dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa bɔri ni bɛ mali Naawuni sizuura lubu biɛhigu Yisa Masia zuɣu ni bahi nya alaka.
en: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ paɣi Yawɛ yuli; dama o noli ni yɛligu ka o daa zaŋ nam ba.
en: Let them all praise the name of the Lord ! He commanded, and they were created;.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ alahichi sanyoo naɣilaa maa ti nyo buɣim luɣ shɛli bɛ ni pii Naawuni jɛmbu duu samban ni luɣ kasi shee la.
en: Then take the bull for the sin offering and burn it in the proper place in the Temple area, outside the Temple building.

dag: Yuuni kam Yisa ba min o ma daa yi chanila Jɛrusalɛm ti puhiri Yaɣigari Chuɣu.
en: Every year the parents of Jesus went to Jerusalem for the Passover Festival.

dag: Di saha ka Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo yaɣili gomna Tatɛnai mini Shɛtaribɔzɛnai ni bɛ tuma zuɣulaantab la daa niŋ kaman Naa Darius ni zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa zaa.
en: Then Tattenai, the governor of the province Beyond the River, Shethar-bozenai, and their colleagues carried out the order of King Darius with all diligence.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ shia ni siɣi a zuɣu na pam, ka a pahi bɛ zuɣu n-tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa ka a biɛhigu taɣi.
en: Then the LORDs spirit will come over you, and you will be caught up in a prophetic frenzy right along with them; it will be like youve become a completely different person.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa gba, ti ku saɣim tin shɛli a ni yɛri maa.
en: He answered, All right, I agree. I won't destroy that town.

dag: Nir yi sabi wuh o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm zali ni di ti tum tuma o kalinsi nyaaŋa, di bi tumdi tuma naɣila o ti shiri kpimi;.
en: In fact, making an agreement of this kind is like writing a will. This is because the one who makes the will must die before it is of any use.

dag: Ka napaɣ Atalia daa wum vuri maa, ka kpe niriba maa sani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: Queen Athaliah heard the crowd and went to the temple.

dag: Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ bɛn bɔri ni bɛn Izraɛlnim su bɛmaŋ la ni yino ni Judas Isikariɔt ŋun daa ti yi Yisa nyaaŋa la.
en: Simon the Cananaean; and Judas, who betrayed Jesus.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba mini Farisiinim daa ti lɔri noli; ka ninvuɣ shɛb kana nti bɔhi Yisa, Bɔ niŋ ka Jɔn nyaandoliba mini Farisiinim nyaandoliba lɔri noli, ka nyin nyaandoliba bi lɔra.
en: On one occasion the followers of John the Baptist and the Pharisees were fasting. Some people came to Jesus and asked him, Why is it that the disciples of John the Baptist and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but yours do not.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni na.
en: So Moses and Aaron walked to the front of the tent.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ni n ni yɛn tiligi n niriba yuun shɛli paaya, ka n ni yɛn darigi n niriba dimnim tibili saha shɛli gba paai.
en: because I intended a day of vengeance; the year of my deliverance had arrived.

dag: Amaa a ba Dauda zuɣu, n ku niŋ li a ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, n ni ti darigi deei nam maa la a bia nuu ni.
en: But I loved your father David, so I will not take your kingdom away from you while you are alive. I will wait until your son becomes king. Then I will take it from him.

dag: di saha nyin be a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni; ka wum, ka chɛ o taali ka niŋ din tuhi, ka ti sokam din simd o tuma kaman a ni mi din be o suhu ni shɛm, dama a kɔŋko m-mi din be daadam kam zaa suhu ni.
en: You know what is in everyone's heart. So from your home in heaven answer their prayers, according to the way they live and what is in their hearts.

dag: ka yɛli Yisa, Karimba, paɣ ŋɔ bela zina tumbu ni ka ti gbaag o.
en: Teacher, they said to Jesus, this woman was caught in the very act of committing adultery.

dag: Kul kpaŋmiya yimaŋ chɛ ka suhudoo be yi mini sokam sunsuuni, ka maliya Naawuni biɛrikasitali din nyɛ nir ni ka shɛli ka ku tooi nya ti Duuma la.
en: Pursue the goal of peace along with everyone—and holiness as well, because no one will see the Lord without it.

dag: Yisa daa piligi ŋahi niriba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Do so n-daa sa wain tihi n-zaŋ li niŋ padiriba nuu ni ni bɛ lihiri li hal ti kpuɣi puu maa atam ti o ka deei bɛ yɔri, ka daa go n-chaŋ tinshee ti yuui.
en: Then Jesus told the people this parable: There was once a man who planted a vineyard, rented it out to tenants, and then left home for a long time.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa kpah o zuɣu ni di zuɣu, ka chɛ ka buŋ ŋun bi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa kaman ninsal la n-kari anabi maa o yinyari tuma ni.
en: But a donkey told him that he was doing wrong. A donkey cannot talk, of course, but that donkey spoke with a mans voice and stopped the prophet from acting so crazy.

dag: M puhiri Traifɛna mini Traifɔsa bɛn nyɛ ti Duuma tumtumdiba la. M puhiri Pɛrisis n ni yuri so ka o nyɛ ŋun tum tuma pam ti Duuma ni la.
en: My greetings to Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work in the Lord's service, and to my dear friend Persis, who has done so much work for the Lord.

dag: O daa chɛ ka zunzuya kana ti ŋub bɛ bindira, ka chɛ ka toli kana ti saɣim bɛ puri atam.
en: He sent locusts to eat their crops and to destroy their fields.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Neesim ni be yi sani yuui biɛla. Ka yi ni mali neesim maa zuɣu, kul chamiya; di yi pa lala zibisim ni ti paai ya. Ŋun chani zibisim ni bi mi o ni kpari shɛli polo.
en: Jesus answered, The light will be with you for only a little longer. Walk in the light while you can. Then you won't be caught walking blindly in the dark.

dag: N yura, a viɛli pam. Yɛlimaŋli, a shiri viɛli pam. Ti bindoo nyɛla momaha.
en: You are so handsome, my lover! Yes, and so charming! Our bed is so fresh and pleasant.

dag: Dama a zaŋ alibarika pam na ti ti o; ka zaŋ salima alali nam zuɣupiligu pil o.
en: You gave the king such wonderful blessings. You put a golden crown on his head.

dag: Amaa ka Pita daa garigi yɛl o, A min a liɣiri maa zaa bahim yoli! Dama a tɛhiya ni a ni tooi zaŋ liɣiri da Naawuni pini.
en: Peter said to Simon, You and your money should both be destroyed because you thought you could buy Gods gift with money.

dag: Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ ŋun bi be lala, dama ŋuna n-nam binshɛɣukam, ka Izraɛlnim nyɛ o ni su zuliya shɛba. O yuli n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: But you, Israel's God, created all things, and you chose Israel to be your very own. Your name is the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Ka naŋgbankpeeni daa kpe bɛ sunsuuni ka bɛ woligi taba di zuɣu; ka Baanabas daa zaŋ Maak pah omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Saipurus.
en: Their argument became so intense that they went their separate ways. Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus.

dag: Paɣ bee doo yi leei jinwara bee bukpaha bɛn kum o. Bɛn labimi ba kuɣa. Bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ni ʒi bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: A man or a woman who is a medium or a wizard must be put to death. The people must kill them with stones. They are responsible for their own death.

dag: Neesim neeri zibisim ni tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi mini bɛn niŋdi nirilim, ni nambɔzɔriba ni wuntizɔriba.
en: Light shines in the darkness for good people, for those who are merciful, kind, and just.

dag: ni Hazarishual ni Bala ni Ɛzɛm.
en: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem.

dag: Ti dimnim maa kpiya, ka buɣim di bɛ ni kani ka chɛ shɛli.
en: our enemies are certainly cut off; fire will devour whats left of them.

dag: Juda kpambaliba mini Jɛrusalɛm kpambaliba ni namɔɣilisi ni maligumaaniba ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛn daa tim naɣisaa maa pirigibu maa sunsuuni gari la.
en: These are the people who walked between the two pieces of the calf when they made the agreement before me: the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the important officials of the court, the priests, and the people of the land.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ o paɣiba min o bihi balisi laakumnima.
en: So Jacob prepared for the trip. He put his children and his wives on camels.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ bɛ ni ku Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb sɔŋ bɛ buɣa tooni, ka zaŋ yi kɔba yɛrigi gili yi maligu bimbina gbini.
en: I will put the dead bodies of the people of Israel in front of their filthy idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars.

dag: N ni ŋuhiri pampam zuɣu, n kpalimla kɔba noli.
en: Because of my sadness, I am losing so much weight that my skin hangs from my bones.

dag: Amaa o ni daa nya yaa saha shɛli maa, ka o daa zaŋ karimbaani kpɛh o kɔbili ni, ka di daa luh o. Dama o daa bi niŋdi din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa sani, ka daa kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ni o ti tuɣili tulaale zim tulaale zim tuɣilibu bimbini zuɣu.
en: Uzziah became proud of his power, and this led to his downfall. One day, Uzziah disobeyed the Lord his God by going into the temple and burning incense as an offering to him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Kumiya doo maa. Zaŋmiy o yi tiŋ tariga, ka niriba maa zaa ti pihi kuɣa lab o.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Tell the people to take that man outside the camp and stone him to death.

dag: Ka nyuli zabbu mini diribarilim tɛha ni be shɛli, nimaani ka chirachira mini tuumbiɛri balibu kam tumbu be.
en: Wherever there is jealousy and selfish ambition, there is disorder and everything that is evil.

dag: Ŋunkam ku biŋkɔbigu, ŋun bom so yo o zuɣu, ka ŋunkam ku ninsala, bɛn kum o.
en: Someone who kills an animal must make amends for it, but whoever kills a human being must be executed.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi yi ti bo ma ni yi suhuri zaa, yi ni nya ma.
en: You will seek me, and you will find me because you will seek me with all your heart.

dag: Ka tumtumdiba maa daa tum tuma, ka duu maa malibu tuma chaŋ tooni. Ka bɛ daa mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ka di be kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm, ka lan niŋ yaa pahi.
en: The men who supervised the work were very faithful. The work to rebuild the Temple was successful. They built Gods Temple the way it was before and they made it stronger.

dag: Dinzuɣu niriba ni nya filiŋ, ka sokam di vi. Di chɛ bɛ taali!.
en: The people have become worse and worse. They have become very low, and you leaders did nothing to lift them up!.

dag: N zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi bɔhi n yɛla, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi bo ma nya ma. N yɛli zuliya shɛb bɛn bi suhiri ma, Mani m-bɔŋɔ, mani m-bɔŋɔ.
en: I, the Lord , was ready to answer even those who were not asking and to be found by those who were not searching. To a nation that refused to worship me, I said, Here I am.

dag: Chɛ ka so m-paɣ a ka pa ni nyin yaag a noli paɣ amaŋa; chɛ ka sana m-paɣ a ka pa ni nyin paɣ amaŋa.
en: Let another person praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.

dag: Ka so yi yɛn mali suhudoo sara ti Yawɛ, di zaligu m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Here are the instructions for offering a sacrifice to ask my blessing:.

dag: dama hal bɛn guni gba maŋmaŋ bi doli fukumsi zaligu, amaa din chɛ ka bɛ bɔri ni yi guni nyɛla ni bɛ tooi nyu bara yi niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu zuɣu.
en: Even those who practice circumcision do not obey the Law; they want you to be circumcised so that they can boast that you submitted to this physical ceremony.

dag: ka yɛli Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Ti ni chaŋ ti kpe tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni m-puɣisi nya li maa tiŋgbani viɛli pam.
en: and said to the entire Israelite community, The land we crossed through to explore is an exceptionally good land.

dag: Ti lo nia ni ti tumla din tuhi, ka di pala zaŋ chaŋ ti Duuma sani kɔŋko, amaa zaŋ chaŋ ninsalinim gba sani.
en: We are trying to do what is right. We want to do what the Lord accepts as right and also what people think is right.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa kari ti paai Sool min o bidibisi n-ku o bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ Jɔnatan mini Abinadab ni Malikishua.
en: But the Philistines caught up with them and killed three of Saul's sons, Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.

dag: Ɛzɛr n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma, ka ŋun pa o zuɣu nyɛ Obadia, ka ŋun pahi ata nyɛ Ɛliab.
en: They were ranked in the following order: Ezer, Obadiah, Eliab, Mishmannah, Jeremiah, Attai, Eliel, Johanan, Elzabad, Jeremiah, and Machbannai.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ a saɣimya teeku puuni, kɔbulli ni. Ka a min a daguya ni a tumtumdiba zaa laɣim shim.
en: Now you are wrecked in the sea; You have sunk to the ocean depths. Your goods and all who worked for you Have vanished with you in the sea.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa piri tɔbbihi maa sɔŋ n-gu tɔbu maa. Bɛ daa chɛ ka tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam dola tiŋ maa nuzaa polo, ka chɛ ka bɛn kpalim mi do tiŋ maa wulinluhili polo. Amaa ka Jɔshua daa gbe vinvamli maa ni.
en: So Joshua had prepared his men for the fight. The main camp was north of the city. The other men were hiding to the west. That night Joshua went down into the valley.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ dabisili din pahir ayopɔin maa ni, ka zaŋ li leei dabisili din be kasi, dama dindali maa ka Naawuni daa vuh o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa binshɛɣukam nambu ni maa jɛlinsi.
en: God blessed the seventh day and made it special, because on that day he rested from his work.

dag: Yinim Itiɔpianima bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku yi gba.
en: People of Ethiopia, this even means you! The Lords sword will kill your people.

dag: ni Bazilit daŋ niriba ni Mɛhida daŋ niriba ni Harisha daŋ niriba.
en: Bazluth, Mehida, Harsha.

dag: Lala zuɣu bɛn bi guni, amaa ka doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm la ni wuhi ni yinim bɛn guni ka mali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu din sabi doya ka yi bi dol li ŋɔ mali taali.
en: So everyone who obeys the Law, but has never been circumcised, will condemn you. Even though you are circumcised and have the Law, you still don't obey its teachings.

dag: Naa Amazia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Amaziahs deeds, arent they written in the official records of Judahs kings?.

dag: Di ni ti niŋ yinim Izraɛlnim lala, dama yi tuumbiɛri galisiya pam. Zaŋ chaŋ biɛkaali, bɛ ni ti ku Izraɛlnim naa.
en: Bethel, this will be your fate because of your evil. Israel, at dawn your king will be killed.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Lɛvinim maa daa kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni nti sɔŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa n-tum tuma. Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Lɛvinim maa polo, lala ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ ba.
en: After this the Levites went in to perform their service in the meeting tent before Aaron and his sons. They did for the Levites just as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning them.

dag: O yiko ni ka o chɛ ka teeku fo n-dɔni baalim. O yɛm ka o daa zaŋ ku Reehab.
en: By his power and wisdom, God conquered the force of the mighty ocean.

dag: Amaa Sɔŋda so n ni yɛn tim ka o yi m Ba sani n-ka yi sanna la nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni be so ni. O yi ti kana, o ni leei n shɛhiralana.
en: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.

dag: O daa bi gbaag omaŋa o sujee ni, o mi daa bi tiligi bɛ nyɛviya, amaa ka daa chɛ ka alɔbo di ba.
en: God blazed a path for his wrath. He didnt save them from death, but delivered their lives over to disease.

dag: Ŋuna n-zali ba ni bɛ kul beni sahakam. O zali ba la zaligu, ka di mi ku yiɣisi.
en: He made all these continue forever. He made the laws that will never end.

dag: Dama dimbɔŋɔ ka o zaŋ su niriba; o tiri ba bindirigu pam.
en: He uses them to control the nations and to give them plenty of food.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ma, Di zaŋ binshɛɣu n-tabili limsi anabitali yɛligu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni, dama saha miriya.
en: Then the angel told me, Dont keep secret the words of prophecy in this book. The time is near for these things to happen.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa kul tɔŋdi pahiri Naa Darius nam ʒiɛman ni zaŋ tabili Naa Sairus ŋun daa nyɛ Pɛriʒia nir la gba nam ʒiɛman ni.
en: So Daniel was successful during the time Darius was king and when Cyrus the Persian was king.

dag: Ti lan yɛl a ni di bi tu ni maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim ni yiliyiiniba ni dunɔguliba ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tumtumdiba bɛn pahi yo farigu.
en: You must also know that it is illegal for you to charge tribute, custom, or dues on any of the priests and Levites, the singers, the doorkeepers, the temple servants, or other servants of this house of God.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bia, mali yaa anfaan shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni la zuɣu.
en: As for you, my son, be strong through the grace that is ours in union with Christ Jesus.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi mi ni pa naŋgban malisim yɛtɔɣa ka ti daa zaŋ ka yi sanna; Naawuni mi n-nyɛ ti shɛhiralana ni ti pala diribarilimnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa limsi diribarilim maa.
en: You know very well that we did not come to you with flattering talk, nor did we use words to cover up greed—God is our witness!.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi ba, Sal yi lee nya dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa ka ti kɔŋ o nyɛvili, nyɔ bɔ ka o lee di?.
en: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself or waste your life?.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka o yɛn chaŋ, ka yihi liɣiri kaman tumtumda daba ayi yɔri ti o yilikpɛrilana, ka yɛl o ni o lihim bara maa viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka lan yɛli ni hal o yi ti di laɣ shɛli o ni ti o maa pooi ka di omaŋmaŋ liɣiri pahi, o yi ti labina o ni yo o.
en: The next morning he gave the innkeeper two silver coins and said, Please take care of the man. If you spend more than this on him, I will pay you when I return.

dag: Ka o ma daa wuh o o ni yɛn suhi shɛli; ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa yɛli Naa Hɛrɔd, Ŋmam Jɔn Baptaizira zuɣu n-niŋ pɔŋ ni na ti ti ma.
en: At her mother's suggestion she asked him, Give me here and now the head of John the Baptist on a plate.

dag: Dinzuɣu yiɣisim kuli. A napɔŋ yi ti kul zani tiŋ puuni, bia maa ni leei Naawuni dini.
en: And Ahijah went on to say to Jeroboam's wife, Now go back home. As soon as you enter the town, your son will die.

dag: Jɛsi daa nyɛla Ɛliab ba. Ɛliab n-daa nyɛ o bituuli, ka ŋun daa pa o zuɣu nyɛ Abinadab, ka ŋun pahi ata daa nyɛ Shimia.
en: Jesse was the father of Eliab his oldest son, Abinadab his second, Shimea his third.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka yi kalinli ti ku lan galisi Yawɛ ni yɛn kari ya bahi zuliya shɛb ni maa.
en: Only a few of you will survive, and the Lord will force you to leave the land and will scatter you among the nations.

dag: Di simdi ni nir siɣis omaŋ Naawuni tooni ;.
en: He should bow down to the Lord. Maybe there is still hope.

dag: Salo ni daa ti laɣimna m-muɣi saha shɛli ka Yisa piligi yɛra, Ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri. Bɛ bɔri ni bɛ nyala shihirili, amaa bɛ ku nya shihir shɛli m-pahila Anabi Jona shihirili la.
en: As crowds were gathering around Jesus, he said: You people of today are evil! You keep looking for a sign from God. But what happened to Jonah is the only sign you will be given.

dag: Lan yɛlimiya, Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti tiligira ŋɔ, fam ti. Yihim ti zuliya kam ni na n-laɣim ti na nti tiligi ti, ka ti paɣir a yuli din be kasi ŋɔ, ka paɣir a ni jilima.
en: Say to him, Save us, O God our Savior; gather us together; rescue us from the nations, so that we may be thankful and praise your holy name.

dag: Di chɛliya ka zina niŋbu mini daɣiri tuma zaa be yi ni bee n-chɛ ka yi kɔre kpɛri binyara ni, dama di bi simdi ni dimbɔŋɔnim be Yisa nyaandoliba biɛhigu ni hal baabiɛla.
en: You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy.

dag: Amaa daadamnim bɛn yi kpi, bɛ lan ka yaa. Daadamnim yi bahi, ya ka bɛ lee lan be?.
en: Humans are different— we die, and that's the end.

dag: Ka o daa ti wum ni Yisa yi Judia ka Galili na, ka o chaŋ o sani nti balim o ni o kana ti tib o bidibiga maa ti o, dama o daa tarigimi yɛn kpi.
en: When he heard that Jesus was coming from Judea to Galilee, he went out to meet him and asked Jesus if he would come and heal his son, for his son was about to die.

dag: Ka Ɛzra ŋun daa lan nyɛ maligumaana la daa zaŋ li ka niriba maa sanna kaman bɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm maa. Bɛ daa nyɛla dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bɛnkam ni tooi wum ka baŋ di gbinni. Di daa nyɛla gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin dahin yini dali.
en: So on the first day of the seventh month, Ezra the priest brought the Instruction before the assembly. This assembly was made up of both men and women and anyone who could understand what they heard.

dag: Sɛrug ni daa ti paai yuun pihita saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Nahɔr.
en: After Serug was years old, his son Nahor was born.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi, n ku lan di li naɣila di gbinni ti niŋ pali Naawuni nam ni.
en: For I tell you, I will never eat it until it is given its full meaning in the Kingdom of God.

dag: Dama m mi ni yi tuumbiɛri galisiya, ka yi daalahichi gba galisi pam. Yi nahindi wuntizɔriba, ka diri birapu, ka kariti tarimba bahira.
en: This is because I know about your many sins. You have done some very bad things: You hurt people who do right, you accept money to do wrong, and you keep the poor from receiving justice in court.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa bol o bi so Zara ni dɔɣi ti o maa yuli Yisahaku.
en: Abraham named his son Isaac.

dag: Ka o daa lan mali bans anahi tam daanya kurupooti maa naŋgbani tarisi bunahi zuɣu din yɛn gbibi di dapuhi.
en: Then he made bronze rings to hold the poles for carrying the altar. He put the rings at the four corners of the grating.

dag: Bolimi pumpɔŋɔ, so beni ŋun ni garig a? Ka malaika ŋuni sani ka a lee yɛn ŋmaligi chaŋ?.
en: Job, call out if you want, and see if anyone answers! But to which of the angels will you turn?.

dag: Ka din chɛ ka saria karibu beni maa nyɛla, neesim ni ka dunia ŋɔ ni na ka salinim ni yu tuumbiɛri tumbu zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ bɔrila zibisim gari neesim maa la.
en: They are judged by this fact: The light has come into the world. But they did not want light. They wanted darkness, because they were doing evil things.

dag: Amaa ka daa naɣ piila Juda zuliya mini Ziɔn Zoli din nyɛ o ni yuri shɛl la.
en: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be Yisifu sani ka chɛ ka o diri nasara o tuma ni. O daa bela o dana ŋun nyɛ Ijipti nir maa yiŋa.
en: So Joseph lived in the home of Potiphar, his Egyptian owner. Soon Potiphar realized that the Lord was helping Joseph to be successful in whatever he did.

dag: Amaa lee miriya ka yi chɛ ka yi yolisim maa leei kuɣituurili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka kpiɔŋ la sani.
en: But watch out or else this freedom of yours might be a problem for those who are weak.

dag: Hal bɛ ku tooi kahigi yɛl shɛŋa zuɣu bɛ ni fiɣisi ma ŋɔ wuh a.
en: These men cannot prove the things they are saying against me now.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣimna, ka o yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Mani n-daa yihi yinim Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka fan ya Ijiptinim mini na shɛb bɛn daa niŋdi ya fitiina la zaa nuu ni bahi.
en: Then he told the Israelites: This is what the LORD God of Israel says: I brought Israel up out of Egypt, and I delivered you from the Egyptians power and from the power of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.

dag: Obal ni Abimeel ni Shiiba ni.
en: Obal, Abimael, Sheba.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ ni na be ŋɔ, biribu saha mini chɛbu saha ni maasim saha ni tulim saha ni shɛɣu saha ni kikaa saha ni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ kul ni beni.
en: As long as the earth exists, seedtime and harvest, cold and hot, summer and autumn, day and night will not cease.

dag: Saamba bɛn be n yiŋa tamla n yɛla. Ka paɣ sara bɛn nyɛ n tumtumdiba zaŋ ma leei sana. N leela tinzun nira bɛ sani.
en: My guests and my servants consider me a stranger.

dag: Di pa shɛli o ni taɣ o tɛha, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka yi nya atam pam. Dina n-ni chɛ ka yi zaŋ chi mini wain ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Who knows whether he will have a change of heart and leave a blessing behind him, a grain offering and a drink offering for the LORD your God?.

dag: Binshɛli daa ka Alikauli Adaka maa puuni, naɣila Musa ni daa zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi shɛŋa niŋ di puuni Sinai Zoli zuɣu luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni daa lo Izraɛlnim alikauli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na nyaaŋa la.
en: The only things kept in the chest were the two flat stones Moses had put there when the Lord made his agreement with the people of Israel at Mount Sinai, after bringing them out of Egypt.

dag: Di saha zoomba nina ni ti neei, ka tikpiranim wum.
en: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be cleared.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa kali niriba maa naai nyaaŋa ka Dauda suhu daa saɣim pam, ka o yɛli Yawɛ, N tum alahichi n ni niŋ shɛm maa zuɣu. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ, n suhir a mi, kpihimi man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ daalahichi maa; dama n tum jɛrilim pam.
en: David felt ashamed after he had counted the people and said to the Lord , I have sinned greatly in what I did! Lord , I beg you, forgive me for my sin. I have been very foolish.

dag: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa yɛli niriba maa Mɔab bɔpiɛligu din daa miri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili, ka be Jɛriko tooni polo la.
en: At this time the people were camped in the Jordan Valley in Moab. This was near the Jordan River, across from Jericho. So Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke to the people. They said.

dag: ni bɛ daazichi zaa ni bɛ paɣiba mini bɛ bihi ni binshɛɣukam din daa be bɛ yinsi zaa chaŋ.
en: After taking everything of value from the houses, they dragged away the wives and children of their victims.

dag: Stɛfanas mini Fɔtunatus ni Akaikus ni daa ka n sanna la niŋ ma suhupiɛlli pam, dama bɛ daa zani yi zaani n-niŋ ma yi ni naan niŋ ma shɛm.
en: I am happy about the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; they have made up for your absence.

dag: Binnamda zaa kul guhirimi ka bɛ suhuri kul ye saha shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn yih o bihi palɔni la zuɣu;.
en: All of creation waits with eager longing for God to reveal his children.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ni n nyɔtaɣirigu; ka n niŋ o naani. Ka n nyari sɔŋsim, ka n suhu piɛla; ka n yiini yila paɣir o.
en: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.

dag: Ka wula ka n lan yɛn yɛli pahi? N lan ka dahima ni n yɛli Gidiɔn mini Barak ni Samsin ni Jɛfita ni Naa Dauda ni Samuɛl ni anabinim bɛn pahi la yɛla.
en: Should I go on? There isn't enough time for me to speak of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o zaŋ dari maa pirigili m-mali buɣim she nimdi ŋubi tiɣi; ka lan zaŋ di shɛŋa mali buɣim wuɣisi ka yɛra, Buɣim ŋɔ wuɣisibu kpe ma nyaɣisim, di kpe n kɔba ni.
en: He enjoys the warm fire and the meat that was roasted over the burning coals.

dag: n ni daa mali bihim paɣiri n naba, ka doori kpam tampima zuɣu la.
en: Life was so good that I washed my feet in cream and had plenty of the finest oils.

dag: Anabi shɛb bɛn daa daŋ m min a tooni na kurimbuni ha la daa tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-yɛri tɔbu tuhibu mini kum ni alɔbo yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndiri tiŋgbɔna mini nam shɛŋa din niriba mali kpiɔŋ.
en: The prophets who spoke long ago, before my time and yours, predicted that war, starvation, and disease would come to many nations and powerful kingdoms.

dag: Ka Asiria naa daa wum Ahaz ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka zaŋ o tɔbbihi chaŋ Damaskus nti ŋme n-nyaŋ ba, ka ku Rɛzin; ka gbahi di niriba n-kuli Kɛɛr nti leei daba.
en: As soon as Tiglath Pileser received the message, he and his troops marched to Syria. He captured the capital city of Damascus, then he took the people living there to the town of Kir as prisoners and killed King Rezin.

dag: Yi daa kam ni dolila jɛmbu duu sania. Gɛra bini pisi n-ni nyɛ anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini.
en: Every price will be set by the official standards.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bundaannima bɛ gom saha, amaa bɛ yi ti neei, bɛ ku lan mali shɛli.
en: They lie down rich, but no longer; open their eyes, but its missing.

dag: Amaa bin yini ŋɔ ka n naɣ kpahim nya: Naawuni nam ninsalinim dɛde, amaa tinim lee bo yɛligabira pam ti timaŋa. .
en: There is one other thing I have learned. God made people good, but they have found many ways to be bad.

dag: Pa nyini n-sa gariche gili Ayuba min o malibu ni o ni su shɛlikam zaa luɣilikam? Nyini n-niŋ alibarika niŋ o tuma ni, ka chɛ ka o buni galisi pam tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: You have always protected him and his family and everything he owns. You bless everything he does, and you have given him enough cattle to fill the whole country.

dag: Anatɔtnim daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihitaayika.
en: from the town of Anathoth:.

dag: O miri ka o ti chaŋ nir ni kpi n-do luɣ shɛli. O miri ka o saɣim omaŋa, hal di yi nyɛla o ba bee o ma.
en: He must not go near any dead bodies and cannot make himself unclean even for his father or mother.

dag: N ni su ninvuɣ shɛb zaa nyɛla a niriba, a mi ni su ninvuɣ shɛb zaa nyɛla n niriba, ka n nyari jilima bɛ sani.
en: Everything that is mine is yours and everything that is yours is mine; I have been glorified in them.

dag: zaŋ tiŋ hal ti yaɣi dunoya zuɣusaa, chɛrubinim mini abie tihi kɔtomsi ka bɛ daa ŋme m-pa di dukpina zuɣu.
en: from the floor to above the doors.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa niŋ ba nirilim ti ba bɛ ni kul suhi shɛlikam zaa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ijiptinim maa daazichi pam pahi chaŋ.
en: The Lord made the Egyptians respect the people and give them what they asked for. In this way the Israelites carried away the wealth of the Egyptians.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn mini ba daa be m-miri taba ni daa kana, bɛ daa yɛli ti siɣimsiɣim bupia, Ti dimnim maa ni yi bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa kana ti liri ti.
en: Now the Jews who were living near them came and said to us again and again, You must return to us.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti kulisi Akisa na dahin shɛli, ka Otiniɛl daa kpam o jaande ni o suhim o ba tiŋgbani palo. Ka Akisa daa ti sheeg o buŋ zuɣu na; ka Kalɛb bɔh o, Bɔ ka a bɔra.
en: Acsah went to live with Othniel. Othniel told Acsah to ask her father Caleb for some more land. Acsah went to her father. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, What do you want.

dag: N ni ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa, ka ku noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ mini teeku ni zahim, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri tuui; n ni ku ninsalinim zaa dunia yili. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: people and animals, birds and fish. Everyone who is evil will crash to the ground, and I will wipe out the entire human race.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Bɔzuɣu ka a min a yidan naai noli ni yi zahim ti Duuma Shia Kasi? Nyama, bɛn zaŋ a yidan yi nti sɔɣi n-na be soli kanna ŋɔ; bɛ ni zaŋ a gba yi.
en: He replied, How could you scheme with each other to challenge the Lords Spirit? Look! The feet of those who buried your husband are at the door. They will carry you out too.

dag: Amaa tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba bɛn lo kpara ŋɔ zaa ni du n-chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu maa ti Yawɛ kaman nyin ti dan ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: But we, your servants, will cross the Jordan River. We will march before the Lord into battle, as our master says.

dag: Ka o lan bɔhi ba, Ka wula ka bɛ daa lee baptaizi ya? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Jɔn Baptaizira baptaizibu ka ti daa deei.
en: Then why were you baptized? Paul asked. They answered, Because of what John taught.

dag: Yihimiya yi biɛr kurili din chɛ ka yi be kaman yi ni daa pun be shɛm la bahi, dama yi biɛr kurili maa daa pun saɣim la kɔr biɛ shɛŋa din daa yɔhim ya la puuni.
en: So get rid of your old self, which made you live as you used to—the old self that was being destroyed by its deceitful desires.

dag: Wuhimi yɛnnima, ka bɛ nyari yɛm pahira. Wuhimi wuntizɔriba, ka bɛ nyari anfaani bɔhimbu puuni.
en: Anything you say to the wise will make them wiser. Whatever you tell the righteous will add to their knowledge.

dag: A min a zuliya maa ni yɛn doli n daalikauli shɛli maa m-bɔŋɔ: Di simdi ni yi puuni doo kam guni.
en: This is my covenant that you and your descendants must keep: Circumcise every male.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be Yisifu sani ka chɛ ka o diri nasara o tuma ni. O daa bela o dana ŋun nyɛ Ijipti nir maa yiŋa.
en: The Lord was with Joseph and made him successful. He lived in the house of his Egyptian master.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, So m-bi bu ti paa. Di saha ka o yɛli ba, Yi gba chamiya m puu ŋɔ ni ha ti tum tuma.
en: Because nobody has hired us, they replied. He responded, You also go into the vineyard.

dag: Amaa ka o daa bɔhi ŋun yɛl o lala maa, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ m ma, ka banim mi nyɛ a tizɔbihi.
en: Jesus answered, Who is my mother? Who are my brothers.

dag: Dama bidibiga lihi ʒiɛm o ba, ka bipuɣiŋga yiɣisi lu o ma zuɣu. Ka paɣa yiɣisi lu o yidan ma zuɣu. Ka nir dimnim ni nyɛla omaŋmaŋ yiŋnima.
en: In these times sons treat their fathers like fools, daughters oppose their mothers, and young women quarrel with their mothers-in-law; your enemies are the members of your own family.

dag: Dinzuɣu yumiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol o ni yɛli shɛm min o fukumsi zalikpana ni o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi sahakam.
en: The Lord is your God, so you must always love him and obey his laws and teachings.

dag: Ka nyin ŋun wuhir a tab ŋɔ, a ku wuh amaŋa? Nyin ŋun wuhiri niriba ni bɛ di zu, a nyɛla ŋun zura?.
en: But how can you teach others when you refuse to learn? You preach it is wrong to steal. But do you steal?.

dag: Di pa shɛli o ni taɣ o tɛha, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka yi nya atam pam. Dina n-ni chɛ ka yi zaŋ chi mini wain ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Who knows, maybe he will change his mind and leave behind a blessing for you. Then you can give grain and drink offerings to the Lord your God.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba maa, Ti Duuma Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Izraɛlnima, chɛliya yi ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa ka di nyɛ din chihiri la zaa.
en: Tell those rebellious people of Israel that I, the Sovereign Lord , will no longer tolerate the disgusting things that they have been doing.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ be kasi bɛ Naawuni sani ka miri ka bɛ dihi bɛ Naawuni yuli vi; dama bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn zaŋdi bɛ Naawuni bindira n-nyɔri buɣim maani sara tiri Yawɛ, dinzuɣu di simdi ni bɛ be kasi.
en: Priests must be holy for their God. They must show respect for Gods name. They offer the bread and special gifts to the Lord , so they must be holy.

dag: Amaa bomiya baaŋa ti ma na pumpɔŋɔ. Baaŋa maa ni daa ti yiini yila saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ yiko siɣi Ilaisha zuɣu na.
en: Now get me a musician. As the musician played his harp, the power of the Lord came on Elisha.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa ti bol o ba Ibrahimma, M ba! Ka o garigi yɛli, M bia, n-nyɛ ma Ka o bɔh o, Buɣim mini dari m-bɔŋɔ, ka piɛ so ti ni ti yɛn zaŋ mali sara maa lee be ya.
en: Isaac spoke up, Father! He answered, Yes, my son? Isaac asked, I see that you have the coals and the wood, but where is the lamb for the sacrifice.

dag: yin miriya ka yi ti wum lala niriba maa yɛligu. Di zɔnya ba nambɔɣu bee n-fa ba bahi.
en: But do not let any of them persuade you; do not even listen to them. Show them no mercy or pity, and do not protect them.

dag: Dabisa kanna, ka bɛ ni ti duhi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zoli ŋɔ ka di du n-gari zoya zaa, ka du n-gari daboya. Ka niriba ti daai ka di gbinna.
en: In the future, the mountain with the Lord 's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills, and every nation will rush to it.

dag: Paɣ maa daa yɛla ago ʒiɛɣu, ka o luɣilikam nyaɣim salima mini kuɣ viɛla yɛri ni waya, ka o gbib salima pipia o nuu ni ka chihi biɛri min o zina niŋbu tabizahim daɣiri pal li.
en: The woman was dressed in purple and red. She was shining with the gold, jewels, and pearls that she was wearing. She had a golden cup in her hand. This cup was filled with terribly evil things and the filth of her sexual sin.

dag: O daa lan bo sida dakuɣiri din ka kalinli, dama Sidɔnnim mini Taainim daa ʒi sida dakuɣiri maa pam na ti ti Dauda.
en: He had the people of Tyre and Sidon bring him a large number of cedar logs.

dag: ni tiŋgban nɛl ni viɣu ni jukangba ni kulijuɣu.
en: the desert owl, the carrion vulture, the cormorant.

dag: Ka Kalɛb daa yɛli, Ŋun ni tooi chaŋ ti liri Kiriatisɛfanima n-tuhi nyaŋ ba ka deei bɛ tiŋ maa, n ni zaŋ m bipuɣiŋga Akisa ti o paɣ pini.
en: Before they started to fight, Caleb made a promise to the men. He said, I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage to whoever attacks and conquers Kiriath Sepher.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yiɣisi bindirigu maa dibu shee m-pirig o kparibu sɔŋ, ka zaŋ bɔdua mil o shee ni.
en: So he got up from the table and took off his robes. Picking up a linen towel, he tied it around his waist.

dag: Ti yaannim daa di bindiri shɛli bɛ ni daa booni manna la mɔɣu ni kaman di ni sabi shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la. Di sabiya: O daa ti ba bindirigu din yi alizanda ni na ka bɛ di. .
en: Our ancestors ate manna in the desert, just as the scripture says, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

dag: Ka kul kpalimmiya be yil yin ni n-diri ka nyuri bɛ ni kul tin ya shɛlikam, dama tumtumda kam simdi yɔri. Ka miriya ka yi lɔhiri yiya.
en: Stay in the peace-loving house. Eat and drink what the people there give you. A worker should be given his pay. Dont leave that house to stay in another house.

dag: nti lihi Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni vinvamli la zaa polo n-nya ka nyɔhi din ŋmani mɔɣu din galisi pam buɣim nyɔhi la kpuɣi du zuɣusaa.
en: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah and saw smoke rising from all over the land—it was like a flaming furnace.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka di nyɛla Liya. Ka Yaakubu daa bɔhi Leeban, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ma lala? Reechɛl zuɣu ka n tum tuma ti a, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɔhim ma.
en: The next morning Jacob found out that he had married Leah, and he asked Laban, Why did you do this to me? Didn't I work to get Rachel? Why did you trick me.

dag: Nam fukumsi yi nahindi tarimba ka bi niŋdi din tuhi, ka mɔŋ ba bɛ yɛlimaŋli soya, nyin di chɛ ka di gar a; dama tuma zuɣulan kam gba malila zuɣulana, ka ŋun nyɛ bɛ zaa mi zuɣulan gba beni.
en: Don't be surprised when you see that the government oppresses the poor and denies them justice and their rights. Every official is protected by someone higher, and both are protected by still higher officials.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛlnima, di pala yi zuɣu ka n yɛn tum tuuni ŋɔ; amaa n yuli din be kasi ka nyɛ yi ni daa saɣim shɛli zuliya shɛb sani yi ni daa be la zuɣu.
en: Now then, give the Israelites the message that I, the Sovereign Lord , have for them: What I am going to do is not for the sake of you Israelites, but for the sake of my holy name, which you have disgraced in every country where you have gone.

dag: Nolɔɣu kukoli saha ka Samuɛl daa ti boli Sool pii maa zuɣu yɛl o, Yiɣisim ka m biɛl a zali soli. Ka Sool yiɣisi ka o mini Samuɛl daa lu soli.
en: and Saul went to sleep. Early the next morning, Samuel shouted to Saul on the roof and said, Get up. I will send you on your way. Saul got up and went out of the house with Samuel.

dag: Ɛlikana bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Amasai mini Ahimɔt.
en: Elkanah had two sons, Amasai and Ahimoth.

dag: Yɛhudianim maligumaaniba zuɣulan ŋun yuli daa booni Siiva bidibis ayopɔin n-daa niŋdi lala maa.
en: The seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, were doing this.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa ni o ni daa zaŋ wɔb nyina n-dih o nam yil shɛli nachiinsi la ni o ni daa me tin shɛŋa zaa la, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: The rest of Ahabs deeds and all that he did—including the ivory palace he built and all the towns he constructed—arent they written in the official records of Israels kings?.

dag: Bɛ kul dolila bɛ nia biɛri maa soli n-gbaari nia ni bɛ bari zana ashilɔni; ka tɛhira, Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi nya ti?.
en: They encourage themselves with evil words. They plan on laying traps in secret. Who will be able to see them? they ask.

dag: O daa tila Bɛtɛlnim mini Ramɔt din be Nɛgɛb Jatir tiŋgban ni la nima.
en: It went to those in Bethel, Ramoth of the arid southern plain, Jattir.

dag: Ka Naaman daa zaŋ o yuri min o chɛchɛbuŋa ŋ-ŋmaligi chaŋ ti zani Ilaisha yiŋ dunol ni.
en: So Naaman went with his horses and chariot and stopped at the entrance to Elisha's house.

dag: O daa yɛli Gaad zuliya: Ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛligi Gaad tiŋgbani ŋɔ mali alibarika. Gaad zuliya niriba ŋmanila gbuɣinli. O darigiri tɔhigiri bɔɣu, ka darigiri fuɣiri zuɣugbana.
en: Tribe of Gad, the Lord will bless you with more land. So shout his praises! Your tribe is like a lion ripping up its victim.

dag: Wuntizɔra ŋɔ daa bela niriba ŋɔ ni, ka o ni daa nyari shɛli ka wumdi shɛli dabisili kam daa nyɛla niriba maa tuumbiɛ shɛŋa din kul chihir o suhu.
en: That good man lived among them, and day after day he suffered agony as he saw and heard their evil actions.

dag: N ni daa nya ʒii shɛli maa daa ŋmanila n ni daa pun nya ʒii shɛli saha shɛl o ni daa kana ni o ti wurim tiŋ maa la, ka lan ŋmani n ni daa nya ʒii shɛli n ni daa be Kɛba Mɔɣili noli la. Ka n daa teei dɔni n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa.
en: This vision was like the one I had seen when God came to destroy Jerusalem, and the one I saw by the Chebar River. Then I threw myself face downward on the ground.

dag: O daa kpihim binnɛma balibu kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni birili; ninsalinim zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri ni biŋgbamda ni noonsi zaa bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni. Kulla Nuhu mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani ŋariŋ maa ni kɔŋko n-daa naɣ tiligi.
en: God wiped away every living thing that was on the fertile land—from human beings to livestock to crawling things to birds in the sky. They were wiped off the earth. Only Noah and those with him in the ark were left.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla binshɛŋa din niŋbu chihira n-zali n jɛmbu duu n-ta li daɣiri.
en: They have set up repulsive idols in my temple, and now it isn't a fit place to worship me.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Sool, M mi lee nyɛ ŋuni, ka n daŋ niriba lee nyɛ banima bee m ba zuliya mi lee nyɛ banim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka n ti yɛn leei naa deemba.
en: Im not worthy, David replied to Saul, and neither is my family or my fathers clan in Israel, to become the kings son-in-law.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Jɛrimia daa yɛli Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa Jɛrusalɛm.
en: I went to Zedekiah and told him what the Lord had said.

dag: Ka a ti chaŋ ti yɛli Firawuna, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛl nyɛla m bidib kpɛma.
en: Then tell him that I have said, Israel is my first-born son.

dag: Ka Rut daa chaŋ ti doli kachɛriba nyaaŋa yihiri bɛ ni daa chɛri ka guuri shɛŋa bahiri la zaɣ yiha. Ka di daa ti niŋ daliri ka o chaŋ Bɔaz ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛlimɛlɛk dɔɣim la puu ni.
en: So Ruth went to the fields. She followed the workers who were cutting the grain and gathered the grain that was left. It happened that part of the field belonged to Boaz, the man from Elimelechs family.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti gbahi ya n-niŋ ya alaka, ka kun ya; ka zuliya kam ti jɛn ya n yuli zuɣu.
en: Then you will be arrested and handed over to be punished and be put to death. Everyone will hate you because of me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa niŋ di puuni, ka zaŋ salima jɛŋgbaris adaka mini alɔbo kɔtomsi la niŋ di ni.
en: Then the Philistines put the Lord s Holy Box on the wagon along with the bag with the golden models of the tumors and mice.

dag: Ka Jɔram daa ŋmaligi guui ka kuhi yɛli Ahazia, Nyaanyibo yɛtɔɣa m-bala.
en: Ahaziah, let's get out of here! Joram yelled. It's a trap! As Joram tried to escape.

dag: N zanila n Duuma zaani ni n yɛli dimbɔŋɔ kpahi yi zuɣu ni, di lan maliya bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni ka bɛ tɛha nyɛ tɛhi yoya la biɛhigu.
en: So Im telling you this, and I insist on it in the Lord: you shouldnt live your life like the Gentiles anymore. They base their lives on pointless thinking.

dag: Dinzuɣu chama, n ni be a nol ni n-wuh a a ni ti yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: Now go! When you speak, I will be with you and give you the words to say.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni sakom leei taŋkpa zim ka duɣiduɣi kɔŋko yiri sagbana ni luri yi zuɣu na hal ti kun ya.
en: He will send dust and sandstorms instead of rain, and you will be wiped out.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ku ba hal ka bɛ ti ŋmaligi guui. Dauda daa kula Siria chɛchɛbumbariba kɔbisiyopɔin, ka ku wɔribariba mi tuhi pihinahi, ka daa ti Shɔbak ŋun daa nyɛ kamɔna kpɛm maa daŋa, ka o kpi nimaani.
en: But the Arameans fled before Israel, and David destroyed seven hundred of their chariots and forty thousand horsemen. David wounded their army commander Shobach, and he died there.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa yɛl o malaika tab bɛn ʒe o tooni, Yeemiya doo maa ni ye binyɛr daɣ shɛŋa maa. Di saha maa ka o daa yɛli Jɔshua, N yihila a daalahichi, ka yɛn zaŋ binyɛr suma yɛl a.
en: Then the angel said to the other angels standing near him, Take those dirty clothes off Joshua. Then the angel spoke to Joshua. He said, Now, I have taken away your guilt, and I am giving you a new change of clothes.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Di sabiya yaha, Miri ka a zahim a Duuma Naawuni. .
en: Jesus answered, The Scriptures also say, Don't try to test the Lord your God! .

dag: Doliya li viɛnyɛliŋga, dina n-ni wuhi yi yɛm mini yi baŋsim ni nyɛ shɛm niriba sani; bɛ yi ti wum zaligunim ŋɔ zaa yɛla bɛ ni yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, zuliya titali ŋɔ niriba nyɛla bɛn mali yɛm mini baŋsim.
en: Keep them faithfully because that will show your wisdom and insight to the nations who will hear about all these regulations. They will say, Surely this great nation is a wise and insightful people.

dag: Yi yi kpe kom puuni ni yi gari, n ni be yi sani, ka yi yi siɣila mɔɣa ni, di ku niŋ ya shɛli. Ka yi yi kpɛla buɣim ni, di ku din ya; di buɣim niɛm ku tooi din ya.
en: When you pass through deep waters, I will be with you; your troubles will not overwhelm you. When you pass through fire, you will not be burned; the hard trials that come will not hurt you.

dag: Bɛ tibirila n niriba maa daŋa bɛ baɣa ka tibbu ka yɛra, Di mali soochi, di mali soochi. Ka soochi mi kani.
en: They treat the wound of my people as if it were nothing: All is well, all is well, they insist, when in fact nothing is well.

dag: Malimi soli ti takɔbi maa ka di ka Raba din nyɛ Ammɔnnim tiŋ la ni na bee n-ka Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ bɛ ni me gooni gili tin shɛli la ni na.
en: One will show the king the way to the Ammonite city of Rabbah, and the other the way to Judah, to the fortified city, Jerusalem.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ nyin daadam, yilimi kuyilli bahi Taai zuɣu.
en: You, human one, sing a lament for Tyre.

dag: Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka yi bi lan mali suhupiɛlli kaman yi ni daa pun mali shɛm la? N din ya shɛhira ni di yi di daa naan nani, yi daa naan kpaɣi yimaŋmaŋ nina ti ma.
en: You were very happy then. Where is that joy now? I can say without a doubt that you would have done anything to help me. If it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.

dag: ka Naawuni daa sɔŋ ba ka bɛ nyaŋ Hagirinim mini bɛn daa pahi bɛ zuɣu maa zaa. Dama bɛ daa niŋla Naawuni yɛda ka suh o ni o sɔŋ ba tɔb maa ni.
en: Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies.

dag: N ku tooi niŋ yinim Izraɛlnim kaman yaɣimɛra maa ni niŋ shɛm maa? Yawɛ lan yɛli, Yaɣiri maa ni kul be yaɣimɛra maa nuu ni shɛm maa, lala ka yinim Izraɛlnim gba be n nuu ni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Family of Israel, you know that I can do the same thing with you. You are like the clay in the potters hands, and I am the potter. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Manna maa daa ŋmanila tiwal shɛli din biɛlim pɔripɔra, ka di kɔtomsi nyɛ zaɣ piɛlifaa kaman dɔzim la.
en: The manna was like small coriander seeds, and it looked like sap from a tree.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa lab kulina maa mini bɛnkam zaa daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ bali bɛ ni, ka woligi bɛmaŋ ka chɛ zuliya shɛb bɛn daa be nimaani daɣiri tuma ni bɛ jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni la zaa daa laɣim di li.
en: The sacrifices were eaten by the Israelites who had returned and by the neighboring people who had given up the sinful customs of other nations in order to worship the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔram daa lab kuli Jɛziriil ni o ti tibi dan shɛli Sirianim ni daa ti o Rama saha shɛl o mini Siria Naa Hazaɛl ni daa tuhiri tab la. Ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔram bia Ahazia daa chaŋ Jɛziriil ni o ti kaai Ɛhab bia Jɔram, o ni daa biɛri la zuɣu.
en: He returned to the city of Jezreel to recover from his wounds, and Ahaziah went there to visit him.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ ni bɛ bari zana gbaag o o yɛtɔɣa puuni.
en: trying to lay traps for him and catch him saying something wrong.

dag: Di yuma anahi nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa chaŋ ti yɛli naa, Naa, n suhir a mi, chɛ ka n chaŋ Hiburɔn nti pali n ni daa lo Yawɛ alikauli shɛli nimaani.
en: At the end of four years, Absalom said to the king, Please let me go to Hebron so I can fulfill a promise I made to the LORD.

dag: Yi yi doli Naawuni nam zaligu kaman di ni wuhi shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la, yi niŋ din tuhi. Dina n-nyɛ: Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la.
en: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, amaa o daa lee bi tumla alahichi paai Izraɛl na shɛb bɛn daa daŋ o tooni la.
en: He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes, but he wasnt as bad as the Israelite kings who preceded him.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu ti kpamdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi lala maa jaande, ka zaani ba zaligu ni bɛ be baalim ka tummi tuma lihiri bɛmaŋa.
en: Our instruction to them is to stop bothering others, to start working and earn their own food. It is by the authority of the Lord Jesus Christ that we are urging them to do this.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Alɔbo ni yi nuzaa polo na ti lu tiŋgbani maa ni niriba zaa zuɣu.
en: He said to me, Destruction will boil over from the north on all who live in this land.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o yihi biŋkpam din pili namanama zuɣu la mini biŋkpam din be namanama maa ni zaa.
en: Then you may present as your offering—a food gift for the LORD—the fat that covers and surrounds the insides.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Naawuni daa kpuɣi Inok ka o bi kpi, ka so daa bi lan nya o, Naawuni ni daa kpuɣ o maa zuɣu. Naawuni Kundi di shɛhira yɛli ni Naawuni ni daa na bi kpuɣi Inok saha shɛli, o daa nyɛla Naawuni nini ni tiɣi so.
en: By faith Enoch was taken up so that he didnt see death, and he wasnt found because God took him up. He was given approval for having pleased God before he was taken up.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni kariti ninvuɣ biɛri saria shɛm m-pal a kɔbili ni, ka saria karibu mini yɛlimaŋli gbaag a.
en: But you are full of this talk about guilt, judgment, and justice!.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Amaa yinim bɛn nyɛ n zɔnim ŋɔ, n yɛri ya mi, di zɔriya bɛn ni tooi ku daadam ka ku tooi lan niŋ shɛli pahi.
en: My friends, don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but after that, there is nothing else they can do.

dag: A ni di a tuma nyɔri. A ni tɔŋ ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.

dag: Ka n daa nya malaika so ka o yi alizanda ni na n-gbib bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga la saafɛbia mini zoligo titali o nuu ni.
en: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven, holding in his hand the key to the abyss and a huge chain.

dag: Ka Izraɛl paɣ bia maa daa tu Naawuni, ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi Musa sani. O ma yuli n-daa booni Shɛlomit, o daa nyɛla Dibiri bipuɣiŋga, ka nyɛ Dan zuliya ni nira.
en: during which the half-Israelite blasphemed the Lords name and cursed. So he was brought to Moses.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ nti ʒini tin shɛli din yuli booni Nazarɛt la ni di chɛ ka anabinim ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. Bɛ daa yɛliya ni bɛ ni ti bol o Nazarɛt nira.
en: and made his home in a town named Nazareth. And so what the prophets had said came true: He will be called a Nazarene.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyama, n yɛn zaŋla n jaaŋgbee din be n nuu ni ŋɔ fiɛbi ko shɛli din be Nail Mɔɣili ŋɔ ni ŋɔ ka di leei ʒim, ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: So the Lord says that he will do something to show you that he is the Lord . I will hit the water of the Nile River with this walking stick in my hand, and the river will turn into blood.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn ʒiɛmdi ninvuɣ biɛri, amaa ka tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri Yawɛ jilima. Ka lan nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbib bɛ ni po pɔ shɛŋa, hal di yi ni ti ba wahala shɛlikam.
en: They hate those who fail to please God and honor those who respect the Lord . If they make a promise to their neighbor, they do what they promised.

dag: Ka daa zaŋ Saimɔn n-chaŋ Yisa sani. Ka Yisa daa ti yul o ka yɛl o, Nyini n-nyɛ Saimɔn, Jɔn bia la. Ka lan yɛl o, Zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, a yuli m-booni Siifas. Yuli ŋɔ mini Pita nyɛla zaɣ yini. Di gbinni nyɛla Kuɣili.
en: Then he took Simon to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, Your name is Simon son of John, but you will be called Cephas.

dag: Man Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa zahim zahin shɛli maa m-bala. To, nyin Bɛlitishaaza, wuhim ma di gbinni. Dama baŋdiba zaa bɛn be n tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni so kani n-ni tooi wuhi ma di gbinni, amaa nyin ni tooi, dama wun shɛb bɛn be kasi shia be a ni.
en: This is the dream I had, said King Nebuchadnezzar. Now, Belteshazzar, tell me what it means. None of my royal advisers could tell me, but you can, because the spirit of the holy gods is in you.

dag: ka ŋme gbuɣima mini naɣilahi ni chɛrubinim kɔtomsi pa dapaɣ shɛŋa o ni daa zaŋ kpɛhikpɛhi firimnim la ni zuɣu. Ka pɔripɔri daanya niŋ firimnim maa mini gbuɣima ni naɣilahi maa zuɣusaa ni bɛ tiŋli.
en: On the panels and frames were bronze bulls, lions, and Cherub angels. There were designs of flowers hammered into the bronze above and below the bulls and lions.

dag: A ni da binshɛli a kpee sani ka di dolila chuɣu maa puhibu nyaaŋa yuma kalinli yaakaza tariga. Ka o mi kɔhi li ti a ka di dol a ni yɛn kpuɣi atam yuma shɛm tariga.
en: If you want to buy your neighbors land, count the number of years since the last Jubilee, and use that number to decide the right price. You are only buying the rights for harvesting crops until the next Jubilee.

dag: Dama n tɛhiya ni Naawuni zaŋ tinim tuumba ŋɔ zalila zaashe shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa ni, ka ti be kaman bɛ ni bahi noli ni bɛ kum ninvuɣ shɛb palɔni, ka leei malaikanim mini ninsalinim ni lihiri shɛb ninliha dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: But it seems to me that God has given me and the other apostles the last place. We are like prisoners condemned to die, led in a parade for the whole world to see—not just people but angels too.

dag: amaa n zɔrila bɛ dimnim ni yɛn kuri ma sul shɛli, dama bɛ dimnim maa ku baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm ka ni yɛli, Ti nuhi n-ti ti nasara, pa Yawɛ n-daa niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa.
en: But I know what their enemies would say. The enemy would not understand. They would brag and say, The Lord did not destroy Israel. We won by our own power.

dag: Bɛnkam zaŋ bɛ ni wuhi ba shɛli niŋ bɛ baɣaka ʒiɛmdila bɛmaŋa, amaa bɛn wum saɣisigu ni nya tɛhi zilima.
en: Those who refuse discipline despise themselves, but those who listen to correction gain understanding.

dag: Bɛ daa diri ka nyura, ka kpuɣiri paɣiba, ka zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba hal ti paai Anabi Nuhu ni daa kpe ŋariŋ ni dahin shɛli ka kom kana ti di bɛ zaa ha la.
en: People were eating, drinking, and getting married even on the day when Noah entered the boat. Then the flood came and killed them all.

dag: Hal a niriba Izraɛlnim ni kul galisi kaman teeku noli bihigu maa, kulla bɛ ni niriba biɛla kɔŋko n-ni ti labina. Bahiyoli din simdi ba kul ʒiɛmi guli ba.
en: Even though now there are as many people of Israel as there are grains of sand by the sea, only a few will come back. Destruction is in store for the people, and it is fully deserved.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, Yinim Judanim zaa mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni Naa Jɛhɔshafat, Wummiya; Yawɛ ni yɛli ya shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di zɔriya dabiɛm, ka di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhiri salo pam zuɣu, dama tɔb maa pala yi dini, amaa di nyɛla Naawuni dini.
en: Pay attention, all of Judah, every inhabitant of Jerusalem, and King Jehoshaphat, Jahaziel said. This is what the LORD says to you: Dont be afraid or discouraged by this great army because the battle isnt yours. It belongs to God!.

dag: Dama nyin daa niŋ li la ashilɔni, amaa man yɛn niŋ li la palɔni wuntaŋ ni Izraɛlnim zaa ninni. .
en: You sinned in secret, but I will make this happen in broad daylight for all Israel to see.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahir ayɔbu puuni gol so ŋun pahir ayɔbu daba anu dali ka n daa ʒi n yiŋa, ka Juda kpamba daa ʒi n tooni, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yiko daa siɣi n zuɣu na nimaani.
en: On the fifth day of the sixth month of the sixth year of our exile, the leaders of the exiles from Judah were sitting in my house with me. Suddenly the power of the Sovereign Lord came on me.

dag: Ka baŋdiba maa garigi yɛl o, So ka dunia ŋɔ ni ŋun ni tooi yɛli nyin naa a ni bɔri ni a baŋ shɛli maa. Na so kani, hal na kara bɛn mali yiko pam ni yino na ʒi n-yɛl o timanim mini saŋmaribaŋdiba ni Kalidianim ni bɛ wuhim o yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo.
en: The Chaldeans answered the king: No one on earth can do what the king is asking! No king or ruler, no matter how great, has ever asked such a thing of any dream interpreter, enchanter, or Chaldean.

dag: Yi ni yɛn tiri Naawuni pina shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Alikama tahili kam puuni, yi ni yihi kuruwa pirigibu buyɔbu puuni yim zuɣu ti. Chi tahili kam puuni, yi ni yihi kuruwa pirigibu buyɔbu puuni yim zuɣu ti.
en: Leaders of Israel, the people must bring you one sixtieth of their grain harvests as offerings to me.

dag: Chɛliya ka Masia ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naa ŋɔ siɣi dapulli ŋɔ zuɣu na pumpɔŋɔ, ka ti nya ka niŋ o yɛda. Ka bɛ ni daa kpahi shɛb tabili dapula m-pah o zuɣu la gba yɛr o zilima.
en: Let us see the Messiah, the king of Israel, come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him! And the two who were crucified with Jesus insulted him also.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Olivi tia dari m-mali chɛrubinima ayi n-zali du shɛli din nyɛ Luɣ Kasi shee maa puuni. Chɛrubi yino kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita anahi ni biɛla.
en: He made two winged creatures of olive wood for the inner sanctuary, each fifteen feet high.

dag: Bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm wuhiri ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm sabi be bɛ suhuri ni, ka bɛ suhuri ni tɛha gba di ba shɛhira ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, dama shɛlini bɛ tɛha galindi ba, ka shɛlini mi ka di zaani bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: They show the proof of the Law written on their hearts, and their consciences affirm it. Their conflicting thoughts will accuse them, or even make a defense for them.

dag: A ni daa piligi balindi Naawuni saha shɛl la ka o daa garig a. Naawuni yur a pam. Lala zuɣu ka n kana ni n ti yɛl a o ni garig a yɛli shɛm. Dinzuɣu luɣim a tiba wum n ni yɛn wuh a ʒii maa gbinni shɛm.
en: When you began to plead with God, he answered you. He loves you, and so I have come to tell you the answer. Now pay attention while I explain the vision.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ daa shiri niŋ Judanima kaman Yawɛ ni zali shɛm ni o yihi ba o sani. Manaasa ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa la.
en: This happened at the Lord 's command, in order to banish the people of Judah from his sight because of all the sins that King Manasseh had committed.

dag: Jɔnatan bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Mɛribbaal; ka Mɛribbaal daa nyɛ Maika ba.
en: Jonathans son was Merib Baal. Merib Baal was Micahs father.

dag: Yi salima mini yi daanzinfa zahimya ka di zahimbu maa din ya shɛhira biɛɣu, ka ni di yi niŋgbuna kaman buɣim ni diri binyara shɛm la. Yi kahi azichi guli dabisa din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ puuni.
en: Your gold and silver are covered with rust, and this rust will be a witness against you and will eat up your flesh like fire. You have piled up riches in these last days.

dag: N daa tuui zaŋ li yɛl la Ziɔnnima, ka zaŋ di lahiba suŋ molo m-moli Jɛrusalɛmnim sani.
en: I first said it to Zion, Look, here they are; to Jerusalem I now send a herald.

dag: Goli maa daba anu dali daa nyɛla bɛ ni daa gbaai Naa Jɛhɔyakin chaŋ la yuma anu saha.
en: It was the fifth year since King Jehoiachin had been taken into exile.

dag: A daa lan nya napɔnvari mini napombihi la ka di shɛli polo nyɛla yaɣiri, ka shɛli polo mi nyɛ kuriti. Di nam maa ni ti pirigi. Di ni ti mali kuriti kpiɔŋ la shɛli, kuriti maa mini yaɣiri ni gari tab la zuɣu.
en: You saw that the feet and toes of the statue were partly clay and partly iron. That means the fourth kingdom will be a divided kingdom. It will have some of the strength of iron in it just as you saw the iron mixed with clay.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl daa kpuɣi wuna maa n-zaŋ niŋ laakum gal ni n-du n-ʒi di zuɣu. Ka Leeban daa vihi suɣili maa ni zaa bo li ka bi nya li.
en: She had already hidden them in the cushion she used as a saddle and was sitting on it. Laban searched everywhere and did not find them.

dag: Dama n ni daa yihi yi yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na saha shɛl la n daa saɣisi ba ni nimmoo, ka kul saɣisiri ba waawaayili hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-yɛra, Deemiya n noli.
en: I repeatedly and tirelessly warned your ancestors when I brought them out of the land of Egypt to this very day, saying, Obey me.

dag: bee n-niŋdi shiriku bee n-nyɛ dɔdihira bee kpilikparisilana.
en: or charms, and don't let them consult the spirits of the dead.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n wuntia ŋɔ, n yi suh a, nyin garigim ma. N daa be muɣisigu ni ka a ti ma faako. Niŋm ma nirilim ka deei n suhigu.
en: God, you showed that I was innocent. You gave me relief from all my troubles. So listen to me now when I call to you for help. Be kind to me and hear my prayer.

dag: Ɛpafiras ŋun gba nyɛ yi ni yino ka nyɛ Yisa Masia tumtumda la puhiri ya. O kul suhiri Naawuni ni nimmoo n-tiri ya ni Naawuni chɛ ka yi bi niriba ka ba n-zani n-niŋ naani zaa Naawuni yubu tumbu puuni.
en: Epaphras, who is one of you, says hello. Hes a slave of Christ Jesus who always wrestles for you in prayers so that you will stand firm and be fully mature and complete in the entire will of God.

dag: N yi di daa bi kana ti wuhi ba, bɛ naan ku mali taali, amaa pumpɔŋɔ bɛ ku tooi lan chihi yi bɛ taali maa ni.
en: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.

dag: O wurindi wɔɣira ka bi vihiri ba, ka zaŋdi shɛb zaani bɛ zaani.
en: He does not have to ask questions when people do wrong, even if they are powerful leaders. He simply destroys them and chooses others to take their place.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn nyɛ n dimnim yi liri ma m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ma, bɛ ni tuui lu.
en: Evil people might attack me. They might try to destroy my body. Yes, my enemies might attack me and try to destroy me, but they will stumble and fall.

dag: Di chɛ ka tuumbiɛtumdiba yɛla muɣis a. Di zabiri ninvuɣ biɛri nyuli;.
en: Dont let those who are evil upset you, and dont be jealous of them.

dag: So kani m-be kasi kaman nyin Yawɛ, so lan kani m-pah a zuɣu. Tampin shɛli mi kani m-be kaman nyin Yawɛ.
en: There is no holy God like the Lord . There is no God but you. There is no Rock like our God.

dag: N kɔre yi daa kpe paɣa ni, ka n do n kpee yiŋ dunol ni gul o.
en: If my heart has been drawn to a woman and I have lurked at my neighbors door.

dag: Ka naŋgbankpeeni daa ti kpe Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba mini Yɛhudia ninvuɣ so sunsuuni bɛ ni paɣibu kali dolibu zuɣu.
en: John's followers got into an argument with a Jewish man about a ceremony of washing.

dag: Yɛlim ba ni bɛ tummi din viɛla, ka nyɛ bundaannim tuun suma tumbu ni; ka lan nyɛ bɛn tiri pini ni suhupiɛlli, ka yu ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ ni mali shɛli n-sɔŋdi bɛ taba.
en: Command them to do good, to be rich in good works, to be generous and ready to share with others.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi ma polo, n ni sabi Ijiptinim mini Babilɔnnim yuya, ka sabi Filistianim gba mini Taainim ni Itiɔpianim yuya ka yɛli, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim gba leela Jɛrusalɛm tiŋbihi.
en: I count Rahab and Babel among those who know me; also Philistia and Tyre, along with Cush— each of these was born there.

dag: Bɛ daa yihi bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi bɛn bi tum taali ʒim, bɛ daa kɔri ba m-mal la Keenan wuna; ka bɛ ʒim maa daa ta tiŋgbɔŋ maa daɣiri.
en: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.

dag: dama Yawɛ n-nyɛ a ni yɛn niŋ so naani, ka o mi ku chɛ ka tɔŋ gbaag a napɔŋ.
en: You can trust the Lord to protect you. He will not let you fall into harm.

dag: Man ŋun nyɛ kpɛm la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri n ni yuri paɣ gahindi so min o bihi ni yɛlimaŋli la. Ka di pala n kɔŋko n-yuri ya, amaa bɛnkam zaa mi yɛlimaŋli la gba yuri ya.
en: Greetings from the Elder. To the lady chosen by God and to her children. I truly love all of you. And I am not the only one. All those who know the truth love you in the same way.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bo n-nya yɛm mini yɛla baŋbu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Those who find wisdom are fortunate; they will be blessed when they gain understanding.

dag: ni Ana ni Dishɔn ni Ɛzɛr ni Dishan. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Hɔri nanima, ka nyɛ Siɛr bidibisi Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the Horite tribal chiefs, Seirs sons, in the land of Edom.

dag: Ka o yidan maa bɔh o, Bɔzuɣu ka a bɔri ni a chaŋ o sani zuŋɔ? Zuŋɔ pala gol palli dabisili bee Vuhim Dabisili. Ka paɣ maa yɛli, Di bi galim.
en: The womans husband said, Why would you want to go to the man of God today? It isnt the New Moon or Sabbath day. She said, Goodbye.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni yi ti shɛb azichi mini nɛma, ka chɛ ka bɛ deei bɛ tarili n-di bɛ tuma nyaɣisim, Naawuni pini m-bala.
en: If God gives some people wealth, property, and the power to enjoy those things, they should enjoy them. They should accept the things they have and enjoy their work—that is a gift from God.

dag: Zinaniŋda gba kul guhirila wuntaŋ lubu ka yɛra, N je ni so nya ma. Ka zaŋ bini pili limsi o ninni.
en: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.

dag: Ka n daa lo nia ni n niŋ din ni ti ma nyaɣisim. Amaa ka di gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: I said to myself, I should have fun—I should enjoy everything as much as I can. But I learned that this is also useless.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ya ka a ba maa lee be? Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi ʒi ma bee m Ba. Yi yi di mi ma, yi naan mi m Ba maa gba.
en: Where is your Father? they asked. You don't know me or my Father! Jesus answered. If you knew me, you would know my Father.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim nyɛla tarimba, bɛ ka yɛm, dama bɛ bi mi Yawɛ soli din nyɛ bɛ Naawuni zaligu la.
en: Then I thought to myself, These common people act like fools, and they have never learned what the Lord their God demands of them.

dag: Dinzuɣu niriba ni nya filiŋ, ka sokam di vi. Di chɛ bɛ taali!.
en: Humanity will be brought down; each person laid low—dont lift them up!.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti bɔri bɛ biɛrisuŋ bee m-bɔri bɛ tɔŋbu saha shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn be yi nyɛvili ni.
en: You must never try to make peace with the Ammonites or Moabites. As long as you live, dont be friendly to them.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ n suhu saɣimmi zaa, ka wula ka n ni yɛli? N ni yɛli, M Ba, chɛ ka saha ŋɔ miligi n zuɣu? Aai, dama di zuɣu ka n kana nti kpalim beni hal ni pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: Now I am deeply troubled. What should I say? Father, save me from this time? No, for this is the reason I have come to this time.

dag: N ni yili yilli paɣi Naawuni yuli; ka zaŋ wumpaɣibo tibig o.
en: I will praise Gods name with song; I will magnify him with thanks.

dag: Ka ŋmana maa zaa daa ti pali; ka o yɛl o bidibisi maa ni yino, Zaŋm ŋman shɛl na. Ka o yɛl o, Ŋman shɛl lan kani. Ka kpam maa mi dii ŋmaai, ka bi lan yirina.
en: When they had filled all the jars, she asked if there were any more. That was the last one, one of her sons answered. And the olive oil stopped flowing.

dag: Amaa ka Gɛshurinim mini Sirianim daa fa Havɔtijairi mini Kɛnat ni di tiŋkpansi bɛ sani, di daa nyɛla tinsi pihiyɔbu. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Makiri ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad ba la bihi.
en: But the kingdoms of Geshur and Aram conquered sixty towns there, including the villages of Jair and Kenath, and the towns nearby. All the people who lived there were descendants of Machir, the father of Gilead.

dag: Yi mi miriya ka yi deei binshɛli ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ so ŋun zo nti be tiliginsim tiŋ ni lab ti be o ya ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan na bi kpi.
en: You may not accept a ransom for someone who has fled to his refuge city so that he can return and live in the land before the priests death.

dag: amaa bɛnkam daa deeg o ka niŋ o yuli yɛda, bɛna ka o niŋ yiko ni bɛ leei Naawuni bidɔɣirisi.
en: Some, however, did receive him and believed in him; so he gave them the right to become God's children.

dag: Di ku yuui ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be sarika ni maa nya yolisim. Bɛ ku kpi, bindirigu mi ku pooi ba.
en: The imprisoned ones will soon be released; they wont die in the pit or even lack bread.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛli mi, Ti du m-bala Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, pa bɛ ni jɛmd o luɣ shɛŋa min o bimbina ka Hɛzɛkia daa wurim ka yɛli Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, Jɛmmiya Naawuni bimbin shɛli din be Jɛrusalɛm la gbin la?.
en: The Assyrian official went on, Or will you tell me that you are relying on the Lord your God? It was the Lord 's shrines and altars that Hezekiah destroyed, when he told the people of Judah and Jerusalem to worship only at the altar in Jerusalem.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ ŋme n-di yi buni mini yi daazichi zaa n-zaŋ li chaŋ yoli, yi ni tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa la zuɣu.
en: I will give them everything you own, because you have sinned everywhere in your country.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma pahi.
en: The Lord spoke to me again.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ n-yili yilli paɣi Yawɛ dahin shɛli Yawɛ ni daa fa o o dimnim zaa nuu ni bahi, ka lan fa o Sool gba nuu ni bahi la nyaaŋa.
en: David spoke the words of this song to the LORD after the LORD delivered him from the power of all his enemies and from Saul.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi na ʒi n-karim Naa Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm kum ni daa ti wum o mini bɛn be o san la yɛla?.
en: Jesus answered, Have you never read what David did that time when he and his men were hungry?.

dag: Zaŋmi kikaa kpa a noli, dama juɣu tam Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zuɣu, bɛ ni saɣim n daalikauli ka birigi n zaligu la zuɣu.
en: Put the trumpet to your lips and give the warning. Be like an eagle over the Lord s house. The Israelites have broken my agreement. They have not obeyed my law.

dag: Amaa ka o ba min o ma bɔh o, Paɣa n-ka a dɔɣiriba bipuɣinsi ni bee ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa ni ka a ni bɔ, ka ti chaŋ ti bɔrila Filistianim bɛn bi gundi ŋɔ bipuɣiŋga ni a niŋ a paɣa? Amaa ka Samsin yɛl o ba, Bom o ti ma, dama n suhu yu o pam.
en: But his father and mother asked him, Why do you have to go to those heathen Philistines to get a wife? Can't you find someone in our own clan, among all our people? But Samson told his father, She is the one I want you to get for me. I like her.

dag: Yi kpe taali ni yi ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb la zuɣu, ka ta yimaŋ daɣiri yi ni maani buɣa la zuɣu. Yi chɛ ka yi dabisili mirina. N ni daa zali ya yuun shɛl la paaya. Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka yi di vi zuliya kam sani, ka tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa nim mali ya ansarisi.
en: You are guilty of those murders and are defiled by the idols you made, and so your day is coming, your time is up! That is why I have let the nations make fun of you and all the countries sneer at you.

dag: Duu daa beni ka di dunoli be dunɔdali zɔntua puuni, nimaani ka bɛ daa paɣiri bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim.
en: In the outer courtyard there was an annex attached to the inner gateway on the north side. It opened into the entrance room that faced the courtyard, and there they washed the carcasses of the animals to be burned whole as sacrifices.

dag: Ka duu ŋɔ ni lu n-dahim, ka bɛnkam ti gariti nimaani yi nya li, di ni niŋ ba alahiziba, ka bɛ yɛli, wɛi, ka bɔhira, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka Yawɛ niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ mini duu ŋɔ lala.
en: This Temple will become a pile of ruins, and everyone who passes by will be shocked and amazed. Why did the Lord do this to this land and this Temple? they will ask.

dag: Ka Sool min o bia Jɔnatan ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be bɛ sani maa daa kpalim be Gɛba din be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni la. Amaa ka Filistianim maa mi daa ti bɛ suɣa do Mikimash.
en: Saul, Jonathan, and their army set up camp at Geba in Benjamin. The Philistine army was camped at Michmash.

dag: Ka Izraɛl zuliya zaa daa laɣim ka Dauda sanna Hiburɔn ti yɛl o, Nyama, ti nyɛla a niŋgbuŋ ni a ʒim.
en: Israel's leaders met with David at Hebron and said, We are your relatives.

dag: Lan gbilisim tibili wum a dabili min a niriba Izraɛlnim fabila; saha shɛli bɛ yi ti ŋmaligi kpa kpe na ka suhir a nyin gbilisim tibili a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni n-wum ti suhigu ka chɛ ti taali.
en: I am your servant, and the people of Israel belong to you, and so whenever any of us look toward this temple and pray, answer from your home in heaven and forgive our sins.

dag: Daadam, Izraɛlnim leela saɣiri n sani. Bɛ zaa bɛn nyɛ anzinfa mini daanya ni samafuu ni kurugu ni dalima ŋɔ, bɛ nyɛligibu shee ka bɛ daa leei saɣiri.
en: Son of man, bronze, iron, lead, and tin are important metals, but when a worker melts silver to make it pure, those metals are poured off as waste. Israel has become like that waste to me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, Naa Ahasivɛrɔs suhuyiɣisili la ni daa ti maai, di saha ka o daa teei Vashiti yɛla min o ni daa niŋ shɛm ni bɛ ni daa zali zaligu shɛli ka di di o la gba yɛla.
en: Sometime later when King Ahasuerus was less angry, he remembered Vashti, what she had done, and what he had decided about her.

dag: N ni daa nyɛ bia, n daa tɔɣisirila bilim yɛtɔɣa, ka mali bia tɛha, ka buɣisiri yɛla bilim buɣisibu; amaa n ni daa ti bi doo, ka n chɛ bilim soya zaa.
en: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.

dag: O ni daa nya ba maa ka o yɛli ba, Chamiya ti zaŋ yimaŋ wuhi maligumaaniba. Bɛ ni daa ŋmaligi chani maa ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: Jesus saw them and said to them, Go and let the priests examine you. On the way they were made clean.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ bindiri viɛla dihiri ba. Izraɛl zoya zuɣu nti yɛn nyɛ bɛ mɔri ŋubbu shee. Nimaani ka bɛ ni ti do momah viɛla tiŋgban ni, ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mo viɛla Izraɛl zoya zuɣu.
en: They will be safe as they feed on grassy meadows and green hills.

dag: Amaa o yi yɛli ma, N nini bi lan tiɣ a. Nyama, mani m-bɔŋɔ, O niŋmi ma kaman o ni nya ka shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: But if he isn't pleased with me—well, then, let him do to me what he wishes.

dag: Naftali zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaanu ni kɔbisinahi.
en: These are Naphtalis clans according to their clans. Their enrollment was .

dag: Di saha ka Jɛsi daa bol o bidibiga Abinadab na nti chɛ ka o gari Samuɛl tooni. Ka Samuɛl yɛli, Yawɛ bi pii ŋumbɔŋɔ gba.
en: Next Jesse called for Abinadab, who presented himself to Samuel, but he said, The LORD hasnt chosen this one either.

dag: Wulinluhili polo tintariga nti yɛn nyɛ Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku noli zaŋ hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din be Lɛbɔhamat samban ni. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ wulinluhili polo yaɣili.
en: The western border will run north along the Mediterranean Sea to a point just west of Lebo-Hamath.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni kpɛh o dabiɛm, ka di chɛ ka o wum vu shɛli damli ka ŋmaligi lab omaŋmaŋ tiŋgban ni, ka n ti chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku o omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The Lord will cause the emperor to hear a rumor that will make him go back to his own country, and the Lord will have him killed there.

dag: Nyama, a wuhi niriba pam, ka kpaŋsi bɛn nuhi ka yaa.
en: You have taught many people and given strength to feeble hands.

dag: Ka o bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee bala? Ka o garigi yɛli, N dana, man Rut m-bala. Kpuɣim ma leeg a paɣa, dama a nyɛla n dɔɣira ŋun ni tooi gbib ma.
en: Boaz said, Who are you? She said, I am Ruth, your servant girl. Spread your cover over me. You are my protector.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n gba zaɣisi ba ka zaŋ ba tahi bɛ dimnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, di saha bɛ yi ti siɣisi bɛmaŋ bɛ suhuri din mali daɣiri maa ni ka niŋ tuuba bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: Maybe they will admit that I turned against them and brought them into the land of their enemies. These people will be like strangers to me. But maybe they will become humble and accept the punishment for their sin.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka dɔr shɛli din kuri niriba mini fiɛɣufiɛɣu ni bimmɔrima ni biisim titali ni sanzali ni yi ni bi mi dɔr shɛŋa ni maligu lu yi zuɣu m-mali ya hal ka yi ti kpi.
en: The Lord will punish you with diseases, fever, and swelling. He will send you terrible heat and you will have no rain. Your crops will die from the heat and disease. All these bad things will happen until you are destroyed!.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa garigi yɛli, Ka bɛ yi ti bi niŋ ma yɛda, ka zaɣisi n yɛligu maa wumbu, ka yɛli ni a bi yi n zuɣu.
en: Then Moses said to God, But the Israelites will not believe me when I tell them that you sent me. They will say, The Lord did not appear to you.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi mini bɛ sapashini ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba daa gbaai Yisa n-lo o mihi.
en: The Roman officer and his men, together with the temple police, arrested Jesus and tied him up.

dag: ka alizin biɛri maa daa balim o yɛli, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim ŋɔ ni.
en: The evil spirits begged Jesus, Send us to the pigs. Let us go into them.

dag: Zikiri bia Joɛl la n-daa nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana, ka Hasɛnua bia Juda mi nyɛ zuɣulaan so ŋun pah ayi n-su tiŋ maa fukumsi.
en: Joel son of Zicri was in charge of them. And Judah son of Hassenuah was in charge of the Second District of the city of Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla zuliya shɛb bɛn ka yɛm; baŋsim ka bɛ sani.
en: People of Israel, that's what the Lord has said to you. But you don't have good sense, and you never listen to advice.

dag: Ka o yɛla daa moli gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: Reports about him spread everywhere in the surrounding region.

dag: Ti dimnim zaa yaala bɛ noya niŋ ti.
en: We are insulted and mocked by all our enemies.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim daa chaŋ ti to jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm puɣisi gbaai Yisa o yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: The Pharisees went off and made a plan to trap Jesus with questions.

dag: N daa bi nya Naawuni jɛmbu duu tiŋ maa ni, dama ti Duuma Naawuni Zallakudura Naa mini Piɛbil la n-nyɛ di jɛmbu duu.
en: I did not see a temple in the city, because its temple is the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb.

dag: Dama nir yi guni bee o yi bi guni di zaa shɛli ka buchi, amaa biɛr palli malibu n-nyɛ din mali buchi.
en: It does not matter at all whether or not one is circumcised; what does matter is being a new creature.

dag: Ka bɛ ti gbahi bɛ naa min o nabihi kuli tinzun tiŋ ni, Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then their king will be taken away, he and his officials together, says the LORD.

dag: Tiŋ maa mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni leela yi ni yɛn saɣim shɛli ti Yawɛ. Kulla Reehab ŋun nyɛ pagɔrili la mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o yiŋ kɔŋko ka di simdi ni yi tiligi, o ni daa zaŋ ti tuumba la sɔɣi la zuɣu.
en: The city and everything is to be destroyed as an offering to the Lord . Only Rahab the prostitute and everyone in her house will be left alive. These people must not be killed because she helped the two spies.

dag: Ka Pita yɛli Yisa, Karimba, di viɛli ni ti be kpe. Chɛ ka ti ti suɣa ata: A zaɣ yini; Anabi Musa zaɣ yini; Anabi Ilaija mi zaɣ yini.
en: Peter reacted to all of this by saying to Jesus, Rabbi, its good that were here. Lets make three shrines—one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

dag: O ni ti di nasara o yɛŋkiŋkabina min o ninvuɣ yɔhimbo soya puuni. O ni ti duh omaŋa, ka ni ti bahi niriba pam yoli n-libigi ba. Hal o ni ti mo nanim zaa Naa, amaa o ni ti bahi yoli ka ninsal nuu ka di ni.
en: Along with his cunning, he will succeed by using deceit. In his own mind, he will be great. In a time of peace, he will bring destruction on many, opposing even the supreme leader. But he will be broken— and not by a human hand.

dag: Ka Yawɛ mi deei yi daalikauli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni yi nyɛla omaŋmaŋ niriba kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli ni di simdi ni yi dol o zaligunim la.
en: Today the LORD has gotten your agreement that you will be his treasured people, just like he promised—by keeping his commandments.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ lala siɣimsiɣim buta ka lan lab zuɣusaa.
en: This happened three times. Then the whole thing was taken back into heaven.
