dag: Di saha ka Absalom daa yɛl o tumtumdiba, Lihimiya, yi yi ti nya ka Amnɔn nyu wain kuli ka n yɛli ya, Kumiya Amnɔn, yin kumiy o. Di zɔriya dabiɛm, mani m-puhi ya. Maliya suhukpeeni ka tum bidibilim tuma.
en: and instructed his servants: Notice when Amnon has had too much to drink, and then when I give the order, kill him. Don't be afraid. I will take the responsibility myself. Be brave and don't hesitate.

dag: Paɣiba pam tum din viɛla, amaa nyini n-gari bɛ zaa.
en: There are many good women, but you are the best.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba pinaayi maa laɣimna.
en: In the evening Jesus went to that house with the twelve apostles.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, N ni saɣim ninvuɣ biɛri yiko, amaa n ni pahi wuntizɔriba yiko.
en: God says, I will take away any power the wicked have and give it to those who are good.

dag: Abimilɛk min o tɔbbihi pirigili yim bɛn daa be o sani daa kab chaŋ ti zanila tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni, ka bɛ pirigili ʒii buyi mi kab ti lu bɛn be mɔɣu ni maa zuɣu n-ku bɛ zaa.
en: While Abimelech and his group hurried forward to guard the city gate, the other two companies attacked the people in the fields and killed them all.

dag: Yinim Iso zuliya, bɛ ni ʒiɛn ya n-zaŋ yi daazichi chaŋ.
en: Descendants of Esau, your treasures have been looted.

dag: Ka Leeban daa boli di yuli Jɛgarisahaduta; ka Yaakubu mi boli di yuli Galiid.
en: Laban named that place Yegar Sahadutha. But Jacob named that place Galeed.

dag: Yawɛ, wula ka a yɛn niŋ ba? Chɛ ka bɛ paɣiba zaŋdi bahira, ka bɛ biha nyuui.
en: Give them, LORD— what will you give them? Give them a womb that miscarries and breasts that are dried up.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ a nam maa ku lan chaŋ tooni, dama Yawɛ pun piig o suhu ni yu ninvuɣ so n-zaŋ o leeg o niriba naa, dama a bi doli Yawɛ ni zal a shɛm.
en: But no, you disobeyed, and so the Lord won't choose anyone else from your family to be king. In fact, he has already chosen the one he wants to be the next leader of his people.

dag: Yawɛ gbibi bɛnkam zaa yɛn lu; ka yiɣisiri bɛnkam zaa pun lu.
en: The LORD supports all who fall down, straightens up all who are bent low.

dag: Di daba ata dali, niriba maa gunibu maa yuma ni daa na biɛri saha shɛli maa, ka Yaakubu bidibis ayi, Simiɔn mini Lɛvi bɛn daa nyɛ Daina tizɔdɔbba la daa zaŋ takɔbiri chaŋ ti liri tiŋ maa nima n-libigi ba ku bɛ dɔbba zaa.
en: Three days later the men who were circumcised were still sore. Two of Jacobs sons, Simeon and Levi, knew that the men would be weak at this time. So they went to the city and killed all the men there.

dag: Di darigi ti tibili ti yaannim daalahichi zuɣu. Zom ti nambɔɣu yomyom; dama ti nya filiŋ pam.
en: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.

dag: M paɣir a, dama a nam ma, ka n yɛla mali dabiɛm mini alahiziba. M mi viɛnyɛliŋga ni a tuma zaa mali alahiziba.
en: I praise you because you are to be feared; all you do is strange and wonderful. I know it with all my heart.

dag: Yi yi ti teei gili tin shɛli ni yi tuhi deei li ka di ti yuui, yin di ŋmahi di tiwala tihi bahi. Yi ni tooi di di wala, amaa miriya ka yi ti ŋmahi li luhi. Tihi din be puri ni maa nyɛla ninsalinima ka yi kana ti teei gil li?.
en: When you are attacking a town, don't chop down its fruit trees, not even if you have had the town surrounded for a long time. Fruit trees aren't your enemies, and they produce food that you can eat, so don't cut them down.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Yi yi yurila bɛn yuri ya ko, paɣiri bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya? Dama alahichinim gba yurila bɛn yuri ba.
en: If you love only the people who love you, why should you receive a blessing? Even sinners love those who love them!.

dag: Nyɔhi maa ni daa ti yiɣisi mɔni tiŋ maa puuni saha shɛli, ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa ŋmaligi lihi bɛ nyaaŋa nya ka tiŋ maa zaa taala buɣim diri ka di nyɔhi yiɣisi mɔni.
en: But then the column of smoke began to rise from the city. When the Benjaminites looked back, there was the entire city going up in smoke to the sky.

dag: Naawuni n-chɛ ka yi nya nyɛvili Yisa Masia zuɣu, ka zaŋ o leei ti yɛm mini ti wuntia, ka lan nyɛ ŋun mali ti ka ti be kasi ni ŋun yihi ti alahichi ni.
en: It is because of God that you are in Christ Jesus. He became wisdom from God for us. This means that he made us righteous and holy, and he delivered us.

dag: Bɛ miri ka bɛ ti kpuɣi pagɔrili bee bɛ ni pun saɣim paɣ so bee paɣ so ŋun yi o yidan yili, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn be kasi bɛ Naawuni sani.
en: Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy.

dag: Jona ni daa be ziŋ karili maa puuni saha shɛli maa, ka o daa suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa yɛli.
en: Jonah prayed to the LORD his God from the belly of the fish.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Sabimi dimbɔŋɔ niŋ litaafi ni ka yi teeri di yɛla, ka yɛli Jɔshua ka di kpe o tibili ni ni n ni kpihim Amalɛknim maa birili dunia yili.
en: Afterwards, the Lord said to Moses, Write an account of this victory and read it to Joshua. I want the Amalekites to be forgotten forever.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisahaku biŋkɔbiguliba maa daa lan gbi kɔbil shɛli, ka bɛ daa lan niŋ ba naŋgbankpeeni di zuɣu; dinzuɣu ka Yisahaku daa boli kɔbiliga maa yuli dimdi kɔbiliga.
en: Then Isaacs servants dug another well. But there was an argument over this well too. So Isaac named that well Sitnah.

dag: Maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di nyɛla din kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka di kɔbiri paligi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu n-zaŋ kpe bintɔrili maa ni maa.
en: The priest must look at it. If the swelling is deeper than the skin, and the hair on it has become white, the priest must announce that the person is unclean. The spot is leprosy that has broken out from inside the boil.

dag: Di saha ka Mikaya daa garigi yɛli, N nya ka Izraɛlnim zaa wurimmi be zoya zuɣu kaman piɛri bɛn ka gul la. Ka Yawɛ yɛli ma, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim ka zuɣulana, chɛ ka sokam labi kul o yiŋ ni suhudoo. .
en: Then Micaiah replied, I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd! And then the LORD said: They have no master. Let them return safely to their own homes.

dag: Dindina wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm, yinim Judanim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi yi lo ni yi chaŋla Ijipti ti ʒini nimaani.
en: then listen to the LORDs word, you remaining Judeans. The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: If you are determined to go to Egypt and you then go and live there.

dag: Nyama, dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa ka n daa lihi alizanda ni n-nya ka duno shɛli yooi yɛya, ka n wum n ni daa pun tuui wum kukol shɛl la ka di be kaman kikaa kumsi la yɛri ma na: Dum kpe na ka n ti wuh a din yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa.
en: After this I looked and there was a door that had been opened in heaven. The first voice that I had heard, which sounded like a trumpet, said to me, Come up here, and I will show you what must take place after this.

dag: Pahimiya n zuɣu ka ti tibigi Yawɛ, ka chɛliya ka ti laɣim duh o.
en: Magnify the LORD with me! Together let us lift his name up high!.

dag: Pukpara maa daa yaɣindila Naawuni yɛligu.
en: The farmer scatters the word.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a wurim duɣu maa, a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn chaŋ maa ninni.
en: Then you should shatter the clay jar in the sight of the people who are with you.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka o garig o yɛm garigibu maa ka o yɛl o, A mini Naawuni nam bi wɔɣ ni taba. Di nyaaŋa ka so daa bi lan buɣisi ni o bɔhi Yisa bɔhigu shɛli yaha.
en: When Jesus saw that the man had given a sensible answer, he told him, You are not far from God's kingdom. After this, no one dared ask Jesus any more questions.

dag: Di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia yɔhim ya yɛli, Yawɛ ni tiligi ti. Zuliya shɛb wuna na mi n-fa bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ Asiria naa nuu ni?.
en: Don't let Hezekiah fool you into thinking that the Lord will rescue you. Did the gods of any other nations save their countries from the emperor of Assyria?.

dag: Dinzuɣu yiɣisim siɣi doli ba chaŋ ka di biɛhind a suhu ni, dama mani n-tim ba a sanna.
en: Hurry down and go with them. Don't worry, I sent them.

dag: Nyini n-zali tɔrili ni o yiɣimi du zuɣusaa katiŋa ka tɛr o tiɛɣu luɣ shɛli din du pam la?.
en: Does an eagle wait for your command to build its nest high in the mountains?.

dag: Naawuni ni deei binshɛlikam zaa ti ba sani maa nyɛla ti mini ti bihi dini; dinzuɣu Naawuni ni yɛl a ni a niŋm shɛlikam zaa, nyin niŋm li.
en: God took all this wealth from our father, and now it belongs to us and our children. So you should do whatever God told you to do.

dag: Mani, mmaŋmaŋ ni ti guli m piɛri maa, ka n ni ti chɛ ka bɛ dɔni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will find them a place to rest. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: ka Ɛbɛl mi daa zaŋ o buzɔŋ ni piɛbil tuuli ni o kpam na nti mali sara, ka Yawɛ Naawuni nini daa tiɣi Ɛbɛl min o sara maa.
en: and Abel also gave an offering to the Lord . He killed the first-born lamb from one of his sheep and gave the Lord the best parts of it. The Lord was pleased with Abel and his offering.

dag: Amaa Nan bia Jɔshua mini Jɛfune bia Kalɛb bɛn daa pahi chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa la n-daa nyɛ bɛn naɣi bi kpi.
en: But Joshua, Nuns son, and Caleb, Jephunnehs son, survived from those men who went to explore the land.

dag: Hal Saimɔn maŋmaŋ gba daa niŋ yɛda ka deei kom baptaizibu; di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ omaŋ tabili Filip n-nyari shihira mini alahiziba tuun shɛŋa din daa niŋdi maa, ka di gar o pam.
en: Even Simon believed and was baptized. He stayed close to Philip, because he marveled at all the miracles and wonders.

dag: Baŋmiya ni ti Duuma suɣilɔdibo la nyɛla din tin ya dahima ni yi tiligi kaman ti mabiyurigu Pool ni daa sab shɛm tin ya Naawuni ni ti o yɛn shɛl la puuni la.
en: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa ti lan yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka o piɛli Dauda bahi bɛ zuɣu ka yɛl o, Cham ti kali Izraɛlnim mini Judanima.
en: The LORD burned with anger against Israel again, and he incited David against them: Go and count the people of Israel and Judah.

dag: Amaa ka o ŋari ma. O taɣi n yɔri la siɣimsiɣim bupia, amaa Naawuni bi saɣi ka o niŋ ma shɛli.
en: Yet he has cheated me and changed my wages ten times. But God did not let him harm me.

dag: Ka Aduna daa lan kɔri naɣilaa mini piɛlaa bɛn daa nyɛ niriba maa suhudoo sara maligu biŋkɔbiri la, ka o bidibisi maa daa taɣi binʒim zaŋ ti o, ka o kpaai li vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.
en: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord 's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.

dag: Naawuni, chɛ ka niriba paɣ a, chɛ ka niriba zaa paɣ a!.
en: Make everyone praise you and shout your praises.

dag: M mi ni yi ni be luɣ shɛli nimaani ka Sintani nam ʒiishee be. Hal ka bɛ daa ti gbaai n shɛhiralana Antipas ŋun daa ʒe ma yim yi ni la n-ku o Sintani biɛhigu shee, amaa ka yi na kul ʒe ma yim ka bi chɛ ma dolibu.
en: I know that you are living right where Satans throne is. You are holding on to my name, and you didnt break faith with me even at the time that Antipas, my faithful witness, was killed among you, where Satan lives.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zani dubil yini nyaaŋa m-buɣisi dunɔdali zaŋ ti paai dubil din la nyaaŋa, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili zaŋ goon yini hal ti paai goon dini la.
en: Then he measured the distance from the back wall of one room to the back wall of the room across the passageway from it, and it was feet.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim bɛn daa doli Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl mini Jɛshua kulina la: Sɛraya mini Jɛrimia ni Ɛzra.
en: The following is a list of the priests and Levites who returned from exile with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and with the High Priest Joshua:.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa piligi n-gbahiri cheechi ni ninvuɣ shɛba n-niŋdi ba alaka;.
en: During this same time, King Herod began to do harm to some of those who were part of the church.

dag: Ka lala ka yi shiri yuri yi mabihi zaa bɛn be Masidɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa; amaa ti mabihi, ti kpamdi ya jaande ni yi kul niŋmi lala pahima.
en: And you have, in fact, behaved like this toward all the believers in all of Macedonia. So we beg you, our friends, to do even more.

dag: Di yi daa nyɛla n zaɣisila n daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba bee paɣiba fabila wumbu.
en: If I refused to be fair to my slaves when they had a complaint against me.

dag: Zara daa lan yɛli, Ŋuni n-daa naan yɛli Ibrahimma ni bihi ni ti mɔɣi man Zara biha. Amaa m bahi dɔɣi bia ti o, o ninkurilim ŋɔ ni.
en: She said, Who could have told Abraham that Sarah would nurse sons? But now Ive given birth to a son when he was old.

dag: Dundɔŋ maa yɛliŋ zaŋ labi wulimpuhili polo gba, di simdi ka di nyɛla mita pisinaayi.
en: The east side of the courtyard must also be cubits long.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn, A niriba maa galisiya pam ni n zaŋ Midiannim niŋ bɛ nuu ni. Di yi niŋ lala Izraɛlnim ni nyu bara niŋ ma ka yɛli, Tinima n-tuhi fa timaŋa.
en: The LORD said to Gideon: You have too many people on your side. If I were to hand Midian over to them, the Israelites might claim credit for themselves rather than for me, thinking, We saved ourselves.

dag: O dari tɔhi n yaɣa zaa, ka n yɛla naai, ka darigi vuɣi n tahima kaman tia la.
en: He batters me from every side. He uproots my hope and leaves me to wither and die.

dag: Noli ni ti di yi bihi mini yi puu atam ni yi niɣi bɛn yɛligi ni yi biŋkɔbbaligu bihi.
en: You'll have only a few children, your crops will be small, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats won't produce many young.

dag: Inok ŋun daa nyɛ ʒiɛmani din pah ayopɔin din daa doli Adam saha nyaaŋa la nir la daa pun tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ niriba ŋɔ polo. O ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya! Ti Duuma min o malaikanim tusatusa shɛm bɛn be kasi kanna.
en: It was Enoch, the seventh direct descendant from Adam, who long ago prophesied this about them: The Lord will come with many thousands of his holy angels.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti tɔɣisi naai ka Jeemsi mi yɛli, M mabihi, wummiya n gba ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ!.
en: When Barnabas and Paul also fell silent, James responded, Fellow believers, listen to me.

dag: Yawɛ, n nya wahala pam. Dolimi n nyɛvili kaman a ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛm la.
en: Lord , I have suffered for a long time. Say the word, and I will live again!.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya salo maa, ka o du zoli zuɣu ti ʒini, ka o nyaandoliba laɣim gil o.
en: When Jesus saw the crowds of people there, he went up on a hill and sat down. His followers came and sat next to him.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ salima sara maligu bimbini la kpɛhi Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni nti zaŋ li zali pateesa la tooni.
en: He put the gold altar in the meeting tent in front of the veil.

dag: bɛn ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu zaŋ tabili jɛmbu duu maa dundɔŋ ni ŋɔ, paɣimiya ŋun Yawɛ yuli.
en: you who serve in the Lord s Temple, in the courtyard of the Temple of our God.

dag: Ka baŋdiba shɛb bɛn be bɛ ni ni ti wuhi bɛ ni niriba pam din tuhi. Amaa di ti ku yuui ka bɛ ku bɛ ni shɛba tɔbu ni, ka nyo shɛb buɣim ku ba, ka gbahi shɛb mi chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: Wise leaders of the people will share their wisdom with many others. But for a while some of them will be killed in battle or be burned to death, and some will be robbed and made prisoners.

dag: Chamiya, amaa nyamiya, n tim ya mi kaman piɛbihi ni be kunduna sunsuuni shɛm la.
en: Go! Be warned, though, that Im sending you out as lambs among wolves.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla Yɛhudianim kɔŋko Naawuni? Bee o nyɛla bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba Naawuni? Iin, o nyɛla bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba Naawuni.
en: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isnt God the God of Gentiles also? Yes, God is also the God of Gentiles.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa kuhiri yɛra, Naawuni kukoli m-bɔŋɔ, pa ninsal dini.
en: The people shouted, You speak more like a god than a man.

dag: O daa zaŋ ba chaŋ ni alaafee, ka dabiɛm bi mali ba, ka teeku daa zaŋ bɛ dimnim la vali.
en: God led them in safety—they were not afraid! But the sea engulfed their enemies!.

dag: A ti ti tibidarigibo balibu kam zaa din sab Musa zaligu ni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ka hal pumpɔŋɔ gba, ti na kul bi saɣi ni ti balim a bee ŋ-ŋmaligi ka chɛ ti daalahichi ka dol a yɛlimaŋli maa.
en: We have not escaped any of the terrible curses written by Moses, and yet we have refused to beg you for mercy and to remind ourselves of how faithful you have always been.

dag: M bia, zaŋm a suhu ti ma, ka kpahim m biɛhigu;.
en: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.

dag: Ka niŋya kpam mini firanki tulaale zim pa di zuɣu, di nyɛla biŋkuma sara maligu.
en: Add olive oil and put incense on it.

dag: ka zaŋ o zali maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini niriba maa zaa tooni n-zaŋ o leei bɛ toondana bɛ zaa ninni.
en: Have him stand in front of Eleazar the priest and the whole community, and there before them all proclaim him as your successor.

dag: Yi mi bi chɛ yi mabihi ŋɔ bahi di saha maa hal ni zuŋɔ, amaa ka kul doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaligunima.
en: All this time you have supported all the other Israelites. You carefully obeyed all the commands that the Lord your God gave you.

dag: Ibrahimma bia Yisahaku zuliya ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ibrahimma n-daa nyɛ Yisahaku ba.
en: This is the story of Abraham's son Isaac.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa tim ti yɛli Tama, Cham a tizɔdoo Amnɔn yiŋa nti niŋ bindirigu ti o.
en: So David sent word to Tamar in the palace: Go to Amnon's house and fix him some food.

dag: Yisa daa ti kari alizin birigu do so zuɣu bahi; alizin birigu maa ni daa chaŋ naai ka doo maa lan leei ŋun tɔɣisira, ka di daa niŋ niriba maa alahiziba pam.
en: Jesus forced a demon out of a man who could not talk. And after the demon had gone out, the man started speaking, and the crowds were amazed.

dag: Sokam nyɛla jɛra ka ka yɛm; salima tuumbaŋdib zaa buɣa dihi ba vi, dama bɛ binnana maa nyɛla ʒiri binyara ka bi vuhira.
en: People who make idols are so stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods are not alive.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yiɣisi nimaani n-zaŋ kpa Nɛgɛb tintariga polo nti ʒini Kadɛshi mini Shur sunsuuni; ka daa ti lan yiɣisi chaŋ ti be Gɛra.
en: Abraham moved to the Southern Desert, where he settled between Kadesh and Shur. Later he went to Gerar, and while there.

dag: N yi ti gbarigi saha shɛli, a mi m biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ bari ma la tɔŋ n ni doli so shɛli zuɣu.
en: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.

dag: Di saha ka Rimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛrɔt nir la bihi bɛn daa nyɛ Rɛkab mini Baana daa yiɣisi lu soli n-daa ti paai Ishibɔshɛt yiŋ wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha din nyɛ saha shɛl o ni daa dɔni ni o vuhi wuntaŋ ni.
en: Rechab and Baanah set out for Ishbosheth's house and arrived there about noon, while he was taking his midday rest.

dag: Bɛ ni daa labir o kuɣa maa, o daa suhirila ti Duuma yɛra. N Duuma Yisa, deemi n nyɛvili.
en: They kept on stoning Stephen as he called out to the Lord, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni daa zal li shɛm o nia lɔbu min o milinsi puuni zuɣu ka o daa zaŋ o niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi mi daa chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu ku o.
en: In accordance with Gods established plan and foreknowledge, he was betrayed. You, with the help of wicked men, had Jesus killed by nailing him to a cross.

dag: Amaa n yɛr a mi ni n ni daa tuui boli ninvuɣ shɛb la ni yino gba noli ku to laɣiŋgu ŋɔ bindira maa. .
en: I tell you all that none of those who were invited will taste my dinner.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri lu bɛ fɔntinsinim zuɣu ŋ-ŋme n-kabisi kur shɛŋa din kpari bɛ dunɔdaya la, ka ku ba bɛ birininim ni.
en: War will sweep through their cities and break down the city gates. It will destroy my people because they do what they themselves think best.

dag: Dindali maa ka Sadusiinim bɛn daa nyɛ bɛn yɛri ni kum ni neebu kani la daa ka Yisa sanna.
en: The Sadducees did not believe people would rise to life after death. So that same day some of the Sadducees came to Jesus and said:.

dag: Kaman kurimbuni ha yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ni yɛli shɛm la, Ninvuɣ biɛɣu kɔbili ni ka ninvuɣ biɛtali yirina. Amaa man ku zaŋ n nuu shih a.
en: There is an old saying: Bad things come from bad people. I havent done anything bad, and I wont hurt you.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka bɛ yihi buɣijɛmbo maa bɛ kɔbili ni, ka zaŋ bɛ na kpima chaŋ katiŋa ka chɛ ma, ka n kul be bɛ sani sahakam.
en: Now let them remove their disloyalties and their kings corpses from me, and I will dwell among them forever.

dag: Ka yi lan wuhiri ni nir yi po sara maligu bimbini di pa taali, amaa ni nir yi po sara shɛli din pa bimbini maa zuɣu, shee ka o niŋ o ni po n-dalim yɛl shɛli maa.
en: You also teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the altar. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gift on the altar.

dag: O mi ni o daguya mali nyɔri, o firila bi kpiri yuŋ.
en: She knows the value of everything she makes, and works late into the night.

dag: n-zaŋ bunsi maa na nti zaŋ bɛ binyɛra pa bɛ yaansi zuɣu, ka Yisa ba.
en: They brought the donkey and its colt and laid some clothes on their backs. Then Jesus got on.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ma, A bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛli? Ka n garigi yɛli, N dana, m bi mi.
en: Then the angel said to me, Dont you know what these things mean? I said, No, sir.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yɛn puhi chu shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni Jɛmbu Duu Yoobu Chuɣu la Jɛrusalɛm, di daa nyɛla kikaa saha.
en: The time came for the Festival of Dedication in Jerusalem. It was winter.

dag: Bɛ tizɔpaɣiba n-daa nyɛ: Zɛruya mini Abigeel. Zɛruya bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Abishai mini Jɔab ni Asahɛl. Bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ata.
en: Jesse also had two daughters: Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah was the mother of Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.

dag: N ni pii mmaŋmaŋ nini ni tiɣi zuɣulaan shɛb tin ya, ka bɛ zaŋ yɛm mini baŋsim sun ya.
en: Then I will give you new rulers who will be faithful to me. They will lead you with knowledge and understanding.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛligu daa di nasara n-yɛligi gili luɣilikam.
en: This is how the word of the Lord was spreading in a powerful way, causing more and more people to believe.

dag: Dama ti Duuma maŋmaŋ ni ti yi zuɣusaa n-siɣina ni tahigu mini malaikanim zuɣulan kukoli ni Naawuni kikaa kumsi. Ka bɛn pun kpi Masia ni la ni ti daŋ kum ni neebu;.
en: The Lord himself will come down from heaven with a loud command, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trumpet call of God. And the people who have died and were in Christ will rise first.

dag: Maika bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Pitɔn mini Mɛlɛk ni Taria ni Ahaz.
en: Micahs sons were Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

dag: Ka duu ŋɔ ni lu n-dahim, ka bɛnkam ti gariti nimaani yi nya li, di ni niŋ ba alahiziba, ka bɛ yɛli, wɛi, ka bɔhira, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka Yawɛ niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ mini duu ŋɔ lala.
en: This temple will become a pile of rocks! Everyone who walks by will be shocked, and they will ask, Why did the Lord do such a terrible thing to his people and to this temple.

dag: Ka Zarai daa ti yɛli Ibram, Nyama, Yawɛ bi chɛ ka n dɔɣi bihi, dinzuɣu zaŋmi n dab bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ dɔni, di pa shɛli o ni dɔɣi bihi ti ma. Ka Ibram daa saɣi Zarai ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Sarai said to Abram, The LORD has kept me from giving birth, so go to my servant. Maybe she will provide me with children. Abram did just as Sarai said.

dag: Abimilɛk kum nyaaŋa ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yɛn fa Izraɛlnim bahi yi palo. Lala nir maa n-daa nyɛ Pua bia Tola ŋun daa nyɛ Dɔdo yaaŋa la. O daa yila Isaka zuliya ni na, ka be Shamir din be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu la.
en: After Abimelech, Tola son of Puah and grandson of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to rescue Israel. He lived in Shamir in the Ephraim highlands.

dag: bɛn nyɛ yuun pihita zaŋ ti paai yuun pihinu, ka nyɛ bɛn zaa ni tooi tum tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni.
en: those to years old who were eligible for work in the meeting tent.

dag: Di saha ka Chɛnaana bia Zɛdɛkia daa kana ti labi Mikaya tapaɣa ka bɔh o, So dini ka Yawɛ shia maa lee doli yi n ni n-kana ti yɛl a yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ.
en: Zedekiah, Chenaanahs son, approached Micaiah and slapped him on the cheek. Just how did the LORDs spirit leave me to speak to you? he asked.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni pa bɛ ni dɔɣi bi shɛb Naawuni daalikauli lɔbu puuni n-naɣ nyɛ o bi maŋa;.
en: This means that the children born in the usual way are not the children of God; instead, the children born as a result of God's promise are regarded as the true descendants.

dag: amaa Masia ŋun daa ʒe yim Naawuni niriba san la o ni nyɛ Naawuni Bia la zuɣu. Ka ti gba nyɛla o niriba, tinim dee yi kul mali suhukpeeni ka niŋ ti ni mali tahima shɛl la naani hal ni di bahigu ni.
en: But Jesus was faithful over Gods house as a Son. We are his house if we hold on to the confidence and the pride that our hope gives us.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Mɔabnim mini Ammɔnnim ni Miunnim shɛb daa ti lo tɔb na ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛhɔshafat.
en: Some time later the armies of Moab and Ammon, together with their allies, the Meunites, invaded Judah.

dag: Di saha o ni ti bɔhi, Bɛ wuna la lee be ya? Bɛ ni daa sɔɣi tampiŋ shɛli ni la lee be ya?.
en: Then the Lord will ask his people, Where are those mighty gods you trusted?.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti o Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti a binshɛŋa zaa la ni shɛli. A ni tooi piig a biŋkɔbbaligu ti o bee a puu atam bee a wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili ni wain ti o ni a suhu zaa.
en: Give to them generously from what the Lord has blessed you with—sheep, grain, and wine.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa yi bi yuri ka tum birigi Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ di tum binshɛŋa la n-tum alahichi, ka di taali maa ʒi bɛ zaa zuɣu ka bɛ bi baŋ di yɛla.
en: When the nation of Israel disobeys me without meaning to, the whole nation is still guilty.

dag: Karimbaani lihigu mini ʒiŋmabo ni bɛn ka taali kubu.
en: eyes that show pride, tongues that tell lies, hands that kill innocent people.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa kul niŋmi kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm. Bɛ ni daa tiri bɛ suɣa ʒiini bɛ tuutanim gbini shɛm, lala ka sokam min o malibu daa doli chani kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Israel did everything the Lord had told Moses. They arranged their camp according to clans and families, with each tribe under its own banner. And that was the order by which they marched into battle.

dag: M min ya, ka lan mi ni yi bi yuri Naawuni yi suhuri ni.
en: but I know you, that you dont have Gods love in you.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yaa ni ŋmanila gumdi, ka bɛ tuma be kaman chɛbili la. Buɣim ni di bɛ mini bɛ tuma zaa, ka so ku kpihi li.
en: The strong will be like dry twigs, their deeds like sparks; the two will burn together, with no one to extinguish them.

dag: Doo yi kpuɣ o mabia paɣa, o tum zaɣ biɛɣu, ka nya o mabia zaɣim, bɛ ku dɔɣi bia.
en: It is wrong for a man to take his brothers wife. It would be like having sexual relations with his brother! They will have no children.

dag: Kpaŋm amaŋ ka n sanna pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Do your best to come to me quickly.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ n tampiŋ ni n tiliginsim ni m birini, ka so ku tooi nyaŋ ma.
en: He alone protects and saves me; he is my defender, and I shall never be defeated.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Hiburɔn ti Kalɛb kaman Musa ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la; ka o daa kari Anaki bidibis ata la nimaani.
en: As Moses had commanded, Hebron was given to Caleb, who drove out of the city the three clans descended from Anak.

dag: dinzuɣu niŋmiya tuuba ka ŋmaligi lab ti Duuma polo ka o kpihim yi daalahichi.
en: Repent, then, and turn to God, so that he will forgive your sins. If you do.

dag: Amaa m Ba ni yɛn tim Sɔŋda so ŋun nyɛ o Shia Kasi, ka o zaŋ n yuli kana la ni ti wuhi ya binshɛɣukam zaa; ka n ni daa wuhi ya shɛlikam zaa la, o ni ti teei ya li.
en: But the Helper will teach you everything and cause you to remember all that I told you. This Helper is the Holy Spirit that the Father will send in my name.

dag: Di tɛhiriya ni n ni tɔɣisi yi din bie yɛla m Ba sani; ŋun ni tɔɣisi yi din bie yɛla o sani beni, ŋuna n-nyɛ Anabi Musa yi ni zaŋ yi tahima zaa niŋ so ni la.
en: Dont think that I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, the one in whom your hope rests.

dag: ni naɣilah ayi mini piɛlah anu ni bulah anu ni yuun yini piɛlabih anu shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi maani biɛrisuŋ sara la. Pɛdazu bia Gamaliɛl sara n-daa bala.
en: and for the well-being sacrifice two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Gamaliel, Pedahzurs son.

dag: ka Hamɔr ŋun daa nyɛ Hivi nira, ka lan nyɛ tiŋ maa ni naa la bia Shɛkɛm daa nya o gbaag o ti zaŋ o saɣim dih o vi.
en: She was seen by Hamor's son Shechem, the leader of the Hivites, and he grabbed her and raped her.

dag: Ka Izraɛl ninvuɣ so bee saan shɛb bɛn be yi sani ninvuɣ so yi go piɛli gbaai biŋkɔbigu bee nooŋa ŋun ŋubbu bi chihira, dilan ŋun kɔrigim bini maa ʒim bahi tiŋa, ka niŋ taŋkpaɣu pa di zuɣu.
en: Anyone who hunts any animal or bird that can be eaten—whether the hunter is an Israelite or an immigrant who lives with you—must drain its blood out and cover it with dirt.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb tinsi tiri ya ni yi su maa ni, yin di ti chɛnya binvuhirigu kam;.
en: Whenever you capture towns in the land the Lord your God is giving you, be sure to kill all the people and animals.

dag: Tinzunnim ni ti yiɣisi guui kaman tɔhinima n-kari doli ba la bee kaman piɛri bɛn ka gul la n-kuli bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbana ni mini bɛ niriba sani.
en: The foreigners living in Babylon will run away to their homelands, scattering like deer escaping from hunters, like sheep without a shepherd.

dag: bɛn kul tumdi tuumbiɛri ka deeri birapu niriba san la.
en: They are guilty of cheating people. They take bribes to do wrong.

dag: Kuruchu bɔbigu daa ʒe kpaŋ ha n-gbiri binyara ŋubira.
en: Far off in the distance a large herd of pigs was feeding.

dag: Jɛhalɛlɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zif mini Zifa ni Tiria ni Asarɛl.
en: Jehallelels family: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

dag: Balaam ni daa nya ka Yawɛ lo ni o niŋla alibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim ni maa zuɣu, o daa bi lan lihi o ni daa yi lihiri binshɛŋa ni baŋdi din yɛn niŋ kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm la, amaa ka zaŋ o zuɣu ʒila mɔɣu polo.
en: Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless the Israelites, so he didnt go as the other times to seek omens. Instead, he turned toward the desert.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Zadok mini Abiata daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa labisi Jɛrusalɛm, ka daa kpalim be nimaani.
en: So Zadok and Abiathar took Gods Holy Box back to Jerusalem and stayed there.

dag: Naa Dauda daa yiɣisi zani yɛli ba, Wummiya, m mabihi mini n niriba; n lo n suhu ni ni m me yili n-zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka din nyɛ ti Naawuni napɔntamdigu ŋɔ zali di puuni; m pun mali di mɛbu shili zaa.
en: Then King David stood up and said: Listen to me, my relatives and my people. I wanted to build a temple as the permanent home for the chest containing the LORDs covenant, our Gods footrest. But when I prepared to build it.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda gba daa yiɣisi voli maa ni yina nti kuhi boli Naa Sool, N dan naa! Ka Sool daa ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa, ka Dauda damdi zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n-lu o sizuura.
en: Then David went out after him and called to him, Your Majesty! Saul turned around, and David bowed down to the ground in respect.

dag: Keenannim bɛn daa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim ni daa nya ka bɛ kumdi Atad kabɔɣili maa shee maa, ka bɛ yɛli, Nandahima titali kumsi ka Ijiptinim ŋɔ kumdi ŋɔ! Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Ɛbɛl Mizraim; ka di be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli.
en: When the people who lived in Canaan saw the funeral service at Goren Atad, they said, This is a time of great sorrow for those Egyptians. So now that place across the Jordan River is named Abel Mizraim.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa fa Amɔrinim tiŋgbani maa ti Izraɛlnima, ka a ti bɔri ni a fa li?.
en: So it was the Lord , the God of Israel, who drove out the Amorites for his people, the Israelites.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu kul bɔrila zabili, ka tikuba mi woligir nir min o zɔsimo.
en: Destructive people produce conflict; gossips alienate close friends.

dag: Nyini n-tiri nanim nasara, ka fa a dabili Dauda bahi.
en: You are the one who gives victory to kings. You saved your servant David from the sword of his enemy.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni zaŋ Pita tum tuun kara Yɛhudianim sani shɛm, lala ka o zaŋ man gba tum tuun kara bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani.
en: For by God's power I was made an apostle to the Gentiles, just as Peter was made an apostle to the Jews.

dag: ka o zaŋ Makipɛla siliga din be o palo la tariga la ti ma yi ninni; ka n yo o di liɣiri ka di leegi n dini, ka m mali n kpiimba sɔɣiri nimaani.
en: I would like to buy the cave of Machpelah, which belongs to Ephron. It is at the end of his field. I will pay him the full price. I want all of you to be witnesses that I am buying it as a burial place.

dag: Bundana bee nandana bee nabia bee tarima ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi niŋ shɛli sɔŋ Ijiptinima.
en: No one in Egypt, rich or poor, important or unknown, can offer help.

dag: Dama bɛ maŋmaŋ naba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ti kpɛhi zana ni, ka bɛ chaŋ ti lu bɔɣili ni.
en: They are caught by their feet in a net; they walk on mesh.

dag: Kul be tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka m be a sani, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka zaŋ tiŋgbana ŋɔ zaa ti a min a zuliya, ka chɛ ka n ni daa lo a ba Ibrahimma alikauli shɛl la pali.
en: You will live there as a foreigner, but I will be with you and bless you. I will keep my promise to your father Abraham by giving this land to you and your descendants.

dag: Ka tɔb maa daa kpaɣi mii Sool, ka peentɔriba daa nya o n-to o piɛm ti o daŋ pam.
en: The battle was fierce around Saul. When the archers located him, they wounded him badly.

dag: Ka kawaan kɔri maa daa zaŋ kawaan kara ayopɔin maa vali. Ka Firawuna daa yirigi neei n-nya ka di nyɛla zahindi.
en: and the thin heads of grain swallowed the full ones. The king woke up and realized that he had been dreaming.

dag: N niriba bɔhiri dari binyara ni bɛ baŋ shɛli, ka bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi wuhiri ba binyara din ti yɛn niŋ. Dama zina niŋbu n-vo ba kpɛhi yɔɣu, ka bɛ chɛ Naawuni ka jɛmdila buɣa.
en: My people take advice from a piece of wood, and their divining rod gives them predictions. A spirit of prostitution has led them astray; they have left God to follow other gods.

dag: O niŋla lala ni bɛ bo ŋun Naawuni hal ti nya o. Ka ti zaa yinoyino min o bi wɔɣ ni taba.
en: God has done all this, so that we will look for him and reach out and find him. He isn't far from any of us.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti je suli niŋ o, ka zo n-kul o ba yiŋ Bɛtilihɛm Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti niŋ chira anahi nimaani.
en: But she became angry with him, went back to her father's house in Bethlehem, and stayed there four months.

dag: Ifriimnim daa ŋmanila bɛ ni wuhi naɣisa so ka o bɔri ni bɛ zaŋ o bu chi, ka n daa bi zaŋ binshɛli pa o nyiŋgoli din viɛl la zuɣu. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni zaŋ dapua n-ga Ifriimnim nyiŋgoya ni. Judanim ni jari, ka Yaakubu zuliya yɛbisi bɛmaŋmaŋ puu.
en: Once you were obedient like a calf that loved to thresh grain. But I will put a harness on your beautiful neck; you and Judah must plow and cultivate the ground.

dag: A bi bɔri biŋkɔbiri sara maligu mini sara maligu balibu kam; a mi bi bɔri alahichi kpihimbu sara maligunima bee bɛ ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb shɛba m-maani sara nyɔri ba buɣim bimbini zuɣu la; amaa a luɣila n tiba ti ma.
en: You dont relish sacrifices or offerings; you dont require entirely burned offerings or compensation offerings— but you have given me ears!.

dag: Di daa kul wum ma la yoli, buɣim maa ni daa bi yihi di ni din zahimzahim maa shɛm.
en: Its a worthless task. Even by fire its great corrosion isnt removed.

dag: Zaŋm ma tabil a suhu kaman a nyɛla dalinli la, ka zaŋ ma pa a baɣiri zuɣu kaman n nyɛla dalinli la. Dama yurilim malila yaa kaman kum la, ka kɔre mali yaa kaman gballi. Di dirimi kaman buɣim la, ka di buɣim zilinli mali kpiɔŋ pam.
en: Set me as a seal over your heart, as a seal upon your arm, for love is as strong as death, passionate love unrelenting as the grave. Its darts are darts of fire— divine flame!.

dag: Ti Naawuni la kanna, o mi bi fo, ka buɣim din diri ni nimmoo be o tooni, ka sanʒiɛ titali ʒiɛri gind o.
en: Our God is coming, but not in silence; a raging fire is in front of him, a furious storm around him.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yiɣisi Ramɛsis n-chaŋ Sukɔt, dɔbba kɔŋko kalinli daa nyɛla tuhi kɔbisiyɔbu m-pahi paɣiba mini bihi.
en: The Israelites traveled from Rameses to Succoth. They numbered about six hundred thousand men on foot, besides children.

dag: Naa suhuyiɣisili nyɛla kum tumo, ka ŋun mali yɛm ni maai li.
en: A wise person will try to keep the king happy; if the king becomes angry, someone may die.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kɔri taŋkpaɣu duhiduhi, ka me teei gili goma ni bɛ ku niriba pam. Firawuna min o tɔbbihi pam bɛn mali yaa ku tuhi tɔbu maa sɔŋ o.
en: Even the king of Egypt and his powerful army will be useless to Judah when the Babylonians attack and build towers and dirt ramps to destroy the cities of Judah and its people.

dag: Di saha ka niriba daa bɔhi ma, A ku yɛli ti a ni niŋ shɛm maa gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The people asked me, Why are you acting like this.

dag: Di saha ka alizin biɛɣu maa daa garigi yɛli ba, M mi Yisa, ka mi Pool; ka banima n-lee nyɛ yi mi.
en: But the evil spirit said to them, I know Jesus, and I know about Paul; but you—who are you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Piim Nan bia Jɔshua ŋun mali biɛrisuŋ la n-zaŋ a nuu pa o zuɣu;.
en: So the Lord said to Moses, Joshua son of Nun is very wise. You will place your hand on him and make him the new leader.

dag: N ni wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka kari ya kpɛhi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka lala maa chɛ ka m paɣi yi ni daɣiri maa bahi.
en: I will scatter your people to every country and nation and will put an end to your evil actions.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa lo nia yɛli ni bɛ zaa yinoyino bom o yaa ni nyaŋ shɛm tariga, ka bɛ zaŋ talim ti ti bɛ mabihi bɛn be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The disciples decided that they each would send as much as they could to help their fellow believers who lived in Judea.

dag: Ka bɛ daa woligi n-kpuɣi yɛŋkiŋkabina soli. Bɛ daa bola bindira niŋ bɔto kura din chahi ka bɛ liɣiliɣi li ni n-zaŋ pa bunsi zuɣu; ka zaŋ wain kol kura din chahi ka bɛ liɣiliɣi li pahi;.
en: and they decided to deceive him. They went and got some food and loaded their donkeys with worn-out sacks and patched-up wineskins.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini ka n kumdi niŋda. N Duuma, nyini ka n suhiri ni a zo ma nambɔɣu.
en: I prayed to you, Lord , and in my prayer I said.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni fa n shia kpiimba biɛhigu shee yiko ni bahi, dama o ni deei ma.
en: But God will save my life from the power of the grave, because he will take me. Selah.

dag: O ni ti ŋub o ni dɔɣi biliɛ shɛba n-tabili bɛ zoya: dama o ni ti sɔɣimi ŋub ba, yi dimnim ni ti yɛn teei gili ya ka niŋdi ya alaka shɛli yi fɔntinsi ni la zuɣu.
en: not wanting to give them any of the afterbirth she pushed out or the babies she bore, because she will be eating them secretly while starving due to the desperate and dire circumstances that your enemy will bring on you in your cities.

dag: ti bɔhi ba, Yi ni yɛli ni yi daa dɔɣi yi bi so zom la m-bɔŋɔ? Di yi nyɛla ŋuna, ka bɔ n-lee chɛ ka o nina maa neei pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: They asked them, Is this your son? You say he was born blind. So how can he see.

dag: N Duuma, n yiŋ bia bɔɣu min o gbali zaa n-kpi, ka di muɣis o pam ka o do yiŋa.
en: The officer said, Lord, my servant is very sick at home in bed. He cant move his body and has much pain.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi ni yɛn yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa labi Yawɛ sani ti yɛl o, Kpihimmi ti daalahichi zaa, ka deei ti tuun shɛŋa din viɛla, ka ti paɣir a kaman di ni simdi ni ti paɣir a shɛm.
en: Prepare to speak and return to the LORD; say to the LORD, Forgive all wickedness; and receive the good. Instead of bulls, let us offer what we can say.

dag: Ka Jabɛshinim maa daa yɛli Naa Nahash, Biɛɣuni ti sa ni zaŋ timaŋ ti a, ka a niŋ ti a ni bɔri shɛm.
en: and said to Nahash, Tomorrow we will surrender to you, and you can do with us whatever you wish.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda gba daa yiɣisi voli maa ni yina nti kuhi boli Naa Sool, N dan naa! Ka Sool daa ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa, ka Dauda damdi zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n-lu o sizuura.
en: Soon, David also got up and left the cave. Your Majesty! he shouted from a distance. Saul turned around to look. David bowed down very low.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Di tɛhiya ni n kamina ni nti kpihim Naawuni fukumsi zaligunima bee anabinim yɛligu; m bi kamina ni nti kpihim di shɛli, amaa n kamina ni n ti chɛ ka di zaa niŋ pali.
en: Don't suppose I came to do away with the Law and the Prophets. I did not come to do away with them, but to give them their full meaning.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, so di lan muɣisiri ma, dama m mali wulɛ shɛŋa din be n niŋgbuŋ ni n-wuhiri ni n nyɛla Yisa ni su so.
en: So dont give me any more trouble. I have scars on my body that show I belong to Jesus.

dag: A ni tooi zaŋ zoligɔnim ga saŋmar shɛb bɛn laɣim taba ka bɛ booni ba Gbiŋgbiŋ min o bihi la? Bee a ni tooi yihi binshɛli din gbibi saŋmar so bɛ ni booni Goli wulan la.
en: Can you tie up the Pleiades ? Can you unfasten the belt of Orion ?.

dag: N kul ni nyuri bara Yawɛ zuɣu. Chɛ ka bɛn nyari nahiŋgu wum li ka mali suhupiɛlli!.
en: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord . Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa nya ma kul maani ma la ansarisi; ka mɛrigiri bɛ noya niŋdi ma, ka viini bɛ zuɣuri niŋdi ma ka yɛra.
en: All who see me make fun of me; they stick out their tongues and shake their heads.

dag: Amɔs ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛkɔa piɛgul la yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. O daa nya li zaŋ chaŋla Izraɛlnim polo Juda Naa Yuzaia mini Jɔash bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa la ʒiɛman ni. Di saha di daa chɛla yuma ayi ni tiŋgbani dambu la niŋ.
en: These are the words of Amos, one of the shepherds of Tekoa. He perceived these things concerning Israel two years before the earthquake, in the days of Judahs King Uzziah and in the days of Israels King Jeroboam, Joashs son.

dag: A yuli daa duya zuliya kam zaa ni a viɛlim maa zuɣu. Dama n ni daa ti a jilima shɛli la zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka a niŋ viɛlim zaa maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You became famous in every nation for your perfect beauty, because I was the one who made you so lovely. This is what the Sovereign Lord says.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na be soli kuna ka lahibali ti nti to Dauda, Absalom ku nabihi la zaa, hal bɛ yino bi lan kpalim.
en: While they were on their way to Jerusalem, someone told David, Absalom has killed all of your sons! Not even one is left.

dag: Dama o mi o ni zaŋ binshɛli nam ti. O teeya ni ti nyɛla taŋkpaɣu.
en: because he knows we are made of dust.

dag: amaa bɛ ku chaŋ tooni, dama sokam ni nya bɛ jɛritali tuma kaman bɛ ni daa nya niriba ayi ŋɔ jɛritali tuma shɛm la.
en: But they wont get very far. Their foolishness will become obvious to everyone like those others.

dag: Pɔhim ʒiɛri kparila nudirigu polo n-chaŋ gili hal ti paai nuzaa polo n-kul chani gindi hal ti paai di piligu shee yaha.
en: The wind blows south, the wind blows north; round and round it blows over and over again.

dag: Wamiya waa paɣ o yuli. Ŋmɛmiya biŋkumda mini guŋgombihi ni mɔɣilɔnim ni chaɣisa paɣ o.
en: Praise his name with dancing; play drums and harps in praise of him.

dag: ka suhi alibarika niŋ o ni ka yɛli, Zallakudura Naa ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ niŋm alibarika niŋ Ibram ni!.
en: blessed him, and said, May the Most High God, who made heaven and earth, bless Abram!.

dag: Ka chɛrubinim maa kpiŋkpama ti yirigi zuɣusaa, ka di mahim luri yɔrigu maa zuɣu, ka bɛ nina kpa taba. Yɔrigu maa polo ka bɛ nina ti yɛn kpa.
en: The wings of these angels should spread up toward the sky. The angels should cover the Box with their wings and should face each other, looking toward the mercy-cover.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ jaaŋgbee ŋme o dabipaɣ bee dabidoo ka o kpi o nuu ni, bɛn darigim o tibili.
en: When a slave owner hits a male or female slave with a rod and the slave dies immediately, the owner should be punished.

dag: O suhu kul yɛla yi zaa nyabu zuɣu, ka o suhu bi doya, dama yi daa wum ni o biɛra.
en: but now he wants very much to see all of you again. He is worried because you heard that he was sick.

dag: Ka Baanabas daa yi ni chaŋ Taasus ni o ti bo Sool shee.
en: Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul.

dag: Dinzuɣu pa yinima n-daa tahi ma kpe na, amaa Naawuni n-daa tahi ma na nti zaŋ ma leei Firawuna ba ni ŋun su o yiŋnim zaa fukumsi, ka lan zaŋ ma leei Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa zuɣulana.
en: So it was not really you who sent me here, but God. He has made me the king's highest official. I am in charge of his whole country; I am the ruler of all Egypt.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ yɛmbimbiɛtali maa ka yɛli ba.
en: Since Jesus recognized their deception, he said to them.

dag: O noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka Ribɛka ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtuɛl bipuɣiŋga la paana, ka koyuli tam o bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu. Bɛtuɛl mi daa nyɛla Ibrahimma tizo Nahɔr min o paɣ Milika bidibiga.
en: Before the servant finished praying, a young woman named Rebekah came to the well. She was the daughter of Bethuel. Rebekah came to the well with her water jar on her shoulder.

dag: M mabihi, Naawuni n-daa pii ya leei bilichinnima; amaa lee miriya ka yi zaŋ yi bilichinsi soli maa tum niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma, naɣ zaŋmiyala yimaŋ leei tab daba yurilim zuɣu.
en: As for you, my friends, you were called to be free. But do not let this freedom become an excuse for letting your physical desires control you. Instead, let love make you serve one another.

dag: N ni zaŋ a niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka bɛ wurim a ni ko pin shɛli la min a ni daa me binshɛŋa din dundu zali luɣ shɛŋa zaa la. Bɛ ni ti pirig a situra zaa, ka yeeg a yɛ viɛla zaa, ka chɛ a zal a zaɣim.
en: Then I will hand you over to your lovers, who will tear down the places where you had sex. They will take your clothes and jewelry, leaving you naked and empty-handed.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Anabitali yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm naa mini Izraɛlnim bɛn zaa be di ni dini.
en: Tell them that this is what the Lord GOD said. This sad message is about the leader of Jerusalem and all the people of Israel who live there.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Ɛhud bidibisi.
en: The descendants of Ehud were Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. They were heads of families that lived in Geba, but which were forced out and went to live in Manahath. Gera, the father of Uzza and Ahihud, led them in this move.

dag: Ti daa lola Ijiptinim mini Asirianim alikauli ni bɛ tiri ti bindirigu ka ti diri tiɣira.
en: We held out a hand to Egypt and to Assyria, to get sufficient food.

dag: Dama o daa bi ku ma niŋ m ma pul ni, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka m ma puli maa leei n gballi, ka o puli maa kul bara sahakam.
en: because he didnt kill me in the womb and let my mother become my grave, her womb pregnant forever.

dag: Ka n daa kul mali lala hal ti paai Kɔbilinini Dunɔdal la mini Naa Kosubo bɔɣili la polo. Ka n ni daa bari biŋkɔb so maa daa bi tooi nya soli gari.
en: On the east side of the city, I headed north to Fountain Gate and King's Pool, but then the trail became too narrow for my donkey.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ Jɛrɔbɔam min o daŋ niriba ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la, ka kul dolila di soli maa; ka daa na kul chɛ ka buɣili Ashɛra kpalim be Samaria.
en: But they didnt deviate from the sins that Jeroboams dynasty had caused Israel to commit; they walked in them! Moreover, a sacred pole stood in Samaria.

dag: Bimɔɣiriga ni ti be gariŋga voli gbini diɛmda, ka bia ŋun ŋmaai bihili ni ti zaŋ o nuu tim bahiga voli ni.
en: A nursing child will play over the snakes hole; toddlers will reach right over the serpents den.

dag: Biɛɣukam niriba daa yi kul kanila Dauda sanna ti pahir o zuɣu hal ka o tɔbbihi ti galisi kaman Naawuni tɔbbihi la.
en: More and more men came every day to help David. So he had a large and powerful army.

dag: Bɛ daa kul darimi gindi kaman bɛn kɔŋ kpɛhili shee, ka be mɔɣu ni mini zoya zuɣu chana, ka be kuɣa lɔna ni mini voyari ni. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma n-yaɣi dunia ŋɔ ni bebu zuɣu.
en: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.

dag: O ni zali ti shɛm n-nyɛ ni ti niŋ o Bia Yisa Masia yuli yɛda ka yuri taba kaman o ni zali ti shɛm.
en: What he commands is that we believe in his Son Jesus Christ and love one another, just as Christ commanded us.

dag: Ka naŋgbankpeeni daa kpe bɛ sunsuuni ka bɛ woligi taba di zuɣu; ka Baanabas daa zaŋ Maak pah omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Saipurus.
en: There was a sharp argument, and they separated: Barnabas took Mark and sailed off for Cyprus.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ ku tooi zo n-yi di ni, hal bɛ yi kuhi niŋ ma gba n ku garigi ba.
en: So this is what the Lord says: I will soon make something terrible happen to the people of Judah. They will not be able to escape. They will be sorry and cry to me for help, but I will not listen to them.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti bo so shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku lan nabi. Di yi pa lala ti mini ti dimnim yi ti yɛn tuhi, bɛ ni pahi ti dimnim maa zuɣu tuhi ti ka nya soli zo n-yi ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: If we don't outsmart them, their families will keep growing larger. And if our country goes to war, they could easily fight on the side of our enemies and escape from Egypt.

dag: Rubin, nyini n-nyɛ m bituuli, nyini n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ; ka lan nyɛ n dɔtali tuuli bia. A nyɛla toondana ka mali kpiɔŋ pam.
en: Reuben, my first son, you are my strength, the first proof of my manhood. You were the most honored and powerful of all my sons.

dag: dindina yin zaŋmiya li kɔhi deei liɣiri n-zaŋ liɣiri maa mali chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii luɣ shɛli ni bɛ jɛmd o maa.
en: sell that part of your crops and take the money with you to the special place the Lord has chosen.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Pool tahi bɛ jintɔriba laɣiŋgu shee din yuli daa booni Ariɔpagus la ti yɛl o, Ti bɔri ni a wuhi ti wuhiri pal shɛli a ni wuhiri ŋɔ ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: They took him into custody and brought him to the council on Mars Hill. What is this new teaching? Can we learn what you are talking about?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yi nti nya farigudeer so ŋun yuli booni Lɛvi, ka o ʒi farigu deebu shee; ka Yisa yɛl o, Yiɣisim doli ma.
en: Afterward, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at a kiosk for collecting taxes. Jesus said to him, Follow me.

dag: Yi bindiri pala din daŋ niŋbu dabisili din nyɛ yi ni zaŋdi kapala tiri Yawɛ yi dakulɔdakulo churi puhibu ni la dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya yi tuun shɛli.
en: The first day of the Festival of Harvest is the day you bring the first of your new crops and give them as a grain offering to the Lord . At that time you must also call a special meeting. You must not do any work on that day.

dag: Di saha ka napaɣ Hagit bia Adɔnija daa ti ka Sulemaana ma Batishiiba sanna. Ka Batishiiba bɔh o, Alaafee ka a kana maa? Ka o garigi yɛli, Iin, alaafee.
en: One day Adonijah, the son of Haggith, went to Solomons mother, Bathsheba. She asked him, Do you come in peace? Adonijah answered, Yes, this is a peaceful visit.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Gbaamiya yimaŋa ni yɛliwumsa. Yi ni buɣisiri tiri yi tab shɛm, lala ka Naawuni mi ni ti buɣisi tin ya hal di ni ti gari lala gba.
en: Think carefully about what you are hearing. God will know how much to give you by how much you understand now. But he will give you more than you deserve.

dag: Ka Ɛbɛd bia Gaal min o mabihi daa ti ka Shɛkɛm na, Ka Shɛkɛmnim daa niŋ o naani.
en: Then Gaal, Ebeds son, and his relatives came passing through Shechem, and the leaders of Shechem shifted their allegiance to him.

dag: Ka dɔro ni daa mali paɣ so m-pɔri gɔŋ o yuun pisaayika ka o ku tooi teeg omaŋ zaa la daa be nimaani.
en: and a woman was there who had been crippled by an evil spirit for years. She was completely bent over and could not straighten up.

dag: ka Yisa daa tim Pita mini Jɔn n-yɛli ba, Chamiya ti mali Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ puhibu shili gul ti, ka ti kana ti di di bindirigu.
en: Jesus said to Peter and John, Go and prepare the Passover meal for us to eat.

dag: A yi zaŋ yɛtɔɣa talim jɛrigu, di ŋmanila a zaŋla sua ŋmaag a napɔŋ bahi ka bɔri yɛla.
en: Never let a fool carry your message. If you do, it will be like cutting off your own feet. You are only asking for trouble.

dag: mini dundɔŋ din gil li maa daantalisi ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ni dundɔŋ maa dunɔdali daantalisi ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ni Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili kpahi zaa ni dundɔŋ din daa gil li maa kpahi zaa.
en: the bases all around the courtyard, and the bases for the courtyards gate, all the dwellings tent pegs, and all the tent pegs used around the courtyard.

dag: Ka Ɛzra daa bɔɣi litaafi maa niriba maa zaa ninni, dama o ni daa ʒe luɣ shɛli maa daa du n-gari niriba maa ni daa ʒe luɣ shɛli. O ni daa bɔɣi litaafi maa, niriba maa zaa daa yiɣisimi zani.
en: So Ezra opened the book. All the people could see him because he was standing above them on the high stage. As he opened the Book of the Law , all the people stood up.

dag: Cham maligumaaniba zuɣulan Hilikia sani nti chɛ ka o mali dunɔguliba bɛn zaani Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunol ni n-deeri laɣ shɛli niriba ni zaŋdi tahiri Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na la laasabu.
en: Go to the High Priest Hilkiah and get a report on the amount of money that the priests on duty at the entrance to the Temple have collected from the people.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa maa di na kul bela n suhu ni, ka Ribɛka paana, ka o koyuli tam o bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu, ka o gari siɣi kɔbiliga maa ni ti ŋɔŋ kom na. Ka n yɛl o, N suhir a, tim ma kom ka n nyu.
en: Before I had finished my silent prayer, Rebecca came with a water jar on her shoulder and went down to the well to get water. I said to her, Please give me a drink.

dag: o nyɛla do so ŋun mali niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu, ka nyɛ ŋun be daɣiri ni, ka di simdi ka maligumaana yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, o nyɛla ŋun mali dɔro o zuɣu ni.
en: the person is afflicted with skin disease; they are unclean. The priest must declare them unclean on account of the head infection.

dag: Di saha ka Yisahaku daa zaŋ Ribɛka ti kpɛh o tanti suɣili ni. Ka Yisahaku daa zaŋ Ribɛka n-leeg o paɣa, ka yur o pam, ka di daa chɛ ka o nya suhukpaŋsibo o ma kum la nyaaŋa.
en: Isaac took Rebekah into the tent where his mother had lived before she died, and Rebekah became his wife. He loved her and was comforted over the loss of his mother.

dag: Ka sagban shɛli daa sirigina ti lim ba, ka bɛ wum ka kukol shɛli yɛri sagbani maa ni, M Biyurigu m-bɔŋɔ! Wummiy o noli.
en: The shadow of a cloud passed over and covered them. From the cloud a voice said, This is my Son, and I love him. Listen to what he says.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sulemaana ni Shimɛi yila Jɛrusalɛm n-chaŋ Gaat ka labina.
en: Someone told Solomon that Shimei had gone to Gath and was back.

dag: Bɛ vaam tampiligim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka zaŋ chinchin bɔribɔri pil li;.
en: They will remove the ashes from the altar and spread a purple cloth on it.

dag: ka kuhi yɛl o, Yiɣisima n-zan a naba zuɣu! Ka gbarigu maa dii vaai yiɣisi zani gbaai chandi.
en: and said in a loud voice, Stand up straight on your feet! The man jumped up and started walking around.

dag: O ŋmanila kɔhigɔriba ŋarima; o ʒir o bindirigu yirila katiŋ na.
en: She brings home food from out-of-the-way places, as merchant ships do.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim, a wuhiri ba ni a nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi, a wuhiri ba ni a nyɛla ŋun ka galimi.
en: Lord, you are faithful to those who are faithful. You are good to those who are good.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-deei nanim maa tinsi maa zaa, ka gbahi bɛ nanim gba zaa; ka daa zaŋ takɔb ku sokam zaa kaman Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa pun yɛl o shɛm.
en: Joshua captured all these cities and killed all their kings. He completely destroyed everything in these cities—just as Moses, the Lord s servant, had commanded.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Akishi, Di viɛla, a ni ti nya man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm. Ka Akishi daa yɛli Dauda, Mbo, n ni zaŋ a leei ŋun ni be n sani n-guli ma hal ni a nyɛvili tariga.
en: Of course, David answered. I am your servant, and you will see for yourself what I can do. Achish said, Good! I will make you my permanent bodyguard.

dag: Shɛm mini Aripakishad ni Shɛla.
en: Shem's descendants included Arpachshad, Shelah, Eber, Peleg, Reu, Serug, Nahor, Terah, and Abram, later renamed Abraham.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ zaŋdi da palli lɛrila dakol pala ni.
en: Instead, new wine must be poured into fresh wineskins!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Ijipti do so n-fa ti piɛguliba maa nuu ni bahi hal ka ŋɔŋ kom ti ti ka ti nyuhi ti biŋkɔbiri maa.
en: An Egyptian rescued us from the shepherds, they answered, and he even drew water for us and watered our animals.

dag: ka nyɛ bɛn bi zuri bɛ taba nyaaŋa, ka bi tumdi bɛ zɔnim taali, ka mi bi mali bɛ ʒiʒiinitab yɛla n-chani moona.
en: who does no damage with their talk, does no harm to a friend, doesnt insult a neighbor.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A kɔr biɛri tuma min a ni daa be a zaɣim a mamanim sani a pagɔrisigu tuma tumbu ni ni a buɣ shɛŋa din chihiri min a ni daa zaŋ a bihi ʒim mali ba la.
en: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: You stripped off your clothes, and like a prostitute, you gave yourself to your lovers and to all your disgusting idols, and you killed your children as sacrifices to idols.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa zaŋ zuliyanim maa zaa zali ka bɛ vihi nya, ka piila Bɛnjamin zuliya.
en: Then Samuel had each tribe come forward, and the Lord picked the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: Ka di mi bi simdi ni ti Duuma tumtumda ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeeni. Di naɣ simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun mali nirilim zaŋ chaŋ sokam sani, ka nyɛ karimba suŋ ni ŋun mali suɣilo.
en: As the Lord's servant, you must not quarrel. You must be kind toward all, a good and patient teacher.

dag: dama yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka ti be, ka pa ni ti nini ni nya shɛli zuɣu.
en: We live by faith and not by sight.

dag: Di bi simdi ka a ti zaŋ li leei niŋgbina kpaʒiɛrim, di mi bi simdi ka a lan niŋ di tatabo yaha. Di nyɛla din be kasi, ka kul ni be kasi a sani.
en: So treat it as holy! Don't ever use it for everyday purposes or mix any for yourselves.

dag: Ka yil yin nim yi ŋmaligi zabira, bɛ yili maa mi wurindimi.
en: And a house torn apart by divisions will collapse.

dag: O ni daa mali binzahi pia maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: O daa mali di zaa ŋ-ŋmahindila taba n-chɛ ka di buɣisibu nyɛ yim, ka di biɛhigu gba nyɛ yim.
en: Huram made ten carts, and they were all the same. Each cart was made from bronze. The bronze was melted and poured into a mold. So all the carts were the same size and shape.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa lan yɛli, N Duuma, n suhir a, di je suli niŋ ma n ni lan yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu. Ka a yi ti nyala wuntizɔriba pihita nimaani? Ka o garigi yɛli, N yi ti nya wuntizɔriba pihita nimaani, n ku saɣim tiŋ maa.
en: He said, Dont be angry with me, my Lord, but let me speak. What if thirty are there? The LORD said, I wont do it if I find thirty there.

dag: Bɛn daa diri bindir viɛla la nti kpiri kum solɔri zuɣu ŋɔ. Bɛ ni daa zaŋ nɛma nyaɣinyaɣi wumsi shɛb la nti do tampuya zuɣu ŋɔ.
en: All who ate expensive foods lie starving in the streets; those who grew up in luxury now sit on trash heaps.

dag: mani yi Duuma ni chɛ ka Asiria naa min o tɔbbihi zaa kana ti liri Judanima. Bɛ ni ti kana kaman Yufretiiz Mɔɣili kom din galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ pam m-pali hal ti puuri bahiri la.
en: therefore, look, the Lord is raising up against them the powerful floodwaters of the Euphrates, the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will rise up over all its channels, overflowing all its banks.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Doliya ma, ka n chɛ ka yi booni ninsalinim tiri Naawuni kaman yi ni gbahiri zahim shɛm maa .
en: Jesus said to them, Come, follow me, and I will make you a different kind of fishermen. You will bring in people, not fish.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ bɛ sani nti chɛ ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa woli taba, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku lan tooi wum tab yɛtɔɣa.
en: Let us go down and mix up their language so that they will not understand each other.

dag: Naa Sool ni daa kul mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa naai, di daa bi yuui ka Samuɛl paai na. Ka Naa Sool daa yi n-chaŋ ti tuh o soli puh o.
en: and just as he placed it on the altar, Samuel arrived. Saul went out to welcome him.

dag: Adam zuliya yuya n-sab kpe ŋɔ. Naawuni ni daa nam ninsala, o daa nam o ŋ-ŋmahindila omaŋa.
en: God created men and women to be like himself. He gave them his blessing and called them human beings. The following is a list of the descendants of Adam, the first man:.

dag: ka ŋmaligi siliga maa gbini n-chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa nyaandoliba piniyini la mini bɛnkam pahi bɛ zuɣu binshɛlikam din daa niŋ maa zaa yɛla.
en: When they returned from the tomb, they reported all these things to the eleven and all the others.

dag: Ka n daa ti lan gariti a sani ka yul a n-nya ka a saɣi bɔbu, ka n daa zaŋ n chinchini pil a limsi a zaɣim maa, ka po pɔri lo a alikauli, ka a leei n ni su so. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: As I passed by again, I saw that the time had come for you to fall in love. I covered your naked body with my coat and promised to love you. Yes, I made a marriage covenant with you, and you became mine. This is what the Sovereign Lord says.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛla ba, Di bi simdi ni bɛ chaŋ. Timiya ba bindirigu ka bɛ di.
en: But Jesus said to them, Theres no need to send them away. You give them something to eat.

dag: Ka Pool daa yi chani Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu Vuhim Dabisili dali kam ka o mini ba ti tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛla, ka o daa lɛbigiri Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim tɛha.
en: Every Sabbath day Paul went to the synagogue and talked with both Jews and Greeks, trying to persuade them to believe in Jesus.

dag: Ka bɛ daa wuh o min o yiŋnim zaa ti Duuma yɛligu.
en: Then Paul and Silas told him and everyone else in his house about the Lord.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ zaawuni ha ka ŋmani maa daa ŋmaai olivi tia vamahili n-gbab o noli lab o sanna ŋariŋ maa ni; ka Nuhu daa baŋ ni kom maa yipa nyuuya tiŋgban ni.
en: It returned in the evening, holding in its beak a green leaf from an olive tree. Noah knew the water was finally going down.

dag: Naawuni daa nam ninsala ŋ-ŋmahindila omaŋa, ka o be kaman Naawuni ni be shɛm. O daa nam ba la doo mini paɣa.
en: So God created human beings, making them to be like himself. He created them male and female.

dag: Dinzuɣu vuhim nyabu ni na kul ʒiɛya gul shɛb ni bɛ vuhi, hal ka bɛn daa tuui wum lahibal suŋ la daa bi paai vuhim shee Naawuni sani bɛ ni daa bi niŋ yɛda la zuɣu.
en: Those who first heard the Good News did not receive that rest, because they did not believe. There are, then, others who are allowed to receive it.

dag: Bɛ ni daa vihi ma bɛ daa loya ni bɛ bahi ma, dama bɛ daa bi nya ka n tum taal shɛli din simdi kum.
en: They asked me many questions, but they could not find any reason why I should be put to death. So they wanted to let me go free.

dag: Di gbihi bee m-pɔb a nini.
en: Dont wait to rest or sleep.

dag: Ka so daa ti bɔh o, N Duuma, niriba biɛla kɔŋko n-yɛn tiligi? Ka Yisa yɛli ba.
en: Someone said to him, Lord, how many people will be saved? Only a few? Jesus said.

dag: N teeg a ni mali yɛda maŋli shɛl la yɛla. Di nyɛla yɛda shɛli a yabipaɣa Lɔis mini a ma Yunis ni daa mal la tatabo, ka m mi ni a gba shiri mal li.
en: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.

dag: Ka n yi mal anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu pini, ka tooi baŋdi yɛlisɔɣira, ka mali baŋsim zaa, hal n yi mali yɛda din ni chɛ ka n tooi vuui zoya di dooshɛhi, ka ka yurilim, dindina m pala shɛli.
en: What if I could prophesy and understand all mysteries and all knowledge? And what if I had faith that moved mountains? I would be nothing, unless I loved others.

dag: Bɛ wain tihi yila Sɔdom wain tihi ni na, ka yi Gomɔra wain tihi puri ni na. Bɛ wain tiwala nyɛla wala din mali lɔɣu. Di zaɣ yila nyɛla din to.
en: Our enemies are grapevines rooted in the fields of Sodom and Gomorrah. The grapes they produce are full of bitter poison;.

dag: Di saha ka Gomna Pailɛt daa chɛ ka bɛ fiɛb Yisa.
en: Then Pilate took Jesus and had him whipped.

dag: Yisa ni daa naag o wunsuhigu ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, o min o nyaandoliba daa yimi chaŋ ti du Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ duli nti kpe tihi pu shɛli din daa do nimaani la ni.
en: After he said these things, Jesus went out with his disciples and crossed over to the other side of the Kidron Valley. He and his disciples entered a garden there.

dag: ka yi ti yɛli yili maa yidana ni yi karimba n-tim ya na ni yi ti bɔh o ni du din ni ka o min nyaandoliba yɛn ʒini m-puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ ka di di bindirigu?.
en: Tell the owner of the house, The Teacher asks that you please show us the room where he and his followers can eat the Passover meal.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu ka o yɛli, Niriba ŋɔ ni saɣim alikauli shɛli n ni daa lo bɛ yaannima, ka zaɣisi n nol la zuɣu.
en: So the Lord became angry with the Israelites, and he said, This nation has broken the agreement that I made with their ancestors. They have not listened to me.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa puuni zuliya kam daa bahi me bɛmaŋmaŋ buɣa n-zaŋ zalizali Samarianim ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la. Zuliya kam daa me buɣa maa zalizal la bɛ ni be tin shɛŋa ni.
en: But each nationality still made its own gods. They set them up in the houses that the people of Samaria had made at the shrines. Each nationality did this in whichever cities they lived.

dag: Ɛlizafan bidibisi ni, Shɛmaya n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbisiyi pah o zuɣu.
en: from the clan of Elizaphan, Shemaiah, in charge of ;.

dag: Pɛriʒia nabia n-daa taɣ ma zali sol ni biɛɣ pisiniyini. Amaa ka Maikil ŋun nyɛ malaikanim nabia la daa kana ti sɔŋ ma, ka n daa chɛ o mini Pɛriʒia nabia maa nimaani.
en: For twenty-one days the leader of the Persian kingdom blocked my way. But then Michael, one of the highest leaders, came to help me. I left Michael there with the leader of the Persian kingdom.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni tinim bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ di suɣilo n-sɔŋ bɛn ka yaa, ka di bɔri ni ti tum din ni tiɣi timaŋmaŋ nini.
en: Some of us have no problem with these things. So we should be patient with those who are not so strong and have doubts. We should not do what pleases us.

dag: dama nyama, a shiri ni niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga. Miri ka a ti chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ piliŋ shih o zuɣu ni, dama bia maa ti yɛn nyɛla Nazari nir Naawuni sani o dɔɣibu ni zaŋ chana. Ka o ni ti piligi n-fari Izraɛlnim Filistianim nuu ni bahira.
en: and after your son is born, you must never cut his hair, because from the day of his birth he will be dedicated to God as a nazirite. He will begin the work of rescuing Israel from the Philistines.

dag: Nyini n-daa zaŋ a kpiɔŋ pirigi teeku kom buyi; ka daa ŋme m-bɔri wɔɣ biɛri la zuɣuri kom ni.
en: You split the sea with your power. You shattered the heads of the sea monsters on the water.

dag: Ka o daa moli molo gili Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm zaa ni bɛ yo Yawɛ farigu shɛli Naawuni dabili Musa ni daa zali Izraɛlnim tiŋgban nɛli ni ni bɛ yo la.
en: They sent word throughout Jerusalem and Judah for everyone to bring to the Lord the tax which Moses, God's servant, had first collected in the wilderness.

dag: Lahibal suŋ ŋɔ ka ti zaŋ na ni ti ti tin ya: Naawuni ni daa lo ti yaannim alikauli shɛl la.
en: We proclaim to you the good news. What God promised to our ancestors.

dag: Ka Obadia bɔhi Ilaija, Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka n lee tum ka a bɔri ni a chɛ ka Ɛhab ku man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ?.
en: Obadiah answered, What have I done that you want to put me in danger of being killed by King Ahab?.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣa dibu polo, di bemi kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni yɛli ni buɣili kam ʒiɛla binshɛɣu din ka dunia ŋɔ ni zaani la, ka Naawuni so mi lan kani pahila Naawuni yino ŋɔ ko.
en: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.

dag: Yisa ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri niriba maa yɛtɔɣa maa, ka o tizɔbihi min o ma daa kana nti ʒe samban ni ka tim ni be ti bol o na ka bɛ tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣ shɛli. .
en: While Jesus was speaking to the crowds, his mother and brothers stood outside trying to speak with him.

dag: Dama n ni chɛ ka a nya filiŋ zuliya kam sani, ka ninsalinim lihi ʒiɛm a.
en: Im about to cut you down to size before the nations; you will be scorned by everyone.

dag: N tɛha ni daa labi n ni na saha shɛli maa, ka n jilima mini n dariza ni n nam maa tibiginsim gba daa lan labi n sanna. Ka n jintɔriba mini n kpambaliba daa lan deei ma, ka n nam maa yiko mini di jilima din gari di ni daa pun be shɛm lan labi n sanna.
en: So at that moment my reason returned to me. My honor and splendor came back to me for the glory of my kingdom. My associates and my princes wanted to be with me again. Not only was I reinstated over my kingdom, I received more power than ever before.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun yɛli Sairus; A nyɛla m piɛgula, ka ni niŋ n ni yɛl a ni a niŋ shɛli. A ni yɛli ka bɛ lan me Jɛrusalɛm zali; ka chɛ ka bɛ sɔŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tampuɣili. .
en: who says about Cyrus, My shepherd— he will do all that I want; who says about Jerusalem, She will be rebuilt; and who says about the temple, You will be founded once again.

dag: Dama ŋun nam a ni be a kaman paɣ yidan ni be o shɛm la. O yuli n-nyɛ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa. Ŋuna n-nyɛ a tiligira ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi la. O yuli n-lan nyɛ, dunia zaa Naawuni.
en: Your real husband is the one who made you. His name is the Lord All-Powerful. The Holy One of Israel is your Protector, and he is the God of all the earth!.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi ni tooi chɛ ka aŋgo zɔnim lo noli aŋgo ni be bɛ sani saha shɛli?.
en: Jesus told them, The friends of a bridegroom don't go without eating while he is still with them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ buri maa so, ka zaŋ gabisi maa vili bɛ zuɣuri chaŋ Izraɛl naa maa sani ti yɛl o, A dabili Bɛnhadad yɛliya ni o suhirila o nyɛvili. Ka Naa Ɛhab daa garigi bɔhi ba, O na be o nyɛvil ni? O nyɛla m mabia.
en: So they wrapped sackcloth around their waists and ropes around their necks, went to Ahab and said, Your servant Benhadad pleads with you for his life. Ahab answered, Is he still alive? Good! He's like a brother to me.

dag: A daa lan tum pagɔrisigu tuma Asirianim sani a ni nyɛ pulaandan la zuɣu. A daa tum pagɔrisigu tuma bɛ sani, ka a nini na kul bi tiɣi li.
en: You couldn't get enough sex, so you chased after Assyrians and slept with them. You still weren't satisfied.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi tuun suma bi zɔri nam fukumsinim dabiɛm, amaa bɛn tumdi tuun biɛri n-zɔri ba dabiɛm. A bɔri ni a ku zɔri ŋun be nam fukumsi ni dabiɛm? Dindina tummi din viɛla, ka a ni nya paɣibu o sani.
en: People who do right dont have to fear the rulers. But those who do wrong must fear them. Do you want to be free from fearing them? Then do only what is right, and they will praise you.

dag: Nir yi di n-tiɣi, o baɣa ka shiri ni, amaa kum yi mali nira, hal binshɛli din to gba nyaɣisimi.
en: When you are full, you will refuse honey, but when you are hungry, even bitter food tastes sweet.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ijipti naa daa yih o nam maa ni Jɛrusalɛm, ka zali Judanim ni bɛ yom farigu din nyɛ anzinfa kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi mini salima kilɔgiram pihitanaanahi.
en: King Neco of Egypt captured Jehoahaz and forced Judah to pay . tons of silver and kilograms of gold as taxes.

dag: Yisa ni daa kul yɛri maa, o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka o nyaandoliba pinaayi la ni yino ŋun yuli booni Judas la mini salo daa paana. Ka Judas daa chaŋ Yisa sani nti puh o ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: Jesus was still speaking when a crowd arrived, led by Judas, one of the twelve disciples. He came up to Jesus to kiss him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe di ni deei li su. Amaa bɛ daa bi deeg a noli bee n-dol a zaligunima. Bɛ daa bi niŋ a ni yɛli ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛl la. Dinzuɣu ka a chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ zaa paai ba maa.
en: They entered and took possession of it, but they didnt obey you or follow your Instruction. In fact, they didnt do anything you commanded them. So you brought upon them this disaster.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti nya ka anab maa dola sol ni, ka buŋ la mini gbuɣinli maa ʒe m-baɣ o. Ka gbuɣinli maa bi ŋub o bee n-ku buŋ maa.
en: and he rode off and found the prophet's body lying on the road, with the donkey and the lion still standing by it. The lion had not eaten the body or attacked the donkey.

dag: Bɔ n-lee pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu? Izraɛlnim daa kɔŋ bɛ ni bɔri shɛli nyabu. Naawuni ni daa pii niriba biɛla shɛb la n-naɣ nya li, amaa bɛn kpalim la bɛn suhuri daa kpɛmmi.
en: What then? The people of Israel did not find what they were looking for. It was only the small group that God chose who found it; the rest grew deaf to God's call.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm la daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim tiŋ maa puuni ka nyɛ bɛn daa zo n-chaŋ o sani mini bɛn daa kpalim tiŋ maa ni la kuli Babilɔn.
en: Nebuzaradan the captain of the special guard rounded up the rest of the people who were left in the city, including those who had defected to the Babylonians, and deported them to Babylon.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb zaŋdi anzinfa pari sania zuɣu zahindi li, ka zaŋdi bɛ kola ni salima pahiri tiri machɛlinim ka bɛ maani wuna tiri ba, ka bɛ damdiri tiŋ jɛmdi li!.
en: Some people are rich with gold and silver. Gold falls from their purses, and they weigh their silver on scales. They pay an artist to make a false god from wood. Then they bow down and worship that false god.

dag: O daa chɛ ka zibisim gil o; sagban tibisa din sabigi ka kom be di ni n-nyɛ o sampaa.
en: He covered himself with darkness; thick clouds, full of water, surrounded him.

dag: ŋun zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni, ka chɛ ka n leei tumo ni n wuhi zuliya kam zaa ka bɛ deeg o noli n-niŋ yɛda o yuli zuɣu la.
en: Through Christ, God gave me the special work of an apostle—to lead people of all nations to believe and obey him. I do all this to honor Christ.

dag: Amaa zaligu ŋɔ ka n daa naɣ zali ba, Deemiya n noli, ka n nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka yi mi nyɛ n niriba, ka yi tumdi n ni zali ya ni yi tummi shɛm, ka biɛhigu niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani.
en: But I did command them to obey me, so that I would be their God and they would be my people. And I told them to live the way I had commanded them, so that things would go well for them.

dag: Ka Musa daa deei tiliginsim liɣiri maa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kalinli daa pani, ka nyɛ Lɛvinim ni yɛn tiligi shɛb maa sani.
en: There were not enough Levites to take the place of all the men from the other family groups, so Moses gathered the money for them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:.
en: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti ti nimmira yɛlimaŋli, yi mi di ti zaŋ gaŋbu bee birapu dibu kpɛhi yi bebu ni, dama birapu dibu nyɛla din chɛ ka baŋda nina bi ne, ka chɛ ka bɛn mali yɛlimaŋli kɔŋdi yɛlimaŋli.
en: You must always be fair. You must not favor some people over other people. You must not take money to change your mind in judgment. Money blinds the eyes of wise people and changes what a good person will say.

dag: ka din pahi pisiyinika daa gbaai Mallɔti min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the nineteenth to Mallothi, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Dindali maa ka yi ni ti baŋ ni n shiri be m Ba ni, ka yi mi be n ni, ka n gba be yi ni.
en: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti mooni Masia molo n-kpamdi sokam jaande, ka wuhiri sokam baŋsim zaa puuni ni di chɛ ka sokam zooi m-bi niriba Masia ni, ka ti zaŋ bɛ zaa yinoyino tahi Naawuni sani.
en: So we preach Christ to everyone. With all possible wisdom we warn and teach them in order to bring each one into God's presence as a mature individual in union with Christ.

dag: Ka Aduna zuliya ni bidibiga kam ni tooi di li kaman di ni zali shɛm yi ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka binshɛɣukam din shihi li ni niŋ kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change.

dag: Amaa ka Nadab mini Abihu daa ti zaŋ buɣim din bi viɛla n-nyo sara maligu ti Yawɛ ka kpi.
en: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unholy fire to the Lord .

dag: N ni zaŋ mmaŋ pa talima o zuɣu, ka a ti bɔh o yɛla n sani. N yi ti bi ʒi o labina ti ti a, nyin chɛ ka di taali kul ʒi n zuɣu sahakam.
en: I will guarantee his safety; you can hold me responsible. If I dont bring him back to you and place him here in front of you, it will be my fault forever.

dag: Ka bɛ daa fa biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn kpalim la yiko, amaa ka lee chɛ ba ni bɛ be saha biɛla pahi.
en: The other beasts had their power taken away, but they were permitted to go on living for a limited time.

dag: ni bɛ ni daa she binyɛr viɛl shɛŋa ni bɛ yɛri tumdi tuma luɣ kasi shee la mini binyɛr kasi shɛŋa bɛ ni daa she n-ti Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaana la min o bidibisi ni bɛ tumdi maligumaaniba tuma la.
en: the woven clothes for ministering as priests in the sanctuary, the holy clothes for the priest Aaron and the clothes for his sons to serve as priests.

dag: Miriya ka yi yɛli Naawuni yɛtɔɣ yoya bee n-tu yi niriba toondana.
en: Do not speak evil of God, and do not curse a leader of your people.

dag: Ka Ɛsta daa zaŋ o ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ti o ni o ti yɛli Mɔdɛkai. Ɛsta ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: In reply Esther ordered Hathach to tell Mordecai.

dag: Lala ka yi yaannim daa niŋ n ni daa tim ba ka bɛ yi Kadɛshibarinia chaŋ ni bɛ ti nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa la.
en: Your fathers did the same thing to me. In Kadesh Barnea I sent spies to look at the land.

dag: Ka Aduna daa niŋ lala. O daa zaŋ firilanim maa zali ni di ne firilatamdigu maa tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa.
en: Aaron obeyed and placed the lamps as he was told.

dag: ka o daa chaŋ ni o ti tuhi Asa soli, ka yɛl o, Nyin Naa Asa mini Juda zuliya ni Bɛnjamin zuliya zaa, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ, yi yi kul be Naawuni sani, o gba ni be yi sani. Yi yi bo o, yi ni nya o. Amaa yi yi zaɣis o, o gba ni zaɣisi ya.
en: Azariah went to meet Asa and said, Listen to me, Asa and all you people of Judah and Benjamin. The Lord is with you when you are with him. If you look for him, you will find him. But if you leave him, he will leave you.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi tihi wali, ka yi puri ni bindira niŋ pam din ni chɛ ka kum ku lan lu yi zuɣu ka yi di vi zuliya shɛb sani.
en: I will increase the yield of your fruit trees and your fields, so that there will be no more famines to disgrace you among the nations.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Keen, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi, ka a zuŋ a ninni?.
en: The Lord said to Cain: What's wrong with you? Why do you look so angry?.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni paɣ tuumbiɛrilan so ni daa wum ni Yisa be Farisii maa yiŋa n-diri bindirigu maa ka o zaŋ luɣilu viɛlli din pali tulaale.
en: Meanwhile, a woman from the city, a sinner, discovered that Jesus was dining in the Pharisees house. She brought perfumed oil in a vase made of alabaster.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ti kul suhir o ni o chɛ ka ti mini ya lan nya taba, ka ti tooi zaŋ din pooi ya yi yɛda niŋbu ni la sɔŋ ya.
en: Night and day we continue praying with all our heart that we can come there and see you again. We want to give you everything you need to make your faith strong.
