dag: Nyama, mbusim din pah ayi gariya; ka din pah ata yɛn doli di nyaaŋ na pumpɔŋɔ.
en: The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon.

dag: Ka kum daa wum o pam ka o bɔri bindirigu ni o di, amaa ka bɛ daa na duɣirimi; di saha maa ka o daa nya ʒii.
en: He became hungry and wanted something to eat; while the food was being prepared, he had a vision.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: To God be the glory forever and always! Amen.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa luri Naawuni sizuura ŋɔ, kamiyana ka n ti yɛli ya o ni tum shɛli ti ma ka yi wum.
en: Come and listen, all who honor God, and I will tell you what he has done for me.

dag: O daa mali bidibiga ka o yuli booni Sool, O daa nyɛla nachimbil viɛlli. Do so daa ka Izraɛl n-viɛl gar o; ka o daa lan wɔɣ gari sokam.
en: He had a son named Saul, who was a handsome young man. No one in Israel was more handsome than Saul, and he stood head and shoulders above everyone else.

dag: N ni fo ka yi wuhi ma. Chɛliya ka m baŋ n ni tum gala shɛli.
en: Instruct me and Ill be quiet; inform me how Ive erred.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Ʒinimi tiŋa n-karim li ka ti wum. Ka Baruk daa karim li ka bɛ wum.
en: the officials said, Please sit down and read it to us, which he did.

dag: Di saha doo maa ya kpamba maa ni boli doo maa na ti tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa, ka o yi na kul vili ʒiɛla lala ka yɛli, N je ni n kpuɣ o.
en: Then the town leaders are to summon him and speak to him. If he still refuses to marry her.

dag: Amiram bihi n-daa nyɛ: Aduna mini Musa ni Miriam. Aduna bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: ti bɔhi ba, Yi ni yɛli ni yi daa dɔɣi yi bi so zom la m-bɔŋɔ? Di yi nyɛla ŋuna, ka bɔ n-lee chɛ ka o nina maa neei pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: The Jewish leaders asked them, Is this your son? Are you saying he was born blind? How can he now see.

dag: Lan bomiya zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ata n-niŋ kpam ŋmiri li ka di leei chi sara m-pahi naɣilaa kam zuɣu; ka lan zaŋ zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayi n-niŋ kpam ŋmiri li ka di leei chi sara m-pahi piɛla yino zuɣu;.
en: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram.

dag: Di saha maa niriba pam ni ti zaɣisi ma dolibu, ka yi tab nyaansi, ka je taba.
en: Many will give up their faith at that time; they will betray one another and hate one another.

dag: Ka o daa bahi ba noli yɛli, Chamiya! Ka bɛ daa yi dɔb maa ni n-chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim maa ni; ka bɛ zaa daa dii zo wuriwuri nti sirigi kuligbiriŋ ni ha n-faai lu teeku ni, ka kom di ba.
en: Go, Jesus told them; so they left and went off into the pigs. The whole herd rushed down the side of the cliff into the lake and was drowned.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, chɛli n taali, ka chɛ ka m min a labi, ka n ti jɛm Yawɛ.
en: But now I beg you, forgive my sin and go back with me, so that I can worship the Lord .

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa tum Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa, ka bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ li.
en: And the Israelites continued walking in all the sins that Jeroboam did. They didnt deviate from them.

dag: O lan nyɛla bɛn guni gba yaba, ka di pala bɛ ni guni maa kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa ka di lee nyɛla bɛ gba ni niŋ yɛda kaman ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa na bi guni ka niŋ yɛda shɛm la zuɣu.
en: He could also be the ancestor of those circumcised people, who arent only circumcised but who also walk in the path of faith, like our ancestor Abraham did while he wasnt circumcised.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ. Benya o naba ni jɛmm o. O nyɛla ŋun be kasi!.
en: Praise the Lord our God; worship before his throne! Holy is he!.

dag: Ka Ɛzra daa yɛli, M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yaannim Naawuni ŋun zaŋ yɛlli ŋɔ niŋ naa suhu ni, ka o ti Yawɛ jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la jilima ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Ezra said, Praise the Lord , the God of our ancestors! He has made the emperor willing to honor in this way the Temple of the Lord in Jerusalem.

dag: Gbaŋ ŋɔ yila gomna Rɛhum mini Shimshai ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaɣili polo gbaŋŋmar la ni bɛ taba bɛn kpalim ni sariakaritiba ni tuma zuɣulaannim ni kpamba ni Pɛriʒianim ni Ɛrɛknim ni Babilɔnnim ni Susa din be Ɛlam tiŋgbɔŋ ni la nima.
en: From Rehum, the governor, from Shimshai, secretary of the province, from their associates, the judges, and from all the other officials, who are originally from Erech, Babylon, and Susa in the land of Elam.

dag: amaa Nɛria bia Baruk n-wuhir a yikombiɛlim zaŋ chaŋ ti polo ni yi zaŋ ti niŋ Babilɔnnim nuu ni, ka bɛ ku ti bee n-gbahi ti daba zaŋ ti kuli Babilɔn.
en: Its Baruch, Neriahs son, who put you up to it so that we end up in the hands of the Babylonians, who will either kill us or deport us to Babylon.

dag: O ni daa duh omaŋa o tuumbiɛri zuɣu la zuɣu, niŋmiy o nahiŋgu ka o fabili lala! Dama o yɛli o suhu ni: N dila nam ʒiya! M pala pakoli! Lala zuɣu n ku nya suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: She gave herself much glory and rich living. Give her that much suffering and sadness. She says to herself, I am a queen sitting on my throne. I am not a widow; I will never be sad.

dag: Kumsi saha beni, ka lari saha beni. Fabila saha beni, ka waa wabu saha beni.
en: There is a time to cry and a time to laugh. There is a time to be sad and a time to dance with joy.

dag: Naa suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋumbu, amaa o nirilim ŋmanila maligim din lu mɔri zuɣu.
en: The shouts of an angry king are like a roaring lion, but his kind words are like a gentle rain falling softly on the grass.

dag: A nam dariza din galisi pam ŋɔ puuni ka a ŋme m-paag a dimnima. Nyini n-daa chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili di ba zaa kaman mɔ kuma ka bɛ chɛ n-sɔŋ ka buɣim di li la.
en: With your great surge you overthrow your opponents; you send out your hot anger; it burns them up like straw.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli bɔɣukpiŋlan maa, Mirim ma na.
en: He said to the man with the withered hand, Step up where people can see you.

dag: dama kaman Naawuni ni daa yihi paɣa doo ni na shɛm, lala zuɣu ka paɣ gba dɔɣiri doo pumpɔŋɔ. Amaa binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla Naawuni ni nam shɛli.
en: This is true because woman came from man, but also man is born from woman. Really, everything comes from God.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Di karitiya tab saria ka Naawuni ti ku kari yi gba saria;.
en: Dont judge others, and God will not judge you.

dag: ka ŋmaligi chaŋ ha ka lan tam o ni lihi nya omaŋ shɛm maa kɔtomsi.
en: They look at themselves, walk away, and immediately forget what they were like.

dag: Ka Manaasa zuliya mini Ifriim zuliya ni ti lu tab zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ ti laɣim lu Juda zuliya zuɣu. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ku chɛ ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa zan tariga. O na kul loya ni o darigi bɛ tibili.
en: Manasseh fought against Ephraim, and Ephraim fought against Manasseh. Then both of them turned on Judah. But the Lord is not finished punishing his people. He is still angry, and his arm is raised to continue punishing them.

dag: Yi ni ti nyɛ n niriba, ka m mi nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: You will be my people, and I will be your God.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi la gba daa maan o ansarisi, ka zaŋ komihigu ti o ni o nyu.
en: The soldiers also made fun of him: they came up to him and offered him cheap wine.

dag: Kpaŋsimiya bɛn nuhi gbarigi la mini bɛn duna gbarigi la.
en: Here is a message for all who are weak, trembling, and worried:.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a nyaŋ Ɛdomnima, ka karimbaani kpe a suhu ni n-chɛ ka a duh amaŋa. Chɛ ka a nini tiɣ a jilima, ka ʒi a yiŋa. Bee bɔzuɣu ka a bɔri vuri ni a chɛ ka bɛ ku a tabili Judanima.
en: Amaziah, you think you're so powerful because you defeated Edom. Go ahead and celebrate—but stay at home. If you cause any trouble, both you and your kingdom of Judah will be destroyed.

dag: Hal tɔbbihi yi teei gili ma, n ku zo dabiɛm; ka hal bɛ ni kul lo tɔbu na ti liri ma maa zaa yoli, n kul ni niŋ naani.
en: Even if a whole army surrounds me, I will not be afraid; even if enemies attack me, I will still trust God.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi tiri so yiko ka o tɔɣisiri yɛm yɛtɔɣa, ka chɛ ka so mi tɔɣisiri baŋsim yɛtɔɣa Shi yino maa yiko ni.
en: The Spirit gives one person the ability to speak with wisdom. And the same Spirit gives another person the ability to speak with knowledge.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa ti kum niŋ Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ ti ba ninvuɣ so ŋun ni fa ba bahi. Dilana n-nyɛ Gɛra bia Ɛhud ŋun daa yi Bɛnjamin zuliya ni na, ka nyɛ gɔbigalan la. Ŋuna ka Izraɛlnim daa timdi ka o zaŋdi bɛ farigu ti yɔri Mɔab Naa Ɛgilɔn.
en: The Israelites cried to the Lord for help, so he sent a man named Ehud son of Gera to save them. Ehud was from the tribe of Benjamin and was trained to fight with his left hand. The Israelites sent Ehud with a gift to King Eglon of Moab.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋuna n-tiri nandaamba pina pam luɣilikam. O nirilim niŋbu kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: As the Scriptures say, He gives generously to the poor; his goodness will continue forever. Psalm :.

dag: Ka n ku lan teei bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa shɛli yɛla. Bɛ tum din doli zaligu mini din tuhi, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni be.
en: I will not remember the bad things they did in the past, because now they live right and are fair. So they will live!.

dag: O daa chɛ ka Ijiptinim suhuri je o niriba maa, ka chɛ ka bɛ doli yɛmbimbiɛri soli n-nahim o daba maa.
en: They served the Lord , and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.

dag: N ni ti niŋdi ba din viɛla ni suhupiɛlli, ka zaŋ ba ʒili tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ni ʒiɛyimtali ni n suhu zaa ni n shia zaa.
en: I will take pleasure in doing good things for them, and I will establish them permanently in this land.

dag: Kpahimmi Naawuni tuma; o yi niŋ shɛli ka di gbiligi, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi mal li zali dɛde?.
en: Think of what God has done! If God makes something crooked, can you make it straight?.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi yɛn niŋ tipawumli kaman Ijiptinim mini Firawuna ni daa niŋ tipawumli shɛm la? O ni daa chɛ ka bɛ tum jɛrilim la nyaaŋa, pa bɛmaŋmaŋa n-daa ti chɛ ka niriba maa chaŋ?.
en: Why should you be stubborn, as the king of Egypt and the Egyptians were? Don't forget how God made fools of them until they let the Israelites leave Egypt.

dag: Ka nachimba pia bɛn daa nyɛ Jɔab gbaɣino ʒiriba daa laɣim gili Absalom m-bahi jɛh o.
en: Ten of Joabs young helpers gathered around Absalom and killed him.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila ti shɛŋa bɛ ni sa m-baɣili kulibɔŋ din mali kom, ka di wandi wala di walibu saha, ka di vari bi suura. Bɛ kul dirila nasara bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa puuni.
en: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa chɛ ka Tarishish ŋarima tatabo chaŋ Ofiri ni bɛ ti ʒi salima na; amaa ka di daa bi paai, dama ŋarima maa daa saɣimla Ɛziɔngɛba.
en: King Jehoshaphat built some cargo ships. He wanted the ships to sail to Ophir for gold, but they never went there—they were destroyed in their home port at Ezion Geber.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs zaligu maa ni daa moli gili, bɛ daa laɣim paɣisara pam tahi Susa din daa nyɛ tinzuɣu maa ni na, ka Ɛsta gba daa be bɛ ni. Bɛ daa zaŋ ba kpɛhila nayili maa puuni nti zaŋ ba niŋ Hɛgai ŋun daa su napaɣiba fukumsi la nuu ni ni o lihiri ba.
en: When the kings order and his new law became public, many young women were gathered into the fortified part of Susa under the care of Hegai. Esther was also taken to the palace to the care of Hegai, the one in charge of the women.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa bɔhi Hivinim maa, Wula ka ti mini ya ni tooi lo tab alikauli? Dama di pa shɛli ka yi kul bela yomayoma kpe.
en: But the Israelites said, Why should we make a treaty with you? Maybe you live nearby.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili! Wula ka n yaannim gbala ni do tin shɛl ni lu n-dahim, ka buɣim di di dunɔdaya, ka n ku lihiri suhugarigu lihigu.
en: I answered, Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! I feel sad because the city where my ancestors are buried is in ruins, and its gates have been burned down.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni ŋun daa bo vuri maa daag o bahi ha ka bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ a leei ti toondana mini ti sariakarita?.
en: The one who started the fight against his neighbor pushed Moses aside and said, Who appointed you as our leader and judge? .

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii bɛ buɣili Baalibɛriti duu anzinfa laɣibaligu pisopɔin ti o. Ka Abimilɛk daa zaŋ liɣiri maa ti da ninvuɣ galima mini ninkuunsinima n-zaŋ ba pa omaŋ zuɣu.
en: They gave him seventy pieces of silver from the temple of Baal-of-the-Covenant, and with this money he hired a bunch of worthless scoundrels to join him.

dag: Ka Judanim daa ti paai luɣ shɛli din du pam mɔɣu ni la shee, ka bɛ daa du li n-lihi tɔbbi gbaliŋ la polo, n-nya ka kpiimba n-do tiŋa, ka bɛ so bi tiligi.
en: The men from Judah arrived at the lookout point in the desert. They looked for the enemys large army, but all they saw were dead bodies lying on the ground. There were no survivors.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi lihi ma ni n nyɛla a tumtumdikpee, nyin deem o kaman a ni ni deei ma shɛm.
en: So, if you really consider me a partner, welcome Onesimus as if you were welcoming me.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Nuhu, Alikauli shɛli din be m mini dunia ŋɔ binnɛma zaa sunsuuni la shihirili m-bala.
en: So God said to Noah, This rainbow is proof of the agreement that I made with all living things on earth.

dag: O ni ti niŋ ninvuɣ titali, ka bɛ ni ti boon o la Zallakudura Naa Bia, ka ti Duuma Naawuni ni ti zaŋ o yab Naa Dauda nam ti o.
en: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High God. The Lord God will make him a king, as his ancestor David was.

dag: Ka o daa ka kɔbo din ni yo, ka naa maa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm sandira maa min o paɣa ni o bihi n-tabil o ni mali shɛlikam zaa ti kɔhi na nti yo o samli maa.
en: But he didn't have any money to pay what he owed. The king ordered him to be sold, along with his wife and children and all he owned, in order to pay the debt.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni nyɛla ŋun niŋdi Izraɛlnim din viɛla, ka lan niŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhuyini din viɛla.
en: God is so good to Israel, to those whose hearts are pure.

dag: Ka Yawɛ mi deei yi daalikauli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni yi nyɛla omaŋmaŋ niriba kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli ni di simdi ni yi dol o zaligunim la.
en: Today the Lord has accepted you as his own people, as he promised you; and he commands you to obey all his laws.

dag: Yi tahiri tab ʒiishɛhi, amaa ka yɛlimaŋli ka yi polo. Yi dolila naŋgbankpeeni mini ʒiri soli ni yi di nasara, ka chɛ ka yɛlibiɛri tiɣi pua n-dɔɣi zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: No one sues honestly; no one pleads truthfully. By trusting in emptiness and speaking deceit, they conceive harm and give birth to malice.

dag: ka di chɛ ka nir kul ni beni sahakam, ka ku kpi.
en: no one can live forever without experiencing the pit.

dag: Ka zuliya kam ni zaŋ bɛ tibiginsim mini bɛ jilima na nti kpe tiŋ maa ni.
en: The greatness and the wealth of the nations will be brought into the city.

dag: Ti ni yuri ya la zuɣu ka ti daa lo ni ti pirigi ti ni mali shɛli tin ya, ka di pala Naawuni lahibal suŋ la kɔŋko, amaa zaŋ tabili timaŋmaŋ nyɛviya gba, ka di nyɛla ti ni kul yuri ya pam la zuɣu.
en: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔh o, A yuli? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N yuli m-booni Bɔbigu. Dama alizin biɛ bɔbigu n-daa ʒi o zuɣu.
en: Jesus asked him, What is your name? Legion, he replied, because many demons had entered him.

dag: Ka Yisa lih o yurilim lihigu ka yɛl o, Yɛl yini n-naɣ poog a: Cham ti kɔhi a ni mali shɛlikam zaa zaŋ ti nandaamba, ka kana ti doli ma, ka di chɛ ka a ti nya buni alizanda ni.
en: Jesus looked at him carefully and loved him. He said, You are lacking one thing. Go, sell what you own, and give the money to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven. And come, follow me.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi tahi bɛ zuɣu ka yɛli ba, Yi ʒi din gbibi ya.
en: But Jesus turned and criticized them for saying this.

dag: ni Kabɔn ni Lamam ni Chitilishi.
en: Cabbon, Lahmam, Chitlish.

dag: Bɛ daa lan pii Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba kɔbisiyi ni pisi bɛn yaannim daa nyɛ Naa Dauda min o kpambaliba ni daa pii shɛb zali ni bɛ sɔŋdi Lɛvinim la. Ka bɛ daa sab bɛ zaa yinoyino yuya sɔŋ.
en: In addition, others came to help the Levites in the temple. The ancestors of these workers had been chosen years ago by King David and his officials, and they were all listed by name.

dag: Ti luya zaa; ti kul teei dola taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: We fall crushed to the ground; we lie defeated in the dust.

dag: Chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ niŋ suhutunanima, ka chɛ ka bɛ tiba kpiri, ka chɛ ka bɛ nina zom, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku zaŋ bɛ nina lihi nya, ka zaŋ bɛ tiba wum, ka zaŋ bɛ suhuri baŋ shɛli gbinni, ka ŋmaligina nya tibbu.
en: Make these people stubborn! Make them stop up their ears, cover their eyes, and fail to understand. Don't let them turn to me and be healed.

dag: Dinzuɣu pom Yawɛ ni a ti ku ku n zuliya n kalinsi nyaaŋa bee n-kpihim n daŋ birili.
en: Promise me with the Lord as your witness, that you won't wipe out my descendants. Let them live to keep my family name alive.

dag: Ka bɛ daa na bi kpe gom, ka Sɔdom tiŋ puuni dɔbba bɛn nyɛ ninkura mini bipola zaa daa laɣimna nti teei gili yili maa.
en: Before the guests went to bed, the men of Sodom surrounded the house. All the men of the city, both young and old, were there.

dag: Ti yi nyɛla bɛn zuɣuri lɛbigi, di nyɛla Naawuni zuɣu; ka ti yi nyɛla ninvuɣ maŋa, di nyɛla yi zuɣu.
en: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.

dag: ka bɛ zaŋ Anabi Aizaia litaafi ti o, ka o kpabigi li bo n-nya luɣ shɛli din daa sab yɛli.
en: he was given the book of Isaiah the prophet. He opened it and read.

dag: Binshɛɣukam mali saha, ka yɛl shɛlikam din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni malila di niŋbu saha.
en: Everything on earth has its own time and its own season.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni yi ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro bee kawaan chimda bee zaɣ maha hal ni dindali maa, naɣila yi ti zaŋ Naawuni sara maligu maa na pɔi. Di nyɛla zaligu sahakam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa yi ni be.
en: You must not eat any of the new grain, or fruit, or bread made from the new grain until you bring that offering to your God. This law will always continue through your generations, wherever you live.

dag: Yi yi ti dɔɣi bihi, ka yi bihi maa mi dɔɣi bihi, ka yi nini ti tiɣi yimaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, yi yi ti mali wuni ŋmahindi binshɛlikam n-tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi.
en: Even when you have been in the land a long time and have children and grandchildren, do not sin by making for yourselves an idol in any form at all. This is evil in the Lord 's sight, and it will make him angry.

dag: Amaa ka naa yɛligu maa daa zani, ka chɛ Jɔab dini maa. Di saha ka Jɔab daa yiɣisi chaŋ gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa n-kali niriba maa, ka labi Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: But the king made Joab obey the order. Joab went out, traveled through the whole country of Israel, and then returned to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kali Lɛvinim maa bɛn yuma paai pihita zaŋ chana, ka bɛ kalinli daa nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahaayika.
en: He then counted the Levite men who were at least years old, and the total was .

dag: Jɔab ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la n-daa su tɔbbihi Fukumsi, ka Jɛhɔshafat Ahilud bia la daa nyɛ ŋun sabiri gbana sɔŋda.
en: Joab son of Zeruiah was the commander of Davids army. Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud wrote about the things David did.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka Jɔn daa nya Yisa ka o kpari o polo na ka o yɛli, Nyamiya Naawuni Piɛbila ŋun kpihindi dunianim daalahichi la.
en: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, Look, the Lamb of God. He takes away the sins of the world!.

dag: Chɛ ka n galimi kalinsi mini m biɛhigu din tuhi gbib ma, dama nyini ka n niŋ naani.
en: Let integrity and virtue guard me because I hope in you.

dag: Yi bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli. Yi soya nyɛla sɔgolima, ka ŋunkam zaa dol li ka suhudoo, dama yi ʒi suhudoo soli.
en: and no one is safe when you are around. Everything you do is unjust. You follow a crooked path, and no one who walks that path will ever be safe.

dag: Amaa yi kpalim jɛmdila yi wuni din nyɛ yi naa ka yi booni li Sakut la mini yi saŋmariga wuni din yuli booni Kaiwan la binnana.
en: But now, because you have worshiped images of Sakkuth, your king god, and of Kaiwan, your star god, you will have to carry those images.

dag: Amaa ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa daa dim salo maa tiba ni yɛli ni bɛ yɛlim o ni o yihimila Barabas bahi, ka pa ni Yisa.
en: But the chief priests told the crowd to ask Pilate to free Barabbas.

dag: Anzinfa doora ŋun yuli daa booni Dimitirius daa malila anzinfa n-doori buɣili Aritɛmis binnana, ka o mini bɛn daa laɣim tumdi di tuma nyari liɣiri pam di ni.
en: There was a silversmith named Demetrius. He made silver models of Artemis temple, and his business generated a lot of profit for the craftspeople.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa kum niŋ Yawɛ ni o sɔŋ ba; dama Jabin daa malila kuriti chɛchɛbunsi kɔbisiwɛi; ka daa zaŋ ninkuunsi n-nahim Izraɛlnim pam yuun pisi.
en: The Israelites cried out to the LORD because Sisera had nine hundred iron chariots and had oppressed the Israelites cruelly for twenty years.

dag: Ka n daa gari a sani n-nya a ni be a ʒim ni talinda, a ni daa do a ʒim ni maa, ka n yɛl a, Niŋmi nyɛvili.
en: I saw you lying there, rolling around in your own blood, and I couldn't let you die.

dag: Duumanima, niŋmiya yi daba din niŋ kamaata, dama yi mi ni yi gba mali Duuma alizanda ni.
en: Masters, be fair and just in the way you treat your slaves. Remember that you too have a Master in heaven.

dag: Ninsal tɛha n-wuhir o soli, amaa Yawɛ n-wuhir o o ni yɛn chani shɛm.
en: People plan their path, but the LORD secures their steps.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl daa yɛli, Naawuni zahimmi n yɛla nya, ka deei n suhigu ka ti ma bidibiga; dinzuɣu ka o daa bol o yuli Dan.
en: Rachel named him Dan, because she said, God has answered my prayers. He judged in my favor and has given me a son.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yɛli Naawuni, Ti tum alahichi, amaa ti suhir a zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, fam ti bahi; ka niŋ ti a ni bɔri ni a niŋ ti shɛm.
en: But the Israelites said to the Lord , We have sinned. Do whatever you want to do to us, but please save us today.

dag: To, yinima n-su Ɛhab bidibisi la fukumsi, ka su o chɛchɛbunsi min o yuri ni bidibbina ni bɛ ni me birini gili tin shɛŋa la, dinzuɣu yi yi deei gbaŋ ŋɔ.
en: The letters said: Your masters sons are in your possession, along with horses and chariots, a fortified city, and weapons. Now when this letter reaches you.

dag: N yɛri ya mi o ni kari saria yomyom ti ba nasara. Ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Daadam Bia yi lab dunia ŋɔ ni na, o ni nya bɛn mali yɛda.
en: He will surely hurry and help them. But when the Son of Man comes, will he find on this earth anyone with faith?.

dag: Bɛ gbinni nyaɣa kuuya, ka bɛ zuɣusaa wula kpi.
en: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim mini Judanim daa dii yiɣisi kuhi bahi Filistianim maa zuɣu, n-kari dol ba hal ti paai Gaat mini Ɛkurɔn dunoya ni, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Filistia tɔbbi shɛb bɛn nya dansi kul luri soli ni, zaŋ Shaaraim hal ti paai Gaat mini Ɛkurɔn.
en: The soldiers from Israel and Judah jumped up with a shout and chased the Philistines all the way to Gath and the gates of Ekron. The dead Philistines were littered along the Shaarim road all the way to Gath and Ekron.

dag: Chɛliya ka Izraɛlnim ti bɛ suɣa gbilligbilli zali di ni simdi ni bɛ ʒi luɣ shɛŋa mini bɛ yaannim dunoya tuutanim ni sa luɣ shɛŋa. Bɛ chɛ ka bɛ suɣa maa noya kpa laɣiŋgu suɣili maa luɣilikam polo.
en: The Israelites will camp each under the banner with the symbol of their household. They will camp around the meeting tent some distance from it.

dag: Bɛ ni ti vɔn ya tahi gooni ŋmabu shee nti daai ya bahi Hamɔn. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will be dragged through holes in your city walls, and you will be thrown toward Harmon. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: Binzahi maa zaɣ yini kam daa malila bintaɣiris anahi di yaɣa anahi maa zaa. Bintaɣirisi maa mini binzahi maa zaa daa nyɛla zaɣ mundili yini.
en: There was a handle on each of the four corners of every stand, projecting from the side of the stand.

dag: Ka binshɛɣukam din mali daɣiri ti ku kpe tiŋ maa ni bee ŋunkam tumdi din chihiri bee ŋ-ŋmari ʒiri, amaa kulla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuya sab Piɛbil maa nyɛvili litaafi la ni kɔŋko nti yɛn kpe tiŋ maa ni.
en: Nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who does what is vile and deceitful, but only those who are registered in the Lambs scroll of life.

dag: Atɛr daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbigaayika.
en: of Ater, that is, of the descendants of Hezekiah.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa ni niriba maa zaa daa bi deei Yawɛ ni yɛli ba ni bɛ ʒinimi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa.
en: So Johanan, the army officers, and all the people disobeyed the Lord s command. The Lord had commanded them to stay in Judah.

dag: Niriba yi daŋ yiɣisibu asiba n-tum tuun kpɛma bindirigu zuɣu hal ni yuŋ, ka bi daŋ gbihibu, di ka buchi, dama Yawɛ n-tir o ni yuri ninvuɣ shɛb gom.
en: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.

dag: Yawɛ yɛri Izraɛlnima, Kamiya n sanna ka n tiligi ya.
en: The Lord says to the people of Israel, Come to me, and you will live.

dag: ka yɛli Jɛrɔbɔam, Piim di ni zaɣ tolima pia, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Nyama, n dari tɔhila Izraɛl nam Sulemaana nuu ni.
en: Then he said: Jeroboam, take ten pieces of this coat and listen to what the Lord God of Israel says to you. Jeroboam, I am the Lord God, and I am about to take Solomon's kingdom from him and give you ten tribes to rule.

dag: Ka bɔh o di saha maa, Di luhiya ni ti yo farigu Naa Siiza sani bee di bi luhi.
en: Tell us, is it against our Law for us to pay taxes to the Roman Emperor, or not.

dag: Yinim bɛn be ʒilinsi ni ŋɔ, saha yuusim wula ka yi kul bɔri ni yi be ʒilinsi maa ni? Saha yuusim wula ka ansarisimaaniba kul yɛn be ansarisi malibu ni? Ka saha yuusim wula ka jɛra kul yɛn zaɣisiri yɛm?.
en: How much longer will you enjoy being stupid fools? Won't you ever stop sneering and laughing at knowledge?.

dag: Judas ni daa ti paana o dii shiri chaŋmi ti zani Yisa tooni ka yɛli, Karimba! Ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: As soon as he got there, Judas said to Jesus, Rabbi! Then he kissed him.

dag: Ka zaŋ piɛlaa la mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi piɛɣu pal la m-mali biɛrisuŋ sara Yawɛ sani; ka maligumaana maa lan mali chi sara mini binnyura sara din pahi la.
en: He shall sacrifice the ram to the Lord as a fellowship offering, and offer it with the basket of bread; he shall also present the offerings of grain and wine.

dag: Ŋunkam yuri saɣisigu nyɛla ŋun yuri yɛm, amaa bɛn je ni bɛ wuhi ba bɛ galimi nyɛla jɛra.
en: Those who love discipline love knowledge, and those who hate correction are stupid.

dag: N daa pun mi a mi pɔi ka naanyi ti nam a a ma puli ni. N daa pun piig a mi zali pɔi ka bɛ ti naanyi dɔɣ a; ka n zaŋ a leei zuliya kam anabi.
en: I chose you before I gave you life, and before you were born I selected you to be a prophet to the nations.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Zaligu dini ka Anabi Musa daa lee zali ya.
en: Jesus answered with a question, What law did Moses give you.

dag: A zaligunim maa chɛ ka m mali yɛm gari n dimnima, dama di kul bela n suhu ni.
en: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.

dag: Yisa daa yɛli salo maa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa la ŋaha puuni, hal o daa bi wuhiri ba shɛli ka pa ni yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni.
en: Jesus used parables to tell all these things to the crowds; he would not say a thing to them without using a parable.

dag: A zaŋ ʒim ti bɛn daa yih a wuntizɔriba mini anabinim ʒim la ni bɛ nyu. Di ni simdi ni a niŋ ba shɛm m-bala.
en: They poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve it.

dag: Ibrahimma n-daa nyɛ Yisahaku ba, Yisahaku bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Iso mini Izraɛl.
en: Abraham was Isaacs father. Isaacs family: Esau and Israel.

dag: Baŋmi ni yɛm gba nyɛla din nyaɣis a suhu ni. A yi nya yɛm, a ni nya dahin shɛli biɛhigu, ka a tahima ku zani soli.
en: Know that wisdom is like that for your whole being. If you find it, there is a future. Your hope wont be cut off.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, N ku dol a kuli bee n-kpe a yiŋa bee n-di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom kpe;.
en: But the man of God answered, I cant return or go with you, and I cant eat food or drink water with you in this place.

dag: Ka Dauda daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya ka Yawɛ malaika maa ʒiɛla tiŋgbani mini zuɣusaa sunsuuni, ka ŋooi takɔbi gbib o nuu ni n-teeg o nuu maa tiri Jɛrusalɛm. Di saha ka Dauda min o kpamba daa chibi kpalansi ye n-lu n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa.
en: When David looked up, he saw the LORDs messenger stationed between the earth and the sky with a drawn sword in his hand stretched out against Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, dressed in mourning clothes, fell on their faces.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Molimi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa Juda fɔntinsi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm pala zuɣu n-yɛra, Wummiya alikauli ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa ka gbibi li.
en: The LORD said to me: Announce all these words in the towns of Judah and on the streets of Jerusalem: Obey the terms of this covenant and perform them.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi ba, Yi na bi karim di ni sabi Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli shɛm la yɛla? Di sabiya: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi la n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili.
en: Havent you read this scripture, The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

dag: Ka Gomna Gɛdalia daa lo ba alikauli yɛli, Di zɔriya Babilɔn sapashinnim dabiɛm, kpalimmiya be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-jɛmdi Babilɔn naa, ka binshɛlikam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani.
en: Gedaliah made a solemn pledge to them and their soldiers, telling them, Dont be afraid of the Chaldean officials. Stay in the land and serve the Babylonian king, and things will go well for you.

dag: Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ yili yilli paɣi Yawɛ tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni?.
en: But how could we possibly sing the LORDs song on foreign soil?.

dag: O daa yi chɛ o zabiri o zaŋdila nayili sania zahim li ka di tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ayi.
en: His hair grew so thick and heavy that when he got it cut once a year, it weighed over two kilograms.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia mini niriba maa zaa suhuri daa paligi Naawuni ni daa tum tuun shɛli ti niriba maa zuɣu, dama bɛ daa tum tuma maa naai yomyom pam.
en: Hezekiah and the people of Judah celebrated, because God had helped them make this happen so quickly.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka tɔna do n-gil a, ka dabiɛm lu a zuɣu libig a.
en: So now there are pitfalls all around you, and suddenly you are full of fear.

dag: Ka naŋgbankpeeni daa ti kpe Ibram biŋkɔbiguliba mini Lɔt biŋkɔbiguliba sunsuuni. Di saha maa Keenannim mini Pɛrizinima n-daa be tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: The shepherds of Abram and Lot began to argue.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tim Neetan Dauda sani, ka o daa chaŋ ti yɛl o, Niriba ayi n-daa be tin shɛli, yino daa nyɛla bundana, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ faralana.
en: So the LORD sent Nathan to David. When Nathan arrived he said, There were two men in the same city, one rich, one poor.

dag: Ka shɛb yɛli ni Anabi Ilaija n-lan yi palo maa yaha, ka shɛb mi yɛli ni anab kura la ni yino n-neei kum ni na maa.
en: Others were saying Elijah had come or one of the prophets from long ago had come back to life.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa balim o yɛli, Karimba, dim bindirigu.
en: In the meantime the disciples were begging Jesus, Teacher, have something to eat.

dag: Ka Farisiinim shɛb bɛn daa be nimaani wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɔh o, Ka daɣila ti gba nyɛla zoomba.
en: Some Pharisees who were there with him heard him say this and asked him, Surely you don't mean that we are blind, too.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili Damaskus ka Sirianim maa daa leei Dauda ni su shɛba, ka bɛ yɔri farigu o sani. Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Dauda kul diri nasara o ni chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam.
en: David set up forts among the Arameans of Damascus. And the Arameans became Davids subjects and brought him tribute. The LORD gave David victory wherever he went.

dag: Dɔɣibu saha beni, ka kpibu saha beni. Biribu saha beni, ka bɛ ni biri binshɛli sib bahi saha beni.
en: a time for giving birth and a time for dying, a time for planting and a time for uprooting what was planted.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yi yi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du m-paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan.

dag: N daa loya n yɛm puuni ni n nyu dam n-nya suhupiɛlli, ka tum jɛrilim; ka yɛm daa kul be n tɛha ni. N daa tɛhiya ni di ni simdi ni nir zaŋ o dunia ŋɔ yili saha biɛla ŋɔ tum tuun shɛli m-bala.
en: Driven on by my desire for wisdom, I decided to cheer myself up with wine and have a good time. I thought that this might be the best way people can spend their short lives on earth.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o niŋ duu kpari, dama bɛ daa na bi mi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ o shɛm.
en: and was put under guard, because it was not clear what should be done with him.

dag: ka n naɣikɔra dapua yɛbu bi to, ka n ʒili mi bi tibisa.
en: My yoke is easy to bear, and my burden is light.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Pɛɛgamum Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun mali takɔb dirili din mali naŋgbana ayi la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: This is the message from the one who has the sharp two-edged sword.

dag: Kaman sara maligu biŋkɔbbaligu ni galisi shɛm ni kaman Jɛrusalɛm churi puhibu ni biŋkɔbbaligu ni beni shɛm la, lala ka bɛ ni daa wurim fɔntin shɛŋa maa ni ti pali daadambiɛligu. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: During the special festivals, Jerusalem was filled with flocks of sheep and goats that had been made holy. In the same way the cities and ruined places will be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: O daa pun daŋ timla ninvuɣ so ka o daŋ bɛ tooni. Dilana n-daa nyɛ Yisifu so bɛ ni daa zaŋ kɔhi ka o leei dabili la.
en: he sent a man ahead of them, who was sold as a slave: it was Joseph.

dag: Bɛ daa yila Midian chaŋ Paran ti zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛba m-pahi bɛmaŋ zuɣu, ka bɛ mini ba zo n-kuli Ijipti nti chaŋ Ijipti naa Firawuna sani. Ka naa maa daa ti Hadad yili mini tiŋgbani ni bindirigu.
en: They set out from Midian and went to Paran. They took men with them from Paran and came to Egypt and to Pharaoh its king. Pharaoh assigned him a home, food, and land.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je man Yawɛ ni ti kana ti gbani n tooni ka dabiɛm mali ba, ka bɛ tibidarigibo ti ku mali tariga.
en: Those who hate the LORD would grovel before me, and their doom would last forever!.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa ka o sanna ti yɛra, Jɔn daa bi tum alahiziba tuun shɛli, amaa o ni daa yɛli shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ doo ŋɔ polo nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Many people came to him. John performed no miracles, they said, but everything he said about this man was true.

dag: Man Pita ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn wurim kpe tinzun tinsi ni m-be Pɔntus mini Galɛshia ni Kapadɔsia ni Ɛsha ni Bitinia.
en: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To Gods chosen strangers in the world of the diaspora, who live in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa suhi alibarika niŋ Firawuna ni ka yiɣisi kuli.
en: Then Jacob gave the king his blessing once again and left.

dag: Ka Yisa lan yɛl o, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, faashee bɛ maan labi dɔɣi ninsala ni kom mini Naawuni Shia, di yi pa lala o ku tooi kpe Naawuni nam ni.
en: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that before you can get into God's kingdom, you must be born not only by water, but by the Spirit.

dag: Pallu zuliya n-daa nyɛ Ɛliab.
en: Pallus descendants: Eliab.

dag: Nyam bɛ ni lo zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu shɛm, ka lo barina tumbu nia, ka ŋmari ʒiri.
en: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.

dag: Wuntaŋ yi puhina m-bii ni tulim n-kpe mɔri, di puma kpahirimi lu ka di viɛlim gba kpaai. Lala ka azichilana gba ni ti kpaai o tuma tumbu puuni.
en: As the sun rises and gets hotter, its heat dries up the plants, and the flowers fall off. The flowers that were so beautiful are now dead. Thats how it is with the rich. While they are still making plans for their business, they will die.

dag: Ifriimnim taɣirila pɔhim chana, ka zɔri doli wulimpuhili polo pɔhim dabisili kam. Bɛ ʒiri mini bɛ suhuyiɣisili kul pahirimi. Ka bɛ mini Asirianim niŋdi daabiligu, ka bɛ tiri Ijiptinim kpam.
en: Everything that the people of Israel do from morning to night is useless and destructive. Treachery and acts of violence increase among them. They make treaties with Assyria and do business with Egypt.

dag: Ti ni daa puhi ba naai ka Pool kahigi Naawuni ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa yiniyini o waazu yihibu ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani yɛli ba.
en: After greeting them, he gave them a detailed report of what God had done among the Gentiles through his ministry.

dag: Ti mali tahima ni Naawuni ni ti yihi ti taali ni o sani; ka dimbɔŋɔnima n-nyɛ ti ni guhiri shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko din tumdi di tuma ti yɛda niŋbu ni la puuni.
en: We eagerly wait for the hope of righteousness through the Spirit by faith.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri sara maligu nyɛla din chihira, di ti ku be ka bɛ zaŋ li na ni nia biɛɣu.
en: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.

dag: Kul zanimiyala yim saɣi ni yi tum taali, ni yi daa taai duŋ zaɣisi man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka zaŋ yi yurilim yaɣiri saamba sani ti mahili kam gbini ka bi deei n noli. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Only admit that you are guilty and that you have rebelled against the Lord , your God. Confess that under every green tree you have given your love to foreign gods and that you have not obeyed my commands. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa nudirigu polo n-yihi waazu jɛndi nudirigu polo maa, ka tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Nɛgɛb nyɔŋ.
en: Human one, face Teman, preach against the south, and prophesy against the thicket in the arid southern plain.

dag: Yawɛ poya ka ku lan taɣ o tɛha: A nyɛla maligumaana ŋun tuma ni be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The Lord made a solemn promise and will not take it back: You will be a priest forever in the priestly order of Melchizedek.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa ni paɣiba daa boli bia maa yuli Obɛd ka yɛli, Bɛ dɔɣi bidibiga ti Naomi! Ka Obɛd daa ti dɔɣi Jɛsi, ka Jɛsi mi dɔɣi Naa Dauda.
en: The neighborhood women named him Obed, but they called him Naomi's Boy. When Obed grew up he had a son named Jesse, who later became the father of King David.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Nyama n yɛn chɛmi ka a be kaman Naawuni la Firawuna sani, ka chɛ ka a mabia Aduna mi nyɛ a daanabi.
en: The Lord said, I am going to make you like God to the king, and your brother Aaron will speak to him as your prophet.

dag: Ibram daa zaŋla o paɣ Zarai min o tizo Haran bia Lɔt, ka bɛ daa laɣim bɛ ni mali binshɛlikam zaa zaŋ tabili bɛ ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb Haran tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-yiɣisi kuli Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ ni daa paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Abram took his wife Sarai, his nephew Lot, and all the wealth and all the slaves they had acquired in Haran, and they started out for the land of Canaan. When they arrived in Canaan.

dag: Bɛ wain nyɛla tinvura lɔɣu. Di nyɛla sapaɣu lɔɣu din bie pam.
en: like wine made from the venom of snakes.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, ti bi lan lihiri so kaman daadamnim ni lihir o shɛm; hal ti ni daa lihi Masia kaman daadamnim ni lihir o shɛm la, ti bi lan lihir o lala.
en: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.

dag: Ka o daa ŋme chɛrubinim mini gbuɣima ni abie tihi kɔtomsi pa di bintaɣirisi mini di dapaɣa zuɣu kaman di zaɣ yini kam ni ni tooi deei palo shɛm tariga, ka mali biŋgolima gil li.
en: and the stands were decorated with flower designs and figures of lions, palm trees, and winged creatures.

dag: A ni ti yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tin shɛli puuni bɛ ni kuri niriba, ka maani buɣa n-ta bɛmaŋ daɣiri la saha paaya.
en: Say, The LORD God proclaims: City, self-destructive blood-letter, self-defiling idol maker.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, N yaaŋa, teemi ni a ni daa be a nyɛvil ni la, a daa nyar a suhu yubu, ka Lazarɔs mi daa nyari wahala, amaa pumpɔŋɔ o suhu maaya, ka a mi be azaaba ni.
en: But Abraham said, Remember, my son, that in your lifetime you were given all the good things, while Lazarus got all the bad things. But now he is enjoying himself here, while you are in pain.

dag: Taainim mini Sidɔnnim ni tin shɛŋa din zaa be Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ, bɔ ka yi lee bɔri ni yi niŋ ma maa? Yi bɔrimi ni yi bɔhi ma biɛri binshɛli zuɣu? Yi yi bɔrimi ni yi bɔhi ma biɛri, n ni chɛ ka yi tuma maa ŋmaligi lu yi zuɣu yomyom!.
en: What are you trying to do to me, Tyre, Sidon, and all of Philistia? Are you trying to pay me back for something? If you are, I will quickly pay you back!.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa tum Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa, ka bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ li.
en: So the Israelites sinned in all the ways Jeroboam did. And they did not stop committing these sins.

dag: Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni wum dimbɔŋɔ bee n-ni ti bɔri ni o zaŋ o zaɣa niŋ di ni dahin shɛli ha?.
en: Why won't his people ever learn to listen?.

dag: Ɛhab bia Izraɛl Naa Jɔram ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaayi saha, ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔram bia Ahazia gba daa di nam.
en: Ahaziah, the son of Judahs king Jehoram, became king in the twelfth year of Israels King Joram, Ahabs son.

dag: N tizɔpaɣa ni n daamiliya, a gbaai n suhu. A nina lihibu min a nyiŋgokɔrigu yabiɛlim yini chɛ ka a gbaai n suhu.
en: My darling, my bride, you excite me! You have stolen my heart with just one quick look from your eyes, with just one of the jewels from your necklace.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa tim tuumba Kiriatijiarimnim sani ti yɛli ba, Filistianim labisi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la na, kamiyana ti kpuɣi li.
en: They sent messengers to the people of Kiriath Jearim to say, The Philistines have returned the Lord 's Covenant Box. Come down and get it.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ sunsuuni, ka lan me binwɔɣinli zali bɛ tintariga ka di teeri ba Yawɛ yɛla.
en: When that time comes, there will be an altar to the Lord in the land of Egypt and a stone pillar dedicated to him at the Egyptian border.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbaamiya yimaŋa ni yɛliwumsa, dama ŋunkam mali ni lan nya m-pahi, ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni tɛhi ni o mali shɛl la.
en: So think carefully about what you are hearing. The people who have some understanding will receive more. But those who do not have understanding will lose even what they think they have.

dag: Yi ni so shiri zaŋd o mabia tahiri sariakaritiba bɛn pa Yisa yɛdaniŋdiba sani ni bɛ ti kari ba saria?.
en: Instead, one Christian goes to court against another and lets unbelievers judge the case!.

dag: Miri ka a ʒiɛhi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo. Zom yi zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni.
en: Dont deviate a bit to the right or the left; turn your feet away from evil.

dag: o daa yɛli ma mi, Daadam, n timd a la Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba bɛn taai duŋ niŋ ma ŋɔ sani. Bɛ mini bɛ yaannim pun birigi n sani zaŋ na hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: He said, Son of man, I am sending you to speak to the family of Israel. Those people and their ancestors turned against me many times. They have sinned against me many times—and they are still sinning against me today.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim, a wuhiri ba ni a nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi, a wuhiri ba ni a nyɛla ŋun ka galimi.
en: O Lord , you are faithful to those who are faithful to you; completely good to those who are perfect.

dag: Di saha maa Hɛbɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛn nir la daa woligimi ka chɛ Kɛnnim bɛn daa nyɛ Hɔbab, Musa deemba daŋ niriba la, ka zaŋ o tanti yi kpaŋ ha ti kpa Zaananim oki tia la gbini miri Kɛdɛshi.
en: In the meantime Heber the Kenite had set up his tent close to Kedesh near the oak tree at Zaanannim. He had moved away from the other Kenites, the descendants of Hobab, the brother-in-law of Moses.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Aŋgo zɔnim ni fabili aŋgo ni be bɛ sani saha shɛli? Amaa saha kanna ka bɛ ni ti yihi aŋgo maa bɛ sani, di saha maa ka bɛ ni ti lo noli.
en: Jesus responded, The wedding guests cant mourn while the groom is still with them, can they? But the days will come when the groom will be taken away from them, and then theyll fast.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni yi ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro bee kawaan chimda bee zaɣ maha hal ni dindali maa, naɣila yi ti zaŋ Naawuni sara maligu maa na pɔi. Di nyɛla zaligu sahakam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa yi ni be.
en: I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change.

dag: Ka Jɔtam daa niŋ wɔɣirili, dama o daa doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa soli.
en: Jotham grew powerful because he faithfully obeyed the Lord his God.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya niriba maa daa zaŋ dari binnani zali ni bɛ jɛmdi li. Ka Jɔnatan ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛrishom bia ni Musa yaaŋa la min o bidibisi daa nyɛ bɛ maligumaaniba di saha maa zaŋ hal ti paai dahin shɛli bɛ ni daa kana ti gbahi ba chaŋ ti leei daba la.
en: The Danites set up the sculpted image for themselves, and Jonathan son of Gershom and grandson of Moses, and his sons became priests for the Danite tribe until the land went into exile.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa chaŋ Yisifu sani ti yɛl o, N dana, n suhir a, chɛ ka mani a dabili ŋɔ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛli niŋ a tibili ni, a mi di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi mani a dabili ŋɔ zuɣu, dama a ŋmanila Firawuna maŋmaŋa.
en: Judah approached him and said, Please, my master, allow your servant to say something to my master without getting angry with your servant since you are like Pharaoh himself.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni; n ni duh a ka paɣ a yuli. A ʒiɛyimtali puuni, a pal a ni daa pun lo nia shɛŋa kurimbuni ha, ka di mali alahiziba la.
en: Lord , you are my God; I will honor you and praise your name. You have done amazing things; you have faithfully carried out the plans you made long ago.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli, Bilimmiya kuɣ kara ti ŋari voli maa noli, ka bo niriba zali di gbini ka bɛ gul li.
en: Joshua answered, Roll some big stones over the mouth of the cave and leave a few soldiers to guard it.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, saha kanna, ka n ni ti ŋme tɔbuchiriga bahi Raba din nyɛ Ammɔnim tiŋ la zuɣu. Di ni ti zani dabari, ka buɣim di di tiŋkpansi. Di saha ka Izraɛlnim mi ti kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kari ba la. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But the time is coming when I will make the people of the capital city of Rabbah hear the noise of battle, and it will be left in ruins and its villages burned to the ground. Then Israel will take its land back from those who took it from them.

dag: Yi bundaannim nyɛla duŋtaariba, ka yi niriba nyɛ ʒiŋmariba, ka yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa be bɛ noya ni.
en: in a city whose wealthy are full of violence and whose inhabitants speak falsehood with lying tongues in their mouths?.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ o nuu tim o koligu ni yihi kuɣili niŋ o kuɣilɔŋ ni n-zaŋ labi Filistia doo maa gbɛɣu, ka kuɣili maa chaŋ ti firi o gbɛɣu maa ni, ka o lu m-pil o puli zuɣu, ka o nini kpa tiŋa.
en: He put a rock in his sling and swung the sling around by its straps. When he let go of one strap, the rock flew out and hit Goliath on the forehead. It cracked his skull, and he fell facedown on the ground.

dag: Yinim wuntizɔriba, maliya suhupiɛlli Yawɛ sani, ka paɣ o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ!.
en: You are the Lord 's people! So celebrate and praise the only God.

dag: Ka di chaŋ wula ka nandahima mali ma pam? Di chaŋ wula ka n suhu kul zɔhira? N ni mali tahima Naawuni sani, dama n ni ti lan paɣ o yaha. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n sɔŋsim ni n Naawuni.
en: Why am I so sad? Why am I so troubled? I will put my hope in God, and once again I will praise him, my savior and my God.

dag: A tizɔpaɣ yurigu la bihi puhir a.
en: Your chosen sisters children greet you.

dag: Ram ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛramiil bituuli san la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Maaz mini Jamin ni Ɛkɛr.
en: Jerahmeels first son, Ram, had sons. They were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

dag: ka fara lu a zuɣu kaman ŋmɛnditol la, ka fakari lu a zuɣu kaman tɔbbia ŋun gbibi bidibbina la.
en: But then you sleep and sleep and become poorer and poorer. Soon you will have nothing. It will be as if a thief came and stole everything you owned.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ lzraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Babilɔn ŋmanila chi bubu saha kabɔɣili; di kpalim biɛla ka o daatam kpuɣibu saha paai.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful, the God of the people of Israel, says: Babylon is like a threshing floor, where people beat the grain at harvest time. And the time to beat Babylon is coming soon.

dag: Dama n ni daa yihi yi yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na dahin shɛl la, n daa bi yɛli ba shɛli bee n-zali ba zaligu zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini sara maligunim polo.
en: At the time I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I didn't command them to offer sacrifices to me.

dag: Chamiya Mirataim tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Chamiya ti liri ba, ka liri Pɛkɔdnima n-ku bɛ zaa. Niŋmiya n ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam zaa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Attack the land of Merathaim; crush those living in Pekod. Ruin and destroy them, declares the LORD; do all I have commanded you.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Di karitiya tab saria ka Naawuni ti ku kari yi gba saria;.
en: Do not judge others, so that God will not judge you.

dag: Ka n daa nya binshɛli o shee ni zaŋ du zuɣusaa polo ka di be kaman daanya din nyaɣisira la, ka be kaman buɣim n-gili o luɣilikam zaa la. Ka n daa nya o shee tiŋli polo ka di ŋmanila buɣim. Ka neesim din ne pam daa ne n-gili o.
en: From the waist up, it was glowing like metal in a hot furnace, and from the waist down it looked like the flames of a fire. The figure was surrounded by a bright light.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛsta daa boli Hatak ŋun daa nyɛ nayili namɔɣili so naa ni daa zaŋ ti o ni o sɔŋd o la na nti yɛl o ni o cham ti bɔhi Mɔdɛkai nya din niŋ o ni din tahi lala na.
en: Then Esther called Hathach, one of the kings eunuchs who had been chosen to serve her. She commanded him to find out what was bothering Mordecai, and why.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka bɛ duɣi chuɣu bindir suma, ka bo wain kura mini bindir suma din mali kpam ni wain shɛli bɛ ni te viɛnyɛliŋga n-ti zuliya kam zaa zoli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: On this mountain, the LORD of heavenly forces will prepare for all peoples a rich feast, a feast of choice wines, of select foods rich in flavor, of choice wines well refined.

dag: Ti bɔri ni a vii sagbana ka siɣina. Ka zoya nya a, ka dabiɛm gbaai li ka di sɔhigi.
en: If only you would tear open the heavens and come down! Mountains would quake before you.

dag: O nyɛla tampiŋ ŋun ka ŋmali. O tuma nyɛla din viɛl zaa, ka o soya zaa nyɛ din tuhi. O nyɛla Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim ka ka galimi. O nyɛla ŋun bebu tuhi ka be tibi.
en: The rock: his acts are perfection! No doubt about it: all his ways are right! Hes the faithful God, never deceiving; altogether righteous and true is he.

dag: N ni yɛl a wuntia tuma min a tiliginsim yɛla dabisili puuni zaa hal n ni ku tooi baŋ di kalinli maa zaa yoli.
en: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yaannim daa yi tin shɛŋa din dolina ŋɔ ni gba daa lab kuli: Bɛtilihɛm — kɔbiga ni pisinaata.
en: from the town of Bethlehem:.

dag: So yi tɛhi ni o mi shɛli, o na bi mi di ni simdi ni o mi shɛli gba.
en: Those who think they know something really don't know as they ought to know.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Cham Firawuna sani, dama mani n-chɛ ka o min o kpambaliba zaa suhuri kpɛma ni di chɛ ka n tum alahiziba tuma ŋɔ bɛ sani.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Go to Pharaoh. I have made him and his officials stubborn. I did this so that I could show them my powerful miracles.

dag: N ni yɛl a wuntia yɛla dabisi muni puuni dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo ni bɛ niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu la di vi ka nya filiŋ.
en: I will speak of your righteousness all day long, because those who tried to harm me have been defeated and disgraced.

dag: Bɛ ŋmaligi jɛmdila buɣili Baal ka chɛ ma; bɛ ŋmanila tɔb shɛli din ka naani niŋbu. Bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛ kpamba zaa bɛ yɛtɔɣ yoya zuɣu. Ka dimbɔŋɔ ti leei bɛ daansarisi malibo Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: and refuse to obey. They are more useless than a crooked arrow. Their leaders will die in war for saying foolish things. Egyptians will laugh at them.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ yɛri din viɛli, ka nyɛ bɛ ni mali shɛli nyuri bara la m-mali binnana din chihira ka nyɛ n ni je binshɛŋa la. Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka di leei binshɛli din nyɛ daɣiri bɛ sani.
en: Once they were proud of their beautiful jewels, but they used them to make disgusting idols. That is why the Lord has made their wealth repulsive to them.

dag: Alizin biɛɣu yi zo ka chɛ nira, alizin biɛɣu maa chanimi nti be kom ni bi dooni luɣ shɛŋa polo m-bɔri vuhim shee ka bi nyara. Di saha maa o yɛrimi, N ni lan labi m biɛr kurili shee.
en: When an evil spirit goes out of a person, it travels over dry country looking for a place to rest. If it can't find one, it says to itself, I will go back to my house.

dag: Di lan yɛli: Kuɣili maa nyɛla kuɣ shɛli din ni chɛ ka niriba tuui; di lan nyɛla kuɣ shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ tuui lu. Din chɛ ka bɛ tuui lu maa nyɛla bɛ ni bi niŋ Naawuni yɛligu yɛda la zuɣu, ka di mi nyɛla Naawuni ni zal li shɛm m-bala.
en: They disobeyed the message and stumbled and fell over this stone, because they were doomed.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, n suhir a, tiligim ti o nuu ni, ka di chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam nanim baŋ ni nyin Yawɛ kɔŋko n-nyɛ Naawuni.
en: So now, LORD our God, please save us from Sennacheribs power! Then all the earths kingdoms will know that you, LORD, are the only true God.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Karimba, m pun dolila dimbɔŋɔnim zaa m bilim ni hal ni wayo.
en: The man said, Teacher, I have obeyed all these commands since I was a boy.

dag: Bi so ŋun mali yɛm tir o ba suhupiɛlli, amaa bi so ŋun nyɛ jɛrigu tirila o ma suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: These are the proverbs of Solomon: A wise son makes his father happy; a foolish one makes his mother sad.

dag: Din tuhi niŋbu n-yɛn nyɛ di buɣisibu vulo, ka yɛlimaŋli nyɛ di bimbuɣisirigu. Sanʒiɛɣu ni ʒe yi ni niŋ ʒiri shɛli yɛda la bahi, ka kokpɛɣu mi ʒi yi ni niŋ yɛda ni binshɛli ni tiligi ya la chaŋ.
en: Justice will be the measuring line for the foundation, and honesty will be its plumb line. Hailstorms will sweep away all the lies you depend on, and floods will destroy your security.

dag: Ka tihi maa daa chɛ ka yɛli fiig tia, Ti bɔri ni nyini n-leei ti naa.
en: Then the trees said to the fig tree, You come and be our king.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yuli bɛ zaa ti tuui taba ka yɛli doo maa, Teem a nuu maa. Ka o teei li, ka di dii kpaŋ zaa.
en: He looked around at them all; then he said to the man, Stretch out your hand. He did so, and his hand became well again.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Agiripa daa yɛli Pool, M bah a noli ni a tɔɣisi zabi amaŋ zuɣu. Ka Pool daa teeg o nuu ka piligi tɔɣisiri ni o chih omaŋ noli yɛra.
en: Agrippa said to Paul, You may now speak to defend yourself. Paul raised his hand to get their attention and began to speak.

dag: O yi nyaŋ ma ku ma, dindina ti ni leei yi daba, amaa ka m mi yi nyaŋ o ku o, yi gba ni leei ti daba tumdi ti tuma.
en: If he is able to fight me and kill me, then we will become your slaves, but if I overcome him and kill him, then you will become our slaves and you will serve us.

dag: Naawuni daa nya Sɔdom mini Gomɔra tinsi la nim taali, ka daa zaŋ buɣim bahi ba yoli wuliwuli, ka di wuhi din ti yɛn niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi luri Naawuni sizuura.
en: God also punished the evil cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. He burned them until there was nothing left but ashes. He used those cities as an example of what will happen to people who are against God.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Again the Lord spoke to me and said.

dag: N ni zaŋ wumpaɣibo sara ti Yawɛ, ka jɛm o.
en: I will give you a thank offering. I will call on the Lord s name.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa mali tahima zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani ŋɔ, maliya kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni.
en: Be strong, be courageous, all you that hope in the Lord .

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu Naawuni zaligubaŋda kam ŋun bɔhim alizanda nam yɛla m-baŋ li viɛnyɛliŋga ŋmanila yil yidan so ŋun bi kɔŋdi bin pala mini bin kura o nɛma ni.
en: Then he said to them, Therefore, every legal expert who has been trained as a disciple for the kingdom of heaven is like the head of a household who brings old and new things out of their treasure chest.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ tia maa, ka yi mi nyɛ di wula; ŋun kul tuɣ ma ka n gba tuɣ o, ŋuna n-wandi wala pam; dama yi yi bi tuɣ ma, yi ku tooi niŋ shɛli.
en: I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, then you will produce much fruit. Without me, you cant do anything.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, N wuhirila niriba palɔni, ka kul wuhiri Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni luɣ shɛŋa Yɛhudianim ni laɣindi la. N na ʒi n-yɛli shɛli ashilɔni.
en: Jesus answered, Ive spoken openly to the world. Ive always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where all the Jews gather. Ive said nothing in private.

dag: Ka salo daa baŋ ka kar o naba; ka o daa ti puhi ba ni bɛ paabuna, ka tɔɣisi ba Naawuni nam yɛla, ka tib barinim bɛn daa be bɛ ni.
en: When the crowds figured it out, they followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them about Gods kingdom, and healed those who were sick.

dag: Amaa dɔbba pia daa be bɛ ni ka yɛli Ishimail, Di ku ti, dama ti mali alikama mini chi ni kpam ni shiri ka di sɔɣi mɔri ni. Dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ba, ka bi ku ba pahi bɛ tab maa zuɣu.
en: He let ten of the men live, because they offered to give him supplies of wheat, barley, olive oil, and honey they had hidden in a field.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan bɔhi, Bimbɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ ŋmahindi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba? Bɛ lee ŋmanila bɔ?.
en: What shall I say about the people of this time? What can I compare them to? What are they like?.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni ti chɛ ka yi nya alahiziba binyara kaman yi ni daa yi Ijipti na, ka n chɛ ka yi nya li shɛm la.
en: As in the days when you came out of the land of Egypt, I will show Israel wonderful things.

dag: Ŋunkam kpɛri kuɣa ni nya daŋ di ni, ka ŋunkam mi wɔriti dari ni be di daŋ nyabu barina ni.
en: If you are moving large stones, you might be hurt by them. If you cut down a tree, you are in danger of it falling on you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yiɣis o suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu pam ka ŋmaligi chaŋ.
en: The Lord became angry with Aaron and Miriam. And after the Lord left.

dag: O yirimina kaman tipum la, ka lan kpi, o vuurila yomyom kaman shilinshia la, o bi yuura.
en: We grow and wither as quickly as flowers; we disappear like shadows.

dag: Wuntizɔra ba ni mali suhupiɛlli pam; ŋunkam dɔɣi bi so ŋun mali yɛm ni mali suhupiɛlli o zuɣu.
en: The father of the righteous will be very happy; the one who gives life to the wise will rejoice.

dag: ka bi nahindi saamba mini kpibisi ni pakoya bee n-kuri bɛn ka taali kpe, ka bi jɛmdi buɣa din nyɛ barina zaŋ chaŋ yi sani ŋɔ.
en: Stop taking advantage of aliens, orphans, and widows. Stop killing innocent people in this land. Stop worshiping other gods, for that will destroy you.

dag: O daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulana la yuun pisinaata. Ka o daa ti kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Shamir.
en: Tola was a judge for the Israelites for years. Then he died and was buried in the city of Shamir.

dag: Amaa o yi mali daŋa, ka di nyɛ dan titali, kaman o yi nyɛ napombara bee o yi nyɛ zoma, yin di zaŋy o mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: But if there is any defect in it, lameness, blindness, any flaw whatsoever, you must not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.

dag: Ŋ-ŋɔ ka Naawuni niŋ wuhi ni o yuri ti: O daa tim o Bi gaŋ na ni o ti chɛ ka ti nya nyɛvili o zuɣu.
en: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.

dag: N tiliginsim mini n jilima yirila Naawuni sanna; ŋuna n-nyɛ n gula ni n ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: My deliverance and glory depend on God. God is my strong rock. My refuge is in God.

dag: M bolila do so ni o yi wulimpuhili polo kana. O yɛn kabimina kaman suligu la nti niŋ n ni lo ni n niŋ shɛli. Mani n yɛli maa, ka di mi shiri ni niŋ lala.
en: I am calling a man from the east to do what I want. He will come like an eagle from a faraway country. He will do all that I have planned. Everything I said will happen just as I said it would.

dag: Amaa ka Iso daa guuina ti tuh o soli m-bɔb gbaag o n-zaŋ o zuɣu ti pa o nyingol zuɣu m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ka bɛ zaa dii kuhira.
en: But Esau ran to meet him, threw his arms around his neck, kissed him, and they wept.

dag: O daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim siɣi teeku puuni n-chaŋ du. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.

dag: Jɛsi daa nyɛla Ɛliab ba. Ɛliab n-daa nyɛ o bituuli, ka ŋun daa pa o zuɣu nyɛ Abinadab, ka ŋun pahi ata daa nyɛ Shimia.
en: Jesse was Eliabs father. Eliab was Jesses first son. Jesses second son was Abinadab. His third son was Shimea.

dag: ka kuhi pam kaman gbuɣinli ni yi ŋum shɛm la. O ni daa kuhi maa, ka satahins ayopɔin tahi.
en: He called out with a loud voice like a lion roaring, and when he called out, the seven thunders raised their voices.

dag: ka din pahi pisinaata gbaai Dɛlaiya, ka din pahi pisinaanahi gbaai Maazia.
en: The twenty-third was Delaiahs group. The twenty-fourth was Maaziahs group.

dag: Ti ni daa mali ti yaɣi Kilikia mini Pamfilia teeku noya zuɣu, ti daa paala Maira din be Lisia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: We went across the sea by Cilicia and Pamphylia. Then we came to the city of Myra in Lycia.

dag: Ka n ni pii ninvuɣ so jaaŋgbee ni puhi vari. Lala ka n yɛn niŋ ka Izraɛlnim chɛ bɛ kparima ni ŋumbu shɛli bɛ ni ŋumdi niŋdi ya sahakam maa.
en: The staff of the person I choose will sprout. Then I will rid myself of the Israelites complaints that they make against you.

dag: Jɛzibɛl daa sabimi yɛli gbana maa ni, Molimiya molo ni sokam lom noli, ka chɛ ka bɛ laɣimna ka yi ti chɛ ka Nabɔt ʒini jilima ʒiishee.
en: This is what the letter said: Announce that there will be a day of fasting when the people will eat nothing. Then call all the people of the town together for a meeting. At the meeting we will talk about Naboth.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din beni nyɛla bɛ ni pun zali shɛli, ka ninsalinim biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm bi sɔɣi. Ka bɛ mi ku tooi ŋme ŋun gari ba kpiɔŋ naŋgbankpeeni.
en: Everything that happens was already determined long ago, and we all know that you cannot argue with someone who is stronger than you.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa na kul kaɣ ʒe kpaŋ maa, ka Musa daa chaŋ miri Naawuni ni daa be sagban sabili shɛli ni maa.
en: The people stood at a distance while Moses approached the thick darkness in which God was present.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ daba ayi ka Pool yɛli Baanabas, Chɛ ka ti lab tin shɛŋa ni ti ni daa moli ti Duuma yɛligu molo la nti kaai ti mabihi bɛn be nimaani maa n-nya bɛ ni be shɛm.
en: A few days later, Paul said to Barnabas, We should go back to all the towns where we told people the message of the Lord. We should visit the believers to see how they are doing.

dag: ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka o bol o yuli Ɛr.
en: and they had three sons. He named the first one Er;.

dag: Zatu daŋ ni: Ɛliɔnai mini Ɛliashib so ni Matania so mi ni Jɛrɛmɔt so gba ni Zabad ni Aziza.
en: Of the family of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.

dag: O yi vihi ya, di ni viɛl yi zuɣu? Bee yi ni tooi yɔhim o kaman niriba ni yɔhindi tab shɛm la?.
en: Will it go well when he searches you, or can you fool him as you fool people?.

dag: Nyin Ɛdom bipuɣiŋga ŋun be Uzi ŋɔ, kul lam ni suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni zaŋ pipia maa ti a gba, ka a gba nyu n-kuli, ka pirig a zaɣim.
en: You people of Edom can celebrate now! But your time will come to suffer and stagger around naked.

dag: Amaa maligumaana Zadok mini Bɛnaaya Jɛhɔiada bia la ni anabi Neetan ni Shimɛi ni Rɛi ni Dauda ninvuɣ kpɛma la daa ka Adɔnija polo.
en: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and David's bodyguards all refused.

dag: M bia wumma, deemi n yɛligu ka nya nyɛvili wɔɣinli.
en: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.

dag: Ka ŋunkam suh a, nyin tim o; ka ŋun bɔri ni a paŋ o binshɛli, nyin paŋm o.
en: When someone asks you for something, give it to him; when someone wants to borrow something, lend it to him.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani; ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa Jɛrɔbɔam Nɛbat bia la ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la.
en: He disobeyed the Lord and caused the Israelites to sin, just as Jeroboam son of Nebat had done.

dag: ka mi bi simdi ni o ka Yisa sanna. Amaa ni o kul yɛlim yɛtɔɣ shɛli o ni yɛn yɛli ka o dabili maa kpaŋ.
en: That is why I did not come to you myself. You need only to give the order, and my servant will be healed.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Taai, nyama, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa. N ni chɛ ka tinsi pam kana ti lir a kaman teeku ni chɛ ka kɔgbana yiɣiri luri shɛm la.
en: The LORD God now proclaims: Tyre, Im now against you! Just as the sea hurls up its waves, I will bring many nations up against you.

dag: Ka di ti kpalimla omaŋmaŋ biyurigu ko, ka o ti bahi tim o gba bɛ sani ka yɛli, Bɛ ni ti ti m bia maa ŋun jilima.
en: The owner had a son he loved very much. Finally, he sent his son to the renters because he thought they would respect him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Taai polo m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ yi ti kuri niriba a puuni, ka bɛn dɛhi dansi la ŋuhira, ka bɛ ti daag a luhi, a lubu damli ni ti sɔhigi tin shɛŋa din ʒe teeku duli.
en: The people of the nations up and down the coast will shudder when they hear your screams and moans of death.

dag: Amaa man ŋuna, n pun naai Iso zuliya zaa, ka yihi ba bɛ sɔɣisili shee, ka bɛ ku tooi lan sɔɣi. O bihi min o dɔɣiriba ni o ʒiʒiinitaba bahi yoli ka so lan kani.
en: But me? I will strip Esau bare. I will expose his hiding places, and he will find no place to take cover. His offspring, family, and acquaintances will perish, and there will be no one left to say.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bia, mali yaa anfaan shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni la zuɣu.
en: Timothy, you are a son to me. Be strong in the grace that we have because we belong to Christ Jesus.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmiya siɣa, ka teeya ni yuun muna ata ka n zaŋ saɣisi yi zaa ha ni nintam yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni.
en: Be on your guard! Remember how day and night for three years I kept warning you with tears in my eyes.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita mabia Anduru ŋun daa nyɛ Yisa nyaandoliba maa ni yino la yɛli Yisa.
en: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the disciples. He spoke up and said.

dag: N naan shiri yiɣi chaŋ katiŋa nti be mɔɣu ni.
en: I would fly far away and make my home in the desert.

dag: N kul malila suhupiɛlli a yɛligu zuɣu kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun ŋme n-di nɛma pam.
en: Your word makes me happy, like someone who has found a great treasure.

dag: ka yi yɛn zaŋ nahu bee biŋkɔbbila mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la bee alikauli palibu sara bee suhuyubu sara bee yi churi puhibu sara shɛŋa yi ni yɛn mali ka di ʒiɛɣu niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim la.
en: you must give special gifts to the Lord . Their smell will please the Lord . You will use your cattle, sheep, and goats for burnt offerings, sacrifices, special promises, special gifts, fellowship offerings, or at your special festivals.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ taaya n-yɔri vuri, ka di vuri kaman teeku vubu la. Aa, niriba maa yɔrila vuri, ka di vuri kaman kom pam vubu la.
en: The nations are a noisy, thunderous sea.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi, n ku lan nyu tiwala kom ŋɔ naɣila dahin shɛli ka m mini ya ni ti lan laɣim nyu di zaɣ palli m Ba Naawuni nam ni.
en: I tell you, I will never again drink this wine until the day I drink the new wine with you in my Father's Kingdom.

dag: Di yi nyɛla n daa birigila soli maa zuɣu, ka chɛ ka n suhu ye n nina ni nya binshɛŋa zuɣu, ka daɣ shɛli yi be n nuhi ni.
en: If I have turned from the right path or let myself be attracted to evil, if my hands are stained with sin.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi yɛn ti nandaamba pini, nyin di mooni li kaman bilikɔɣinim ni niŋdi shɛm Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni mini pala zuɣu ni niriba nyari ba m-paɣiri ba la. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛn pun nya bɛ laara.
en: So when you give something to a needy person, do not make a big show of it, as the hypocrites do in the houses of worship and on the streets. They do it so that people will praise them. I assure you, they have already been paid in full.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti Ifriim zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: bɛ tiŋgbani maa piligu shee daa kpuɣila Atarɔtada wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ hal ni Bɛtihɔrɔn Duli polo.
en: This was the territory of the Ephraimite families: their border ran from Ataroth Addar eastward to Upper Beth Horon.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka n ni baŋ ni a nini tiɣi ma. Dina n-nyɛ: a bi chɛ ka n dimnim nyaŋ ma.
en: They will not triumph over me, and I will know that you are pleased with me.

dag: Di saha ka Pita daa bɔhi Yisa, Ti Duuma, tinim ka a lee ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ bee sokam zaa.
en: Peter said, Lord, does this parable apply to us, or do you mean it for everyone.

dag: Ka Zilipa ŋun daa nyɛ Liya dabipaɣ la mi bidibisi daa nyɛ Gaad mini Asha. Yaakubu ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb Mɛsopoteemia m-bala.
en: The sons of Zilpah, Leahs servant, were Gad and Asher. These were Jacobs sons born to him in Paddan-aram.

dag: Ka Isaka zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaanahi ni kɔbisinahi.
en: The total number of men counted from the tribe of Issachar was .

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa lo nia biɛri ni yi saɣim yi tab la, yi nia biɛri maa ni ŋmaligi din ya. Man Yawɛ ni chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ niŋ ya. Yi bahigu ti ku viɛla.
en: All of you that plot to destroy others will be destroyed by your own plots. The Lord himself will make this happen; you will suffer a miserable fate.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba maa daa saɣi ni bɛ ku lan deei liɣiri niriba maa sani; ka lan saɣi ni bɛn maligumaaniba maa ku mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: The priests agreed to this and also agreed not to make the repairs in the Temple.

dag: Miri ka a fa nandaamba nɛma bɛ ni nyɛ nandaamba zuɣu bee m-muɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn diri wahala dunɔdali ni;.
en: It is easy to steal from the poor, but dont do it. And dont take advantage of them in court.

dag: Nyamiya, n zaŋla alibarika mini noli dibu zali ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ:.
en: Today I am giving you the choice between a blessing and a curse—.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛli ba, Bomiya la palli n-niŋ yalim niŋ di ni ti ma na. Ka bɛ daa bo li na ti ti o.
en: Elisha said, Bring me a new bowl and put salt in it. They brought the bowl to Elisha.

dag: Ka so yi mali niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa, bɛn zaŋm o ka maligumaana sanna.
en: Any of you with a skin disease must be brought to a priest.

dag: Nir yi zɔri o taba dabiɛm, di nyɛla zana, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ Yawɛ naani ni yi yɛla ni.
en: Don't fall into the trap of being a coward— trust the Lord , and you will be safe.

dag: Leeban ni daa wum o tizɔpaɣ bia Yaakubu yɛla maa, ka o guui ka o sanna nti bɔb gbaag o m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ka zaŋ o kul o yiŋa. Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Leeban binshɛlikam zaa.
en: When Laban heard the news about his sisters son Jacob, he ran to meet him. Laban hugged him and kissed him and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban everything that had happened.

dag: Jɔn daa yɛrila laakum kɔbiri binyɛrigu, ka mali gbaŋ lɔr o shee ni, ka o bindirigu daa nyɛla toli mini shiri.
en: John wore clothes made of camel's hair. He had a leather strap around his waist and ate grasshoppers and wild honey.

dag: Ka o daa ti ba bɛ ni suhi shɛli, amaa ka daa chɛ ka dɔr biɛri gbahi ba.
en: so he gave them what they asked for, but also sent a terrible disease among them.

dag: ka hal ti ni daa nyɛ bɛn kpi ti nɔzaɣisibo zuɣu la, o daa neei ti mini Masia kum ni. Naawuni daanfaani zuɣu ka yi tiligi.
en: However, God is rich in mercy. He brought us to life with Christ while we were dead as a result of those things that we did wrong. He did this because of the great love that he has for us. You are saved by Gods grace!.

dag: N dabisa maa zɔrimi gariti kaman ŋariŋ shɛli din zɔri pam la, di chanimi kaman tɔrili ni yi silim na ni o ti to binnɛɔŋ shɛm la.
en: My life passes like the swiftest boat, as fast as an eagle swooping down on a rabbit.

dag: Di ni ti leei teeku sunsuuni luɣ shɛli bɛ ni deeni lansi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. Di ni leei niriba ni yɛn ŋmɛri diri nɛma luɣ shɛli.
en: where fishermen can dry their nets along the coast. I promise that you will be robbed.

dag: Ka Maata daa paai Yisa sani ti yɛl o, N Duuma, a yi di daa be ya ŋɔ, n tizɔdoo ŋɔ daa naan ku kpi;.
en: Martha said to Jesus, Lord, if you had been here, my brother wouldnt have died.

dag: Naawuni m-mi di shee, ka mi di soli ni be shɛli.
en: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;.

dag: Farisiinim bɛn yuri liɣiri pam la ni daa wum Yisa ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɛ maan o ansarisi.
en: When the Pharisees heard all this, they made fun of Jesus, because they loved money.

dag: N tuumbiɛri mini n daalahichi lee nyɛla diba ala? Chɛ ka m baŋ m biriginsim mini n daalahichi.
en: Please point out my sins, so I will know them.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ binnɛma balibu kam zaɣ lɔɣu ni zaɣ nyaŋ niŋ a sani ŋariŋ maa ni, ka lala niŋbu chɛ ka bɛ tiligi.
en: Also, you will take two of every living thing on the earth with you into the boat. Take a male and female of every kind of animal so that they might survive with you.

dag: N daa sabi gbaŋ ti cheechi na; amaa ka Diɔtrifiiz ŋun bɔri ni o nyɛ bɛ toondan la bi lihi ma ni m mali yiko zaŋ chaŋ n ni yɛli shɛm maa polo.
en: I wrote a short letter to the church; but Diotrephes, who likes to be their leader, will not pay any attention to what I say.

dag: Dama o suhuyiɣisili bi yuura, ka o nyɛ ŋun kul niŋdi alibarika niŋdi niriba ni sahakam. Di pa shɛli kuhigu ni beni yuŋ, amaa ka suhupiɛlli mi be biɛɣ neebu ni.
en: His anger lasts for only a second, but his favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay all night, but by morning, joy!.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila taba, Zahin zahinda la n-kanna ŋɔ.
en: They said to one another, Look, here comes the hero of those dreams!.

dag: Amaa Sirianim maa ni daa nya ka Izraɛlnim tuhi nyaŋ ba maa, ka bɛ laɣim taba.
en: The Arameans realized they had lost the battle, so they brought all their troops together again.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Bɛ bi kɔhirila jahinjɛya anu kɔbo? Naawuni mi bi tamdi bɛ ni yino yɛla.
en: Arent five sparrows sold for two small coins?Yet not one of them is overlooked by God.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa shiri zaŋ chɛribo kuɣa mali pilima n-guni Izraɛlnim luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Gibiatihaaralɔt la.
en: So Joshua made flint knives for himself. He circumcised the Israelites at Foreskins Hill.

dag: Yawɛ, a mi binshɛɣukam, teemi n yɛla, ka sɔŋ ma, ka bɔhi bɛn niŋdi ma alaka ŋɔ biɛri ti ma. Di di suɣilo hal ka bɛ ti di n nyɛvili. Baŋmi ni a zuɣu ka bɛ turi ma maa.
en: Then I said, Lord , you understand. Remember me and help me. Let me have revenge on those who persecute me. Do not be so patient with them that they succeed in killing me. Remember that it is for your sake that I am insulted.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣa maa daa gari Mariama pam ka o bɔhir o suhu, ka bɔ puhigu n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: Mary was confused by the angel's words and wondered what they meant.

dag: Zimiri daa ku Baasha daŋ niriba maa zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka anabi Jɛhu yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Naa Baasha polo la.
en: So Zimri destroyed Baashas family just as the Lord said he would when he spoke against Baasha through the prophet Jehu.

dag: Wulinluhili polo tintariga nti yɛn nyɛ Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku noli zaŋ hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din be Lɛbɔhamat samban ni. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ wulinluhili polo yaɣili.
en: For the western limit, the Mediterranean Sea is the boundary up to Lebo-hamath. This is the western limit.

dag: Aruna daa bela o kabɔɣili maa ni buri alikama, ka daa ti ŋmaligi lihi nya malaika maa, ka o bidibis anahi bɛn daa be o sani daa zo n-sɔɣi.
en: Araunah and his four sons were threshing wheat at the time, and when they saw the angel, the four sons ran to hide.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o tɔb nɛma maa ti niŋ bɛ buɣ shɛli jɛmbu duu, ka daa zaŋ o zuɣu maa ti yili bɛ buɣili Dagɔn jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: The Philistines put Sauls armor in the temple of their false gods. They hung Sauls head in the temple of Dagon.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yɛtɔɣ yoya yiri yi noya ni na naɣila din kpaŋsiri niriba suhuri, ka di ni niŋ bɛnkam zaa wum li anfaani.
en: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.

dag: ni ninsalinim tuhi pinaayɔbu.
en: and , humans.

dag: O vuhim pɔhim daa ʒe n-neei zuɣusaa, ka o daa zaŋ o nuu kuhi wahu ŋun zɔri ni o tiligi.
en: His breath made the skies clear. His hand destroyed the snake that tried to get away.

dag: So shɛli beni ŋ-ŋmani din tuhi nir sani, amaa ka di bahigu ti nyɛla kum.
en: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.

dag: Ti ni daa puhi ba naai ka Pool kahigi Naawuni ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa yiniyini o waazu yihibu ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani yɛli ba.
en: Paul greeted them and gave a complete report of everything that God had done among the Gentiles through his work.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni di chɛ ka yi ku lan nyɛ bɛ daba, n kabi yi nyiŋgoya ni dapuhi la, ka chɛ ka yi tooi chana ka yi zuɣuri ʒe tibi.
en: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypts land—who brought you out from being Egypts slaves. I broke your bonds and made you stand up straight.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum kum ni neebu yɛla maa ka bɛ ni shɛb maani Pool ansarisi, ka shɛb mi yɛli ni dahin shɛli ka bɛ ni ti lan wum o yɛtɔɣa maa pahi.
en: As soon as the people heard Paul say a man had been raised from death, some of them started laughing. Others said, We will hear you talk about this some other time.

dag: A chɛ ka a niriba di wahala pam; a ti ti la wain ka ti nyu, ka di chɛ ka ti chani jeena.
en: You have given your people many troubles. We are dizzy and fall down like drunks.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ni nyɛ naa n-su dunia ŋɔ zaa. Dindali maa, Yawɛ yino nti yɛn be, ka o yuli gba nyɛ yu yini.
en: The LORD will become king over all the land. On that day the LORD will be one, and the LORDs name will be one.

dag: N ni niŋ a daŋ niriba kaman n ni daa niŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ niriba mini Ahija bia Baasha daŋ niriba shɛm la, a ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi, ka chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi la zuɣu.
en: I will make your household like that of Jeroboam, Nebats son, and like the household of Baasha, Ahijahs son, because of the way youve angered me and because youve made Israel sin.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o bidibiga bipuɣiŋga bee o bipuɣiŋga mi bipuɣiŋga dɔni, dama di nyɛla vi tuuni.
en: You must not have sexual relations with your granddaughter. It doesnt matter whether she is the daughter of your son or the daughter of your daughter—they are all a part of you!.

dag: ka n chɛ ka bɛ niŋ bindirigu tin ya na, yi ni ka mani yi dabili ŋɔ sani ŋɔ na zuɣu, di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi gari. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Niŋm a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Let me offer you a little bread so you will feel stronger, and after that you may leave your servant and go on your way—since you have visited your servant. They responded, Fine. Do just as you have said.

dag: Ka bɛnkam zaa daa wum li maa zaŋ li niŋ bɛ suhuri ni ka bɔhira, Bɔtaa nira n-lee ti yɛn nyɛ bia ŋɔ? Dama sokam daa baŋya ni ti Duuma zaɣa be o ni.
