en: Everyone who heard about this wondered what this child would grow up to be. They knew the Lord was with him.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa bol o bihi na nti yɛli ba, Laɣimmiya na ka n ti yɛli ya din ti yɛn niŋ ya dahin shɛli ha yɛla.
en: Jacob summoned his sons and said, Gather around so that I can tell you what will happen to you in the coming days.

dag: A je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣis a zaligunim dolibu. Bɛ yɔhiŋgu soya nyɛla yoli.
en: You reject all deceitful liars because they refuse your teachings.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun karindi anabitali yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wumdi li ka doli din sabi litaafi ŋɔ puuni mal alibarika, dama saha maa miriya.
en: Favored is the one who reads the words of this prophecy out loud, and favored are those who listen to it being read, and keep what is written in it, for the time is near.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa chaŋ Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, M ba mini m biɛyanim zaŋ bɛ piɛri mini bɛ niɣi ni bɛ ni su shɛlikam yi Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, bɛ be Goshɛn tiŋgban ni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Joseph went in to Pharaoh and said, My father and my brothers and all their families are here. They have all their animals and everything they own from the land of Canaan with them. They are now in the land of Goshen.

dag: Lɔt saha la gba, lala n-daa nyɛ li: Bɛ daa diri ka nyura; ka dari ka kɔhira; ka biriti ka mɛri yiya.
en: It will be the same as during the time of Lot, when God destroyed Sodom. Those people were eating, drinking, buying, selling, planting, and building houses for themselves.

dag: Yinim danyuriba, yiɣisimiya kum; yinim wain nyuriba zaa, kummiya wain nyaɣisili la zuɣu, dama yi noli ŋmaala di nyubu maa.
en: Wake up, you who drink too much, and weep. Scream over the sweet wine, all you wine drinkers, because it is snatched from your mouth.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, wain booriba kpɛm la daa tam Yisifu yɛla ka bi teeg o yɛla.
en: but the king's personal servant completely forgot about Joseph.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔhim ba biɛri, bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi tum tuun shɛŋa zaa zuɣu.
en: Pay them back for everything they have done, Lord !.

dag: So yi zaŋ o ni di tiŋgban shɛli fali yaɣ shɛli ti Yawɛ, dindina di daa yɛn dolila di ni yɛn tooi deei bimbira shɛm. Pal shɛli din ni biri siŋkaafa tah ayi daa ni nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu pihinu.
en: If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every kilograms of seed.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o ba, Mani a bituuli Iso. M pun niŋ a ni yɛli ma shɛm maa. Yiɣisim ʒini di m mɔɣu ni nimdi maa, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: Jacob replied, I am Esau, your first-born, and I have done what you told me. Please sit up and eat the meat I have brought. Then you can give me your blessing.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa yi Kadɛshi m-mali ti paai Hɔr Zoli gbini.
en: All the Israelites traveled from Kadesh to Mount Hor.

dag: Malaika ŋun daa yɛli ma lala maa daa malila salima jaaŋgbee din nyɛ o ni mali shɛli buɣisiri binyara ni o ti buɣisi tiŋ maa mini di dunoya ni di gooni la.
en: The angel who spoke to me had a gold measuring stick to measure the city, its gates, and its wall.

dag: Amaa o niŋgbuŋ din nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu ŋmahinli la yɛla ka o daa yɛri maa.
en: But the temple Jesus meant was his own body.

dag: M bi yi alizanda ni na ni n ti tumla mmaŋmaŋ yubu, amaa ŋun tim ma na maa yubu ka n kana ni n ti tum.
en: because I have come down from heaven to do not my own will but the will of him who sent me.

dag: A ni be alizanda ni a biɛhigu shee din be kasi ka mali jilima ŋɔ, lihim na nya. A baɣa ni daa yi be ti ni shɛm ni a yiko la lee kpalimla ya? A yurilim min a nambɔzɔbo la lan kani zaŋ kana ti sani.
en: Please, Lord , look down from your holy and glorious home in the heavens and see what's going on. Have you lost interest? Where is your power? Show that you care about us and have mercy!.

dag: amaa ka bɛ daa ti paai Yisa sani n-nya ka o pun kpimi, dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bi kabi ŋun gbaya.
en: When they came to Jesus, they saw that he was already dead so they didnt break his legs.

dag: O ni yih a muɣisigu ni, ka barina shɛli ku shih a saha shɛlikam.
en: From six adversities he will deliver you; from seven harm wont touch you.

dag: ni yi doli niriba ŋɔ tatabo niŋsim maa mini ŋunkam pahi bɛ zuɣu tumdi bɛ ni tumdi shɛm maa naba.
en: to follow the leading of people like these and others who work hard and serve together with them.

dag: Ka o lan tim so yaha, ka bɛ daa ti ku ŋuna. Ka o lan tim niriba pam pahi, ka bɛ ti fiɛb bɛ shɛba, ka ku bɛ gba ni shɛba.
en: He sent another one; that one they killed. The landlord sent many other servants, but the tenants beat some and killed others.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N ni chɛ ka n jilima zaa gar a tooni, ka m boli n yuli a tooni, Yawɛ. N ni bɔri ni n niŋ ninvuɣ so nirilim, n ni niŋ o nirilim. N ni lan bɔri ni n zo ninvuɣ so nambɔɣu, n ni zo o nambɔɣu.
en: The Lord answered: All right. I am the Lord , and I show mercy and kindness to anyone I choose. I will let you see my glory and hear my holy name.

dag: ka bindira balibu kam din nyɛ bɛ ni daa she shɛli ti Firawuna be piɛ shɛli din tam zuɣusaa ni, amaa ka noombihi lee kana ti diri li n zuɣu ni piɛri maa ni.
en: In the basket on top there were baked goods for Pharaohs food, but birds were eating them out of the basket on my head.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ daa chɛ ka Yawɛ ni daa lo Jɛhu alikauli shɛli yɛli, A bihi ni ti diri Izraɛl nam zaŋ hal ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahir anahi ni la niŋ pali.
en: So the promise was fulfilled which the Lord had made to King Jehu: Your descendants down to the fourth generation will be kings of Israel.

dag: Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Bɔ ka yi lee du m-ba ka na kul be ti ni teei gili Jɛrusalɛm shɛli ŋɔ puuni maa.
en: This is what Assyrias King Sennacherib says: What makes you so confident that you stay put in Jerusalem while it is being attacked?.

dag: Jɛra n-yɛri bɛ suhuri ni ni Naawuni kani. Bɛ nyɛla tuumbiɛrinima, ka tumdi tuun shɛŋa din chihira; ka so ka bɛ ni n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi din tuhi.
en: Only a fool would say, There is no God! People like that are worthless! They are heartless and cruel and never do right.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu nyɛla Naawuni yɛla, amaa man kul nyɛla ŋun mali ninsalitali biɛhigu ka nyɛ alahichi dabili.
en: We know that the Law is spiritual. But I am merely a human, and I have been sold as a slave to sin.

dag: Zahimmi Asiria din nyɛ Lɛbanɔn sida tia, din mali wul viɛla, ka nyɛ tibɔŋ ni mahim, ka nyɛ din wɔɣa pam, ka di wulikpani chaŋ ti tɔri sagbana la.
en: Consider Assyria, a cedar of Lebanon: beautiful branches, dense shade, towering height; indeed, its top went up between the clouds.

dag: Yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka ʒiɛnya dɛde yi yɛda niŋbu puuni. Benya kaman dɔbba! Maliya yaa!.
en: Be alert, stand firm in the faith, be brave, be strong.

dag: Nyama, o kanimina kaman sagbana la, o chɛchɛbunsi ŋmanila pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga, ka o yuri zɔri yomyom gari tɔrili. Mbusim be ti zuɣu, dama ti bahi yoli.
en: Look! The enemy rises up like a cloud. His chariots look like a windstorm. His horses are faster than eagles. It will be very bad for us! We are ruined!.

dag: amaa yi ni daa deei Shia Kasi so Masia san la nyɛla ŋun kul kpalim be yi ni, ka di bi lan simdi ni so wuhi ya shɛli; Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi ni wuhiri ya binshɛɣukam ka di nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ka pa ʒiri la zuɣu, kul benya Masia ni.
en: Christ gave you a special gift. You still have this gift in you. So you dont need anyone to teach you. The gift he gave you teaches you about everything. It is a true gift, not a false one. So continue to live in Christ, as his gift taught you.

dag: A ni tooi baŋ Naawuni tɛha din zilim ŋɔ? A ni tooi baŋ Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ yɛm tariga?.
en: Can you find the secret of God or find the extent of the Almighty?.

dag: Ka nyini ŋun nyɛ n tumtumdikpee ŋɔ, n suhir a ni a sɔŋmi paɣiba maa, dama m mini ba zaŋ tabili Klɛmɛnt ni n tumtumditaba bɛn yuya sabi nyɛvili litaafi ni la n-daa laɣim tumdi lahibal suŋ molo molibu tuma.
en: Yes, and Im also asking you, loyal friend, to help these women who have struggled together with me in the ministry of the gospel, along with Clement and the rest of my coworkers whose names are in the scroll of life.

dag: M biɛhigu shee ni ti be bɛ sani ka n nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka bɛ gba nyɛ n niriba.
en: My dwelling will be with them, and I will be their God, and they will be my people.

dag: ka pumpɔŋɔ o shiri niŋ o ni daa yɛli ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa, yi zaa ni tum alahichi Yawɛ sani ka bi deeg o nol la zuɣu. Dinzuɣu ka yɛlli ŋɔ paai ya maa.
en: Now the LORD has made it happen. He has done just as he warned because all of you have sinned against the LORD and havent obeyed him. Thats why this has happened to you.

dag: Yili maa ni bihi mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba maa daa malila sala buɣim zali ʒiɛya wuɣisira, dama wari n-daa be; ka Pita gba daa ʒe bɛ sani n-wuɣisiri buɣim maa.
en: It was cold, and the servants and temple police had made a charcoal fire. They were warming themselves around it, when Peter went over and stood near the fire to warm himself.

dag: Ka naa kpamba maa daa yɛl o, Nyama, tinim bɛn nyɛ a kpamba ŋɔ mali shili ni ti niŋ nyini n dan naa ni lo shɛli.
en: The officials said, Your Majesty, we'll do whatever you say.

dag: N ni chani ni yolisim, dama m bo n-nya a zaligunima.
en: So I will live in freedom, because I do my best to know your instructions.

dag: Pita daa lan yɛli pahi, Yisa ŋɔ ka Naawuni daa neei kum ni ka ti zaa leei di shɛhiranima.
en: So Jesus is the one God raised from death. We are all witnesses of this. We saw him.

dag: Ka sokam ni ti jɛn ya n yuli zuɣu. Amaa ŋunkam ti niŋ suhukpeeni hal ni wahala ŋɔ bahigu ni ti tiligi.
en: Everyone will hate you because of me. But if you keep on being faithful right to the end, you will be saved.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa yɛli, Gbaamiya Mikaya n-zaŋ o ti ti Amɔn ŋun nyɛ tiŋ ŋɔ Gomna la mini nabia Jɔash.
en: Arrest him, ordered Israels king, and turn him over to Amon the city governor and to Joash the kings son.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni n-nyɛ n tiligira; n ni niŋ o naani, ka ku zo dabiɛm. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ n yiliyiinili mini n kpiɔŋ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n tiligira.
en: I trust you to save me, Lord God, and I won't be afraid. My power and my strength come from you, and you have saved me.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu yiliyiiniba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihinahaayika.
en: These are the singers: the descendants of Asaph:.

dag: Bɛn zɔr o, bɛna ka o mi zɔri nambɔɣu ʒiɛmani zaŋ ti kpa ʒiɛmani.
en: from one generation to another he shows mercy to those who honor him.

dag: Naa ŋun yuli booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, so kanna m-be kaman Tabo zoli ni be shɛm zoya ni la, ka be kaman Kamɛl zoli ni ʒe m-baɣi teeku shɛm la.
en: Egypt, I am the true king, the Lord All-Powerful, and as surely as I live, those enemies who attack will tower over you like Mount Tabor among the hills or Mount Carmel by the sea.

dag: Maliya biɛrisuŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani, ka di chɛ ka bɛ yi tɔɣisiri n-dalindi ya ni yi nyɛla tuumbiɛtumdiba, bɛ ni bahi nya yi tuun suma ka ti Naawuni jilima o kandina dali.
en: Live honorably among the unbelievers. Today, they defame you, as if you were doing evil. But in the day when God visits to judge they will glorify him, because they have observed your honorable deeds.

dag: amaa di ku niŋ lala yinim sani. Dinzuɣu ŋun bɔri ni o nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ leei yi zaa ha bia;.
en: But it should not be that way with you. Whoever wants to be your leader must be your servant.

dag: ti lan zaɣisim a zaligunim maa yaha ka chaŋ ti kpuɣi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din chihiri ŋɔ bipuɣinsi n-niŋ ti paɣiba? A ku je suli m-bahi ti yoli zaa kahikahi, ka chɛ ka ti ni so ku lan tiligi?.
en: will we once again break your commandments and intermarry with the peoples who practice these detestable things? Would you not be so angry with us that you leave us without remnant or survivor?.

dag: Naawuni ku chɛ ka o suhuyiɣisili maai; o nyaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔŋdi Reehab la.
en: When God showed his anger, the servants of the sea monster fell at his feet.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun guli ma kaman piɛgula ni guli piɛri shɛm la, ka binshɛli bi poori ma.
en: The Lord is my shepherd; I have everything I need.

dag: Pa kurimbuni lahibaya din pa yɛlimaŋli ka ti daa zaŋ wuhi ya ti Duuma Yisa Masia yiko min o kandina yɛla, amaa ti nyɛla shɛhiranim bɛn nini daa nya o jilima.
en: We told you about the power of our Lord Jesus Christ. We told you about his coming. The things we told you were not just clever stories that people invented. No, we saw the greatness of Jesus with our own eyes.

dag: N ni zaŋ di mini Ammɔnnim niŋ wulimpuhili polo nim nuu ni, ka bɛ su ba, ka zuliya shɛb ku lan teei Ammɔnnim yɛla.
en: The same eastern desert tribes that invade Ammon will invade Moab, and just as Ammon will be forgotten forever.

dag: Di saha ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Adɔnija saamba maa zaa, ka bɛ vaai yiɣisi, ka bɛ zaa yinoyino zaŋ kpa o kpabu polo.
en: Adonijah's guests shook with fear when they heard this news, and they left as fast as they could.

dag: Ka shɛŋa lu gɔhi ni, ka gɔhi maa zooi lim li n-girimgirim li.
en: Some other seeds fell where thornbushes grew up and choked the plants.

dag: Di veeni ni nir nya wahala la o bilim ni.
en: It is good for a man to wear his yoke from the time he is young.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa mali hal ti zooi, ka Yawɛ be o sani, ka chɛ ka o yɛtɔɣa zaa nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: As Samuel grew up, the Lord helped him and made everything Samuel said come true.

dag: Yi ni ŋubi wɔɣira nimdi, ka nyu dunia ŋɔ nanim ʒim mini piɛlahi ʒim ni piɛnyama ʒim ni buhi ʒim ni naɣilahi ʒim, bɛ zaa nyɛla Bashan biŋkɔb kpaba.
en: You will eat the meat from the bodies of powerful soldiers and drink the blood from world leaders. They will be like rams, lambs, goats, and fat bulls from Bashan.

dag: Di saɣimya Naawuni Shia Kasi suhu, dama ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ni zaŋ so dalim ya n-wuhi ni dahin shɛli kanna ka o ni ti fan ya bahi zaa.
en: Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.

dag: Yiɣisim chaŋ Zarɛfat din be Sidɔn tiŋgban ni la nti be ni. Nyama, n yɛli pako so ŋun be nimaani ni o tim a bindirigu.
en: Go to the town of Zarephath in Sidon and live there. I've told a widow in that town to give you food.

dag: Chɛ ka a neesim min a yɛlimaŋli kana; ka chɛ ka di wuhi ma soli n-zaŋ ma tahi a zoli din be kasi ka nyɛ a ni be luɣ shɛl la zuɣu.
en: Send your light and truth—those will guide me! Let them bring me to your holy mountain, to your dwelling place.

dag: O ni ti zani n-dih o biŋkɔbbaligu Yawɛ yiko ni, ka ni ti zani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ yuli jilima ni. Ka bɛ ti be ni alaafee, dama pumpɔŋɔ o ni nyɛla ninvuɣ titali dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa.
en: He will stand and shepherd his flock in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God. They will dwell secure, because he will surely become great throughout the earth.

dag: n-zaŋ li ti zali Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa, ka zaŋ pateesa yili liri Alikauli Adaka maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: The chest was brought into the tent and set behind the curtain in the most holy place. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Yawɛ doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka tumdi wuntia tuma tiri bɛn nyari nahiŋgu.
en: For all who are mistreated, the Lord brings justice.

dag: Bɛ ʒii nyabu nyɛla ʒiri, ka bɛ daanabitali yɛtɔɣa nyɛ ʒiri. Bɛ yɛra, Yawɛ yɛliya. Ka di mi pala Yawɛ n-tim ba. Amaa ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ yɛligu maa niŋ pali.
en: Those prophets lie by claiming they speak for me, but I have not even chosen them to be my prophets. And they still think their words will come true.

dag: Dinzuɣu, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn yɔhila yi gbala, ka yihi ya yi gbala maa ni na, yinim bɛn nyɛ n niriba ŋɔ n-zaŋ ya labisi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So now, prophesy and say to them, The LORD God proclaims: Im opening your graves! I will raise you up from your graves, my people, and I will bring you to Israels fertile land.

dag: Yi ni tooi lan da saan shɛb mini tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani mini bɛ malibu ni dɔɣi bi shɛb yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bɛ sani, ka bɛ leei yi sulinsi.
en: Also, you may get children as slaves if they come from the families of the foreigners living in your land. These child slaves will belong to you.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa su tɔbbi shɛb kalinli nyɛ tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbisita ni tusaayopɔin ni kɔbisinu bɛn daa mali kpiɔŋ din ni tooi sɔŋ naa ka o tuhi o dimnima.
en: Under them were , soldiers able to fight effectively for the king against his enemies.

dag: Ka yi mi nini nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ zuliya shɛba shɛlikam zaa yi zuɣu la; dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun daa tuhi ba tin ya.
en: You have seen how the Lord your God fought for you and helped you defeat the nations who lived in this land.

dag: O zaŋd o naba kɔrisiri tiŋa ni yaa, o mali suhupiɛlli pam o yaa maa zuɣu, ka zɔri tuhiri bidibbina soli.
en: A horse is happy to be so strong. It scratches the ground with its foot and runs into battle.

dag: Bɛ daa yiɣi du zuɣusaa ha n-lab ti lu bulli ni, ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba bɛ barina maa puuni.
en: The waves went as high as the sky; they crashed down to the depths. The sailors courage melted at this terrible situation.

dag: Di yi nyɛla n daa birigila soli maa zuɣu, ka chɛ ka n suhu ye n nina ni nya binshɛŋa zuɣu, ka daɣ shɛli yi be n nuhi ni.
en: If my step has turned from the way, if my heart has followed my eyes or a blemish has clung to my hands.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka yi tum alahichi ni yɛlimaŋli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani. Yi daa ŋmaligiya yomyom ka chɛ Yawɛ ni zali ya ni yi doli so shɛli maa, ka doola naɣibil kɔtomsi zali yimaŋa.
en: It was then that I saw how you sinned against the LORD your God: you made yourselves a calf, an idol made of cast metal! You couldnt wait to turn from the path the LORD commanded you!.

dag: Nyama, ti ni daa nya laɣ shɛli ti kpalansi noya ni la, ti daa ʒi li yi Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni labina ti ti a, ka bɔzuɣu ka ti ni ti zu anzinfa bee salima a dan yiŋa?.
en: We brought back the money that we found in our sacks before. So surely we wouldnt steal silver or gold from your masters house.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ niŋm alibarika niŋ Shɛm ni; ka chɛ ka Keenan nyɛ o dabili.
en: Noah also said, May the Lord , the God of Shem, be praised! May Canaan be Shems slave.

dag: Pita daa kul gɔrimi gindi luɣilikam kaari Yisa nyaandoliba, ka daa ti chaŋ Yisa nyaandol shɛb bɛn daa be Lida la gba sani.
en: As Peter toured the whole region, he went to visit Gods holy people in Lydda.

dag: ka o yɛl o, Dindina bɛn fiɣis a maa n-ni kana ka n naanyi wum a nol ni. Ka daa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm o ti niŋ Naa Hɛrɔd yiŋa n-gul o.
en: The governor said, I will listen to your case as soon as the people come to bring their charges against you. After saying this, he gave orders for Paul to be kept as a prisoner in Herod's palace.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa kul shini; ka di daa gari Gomna Pailɛt pam.
en: But Jesus did not answer, and Pilate was amazed.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd daa lan tum tuun biɛ shɛli pahi; dina n-nyɛ o ni daa gbaai Jɔn kpɛhi duu la.
en: He added this to the list of his evil deeds: he locked John up in prison.

dag: Malimiya m biɛhigu shee mini di puuni nɛma ka di be kaman n ni yɛn wuh a ka yi mal li shɛm.
en: I will show you what the Holy Tent and everything in it should look like. Build everything exactly as I show you.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. M bɔri ni a kpaŋsi yɛla ŋɔ, ka di chɛ ka bɛn niŋ Naawuni yɛda tooi zaŋ bɛ dahima tum tuun suma. Dimbɔŋɔnim viɛla, ka mali buchi ninsalinim sani.
en: This is a true statement. And I want you to be sure that the people understand these things. Then those who believe in God will be careful to use their lives for doing good. These things are good and will help everyone.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl taba, Kamiyana ka ti me timaŋmaŋ tiŋa, ka me pii tam di zuɣu ka di du hal ka di zuɣusaa ti tɔri sagbana n-zali yuli, dama di yi pa lala, ti ni ti wurim gili dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: They said, Now let's build a city with a tower that reaches the sky, so that we can make a name for ourselves and not be scattered all over the earth.

dag: Ka o garigi bɔhi ba, Yi na bi karim ni Naawuni ŋun daa nam ninsalinim piligu ni la daa nam ba la doo mini paɣa?.
en: Jesus answered, Haven't you read the scripture that says that in the beginning the Creator made people male and female?.

dag: Kaman niriba ni kul zaŋdi anzinfa mini daanya ni kuriti ni samafuu ni dalima n-niŋdi binshɛli din nyɛligiri binyara ni, ka vibiri buɣim niŋdi li ni di nyɛligi shɛm la, lala ka n ti yɛn zaŋ ya niŋ n sujee mini n suhuyiɣisili puuni n-nyɛligi ya.
en: in the same way that the ore of silver, copper, iron, lead, and tin is put in a refining furnace. My anger and rage will melt them the way fire melts ore.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya bantab viɛlli vil o zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bantab viɛlli maa vil o zuɣu maa, ka zaŋ binyɛr suŋ yɛl o; ka Yawɛ malaika maa ʒiɛya.
en: He said, Put a clean turban upon his head. So they put the clean turban upon his head, and they dressed him in garments while the LORDs messenger stood by.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naa daa bi saɣi niriba maa ni yɛli shɛm din ni chɛ ka Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka anabi Ahija ŋun daa nyɛ Shilo nir la yɛli Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam shɛm la niŋ pali.
en: The king didnt listen to the people because this turn of events came from God so that the LORD might keep his promise concerning Jeroboam, Nebats son, which God delivered through Ahijah from Shiloh.

dag: Babilɔn yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga ni ʒiɛri tiŋgban nɛli ni shɛm, lala ka mbusim pɔhim yɛn yi tiŋgban shɛli din mali dabiɛm ni na.
en: This is a message about the desert by the sea : It is coming like a storm blowing through the Negev. It is coming in from the desert, from a frightening nation.

dag: Amaa Jɔsia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisaayika saha, ka bɛ daa lan puhi Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu maa Jɛrusalɛm.
en: But in Josiah's eighteenth year as king of Judah, everyone came to Jerusalem to celebrate Passover.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa kuli; ka salo daa lan laɣim o sani hal ka o min o nyaandoliba ti kɔŋ bindirigu dibu.
en: Jesus entered a house. A crowd gathered again so that it was impossible for him and his followers even to eat.

dag: Ka bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa kul tuhi chani tooni shia ni bɔri luɣ shɛlikam polo. Bɛ daa kul chanimi ka bi ŋmaligira.
en: Each moved straight ahead wherever the wind propelled them; they moved without turning.

dag: nyin gbilisim tibili alizanda ni wum ka chɛ a niriba Izraɛlnim maa taali, ka lan zaŋ ba labisi a ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti bɛ mini bɛ yaannim la ni na.
en: listen to them in heaven. Forgive the sins of your people and bring them back to the land which you gave to them and to their ancestors.

dag: di saha n nyarila Naawuni tuma zaa, ka baŋ ni so ku tooi baŋ din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni. Bɛ yi bɔra, bɛn kpaŋm bɛmaŋ kabo, bɛ ku tooi baŋ li. Hal yɛnnim ni wuhiri ni bɛ mi li la, bɛ kul ku tooi baŋ li.
en: and never be able to understand what God is doing. However hard you try, you will never find out. The wise may claim to know, but they don't.

dag: ni Zalimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Aho nir la ni Maharai ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛtɔfa nir la.
en: Zalmon from Ahoh; Maharai from Netophah.

dag: ka yi lula ŋun ye binyɛr suma la sizuura ka yɛl o, N dana, ʒinim ʒiishe viɛlli ŋɔ ni; ka ŋmaligi yɛli nandan la ŋuna, Ʒe nimaani bee kamina nti ʒin tiŋa n naba ŋɔ shee.
en: If you show more respect to the well-dressed man and say to him, Have this best seat here, but say to the poor man, Stand over there, or sit here on the floor by my feet.

dag: Di saha Ijiptinim daa sɔɣirila bɛ bikpamba shɛb zaa Yawɛ ni daa ku la. Yawɛ daa bi chɛ bɛ buɣa gba.
en: while the Egyptians were burying their oldest males, whom the LORD had killed. The LORD also executed judgments against their gods.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa yi niriba maa sani n-chaŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni ti gbani n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa. Ka Yawɛ jilima neesim daa neei bɛ sani.
en: Moses and Aaron went to the entrance to the sacred tent, where they bowed down. The Lord appeared to them in all of his glory.

dag: Ka dɔrolan maa garigi yɛl o, N Duuma, kom maa yi ti dam, n ka so ŋun ni zaŋ ma siɣi di ni, ka mmaŋmaŋ yi chani ni n ti siɣi, so daŋdi ma la di ni siɣibu.
en: The sick man answered, Sir, I don't have anyone here to put me in the pool when the water is stirred up; while I am trying to get in, somebody else gets there first.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni lu Babilɔn zuɣu n-wurim li, ka ku bɛn kpalim be di ni mini bɛ bihi ni bɛ zuliya; man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will arise against them, says the LORD of heavenly forces. I will cut off Babylons renown and remnant, offshoot and offspring.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa shiri niŋ lala dindali maa yuŋ. O daa chɛ ka piɛ gbaŋ maa zuɣu kummi, amaa ka chɛ ka maligim lu m-mahigi tiŋgbani din gil li zaa.
en: That night God did that very thing. Just the sheepskin was dry, but the ground around it was wet with dew.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka o sanna dindali maa yuŋ ti yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ a ba Ibrahimma Naawuni, di zɔri dabiɛm, n ni be a sani, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka chɛ ka a zuliya nab pam n dabili Ibrahimma zuɣu.
en: where the Lord appeared to him that night and told him, Don't be afraid! I am the God who was worshiped by your father Abraham, my servant. I will be with you and bless you, and because of Abraham I will give you many descendants.

dag: Di simdi ka a zaŋ daba ayopɔin tum Aduna min o bidibisi maligumaaniba leebu tuma kaman n ni zal a shɛm maa.
en: Repeat this ordination ceremony for Aaron and his sons seven days in a row, just as I have instructed you.

dag: Yɛla ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni dini n-lee be asama ni nira yɛli: A yi yɛli so ni a chɛ o daalahichi paŋ o bee a yi yɛl o ni o yiɣisim chaŋ.
en: Is it easier for me to tell this man that his sins are forgiven or to tell him to get up and walk?.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ku tinsi maa niriba zaa, ka bi chɛ ka paɣa bee doo kpalim; ka daa gbahi bɛ piɛri mini niɣi, ni bunsi ni laakumnima, ka va bɛ situra pahi n-lab Akishi sanna.
en: When David attacked an area, he wouldnt leave anyone alive, man or woman. He would take the sheep, the cattle, the donkeys, the camels, and the clothes and would then go back to Achish.

dag: Kamiyana nti sɔŋ ma ka ti chaŋ ti liri Gibiɔnnima n-ku ba, bɛ ni chaŋ ti niŋ sandaani niŋ Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim la zuɣu.
en: Come with me and help me attack Gibeon. Gibeon has made a peace agreement with Joshua and the Israelites.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri Yawɛ, bɛna ka o wuhiri di ni simdi ni bɛ doli so shɛli.
en: Where are the ones who honor the LORD? God will teach them which path to take.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka Yisahaku sanna ti yɛl o, Di chaŋ Ijipti, kpalim be tiŋgban shɛli ni n ni yɛn wuh a.
en: because the Lord had appeared to Isaac and said: Isaac, stay away from Egypt! I will show you where I want you to go.

dag: Hal o ba bee o ma bee o biɛli bee o tizɔpaɣa yi kpi gba, ŋun di saɣim omaŋa; dama o ni wolig omaŋ ti Naawuni maa yɛla bela o zuɣu ni.
en: so you must not let yourself become unclean like this—even for your own father or mother, brother or sister when they die. This is because you have the hair that you dedicated to God on your head!.

dag: Niriba maa ni da n-gili tiŋgbɔŋ maa puuni ni tahima kalinsi, ka kum wum ba. Kum din yɛn wum ba maa mini bɛ suhuyiɣisili maa puuni, bɛ ni tu bɛ naa mini bɛ wuni. Bɛ ni ti kpuɣi bɛ zuɣuri lihi zuɣusaa.
en: The people will wander through the land, discouraged and hungry. In their hunger and their anger they will curse their king and their God. They may look up to the sky.

dag: A mi ni bɛnkam be Ɛsha daa zoya ka chɛ ma, bɛ ni shɛba n-nyɛ Faijɛlus mini Hɛrimɔjɛneez.
en: You know that everyone in Asia has left me. Even Phygelus and Hermogenes have left me.

dag: Yi ni tooi zani Naawuni zaani n-tɔɣisi ʒiri yɛtɔɣa, bee n-zan o zaani tɔɣisi yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa?.
en: Why are you lying? Do you think your lies will benefit God?.

dag: Kɔbil nin yini ni tooi bilisi ko nyaɣisili mini ko lɔŋolɔŋɔ?.
en: Both fresh water and salt water dont come from the same spring, do they?.

dag: Uri bia Bɛzalɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Hur yaaŋa, ka nyɛ Juda zuliya ni nir la n-daa mali binshɛɣukam zaa Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa ni o mali maa.
en: Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, from the tribe of Judah, made everything the Lord commanded Moses.

dag: Naa Uzia ni daa tum tuun shɛli zaa pahi min o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else Azariah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: ka o yɛli ba, Naawuni pun kahig o nam daashili yɛla wuhi yinima, amaa bɛn kpalim la bɛna, yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni ka o wuhiri ba ni di chɛ ka bɛ lihiri ka ku nyari shɛli, ka wumdi ka ku baŋdi di gbinni.
en: He said, You have been chosen to know the secret truths about Gods kingdom. But I use stories to speak to other people. I do this so that They will look, but they will not see, and they will listen, but they will not understand. Isaiah :.

dag: Ka bo wɔr shɛb Pool ni ti yɛn ba n-zali, ka mal o baalim tahi Gomna Filiksi sani.
en: Get some horses for Paul to ride so that he can be taken to Governor Felix safely.

dag: Ka dɔbba bɛn zaa daa be o yiŋ puuni, ka nyɛ bɛ ni dɔɣi bidib shɛb mini bɛ ni daa zaŋ bɛ liɣiri da shɛb tinzunnim sani zaa gba daa guni.
en: together with all of Abraham's slaves.

dag: Di saha ka Sool lan yɛli ba, Vihimiya m mini m bia Jɔnatan sunsuuni nya.! Ka di daa gbaala Jɔnatan.
en: Then Saul said, Decide between me and my son Jonathan. And Jonathan was selected.

dag: Ka saŋmarisi luri tiŋ na kaman sanʒiɛ titali ni yi yiɣisina nti ʒe fiig tia ka di wal kaha suuri luri shɛm la.
en: The stars fell down to the earth, like unripe figs falling from the tree when a strong wind shakes it.

dag: Lala ka Naa Dauda gba wuhi alibarika shɛli din be ninvuɣ so ni Naawuni ni lihi wuntizɔra, ka di pala o tuma zuɣu. O ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: David said the same thing when he was talking about the blessing people have when God accepts them as good without looking at what they have done:.

dag: ni bina ni kɔre kpɛbu ni ninvuɣ biɛtali ni yɔhiŋ ni biɛr yoli ni nyuli zabbu ni nyaanzubo ni karimbaani ni jɛrilim.
en: commit adultery, be greedy, and do all sorts of evil things; deceit, indecency, jealousy, slander, pride, and folly—.

dag: Yinim bɛn bɔri Yawɛ, ka bɔri wuntia ŋɔ, wummiya! Nyamiya bɛ ni daa ŋma kuɣ shɛli yihi ya na mini bɛ ni daa gbi tampin shɛŋa yihi ya na.
en: Some of you people try hard to live good lives. You go to the Lord for help. Listen to me. You should look at Abraham your father. He is the rock you were cut from.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔhi, Ka di chaŋ wula ka n wumdi piɛri kumsi mini niɣi ŋumbu.
en: Then why, Samuel asked, do I hear sheep and cattle.

dag: Bɛ dim maa zaŋla ziŋgoo gbahi bɛ zaa, ka zaŋ o laŋa n-vo ba na ti niŋ o daasau ni, ka di niŋ o nyaɣisim ka o suhu paligi.
en: Then an enemy comes along and takes them captive with hooks and nets. It makes him so happy.

dag: Di saha ka Mikaya daa garigi yɛli, N nya ka Izraɛlnim zaa wurimmi be zoya zuɣu kaman piɛri bɛn ka gul la. Ka Yawɛ yɛli ma, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim ka zuɣulana, chɛ ka sokam labi kul o yiŋ ni suhudoo. .
en: Micaiah answered, In a vision I saw Israelite soldiers wandering around, lost in the hills like sheep without a shepherd. The Lord said, These troops have no leader. They should go home and not fight. .

dag: o yi ti nya ka bia maa bi dol ti labina, o ni kpi; ka tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ni chɛ ka ti ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa kpi ni zab piɛla ni suhugarigu.
en: Our father will die if he sees that the boy isnt with us—and it will be our fault. We will send our father to his grave a very sad man.

dag: Nir yi ŋubiri ka kuma ka mali suhudoo, di so yil shɛli nim bɛn diri bindir nyaɣisa ka zabili be di yili maa ni.
en: It is better to have nothing but a dry piece of bread to eat in peace than a whole house full of food with everyone arguing.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la.
en: Then Joshua said to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh.

dag: Di daba ayɔbu nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa zaŋ Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Jeemsi maa mabia la pah omaŋ zuɣu n-du zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu bɛ kɔŋko.
en: Six days later Jesus took with him Peter and the brothers James and John and led them up a high mountain where they were alone.

dag: Ka n daa ti kpuɣi n zuɣu n-lihi nya binyila anahi ʒii shɛl ni yaha.
en: Then I looked up and I saw four horns.

dag: Filistia nanim mini bɛ niriba kɔbigakɔbiga, shɛb mi tuhilituhili ni daa ti garita, ka Dauda min o niriba pahi Akishi n-doli nyaaŋa na.
en: As the Philistine rulers went out marching in units of hundreds and thousands, David and his soldiers were in the rear with Achish.

dag: Ka o daa yihi ti nimaani na nti zaŋ o ni daa po pɔri ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti yaannim la ti ti.
en: The Lord rescued us from Egypt, so he could bring us into this land, as he had promised our ancestors.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa yɛl o, Man bi lan yɛn ku saha a sani yaha, ka daa dii zaŋ kpana ata chaŋ ti kuhi Absalom suhu dɛde saha shɛl o ni daa na ne n-yili oki tia maa zuɣu maa.
en: Joab said, I'm not going to waste any more time on you! Absalom was still alive, so Joab took three spears and stuck them through Absalom's chest.

dag: Nimaani ka bɛ daa kpah o tabili dapulli maa zuɣu, ka daa kpahi niriba ayi gba tabili dapula n-zaŋ sa m-pahi Yisa zuɣu: Yino o nudirigu polo, ŋun la mi o nuzaa polo, ka Yisa daa be bɛ sunsuuni.
en: There they crucified him; and they also crucified two other men, one on each side, with Jesus between them.

dag: Ka o yiɣisi kuli.
en: The man got up and went home.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu be kasi sani, binshɛɣukam nyɛla din be kasi; amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu bi be kasi ka nyɛ bɛn bi niŋ yɛda sani, binshɛli kani n-nyɛ din be kasi, dama bɛ suhuri ni tɛha malila daɣiri.
en: To people who are pure, everything is pure. But to those who are full of sin and dont believe, nothing is pure. Really, their thinking has become evil and their consciences have been ruined.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ maŋmaŋ ni gari yi tooni n-zaŋ ya du li. O ni ku zuliya shɛb bɛn be yi tooni ŋɔ, ka yi deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ su. Jɔshua gba ni gari yi tooni n-zaŋ ya du kaman Yawɛ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm maa.
en: But the LORD your God, hes the one who will cross over before you! Hes the one who will destroy these nations before you so you can displace them. Joshua too will cross over before you just like the LORD indicated.

dag: M bi yɛn pahi so zuɣu bee n-niŋ so naŋgban malisim.
en: I don't know how to be unfair or to flatter anyone—.

dag: Miri ka a mali jɛlinsi a suhu ni ni a kpee, amaa chɛ ka a min a kpee maa tɔɣisi mali yi yɛtɔɣa, di yi pa lala a ni ti tum alahichi o zuɣu.
en: Dont secretly hate any of your neighbors. But tell them openly what they have done wrong so that you will not be just as guilty of sin as they are.

dag: Wula ka a yɛn tooi niŋ tuhi nyaŋ n dan sapashin bil yino gba, a yi du m-bala Ijiptinim ni bɛ ti a chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba?.
en: You are no match for even the lowest ranking Assyrian official, and yet you expect the Egyptians to send you chariots and cavalry!.

dag: So ku tooi baŋ yɛl biɛɣu ni yɛn paag o saha shɛli. Ziŋgbahiri laŋ din mali putɔɣu ni gbahiri zahim shɛm ni zana ni gbahiri noombihi shɛm la, lala ka yɛl biɛɣu gba libigiri daadamnim gbahiri ba.
en: You never know when your time is coming. Like birds suddenly caught in a trap, like fish caught in a net, we are trapped at some evil moment when we least expect it.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa yɛl o, Man bi lan yɛn ku saha a sani yaha, ka daa dii zaŋ kpana ata chaŋ ti kuhi Absalom suhu dɛde saha shɛl o ni daa na ne n-yili oki tia maa zuɣu maa.
en: Joab said, I wont waste time like this with you! He took three sticks in his hand and drove them into Absaloms chest while he was still alive in the oak.

dag: Yuuni maa ni daa ti gari, ka bɛ daa lan lab o sanna yuuni din paya ni ti yɛl o, N dana, ti ku sɔɣ a, ti di ti liɣiri zaa; ka ti niɣi zaa nyɛla nyin n dan dini; ti lan ka binshɛɣu nyin n dan tooni m-pahila ti niŋgbuna ŋɔ mini ti puri.
en: But the next year the people had no animals and nothing to buy food with. So they went to Joseph and said, You know that we have no money left, and all our animals belong to you. So we have nothing left—only what you see—our bodies and our land.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, a nyɛla Yɛlimaŋlilana, amaa ti nyɛla bɛn tiligi ka kpalim kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ. Tinima n-ʒe a tooni ni ti taali maa hal so ni ku tooi zani a tooni lala maa zaa yoli.
en: Lord God of Israel, you have been more than fair by letting a few of us survive. But once again, our sins have made us ashamed to face you.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa tuma zaa yɛn nyɛla Aduna min o bidibisi la ni zali shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni yɛn ʒi shɛlikam mini bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛlikam polo; ka a wuhi ba bɛ ni yɛn su binshɛlikam zaa ʒibu fukumsi.
en: and they will carry them wherever Aaron and his sons tell them to.

dag: N ni lan bɔhi bɔhigu ŋɔ pahi: Izraɛlnim daa bi baŋ? Anabi Musa n-nyɛ ŋun tuui garigi. O daa yɛli ni Naawuni yɛliya: N ni chɛ ka yi zab zuliya shɛb bɛn pa zuliya maŋli nyuli; ka chɛ ka yi suhuri yiɣisi bahi zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra zuɣu.
en: Again I ask: Did the people of Israel not understand? Moses himself is the first one to answer: I will use a so-called nation to make my people jealous; and by means of a nation of fools I will make my people angry.

dag: O ni zaŋ a niŋ o kpiŋkpama lɔŋni, ka a nya sɔɣibu shee o kpiŋkpama maa ni. O ʒiɛyimtali nyɛla gbaɣino mini din taɣiri nira.
en: He will cover you with his wings; you will be safe in his care; his faithfulness will protect and defend you.

dag: Anabi Musa ni daa zaŋ Naawuni daalikauli zaligunim zaa yɛla yɛli niriba zaa la nyaaŋa, o daa zaŋla naɣibihi mini buhi ʒim ni kom n-zaŋ taaŋkɔro vari mini piɛkɔb ʒɛhi tim di ni n-zaŋ li mihi Naawuni Zaligu Kundi la mini niriba maa zaa.
en: Moses took the blood of calves and goats, along with water, scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the Law scroll itself and all the people after he had proclaimed every command of the Law to all the people.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi bɔhi Naa Agiripa, Naa, a niŋ anabinim yɛligu yɛda? M mi ni a niŋ bɛ yɛligu yɛda.
en: King Agrippa, do you believe what the prophets wrote? I know you believe.

dag: Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili maa ni daa mali ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli din bɛ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, bɛ daa mɛla sara maligu bimbin titali zali nimaani.
en: When the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh arrived at Geliloth, still on the west side of the Jordan, they built a large, impressive altar there by the river.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni kaman o ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la, yi ni ti dihi zuliyanim pam samli; amaa yinim ti ku paŋ shɛli. Yi ni ti su zuliyanim pam, amaa bɛn ti ku sun ya.
en: The Lord will bless you, as he has promised. You will lend money to many nations, but you will not have to borrow from any; you will have control over many nations, but no nation will have control over you.

dag: Di be katiŋ ka chɛ ma, dama muɣisigu be yoma, ka so kani ŋun ni sɔŋ ma.
en: So dont leave me! Trouble is near, and there is no one to help me.

dag: Ka Naftali zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaata ni kɔbisinahi.
en: Those enlisted from the tribe of Naphtali were .

dag: Jɛfita kalinsi nyaaŋa, Ibizan ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm nir la n-daa leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulana.
en: Ibzan, the next leader of Israel, came from Bethlehem.

dag: ka yɛli ba ni bɛ di ŋubi mɔri bee bimbilli kam bee tihi vari, amaa ni bɛ nahimmila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka Naawuni bintabinda la bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu la.
en: They were told not to hurt the grass of the earth or any green plant or any tree. They could only hurt the people who didnt have the seal of God on their foreheads.

dag: Ka Sirianim bɛn daa yi Damaskus na ni bɛ ti sɔŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa maa, ka Dauda daa lu bɛ zuɣu n-ku bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi.
en: Arameans from Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah, but David defeated those , Arameans.

dag: amaa Naawuni yɛl ti, Miriya ka yi di ti shɛli din be puu ŋɔ sunsuuni ŋɔ wala bee n-shihi li gba, yi yi niŋ lala, yi ni kpi. .
en: except the one in the middle. He told us not to eat fruit from that tree or even to touch it. If we do, we will die.

dag: Yɛm tiri yɛndan kpiɔŋ gari nanim pia bɛn be tiŋ puuni.
en: Surely there is no one on earth who always does good and never sins. But wisdom can make one person stronger than ten leaders in a city.

dag: Amaa ka ti daa suhi ti Naawuni maa, ka bo niriba zali gu ba wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa.
en: But we kept on praying to our God, and we also stationed guards day and night.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi ba, Yi na bi karim di ni sabi Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli shɛm la yɛla? Di sabiya: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi la n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili.
en: You surely know that the Scriptures say, The stone the builders tossed aside is now the most important stone of all.

dag: Nir yi pii yu suŋ di gari buni pam, ka jilima mi gari anzinfa bee salima.
en: If you have to choose between a good reputation and great wealth, choose a good reputation.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa lan yɛli Haga, N ni chɛ ka a zuliya nab pam hal ka so ti ku tooi kali ba.
en: Then he said, I will give you so many descendants that no one will be able to count them.

dag: Ka Gaad bidibisi daa nyɛ: Zifiɔn mini Hagi ni Shuni ni Ɛzibɔn ni Ɛr ni Arɔd ni Arɛli.
en: Gad and his sons: Zephon, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arod, and Areli.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ, M biɛhimi ŋmɛnditoya ŋɔ naba? N ni paai ba? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Biɛhimi bɛ naba, a ni paa ba n-fa a niriba maa.
en: Then David asked the LORD, Should I go after this raiding party? Will I catch them? Yes, go after them! God answered. You will definitely catch them and will succeed in the rescue.

dag: ka tiligi bɛ shihi ka di ku kpe gballi ni; ka chɛ ka bɛ ku kpi.
en: He keeps one from the pit, a life from perishing by the sword.

dag: M bihi, kamiyana nti wum n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ; n yɛn wuhi ya la Yawɛ sizuura lubu.
en: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord .

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi dunia ŋɔ ni yɛla viɛli pam. Ka m mali suhupiɛlli pam bɛ zuɣu.
en: But you have also said about the gods of this land, They are my powerful gods. They are the ones who make me happy.

dag: ka turi Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ bɛ ni daa nya biɛrim shɛli maa mini yuma din gbahi ba la zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku niŋ tuuba bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: and they cursed the God of heaven for their pains and sores. But they did not turn from their evil ways.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so o yɛla.
en: But he strictly ordered them not to reveal who he was.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔhi Jɛsi, A bidibisi maa zaa m-be kpe ŋɔ? Ka o yɛli, Di kpalimla biasani, amaa ŋun gulila piɛri. Ka Samuɛl yɛli Jɛsi, Timmi ti zaŋ o na, dama ti ku ʒini ka pa ni o paala kpe na.
en: Do you have any other sons? Yes, Jesse answered. My youngest son David is out taking care of the sheep. Send for him! Samuel said. We won't start the ceremony until he gets here.

dag: ka Jeesɔn deei ba kpɛh o yiŋa. Bɛ mi nyɛla bɛn saɣindi Naa Siiza zaligunima, ka yɛri ni na so lan beni m-pahi Naa Siiza zuɣu ni ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa.
en: Jason is keeping them in his house. They all do things against the laws of Caesar. They say there is another king called Jesus.

dag: A tɛhiya ni zuŋɔ ka m piligi bɔhiri Naawuni n-nyar o yɛla tir o? Naa, di zaŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mini n daŋ zaa so taali, dama mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ bi mi dimbɔŋɔ zaa yɛla hal baabiɛla gba.
en: Yes, I consulted God for him, and it wasn't the first time. As for plotting against you, Your Majesty must not accuse me or anyone else in my family. I don't know anything about this matter.

dag: Wuntizɔriba firilanim kul nɛmi, amaa ka ninvuɣ biɛri firilanim kpira.
en: The light of the righteous rejoices, but the lamp of the wicked goes out.

dag: Ti mi bi tibigirila timaŋa yi sani yaha, amaa ti wuhiri ya la dalir shɛli din ni chɛ ka yi nyu bara ti zuɣu, ka lan chɛ ka yi tooi garigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali ninsal niŋgbuŋkom lihibu nyuri bara, ka pa ni o biɛhigu la bɔhigu.
en: We are not trying again to recommend ourselves to you; rather, we are trying to give you a good reason to be proud of us, so that you will be able to answer those who boast about people's appearance and not about their character.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bɔhi Yisa, Karimba, bɔ saha ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ti yɛn niŋ, ka shihir bɔ nti yɛn wuhi dimbɔŋɔnim niŋbu saha.
en: Teacher, they asked, when will this be? And what will happen in order to show that the time has come for it to take place.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul chani Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini niriba yinsi biɛɣukam nti wuhiri ba, ka yihiri waazu yɛri ni Yisa n-nyɛ Masia.
en: Every day they spent time in the temple and in one home after another. They never stopped teaching and telling the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma yi dundɔntitali ni zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo nti zaŋ ma kpe du shɛŋa din daa be Naawuni jɛmbu duu sambani tooni polo mini du shɛli din daa be nuzaa polo tooni.
en: After the man and I left the temple and walked back to the outer courtyard, he showed me a set of rooms on the north side of the west building. This set of rooms was meters long and meters wide.

dag: amaa a nina yi bi ne, a niŋgbuŋ zaa ni bela zibisim ni. Dama din di naan nyɛ a neesim yi niŋ liti, dindina nyin baŋmi ni di zibisim maa ku mali kpee.
en: but if your eyes are no good, your body will be in darkness. So if the light in you is darkness, how terribly dark it will be!.

dag: Ka bɛ ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti be bɛ sani. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: The people will know that I am the Lord their God. They will know that I am the one who led them out of Egypt so that I could live with them. I am the Lord their God.

dag: Di chɛliya ka dimbɔŋɔ niŋ ya alahiziba, dama saha kanna ka bɛnkam zaa be gbala ni ni ti wum o kukoli.
en: Do not be surprised at this; the time is coming when all the dead will hear his voice.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nya ka neesim maa viɛla, ka o woligi neesim maa ka chɛ zibisim.
en: He saw the light, and he knew that it was good. Then he separated the light from the darkness.

dag: A chɛ ka ti lu zana ni, ka a zaŋ ʒi tibisa ʒil ti.
en: You let us be trapped. You put heavy burdens on us.

dag: Miriya ka yi ku ninsala.
en: Do not murder.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti ku yi yuri, ka saɣim yi chɛchɛbunsi.
en: On that day—says the LORD— I will cut down your horses in your midst; I will destroy your chariots!.

dag: Ka Samla daa ti kpi, ka Shaul ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛhɔbɔt din daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni nir la daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: When Samlah died, Shaul ruled that area. Shaul was from Rehoboth by the River.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, N ni be m biɛhigu shee ka lihina baalim kaman maligim ni lurina yuŋ kachɛɣu saha shɛm ni kaman biisim ni be wuntaŋ ni shɛm la.
en: The LORD said to me: I will quietly watch from my own place, like the shimmering heat of sunshine, like a clouds shade in the harvest heat.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa miligi Kɔra mini Datan ni Abiram biɛhigu shee maa. Datan mini Abiram ni bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ bisarinsi ni bɛ bibihi daa yimina ti ʒe bɛ suɣa dunoya ni.
en: So everyone moved away from those tents, except Korah, Dathan, Abiram, and their families.

dag: Kamiyana ti nya Yawɛ ni tum shɛm. Nyamiya o ni tum tuun shɛŋa ka di mali dabiɛm dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Come, see the LORDs deeds, what devastation he has imposed on the earth.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa yɛli Samuɛl, Tim ti naa ka o su ti maa, di daa bi palig o suhu; ka o daa suhi Yawɛ.
en: Samuel was upset to hear the leaders say they wanted a king, so he prayed about it.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa yɛli Dauda, Kamina ka n ti zaŋ a niŋgbuŋ ti juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri.
en: Come here, he said to David, and Ill feed your flesh to the wild birds and the wild animals.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa Yisa ni daa baŋ ni binshɛɣukam niŋya naai maa ka o daa yɛli, Kɔnyuri mali ma. O daa yɛlila lala ni di chɛ ka Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali.
en: Jesus knew that by now everything had been completed; and in order to make the scripture come true, he said, I am thirsty.

dag: To, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisifu kuli Ijipti, ka tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa guli Firawuna la sapashin kpɛm ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti nir ka o yuli booni Pɔtifa la daa da o Ishimail zuliya bɛn daa ʒi o kuli nimaani maa sani.
en: The traders who bought Joseph took him down to Egypt. They sold him to the captain of Pharaohs guard, Potiphar.

dag: Di viɛli gari salima, hal di viɛli gari salima alali; ka lan nyaɣisi gari shiri, ni shigbani din tɔɣiri shiri.
en: They are more desirable than the finest gold; they are sweeter than the purest honey.

dag: din ni chɛ ka o ku dih o bihi vi o niriba sunsuuni. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mal o ka o be kasi.
en: so that he doesnt make his children impure among his people, because I am the LORD, who makes him holy.

dag: Chamiya Saipurus teeku noli ti nya, ka timiya Kɛdar ka bɛ ti lihi viɛnyɛliŋga n-nya lala na mi n-niŋ.
en: Go across the sea to the Islands of Kittim. Send someone to the land of Kedar. Look very carefully. See if anyone has ever done anything like this.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn da ba ku ba mi bi nya tibidarigibo; ka bɛn kɔhi bɛ nimdi mi yɛli, Ti paɣiri Naawuni! Ti leei bundaannima. Hal piɛri maa maŋmaŋ piɛguliba maa daa bi zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: Those who buy them will kill them, but they will go unpunished. Those who sell them will say, Blessed is the LORD, for I have become rich. And their own shepherds wont spare them.

dag: Mani n-chɛ ka zuɣulaannim su bɛ niriba, ka chɛ ka bɛnkam su niriba su ba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: With my help leaders govern, and important officials make good decisions.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ bɛ ni yɛli, Ti lan ka naa, dama ti bi zɔri Yawɛ, ka bɔ ka naa lee yɛn niŋ ti ti.
en: We don't have a king, you will say. We don't fear the Lord . And what good are kings.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa yeeg omaŋmaŋ kparibu shɛli o ni ye n-ti Dauda, ka zaŋ o gbaɣino ti o, hal ka zaŋ o takɔbi min o tɔbu ni o gban shɛli o ni mali lɔr o shee ni ti o pahi.
en: Jonathan took off the robe that he was wearing and gave it to David. He also gave him his military clothes, his sword, his bow and arrows, and his belt.

dag: Yawɛ, n gbib a zaligunim viɛnyɛliŋga. Di chɛ ka n di vi.
en: I have followed your instructions, Lord ; don't let me be put to shame.

dag: Puhimiya Yawɛ, dama o viɛla. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Praise the Lord ! He is good. God's love never fails.

dag: Ka Yisifu maa daa nyɛ Matatias bia, ka Matatias nyɛ Amɔs bia, ka Amɔs nyɛ Nahum bia, ka Nahum nyɛ Ɛsili bia, ka Ɛsili mi nyɛ Nagai bia.
en: Mattathias, Amos, Nahum, Esli, Naggai.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Kamina! Ka Pita daa yi ŋariŋ maa ni n-tam kom zuɣu chani Yisa sani;.
en: Come on! Jesus said. Peter then got out of the boat and started walking on the water toward him.

dag: Kaman sagani ni yi booi sagbana ni saa mibu dali shɛm la, lala ka jilima din daa gili o maa daa be. Yawɛ jilima kɔtomsi ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala. N ni daa nya li maa ka n daa lu n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa, ka wum so kukoli ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: that had in it all the colors of the rainbow. This was the dazzling light which shows the presence of the Lord . When I saw this, I fell face downward on the ground. Then I heard a voice.

dag: a yi yɛli, Nyama, ti di bi mi dimbɔŋɔ. Ŋun mi din be ninsal suhu ni la nya li. Ŋun gul a bi mi li? O ku yo nira o tuma samli?.
en: If you say, Look, we didnt know about it, the one who weighs hearts—doesnt he understand? The one who protects your life—he knows. He makes people pay for their actions.

dag: O yaar o noli n-tɔɣisiri yɛm yɛtɔɣa, ka nirilim niŋbu wuhibu be o noli ni.
en: Her mouth is full of wisdom; kindly teaching is on her tongue.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Chɛ ka di niŋ lala pumpɔŋɔ, dama di simdi ni ti tum din ni chɛ ka Naawuni ni zali shɛm zaa niŋ pali. Di saha ka Jɔn daa saɣi ka baptaiz o.
en: Jesus answered, Let it be this way for now. We should do whatever God says is right. Then John agreed.

dag: A daa nyɛla ŋun ka galimi a biɛhigu ni a nambu dali hal ka bɛ ti nya alahichi a ni.
en: You were truly good from the time of your birth, but later you started doing wicked things.

dag: Bɛ bihi ni ti be kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm kurimbuni ha la, bɛ ʒilɛli maa ni ti nya zaa zani n sani, ka n ti darigi bɛn zaa daa nahindi ba la tibili.
en: Their children will thrive as they did long ago, and their community will be established before me. I will punish their oppressors.

dag: Kahigim a daalikauli din nyɛ bɛn lur a sizuura dini la wuhi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ, ka n lu a sizuura.
en: Do what you promised me, your servant, so that people will respect you.

dag: Di saha ka n yura maa yɛli Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanima, Nyamiya m mini n tihi puu ŋɔ yɛla ŋɔ.
en: So now, you who live in Jerusalem, you people of Judah, judge between me and my vineyard.

dag: Di saha maa machɛli daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, dama Filistianim maa daa yɛlimi ni di yi pa lala Izraɛlnim ni ti kuri takɔbiri bee kpana zali.
en: The Philistines would not allow any Israelites to learn how to make iron tools. If we allowed that, they said, those worthless Israelites would make swords and spears.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Darius daa sab gbaŋ ti zuliya kam mini niriba balibu kam ni tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni yɛli: Naawuni timi ya suhudoo pam!.
en: Then King Darius wrote the following decree: To all the peoples, nations, and languages inhabiting the entire earth: I wish you much peace.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Musa zuɣu ka o yɛl o, Pa a mabia n-nyɛ Aduna ŋun nyɛ Lɛvi nir la? M mi ni o nyɛla ŋun ni tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa viɛnyɛliŋga. Nyama, o nyɛla ŋun yɛn yina ti tuh a soli, ka o yi ti nya a, o suhu ni paligi pam.
en: The Lord became angry with Moses and said: What about your brother Aaron, the Levite? I know he is a good speaker. He is already on his way here to visit you, and he will be happy to see you again.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni tilig a, ka bɛ ku zaŋ a niŋ a ni zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb la nuu ni.
en: But I, the Lord , will protect you, and you will not be handed over to the people you are afraid of.

dag: So beni n-nyɛ zoma n-lan paai n dabili bee n-nyɛ tikpiralana n-lan paai n tumo so n ni tim? Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ zoma m-paai n ni pii so, bee n-nyɛ zoma paai Yawɛ dabili?.
en: Who is blind if not my servant and deaf like my messenger whom I send? Who is blind like the restored one, blind like the servant of the LORD?.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ni lan zo Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim ŋɔ nambɔɣu, ka lan pii ba n-zaŋ ba labisi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaha; ka chɛ ka tinzunnim zaŋ bɛmaŋ pahi Yaakubu zuliya maa zuɣu n-doli ba labi.
en: The Lord will once again be merciful to his people Israel and choose them as his own. He will let them live in their own land again, and foreigners will come and live there with them.

dag: N kul zaŋ n nina kpala Yawɛ, dama ŋuna n-ni yihi n naba zana ni.
en: My eyes are always looking to the LORD because he will free my feet from the net.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun pah ayi ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaayopɔin saha ka Amazia bia Uzia daa di Juda nam.
en: King Azariah son of Amaziah of Judah became king in the th year that Jeroboam was king of Israel.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Kulima! A bia maa ni gali. Ka zuɣulan maa daa niŋ Yisa ni yɛl o shɛm maa yɛda, ka ŋmaligi kuli.
en: Jesus replied, Go home. Your son lives. The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him and set out for his home.

dag: Ka Ɛzra daa yɛli, M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yaannim Naawuni ŋun zaŋ yɛlli ŋɔ niŋ naa suhu ni, ka o ti Yawɛ jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la jilima ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Bless the LORD, the God of our ancestors, who has moved the king to glorify the LORDs house in Jerusalem.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ ya niŋ ŋarima ni n-labisi Ijipti; n ni daa lɔn ya alikauli ni yi nini ku lan nya luɣ shɛl la. Ka yi ti zaŋ yimaŋ ni yi kɔhi yi dimnim maa zuɣu nimaani n-leei bɛ dabidɔbba mini bɛ dabipaɣiba, amaa ka ŋun ni dan ya ku beni.
en: The Lord will send you back to Egypt in ships. I said you would never have to go to that place again, but he will send you there. In Egypt you will try to sell yourselves as slaves to your enemies, but no one will buy you.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ moli gili nyaandoliba maa ni ni nyaandol ŋɔ ŋun ku kpi; amaa Yisa daa bi yɛli Pita ni nyaandol maa ku kpi. O daa yɛl o mi, N yi yu ni o kul kpalim beni hal ka n ti lan labina, di lee nya a ya.
en: So a report spread among the followers of Jesus that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say he would not die; he said, If I want him to live until I come, what is that to you.

dag: Dinzuɣu kom maa na kul nyɛla ko viɛlli hal ni zuŋɔ kaman Ilaisha ni daa yɛli shɛm maa.
en: The water has been fine ever since, just as Elisha said.

dag: Ka yi yi ni zɔr Yawɛ ka jɛmd o, ka deer o noli ka ku zaɣisi ŋun Yawɛ zaligunim dolibu, ka yi mini yi na so ŋun sun ya maa zaa doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa, dindina shɛlikam ni niŋ viɛnyɛla yi sani.
en: All will go well with you if you honor the Lord your God, serve him, listen to him, and obey his commands, and if you and your king follow him.

dag: Ka di yi yɛligi o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla dɔr biɛɣu.
en: If the spot spreads, the priest shall pronounce you unclean; you are diseased.

dag: Zaŋmi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛli ba ka bɛ zaŋ mali kuli ti yɛli bɛ nanima ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni ti yɛn yɛli yi nanim maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: So have them tell their kings that I have said: I am the All-Powerful Lord God of Israel.

dag: O daa nyo Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili ni Jɛrusalɛm yiya zaa buɣim; o daa nyo yil titali kam buɣim.
en: Nebuzaradan burned the Lord s Temple, the kings palace, and every important building in Jerusalem, as well as all the houses.

dag: ni di chɛ ka cheechi maa viɛla, ka ka liɣisibu bee gurimbu, ka ni bela kasi ka ka galimi, ka o zaŋ li ti omaŋa.
en: Christ died so that he could give the church to himself like a bride in all her beauty. He died so that the church could be holy and without fault, with no evil or sin or any other thing wrong in it.

dag: Yi yi mi ni o nyɛla wuntialana, yin baŋmiya ni ŋunkam tumdi din tuhi nyɛla Naawuni bia.
en: If you know that he is righteous, you also know that every person who practices righteousness is born from him.

dag: Amaa di bi simdi ka o zaŋ omaŋ leei kaman o yidan la o niriba sunsuuni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o saɣim omaŋa.
en: But a priest must not make himself unclean if the dead person was only one of his slaves.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka di zaa laɣim bi, ka chɛbu saha ti paai ka n yɛli bɛn yɛn chɛ li: Daŋmiya piriŋkpana la chɛbu n-laɣim li lo bɔba n-nyo buɣim, amaa ka chɛ alikama la zaa n-laɣimna nti niŋ n kambɔŋ ni. .
en: Let both grow side by side until the harvest. And at harvesttime Ill say to the harvesters,First gather the weeds and tie them together in bundles to be burned. But bring the wheat into my barn.

dag: Wuntizɔriba zoorimi kaman abie tia la, ka zoori kaman Lɛbanɔn sida tia la.
en: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.

dag: Amaa hal ni zuŋɔ Yawɛ na bi tin ya tɛha din ni baŋ bee nina din ni nya bee tiba din ni wum.
en: But to this very day he has not let you understand what you have experienced.

dag: O ni daa sɔɣ o maa nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛl o bidibisi, N yi ti kpi, yin zaŋmiya ma sɔɣi ti ni sɔɣi anabi ŋɔ gbal shɛli ni ŋɔ n-zaŋ n kɔba sɔŋ baɣil o kɔba.
en: After the burial the prophet said to his sons, When I die, bury me in this grave and lay my body next to his.

dag: Yawɛ, gbilisim a tibili wum, ka neeg a nina nya, ka wum Sɛnachɛrib ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa ti na tu nyin Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ.
en: Just look and see how Sennacherib has insulted you, the living God.

dag: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka mi yi ni nahindi shɛm yɛla mini yi daania niŋbu ni yi ni je tuumbiɛrinim shɛm yɛla. N lan mi yi ni kpahim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋa m-boli Yisa tuumba, amaa ka pa o tuumba la ni yi ni nya ka bɛ nyɛla ʒirinim la.
en: I know what you do, how hard you work and never give up. I know that you dont accept evil people. You have tested those who say they are apostles but are not. You found that they are liars.

dag: A ni ti kahi a nɛma yina wuntaŋ ni bɛ ninni kaman nira ni yɛn zo kuŋkɔɣim ka kahi o nɛma shɛm la, ka a ti yi bɛ ninni zaawuni kaman kuŋkɔɣinzɔr la.
en: In the daytime while they watch, carry your backpack as if for exile. At twilight while they watch, go out like those who are led out to exile.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa ka o sanna ashilɔni ti bɔh o, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka tinim di bi tooi kari alizin biɛɣu maa bahi.
en: Then the followers came to Jesus alone. They said, We tried to force the demon out of the boy, but we could not. Why were we not able to make the demon go out.

dag: Amaa yinim gbibi n ni zali zaligu shɛŋa, ka miriya ka yi ni tiŋbia bee saan so ŋun be yi sani tum din chihiri maa.
en: They did all these disgusting things and made the land unclean, but you must not do them. All of you, whether Israelites or foreigners living with you, must keep the Lord 's laws and commands.

dag: Yi yab Ibrahimma suhu daa piɛli ni o nya n saha ŋɔ, ka mi daa shiri nya li ka di niŋ o suhupiɛlli.
en: Your father Abraham was overjoyed that he would see my day. He saw it and was happy.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ chana, ka Sool daa piligi m-bɔri Dauda soya.
en: So Saul kept a close eye on David from that point on.

dag: Kom daa beni n-sɔŋ li. Ka tiŋgbani ziliŋ daa chɛ ka di zooi niŋ wɔɣilim, ka chɛ ka di mɔɣa kom daa zo n-tiɛli bɛ ni daa sa li luɣ shɛli maa, ka di kɔsoya kom zo n-tiɛli tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tihi zaa.
en: There was water to make it grow, And underground rivers to feed it. They watered the place where the tree was growing And sent streams to all the trees of the forest.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa naag o wunsuhigu ŋɔ zaa saha shɛli, ka buɣim daa yi zuɣusaa na ti taai bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini sara shɛŋa, ka Yawɛ jilima daa pali duu maa.
en: As soon as Solomon finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the entirely burned offering and the sacrifices, while the LORDs glory filled the temple.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka a tir a kpee zalige bee bɔzuɣu ka a ʒiɛmd a kpee? Dama ti zaa ni ti zani Naawuni tooni ka o kari ti saria.
en: So why do you judge your brother or sister in Christ? Or why do you think that you are better than they are? We will all stand before God, and he will judge us all.

dag: ni Rabit ni Kishiɔn ni Ɛbɛz.
en: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez.

dag: Naawuni vuhim ni ku ba, ka o suhuyiɣisili pɔhim di ba.
en: They lost the breath God gave them. They were cut off from his breath of life.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan dɔɣ o tizo Ɛbɛl gba. Ɛbɛl daa nyɛla piɛgula, ka Keen mi nyɛ pukpara.
en: Eve gave birth again to Cains brother Abel. Abel became a shepherd, and Cain became a farmer.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa mali kpamba bɛn daa ʒiin o ba Sulemaana tooni o ni daa na be o nyɛvili ni saha shɛl la saawara ka bɔhi ba, Yi lee tɛhiya ni di simdi ni n yɛli niriba ŋɔ wula.
en: King Rehoboam consulted the elders who had served his father Solomon when he was alive. What do you advise? Rehoboam asked. How should I respond to these people.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, Bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili ma yurilim puuni, n ni fa ba bahi. Bɛn mi n yuli, n ni guli ba.
en: God says, I will save those who love me and will protect those who acknowledge me as Lord .

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yipa baŋ Naawuni bee Naawuni yipa baŋ ya, ka di chaŋ wula ka yi yɛn lab dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda din gbarigi ka ka yaa ŋɔ dabitim ni yaha? Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi lan bɔri ni yi labi di sulinsi ni yaha?.
en: But now you know the true God. Really, though, it is God who knows you. So why do you turn back to the same kind of weak and useless rules you followed before? Do you want to be slaves to those things again?.

dag: Di yuun pihinahi nyaaŋa ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti puhi yi Anabi Musa zuɣu mɔɣu ni zo shɛli din yuli booni Sinai la gbini m-be tutuɣu ni kaman buɣim la.
en: Forty years later, an angel appeared to Moses from a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.

dag: Nɛtɔfa — pihinunaayɔbu.
en: The people of Netophah.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a nyaandoliba bi doli ti yaannim kali? Dama bɛ bi doli bɛ niŋgbuna ni paɣibu kal la m-paɣiri bɛ nuhi ka diri bindirigu.
en: Why are your disciples breaking the elders rules handed down to us? They dont ritually purify their hands by washing before they eat.

dag: A yi lo Naawuni alikauli, nyin palimi li yomyom, dama o je jɛra yɛlli. Niŋm a ni lo alikauli ni a niŋ shɛli.
en: So when you make a promise to God, keep it as quickly as possible. He has no use for a fool. Do what you promise to do.

dag: Kamiya n sanna ka n tiligi ya. Yi yi ku kana n ni kana kaman buɣim la nti lu Yisifu zuliya zuɣu. Ka buɣim maa ni di Bɛtɛlnima, ka so kani n-ni kpihi li.
en: Turn back to the Lord , you descendants of Joseph, and you will live. If you don't, the Lord will attack like fire. Bethel will burn to the ground, and no one can save it.

dag: Sintani daa pun niŋ tɛha niŋ Judas ŋun daa nyɛ Saimɔn Isikariɔt bia la suhu ni ni o yi Yisa nyaaŋa. Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti laɣim diri yuŋ bindirigu saha shɛli.
en: Jesus and his disciples were at supper. The Devil had already put into the heart of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, the thought of betraying Jesus.

dag: Zallakudura Naa ni daa ti zuliyanim bɛ tiŋgbana saha shɛl o ni daa woligi daadamnima, o daa zali zuliya kam tintarisi kaman Izraɛlnim kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The Most High assigned nations their lands; he determined where peoples should live. He assigned to each nation a heavenly being.

dag: Yawɛ, n suhu kul yɛla a tiliginsim zuɣu, ka n suhu kul yu a zaligu.
en: Lord , I want you to save me. Your teachings make me happy.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Wula ka di lee sab Naawuni zaligu ni? Wula ka a lee karindi li.
en: Jesus said to him, What is written in the law? What do you understand from it.

dag: O ni gul o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe o yim, amaa o ni zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛri bɛna m-bahi zibisim ni; dama ninsal ku tooi di nasara omaŋmaŋ yiko ni.
en: You protect your loyal people, but everyone who is evil will die in darkness. We cannot win a victory by our own strength.

dag: Ka suhusaɣiŋgu zuɣu daa chɛ ka Naa Bɛlishaaza ninni biɛhigu maan taɣi pahi, ka o kpambaliba bi lan mi bɛ ni yɛn gbaai shɛm.
en: and they were completely puzzled. Now the king was more afraid than ever before, and his face turned white as a ghost.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ yi tiligira; labimiya n sanna. Dama n vuui yi tuumbiɛri mini yi daalahichi bahi kaman sagbani bee paɣili ni vuuri shɛm la.
en: I have swept your sins away like a cloud. Come back to me; I am the one who saves you.

dag: Di yi nyɛla dilan zaŋla nahu na ni o ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, ŋun zaŋmi naɣilaa ŋun ka daŋa m-mali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni din ni chɛ ka Yawɛ deeg o.
en: If you are offering one of your cattle as a burnt offering, you must bring a bull without any defects. You must present it at the entrance of the Tent of the Lord 's presence so that the Lord will accept you.

dag: Ka Ammɔnnim maa daa yina ti teei zani bɛ tiŋ maa tooni, ka na shɛb bɛn daa kana ni bɛ ti sɔŋ ba maa mi ʒe mɔɣu ni palo ni bɛ ko.
en: The Ammonite troops marched to the entrance of the city and prepared for battle, while the Syrian troops took their positions in the open fields.

dag: Jɔpa mini Lida ni daa bi wɔɣ ni tab zuɣu ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa wum ni Pita be Lida ka tim niriba ayi o sani ni bɛ ti yɛl o ni bɛ bɔri ni o ka bɛ sanna yomyom.
en: The followers in Joppa heard that Peter was in Lydda, which was not far away. So they sent two men, who begged him, Hurry, please come quickly.

dag: Judanim ni ŋmanila tɔbbi shɛb bɛn di nasara ka no bɛ dimnim firi soli zuɣu baɣiri ni; dama Yawɛ be bɛ sani. Bɛ ni tuhi nyaŋ bɛ dimnim bɛn nyɛ tɔbutuhiri wɔribariba la.
en: They will defeat their enemy —it will be like soldiers marching through mud in the streets. They will fight, and since the Lord is with them, they will defeat even the enemy soldiers riding horses.

dag: Dinzuɣu di lan ŋmariya tab ʒiri! Sokam yɛlim o mabia yɛlimaŋli, dama ti zaa nyɛla niŋgbun yini yaɣ shɛŋa.
en: No more lying, then! Each of you must tell the truth to the other believer, because we are all members together in the body of Christ.

dag: Yɛm ni ti gul a, ka yɛla baŋbu gba taɣ a.
en: Planning ahead will protect you, and understanding will guard you.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Alizanda nam ŋmanila yil yidan so ŋun daa daŋ yibu asiba n-chaŋ ni o ti bu padiriba paa niŋ o puu ni.
en: As Jesus was telling what the kingdom of heaven would be like, he said: Early one morning a man went out to hire some workers for his vineyard.

dag: Doo maa ni daa nya ka o bi tooi nyaŋ Yaakubu maa, ka o daa shih o sakpuɣu, ka o sakpuɣu maa ŋmirigi bɛ ni daa vari saha shɛli maa.
en: When the man saw that he couldnt defeat Jacob, he grabbed Jacobs thigh and tore a muscle in Jacobs thigh as he wrestled with him.

dag: Yɛlli ŋɔ nyɛla din chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe tibi yɛma ŋma. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali yiɣisi wuɣili ninvuɣ biɛɣu zuɣu.
en: Good people wonder how this could happen. The innocent are upset with anyone who is against God.

dag: ka wuh a din tuhi mini yɛlimaŋli din ni chɛ ka a garigi bɛn tim a na yɛlimaŋli garigibu?.
en: They will teach you things that you can know for sure to be true. Then you can give good answers to the one who sent you.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti nya Nataniɛl ka o kan o sanna, o daa yɛlimi, Nyama, n-nyɛ Izraɛl nir alali ŋun ka yɛmbimbiɛri biɛhigu o ni hal baabiɛla.
en: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him, he said, Here is a true descendant of our ancestor Israel. And he isn't deceitful.

dag: Dan zuliya tiŋgbani maa wulimpuhili polo zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo, Asha zuliya ni su tiŋgban yini.
en: Along the boundary of Dan from the eastern border to the western border: Asher, one portion.

dag: Yaakubu ni daa ti wum ni kawana be Ijipti, ka o bɔh o bihi, Bɔzuɣu ka yi lihiri taba.
en: When Jacob found out there was grain in Egypt, he said to his sons, Why are you just sitting here, staring at one another?.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti kum niŋ Yawɛ, amaa ka o ku garigi ba; di saha maa, o ni ti lɛb o nyaaŋa biri ba bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: Then they will cry out to the LORD, but he wont answer them. He will hide his face from them at that time, because of their evil deeds.

dag: Lala maa ni chɛ ka n suhuyiɣisili zani tariga zaŋ chaŋ a polo, ka n ŋmaligi n nyuli zabbu ka chɛ a, ka fo, ka n suhu ku lan yiɣisi.
en: Only then will I calm down and stop being angry and jealous.

dag: Dama tia mali tahima, bɛ yi ŋmaai li luhi, di ni lan kpiri, ka ku chɛ zoobu.
en: When a tree is chopped down, there is always the hope that it will sprout again.

dag: Yɛlimiya Amasa, A nyɛla n niŋgbuŋ mini n ʒim, zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, n yi bi zaŋ a leei n tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma n-zali Jɔab zaani, Naawuni ŋun niŋmi ma zaɣ biɛɣu, hal ŋun niŋmi ma zaɣ biɛɣu pam gba. .
en: Also tell Amasa, You are part of my family. I swear that I will make you captain of the army in Joabs place.

dag: Nyam n dimnim ni galisi shɛm; ka nya bɛ ni je ma pam shɛm.
en: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n daashili sɔɣibu shee ni n nyɔtaɣirigu; m mali tahima a yɛligu ni.
en: You are my shelter and my shield— I wait for your promise.

dag: Amaa Sulemaana daa bi zaŋ Izraɛlnim leei daba. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ o tɔbbihi min o kpamba ni o sapashinnim ni o sapashin kpamba ni o chɛchɛbunsi duhiriba kpamba ni o wɔribariba.
en: Solomon did not force any Israelites to be his slaves. The Israelites were soldiers, government officials, officers, captains, and chariot commanders and drivers.

dag: O daa lan me bimbina zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni, Yawɛ ni daa yɛli, Jɛrusalɛm n-nyɛ luɣ shɛli n yuli ni yɛn be sahakam la.
en: He built pagan altars in the Temple, the place that the Lord had said was where he should be worshiped forever.

dag: Yuma ayopɔin puuni o ku mali ninsal tɛha, amaa ka ni malila biŋkɔbigu tɛha.
en: Give him the mind of a wild animal for seven long years.

dag: Yawɛ baɣa be ti ni. O ni niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni. O ni niŋ alibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim ni. O ni niŋ alibarika niŋ Aduna zuliya ni.
en: The Lord remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless Israel. He will bless Aarons family.

dag: ka nyɛ bɛn bi zuri bɛ taba nyaaŋa, ka bi tumdi bɛ zɔnim taali, ka mi bi mali bɛ ʒiʒiinitab yɛla n-chani moona.
en: Such people dont say bad things about others. They dont do things to hurt their neighbors. They dont tell shameful things about those close to them.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita yɛl o, N Duuma, dindina pa n naba kɔŋko, amaa paɣimi n naba zaŋ tabili n nuhi ni n zuɣu zaa.
en: Simon Peter said, Lord, not only my feet but also my hands and my head.

dag: Ka tiŋguliba daa chani gindina ti nya ma n-gbaai ma bu ma ti ma dansi. Ka tiŋ maa gooni guliba daa darigi fuɣi n chinchin shɛli din gbini n nyiŋgoli ni.
en: The sentries patrolling the city found me; they struck me and bruised me; the guards at the city wall tore off my cape.

dag: Ka bee binshɛli beni, ka bɛ ni yɛli, Nyamiya, bini ŋɔ din nyɛla bin palli? Di nyɛla binshɛli din pun beni hal ka bɛ na bi dɔɣi ti gba.
en: People may say about something: Look at this! Its new! But it was already around for ages before us.

dag: Malimiya pipih anahi din ŋmani alimɔnd pum ka mali bintira kɔtomsi mini tipum kɔtomsi tam firilatamdigu maa maŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: and four on the stem.

dag: ka o lihi n-nya Yisa ni chani ha ka yɛli, Nyamiya Naawuni Piɛbil la ha.
en: When he saw Jesus walking along he said, Look! The Lamb of God.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni daa ti paana n-yi biɛɣu n daa bi niŋ zinchili, ka chaŋ ti ʒini n sariadibo ʒiishee ka yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm Pool na.
en: When they came here, then, I lost no time, but on the very next day I sat in the judgment court and ordered the man to be brought in.

dag: Amaa ti tuumbiɛri yi nyɛla din wuhiri ni Naawuni niŋdi din tuhi, dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli? Ti ni yɛli ni Naawuni yi darigi ti tibili o bi niŋ din tuhi? Ninsal tɛha yɛtɔɣa ka n tɔɣisi maa.
en: When we do wrong, that shows more clearly that God is right. So can we say that God does wrong when he punishes us?.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ bo chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi piɛlabil ŋun la zuɣu mali sara zaawuni kaman asiba din la n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim. Di nyɛla din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: Offer the second lamb just before dark. Offer it just as the morning offering. Also give the drink offering that goes with it. This will be a sweet-smelling gift to the Lord .

dag: Di lihi ʒiɛm ma, n ni sabigi maa zuɣu. Wuntaŋa n-kpe ma ka n sabigi maa. N tizɔdɔbba jɛla suli niŋ ma; bɛ chɛ ka n gulila wain tihi puu, ka kɔŋ dahima maani mmaŋa.
en: Dont look at how dark I am, at how dark the sun has made me. My brothers were angry with me. They forced me to take care of their vineyards, so I could not take care of myself.

dag: Bɛ ni ti doli Yawɛ, ka o ti ŋum kaman gbuɣinli la; yɛlimaŋli, o shiri ni ti ŋum, ka o niriba ti yi wulinluhili polo na ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: My people will follow me when I roar like a lion at their enemies. They will hurry to me from the west.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa lan lo tab alikauli Yawɛ tooni, ka Jɔnatan daa kuli, ka Dauda mi kpalim be Hɔrɛshi.
en: Jonathan and David both made an agreement before the Lord . Then Jonathan went home, and David stayed at Horesh.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ŋubi ba tiɣi; dama o daa ti ba bɛ suhuri ni ye shɛli zuɣu.
en: The people ate until they were full. God had given them what they wanted.

dag: Ka paɣa maa yi ti tuui dɔɣi bidibiga, bɛn zaŋm o mabi so ŋun kpi maa yuli boli bia maa din ni chɛ ka o yuli maa ku kpihim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The first son that they have will be considered the son of the dead man, so that his family line will continue in Israel.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi mini kom ni ʒim, ka shɛhira diba ata ŋɔ zaa mi yɛla saɣisila taba.
en: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and all three give the same testimony.

dag: amaa ka bɛ daa bi tooi baŋ o.
en: they saw him, but somehow did not recognize him.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu hal nti naai bɛ birili n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti bɛ mini bɛ yaannim ŋɔ ni.
en: War and hunger and disease will strike them, until they finally disappear from the land that I gave them and their ancestors.

dag: Ka o lan maa yi be katiŋa bee a yi bi mi o lana, dindina nyin taɣim o kul a yiŋa, ka o ti be a sani hal ka o lan maa ti bɔh o yɛla, ka a zaŋ o ti o.
en: If the owner does not live near you or if you dont know who it belongs to, take the ox or sheep to your house. Keep it there until the owner comes looking for it; then give it back.

dag: Nyamiya, ninvuɣ so ŋun zaɣisi ni o ku zo nti sɔɣi Naawuni sani tiligi, amaa ka naɣ niŋla o daazichi naani, ka zaŋ o daazichi maa n-leeg o sɔɣibu shee la.
en: Just look at them now! Instead of trusting God, they trusted their wealth and their cruelty.

dag: Ka Aduna daa niŋ lala. O daa zaŋ firilanim maa zali ni di ne firilatamdigu maa tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa.
en: Aaron did so. He set up its lamps in front of the lampstand as the LORD commanded Moses.

dag: A ni daa nya ka kuriti mini yaɣiri gari tab shɛm la, lala ka bɛ ni ti kpuɣiri tab bipuɣinsi n-lɔri ba amiliya ni di chɛ ka bɛ laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini, amaa kuriti mini yaɣiri ni ku tooi gari taba n-leei zaɣ yini shɛm, lala ka bɛ gba ku tooi leei zaɣ yini.
en: This kingdom will be the result of a marriage between kingdoms, but it will crumble, just as iron and clay don't stick together.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun daa be Izraɛlnim sani mɔɣu maa ni saha shɛli malaika so ŋun daa be bɛ san la ni daa tɔɣis o mini ti yaannim yɛtɔɣa Sinai Zoli gbin la. Nimaani ka ŋun Anabi Musa daa deei Naawuni yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ nyɛvili yɛtɔɣa la ti ti.
en: He is the one who was with the people of Israel assembled in the desert; he was there with our ancestors and with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and he received God's living messages to pass on to us.

dag: Yawɛ shiri tum tuun kara ti ti, ka ti suhuri paligi pam.
en: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.

dag: Ka o daa ʒini ka boli bɛ pinaayi maa na ti yɛli ba, Ŋun bɔri ni o gari sokam zaa, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ leei bia sokam zaa sani, ka zaŋ omaŋ leei sokam zaa dabili.
en: He sat down, called the Twelve, and said to them, Whoever wants to be first must be least of all and the servant of all.

dag: Amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn soli ŋmanila biɛkaali neesim, di kul neerimi pahiri hal ti be kaman wuntaŋ yi ti zani zuɣu ni la.
en: The path of those who live right is like the early morning light. It gets brighter and brighter until the full light of day.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa yɛli Izraɛl naa, Daŋ bɔhi Yawɛ m-baŋ o ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: But first let's consult the Lord .

dag: Alichɛbba maa nyiŋgoli daa ŋmanila kurugu gbaɣino nyiŋgoli, ka bɛ niŋ tani kɔɣili di nyiŋgoli maa zaa gili din ni chɛ ka di ku cheei.
en: The hole for the head was reinforced with a woven binding to keep it from tearing.

dag: n-yo bidibikpamba bɛn kalinli pani maa zuɣu Aduna min o bidibisi sani.
en: You will give the money for their rescue to Aaron and his sons.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa daa yiɣisi zani salo maa sunsuuni m-bɔhi Yisa, A ka noli din ni garigi? Shɛhira bɔ ka bɛ lee dir a ŋɔ.
