en: The high priest stood up in the council and asked Jesus, Why don't you say something in your own defense? Don't you hear the charges they are making against you.

dag: dindina wula ka tinim ni tooi zo n-yi tibidarigibo maa ni, ti baɣa yi ka tiliginsim din galisi ŋɔ ni? Ti Duuma maŋmaŋ daa tuui yɛli tiliginsim maa yɛla, ka bɛn daa wum o yɛligu di o shɛhira ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, a tum alahiziba tuma ti ti; a lo ti nia suma pam; ka so mi bi ŋman a. N yi yɛn yɛli di zaa yɛla, di ni galisi pam ka nira ku tooi kal li!.
en: Lord my God, you have done many amazing things! You have made great plans for us—too many to list. I could talk on and on about them, because there are too many to count.

dag: O daa dolila o ba Asa naba, o daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, ka bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ li, naɣila bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la ka o daa bi wurim; ka niriba daa na kul chani ti maani li, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim nimaani.
en: Jehoshapat walked in all the ways of his father Asa, not deviating from it. He did the right things in the LORDs eyes, with the exception that he didnt remove the shrines. The people continued to sacrifice and offer incense at them.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn luri n yuli sizuura ŋɔ, n tiliginsim yiko din be kaman wuntaŋ neesim la ni nyee kpɛn ya, ka tahi tibbu na ti tin ya. Yi ni ti yiɣiri jamdi kaman naɣibihi pola n-yi naɣiluu ni na la.
en: But, for my followers, goodness will shine on you like the rising sun. And it will bring healing power like the suns rays. You will be free and happy, like calves freed from their stalls.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Ŋahili maa gbinni m-bɔŋɔ: Bimbira maa nyɛla Naawuni yɛligu.
en: This is what the story means: The seed is Gods teaching.

dag: Ka Sintani daa ti yiɣisi lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu, m-piɛli Dauda ni o kali Izraɛlnima.
en: Satan wanted to bring trouble on the people of Israel, so he made David decide to take a census.

dag: Ka Musa daa teeg o nuu tiri teeku maa. Zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu daa ti yɛn neei ka teeku maa kom maa lan nahi taba, ka Ijiptinim maa daa yɛn zo n-yi dini, ka Yawɛ daai ba niŋ teeku maa bulli ni.
en: So Moses held out his hand over the sea, and at daybreak the water returned to its normal level. The Egyptians tried to escape from the water, but the Lord threw them into the sea.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-daa zali ni Izraɛlnim zaŋm li tiri ba dahin shɛli bɛ ni daa booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni la. Di nyɛla zaligu din kul yɛn beni bɛ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: This law will never change. I am the Lord !.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnim maa, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui, ka sokam daa zo n-kul o yiŋa. Bɛ daa ku niriba pam, dama Izraɛlnim tɔbbi tinchandib tuhi pihita ka bɛ daa ku.
en: The Philistines fought hard and defeated the Israelites, who went running to their homes. There was a great slaughter: thirty thousand Israelite soldiers were killed.

dag: ka kari saria din tuhi n-sɔŋ kpibisi mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu, ka lala chɛ ka dabiɛm ku lan mali daadamnim yaha.
en: to establish justice for the orphan and the oppressed, so that people of the land will never again be terrified.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti maa na, bɛ daa kpɛla yɔɣu ni chaŋ na hal ti paai Teeku Ʒiɛɣu n-gbaai li du n-ka Kadɛshi na.
en: When the Israelites came from Egypt, they traveled across the desert to the Red Sea and then to Kadesh.

dag: A chɛ ka niriba ŋmanila teeku ni zahim, ka ŋmani biŋgbamda bɛn ka naa.
en: The people you put on this earth are like fish or reptiles without a leader.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan yɛli, Ka daɣila Kɛilanim ŋɔ ni zaŋ m mini n niriba ŋɔ niŋ ŋun Sool nuu ni? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Bɛ shiri ni zaŋ ya niŋ o nuu ni.
en: Again David asked, Will the people of Keilah give me and my men to Saul? The Lord answered, They will.

dag: Bɛ ni bi lihi nya Yawɛ ni pun tum tuun shɛŋa bee n-lihi nya o nuhi tuma la zuɣu, o ni daai ba luhi ka ku lan yiɣisi ba zali.
en: Because they have no regard for what the LORD has done, no regard for his handiwork, God will tear them down and never rebuild!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti zaŋ nyin Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl ŋun nyɛ n dabili ŋɔ n-zali zaashe tital ni ka a be kaman n nintu shɛli din dihiri gbana la, dama mani m-piig a. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But tell my servant Zerubbabel that I, the Lord All-Powerful, have chosen him, and he will rule in my name.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam deei n tumo deela mani, ka ŋunkam mi deei ma deela ŋun tim ma na.
en: I tell you for certain that anyone who welcomes my messengers also welcomes me, and anyone who welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me.

dag: Bɛ ku Izraɛl jilima zoya din du pam zuɣu, ka wɔɣira lu.
en: Israel, your beauty was ruined on your hills. Oh, how those heroes fell!.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ nyama, Yawɛ zaŋla ʒiri shia niŋ a daanabinim ŋɔ zaa noya ni. Yawɛ yɛlila zaɣ biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: Ahab, this is exactly what has happened. The Lord made all your prophets lie to you, and he knows you will soon be destroyed.

dag: Ka o ma daa ŋmaligi yɛli yili maa ni bihi, O yi ti yɛli ya ni yi niŋm shɛlikam, yin niŋmiya li.
en: His mother told the servants, Do whatever he tells you.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, M bi tim ba yi sanna, amaa bɛ zaŋ n yuli tɔɣisirila ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa ni di chɛ ka n kari ya bahi ka yi mini bɛna anabinim bɛn tɔɣisiri ya anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa ti kpi. .
en: Those prophets claim to be speaking for the Lord , but he didn't send them. They are lying! If you do what they say, he will have both you and them dragged off to another country and killed. The Lord has spoken.

dag: Di simdi ka n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ka nya faako. Di simdi ni n yaai n noli garigi.
en: I must speak so that I will feel better. I must answer your arguments.

dag: Di saha ka Ahimɛlɛk daa garigi yɛli, Naa, a sapashin kpamba ŋɔ ni ŋuni n-lee ʒe a yim kaman Dauda ŋun nyɛ nyin naa deemba, ka lan nyɛ a tɔbbi shɛb bɛn gul a sapashin kpɛma ni ŋun mali jilima a yili ŋɔ n-gari sokam la?.
en: Your Majesty, none of your officers is more loyal than David! Ahimelech replied. He's your son-in-law and the captain of your bodyguard. Everyone in your family respects him.

dag: Dabili ŋun mali yɛm ni ti su bidɔɣiro ŋun tumdi vi tuma, ka ni ti di fali kaman daŋ ni nir la.
en: A smart servant will gain control over his masters foolish son. He will be treated like a son and get a share of the inheritance.

dag: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa yɛli sapashinnim bɛn su tɔbbihi fukumsi la, Zaŋmiy o doli guliba maa sunsuuni gari, ka zaŋ takɔb ku ŋunkam be o polo. Dama maligumaana maa daa yɛlimi, Di kuny o Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: Then the priest Jehoiada ordered the unit commanders who were in charge of the army: Take her out under guard, he told them, and kill anyone who follows her. This was because the priest had said, She must not be executed in the LORDs temple.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, yil yini puuni niriba anu noya ni ti woli. Niriba ata ni ti naai noli zaɣisi niriba ayi, ka niriba ayi mi ni ti zaɣisi niriba ata maa.
en: From now on a family of five will be divided, three against two and two against three.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa lo naa alikauli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni. Ka Jɛhɔiada daa yɛli ba, N-nyɛ nabia maa, chɛliya ka o di nam kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Dauda zuliya polo la.
en: The entire assembly made a covenant with the king in Gods temple. Jehoiada said, Look! Here is the kings son. He must be king, just as the LORD promised about Davids descendants.

dag: A yi be mɔpilli zuɣusaa larigi ni di so ni a mini yidaampaɣ so ŋun bɔri zabili pam laɣim be yil ni.
en: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.

dag: Hal bɛ ni kul yɛra, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, di zaa yoli bɛ pɔri maa nyɛla ʒiri pɔri.
en: Even though you claim to worship the Lord , you do not mean what you say.

dag: amaa ŋunkam chihi dimbɔŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ Yisa polo pala ŋun mali Shi so ŋun yi Naawuni sanna. Ka shia ŋɔ nyɛla shi so ŋun yi Masiachihira sanna, ka yi mi pun wum ni o ni ti kana, ka hal o pun be dunia ŋɔ ni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: But anyone who denies this about Jesus does not have the Spirit from God. The spirit that he has is from the Enemy of Christ; you heard that it would come, and now it is here in the world already.

dag: Zuɣusaa niriba maa ni daa kpuɣi ninsalinim bipuɣinsi dɔɣi bihi saha shɛli mini di saha maa nyaaŋa ka tiyaawumyanim daa piligi be dunia ŋɔ ni. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛn mali kpiɔŋ kurimbuni maa ha ni bɛn mali yuya.
en: In those days, and even later, there were giants on the earth who were descendants of human women and the heavenly beings. They were the great heroes and famous men of long ago.

dag: Ka yi daa vu m-mirina ti zani zoli maa gbini, ka zoli maa daa taai buɣim n-kpuɣi du sagbana ni, ka sagbana daa zibigi lim li.
en: Mount Sinai was surrounded by deep dark clouds, and fire went up to the sky. You came to the foot of the mountain.

dag: Naawuni, m paɣir a. Di shini ma!.
en: I praise you, God! Don't keep silent.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa bɔhi Aizaia, Ka bɔ n-lee yɛn nyɛ Yawɛ ni yɛli ni o ni chɛ ka n kpaŋ maa mini n ni yɛn chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu daba ata dali maa shihirili? Ka Aizaia garigi yɛli.
en: Hezekiah said to Isaiah, What is the sign that the LORD will heal me and that Ill be able to go up to the LORDs temple in three days.

dag: Amaa yi ni daa niŋ ma nirilim sɔŋ ma n wahala puuni la viɛli pam.
en: But it was good that you helped me when I needed help.

dag: O ni daa ti nya ka o ku lan tooi sɔɣ o yaha, ka o daa kpuɣi bɛ ni zaŋ kulikaɣa wuɣi piɛ shɛli n-zaŋ kootaali tanta li din ni chɛ ka kom ku tooi kpe di ni. Ka o daa zaŋ o bia maa niŋ di ni n-zaŋ li chaŋ ti zali kaɣili ni mɔɣili duli.
en: But when she could not hide him any longer, she took a basket made of reeds and covered it with tar to make it watertight. She put the baby in it and then placed it in the tall grass at the edge of the river.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zɔri ni bɛ ti du tampima, ka zaŋ kur tibisa anahi din bari ŋariŋ maa zaani bahi kɔtiŋa di nyaaŋa polo, ka kari bɛ buɣa ka jiɣiri biɛɣu neebu zuɣu.
en: Afraid that we might run aground somewhere on the rocks, they hurled out four anchors from the stern and began to pray for daylight.

dag: Salo maa ni daa baŋ ni o nyɛla Yɛhudia nir maa ka bɛ zaŋ kaman awa mun ayi n-duhi bɛ yee yɛra, Ɛfɛsusnim buɣili Aritɛmis galisiya pam! Ɛfɛsusnim buɣili Aritɛmis galisiya pam.
en: But when the crowd saw that he was Jewish, they all shouted for two hours, Great is Artemis, the goddess of the Ephesians.

dag: Ka a zaŋ li sɔŋ pie taba kulis ayi salima teebuli la zuɣu. Kul yini kam zuɣu zaɣ kpil ayɔbu.
en: You must place them in two stacks, six in a stack, on the pure table before the LORD.

dag: Maliya kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni pam, di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhiri bɛ zuɣu, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni be yi sani; o ku chɛ ka yi kɔŋ nasara bee n-chɛn ya bahi.
en: Be strong! Be fearless! Dont be afraid and dont be scared by your enemies, because the LORD your God is the one who marches with you. He wont let you down, and he wont abandon you.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa tim ti yɛli Hiram.
en: Solomon sent back this message to Hiram:.

dag: Di simdi ni yi doli bɛ ni kahigi zaligu maa wuhi shɛm bee bɛ ni ŋmaai yɛtɔɣa maa shɛm. Di ti ŋmaligiya kpa yi nudirigu polo bee yi nuzaa polo ka chɛ bɛ ni ŋmaai yɛtɔɣa maa shɛm tin ya.
en: Act precisely according to the instruction they give you and the ruling they announce to you. Dont deviate even a bit from the word they announce.

dag: Ti yaannim ni daa paɣir a ti jɛmbu du kasi shɛli puuni la, buɣim di li, ka luɣ shɛŋa zaa din viɛli ka ti daa yuri li la wurim doya.
en: Our ancestors worshiped you in our holy Temple. That wonderful Temple has now been burned. All our precious possessions have been destroyed.

dag: Paɣ zinalan biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: O dirimi ka nyɛh o noli ka yɛli, M bi tum gala.
en: This is how an unfaithful wife acts: she commits adultery, takes a bath, and says, But I haven't done anything wrong.

dag: A zaligu zuɣu ka binshɛɣukam beni zuŋɔ, dama binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla a daba.
en: Your rules endure to this day because everything serves you.

dag: Daadam, tin shɛli nim yi bi ʒe yim ni mani ka tum alahichi, ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu ka m mɔŋ ba bindirigu, ka chɛ ka kum lu bɛ zuɣu n-kuri ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri bɛn be di ni.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, suppose an entire nation sins against me, and I punish it by destroying the crops and letting its people and livestock starve to death.

dag: Dama nir yi guni bee o yi bi guni di zaa shɛli ka buchi, amaa biɛr palli malibu n-nyɛ din mali buchi.
en: It doesnt matter if anyone is circumcised or not. The only thing that matters is this new life we have from God.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daalibarika zuɣu ka n nyɛ n ni nyɛ so ŋɔ, ka o daalibarika zaŋ chaŋ m polo pala yoli, dama n tumiya gari bɛ zaa, amaa pa mani n-tum li, Naawuni daalibarika din be n ni maa n-tum li.
en: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, N ka laɣifu din ni ti a, amaa n ni mali shɛli, dina ka n yɛn ti a: Yisa Masia Nazarɛt nir yuli zuɣu, yiɣisim zani n-leei ŋun chana.
en: But Peter said, I dont have any silver or gold, but I do have something else I can give you. By the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth—stand up and walk.

dag: Nyin ninsala, ka a ni kariti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri ŋɔ tatabo saria ka amaŋmaŋ gba tumdi li maa, a tɛhiya ni a ni nya soli din ni doli yi Naawuni sariakaribo ni?.
en: But you, my friend, do those very things for which you pass judgment on others! Do you think you will escape God's judgment?.

dag: Yawɛ, mɔɣa zuɣu ka a suhu daa yiɣisi bahi la bee kulibɔna zuɣu ka a suhu daa yiɣisi bahi bee teeku zuɣu ka a suhu daa yiɣisi bahi saha shɛli a ni daa kpe a nasara dibu chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu ni ka yuri vɔri li la?.
en: Was the LORD raging against the rivers? Or was your anger directed against the rivers? Or was your fury directed against the sea when you rode on your horses or rode your chariots to victory?.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahi ni kɔbisinu.
en: Those enlisted from the tribe of Ephraim were .

dag: ka nya so ka o ʒe di sunsuuni ŋ-ŋmani daadam. O daa yɛla binyɛr wɔɣinli din chaŋ ti lim o napɔnvari, ka salima nyolɔrigu lo o nyɔɣu.
en: and among them there was what looked like a human being, wearing a robe that reached to his feet, and a gold band around his chest.

dag: Yi zuɣuri ni zaŋ ti siɣi yi naba ni zaa ka alaafee. Amaa dansi mini yuma din kabiri ʒim m-beni; di bi paɣi bee m-pɔbi, kpam mi bi niŋ bɔbili li ka di maha.
en: From head to toe, none are well— only bruises, cuts, and raw wounds, not treated, not bandaged, not soothed with oil.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Yi pun wum ka di sab yɛli kurimbuni ha, Miri ka a ku ninsala, ka ŋunkam ku ninsala ni ti be yɛla ni saria karibu shee.
en: You have heard that it was said to those who lived long ago, Dont commit murder, and all who commit murder will be in danger of judgment.

dag: Dama nyini n-galisi, ka tumd alahiziba tuma; a ko n-nyɛ Naawuni.
en: because you are awesome and a wonder-worker. You are God. Just you.

dag: N ni yu a zaligunim maa; n ku tam a yɛligu yɛla.
en: I enjoy your laws. I will not forget your word.

dag: Dama di nyɛla nɛma labisi ti yuuni yi sani; di ni ti nyɛla yuuni din be kasi; yi ni ti dila binshɛŋa din bili mɔɣu ni di yuuni maa.
en: That year is Jubilee. It will be a holy time for you. You will eat the crops that come from the field.

dag: Bɛ ni bi lihi Naawuni kaman Naawuni maa zuɣu ka o chɛ ba bahi, ka bɛ tɛhiri tɛhi biɛri ka tumdi din chihiri tumbu.
en: People did not think it was important to have a true knowledge of God. So God left them and allowed them to have their own worthless thinking. And so they do what they should not do.

dag: Zɛbulɔn tiŋgbani mini Naftali tiŋgbani din be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli zaŋ labi teeku polo, ka nyɛ tiŋgban shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Galili chɛfirinim tinsi la.
en: Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, on the road to the sea, on the other side of the Jordan, Galilee, land of the Gentiles!.

dag: O kɔr o biŋkɔbiri, ka zaŋ o wain gabi taba, ka mali bindira dibu shili zali.
en: She has had an animal killed for a feast, mixed spices in the wine, and set the table.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma garigi yɛli, N daa tɛhimi ni so ka kpe n-zɔri Naawuni, ka tɛhi ni bɛ ni ku ma m paɣ maa zuɣu, dina n-chɛ ka n niŋ lala maa.
en: Abraham said, I thought to myself, No one reveres God here and they will kill me to get my wife.

dag: Yɛhudia do so daa be Susa din nyɛ tinzuɣu maa ni ka o yuli booni Mɔdɛkai. O daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nira. Mɔdɛkai ba n-daa nyɛ Jair. O yaba n-daa nyɛ Shimɛi, ka o yab do kurili mi nyɛ Kish.
en: There in Susa lived a Jew named Mordecai son of Jair; he was from the tribe of Benjamin and was a descendant of Kish and Shimei.

dag: ka yɛra, Na so ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika! Suhudoo be alizanda ni! Paɣimiya Zallakudura Naa.
en: They shouted, Blessed is the king who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven and glory to God.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka o lan yi nti nya ka Izraɛlnim niriba ayi ŋmaligi zabira, ka o chaŋ ni o ti gooi ba ka yɛli, M mabihi, yi nyɛla mabi yinsi, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi lan ŋmaligi zabira.
en: The next day, Moses saw two of his own people fighting. He tried to make peace between them. He said, Men, you are brothers! Why are you trying to hurt each other.

dag: Ka o yi ti kpe luɣ kasi shee maa ni ni o ti yo alahichi samli, di bi simdi ka so kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni hal ka o ti yo omaŋmaŋ min o yiŋnim daalahichi samli ni Izraɛlnim zaa daalahichi samli, ka naanyi yina.
en: No one can be in the meeting tent from the time Aaron enters to make reconciliation in the inner holy area until the time he comes out. He will make reconciliation for himself, for his household, and for the whole assembly of Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni tooi pahi n zuɣu ka ti tuhi tɔb shɛli yi ni daa nya ka n tuhira, ka wum ni n na kul tuhiri li pumpɔŋɔ la.
en: You saw the difficulties I had to face, and you hear that I am still having troubles. Now you must face them too.

dag: Paɣiba, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu. Chɛliya ka o nol ni yɛligu kpe yi tiba ni. Wuhimiya yi bipuɣinsi kuyila, ka sokam wuh o ʒiʒiinikpee fabila.
en: Now, women of Judah, listen to the message from the Lord . Listen to the words from his mouth. Teach your daughters how to cry loudly. Each of them must learn to sing this funeral song:.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti nyuri wain dabisi shɛli din pahir ayi maa dali, ka naa lan bɔhi Ɛsta, Napaɣ Ɛsta, bɔ ka a lee kul bɔra? Bee bɔ ka a yɛn suhi ma? N ni zaŋ li ti a, hal di yi nyɛla n nam ŋɔ pirigili gba, n ni zaŋ li ti a.
en: the king said to her, This is the second day weve met for wine. What is your wish, Queen Esther? Ill give it to you. And what do you want? Ill do anything—even give you half the kingdom.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ zim sara maligu nti tooi li pal o nuu n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim asiba la zuɣu.
en: Then he presented the grain offering, took a handful from it, and completely burned it on the altar, in addition to the mornings entirely burned offering.

dag: Mɔabnima, mbusim be yi zuɣu! Yinim Chɛmɔshinima, Chɛmɔshi niriba ŋɔ ni bahi yoli zaa. O chɛ ka o bidibisi leei bɛn zo n-kpe yɔɣu, ka o bipuɣinsi mi leei Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn daba.
en: It is bad for you, Moab. You lost Chemoshs people. His sons ran away. His daughters were taken prisoners by Sihon, king of the Amorites.

dag: Bɔ saha ka a yɛn chɛ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ tɔɣisibu? Gbilisim tibili ka ti gba tɔɣisi.
en: How long? Would you all stop talking. Try to understand and then we can speak.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla nirilimlana ni ŋun be tibi. Ti Naawuni maa nyɛla nambɔzɔra.
en: You are kind, Lord , so good and merciful.

dag: Bɛ ni daa baptaizi ya saha shɛl la, yi mini Masia ka bɛ daa laɣim sɔɣi maa, ka yi mini Masia laɣim n-neei kum ni yi ni daa niŋ Naawuni ŋun daa neei Masia kum ni yiko tuma yɛda la zuɣu.
en: For when you were baptized, you were buried with Christ, and in baptism you were also raised with Christ through your faith in the active power of God, who raised him from death.

dag: Ka Firawuna Nɛko daa zaŋ Jɔsia bia Ɛliakim n-leei naa zal o ba Jɔsia zaani, ka taɣ o yuli m-bol o Jɛhoyakim. Ka o daa zaŋ Jɛhɔahaz n-kuli Ijipti, ka o ti kpi nimaani.
en: King Neco made Josiah's son Eliakim king of Judah as successor to Josiah, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. Joahaz was taken to Egypt by King Neco, and there he died.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Agiripa daa yɛli Pool, M bah a noli ni a tɔɣisi zabi amaŋ zuɣu. Ka Pool daa teeg o nuu ka piligi tɔɣisiri ni o chih omaŋ noli yɛra:.
en: Agrippa said to Paul, You may speak for yourself. So Paul gestured with his hand and began his defense.

dag: Dabiɛm ni ti kpe Tɛman tɔbbi biinsi, ka bɛ dimnim ti kpimsi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Iso Zoli maa zuɣu zaa.
en: The fighting men of Teman will be terrified, and every soldier in Edom will be killed.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ li tila kapintanim mini tammɛriba ni bɛ da kuɣ kpɛra mini yɔɣira ni gurilɔnima m-mali Juda nanim ni daa chɛ ka shɛli polo lu la me.
en: They then gave it to the carpenters and the builders to pay for quarried stone and lumber for rafters and beams in the buildings the kings of Judah had neglected.

dag: Amaa maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ni daa fiɣis o, o daa bi garigi shɛli.
en: Then, when the leading priests and the older Jewish leaders made their accusations against Jesus, he said nothing.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ ti ma vuhim luɣilikam, ka n ka dima bee zuɣubiɛɣu yɛl shɛli.
en: But now the Lord my God has given me peace on all my borders. I have no enemies, and there is no danger of attack.

dag: Ka saa daa gbaai nyaɣisibu ka tahira, ka vuri mɔni, ka tiŋgbani daa dam pam, ka tiŋgbani dambu lala tatabo daa na ʒi n-niŋ daadamnim nambu piligu ni zaŋ kana di saha maa.
en: There were lightning strikes, voices, and thunder, and a great earthquake occurred. The earthquake was greater than any that have occurred since there have been people on earth.

dag: Di ti tumiya tuma, amaa lee ti malimiyala bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ.
en: Present a food offering to the Lord and do none of your daily work.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ yɛda niŋbu kɔŋko gba, di yi bi tumdi tuma, di nyɛla yɛda kpiŋ.
en: In the same way, faith is dead when it doesnt result in faithful activity.

dag: Sokam birigiya, bɛ zaa laɣim dolila biriginsim soli; so kani n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi din tuhi, hal ninvuɣ yino gba kani.
en: They all turned away. They have become worthless together. There is no one who shows kindness. There is not even one. .

dag: Buɣim di yi tinsi, ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ nyɛ zaɣ nɛli. Tinzunnim fa yi tiŋgbɔŋ n-saɣim li yi ninni, ka di kpalimla zaɣ nɛli.
en: Your land is in ruins, and your cities are in flames. Your enemies have taken your land, and foreigners are taking what it produces. It looks like some foreigners destroyed it.

dag: Ka n daa kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nya paɣiba ayi ka bɛ yiɣiri kpari m polo na, ka bɛ kpiŋkpama ŋmani shinshingooro kpiŋkpama. Ka bɛ daa kpuɣ piɛɣu maa zuɣusaa n-zaŋ li yiɣi chaŋ.
en: Right after this I saw two women coming through the sky with wings outstretched like a stork in the wind. Suddenly they lifted the basket into the air.

dag: Suhudoo din lɔn ya tabili tab la zuɣu, chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye naŋgban yini malibu shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tiri ti la zuɣu.
en: You are joined together with peace through the Spirit. Do all you can to continue as you are, letting peace hold you together.

dag: N ni tim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn saɣindi na ka bɛ ti saɣim a. Bɛ zaa gbibila bɛ bidibbina. Bɛ ni ti ŋmahi yi sida da viɛl la n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim.
en: I will send men to destroy the palace, each armed with weapons. They will cut up your strong, beautiful cedar beams and throw them into the fire.

dag: Naawuni, a wum n ni lo alikauli shɛŋa la, ka pun ti ma pin shɛli a ni zaŋdi tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur a yuli sizuura la.
en: You have heard my promises, O God, and you have given me what belongs to those who honor you.

dag: ni di chɛ ka alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi sagbana tiŋli ŋɔ na baŋ ŋun Naawuni yɛm soya balibubalibu ni nyɛ shɛm cheechi zuɣu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: in order that at the present time, by means of the church, the angelic rulers and powers in the heavenly world might learn of his wisdom in all its different forms.

dag: Ka Taai Naa Hiram daa ti wum ni bɛ leei Sulemaana nam n-zal o ba zaashee, ka o daa tim tuumba Naa Sulemaana sani, dama Naa Hiram daa yuri Dauda pam.
en: King Hiram of Tyre had always been a friend of David's, and when he heard that Solomon had succeeded his father David as king, he sent ambassadors to him.

dag: Ka yi mi yi suhi li, yi bi nyari li, dama yi tɛha bi tuhi lala niŋbu ni; yi suhirila binshɛŋa yi ni yɛn zaŋ tum yimaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre nyaɣisim tuma.
en: And when you ask, you do not receive it, because your motives are bad; you ask for things to use for your own pleasures.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ kul ʒila o nam ʒiishee sahakam, ka zal o nam ʒiishee ni o kari saria.
en: But the LORD rules forever! He assumes his throne for the sake of justice.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Di yɛra, N na nyɛla bia, dama a ni chaŋ n ni tim a ni a chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa sani nti yɛli ba n ni zal a ni a yɛlim ba shɛlikam.
en: But the Lord said to me, Dont say, I am only a boy. You must go everywhere I send you and say everything I tell you to say.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n lan yɛri ya, saha kanna, hal di paaya gba, ka kpiimba ni ti wum Naawuni Bia maa kukoli, ka bɛnkam ti wum li ni mali nyɛvili.
en: I am telling you the truth: the time is coming—the time has already come—when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear it will come to life.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ ka n guhira. Nyini n Duuma Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun ni garigi ma.
en: But I wait for you, LORD! You will answer, my Lord, my God!.

dag: Ka n yi pirigi n ni mali shɛlikam zaa zaŋ tari, hal ka zaŋ n niŋgbuŋ ti ni bɛ nyo li buɣim, ka ka yurilim, dindina di ku ku ma buchi.
en: I may give away everything I have to help others, and I may even give my body as an offering to be burned. But I gain nothing by doing all this if I dont have love.

dag: Di saha ka ŋun nyɛ ŋun pun be tum kurimbuni ha la daa kana ti kari saria sɔŋ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ wuntizɔriba, ka saha daa paai ni wuntizɔriba maa deei nam su.
en: The little horn kept killing Gods holy people until the Ancient King came and judged him. The Ancient King announced his decision about the little horn. This judgment helped Gods holy people, and they received the kingdom.

dag: Amaa Dauda daa yi kul yirila Sool sani n-kun o ba sani Bɛtilihɛm ti gul o piɛri saha saha ka labira.
en: David would go back to Bethlehem from time to time, to take care of his father's sheep.

dag: ni yɛli Yawɛ, A sani n-nyɛ n sɔɣibu shee, ni m birini; Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n ni niŋ so naani ŋɔ.
en: I say to the LORD, You are my refuge, my stronghold! You are my God—the one I trust.

dag: Teemi Yisa Masia ŋun daa yi Naa Dauda zuliya ni na, ka nyɛ ŋun daa neei kum ni kaman n ni daa wuhi shɛm n lahibal suŋ molo molibu ni la yɛla.
en: Remember Jesus Christ. He is from the family of David. After Jesus died, he was raised from death. This is the Good News that I tell people.

dag: Gɔhi ni ti zibigi bɛ nam yiya ni mini goma ni gili bɛ tin shɛŋa ni, ka yɔbahi mini viri ni be nimaani.
en: Thorns will grow up in its palaces, weeds and brambles in its fortresses. It will be a dwelling for jackals, a home for ostriches.

dag: yɛra, Nyamiya, ti chanila Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ maligumaaniba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib nuu ni, ka bɛ ni ti di o saria yɛli ni bɛ kum o, ka zaŋ o ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima.
en: Look! he said. Were going up to Jerusalem. The Human One will be handed over to the chief priests and the legal experts. They will condemn him to death and hand him over to the Gentiles.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni nambɔzɔbo zuɣu, o yi ti chɛ ka di biɛɣ maa neesim neei yi alizanda ni na.
en: God's love and kindness will shine upon us like the sun that rises in the sky.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa lan labina ti yɛl o, Naa, A mi ni Miidianim mini Pɛriʒianim zaligu shɛŋa naa ni zali ku tooi taɣi.
en: Then Daniel's enemies came back to the king and said to him, Your Majesty knows that according to the laws of the Medes and Persians no order which the king issues can be changed.

dag: A niriba Izraɛlnim yi ti tum alahichi a sani ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ dimnim nyaŋ ba, amaa di nyaaŋa ka bɛ labina ti bol a yuli, ka fabili niŋ a, ka suh a, duu ŋɔ puuni.
en: If your people Israel are defeated by an enemy because they have sinned against you, but then they change their hearts, give thanks to your name, and ask for mercy in your presence at this temple.

dag: Ka Pita lan yɛl o, Hal bɛ yi ni ku m min a gba, n ku chihi ni m bi mi a. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa zaa daa yɛl lala.
en: Peter said, Even if I must die alongside you, I wont deny you. All the disciples said the same thing.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti sɔɣi ba din ni chɛ ka bɛ nya jilima dahin shɛli n ni ti yɛn wuhi ba n jilima ni nyɛ shɛm maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Everyone will help with the burial, and they will be honored for this on the day the brightness of my glory is seen.

dag: N ni suhiri Naawuni yi zuɣu shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N suhiri Naawuni ni yi yurilim mini yi baŋsim maŋli zaŋ tabili yi suhuri ni baŋbu zoori pahira.
en: I pray that your love will keep on growing more and more, together with true knowledge and perfect judgment.

dag: A chɛ ka ti leela daɣiri mini saɣiri zuliya shɛb sani.
en: You made us trash and garbage in front of all other people.

dag: Ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa ti mal li paɣiri bɛ nuhi mini bɛ naba.
en: Aaron and his sons must wash their hands and feet with the water from this bowl.

dag: A wuntitali nyɛla wuntitali din bi naara, ka a zaligunim nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: Your righteousness lasts forever! Your Instruction is true!.

dag: A ni yɛli ti yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Yawɛ yuli ni ŋɔ, ti ku wum a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: We refuse to listen to what you have told us in the name of the Lord .

dag: Ka o daa niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka yɛli ba, Dɔɣimiya ka wɔɣi n-nab pali teeku mini dunia.
en: Then he gave the living creatures his blessing—he told the ocean creatures to increase and live everywhere in the ocean and the birds to increase everywhere on earth.

dag: Ka niriba daa yi daŋdi yibu chan o sani Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni ti wumd o yɛtɔɣa.
en: Every morning all the people got up early to go listen to Jesus at the Temple.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb malila bɛ chɛchɛbunsi nyuri bara; ka shɛb mi mali bɛ yuri nyuri bara, amaa tinim malila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ yuli nyuri bara.
en: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.

dag: Ka Gaad daa kana ti yɛli Dauda, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm bɔŋɔ, piim a ni bɔri shɛli.
en: When Gad came to David, he said to him, This is what the LORD says: Take your choice.

dag: Di bi simdi ka dabindi be yi yinsi daba ayopɔin maa ni. Ka ŋunkam di binshɛli din mali dabindi, dilan ni yi Izraɛlnim laɣiŋgu ni, dilan yi nyɛla sana bee tiŋbia.
en: For seven days no yeast should be found in your houses because whoever eats leavened bread will be cut off from the Israelite community, whether the person is an immigrant or a native of the land.

dag: Ka Naa Ɛla ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum tuun shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: The rest of what Elah did is written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa gindi fɔntinsi mini tiŋkpansi yihiri waazu, ka mali Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ yɛla wuhiri niriba. Ka o nyaandoliba pinaayi la daa be o sani.
en: Some time later Jesus traveled through towns and villages, preaching the Good News about the Kingdom of God. The twelve disciples went with him.

dag: Mɔɣu ni mini fɔndi ni nima, paɣimiya Naawuni; Kɛdarinima, paɣimiy o. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Sɛla fɔŋ ni zoya zuɣu, tahimiya, ka yili yila ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Let the desert and its towns shout aloud, the villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the cliff dwellers sing; from the top of the mountains let them shout.

dag: Shɛli ka ti ni din ni chɛ ka ti yɛli ni ti nyɛla bɛn ni tooi tum tuma ŋɔ. Din chɛ ka ti tooi tumdi li yila Naawuni sanna.
en: It isnt that we ourselves are qualified to claim that anything came from us. No, our qualification is from God.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ zaa bɔh o, Ka daɣila a shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia? Ka o yɛli ba, Yi ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li.
en: They all said, Are you Gods Son, then? He replied, You say that I am.

dag: Di zɔrimi duri zoya, ka zɔri siɣiri vinvama ni n-chani ti dooni a ni zali ni di dɔni luɣ shɛli.
en: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.

dag: O daa lan yɛli ti, Yi mi di kul mɛnya yiya bee m-biri bimbira bee n-sa wain tihi bee m-mali dimbɔŋɔnim zaa shɛli. Amaa kul benya suɣa ni yi nyɛvili biɛhigu ni zaa din ni chɛ ka yi ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni yi ni be kaman saamba ŋɔ yuui.
en: or build houses or plant crops and vineyards. Instead, you must always live in tents and move from place to place. If you obey this command, you will live a long time.

dag: ti yɛl o, A bi mi ni Ammɔnnim naa Baalis timla Nɛtania bia Ishimail na ni o ti ku a? Amaa ka Ahikam bia Gɛdalia daa bi niŋ ba yɛda.
en: They said, Gedaliah, we came to warn you that King Baalis of Ammon hired Ishmael to murder you! Gedaliah refused to believe them.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, Yi mali so shɛŋa din ni doli zaɣisi Naawuni zaligunima, ka doli yimaŋmaŋ kaya!.
en: Jesus continued, Clearly, you are experts at rejecting Gods commandment in order to establish these rules.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan gbaai niriba maa yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ dunia ŋɔ neesim; ka ŋunkam doli ma ku be zibisim ni, amaa o ni malila nyɛvili neesim.
en: Jesus spoke to the Pharisees again. I am the light of the world, he said. Whoever follows me will have the light of life and will never walk in darkness.

dag: Yisifu ni daa dɔɣi bi shɛb Ijipti daa nyɛla bidibis ayi. Yaakubu yiŋnim zaa bɛn daa kuli Ijipti kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔin.
en: Josephs sons born to him in Egypt were persons. Thus, all of the persons in Jacobs household going to Egypt totaled .

dag: Zoya mini kunkuna ni tihi din wandi wala ni sida tihi zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars.

dag: Ka so kani ŋun mali suhukpeeni din ni tooi niŋ o ka o suhu yiɣisi. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zan o tooni?.
en: Nobody is fierce enough to rouse him; who then can stand before me?.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa laɣim bɛn daa be o sani maa na nti piripiri ba, ka niriba tuhili kam bee niriba kɔbiga kam mali di sapashin kpɛma.
en: David counted his men and chose captains over and captains over to lead them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ dabisi shɛŋa kum o kuli maa ni daa ti gari, ka Yisifu daa yɛli Firawuna yiŋnima, N suhiri ya, yi nini yi tiɣi ma, yin yɛlimiya Firawuna.
en: When the time of mourning was over, Joseph said to the king's officials, Please take this message to the king:.

dag: Timiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jilima din ni chɛ ka o ku tahi zibisim na, ka yi tuui zoya zuɣu wuntaŋ ni; yi yi ti bɔri neesim saha shɛli, o chɛrimi ka di niŋ zibisim titali, ka chɛ ka di niŋ bumbɔni.
en: Honor the Lord your God. Praise him or he will bring darkness. Praise him before you fall on the dark hills. You people of Judah are hoping for light, but the Lord will turn the light into thick darkness. He will change it into the deepest gloom.

dag: N ni suhiri Naawuni yi zuɣu shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N suhiri Naawuni ni yi yurilim mini yi baŋsim maŋli zaŋ tabili yi suhuri ni baŋbu zoori pahira.
en: This is my prayer for you: that your love will grow more and more; that you will have knowledge and understanding with your love;.

dag: Bɛ lɛbila yɛla pili ma. Yaɣimɛra mini yaɣiri pala yim. Bɛ ni mali binshɛli ku tooi yɛli ŋun mal li, Pa nyini m-mali ma; bee bɛ ni nam bin so ku tooi yɛli ŋun nam o, A bi nam ma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: They turn everything upside down. Which is more important, the potter or the clay? Can something you have made say, You didn't make me? Or can it say, You don't know what you are doing?.

dag: M bolila n tumtumda, amaa ka o bi garigi ma. Di simdi ni mmaŋmaŋ balim o.
en: I call my servant, and he doesnt answer; I myself must beg him.

dag: N Duuma Naawuni ni tin ya din simdi ya zaa o bundaantali din be Yisa Masia ni la zaa puuni.
en: And with all his abundant wealth through Christ Jesus, my God will supply all your needs.

dag: A na mi n-kpe bɛ ni zaŋ saa ŋun noli maai pam zali du shɛŋa ni, bee a na mi n-nya bɛ ni zaŋ sakuɣa zali du shɛŋa ni.
en: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail.

dag: Di saha maa ka Midiannim mini Amalɛknim ni wulimpuhili polo nim zaa daa laɣim kana ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-zaŋ bɛ tantinim ti kpa Jɛziriil Vinvamli ni.
en: All the Midianites, Amalekites, and other eastern nations got together and crossed the Jordan River. Then they invaded the land of Israel and set up camp in Jezreel Valley.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ku shɛb tɔb ni la daa so kum ni daa ku shɛba la. Bɛ daa mɔŋ ba puri ni bindirigu, ka kum ʒi ba chaŋ.
en: It was better for those who were killed by the sword than for those who died of hunger. Those starving people were sad and hurt. They died because they got no food from the field.

dag: Dama n yɛn chɛmi ka Babilɔnnim bɛn nyɛ ninkuunsinim mini bɛn tahiri damli dambu na, ka nyɛ bɛn chani gindi dunia ŋɔ zaa ni bɛ tuhi fa yiya din pa bɛ dini ŋɔ nya yaa.
en: I am about to rouse the Chaldeans, that bitter and impetuous nation, which travels throughout the earth to possess dwelling places it does not own.

dag: Gidiɔn kum nyaaŋa, di daa bi yuui ka Izraɛlnim lan ŋmaligi jɛmdila Baalnima. Bɛ daa zaŋla alikauli lɔbu Baal n-leei bɛ wuni.
en: Soon after Gideon's death, the Israelites turned their backs on God again. They set up idols of Baal and worshiped Baal Berith as their god.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ o kɔhimma nyɔri ti yaɣi ni o nya buni pam, o bɔri li zaanila ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋdi nandaamba nirilim.
en: If you make money by charging high interest rates, you will lose it all to someone who cares for the poor.

dag: Yisifu daa piila o biɛyanim maa ni niriba anu n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ti wuhi Firawuna.
en: From all of his brothers, he selected five men and presented them before Pharaoh.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba maa ni pam ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ bɛ daa yɛlimi, Yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ din kpɛm pam; ŋuni n-lee ni tooi deei li.
en: Many of Jesus' disciples heard him and said, This is too hard for anyone to understand.

dag: Bɛ loya ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ zahima maa n-chɛ ka n niriba tam n yɛla saha shɛli bɛ ni tɔɣisiri tab di yɛla maa, kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa tam n yɛla ka jɛmdi Baal shɛm la.
en: They think that the dreams they tell will make my people forget me, just as their ancestors forgot me and turned to Baal.

dag: Ŋunkam bɔri ni o tilig o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋ o nyɛvili ni ti lan nya li.
en: People who try to save their lives will lose them, and those who lose their lives will save them.

dag: ka yuri jilima ʒiishɛhi ʒinibu bɛ churi puhibu ni, ka yuri ʒiishe viɛla ni ʒinibu bɛ jɛmbu duri ni;.
en: They love the best places at feasts and the reserved seats in the synagogues;.

dag: Bɛ daa naɣ yɛl ti mi ni bɛ bɔri ni ti teeri nandaamba bɛn be bɛ ni yɛla, ka n gba suhu ni daa pun ye shɛli niŋbu zuɣu n-daa bala.
en: All they asked was that we should remember the needy in their group, which is the very thing I have been eager to do.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ ni yino yɛl o, Biɛhiŋ kani, zaŋ chaŋ yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, n ni lab a sanna, ka a paɣ Zara ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga. Ka Zara daa be o nyaaŋa tanti suɣili dunol ni n-wumda.
en: One of them said, Nine months from now I will come back, and your wife Sarah will have a son. Sarah was behind him, at the door of the tent, listening.

dag: Ka o daa boli bia maa yuli Ikabɔd ka yɛli, Naawuni jilima yi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni! Bɛ ni daa fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la min o yidan ba ni o yidan ni daa kpi zuɣu.
en: She named the baby Ichabod, that is to say, Israels glory has been taken away. She did this because Gods Holy Box was taken away and because both her father-in-law and her husband were dead.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim ni nya alibarika pam, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri ni o nya buni yomyom ku yi tibidarigibo ni.
en: Honest people will lead a full, happy life. But if you are in a hurry to get rich, you are going to be punished.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa zali Jɔab mini Abishai ni Itai zaligu n-yɛli N zuɣu, miriya ka yi niŋ nachimbil Absalom shɛli. Ka niriba maa zaa daa wum naa ni zali sapashin kpamba maa zaligu shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Absalom polo maa.
en: The king gave a command to Joab, Abishai, and Ittai. He said, Do this for me: Be gentle with young Absalom! Everyone heard the kings orders about Absalom to the captains.

dag: Dinzuɣu kum ni neebu dali, ŋun paɣa n-lee ni ti nyɛ o? Dama bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa zaa daa kpuɣ o mi.
en: When God raises people from death, whose wife will this woman be? All seven brothers had married her.

dag: Haman daa lan yɛli, Ka din gari lala nyɛla, n kɔŋko n-nyɛ Napaɣ Ɛsta ni boli so pahi naa zuɣu ni ti kana nti di bindira ka nyu binnyura. Hal o lan bol ti ni ti sa labina biɛɣuni yaha.
en: And thats not all, Haman added. Im the only one Queen Esther invited to be with the king at the party she gave. And the Queen also has invited me to be with the king again tomorrow.

dag: Mbusim be yinim gba zuɣu sokam yi ti paɣiri ya saha shɛli, dama lala ka bɛ yaannim daa pun niŋ anab ʒirinim la.
en: How terrible for you when all speak well of you. Their ancestors did the same things to the false prophets.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa yɛli Musa, Yim n sani, Miri ka a lan chɛ ka n nya a yaha. N nini yi ti lan nya a, n ni ku a.
en: He said to Moses, Get out of my sight! Don't let me ever see you again! On the day I do, you will die.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ pahi yɛli, Alizanda nam lan ŋmanila lan shɛli kulipalinim ni zaŋ lab kom ni n-gbahi zahim balibu kam;.
en: Also, the Kingdom of heaven is like this. Some fishermen throw their net out in the lake and catch all kinds of fish.

dag: dama zuliya kam pun nyu o kɔr biɛri wain la, ka dunia nanim niŋ zina o sani, ka dunia kɔhigɔriba niŋ bundaannima o kɔr biɛri din galisi pam maa zuɣu.
en: because all the nations have fallen due to the wine of her lustful passion. The kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth became rich from the power of her loose and extravagant ways.

dag: Alizanda nam ŋmanila na so ŋun daa yɛn puh o bia daamiliya lɔbu chuɣu.
en: The kingdom of heaven is like what happened when a king gave a wedding banquet for his son.

dag: N ni daa kari yi yaannim saria Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni tiŋgban nɛli ni shɛm la, lala ka n yɛn kari yi gba saria. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will now condemn you just as I condemned your ancestors in the Sinai Desert, says the Sovereign Lord .

dag: N ni tɔɣis a zaligunim maa yɛla nanim tooni, ka ku zo vi.
en: I will announce your commands to kings and I will not be ashamed.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi, ka bɛ daa laɣisi bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi mini zimburisa din guui pal piɛr ayopɔin.
en: The crowd of about , people ate all they wanted, and the leftovers filled seven large baskets. As soon as Jesus had sent the people away.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yiɣis o suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu pam ka ŋmaligi chaŋ.
en: The Lord was angry with them; and so as he departed.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ tarimba mal alibarika, dama bɛ ni ti su dunia ŋɔ.
en: Happy are those who are humble; they will receive what God has promised!.

dag: N daa yɛli ya, Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, dinzuɣu miriya ka yi jɛm Amɔrinim shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi ni be ŋɔ wuna la. Amaa ka yi zaɣisi n noli.
en: I told you, I am the LORD your God; you must not worship the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you are living. But you have not obeyed me.

dag: Chɛ ka n jɛma tiɣ a nini, dama m mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ zuɣu.
en: May he be pleased with my song, for my gladness comes from him.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Neesim shɛŋa neemiya zuɣusaa sagbana ni n-woligi wuntaŋ ni ka chɛ yuŋ, ka neesim maa wuhiri shihira ni saha ni dabisa ni yuma;.
en: Then God commanded, Let lights appear in the sky to separate day from night and to show the time when days, years, and religious festivals begin;.

dag: Sɔŋmiya Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn be wahala ni, ka niŋmiya saani.
en: Contribute to the needs of Gods people, and welcome strangers into your home.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Bɛtɛl Naawuni, luɣ shɛl a ni daa booi kpam bahi bimbini zuɣu ka po pɔri n san la. Yiɣisim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni lab bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni pumpɔŋɔ. .
en: and I am the God you worshiped at Bethel, when you poured olive oil on a rock and made a promise to me. Leave here at once and return to the land where you were born.

dag: Yi yi di nyɛla dunia ŋɔ ni su ninvuɣ shɛba, dunianim naan yuri ya, amaa yi pala dunia ni su shɛba, dama mani m-pii ya, dinzuɣu ka dunia ŋɔ nim jɛn ya maa.
en: If you belonged to the world, the world would love you as it loves its own people. But I have chosen you to be different from those in the world. So you dont belong to the world, and that is why the world hates you.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli maa paai ma, ka tiligi ma kaman a daalikauli ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Lord , show me your faithful love. Save me, as you promised.

dag: Bɛ yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Saimɔn, Yisa ni daa ti so yuli Pita la min o tizo Anduru ni Jeemsi mini Jɔn ni Filip mini Baatolomiu.
en: Simon , Andrew, brother of Peter, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew.

dag: Kum chɛ ka bɛ lan ka yaa, ka barina do n-gu ba ni di chɛ ka bɛ tuui.
en: Starving, they run, only to meet disaster.

dag: Ka Yisa daa wum lala maa ka yɛli ba, Bɛn mal alaafee bi bɔri dɔɣite naɣila bɛn biɛra; pa wuntizɔriba zuɣu ka n kana, amaa alahichinim tuuba niŋbu zuɣu ka n kana.
en: Jesus heard them and answered, People who are well do not need a doctor, but only those who are sick. I have not come to call respectable people, but outcasts.

dag: Di zuɣu ka Naawuni daa pii ma leei di molomoona mini tumo ni karimba ŋun ni wuhi bɛn pa Yɛhudianim yɛda niŋbu mini yɛlimaŋli soli yɛla. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri maa; m bi ŋmarila ʒiri!.
en: And I was chosen as an apostle to tell people that message. I was chosen to teach those who are not Jews to believe and understand the truth.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa Kaiafas yiŋ maa ni n-tahi Gomna yiŋa asibaasi. Bɛmaŋmaŋ daa bi saɣi doli kpe Gomna yiŋ maa ni, dama bɛ daa bi bɔri ni bɛ tum birigi bɛ kali din ni chɛ ka daɣiri tab ba ka bɛ ku tooi di Yaɣigari Chuɣu bindirigu.
en: It was early in the morning when Jesus was taken from Caiaphas to the building where the Roman governor stayed. But the crowd waited outside. Any of them who had gone inside would have become unclean and would not be allowed to eat the Passover meal.

dag: dindina Yawɛ ni chɛ ka dɔr biɛri ni alahiziba dɔriti din ku naai lu yi mini yi bihi zuɣu.
en: he will punish you and your descendants with incurable diseases.

dag: Dinzuɣu yihimiya dabin kura la yi sunsuuni din ni chɛ ka yi leei bɔrɔbɔro ziŋŋɔriti palli din ka dabindi kaman di ni simdi ni yi be shɛm. Dama Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Yaɣigari Chuɣu Piɛbil la pun zaŋ omaŋ mali sara.
en: Get rid of the old yeast! Then you will be like fresh bread made without yeast, and this is what you are. Our Passover lamb is Christ, who has already been sacrificed.

dag: ŋun daa chɛ o yidaan tuuli, ka tam o ni daa lo Naawuni alikauli shɛli yɛla la.
en: She married when she was young, but then she left her husband. She forgot the marriage vows she made before God.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kali Mɛrari zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ mini bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: The enrollment of the Merarite clans by their clans and their households.

dag: ka Gomna Pailɛt lan bɔh o yaha, A ka noli din ni garigi? A bi wum bɛ ni fiɣisir a shɛm maa.
en: so Pilate questioned him again, Aren't you going to answer? Listen to all their accusations.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ŋmani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ? Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ʒi nam kuɣu zuɣu zuɣusaa ha.
en: There is no one like the Lord our God. He sits on his throne high in heaven.

dag: Naawuni Bia maa zuɣu ka Naawuni daa zaŋ binshɛɣukam labisi omaŋmaŋ sani. Naawuni deeri sandaani la o Bia maa ʒim din daa yi dapulli zuɣu la zuɣu, ka zaŋdi binshɛɣukam din be dunia ŋɔ ni mini din be alizanda ni n-labisiri omaŋmaŋ sani.
en: and he reconciled all things to himself through him— whether things on earth or in the heavens. He brought peace through the blood of his cross.

dag: Ka niŋmiya tab nirilim, ka mali nambɔzɔbo biɛhigu, ka chɛri yi tab taali paŋdi ba kaman Naawuni ni daa chɛ m-paŋ yi gba Masia zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim o yiŋbi shɛb bɛn zooi gari o ni tuui tim shɛb maa, ka bɛ ti niŋ bɛ gba lala.
en: Again he sent other servants, more than the first group. They treated them in the same way.

dag: Ka yɛli, Laɣimmiya n niriba bɛn ʒe ma yim la ti ma na, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo ma sara maligu alikauli la.
en: Bring my faithful to me, those who made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

dag: Bihi bɛn nyɛ jɛra tirila bɛ banim suhugarigu, ka tiri bɛ ma ŋun dɔɣi ba biɛrim.
en: Foolish children upset their parents and make them sad.

dag: Ka Iso yɛl o, M mini kum kul chɛ tab la kpe ni kpe, ka buchi bɔ ka kpamdi lan yɛn ku ma.
en: Esau said, All right! I am about to die; what good will my rights do me.

dag: Malimi shili kaman doo la, ka m bɔh a ka a yɛli ma.
en: Prepare yourself like a man; I will interrogate you, and you will respond to me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntinsi pia Ifriim mini Dan ni Manaasa zuliya niriba pirigili la tiŋgbana ni ti Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn kpalim la.
en: The rest of the clan of Kohath was assigned ten cities from the territories of Ephraim, Dan, and West Manasseh.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi chɛ o yiya bee o mabi dɔbba bee o tizɔpaɣiba bee o ba bee o ma bee o bihi bee o puri n yuli zuɣu ni nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha bukɔbigakɔbiga, ka ti lan nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: And all who have left houses, brothers, sisters, father, mother, children, or farms because of my name will receive one hundred times more and will inherit eternal life.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ taɣimiya yi biŋkɔbiri, ka zaŋ yi binshɛɣukam zaa din be mɔɣu ni kulisi yiŋa, dama daadam bee biŋkɔbigu ŋun be mɔɣu ni ka bi kuli yiŋa, sakuɣa maa ni lu n-ku ba. .
en: You had better give orders for every person and every animal in Egypt to take shelter. If they don't, they will die.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli Tomas, Zaŋm a nubil bɔbili n nuhi ŋɔ ni, ka zaŋ a nuu tim m puluɣili bɔbili ŋɔ ni, ka niŋ yɛda.
en: Then he said to Thomas, Put your finger here. Look at my hands. Put your hand into my side. No more disbelief. Believe.

dag: Di ni nyɛ nyini n-fa bɛ yɛm ka bɛ bi lan mi shɛli maa, dinzuɣu a ku chɛ ka bɛ di nasara.
en: Youve closed their mind to insight; therefore, you wont be exalted.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, N yɛri ya la dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni yi di ti birigi.
en: I have said these things to you so that you wont fall away.

dag: Yinim Lakishinima, zaŋmiya chɛchɛbunsi ga yuri, di daa nyɛla alahichi piligu Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga sani, dama a ni ka bɛ daa nya Izraɛlnim biriginsim.
en: Get the war chariots ready, you people of Lachish. You led Jerusalem into sin, just as Israel did.

dag: Ka Pita mini nyaandol ŋun maa daa yina n-zaŋ kpa siliga maa polo.
en: So Peter and the other follower started going to the tomb.

dag: Naa Lɛmuɛl yɛtɔɣa, din nyɛ o ma ni daa wuh o anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: These are the solemn words which King Lemuel's mother said to him:.

dag: Ka yi yi tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla, ka doli wun shɛŋa n-tumdi bɛ ni bɔri shɛm ka jɛmdi li, nimmoo ka n yɛri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, biɛhiŋ kani, yi ni kpi.
en: Never forget the Lord your God or turn to other gods to worship and serve them. If you do, then I warn you today that you will certainly be destroyed.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa tim tuumba ka bɛ zo n-chaŋ o suɣili maa ni nti shiri nya ka di pi tiŋa ka anzinfa maa be di gbinni.
en: Then Joshua sent messengers. They ran to the tent. There it was, hidden in his tent, with the silver on the bottom.

dag: Yinim teeku noli tinsinim mini Sidɔnnima, maamiya yi ni. Yi daabihi bela teeku ni bɔri azichi tiri ya.
en: You people living near the sea, mourn in silence. The merchants of Sidon sent traders across the sea and filled the city with riches.

dag: Ka zuliya kam nim maa ti baŋ ni Izraɛlnim tuumbiɛri zuɣu ka bɛ gbahi ba leei daba chaŋ maa, dama bɛ daa nyɛla bɛn bi ʒe yim n sani, dinzuɣu ka n daa ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋa, ka zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku bɛ zaa.
en: Foreign nations will realize that the Israelites were forced to leave their own land because they sinned against me. I turned my back on my people and let enemies attack and kill them.

dag: Paɣ yi nya sɔrilim din nyɛ o ni pun nyari shɛli sahakam, o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni daba ayopɔin, ka ŋunkam shih o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If a woman has a discharge from her monthly time of bleeding, she will be unclean for seven days. Anyone who touches her will be unclean until evening.

dag: Musa daa zali ba, Yuma ayopɔin kam ni, saha shɛli din nyɛ yi ni kuri sama tiri taba, ka nyɛ suɣa tibu chuɣu puhibu saha la.
en: Moses then commanded them: At the end of seven years, at the appointed time in the year of debt cancellation, during the Festival of Booths.

dag: amaa ka n daa ti lan gariti nimaani ka bɛ kani; ka n lihi bo ba ka bi nya ba.
en: But then he was gone. I looked for him, but I could not find him.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ galima be n niriba maa ni, bɛ nyɛla bɛn fari bɛ tab nɛma. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bariti zana kaman nooŋgbahiriba la n-gbahiri ninsalinima.
en: Evildoers live among my people; they lie in wait like those who lay nets to catch birds, but they have set their traps to catch people.

dag: Amaa yinim lihi ʒiɛmla nandaamba. Pa bundaannima n-nahindi ya la? Pa bɛna n-dariti ya tahiri ʒiishee la?.
en: You mistreat the poor. But isn't it the rich who boss you around and drag you off to court?.

dag: Di saha n yi ti laɣim ya, n ni zaŋ ya kuli yiŋa, dama n ni chɛ ka yi yuli du, ka yi nya jilima dunianim zaa sani saha shɛli n yi ti lan labisi yi daazichi la na ka yi nina nya li. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: At that time I will lead you back home. I will bring your people back together. I will cause people everywhere to honor and praise you. You will see me bring back all the blessings you once had. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Ka wain booriba kpɛm la daa yɛli Yisifu o zahindi ni nyɛ shɛm. O daa yɛl o mi, Zahindi maa ni n sa nyami ka wain tia ʒe n tooni.
en: The king's personal servant told Joseph, In my dream I saw a vine.

dag: Ka malaika so gba daa yi alizanda ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu na n-gbibi gɔr dirili.
en: Then another angel came out of the temple in heaven. This angel also had a sharp sickle.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Jɛrusalɛm m-bɔŋɔ, mani n-zaŋ li zali zuliya pam sunsuuni, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbɔna pam gil li.
en: The Sovereign Lord said, Look at Jerusalem. I put her at the center of the world, with other countries all around her.

dag: Mɔɣu ni mini fɔndi ni nima, paɣimiya Naawuni; Kɛdarinima, paɣimiy o. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Sɛla fɔŋ ni zoya zuɣu, tahimiya, ka yili yila ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Tell the tribes of the desert and everyone in the mountains to celebrate and sing.

dag: ka ti mabia ŋun mi nyɛ azichilana ka Naawuni siɣis o, di simdi ni o gba mali suhupiɛlli, dama azichilana ni ti vuui kaman mɔpuma ni kpahiri luri shɛm la.
en: But any who are rich should be glad when God makes them humble. Rich people will disappear like wild flowers.

dag: Dinzuɣu piɛguliba, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: So listen to me, you shepherds.

dag: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali ka bɛ daa vihi do shɛb bɛn kpuɣ tinzun paɣiba maa yɛla maa zaa naai.
en: And by the first day of the first month, they finished discussing all the men who had married foreign women.

dag: ni Jɔa ni Iddo ni Zɛra ni Jiatɛrai.
en: Joah was Zimmahs son. Iddo was Joahs son. Zerah was Iddos son. Jeatherai was Zerahs son.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa ti tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa yɛla; ka o daa zaŋ ba niŋ Sisɛra ŋun daa nyɛ Hazɔrinim naa Jabin sapashin kpɛm la nuu ni. Ka lan zaŋ ba niŋ Filistianim mini Mɔabnim nanim nuu ni, ka bɛ daa ŋme ba tɔbu.
en: But your ancestors forgot the Lord , so he let them be defeated by the Philistines, the king of Moab, and Sisera, the commander of Hazor's army.

dag: ka yi yɛli, Mbaye, n daa zaɣisi biɛrisuŋ, ka zaɣisi zuɣuni kpahibu.
en: and you will say, Why would I never learn? Why would I never let anyone correct me?.

dag: So yi mali dunia ŋɔ buni, ka nya o mabia ŋun simdi sɔŋbu ka yih o suhu o ni, wula ka Naawuni yurilim ni tooi be nira ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo ni?.
en: But if someone has material possessions and sees a brother or sister in need but refuses to help—how can the love of God dwell in a person like that?.

dag: M mabiyurisi, hal ti ni kul yɛri ŋ-ŋɔ maa zaa yoli, ti niŋ ya naani. Ti mi ni yi mali bin suma din yi yi tiliginsim ni na ka nyɛ din so binshɛɣukam.
en: But we are convinced of better things in your case, brothers and sisters, even though we are talking this way—things that go together with salvation.

dag: Yawɛ daa wuhi ti shihira ka tum alahiziba tuun kara din mali dabiɛm pam jɛndi Ijipti mini Firawuna ni o yiŋnim zaa ti ninni.
en: With our own eyes we saw him work miracles and do terrifying things to the Egyptians and to their king and to all his officials.

dag: Ka banim ka o daa po n-yɛli ni bɛ ku nya vuhim o san la? Pa bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn daa niŋ tipawumlinim la?.
en: And which people was God talking to when he promised that they would never enter his place of rest? He was talking to those who did not obey him.

dag: ka daa ʒi nimaani gul o.
en: After that they sat there and watched him.

dag: Amaa pa Yisa maŋmaŋa n-daa baptaiziri ba, o nyaandoliba n-daa baptaiziri ba.
en: Actually, Jesus himself did not baptize anyone; only his disciples did.

dag: Ka Hiburɔn daa leei Jɛfune ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛnizi nir la bia Kalɛb ni su shɛli hal ni zuŋɔ, o ni daa ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni yim la zuɣu.
en: Hebron still belongs to the descendants of Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, because he faithfully obeyed the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Dali gba bɛ daa ni bɔ a pam kɔŋ, dinzuɣu cham yɛla ŋɔ ni daa yiɣisina ka a sɔɣi luɣ shɛl la nti ŋuni kuɣa din duhiya la lɔŋni.
en: By the day after tomorrow, everyone will think you've been gone a long time. Then go to the place where you hid before and stay beside Going-Away Rock.

dag: Amaa binshɛɣukam bɛn ka gɔhi mini paɣiri, yin di ŋubiya ba. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam yi sani.
en: but anything living in the water that does not have fins and scales may not be eaten; it must be considered unclean.

dag: Kum mini kɔnyuri n-daa yɛn ku ba, hal ka bɛ daa ti yihi tahima.
en: They were hungry and thirsty and had given up all hope.

dag: Bɛ zilima ŋmanila piɛm din mali lɔɣu, di tɔɣisirila ʒiri yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ zaa tɔɣisirila zɔsimdi yɛtɔɣa bɛ ʒiʒiinitab sani, amaa bɛ suhuri ni, bɛ nyɛla bɛn sɔɣi dɔni gu ni bɛ tum barina.
en: Their tongues are like deadly arrows; they always tell lies. Everyone speaks friendly words to their neighbors, but they are really setting a trap for them.

dag: Izraɛlnima, wummiya Yawɛ ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni o yɛli yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ o ni daa yihi shɛb Ijipti na la:.
en: People of Israel, listen to this message! This is what the Lord said about you, Israel. This message is about all the families that I brought from the land of Egypt.

dag: Teemi ni a daa me ma mi kaman yaɣiri la, ka lan yɛn chɛ ka n leei taŋkpaɣu?.
en: Remember, you molded me like clay. Will you turn me into clay again?.

dag: Bɛ ni nyu li hal ti ʒiɛhira, ka bɛ yɛma fa, n ni yɛn zaŋ takɔb shɛli liri ba maa zuɣu.
en: They will drink and stagger about half-crazed because of the sword that I am sending against them.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni n kamina ni n ti ti dunia ŋɔ nim suhudoo? Aai, n yɛri ya mi ni ninvuɣ tuɣilibo ka n tahina.
en: Do you suppose that I came to bring peace to the world? No, not peace, but division.

dag: Ka wuhi ba wuntia ni nyɛ shɛli, dama n labirila m Ba sani ka yi ku lan nya ma.
en: they are wrong about what is right, because I am going to the Father and you will not see me any more;.

dag: Naftali ŋmanila walinyaŋ so ŋun gɔr o yubu, ka dɔɣi bi viɛla.
en: Naphtali is a wild doe that gives birth to beautiful fawns.

dag: Bɛn muɣisiri ya ni yi guni la nyɛla bɛn bɔri ni bɛ duhi bɛmaŋa niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu puuni, ka di daliri kul nyɛla ni bɛ di nya nahiŋgu Masia dapulli yɛla zuɣu;.
en: The people who are trying to force you to be circumcised are the ones who want to show off and boast about external matters. They do it, however, only so that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

dag: A niŋdi ninvuɣ biɛri kaman saɣiri la, dinzuɣu ka n yur a zaligunima.
en: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.

dag: Yisa daa ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ wuhi ni di simdi ni niriba suhiri Naawuni sahakam ka di niŋdi anyinsi.
en: Then Jesus taught the followers that they should always pray and never lose hope. He used this story to teach them:.

dag: Malikiram ni Pɛdaya ni Shɛnaza ni Jɛkamia ni Hɔshama ni Nɛdabia.
en: Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan chaŋ ti lu Keenannim bɛn be Hiburɔn la nim zuɣu n-tuhi nyaŋ Shɛshai mini Ahiman ni Talimai.
en: Judah moved against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron, known before as Kiriath-arba, and they defeated Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.

dag: dama Naawuni nyɛla yino ka ni chɛ ka Yɛhudianim bɛn guni yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, ka mi ni lan chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ka bi guni la gba yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: God is one, and he will put the Jews right with himself on the basis of their faith, and will put the Gentiles right through their faith.

dag: Arivadnim mini Hɛlɛchinim daa nyɛla bɛn ʒi a goma zuɣu ti gili, ka Gamadinim mi daa ʒe a binchunchuna gbini. Bɛ daa zaŋdila bɛ lɔɣubuya yiini a dukpina zuɣu ti tuui. Bɛna n-daa chɛ ka a viɛl zaa.
en: The men of Arvad and Helech were stationed on your walls all around; the men of Gamad were in your towers. They hung their weapons on your walls all around. They were the ones who completed your beauty.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa kana ti gbani Yisa tooni yɛl o, N Duuma, sɔŋm ma.
en: At this the woman came and fell at his feet. Help me, sir! she said.

dag: Ka Mariama daa zaŋ yɛla ŋɔ zaa niŋ o suhu ni n-kul tɛhiri di yɛla.
en: Mary committed these things to memory and considered them carefully.

dag: Binneembihi kam zaa bɛn mali paɣiri ka mali bɛ naba anahi zaa chana nyɛla yi ni chihiri shɛb dibu.
en: All winged insects are unclean.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa kari Filistianim maa ti bahi, ka lab bɛ suɣa ni ti di nɛma.
en: When the Israelites came back from chasing the Philistines, they plundered their camp.

dag: N daa pun mi a mi pɔi ka naanyi ti nam a a ma puli ni. N daa pun piig a mi zali pɔi ka bɛ ti naanyi dɔɣ a; ka n zaŋ a leei zuliya kam anabi.
en: Jeremiah, I am your Creator, and before you were born, I chose you to speak for me to the nations.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri pinaayi puuni gol so ŋun pahiri pinaayi dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: In the twelfth year, on the first day of the twelfth month, the LORDs word came to me.

dag: a noli ni yɛtɔɣa maa ni leei zana bar a, ka a noli ni yɛtɔɣa maa ni gbaag a.
en: Have you been caught by your own words, trapped by your own promises?.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yi ti chɛ ka n sariakaribo yɛlibiɛri anahi lu Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu, di ku viɛla, dina n-nyɛ takɔbi mini fifali ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛri ni alɔbo din yɛn kuri ninsalinima mini biŋkɔbiri bɛn be di ni la.
en: This is what the Sovereign Lord is saying: I will send my four worst punishments on Jerusalem—war, famine, wild animals, and disease—to destroy people and animals alike.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan mɔhi vuri pam yɛli, Pa doo ŋɔ ka ti bɔri ni a yihi bahi. Barabas ka ti bɔri ni a yihi bahi! Barabas daa nyɛla ŋmɛnditoli.
en: They shouted back, No, not him! Let Barabbas go free.

dag: Mikimasinim daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pisinaayi.
en: of Michmas.

dag: Du shɛli din dunoya daa kpa Naawuni jɛmbu duu sambani wulinluhili polo la yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita pihitanaanu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛla mita pihinahinaanu, ka di dikili barilim nyɛ mita ayi ni pirigili gili di zaa.
en: There was a building in this restricted area west of the Temple. The building was cubits wide and cubits long. The wall of the building was cubits thick all around.

dag: Ka doo maa yɛli, A ni zaŋ paɣ so ti ma ni o be n san la, ŋuna n-zaŋ tia maa walli maa ti ma ka n di.
en: The man said, The woman you gave me, she gave me some fruit from the tree, and I ate.

dag: Ka Pita daa kpalim Jɔpa, Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ gbanzab la yiŋa n-niŋ daba ayi nimaani.
en: Peter stayed for some time in Joppa with a certain tanner named Simon.

dag: Bɛ zaa m-mali dɔriti tibbu pina? Bɛ zaa n-tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni? Bɛ zaa n-kahigiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa gbinni wuhira?.
en: All dont have gifts of healing, do they? All dont speak in different tongues, do they? All dont interpret, do they?.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ mali wumpaɣibo sara, ka yili suhupiɛlli yila yɛl o tuma yɛla.
en: Let them offer thanksgiving sacrifices and declare what God has done in songs of joy!.

dag: Kunyanambɔzɔbo ni daa ŋmaai bihili, ka o lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga yaha.
en: After Gomer had weaned her daughter, she became pregnant again and had another son.

dag: Yiɣisim chaŋ Mɛsopoteemia a ma ba Bɛtuɛl yiŋa nti kpuɣi a ma tizɔdoo Leeban bipuɣinsi ni yino niŋ a paɣa.
en: Get up and go to Paddan-aram, to the household of Bethuel, your mothers father, and once there, marry one of the daughters of Laban, your mothers brother.

dag: O daa mali di gbaya maa ka di ŋmanila chɛchɛbuŋ gbaya. Di spindilinim mini di fiilinim ni di sipuɣisinim ni di duɣuri zaa daa nyɛla daanya.
en: and looked like chariot wheels. The axles, rims, spokes, and hubs were made out of bronze.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Zaŋmi kpani din be a nuu ni ŋɔ tiri Ai; n ni zaŋ li niŋ a nuu ni. Ka Jɔshua daa zaŋ kpani din be o nuu ni maa tiri.
en: The LORD said to Joshua, Point the dagger in your hand toward Ai, because I will give it into your power. So Joshua pointed the dagger in his hand toward the city.

dag: dindina nyin bom peeŋkpaa n-zaŋ o tibili tabili dunoli naŋgbanyee n-chib li voli, ka o nyɛ a dabili sahakam. Zaŋ chaŋ a dabili ŋun nyɛ paɣ gba polo, di simdi ni a niŋ o lala.
en: Take the slave to the door of your house and push a sharp metal rod through one earlobe and into the door. Such slaves will belong to you for life, whether they are men or women.

dag: Zɛra daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Zɛranima; ka Shaul mi daŋ niriba nyɛ Shaulnima.
en: Zerah, and Shaul.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli ni: Di saha maa alizanda nam ni ti ŋmanila paɣipiɛlisi pia bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ firilanim chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi amiliya aŋgo soli.
en: At that time Gods kingdom will be like ten girls who went to wait for the bridegroom. They took their lamps with them.

dag: Bɛ daa yi kamina nti kpa tanti suɣa do Izraɛlnim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-saɣindi bɛ bindira zaŋ hal ti paai Gaza, hal ka binshɛli zaŋ tabili piɛri mini niɣi ni bunsi gba bi kpalim.
en: They would set up camp against the Israelites and destroy the lands crops as far as Gaza, leaving nothing to keep Israel alive, not even sheep, oxen, or donkeys.

dag: N kul yɛla n noli vuhiri nyahigira, dama n suhu kul yɛla a zaligunim maa zuɣu.
en: I open my mouth up wide, panting, because I long for your commandments.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Suhudoo ka n zaŋ tin ya; mmaŋmaŋ suhudoo mi ka n zaŋ tin ya maa. Di pala dunianim ni tiri suhudoo shɛm la ka n tin ya maa. Di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give you. I give to you not as the world gives. Dont be troubled or afraid.

dag: Naawuni, kul niŋmi alibarika niŋmi ti ni. Niriba bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa jɛmm a.
en: Let God continue to bless us; let the far ends of the earth honor him.

dag: Amaa ka Barizillai daa yɛli, Yuma ala ka n lee lan yɛn niŋ dunia yili ŋɔ, ka lan doli nyin naa kuni Jɛrusalɛm?.
en: But Barzillai said to the king, Do you know how old I am? Do you think I can go with you to Jerusalem?.

dag: Sokam mi o yidana tiŋ maa dunɔdaya gbini, ka o mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kpamba laɣindi ʒiina.
en: Her husband is a well-known and respected leader in the city.

dag: Di ni daa be shɛm hal ka kom ti kana ti di bɛ zaa ha la: Bɛ daa diri ka nyura; ka kpuɣiri paɣiba, ka zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba hal ti paai Anabi Nuhu ni daa kpe ŋariŋ ni dahin shɛli.
en: In those days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving their children to be married right up to the day Noah entered the boat.

dag: dama m bi sɔɣi ya yɛl shɛli; n kahigi Naawuni yɛlli kam wuhi ya.
en: I can say this because I know that I told you everything that God wants you to know.

dag: Yi mi miriya ka yi ti zaŋ kuɣa me binwɔɣinli zali, dimbɔŋɔnim nyɛla Naawuni ni je shɛŋa.
en: And do not set up any stone pillar for idol worship; the Lord hates them.

dag: So yi bi pali alikauli ka tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani, ka di nyɛla o kpee n-zaŋ binshɛli puh o zalibu bee n-yɛl o ni o gul li, ka o ti yɔhim o bee o fala o kpee bee di yi nyɛla o zumi.
en: An offering is to be made if any of you sin against the Lord by refusing to return what another Israelite has left as a deposit or by stealing something from him or by cheating him.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Ŋmamiya di tihi luhi. Kahimiya kuɣa duhi gili Jɛrusalɛm. Tiŋ shɛli din simdi tibidarigibo m-bala. Shɛli ka di puuni naɣila alaka niŋbu.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: Cut down her trees, and build siege ramps against Jerusalem. This city must be held accountable, for theres nothing but oppression in her midst.

dag: Paɣiviɛligakushihikom ni ʒe go tihi sunsuuni shɛm, lala ka n yura be paɣisara sunsuuni.
en: My darling, among other women, you are like a lily among thorns!.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim daa niŋdila binyari viɛla mini situr sabilifaa shɛŋa bɛ ni wuɣi ni duu puuni tiŋgban ni kuntu shɛŋa bɛ ni liɣisiliɣisi, ka zaŋ mihi wuɣi ka di mali yaa daabiligu. Binyara ŋɔ ni ka a mini ba daa niŋdi daabiligu.
en: and they gave you expensive clothing, purple and embroidered cloth, brightly colored rugs, and strong rope.

dag: O yi vihi ya, di ni viɛl yi zuɣu? Bee yi ni tooi yɔhim o kaman niriba ni yɔhindi tab shɛm la?.
en: If he took you to court, could you fool him, just as you fool others?.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ni ŋun nam ba la yɛliya, Yi ni tooi bɔhi ma bɔhigu zaŋ chaŋ m bihi polo? Bee n-wuhi ma di ni simdi ni n niŋ shɛm?.
en: I am the Lord , the Creator, the holy God of Israel. Do you dare question me about my own nation or about what I have done?.

dag: Sulemaana tumtumdiba zuliya daŋ bɛn daa yi Babilɔn n-lab kuli yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Sɔtai daŋ mini Hasofɛrɛt daŋ ni Pɛruda daŋ.
en: Here is a list of Solomon's servants whose descendants returned: Sotai, Hassophereth, Peruda, Jaalah, Darkon, Giddel, Shephatiah, Hattil, Pochereth Hazzebaim, and Ami.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi ma, Jɛrimia, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n gari yɛli, N nyala fiig tiwala din viɛl pam, ka nya fiig tiwala din bie pam, ka di biɛbu maa zuɣu chɛ ka so ku tooi di li.
en: Jeremiah, the Lord asked, what do you see? Figs, I said. Some are very good, but the others are too rotten to eat.

dag: N yɛli barinyuriba, Di nyuriya bara. Ka yɛli ninvuɣ biɛri mi, Di maliya karimbaani.
en: To those who are proud I say, Stop your boasting. I warn the wicked, Dont brag about how strong you are.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa baŋ din yɛn doli di nyaaŋa ka bɔh o, Ti Duuma, ti cham ba takɔbiri.
en: When the disciples who were with Jesus saw what was going to happen, they asked, Shall we use our swords, Lord.

dag: Ka Dɛbɔra daa yɛli Barak, Yiɣisima! Yawɛ m-be a tooni mal a chana. Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Yawɛ zaŋ Sisɛra niŋ a nuu ni. Di saha ka Barak daa yiɣisi ka tɔbbihi tuhi pia dol o ka bɛ yi Tabo Zoli zuɣu siɣi.
en: Then Deborah said to Barak, Get up! This is the day that the LORD has handed Sisera over to you. Hasnt the LORD gone out before you? So Barak went down from Mount Tabor with ten thousand men behind him.

dag: Mɛmiya yiya m-be di ni, ka kɔnya puri n-diri di bindira.
en: Build houses and settle down; cultivate gardens and eat what they produce.

dag: Paɣ yi nya sɔrilim din nyɛ o ni pun nyari shɛli sahakam, o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni daba ayopɔin, ka ŋunkam shih o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: When a woman has her monthly period, she remains unclean for seven days, and if you touch her, you must take a bath, but you remain unclean until evening.

dag: amaa ka labina nti di bindirigu ka nyu kom luɣ shɛli o ni yɛl a, Miri ka a di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom la zuɣu, o ku chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ a sɔɣi pah a yaannim ni. .
en: He told you not to eat or drink anything in this place, but you came back here and ate and drank. So your body will not be buried in your family grave.

dag: Ka yi ni bi mi ninvuɣ shɛba ni ti di yi puri ni bindira ni yi tuma zaa daanfaani. Yi ti kul ni bela turi mini nahiŋgu ni sahakam.
en: A foreign nation will take all the crops that you have worked so hard to grow, while you receive nothing but constant oppression and harsh treatment.

dag: Di bi simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun nyuri dam kuuna bee ŋun nyɛ vubɔra, amaa di simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun be baalim, ka pa ni ŋun ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeeni bee ŋun suhu ye liɣiri zuɣu nti yaɣi.
en: he must not be a drunkard or a violent man, but gentle and peaceful; he must not love money;.

dag: Bɛ dihi ti vi, dama bɛ turi ti. Ti lan ka jilima, dama tinzunnim kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu luɣ kasi shee la.
en: We people of Judah are ashamed. We have been insulted, because strangers have gone into the holy places of the Lord s Temple.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Samuɛl.
en: The Lord told Samuel.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka kum daa ti lu Ijipti mini Keenan tiŋgbɔna ni zaa n-ti ba wahala pam, ka ti yaannim maa daa ti lan ka bindirigu.
en: But all the land of Egypt and of Canaan became dry. It became so dry that food could not grow, and the people suffered very much. Our people could not find anything to eat.

dag: kaman Daadam Bia gba ni be shɛm la; o bi kamina ni o ti ʒiya ka niriba tumdi tir o, amaa ni ŋun lee ti tumdi tiri ba, ka zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima niriba pam nyɛviya zuɣu.
en: The Son of Man did not come to be a slave master, but a slave who will give his life to rescue many people.

dag: Doo zabiri yi guhi, o nyɛla ŋun mali zuɣupalo, amaa o pala ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: If someone loses their hair, they are bald, but they are clean.

dag: ka zaŋ noombil nɛɔŋ la mini sida dari la ni mi ʒee la ni taaŋkɔro la ni noombil nɛɔŋ maa zaa tim bɛ ni kɔrigi noombil so kɔzɔrim kom ni la ʒim ni.
en: Then he will dip the other bird, the cedar, the red yarn, and the hyssop in the blood of the dead bird.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, N yɛrila yinim bɛn wumdi n yɛligu ŋɔ, yumiya yi dimnima, ka niŋmiya bɛn jɛn ya la zaɣ viɛlli.
en: But I say to you who are willing to hear: Love your enemies. Do good to those who hate you.

dag: Ka niriba daa ti yiɣisi wulimpuhili polo n-chaŋchaŋ ti paai Shiina tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɔpiɛligu ni n-kpalim ʒini nimaani.
en: but after some of them moved from the east and settled in Babylonia.

dag: Ka di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali yaha ka Yisa lan kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu ti wuhiri niriba, ka do so ŋun nudirigu bɔɣu kpi daa beni.
en: On another Sabbath day Jesus went into the synagogue and taught the people. A man with a crippled right hand was there.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa nyɛ kulipalinima bɛn labiri ziŋgɔhi mini bɛn mali yilima bee nɛri gbahiri zahim Nail Mɔɣili maa ni ni ti fabili.
en: Those who fish will lament; all who cast fishhooks in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the water will pine away.

dag: ka tiwula ata be di zuɣu, ka di ni sa kul piligi puhiri vari ka dii daai pum n-wali wala ka di mooi.
en: and on the vine were three branches. When it budded, its blossoms appeared, and its clusters ripened into grapes.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yiɣisi chaŋ Sool ni be luɣ shɛli maa ti nya o ni do luɣ shɛli polo, ka Nɛr bia Abinɛr ŋun daa nyɛ o tɔbbihi zuɣulan la do o sani. Sool daa dola suɣa maa sunsuuni, ka tɔbbihi maa do n-gil o.
en: Then David went to where Saul had set up his camp. David saw where Saul and Abner were sleeping. Saul was sleeping in the center of a circle of men that surrounded him.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli Ahija, Zaŋmi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la na. Dama din dali maa Izraɛlnim daa zaŋla Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa mali chaŋ.
en: Saul said to Ahijah, Bring the priestly vest! because at that time, Ahijah wore the priestly vest in Israels presence.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ɛhab daa yɛl o paɣ Jɛzibɛl Ilaija ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa min o ni zaŋ takɔbi ku Baal daanabinim zaa shɛm yɛla.
en: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, how he had killed all Baals prophets with the sword.

dag: Yi min o ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini zuɣu ka o zaŋdi yi gba m-pahiri bɛn zaa kpalim zuɣu m-mɛri du shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni ni ni be shɛl ni o Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa tim Ɛliakim ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi la mini Shɛbina ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni maligumaaniba kpamba bɛn daa ye buri Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia sani.
en: He told Prime Minister Eliakim, Assistant Prime Minister Shebna, and the senior priests to dress in sackcloth and tell the prophet Isaiah:.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ gali sabilifaa wuɣi alichɛbba shɛli maligumaana ni yɛn yɛri pahi binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa zuɣu. Alichɛbba maa daa nyɛla zaɣ sabilifaa zaa.
en: The priestly robe was made of blue wool.

dag: N ni daa wum bɛ fabila maa mini bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka n suhu daa yiɣisi pam.
en: I was very angry when I heard their protest and these complaints.

dag: Zaadali Ninivenim gba ni ti wuhi ni ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim mali taali, dama Anabi Jona ni daa yihi ba waazu la, bɛ daa niŋ tuuba; ka nyamiya, yɛl shɛli din gari Anabi Jona be kpe.
en: The people of Nineveh will rise up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, because they changed their hearts and lives in response to Jonahs preaching—and one greater than Jonah is here.

dag: O daa jɛm Naawuni Zakaria ŋun daa wuh o Naawuni jɛmbu sol la ʒiɛman ni. O ni daa jɛmdi Yawɛ saha shɛli maa zaa, Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: Uzziah followed God in the time of Zechariahs life. Zechariah taught Uzziah how to respect and obey God. When Uzziah was obeying the Lord , God gave him success.

dag: Dama Naawuni mi ni yi yi di li, yi nini ni neei, ka yi be kaman ŋun Naawuni, ka mi zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: God knows that on the day you eat from it, you will see clearly and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, a chɛ ka o takɔbi noli gbilim; ka bi zan o nyaaŋa tɔbu ni.
en: Yes, you dulled the edge of his sword and didnt support him in battle.

dag: Ka Nikɔdimus bɔh o, Wula ka dimbɔŋɔ ni tooi nani.
en: Nicodemus said, How are these things possible.

dag: O daa kul dolila Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ o, ka kul dol o zaligu kpan shɛŋa o ni daa zaŋ ti Musa la.
