en: He was very faithful to the Lord and did not stop following him. He obeyed the commands that the Lord had given to Moses.

dag: Dindali maa bɛ ni ti piɛbi kika titali, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yirigi be Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini bɛ ni daa kari shɛb kulisi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la kana ti jɛm Yawɛ Jɛrusalɛm zoli din be kasi la zuɣu.
en: Many of my people are now lost in Assyria. Some of my people have run away to Egypt. But at that time a great trumpet will be blown, and all those people will come back to Jerusalem. They will bow down before the Lord on that holy mountain.

dag: Yi yi chana, yin yihimiya waazu yɛra, Alizanda nam mirina.
en: As you go, announce that the kingdom of heaven will soon be here.

dag: Ka Yaakubu zuliya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ni ti be zuliya pam sunsuuni kaman maligim n-yi Yawɛ sanna la. Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila saa ŋun miri bahiri mɔri zuɣu ka di baɣa ka niriba ni bee n-lihiri daadam ninni la.
en: A few of Jacob's descendants survived and are scattered among the nations. But the Lord will let them cover the earth like dew and rain that refreshes the soil.

dag: dindina n ni be yi sani kpe, n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim kurimbuni ha ni bɛ su li sahakam ŋɔ ni.
en: only then will I dwell with you in this place, in the land that I gave long ago to your ancestors for all time.

dag: Ka doo maa yɛli, Di yi nyɛla lala, hal n ni mali soli ni n da tiŋgbani maa la zaa yoli, n ni chɛ di dabu, dama di wuhiya ni mmaŋmaŋ bihi ti ku di li fali. Nyin dam li, man ku da li.
en: But the redeemer replied, Then I cant redeem it for myself, without risking damage to my own inheritance. Redeem it for yourself. You can have my right of redemption, because Im unable to act as redeemer.

dag: Zaŋmiya salima alali din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihitanaanu mali firilatamdigu maa mini di binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: All these items should be made from pure gold weighing one kikkar.

dag: Ka Yisa bol o, Mariama! Ka o ŋmalig o polo ka yɛli Hiburuli ni, Rabɔni! Di gbinni nyɛla, Karimba.
en: Jesus said to her, Mary! She turned toward him and said in Hebrew, Rabboni.

dag: Iso paɣ Oholibama ŋun daa nyɛ Zibiɔn bia Ana bipuɣiŋga la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛushi mini Jalam ni Kɔra.
en: Esau's wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah son of Zibeon, bore him three sons: Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

dag: N ni tɔɣisi yɛm yɛtɔɣa. N suhu ni tɛha nyɛla din mali baŋsim.
en: My mouth speaks wisdom; my hearts meditation is full of insight.

dag: Tab jɛlinsi nyɛla din tahiri zabili na, amaa yurilim limsiri taali balibu kam.
en: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛbisi ba, ka bɛ mali ti paai Antiɔk n-laɣim yɛdaniŋdiba n-zaŋ gbaŋ maa ti ba.
en: The messengers were sent off and went to Antioch, where they gathered the whole group of believers and gave them the letter.

dag: Amaa Naawuni yiko puuni o kuri wɔɣira. O yi tum o tuma, ninvuɣ biɛri kpirimi.
en: By his power God removes the powerful. Even if they have a high position, they cannot be sure of their lives.

dag: Amaa tiŋ maa nim yi bi zaŋ bɛmaŋ tin ya ni suhumahili, ka lo tɔbu ni bɛ tuhi ya, dindina yin teemiya gili tiŋ maa.
en: But if the people of that city will not surrender, but choose to fight, surround it with your army.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yiɣisi chaŋ Baalipɛrazim nti tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim maa nimaani ka yɛli, Yawɛ kpe n dimnim maa sunsuuni kaman kokpɛɣu la. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Baal Pɛrazim maa.
en: So David went to Baal Perazim and there he defeated the Philistines. He said, The Lord has broken through my enemies like a flood. And so that place is called Baal Perazim.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paai Jɛrusalɛm; ka Yisa chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti kariti bɛn kɔhiri mini bɛn dari nɛma Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka daari laɣitaɣiriba teebuya mini ŋmaŋkɔhiriba kuɣisi luhira;.
en: When they arrived in Jerusalem, Jesus went to the Temple and began to drive out all those who were buying and selling. He overturned the tables of the moneychangers and the stools of those who sold pigeons.

dag: dama n zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa a ni daa tɔɣisi ma la tɔɣisi ba, ka bɛ dee li ka baŋ ni n shiri yila a sanna, ka niŋ yɛda ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na.
en: I told them the words you gave me, and they accepted them. They realized the fact that I came from you and believed that you sent me.

dag: O ʒiɛla fɔntinsi dunɔdaya ni, o bela dunɔdaya maa gbini n-kuhiri boona:.
en: At the entrance to the city, beside the gates, she calls:.

dag: Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu ka n ti yɛn sa li. Ka di teei wula n-wali wala, ka leei sida ti titali. Ka noonsi balibu kam ni ti kana ti zaani di gbini. Ka noonsi balibu kam ni ti te bɛ tɛri di wula mahim ni.
en: On Israels mountainous highlands I will plant it, and it will send out branches and bear fruit. It will grow into a mighty cedar. Birds of every kind will nest in it and find shelter in the shade of its boughs.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali, Firawuna ni chɛ ka bɛ kana ti yih a nti lan zaŋ a labis a tuma ni; ka a ni lan zaŋdi Firawuna pipia maa ni binnyura maa ti tir o kaman a ni daa pun nyɛ o wain tɔɣira shɛm la.
en: After three days, Pharaoh will give you an audience and return you to your position. You will put Pharaohs cup in his hand, just the way things were before when you were his wine steward.

dag: N daa nyɛla nachimbila, ka pumpɔŋɔ n kurigiya, amaa n na ʒi n-nya ka Yawɛ chɛ wuntizɔriba bahi bee n-nya ka bɛ bihi chani maani bara bɔri bindirigu.
en: I am old now; I have lived a long time, but I have never seen good people abandoned by the Lord or their children begging for food.

dag: Yisa ni daa wuhiri niriba Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni maa ka o ti bɔhi ba, Yi mi ma, ka mi n ni shiri yi shɛl na? Pa mmaŋmaŋ yubu ni ka n kana; ka ŋun tim ma na maa mi nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana, amaa yi bi mi o.
en: As Jesus taught in the Temple, he said in a loud voice, Do you really know me and know where I am from? I have not come on my own authority. He who sent me, however, is truthful. You do not know him.

dag: Yi gba ni nyɛ Naawuni bihi maa zuɣu ka Naawuni tim o Bia maa Shia ka o kana ti be ti suhuri ni kuhiri yɛra, M Ba! M Ba.
en: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.

dag: Amaa o yidan maa yi bi saɣi li o ni wum li saha shɛli maa, dindina o ni ku o pɔri maa min o noli ni daa faag o ka o yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ni o niŋ shɛl la; ka Yawɛ ni chɛ o taali.
en: But if her husband forbids her to fulfill the vow when he hears about it, she is not required to keep it. The Lord will forgive her.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa zaŋ anzinfa shɛli bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili nɛma duu la zaa ti o.
en: Hezekiah gave all the silver that was in the Lord s Temple and in the kings treasuries.

dag: Di saha gom daa wum Pita min o tab la pam, amaa ka bɛ lee ne n-ʒiya, ka daa ti nya Yisa jilima ni niriba ayi bɛn daa ʒe o sani maa.
en: Peter and those with him were almost overcome by sleep, but they managed to stay awake and saw his glory as well as the two men with him.

dag: Wuntizɔra tɛhirila o ni yɛn garigi shɛm, amaa ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun noli ni zaɣ biɛɣu n-yirina.
en: The righteous heart reflects before answering, but the wicked mouth blurts out evil.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ahaz daa tim tuumba Asiria Naa Tigilatipilɛza sani nti yɛl o, N nyɛla a bia ni a dabili, kamina nti fa ma Siria naa mini Izraɛl naa bɛn kana ti liri ma ŋɔ nuu ni bahi.
en: Ahaz sent men to Tiglath Pileser, the emperor of Assyria, with this message: I am your devoted servant. Come and rescue me from the kings of Syria and of Israel, who are attacking me.

dag: O bi galisi gari ma yili ŋɔ puuni, o mi bi mɔŋ ma shɛli naɣila nyini, dama a nyɛla o paɣa; ka wula ka n ni tooi tum ninvuɣ biɛtali tuun titali ŋɔ n-tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani.
en: I have as much authority in this house as he has, and he has not kept back anything from me except you. How then could I do such an immoral thing and sin against God.

dag: Ka shɛb mi daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni nɛma fukumsi. Bɛna n-daa lan su tahi shɛŋa mini la shɛŋa din be kasi la fukumsi. Bɛna n-daa lan su bɔrɔbɔro zim mini wain ni kpam ni tulaale zim ni tulaalɛnim zaa fukumsi.
en: Other gatekeepers were chosen to care for the furniture and the special dishes. They also took care of the flour, wine, oil, incense, and special oil.

dag: Di saha yin yɛlimiy o, A dabili Yaakubu n-su ba, ka zaŋ ba ti ti ni ti zaŋ ba na ti ti nyini n-dan Iso pini, ka din pahi nyɛla, omaŋmaŋ doli ti nyaaŋa na. .
en: you must answer, They belong to your servant Jacob. He sends them as a present to his master Esau. Jacob himself is right behind us.

dag: Yi ni so miri ka o ti zaŋ o bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga nyo buɣim mali sara bee n-ŋmɛri bihigu bee m-buɣiri baɣa bee n-nyɛ bɔha bee bukpaha.
en: Dont sacrifice your sons or daughters in the fires on your altars. Dont try to learn what will happen in the future by talking to a fortuneteller or by going to a magician, a witch, or a sorcerer.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ paɣ shɛb bɛn daa tumdi tuma Yawɛ min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili dunol ni la daanya diɣisi mali tahili mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu.
en: He made the copper washbasin with its copper stand from the copper mirrors among the ranks of women assigned to the meeting tents entrance.

dag: Naawuni ni nam binshɛɣukam nyɛla din viɛla, ka di bi simdi ni ti siŋ li, tinim dee yi di li ni Naawuni paɣibu.
en: Everything that God made is good. Nothing he made should be refused if it is accepted with thanks to him.

dag: Hal yi zuɣu ka Yawɛ je suli niŋ ma yɛli, A gba ku kpe tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The Lord was also angry with me because of you. He said to me, Moses, you cannot enter the land, either.

dag: ka yɛli, N dan naa, nyini n-daa yɛli, Adɔnija ni di nam n kalinsi nyaaŋa n-ʒini n nam ʒiishee.
en: and said, My lord and king, did you announce that Adonijah will be the new king after you? Have you decided that he will rule the people now?.

dag: Ti zaŋmiya ti viɛla wala mini abie tihi vari ni ti shɛŋa din mali vari wulikpana ni kul tihi na di piligu dali maa nti wuhi yi suhupiɛlli Yawɛ tooni hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: Pick the best fruit from your trees and cut leafy branches to use during the time of this joyous celebration in my honor.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛligu nyɛla din be tibi, ka o tuma zaa nyɛ din tuhi.
en: Because the LORDs word is right, his every act is done in good faith.

dag: Man Klɔdius Lisias n-sab gbaŋ ŋɔ m-puhiri n dan Gomna Filiksi.
en: From Claudius Lysias, To the Most Honorable Governor Felix. Greetings:.

dag: O daa zaŋ o ba ni daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa la min omaŋmaŋ ni daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa ti Yawɛ ka di nyɛ anzinfa mini salima ni lahi la ti zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: He placed in the Temple all the objects his father had dedicated to God, as well as the gold and silver objects that he himself dedicated.

dag: Dama jɛrigu tɔɣisirila jɛrilim yɛtɔɣa, ka tɛhiri zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu yɛla. O ni tumdi shɛm min o ni yɛri shɛm nyɛla biriginsim zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani. O mi na ʒi n-ti kum ni mali shɛb bindirigu bee n-niŋ kom ti kɔnyuri ni mali ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Fools talk foolishness. They always make plans to do sinful things, to lie about the Lord , to let the hungry starve, and to keep water from those who are thirsty.

dag: Ka naa maa daa bol o na ti yɛl o, Nyin zaɣ yoli ŋɔ! A ni daa balim ma la, n daa bi ku a samli la zaa ti a?.
en: Then the master called his servant in and said, You evil servant. You begged me to forgive your debt, and I said you did not have to pay anything!.

dag: Kunduna mini piɛri ni ti laɣim doya, ka jɛŋgbina mini bubihi ti laɣim doya, ka naɣibihi mini gbuɣimbihi ni gbuɣim pola ti laɣim doya, ka bihi ti vɔri ba chana.
en: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat; the calf and the young lion will feed together, and a little child will lead them.

dag: Kalim bɛn nyɛ yuun pihita zaŋ ti paai yuun pihinu, ka nyɛ bɛnkam zaa ni tooi tum tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni.
en: You will enroll those from to years old, all who are eligible for service to do work in the meeting tent.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa.
en: The Festival of Shelters begins on the fifteenth day of the seventh month and continues for seven days.

dag: Ti yi zaŋ Naawuni Shia yɛla biri yi suhuri ni, dindina di zooya ni ti deei dunia ŋɔ ni binyara yi sani?.
en: If we sowed spiritual things in you, is it so much to ask to harvest some material things from you?.

dag: Amaa lee daŋmiya m-bola Naawuni nam dubu min o wuntia, ka o naanyi zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha pahi ya.
en: What you should want most is Gods kingdom and doing what he wants you to do. Then he will give you all these other things you need.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni yi di yimaŋ shɛhira ni yi nyɛla bɛn daa ku anabinim maa yaansi.
en: So you actually admit that you are the descendants of those who murdered the prophets!.

dag: Suhugarigu zuɣu chɛmi ka n nina niŋ liti, Yawɛ, n kul teela n nuhi n-suhir a dabisili kam.
en: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord .

dag: Ka Atai daa nyɛ Neetan ba, ka Neetan mi daa nyɛ Zabad ba.
en: Attai was Nathans father. Nathan was Zabads father.

dag: N ni kpaŋsi yi suhuri kaman paɣ ni kpaŋsir o bia suhu shɛm la. Yi ni nya suhukpaŋsibo Jɛrusalɛm.
en: I will comfort you like a mother comforting her child. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yoli, a zaɣisi ti ka filim ti. Ka ti tɔbbihi yi chani tɔb tuhibu, a lan ka bɛ sani.
en: But now you have rejected us; you don't lead us into battle, and we look foolish.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa vu m-miri Dauda, ka o nyɔtaɣiriʒira be o tooni.
en: Goliath came toward David, walking behind the soldier who was carrying his shield.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ timmi laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa mini Baal anabinim kɔbisinahi ni pihinu ni Ashɛra anabinim kɔbisinahi bɛn diri Jɛzibɛl yiŋ la n-zaŋ ba ka n sanna Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu.
en: Now tell all the people of Israel to meet me at Mount Carmel. Also bring the prophets of Baal and the prophets of the goddess Asherah, who get their support from Queen Jezebel.

dag: Filip mini Baatolomiu ni Tomas ni Matiu ŋun daa nyɛ farigudeera la ni Alifius bia Jeemsi ni Taddius ni.
en: Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew, the tax collector, James, the son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus.

dag: ka Diuɛl bia Ɛliasaf nyɛ Gaad zuliya zuɣulana.
en: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was the leader of the Gad tribe.

dag: Ka naa maa suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o tim o tɔbbihi ni bɛ chaŋ ti ku ninvuɣ kuriba maa, ka nyo bɛ tiŋ maa buɣim.
en: The king was angry. He sent his soldiers to destroy those murderers and set their city on fire.

dag: M puhiri Rufus ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ gahindili ti Duuma ni la min o ma ŋun nyɛ n gba ma la.
en: Greetings also to Rufus, one of the Lords chosen people, and to his mother, who has been a mother to me too.

dag: N nyala putɔɣu yɛl shɛŋa din niŋdi ʒii. Di nyɛla nyaanyira ni ŋun tumdi saɣiŋgu tuma ʒii. Ɛlam tɔbbihi, lirimiya ba. Miidia tɔbbihi, dɔnimiya gili tinsi gu. Naawuni ni chɛ ka Babilɔnnim ni tahi wahala shɛli na maa zan tariga.
en: I have seen a vision of cruel events, a vision of betrayal and destruction. Army of Elam, attack! Army of Media, lay siege to the cities! God will put an end to the suffering which Babylon has caused.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikaa Ziɔn Zol zuɣu; m-moli nolɔbo molo, ka laɣim niriba.
en: Blow the horn in Zion; demand a fast; request a special assembly.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi.
en: Everyone ate until they were full.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ zaligu din daŋ tooni ni din nyɛ kpɛma.
en: This is the first and greatest commandment.

dag: Ka doo maa yɛl o, Bɛ zaŋ kpa luɣ shɛli polo, dama n wumya ka bɛ yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ Dɔtan. Di saha ka Yisifu daa biɛh o biɛyanim maa naba nti nya ba Dɔtan maa.
en: The man said, They have already left. I heard them say that they were going to Dothan. So Joseph went after his brothers and found them at Dothan.

dag: Bɛ dihi ti vi, dama bɛ turi ti. Ti lan ka jilima, dama tinzunnim kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu luɣ kasi shee la.
en: You say, We've been disgraced and made ashamed; we feel completely helpless because foreigners have taken over the holy places in the Temple.

dag: ŋun daa be yi tooni mali ya be soli chana ni o ti bo palo tin ya ka yi ti yi suɣa dɔni la yɛda. O daa bela buɣim ni yuŋ, ka be sagban ni wuntaŋ ni ni o wuhi ya yi ni yɛn doli so shɛli.
en: even though he had always been with us in the desert. During the daytime, the Lord was in the cloud, leading us in the right direction and showing us where to camp. And at night, he was there in the fire.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ bi baŋ o ni yɛli ba shɛlikam maa zaa gbinni; di daa nyɛla yɛlisɔɣirili bɛ sani, dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bi baŋ di gbinni maa.
en: The apostles did not understand what Jesus was talking about. They could not understand, because the meaning of what he said was hidden from them.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa zaŋla bɛmaŋ bali niriba maa ni n-niŋdi bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: Instead, they got mixed up with the nations, learning what they did.

dag: Karimbaani tahirila saɣiŋgu na, ka maŋduhibu mi tahiri lubu na.
en: Pride is the first step toward destruction. Proud thoughts will lead you to defeat.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ tab saawara yɛra, Ti ni bi ʒi bɔrɔbɔro la na zuɣu m-bala.
en: They started discussing among themselves: He says this because we don't have any bread.

dag: Ti piɛb yuhi niŋ ya, ka yi zaɣisi waa wabu; ka kumda, ka yi bi fabinda.
en: We played the flute, but you would not dance! We sang a funeral song, but you would not mourn.

dag: Laɛl bia Ɛliasaf n-daa nyɛ Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: with Eliasaph son of Lael as chief of the clan.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi Sukɔt n-chaŋ ti dɔni Itam tiŋgban nɛl naŋgbaŋgbiriŋ.
en: The Israelites left Sukkoth and camped at Etham on the edge of the desert.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ kɔniŋdi bini maa zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo zaŋ labi wulimpuhili polo lɔrigi ni.
en: He placed the Sea at the southeast corner.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Kpuɣim a jaaŋgbɛ shɛli a ni daa zaŋ fiɛbi Nail la n-niŋ a nuu ni, ka zaŋ Izraɛl kpamba pah amaŋ zuɣu, ka yi gari niriba maa tooni chaŋ.
en: The LORD said to Moses, Go on ahead of the people, and take some of Israels elders with you. Take in your hand the shepherds rod that you used to strike the Nile River, and go.

dag: Di chani a ʒiʒiinikpee yiŋa waawaayili, di yi pa lala, o nyee ni ti nyɔn a, ka o ku lan bɔr a.
en: Don't visit your neighbors too often; they may get tired of you and come to hate you.

dag: Yi ni lo shɛli yi suhuri ni maa ku niŋ. Yi ni tɛhi shɛm nyɛla, chɛ ka ti gba be kaman zuliya shɛb ni be shɛm tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka jɛmdi dari mini kuɣa.
en: You have made up your minds that you want to be like the other nations, like the people who live in other countries and worship trees and rocks. But that will never be.

dag: Bɛ zilima ŋmanila piɛm din mali lɔɣu, di tɔɣisirila ʒiri yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ zaa tɔɣisirila zɔsimdi yɛtɔɣa bɛ ʒiʒiinitab sani, amaa bɛ suhuri ni, bɛ nyɛla bɛn sɔɣi dɔni gu ni bɛ tum barina.
en: Their tongue is a lethal arrow; their words are deceitful. They wish their neighbors well, but in their hearts plot their ruin.

dag: Dama bɛ maŋmaŋ naba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ti kpɛhi zana ni, ka bɛ chaŋ ti lu bɔɣili ni.
en: They walk into a net, and their feet are caught;.

dag: Alibarika pipi shɛli ti ni niŋd alibarika niŋdi di ni la, di pala Masia ʒim ka ti laɣindi nyura? Ka bɔrɔbɔro shɛli ti ni ŋmahiri la, di pala Masia niŋgbuŋ ka ti laɣindi ŋubiri maa?.
en: The cup of blessing that we give thanks for is a sharing in the blood sacrifice of Christ, isnt it? And the bread that we break is a sharing in the body of Christ, isnt it?.

dag: Bɛ daa lan kpuɣi duɣuri mini soobuya ni bɛ ni mali binshɛŋa n-kpihindi firilanima ni tulaale zim lahi ni daanya la shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni daa mali tumdi tuma Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni la.
en: The Babylonians also took the pots, the shovels, the tools for trimming the lamps, the spoons, and all the bronze dishes that were used in the Temple.

dag: Nudirigu polo tintariga yɛn zaŋla Tama hal ni Mɛribatikadɛshi koma dooshee n-zaŋ nimaani hal ni Ijipti kulibɔŋ ni Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ nudirigu polo yaɣili.
en: The southern boundary runs southwest from Tamar to the oasis of Kadesh Meribah and then northwest along the Egyptian border to the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Ka Gaal lan yɛl o yaha, Nyama, niriba n-yi zoya maa sunsuuni siɣirina ŋɔ, ka shɛb mi yi baɣisi oki tia la polo kanna.
en: But Zebul, look over there, Gaal said. There's a crowd coming down from the sacred mountain, and another group is coming along the road from the tree where people talk with the spirits of the dead.

dag: Ka Isaka bidibisi daa nyɛ: Tola mini Puva ni Jashub ni Shimrɔn.
en: Issachar and his sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.

dag: Wummiya n wuhibu, ka niŋ yɛm. Miriya ka yi zaɣisi li.
en: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.

dag: Ti daa yulila sɔŋsim soli hal ka ti nini ti sabi, ti daa yuunila zuliya shɛb soli ni bɛ tiligi ti, ka bɛ daa bi tooi tiligi ti.
en: For help that never came, we looked until we could look no longer. We kept waiting for help from a nation that had none to give.

dag: Biɛɣ ti yɛn neei ka zibisim vuui. N ni zo yomyom du mɛɛr ni nyo zo shɛli zuɣu, ka zo n-du firanki tulaale zim ni nyo dabo shɛli zuɣu.
en: I will go to that mountain of myrrh and to that hill of frankincense while the day breathes its last breath, and the shadows run away.

dag: Amaa Ɛliɛza ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bidibisi ka kpi. O daa dɔɣila bipuɣinsi ko. Ka Kish ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ maa ni nir la bidibis daa kpuɣ o bipuɣinsi maa.
en: Eleazar died without having sons. He only had daughters. Eleazars daughters married their own relatives. Their relatives were Kishs sons.

dag: Chɛ ka n wumd a yurilim maŋli la yɛla asiba kam; dama nyini ka n niŋ naani. N suhir a, wuhim ma n ni yɛn doli so shɛli, dama nyini ka n kuhiri niŋda.
en: Tell me all about your faithful love come morning time, because I trust you. Show me the way I should go, because I offer my life up to you.

dag: O nam dariza bi mali ya dabiɛm, ka dabiɛm gbahi ya o zuɣu?.
en: and his glorious splendor would make you terrified.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Yɛlimiya ninvuɣ so ŋun tim ya n sani ŋɔ na.
en: and she told them to go back to the king and give him.

dag: Ka doo maa yi taali ni, amaa ka paɣ maa ŋun taali ʒi o zuɣu.
en: If the husband is wrong, he will not be punished; but if his wife is guilty, she will be punished.

dag: Wuhibu maa bela lahibal sun shɛli Naawuni ŋun nyɛ jilimalana mini alibarikalan ŋɔ ni zaŋ niŋ n nuu ni ni m mol li la puuni.
en: That teaching is part of the Good News that our blessed God gave me to tell. In it we see his glory.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai zoli maa gbini, ka o deei li bɛ sani n-zaŋ kpɛhi duu; ka chɛbisi ba ka bɛ ŋmaligi labi.
en: When Gehazi arrived at the elevated fortress, he took the items from them and stored them in his house. Then he sent the servants away, and they left.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi wuna din ka bukaata la zaŋ bɛ ʒiɛyimtali biɛhigu zaŋ chaŋ a sani bahi.
en: All who worship worthless idols turn from the God who offers them mercy.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa bɔhi ba pahi buta, Bɔzuɣu? Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka o lee tum? M bi nya ka o tum tuumbiɛ shɛli din simdi kum. Dinzuɣu n ni chɛmi ka bɛ fiɛb o, ka zaŋ o bahi.
en: For the third time, Pilate said to them, Why? What wrong has he done? Ive found no legal basis for the death penalty in his case. Therefore, I will have him whipped, then let him go.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The LORD said to Moses.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ Zɛdɛkia kuli Babilɔn, ka o ti be nimaani hal ka n ti lan zaŋ n zaɣa labis o polo. Hal yi yi tuhi Babilɔnnim maa, yi ku di nasara. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.?.
en: And Zedekiah will be carried off to Babylon to live out his days until I punish him, declares the LORD. If you make war against the Babylonians, you will fail.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun niŋdi sokam zaa zaɣ viɛlli, ka zɔri o ni nam binshɛɣukam zaa nambɔɣu.
en: The LORD is good to everyone and everything; Gods compassion extends to all his handiwork.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-lee muɣisi ya bee bɔ n-leei niŋ ka yi biɛhindi yi suhuri ni?.
en: He said to them, Why are you startled? Why are doubts arising in your hearts?.

dag: Sana bee tinzun nir yi be yi sani ka ti leei bundana, ka yi mabia mi leei faralana, ka zaŋ omaŋa pa talima san maa bee tinzun nir maa bee san maa yiŋ ninvuɣ so sani.
en: If an immigrant or foreign guest prospers financially among you, but your fellow Israelite faces financial difficulty and so sells themselves to the immigrant or foreign guest, or to a descendant of a foreigner.

dag: Lala ka yi ni shɛb daa be. Amaa ka Naawuni daa paɣi yi daalahichi bahi, ka mali ya ka yi be kasi. Ka yi leei wuntizɔriba ti Duuma Yisa Masia yuli mini Naawuni Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God.

dag: A chɛ a niriba tuumbiɛri paŋ ba; ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi zaa paŋ ba.
en: Youve forgiven your peoples wrongdoing; youve covered all their sins. Selah.

dag: O ni daa kul nyɛ Naawuni Bia maa zaa yoli, o daa bɔhim nɔdeebo wahala dibu puuni.
en: Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o n-zaŋ o chaŋ nayili dunɔdali din yuli daa booni wɔhu dunɔdal la gbini nti ku o nimaani.
en: They arrested her when she reached the entrance of the Horse Gate at the royal palace. She was executed there.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa ti zaɣisi zuɣulaannim maa noli; ka kul jɛmdila wuna. Di daa bi yuui ka bɛ ŋmaligi ka chɛ bɛ yaannim bɛn daa doli Yawɛ zaligunim ni daa doli so shɛl la, ka shiri bi dol li.
en: But the Israelites did not listen to their judges. The Israelites were not faithful to God—they followed other gods. In the past, the ancestors of the Israelites obeyed the Lord s commands. But now the Israelites changed and stopped obeying the Lord.

dag: dindina yi ni tooi saɣim n ni daa lo n dabili Dauda alikauli shɛl la gba din ni chɛ ka o ku lan mali bidibiga ŋun ni ʒin o nam ʒiishee mini n ni daa lo n tumtumdiba Lɛvinim alikauli shɛl la.
en: then you could change my agreement with David and Levi. Then descendants from David would not be the kings, and the family of Levi would not be priests.

dag: Di bo yomyom yaag a noli bee n-jiɣ a suhu ni n-yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli Naawuni tooni, dama Naawuni bela alizanda ni, ka a mi be dunia ŋɔ ni; dinzuɣu chɛ ka a yɛtɔɣa pɔra.
en: Think before you speak, and don't make any rash promises to God. He is in heaven and you are on earth, so don't say any more than you have to.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuhi pam m-bɔhi, Ti min a bɔ ni, nyin Naawuni Bia? A kamina ni a ti nahim ti ka saha na bi paai.
en: Suddenly they shouted, Jesus, Son of God, what do you want with us? Have you come to punish us before our time.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa duh o zuɣu yul o nyaandoliba maa ka yɛli, Yinim bɛn nyɛ nandaamba ŋɔ mal alibarika, dama Naawuni nam nyɛla yi dini.
en: Jesus looked at his disciples and said, Happy are you poor; the Kingdom of God is yours!.

dag: amaa ka Ammɔn nabihi daa yɛli bɛ dan Hanun, A tɛhiya ni Dauda ni tim tuumba na ka bɛ ti sɔɣi kuli maa wuhiri ni yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu ka o be a maa? Dauda timla niriba ŋɔ na ni bɛ ti vihi baŋ yaŋɔ daashili zaa ka tuhi nyaŋ ti.
en: the Ammonite officials asked their master Hanun, Do you really believe David is honoring your father because he has sent you condolences? Of course not! David has sent his servants to you to search the city, spy it out, and overthrow it.

dag: O kari ma bahi zibisim ni, ka neesim shɛli kani.
en: He chased me into a dark place, where no light could enter.

dag: Ka bɛ daa di ka nyu dindali maa ni suhupiɛlli pam Yawɛ tooni. Ka bɛ daa lan booi kpam bahi Dauda bia Sulemaana zuɣu ni n-zaŋ o leei naa ti Yawɛ m-pahi buyi, ka zaŋ Zadok leei maligumaana.
en: So that day they were very happy as they ate and drank in the presence of the Lord . For a second time they proclaimed Solomon king. In the name of the Lord they anointed him as their ruler and Zadok as priest.

dag: Mahili bidibisi ni Ɛliɛza ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bidibiga la n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Mahlis son was Eleazar, but Eleazar did not have sons.

dag: Amaa o bihi yi ti zaɣisi n zaligu, ka bi doli n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi.
en: If his descendants stop following my law and stop obeying my commands.

dag: A daa lo a suhu ni ni a ni du zuɣusaa ha n-chaŋ ti yaɣi Naawuni saŋmarisi zuɣu n-zaŋ a nam kuɣ zali nimaani. A daa tɛhiya ni a ni chaŋ ti ʒini laɣiŋgu zoli din du pam ka be nuzaa polo la zuɣu.
en: You were determined to climb up to heaven and to place your throne above the highest stars. You thought you would sit like a king on that mountain in the north where the gods assemble.

dag: Dinzuɣu tintariga maa yɛn zaŋla teeku tariga hal ni Hazɛrɛnɔn din be Damaskus tintariga nuzaa polo, ka chɛ Hamat tintariga bahi nuzaa polo. Dina n-yɛn nyɛ nuzaa polo maa yaɣili.
en: So the border will go from the sea to Hazar Enan on the northern border of Damascus and Hamath. This will be on the north side.

dag: Yihimiya putɔɣu mini suhuyiɣisili ni sujee ni zabili ni nyaanzubo ni biɛr biɛɣu zaa yi bebu ni.
en: Get rid of all bitterness, passion, and anger. No more shouting or insults, no more hateful feelings of any sort.

dag: N Duuma Yisa zuɣu, m mi ka biɛhiŋ kani ni binshɛɣ kani m-mali daɣiri dimaŋmaŋ puuni, amaa so yi tɛhi ni binshɛli mali daɣiri, o sani di shiri mali daɣiri.
en: I know and Im convinced in the Lord Jesus that nothing is wrong to eat in itself. But if someone thinks something is wrong to eat, it becomes wrong for that person.

dag: Bɛ yi kar o saria, bɛn wuhimi ni o mali taali, ka chɛ ka o wunsuhigu leei alahichi.
en: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.

dag: ka daa lan zaŋ bantabiga vil o, ka zaŋ salima bimparilan din be kasi niŋ di tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: He also put the turban on Aarons head. He put the strip of gold on the front of the turban. This strip of gold is the holy crown. Moses did this just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbɛri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa gbini, dama bɛ tuma daa nyɛla bɛ guli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka yoori di dunoya biɛɣ asiba kam.
en: They lived near the Temple, because it was their duty to guard it and to open the gates every morning.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa pun yɛli Musa.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Bee na ŋuni n-lee ni bɔri ni o lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuh o kpee, ka ku ʒini niŋ laasabu nya o ni tooi zaŋ tɔbbihi tuhi pia chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ o kpee ŋun mali tɔbbihi tuhi pisi?.
en: Or what king would go to war against another king without first sitting down to consider whether his ten thousand soldiers could go up against the twenty thousand coming against him?.

dag: Birim a bimbira asiba ni zaawuni, dama a ku tooi baŋ din ti yɛn niŋ, dimbɔŋɔ bee din la bee di zaa nti yɛn niŋ.
en: Plant your seeds early in the morning and keep working in the field until dark. Who knows? Your work might pay off, and your seeds might produce.

dag: Miligim ka chɛ niriba ŋɔ, ka n ku ba pumpɔŋɔ! Ka bɛ daa lu n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa.
en: Move back from these people, and I will destroy them on the spot! The two of them bowed down with their faces to the ground.

dag: Nyama, Mani n-nam machɛle, ka ti zuɣiri pɔhim, ka di chɛ ka buɣimsala buɣim nyɛligira, ka machɛli kuriti bidibbini din ni ku di bukaata. Mani n lan nam ŋun bɔhiri biɛri ka o kuri niriba.
en: Don't forget that I created metalworkers who make weapons over burning coals. I also created armies that can bring destruction.

dag: A sɔŋsim zuɣu ka o jilima galisi; ka a chɛ ka o yuli du ka o nam mali dariza.
en: His glory is great because of your help; you have given him fame and majesty.

dag: Bɛ ni ti deei Ɛdomnim tiŋgbɔŋ su. Siɛrinim dimnim ni ti deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ su.
en: Israel will conquer Edom and capture the land of that enemy nation.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka o yɛri bɛn bala la mi, Timmiya tiŋ puuni dol o nyaaŋa ku niriba. Di yuliya yaɣi so zuɣu bee n-zo so nambɔɣu.
en: And I heard God say to the other men, Follow him through the city and kill. Spare no one; have mercy on no one.

dag: Amaa yiŋbia maa yi yɛl o suhu ni ni o yiŋlan yuui kundi na, ka piligi bur o tab bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba, ka diri ka nyuri dam kuuna.
en: But suppose one of the servants thinks that the master won't return until late. Suppose that servant starts beating all the other servants and eats and drinks and gets drunk.

dag: Ka o ni yuri ya shɛm o suhu ni kul pahirimi, di bahi bamdi o yi teei yi zaa nɔdeebo mini yi ni daa deeg o ni sizuura lubu la yɛla.
en: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.

dag: Dama bɛnkam ti tum din chihiri maa, bɛn yihim ba bɛ daŋ ni.
en: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.

dag: O daa tuhi deei Izraɛl tintariga tinsi Lɛbohamat dunol shee zaŋ hal ti paai Araba Teeku ni kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa chɛ ka o dabili anabi Jona Amitai bia ŋun daa yi Gatihɛfa la na yɛli shɛm la.
en: He reconquered all the territory that had belonged to Israel, from Hamath Pass in the north to the Dead Sea in the south. This was what the Lord , the God of Israel, had promised through his servant the prophet Jonah son of Amittai from Gath Hepher.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ti ba. Ti yab Ibrahimma ʒi ti, ka Yaakubu gba bi mi ti. Amaa nyin Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti ba, ka a yuli nyɛ ti Tiligira kurimbuni ha.
en: You are our father. Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob do not acknowledge us, but you, Lord , are our father, the one who has always rescued us.

dag: Di yi pala Yawɛ m-me yili, bɛn mɛri li dirila wahala yoli. Di yi pala Yawɛ n-guli tiŋa, tiŋguliba gul li la yoli.
en: If the Lord does not build the house, the work of the builders is useless; if the Lord does not protect the city, it does no good for the sentries to stand guard.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii wɔribariba ayi, ka naa maa tim ba Siria tɔbbihi maa sani ka yɛli ba, Chamiya ti nya.
en: So they chose two chariots with their horses. The king sent them after the Aramean army, saying, Go and see.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ tahima niŋ Naawuni ni, ka ku tam Naawuni tuma yɛla, ka kul dol o zaligunima.
en: In this way they also will put their trust in God and not forget what he has done, but always obey his commandments.

dag: ka ŋun Aduna ti zaŋ o nuh ayi pa bu nɛɔŋ maa zuɣu ni, ka kaŋka Izraɛlnim tuumbiɛri zaa mini bɛ biriginsim zaa ni bɛ daalahichi zaa n-zaŋ li ʒili bua maa, ka bɛ ni pun pii ninvuɣ so zali vo bua maa chaŋ mɔɣu ni.
en: There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins.

dag: Di simdi ni o ŋmaligi ka chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu ka tumdila din tuhi. Di simdi ni o bola suhudoo, ka kul biɛhiri di naba hal ti nya li.
en: You must turn away from evil and do good; you must strive for peace with all your heart.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi kuli Izraɛl zuliya daŋ shɛli puuni niriba, dindina ti yaannim tarili ni ka bɛ tarili ni yina, ka bɛ zaŋ li pahi bɛ ni kuli daŋ shɛli puuni dɔbba maa tarili ni; di saha ka di yi ti tarili ni.
en: But if they marry men from other tribes of Israel, the land they receive will become part of that tribe's inheritance and will no longer belong to us.

dag: dama o daalahichi dumi hal ti paai sagbana, ka Naawuni teeg o tuumbiɛri yɛla.
en: Her sins have piled up as high as heaven, and God remembered her unjust acts.

dag: Bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa n sani n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, saha shɛli bɛ yaannim ni daa yi Ijipti na hal ni zuŋɔ la zuɣu. .
en: My people have done what I hate and have not stopped making me angry since their ancestors left Egypt.

dag: O daa chɛ ka zɔhi waɣi pam muɣisi ba, ka chɛ ka poloya gba waɣi n-saɣim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.

dag: Di saha ka omaŋmaŋ daa yiɣisi chaŋ Rama nti chaŋ kɔbil titali din be Sɛku la gbini ti bɔhi, Ya ka Samuɛl mini Dauda lee be la? Ka so yɛl o, Nyama bɛ be Naiɔt Rama tiŋgban ni.
en: Then he himself started out to Ramah. When he came to the large well in Secu, he asked where Samuel and David were and was told that they were at Naioth.

dag: Ka Gomna Filiksi daa ti Pool noli ni o tɔɣisi. Ka Pool daa yaag o noli yɛli, N ni mi ni yuma shɛm ka a nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim sariakarita zuɣu, di niŋ ma nyaɣisim ni n tɔɣisi zabi mmaŋ zuɣu a sani.
en: The governor motioned for Paul to speak, and he began: I know that you have judged the people of our nation for many years, and I am glad to defend myself in your court.

dag: Ka yilibila daa bili yina tam yila anahi maa zaɣ yini zuɣu. Ka di yiko daa yɛligi kpa nudirigu polo mini wulimpuhili polo ni Alikauli Tiŋgbɔŋ la polo.
en: A single, very small horn came out of one of the four horns. It grew bigger and bigger, stretching toward the south, the east, and the beautiful country.

dag: Amaa ka Iso yɛl o, M mabia, mal a bini; n gba bi kɔŋ.
en: But Esau said, You dont have to give me gifts, brother. I have enough for myself.

dag: Chɛ ka m be a jɛmbu duu sahakam, ka chɛ ka n sɔɣ a kpiŋkpama lɔŋni.
en: I want to live in your tent forever. I want to hide where you can protect me. Selah.

dag: Ka paɣ ŋɔ ti dɔni marig o bia yuŋ ka o kpi.
en: Then one night she accidentally rolled over on her baby and smothered it.

dag: N kul ni dol a zaligu sahakam.
en: I will always keep your Instruction, always and forever!.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Yisahaku zuliya jɛmbu shee saɣim; ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim sara maligu bimbin la shee saɣim; chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku Naa Jɛrɔbɔam zuliya zaa.
en: The places where Isaac's descendants worship will be destroyed. The holy places of Israel will be left in ruins. I will bring the dynasty of King Jeroboam to an end.

dag: Gbihim biɛla, dɔnim biɛla, zaŋm a nuhi taɣili taba vuhi biɛla.
en: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little lying down with folded arms.

dag: Ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya ni yi kummi ka fabili, ka pini zuɣukpina, ka pili buri.
en: The Sovereign Lord Almighty was calling you then to weep and mourn, to shave your heads and wear sackcloth.

dag: Yinima ninsalinim ka m boona. Bɛnkam be bɛ nyɛviya ni ka m booni maa.
en: I am calling out to each one of you!.

dag: Amaa dɔro yi be situr shɛli ni bee bɛ ni bahi mi shɛŋa ni bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan shɛŋa ni bee bɛ ni zaŋ gbaŋ mali binshɛli ni, ka yi paɣi li ka di yi, di simdi ka yi paɣi li pahi buyi, ka di yi daɣiri ni.
en: But if the mildew did not come back after washing, that piece of leather or cloth is clean, whether the cloth was woven or knitted.

dag: Kpaŋm amaŋ chɛ ka Ziinas ŋun nyɛ zaligubaŋda la mini Apolɔs niŋ yomyom gbaai soli chaŋ, ka zaŋ di ni simdi ni bɛ mali shɛli ti ba.
en: Zenas the lawyer and Apollos will be traveling from there. Do all that you can to help them prepare for their trip. Be sure that they have everything they need.

dag: Di saha maa ha so daa yi yɛn chaŋ shɛli polo ka labina o suhu bi doya; dama tinsi maa nim daa kul zabirimi.
en: At that time, it wasnt safe to travel because great turmoil affected all the inhabitants of the area.

dag: N yura maa n su ma ka n gba su o. O chɛ ka o biŋkɔbbaligu ŋubiri mɔri Paɣiviɛligakushihikom shee.
en: My lover is mine, and I am his; he feeds his flock among the lilies.

dag: Ka sokam deeri Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tiri pin shɛŋa maa niriba zaa sɔŋsim nyabu zuɣu.
en: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.

dag: Ka gomna Rɛhum gba mini Shimshai ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ yaɣili maa polo gbaŋŋmar la daa sab gbaŋ ti Naa Atazɛrikisɛs zaŋ chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm yɛla polo. Bɛ ni daa sab yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Rehum the royal deputy and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter concerning Jerusalem to King Artaxerxes as follows.

dag: Di saha ka o daa boli Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa ni ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛn be o sani, bihi zaŋ tabili ninkura na.
en: so I called together Johanan, all the army leaders who were with him, and all the other people.

dag: Yi lo nia shɛŋa din ka buchi, yimaŋmaŋ vuhim ni ŋmaligi din ya kaman buɣim la.
en: You make worthless plans and everything you do is useless. My spirit is like a fire that will destroy you.

dag: N ni ŋme solɔɣu du n zoya zaa, ka mali n soya ka di viɛla.
en: I will level the mountains and make roads.

dag: amaa zaŋm ma ti sɔŋla m banim dooshee. Ʒimiya ma yi Ijipti ŋɔ kuli nti sɔɣi ma bɛ sɔɣibu shee. Ka Yisifu yɛl o, N ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: I want to be buried where my fathers are; carry me out of Egypt and bury me where they are buried. Joseph answered, I will do as you say.

dag: Ka Amnɔn daa zaŋ di yɛla muɣis omaŋ hal ti gbaai dɔro o tizɔpaɣ Tama maa zuɣu. Dama Tama daa na ʒi doo, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Amnɔn kɔŋ o ni yɛn niŋ o shɛm.
en: She was a virgin. Amnon wanted her very much, but he did not think it was possible for him to have her. He thought about her so much that he made himself sick.

dag: Bee di yi nyɛla buɣim nyooi so ka buɣim yum maa ti liɣisi zaɣ piɛlli din mooi bee zaɣ piɛlli.
en: Whenever there is a burn on someones skin, and the raw patch of the burn becomes a reddish-white or white shiny spot.

dag: Ka Pool daa bɔri ni o zaŋ o pah omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ; dinzuɣu ka o daa guni Timoti, Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be tinsi maa ni la zuɣu, dama bɛ zaa daa mi ni Timoti ba nyɛla Giriiki doo.
en: Paul wanted to take Timothy along with him, so he circumcised him. He did so because all the Jews who lived in those places knew that Timothy's father was Greek.

dag: Ka ti Duuma daa yɛl o, Yinim Farisiinim paɣirila pipihi mini lahi nyaansi, amaa ka yi puuni lee pali ninvuɣ fabo mini ninvuɣ biɛtali.
en: So the Lord said to him: You Pharisees clean the outside of cups and dishes, but on the inside you are greedy and evil.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ tinim Yawɛ niriba ŋɔ ka yɔɣu ŋɔ ni na ni ti mini ti biŋkɔbiri ti kpi kpe?.
en: Why have you brought us out into this wilderness? Just so that we can die here with our animals?.

dag: Yawɛ, fam ma ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahi; guli ma, ka duŋtaariba ku paai ma.
en: Save me, Lord , from evildoers; keep me safe from violent people.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa ti tim ka bɛ chaŋ ti yih o na ka o deeg o. Ka naa maa daa bɔh o ashilɔni o yiŋ maa ni, Yawɛ yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli? Ka Jɛrimia garigi yɛli, O yɛli shɛli. Di saha ka o daa yɛli, Bɛ ni zaŋ a niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni.
en: Then King Zedekiah sent for Jeremiah and had him brought to the palace. Zedekiah talked to Jeremiah in private. He asked Jeremiah, Is there any message from the Lord ? Jeremiah answered, Yes, he said that you will be given to the king of Babylon.

dag: Amaa yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni wum n suhigu ka deei n suhigu maa.
en: But God has indeed heard me; he has listened to my prayer.

dag: M mabihi, pumpɔŋɔ ti ŋmanila Yisahaku; ti nyɛla Naawuni bihi o daalikauli lɔbu zuɣu.
en: Now, you, my friends, are God's children as a result of his promise, just as Isaac was.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun daa lee yi ha nti nya o kpe so ŋun daa di o gba samli ka di bi yaɣi lala, ka o ʒe n-di dilan maa nyiŋgol ni ka yɛl o, Yom ma n samli la.
en: Then the man went out and met one of his fellow servants who owed him a few dollars. He grabbed him and started choking him. Pay back what you owe me! he said.

dag: Zɛdɛkia daa lan zaɣisi ni o ku jɛm Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ŋun daa chɛ ka o po Naawuni ni o ni jɛm o la, ka daa lan niŋ karimbaani ni tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku labi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni la sani.
en: Zedekiah rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had forced him to swear in God's name that he would be loyal. He stubbornly refused to repent and return to the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Tarimtali mini Yawɛ zɔbo laara nyɛla buni mini jilima ni nyɛvili.
en: The reward of humility and the fear of the LORD is wealth, honor, and life.

dag: M mali baŋsim gari n karimbanima, dama n kul tɛhirila a zaligunim maa yɛla.
en: I am wiser than all my teachers, because I study your rules.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Jɔn sani ti yɛl o, Karimba, ŋun daa be a sani Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili yaɣili ka a di o shɛhira la baptaizirila niriba pumpɔŋɔ, ka sokam zaa kabiri chani o sani.
en: They came to John and said, Rabbi, look! The man who was with you across the Jordan, the one about whom you testified, is baptizing and everyone is flocking to him.

dag: Ka bɛ yi saɣi suhumahili yɛtɔɣa maa, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ tin ya, dindina ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani zaa ni tum dabitim tuma tin ya.
en: If they open the gates and surrender, they are all to become your slaves and do forced labor for you.

dag: Daadam, a ni kari ba saria? A ni kari ba saria? Di nyaaŋa ka a chɛ ka bɛ baŋ bɛ yaannim ni daa tum din chihiri shɛŋa.
en: Should you judge them? Will you judge them, son of man? You must tell them about the terrible things their fathers have done.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi maa daa ti zaŋ Simiɔn chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu. Dindali maa ka Yisifu mini Mariama gba daa zaŋ Yisa chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni ni bɛ ti niŋ kaman Anabi Musa zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛm la.
en: When Mary and Joseph brought Jesus to the temple to do what the Law of Moses says should be done for a new baby, the Spirit told Simeon to go into the temple.

dag: Nir yi garigi bɔhigu viɛnyɛla di nyɛla suhupiɛlli nir kam sani. Ka nir yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa di tɔɣisibu saha, di viɛla.
en: Giving the right answer at the right time makes everyone happy.

dag: N yɛli Yawɛ, Nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni. Yawɛ, gbilisim tibili wum n suhigu.
en: I tell the LORD, You are my God! Listen to my request for mercy, LORD.

dag: Ka lan bɔh o, Filip, a bi niŋ yɛda ni m be m Ba maa ni ka m Ba maa gba be n ni? Yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n ni tɔɣisiri ya maa, m bi tɔɣisiri li la mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni; amaa m Ba ŋun be n ni maa n tumdi o tuma maa.
en: Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.

dag: Ka Lɛvi bidibisi maa daa niŋ kaman Musa ni yɛli ba shɛm, ka bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb dindali maa kalinli daa nyɛla kaman dɔbba tusaata.
en: The Levites obeyed, and killed about three thousand men that day.

dag: Yawɛ, gbilisim a tibili wum, ka neeg a nina nya, ka wum Sɛnachɛrib ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa ti na tu nyin Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ.
en: LORD, turn your ear this way and hear! LORD, open your eyes and see! Listen to Sennacheribs words. He sent them to insult the living God!.

dag: Ka Pita daa dii yiɣisi doli ba. O ni daa mali ti paai, ka bɛ zaŋ o du jirambisa zuɣusaa duu maa ni, ka tiŋ maa ni pakoya zaa daa ʒe n-gili Pita kumda, ka wuhir o binyɛr shɛŋa Dɔɔkas ni daa na be o nyɛvili ni ka she n-ti ba.
en: So Peter got ready and went with them. When he arrived, he was taken to the room upstairs, where all the widows crowded around him, crying and showing him all the shirts and coats that Dorcas had made while she was alive.

dag: M bia, di tam n ni wuh a shɛli, amaa gbibi n ni wuh a shɛli maa a suhu ni.
en: My child, don't forget what I teach you. Always remember what I tell you to do.

dag: Mɛshɛzabɛl bia Pɛtahia ŋun daa yi Zɛra daŋ ni na, ka nyɛ Juda zuliya nir la n-daa nyɛ ŋun ʒe niriba zaani Pɛriʒia Naa sani saria dibu shee bɛ yɛlli kam ni.
en: Pethahiah son of Meshezabel, of the clan of Zerah and the tribe of Judah, represented the people of Israel at the Persian court.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Pɛɛgamum Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun mali takɔb dirili din mali naŋgbana ayi la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.

dag: amaa ka o nini daa bi tiɣi Keen ŋun min o sara maa. Dinzuɣu ka Keen suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o zuŋ o ninni.
en: but he rejected Cain and his offering. Cain became furious, and he scowled in anger.

dag: Ka bɛ mini bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa daa kpe kpiimba biɛhigu shee zaɣ nɛma, ka tiŋgbani mum ba niŋ, ka bɛ daa bahi yoli niriba maa ni.
en: So they went down alive to the world of the dead, with their possessions. The earth closed over them, and they vanished.

dag: yin chɛliya ka o mal o ni daa kɔhi li yuun shɛli maa zaŋ kana di saha maa laasabu, ka yo laɣ shɛli din pahi ti o ni daa kɔhi li ti so maa, ka bɛ labis o tiŋgbani ti o.
en: In that case you must pay to the one who bought it a sum that will make up for the years remaining until the next Year of Restoration, when you would in any event recover your land.

dag: n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ka yɛli, N niŋgbun shɛli n ni zaŋ pa talima yi zuɣu m-bala. Niŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ teemi n yɛla.
en: gave thanks to God, broke it, and said, This is my body, which is for you. Do this in memory of me.

dag: ka lihiri buɣim ni dir o ka di nyɔhi kpuɣiri duri zuɣusaa maa ka kuhiri yɛra, Tin dini n-yi lee beni ŋ-ŋmani tin titali ŋɔ.
en: They saw the smoke from her burning. They cried out, There was never a city like this great city.

dag: O daa ti bɛ ni yino la pɔŋ tusaanu, ka ti yino pɔŋ tusaayi, ka ti ŋun kpalim la mi pɔŋ tuhili. O daa ti bɛ zaa la kaman bɛ yaa tariga ni nyɛ shɛm ka naanyi chaŋ.
en: He gave to each one according to his ability: to one he gave five thousand gold coins, to another he gave two thousand, and to another he gave one thousand. Then he left on his trip.

dag: Ʒiri be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɔri nia biɛri tɛha ni, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri din viɛli tumbu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Deceit is in the heart of those who plan evil, but there is joy for those who advise peace.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni lan me Ziɔn, o ni kana ni o jilima.
en: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen.

dag: ka zaŋ Yawɛ ni daa lo Izraɛlnim alikauli shɛl la ni be adaka shɛl ni la niŋ di puuni.
en: I have put the Box of the Agreement in the Temple. The Lord s Agreement with Israel is in that box.

dag: Guŋgombihi din kumsi tiri suhupiɛlli mini mɔɣilɔnim kumsi foya, ka bɛn yɔri suhupiɛlli vuri gba fo.
en: The joyous tambourines have ceased; the roar of partiers has stopped; the joyous harp has ceased.

dag: A ni mi shɛli, n gba mi li. M pala ŋun pooi daadam a sani.
en: Just as you know, I also know; Im not inferior to you.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ o daa zaŋla Yisa yihina nti ʒin o saria karibu ʒiishee din nyɛ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Gabata Hiburuli ni la. Di gbinni nyɛla luɣ shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ kuɣa ŋme m-malimali.
en: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out to the place called The Stone Pavement. Pilate sat down on the judges seat there.

dag: Anab ŋuni ka yi yaannim maa daa lee bi niŋ alaka? Bɛna n-daa ku Naawuni ni daa tim o daanab shɛb bɛn daa daŋ na ni bɛ ti moli ŋun Naawuni wuntialana kandina molo la, ka yi mi yi o nyaaŋa ku o.
en: They persecuted every prophet who ever lived. They even killed those who long ago said that the Righteous One would come. And now you have turned against that Righteous One and killed him.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa atam bupia kam puuni yim zuɣu, di yi nyɛla tiŋgban ni bindira bee tihi wala, di nyɛla Yawɛ dini, ka nyɛ din be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: One tenth of all the produce of the land, whether grain or fruit, belongs to the Lord .

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti ʒini Naawuni jɛmbu duu miri bɛ liɣiri tɔhibu shee n-yuuni niriba ni tɔhiri liɣiri shɛm; ka bundaannim tɔhiri pampam.
en: Jesus sat near the Temple collection box and watched as people put money into it. Many rich people put in a lot of money.

dag: O ni yɛli, N ni lan chɛ ka ŋɔ nyɛla yɛtɔɣ shɛli din wuhiri ni binshɛŋa din nyɛ binnamda ka damdi la ni vuui ni di chɛ ka binshɛŋa din ku tooi dam la kpalim be.
en: The words once more plainly show that the created things will be shaken and removed, so that the things that cannot be shaken will remain.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, A nya du kara ŋɔ zaa bebɔ? Di zaa ni ti wurim hal ka di kuɣ yini gba ti ku lan pa di kpee zuɣu.
en: Jesus responded, Do you see these enormous buildings? Not even one stone will be left upon another. All will be demolished.

dag: Nuhu gba ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbisinu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt.
en: When Noah was years old, Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yiɣisi chani Zarɛfat nti yɛn kpe tiŋ maa ni ka nya pako so ka o be nimaani pihiri dari, ka o bol o yɛl o, Kpɛm ti tooi kom biɛla niŋ pipia ni ti ma na ka n nyu.
en: When Elijah came near the town gate of Zarephath, he saw a widow gathering sticks for a fire. Would you please bring me a cup of water? he asked.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni daa duh o pam zaŋ o ʒili jilima ʒiishee, ka ti o yuli din tibisi gari yuli kam.
en: For this reason God raised him to the highest place above and gave him the name that is greater than any other name.

dag: O daa jɛmdila Baal, ka dol o ba ni daa niŋ shɛlikam la soli n-chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: Ahaziah served the false god Baal and worshiped him, just as his father did before him. He did all the things that his father did to make the Lord , the God of Israel, angry.

dag: Amaa Hiram ni daa ti yi Taai kana ni o ti nya tin shɛŋa Sulemaana ni zaŋ ti o maa, o nini daa bi tiɣi li.
en: Hiram went to see them, and he did not like them.

dag: Yinima ninsalinim ka m boona. Bɛnkam be bɛ nyɛviya ni ka m booni maa.
en: I appeal to all of you; I call to everyone on earth.

dag: Gɛbal kpamba mini di yɛnnim daa bela a sani m-maani a shee kpatuɣa zaana. Teeku puuni ŋarima zaa mini di kpatoonsi zaa daa nyɛla bɛn be a ni dar a nɛma.
en: Experienced men from Byblos repaired any damages. Sailors from all over shopped at the stores in your port.

dag: Aduna bidibis ayi la ni daa chaŋ miri Yawɛ ka kpi la nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa.
en: The Lord spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron who were killed when they offered unholy fire to the Lord .

dag: O ti o niriba faako. O lo o daalikauli ni di kul ʒiɛya sahakam. O yuli be kasi ka mali dabiɛm.
en: God sent redemption for his people; God commanded that his covenant last forever. Holy and awesome is Gods name!.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Wula ka niriba lee ni tooi yɛli ni Masia nyɛla Naa Dauda yaaŋa?.
en: Jesus said to them, Why do they say that the Christ is Davids son?.

dag: Nir ni tooi ba wɔhu n-kari kuɣa ni? Ka nir ni tooi zaŋ naɣikɔra n-ko teeku ni? Amaa yi zaŋ yɛlimaŋli leei ʒiri, ka zaŋ din tuhi leei din bi tuhi.
en: Do horses gallop on rocks? Does anyone plow the sea with oxen? Yet you have turned justice into poison, and right into wrong.

dag: Dama m baŋ n tuumbiɛri ni nyɛ shɛli, ka n daalahichi kul ʒe n tooni.
en: I recognize my faults; I am always conscious of my sins.

dag: Yi daazichi pooya, ka lɛla ŋubi saɣim yi situra.
en: Your riches have rotted away, and your clothes have been eaten by moths.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n wumya. A nini shiri ku lan nya ma.
en: Then Moses told Pharaoh, You are right about one thing. I will not come to see you again.

dag: Yi yi ti suhiri Naawuni, yi boon o la yi Ba. Ŋun Naawuni n-nyɛ sariakarita ŋun kariti sokam zaa yinoyino saria kaman o tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bi yaari so yuri ka chɛ so, dinzuɣu lumiy o sizuura saha shɛli yi ni be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ.
en: You call him Father, when you pray to God, who judges all people by the same standard, according to what each one has done; so then, spend the rest of your lives here on earth in reverence for him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka n daa sabi gbaŋ la tin ya ni m buɣisi ya nya yi deeri noli binshɛɣukam ni.
en: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, faashee bɛ maan labi dɔɣi ninsala, di yi pa lala o ku tooi nya Naawuni nam.
en: Jesus answered, I assure you, everyone must be born again. Anyone who is not born again cannot be in Gods kingdom.

dag: Ti bi nyuri bara n-yaɣiri di ni simdi ni ti nyu bara shɛm tariga ninvuɣ shɛb tuma zuɣu, amaa ti tahima nyɛla ni yi yɛda yi zooi pahi, ti tuma soya gba ni yɛligi yi sani.
en: So we do not boast about the work that others have done beyond the limits God set for us. Instead, we hope that your faith may grow and that we may be able to do a much greater work among you, always within the limits that God has set.

dag: Ka bɛ yiŋlan maa daa yuug o gɔrim maa polo hal ti kuna, ka bɛ min o daa ti laɣim ni bɛ mal o liɣiri maa laasabu.
en: After a long time the master came home. He asked the servants what they did with his money.

dag: Lala ka a yɛn niŋ woligi Lɛvinim maa Izraɛlnim ni, ka Lɛvinim maa nyɛ n ni su shɛba.
en: Separate the Levites in this way from the rest of the Israelites, so that they will belong to me.

dag: O ni daa kuni maa, ka o yiŋbihi tuh o sol na ti yɛl o, A bia la kpaŋya.
en: While he was on his way, his servants were already coming to meet him. They said, Your son lives.

dag: Ka dabili maa yi niŋ a ni wuh o shɛm maa, a ni puh o di zuɣu? Aai!.
en: The servant does not deserve thanks for obeying orders, does he?.

dag: ka Adaya nyɛ Ɛtan bia, ka Ɛtan nyɛ Zimma bia, ka Zimma nyɛ Shimɛi bia.
en: son of Ethan son of Zimmah son of Shimei.

dag: O gurim ma ʒili, ka di leei shɛhira jɛndi ma; ka n kɔɣisibu nyɛ din di shɛhira jɛndi ma.
en: You have made me thin and weak, and people think that means I am guilty.

dag: Zaŋm ma tabil a suhu kaman a nyɛla dalinli la, ka zaŋ ma pa a baɣiri zuɣu kaman n nyɛla dalinli la. Dama yurilim malila yaa kaman kum la, ka kɔre mali yaa kaman gballi. Di dirimi kaman buɣim la, ka di buɣim zilinli mali kpiɔŋ pam.
en: Close your heart to every love but mine; hold no one in your arms but me. Love is as powerful as death; passion is as strong as death itself. It bursts into flame and burns like a raging fire.

dag: Ka o zabiri piɛli kaman piɛ piɛlli kɔbiri bee gumbɔrigu; ka o nina be kaman buɣim zilinli la.
en: His head and hair were white like wool—wool that is white as snow. His eyes were like flames of fire.

dag: Di saha ka o daa lan yɛli Ibram, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun daa yih a Ur din be Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a ka a su li.
en: He said to Abram, I am the Lord who led you from Ur of Babylonia. I did this so that I could give you this land. You will own this land.

dag: Amaa yi suhukpeeni niŋbu puuni ka yi ni ti nya yi nyɛviya.
en: You will be saved by being faithful to me.

dag: N daa lihi zoya zuɣu n-nya ka di sɔhirimi, ka daboya zaa daa chani tooni ka labiri nyaaŋa.
en: I looked at the mountains—they were shaking, and the hills were rocking back and forth.

dag: N suhu kul yɛla a zaligunim dolibu zuɣu sahakam.
en: Im worn out by longing every minute for your rules!.

dag: Kom pam ku tooi kpihi yurilim, ka kokpɛɣu mi ku tooi di li. Nir yi zaŋ o yiŋ azichi zaa ni o da yurilim, bɛ ni mal o ansarisi.
en: Love cannot be drowned by oceans or floods. It cannot be bought— any offer would be scorned no matter how great.

dag: Amaa di ŋmɛriya tab naŋgbankpeeni, so mi di galim o kpee. Yinim maligumaaniba ŋɔ ka n galim.
en: Yet let no one protest, and let no one complain. Listen, priest, I am angry with your people.

dag: Yawɛ, m mi ni a saria karibu nyɛla din tuhi. Ʒiɛyimtali puuni ka a daa darigi n tibili maa.
en: LORD, I know that your rules are right and that you rightly made me suffer.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna, Sara maligu shee alahichi yɛn ʒila a min a bidibisi ni a yaannim zuliya bɛn be a sani zuɣu; ka maligumaanitali alahichi ʒi a min a bidibisi maa kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: The Lord said to Aaron: You, your sons, and the other Levites of the Kohath clan, are responsible for what happens at the sacred tent. And you and your sons will be responsible for what the priests do.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla Hiburɔn din be Juda tiŋgban ni mini di momaha tiŋgbana din gil li la ti ba.
en: This included Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pasture lands around it.

dag: Dama lala naan nyɛla zaɣ biɛtitali di naan nyɛla bibiɛlim tuuni.
en: If I took someone's wife, it would be a horrible crime.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti paai yuun pihinu, bɛn chɛli di tuma maa tumbu.
en: But when a man is years old, he will retire from this hard work.

dag: Ka tiŋ ŋɔ yuli ti ma suhupiɛlli mini paɣibu ni jilima dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam bɛn wum n ni tum tuun suŋ shɛŋa ti ba maa yɛla sani, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira zaɣ viɛl shɛŋa zaa mini tɔŋsim shɛli zaa n ni ti ba maa zuɣu.
en: Then Jerusalem will be a wonderful place. The people will be happy. People from other nations will praise it when they hear about the good things happening there. They will hear about the good things I am doing for Jerusalem.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma doli nudirigu polo dunɔdali n-kpe dundombil ni nti buɣisi nudirigu polo dunɔdali maa, ka di mini dunɔda dina la zaa kul nyɛ yim.
en: Then the man led me through the south gate into the inner courtyard. He measured this gate. This gateway measured the same as the other gates to the inner courtyard.

dag: Ka Naawuni ŋun daa neei Yisa kum ni la Shia yi be yi ni, ŋun Naawuni ŋun daa neei Yisa kum ni maa ni zaŋ nyɛvili niŋ yi gba niŋgbuna din kpiri ŋɔ ni, o Shia ŋun be yi ni la zuɣu.
en: Yet God raised Jesus to life! God's Spirit now lives in you, and he will raise you to life by his Spirit.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Izraɛlnima, n ni kari yi zaa yinoyino saria kaman yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Niŋmiya tuuba, ka zo n-yi yi tuumbiɛri zaa tumbu ni, di yi pa lala tuumbiɛri tumbu maa ni chɛ ka yi bahi yoli.
en: Therefore, I will judge each of you according to your ways, house of Israel. This is what the LORD God says. Turn, turn away from all your sins. Dont let them be sinful obstacles for you.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛli ba, Bomiya la palli n-niŋ yalim niŋ di ni ti ma na. Ka bɛ daa bo li na ti ti o.
en: Put some salt in a new bowl and bring it to me, he ordered. They brought it to him.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Bɛ ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn chɛmi ka n yɛligu din yiri a noli ni na be kaman buɣim la, ka niriba maa mi be kaman dari la, ka buɣim maa di ba.
en: I am the Lord God All-Powerful. Jeremiah, I will tell you exactly what to say. Your words will be a fire; Israel and Judah will be the fuel.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya din niŋ maa yɛli ba di ni niŋ shɛm ka alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu maa ti lan leei ninvuɣ maŋli maa yaha.
en: The men who saw these things happen told the others all about how Jesus made the man well.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Bɛ bi kɔhirila jahinjɛya anu kɔbo? Naawuni mi bi tamdi bɛ ni yino yɛla.
en: Five sparrows are sold for only a few cents, but God doesn't forget a single one of them.

dag: Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisiya pam. O suhuyiɣisili din daa kɔŋ tim maa zuɣu ka o daa niŋ buɣim juui Ziɔn ka di di li zaa.
en: The Lord turned loose the full force of his fury; he lit a fire in Zion that burned it to the ground.

dag: N ni daa kul lihiri yila maa, ka n ti nya yilibila ka di daai yil ata shɛŋa din daa pun saya la n-vuɣ li bahi, ka puhi yina. Yilibil maa daa malila nina ka di be kaman ninsal nina la, ka mali noli ka di tɔɣisiri karimbaan yɛtɔɣa.
en: While I was staring at the horns, I saw a little horn coming up among the others. It tore out three of the horns that were already there. This horn had human eyes and a mouth that was boasting proudly.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuhiri booni tab yɛra, Kasi, kasi, kasi! N-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ. O jilima palila dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: as they shouted, Holy, holy, holy, Lord All-Powerful! The earth is filled with your glory.

dag: Ka o naanyi zaŋ dari maa din kpalim mali o wuni zali n-damdiri di tooni jɛmdi li, ka suhiri li yɛra, Tiligim ma, dama nyini n-nyɛ n wuni.
en: There is a little of the wood left, so he makes a statue and calls it his god. He bows down before it and worships it. He prays to it and says, You are my god, save me.

dag: ka Okiran bia Pagiɛl daa nyɛ Asha zuliya zuɣulana;.
en: Pagiel son of Ochran was in command of the tribe of Asher.

dag: O lan ka kpe; o neei kum ni kaman o ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la. Kamiyana ti nya o ni daa do luɣ shɛli.
en: But he is not here. He has risen from death, as he said he would. Come and see the place where his body was.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ku Sirianim maa chɛchɛbunduhiriba tusaayopɔin mini tɔbbihi bɛn chani tiŋa tuhi pihinahi. Ka o daa lan ku Shɔbak ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ Kamɔna kpɛm maa, ka Sirianim maa daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Izraɛlnima.
en: the Syrians ran from Israel. David killed , chariot troops and , regular soldiers. He also killed Shophach, their commander.

dag: Ka tiŋguliba daa chani gindina ti nya ma n-gbaai ma bu ma ti ma dansi. Ka tiŋ maa gooni guliba daa darigi fuɣi n chinchin shɛli din gbini n nyiŋgoli ni.
en: They found me—the guards who make their rounds in the city. They struck me, bruised me. They took my shawl away from me, those guards of the city walls!.

dag: Dunianima, wummiya, n yɛn chɛmi ka alɔbo lu niriba ŋɔ zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ tuma nyɔri, dama bɛ zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu, ka zaɣisi n wuhibu gba.
en: Pay attention, earth: Im bringing disaster upon my people, the fruit of their own devices, because they have ignored my words and they have rejected my teaching.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Yisifu zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Bɛnjamin zuliya ni mi tuhi pinaayi.
en: from the tribe of Zebulun, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Joseph, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Benjamin, twelve thousand were sealed.

dag: Chamiya ti maan lihi viɛnyɛliŋga n-nya o shiri beni, ka baŋ o ni be luɣ shɛli maa, ka lan baŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun nya o nimaani maa, dama bɛ yɛli ma ni o neeya pam.
en: Now please do just a little more for me. Find out exactly where David is, as well as where he goes, and who has seen him there. I've been told that he's very tricky.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ o bia paɣ dɔni, bɛn kum bɛ niriba ayi maa, bɛ tumla taali bɛ ni nyɛ dɔɣiri yini zuɣu, bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒila bɛ zuɣu.
en: If a man has sexual intercourse with his daughter-in-law, both of them must be executed. They have acted perversely; their blood is on their own heads.

dag: Bɛ nuhi mi tuumbiɛri tumbu pam; kpambaliba mini bɛ sariakaritiba diri birapu. Yikolaannim zaŋdi bɛ suhuyubu zaana, ka lala chɛ ka bɛ naari noli lɔri nia biɛri.
en: They are all experts at doing evil. Officials and judges ask for bribes. The influential people tell them what they want, and so they scheme together.

dag: Shɛlini bɛ daa turi ya ka muɣisiri ya palɔni, ka shɛlini mi yi daa nyɛla bɛn pahi bɛ ni niŋdi yi tab shɛb lala zuɣu.
en: You were at times publicly insulted and mistreated, and at other times you were ready to join those who were being treated in this way.

dag: O daa chaŋ ti kpɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti ŋub sara maligu bɔrɔbɔro shɛŋa din daa chihiri ni so ŋubi naɣila maligumaaniba kɔŋko la, hal ka daa pii li ti ti bɛn daa be o sani maa.
en: He broke the Law by going into Gods house and eating the bread of the presence, which only the priests can eat. He also gave some of the bread to his companions.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa nya ka Abimilɛk kpi maa, ka bɛ zaa ŋmaligi kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: The Israelites saw that Abimelech was dead, so they all went back home.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ nyɛla yaɣili maa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi dabitim ni na, ka nyɛ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa gbahi shɛb daba la. Bɛ daa labila Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda na, ka sokam ti be o ya.
en: These are the people of the province who came back from captivity. In the past, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon took them as prisoners to Babylon. These people came back to Jerusalem and Judah. They all went to their own towns.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛl daa zaŋ o nuhi puli pa tab zuɣu n-zaŋ o nudirigu pa Ifriim ŋun daa nyɛ biasan la zuɣu ni, ka zaŋ o nuzaa mi pa Manaasa ŋun daa nyɛ bituuli maa zuɣu ni.
en: But before Jacob gave them his blessing, he crossed his arms, putting his right hand on the head of Ephraim and his left hand on the head of Manasseh.

dag: Niriba yi turi ya ka niŋdi ya alaka, ka ŋmari ʒi biɛri balibu kam pari ya n zuɣu, yi mal alibarika.
en: People will insult you and hurt you. They will lie and say all kinds of evil things about you because you follow me. But when they do that, know that great blessings belong to you.

dag: Ka ti zaa bɛn nyɛ chinchini ni bi pili liri shɛb ninni ŋɔ lihirila ti Duuma jilima ŋɔ, ka jilima maa mi nyɛla din kul pahiri jilima, ka nyɛ din taɣiri ti biɛhigu ni ti mal o ŋmahinli, dama dimbɔŋɔ yirila ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ Shia la sanna.
en: All of us, then, reflect the glory of the Lord with uncovered faces; and that same glory, coming from the Lord, who is the Spirit, transforms us into his likeness in an ever greater degree of glory.

dag: ka Zimiri daa kana nti ŋme o luhi ku o; ka daa di nam zan o zaani. Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaayopɔin saha ka dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋ maa.
en: when Zimri went there and killed Elah. So Zimri became king in the twenty-seventh year of Asa's rule in Judah.

dag: ka daa suhi ti Duuma n-yɛli, Nyin ti Duuma ŋun mi niriba zaa suhuri ŋɔ, wuhim ti a ni pii so niriba ayi ŋɔ ni.
en: Then they prayed, Lord, you know the thoughts of everyone, so show us which of these two you have chosen.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tarimba, ka tumd o ni zali ya shɛm ŋɔ, jɛmmiya Yawɛ. Bomiya wuntitali mini tarimtali, di pa shɛli ka yi ti nya sɔɣisili shee Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili dabisili maa dali.
en: If you humbly obey the Lord , then come and worship him. If you do right and are humble, perhaps you will be safe on that day when the Lord turns loose his anger.

dag: Ŋahili ŋɔ ka Yisa daa ŋahi ba, amaa ka bɛ bi baŋ o ni yɛli ba shɛm maa gbinni.
en: Jesus told the people this story, but they did not understand what it meant.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa niŋ sapashin kpɛm maa ni wuhi ba shɛm maa n-zaŋ Pool yuŋ m-mali ti paai Antipatiris.
en: Following their orders, the soldiers took Paul during the night and brought him to Antipatris.

dag: Anabitali yɛtɔɣa yi ka luɣ shɛli nimaani nim baɣa ka shɛl ni, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli zaligu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Without guidance from God law and order disappear, but God blesses everyone who obeys his Law.

dag: Ka Miriam daa yiini yila yɛra: Yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ, dama o di nasara din mali jilima, ka daai wɔribara min o wɔhu zaa niŋ teeku ni.
en: Then she sang to them: Sing praises to the Lord for his great victory! He has thrown the horses and their riders into the sea.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli ŋun duɣi bindirigu maa, Zaŋmi n ni di zaŋ nim shɛli ti a ka yɛl a ni a zaŋ li zali di ko la na.
en: Samuel said to the cook, Bring the meat I gave you. It is the share I told you to save.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinima n-nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn daŋ gbahi shɛb kuli tinduya ni, ka yi churi puhibu mini yi suhuyubu maa zani tariga.
en: So you will be the first to go into exile. Your feasts and banquets will come to an end.

dag: N daa ti baɣisila vinnyaɣilan puu gari, ka daa ti lan baɣisi jɛrigu wain tihi puu gari.
en: I walked through the fields and vineyards of a lazy, stupid person.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Bɛ daa tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa yɛla, ka ŋmaligi jɛmdila Baalnim mini Ashɛranima.
en: The Israelites did things that the LORD saw as evil, and they forgot the LORD their God. They served the Baals and the Asherahs.

dag: Nir ni tooi zaŋ buɣim buɣi ka di ku di o situra?.
en: Can a man scoop fire into his lap and his clothes not get burned?.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi ba, Ka yi yi gundi nira Vuhim Dabisili dali ni Anabi Musa zaligu maa di saɣim, di chaŋ wula ka yi je suli niŋ ma n ni chɛ ka ninsal niŋgbuŋ zaa nya alaafee Vuhim Dabisili dali zuɣu?.
en: in order to obey the Law of Moses. Why are you angry with me for making someone completely well on the Sabbath?.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa po pɔri di saha maa ha yɛli, Ŋunkam ti yiɣisi ni o lab me Jɛriko zali, Yawɛ ŋun yɛlim noli ti o ka di di o. Ŋunkam ti zali di tanzaa, o bidib kpɛm ni kpi; Ŋunkam mi ti mali di duno yɔriti, o bidibiga ŋun nyɛ biasani ni kpi.
en: At this time Joshua issued a solemn warning: Anyone who tries to rebuild the city of Jericho will be under the Lord 's curse. Whoever lays the foundation will lose his oldest son; Whoever builds the gates will lose his youngest.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ chɛ ka niriba duh a yuli, ka tibigi li sahakam ka yɛra, Yawɛ nyɛla Tɔbbihi Naa, ŋuna n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni. Chɛ ka mani a dabili Dauda zuliya nya zaa zani a sani.
en: Then you will be famous forever, and everyone will say, The Lord All-Powerful rules Israel and is their God. My kingdom will be strong.

dag: A yi tum alahichi, Naawuni bimbɔ ka di yɛn pii? Ka a yi birigi bushɛm, bɔ ka di yɛn niŋ o?.
en: If youve sinned, how have you affected God? Your offenses have multiplied; what have you done to him?.

dag: Hal putɔɣulaannim yi kul zoori kaman mɔri la, ka tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa kul tɔŋda, bɛ ni ti bahi yoli zaa.
en: The wicked may sprout like grass, and those who do evil may blossom like flowers, but they will be destroyed, never to be seen again.

dag: O ni daa di nam yuun shɛli maa goli so ŋun daŋ tooni puuni ka o daa kparigi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la dunoya n-chɛ ka bɛ malimali di zaa.
en: In the first month of the first year of Hezekiah's rule, he unlocked the doors to the Lord 's temple and had them repaired.

dag: Ka ŋun daa daŋ deebu la daa dii zaŋ o yiŋlan maa ni ti o laɣ shɛli maa wolim nya nyɔri ka di min o laɣidaya saɣi taba.
en: After the man left, the servant who had five valuable coins took them and went to work doing business with them. He gained five more.

dag: Ka nir yi ti ku o kpee sarati kubu, o ni tooi zo n-kuli lala tinsi maa zaɣ yin ni tiligi ŋun dol o ni o ku o yo samli nuu ni.
en: Anyone who kills by striking down someone unintentionally or by mistake may flee there. These places will be a refuge for you from any member of the victims family seeking revenge.

dag: Ti Duuma Zallakudura Naa ŋun be, ka daa pun be, ka ni ti kana la yɛliya: N nyɛla Alfa mini Omega. Di gbinni nyɛla ŋun nyɛ piligu ni bahigu.
en: The Lord God says, I am the Alpha and the Omega. I am the one who is, who always was, and who is coming. I am the All-Powerful.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, saha shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti labi me tiŋ maa ti Yawɛ. Bɛ ni ti kpuɣi li la Hananɛl Du wɔɣinli la shee hal ti paai Gooŋgɔŋ Dunɔdal la shee.
en: The Lord said: Someday, Jerusalem will truly belong to me. It will be rebuilt with a boundary line running from Hananel Tower to Corner Gate.

dag: Ka di daa gari bɛ zaa, ka bɛ paɣir o yɛtɔɣ suma din yi o nol ni na maa zuɣu, ka bɔhiri taba, Pa Yisifu dapal la m-bala.
en: They were all well impressed with him and marveled at the eloquent words that he spoke. They said, Isn't he the son of Joseph.

dag: Ka Samsin yɛl o, Bɛ yi zaŋ mi pal shɛŋa bɛ ni na bi zaŋ lo binshɛli lo ma, n ni gbarigi, ka be kaman sokam ni be shɛm.
en: He told her, If they tie me with new ropes that have never been used, I'll be as weak as anybody else.

dag: Ka Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa yɛl o namɔɣilisi kpɛma Ashpɛnaz ni o lihim Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛ ni gbahina maa ni m-pii nabihi mini kpambaliba;.
en: One day the king ordered Ashpenaz, his highest palace official, to choose some young men from the royal family of Judah and from other leading Jewish families.

dag: Ka n daa wum kukol tital shɛli damli ka di yɛri nam ʒiishee maa gbini, Nyama, Naawuni biɛhigu shee bela ninsalinim sani. Ka o ni be bɛ sani, ka bɛ nyɛ o niriba, ka ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋ mi ni be bɛ sani n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni;.
en: I heard a loud voice speaking from the throne: Now God's home is with people! He will live with them, and they shall be his people. God himself will be with them, and he will be their God.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni daa kuhi boli ba ka bɛ zaɣisi wumbu shɛm, lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa kuhi boli ma ka n gba zaɣisi ba garigibu.
en: and said, You people paid no attention when I called out to you, and now I'll pay no attention when you call out to me.

dag: Bɛ daa kpɛnkpɛla sida dari din be duu maa puuni m-malimal li, ka ŋme yɔɣa mini tipuma din yirigi kɔtomsi m-pampa di zuɣu, sida dapaɣa maa noli ka bɛ daa zaŋ kpahi pa di puuni zaa hal ka kuɣ yini gba ti bi lan nyiya.
en: They covered the walls in this room with cedar boards—none of the stones in the walls could be seen. They carved pictures of flowers and gourds into the cedar.

dag: Ziɔn zuɣu, n ku shini; Jɛrusalɛm zuɣu, n ku vuhi hal ka di ti di nasara, ka ne kaman biɛŋmariga la, ka di tiliginsim ne kaman buɣim mokpalli neesim la.
en: I will speak out to encourage Jerusalem; I will not be silent until she is saved, And her victory shines like a torch in the night.

dag: Noli ŋɔ zaa ni ti doli ya n-din ya hal ti kun ya, yi ni zaɣisi ni yi ku doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la zuɣu.
en: All these curses will come on you. They will keep chasing you and catching you, until you are destroyed, because you did not listen to what the Lord your God told you. You did not obey the commands and laws that he gave you.

dag: Ŋmɛnditoya kana ti bela tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zoya zuɣu zaa, dama Yawɛ tɔbu n-lu tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam; ka so ku tiligi.
en: Across all the desert highlands people have come to plunder. I have sent war to destroy the entire land; no one can live in peace.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ m binnamda zaa kpɛma, ŋun nam o kɔŋko n-ni tooi zaŋ takɔbi mir o.
en: He is the first of Gods acts; only his maker can come near him with a sword.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Jɛrimia daa yɛli anabi Hanania maligumaaniba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa ʒe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni ninni.
en: Then the prophet Jeremiah responded to Hananiah in the presence of the priests and all the people who were standing in the LORDs temple.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe siliga maa ni nti nya ka nachimbil so ye binyɛr piɛlli ʒi bɛ nudirigu polo, ka di gari ba pam.
en: The women walked into the tomb and saw a young man there wearing a white robe. He was sitting on the right side of the tomb. The women were afraid.

dag: ti daag o yihi bɛ tiŋ maa tariga nti labir o kuɣa. Ka bɛn daa di o kubu maa shɛhira ka lan nyɛ bɛn yɛn ku o maa fuɣi bɛ binyɛra ti sɔŋ nachimbil so ŋun yuli daa booni Sool la tooni.
en: They took him out of the city and began throwing stones at him. The men who told lies against Stephen gave their coats to a young man named Saul.

dag: Dabiɛm ni ti kpe ba pam nimaani, dama Naawuni be wuntizɔriba sani.
en: Count on it: they will be in utter panic because God is with the righteous generation.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wum ka bɛ yɛli ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ fɔntiŋ shɛŋa tin ya ni yi be di ni la tin yin ni.
en: Or if you hear about one of your towns the LORD your God is giving you to inhabit, that.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n daa lan po pɔri tiŋgban nɛli maa ni ni n ni wurim ba kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni mini tiŋgbɔŋ shɛŋa ni.
en: So I solemnly swore that I would scatter the people of Israel across the nations.

dag: ka daa jɛm buɣ shɛŋa Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi jɛm li la.
en: They served idols, and the Lord had said to them, You must not do this.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yi Bɛrishiiba n-zaŋ kpa Haran polo.
en: Jacob left Beer-sheba and set out for Haran.

dag: Ka Balak daa yɛli Balaam, Kamina pumpɔŋɔ, ka n zaŋ a chaŋ luɣ shɛli polo, di pa shɛli ka Naawuni ti chɛ ka a yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu nimaani ti ma.
en: Balak said, Come with me, and I will take you to another place. Perhaps God will be willing to let you curse them for me from there.

dag: Bomiya Naawuni Shia Kasi pina din so maa viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka n ni lan wuhi ya so shɛli din viɛli gari shɛlikam.
en: Use your ambition to try to get the greater gifts. And Im going to show you an even better way.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa n-lihiri bɔri paɣisar viɛlli, ka daa ti nya Abishag ŋun daa nyɛ Shunɛm paɣisarili n-zaŋ o na ti ti naa.
en: A search was made all over Israel for a beautiful young woman, and in Shunem they found such a woman named Abishag, and brought her to the king.

dag: Bɛ daa kul dolila nyaaŋa n-kuhiri yɛra, Kumiy o! Kumiy o.
