en: They were all coming after him and screaming, Kill him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa niŋ naɣitɔroko palli ni n-yi Abinadab yiŋ chana, ka Yuza mini Ahio daa vɔri li chana.
en: At Abinadab's house they brought out the Covenant Box and put it on a new cart. Uzzah and Ahio guided the cart.

dag: Niriba pam kul yɛri ma mi, Naawuni ku sɔŋ a.
en: me and say, God won't rescue you.

dag: Naawuni wuhiya ni o sani n-nyɛ sɔɣibu shee din nyɛ tiŋ puuni birininim la ni.
en: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.

dag: Ka yi yi ti paai Yawɛ ni daa lo alikauli ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la ni, yin puhimiya di chuɣu maa.
en: You must remember to do this even when you go to the land the Lord is giving you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa daba ata dali ka so daa ti niŋdi amiliya Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Kɛna la. Yisa ma daa be amiliya maa ni.
en: Two days later there was a wedding in the town of Cana in Galilee. Jesus' mother was there.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim buta ka n daa suhi n Duuma di zuɣu ni o yihi li n ni.
en: Three times I prayed to the Lord about this and asked him to take it away.

dag: Daadam Bia ni ti tim o malaikanim na, ka bɛ ti yaa binshɛɣukam din chɛ ka niriba tumd alahichi mini tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa bɛn be o nam ni.
en: The Human One will send his angels, and they will gather out of his kingdom all things that cause people to fall away and all people who sin.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa tim ti laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa mini anabinim maa na Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu.
en: So Ahab summoned all the Israelites and the prophets of Baal to meet at Mount Carmel.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Then this message from the Lord came to Jeremiah:.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma labi Naawuni jɛmbu duu samban ni dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la, ka di yomi.
en: The man took me back to the outer courtyard, near the east gate of the temple area. I saw that the doors to this gate were closed.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli niriba ayi shɛba o ni daa tim ka bɛ chaŋ ti puɣisi kaai Jɛriko la, Chamiya pagɔrili la yiŋa nti yih o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o yiŋ na kaman yi ni daa pun po ni yi ni niŋ shɛm la.
en: Joshua spoke to the two men who had scouted out the land. Go to the prostitutes house. Bring out the woman from there, along with everyone related to her, exactly as you pledged to her.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni booni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ la puuni, kpaŋsimiya tab dabisili kam ka di chɛ ka yi ni so ku niŋ tipawumlilana alahichi yɔhiŋgu zuɣu;.
en: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called today. If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.

dag: N daa kuhi pam niŋ o, ka yili yila ni suhupiɛlli paɣ o.
en: My mouth cried out to him with praise on my tongue.

dag: O ni daa yɛri ma yɛla maa, ka n daa lu n-dɔni tiŋ tarigi. Amaa ka o daa gbaai ma n-yiɣisi ma zali n naba zuɣu.
en: While Gabriel was speaking, I fell to the ground and went to sleep. It was a very deep sleep. Then Gabriel touched me and lifted me to my feet.

dag: Ŋunkam di nasara ni deei pini ŋɔ n sani, ka n ni nyɛ o Naawuni, ka o mi nyɛ m bia.
en: All who win the victory will be given these blessings. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n ta yi nanim bɛn be n sara maligu shee daɣiri, ka chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu paai Yaakubu zuliya, ka chɛ ka bɛ tu Izraɛlnima.
en: and your rulers profaned my sanctuary. So I brought destruction on Israel; I let my own people be insulted.

dag: dama bɛ daa wum ka bɛ tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa paɣiri Naawuni. Di saha ka Pita bɔhi.
en: They heard them speaking in other languages and praising God. Peter asked.

dag: Naawuni pun tin ya dahima ni yi doli Masia, ka di pala ni yi niŋ o yɛda kɔŋko, amaa ni yi di wahala gba o zuɣu.
en: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.

dag: Ʒiɛman yini niriba ni paɣ a a ni tum shɛm zuɣu ʒiɛman shɛli niriba sani, ka yɛl a yiko tuma yɛla.
en: Each generation will announce to the next your wonderful and powerful deeds.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ, N Duuma, m pala zilinvaliŋgalana, hal dahin shɛli ha bee a ni tɔɣisiri mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ. M bi tooi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa yomyom, ka n zilinli bi tooi lɛbigira.
en: But Moses said, No, Lord , don't send me. I have never been a good speaker, and I haven't become one since you began to speak to me. I am a poor speaker, slow and hesitant.

dag: Ka so shɛli din kuni nyɛvili shee dolibu mi to, ka di dunoli nyɛ duno muɣiliŋga, ka niriba bɛn mi dol li bi yaɣ lala.
en: But the gate to life is narrow and the way that leads to it is hard, and there are few people who find it.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yi Bɔzira din be Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-ye binyɛr ʒee kanna ŋɔ? Ŋuni n-lee ye binyɛr viɛlli n-kanna ni yiko ni o kpiɔŋ ŋɔ? Yawɛ ŋun mali yiko ka ni tooi tiligi niriba la n-kanna ni o ti mol o nasara dibu la molo.
en: Who is this coming from the city of Bozrah in Edom? Who is this so splendidly dressed in red, marching along in power and strength? It is the Lord , powerful to save, coming to announce his victory.

dag: nyin chɛl a sara maa nimaani, ka chaŋ a kpee maa sani ka yi ti mali yi yɛlli maa pɔi ka a naanyi labi nti zaŋ a sara maa ti Naawuni.
en: leave your gift there in front of the altar. Make peace with that person, then come back and offer your gift to God.

dag: Ka sala buɣimniɛm yiri neesim shɛli din be o sani maa ni na.
en: Coals of fire blazed out of the brightness before him.

dag: Amaa hal yi yi di wahala wuntia zuɣu, yi mal alibarika. Di zɔriya ninsalinima bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: But you may suffer for doing right. If that happens, you have Gods blessing. Dont be afraid of the people who make you suffer; dont be worried.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ sol zuɣu zibisi ka sarigira, ka Yawɛ malaika kariti doli ba.
en: May their path be dark and slippery while the angel of the Lord strikes them down!.

dag: Di saha maa Jɔab daa na kul tuhirila Ammɔnnim bɛ tin zuɣu din nyɛ Raba la ni.
en: Rabbah was the capital city of the Ammonites. Joab fought against Rabbah and captured it.

dag: Yoomiya tiŋ maa dunoya, ka chɛ ka zuliya shɛli din niriba nyɛ wuntizɔriba ka ʒe yim ŋɔ gari kpe.
en: Open the gates for the good people to enter. They are the Gods faithful followers.

dag: Ka bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaata dali daa ti paai, dabisi shɛli dali naa zaligu maa ni daa yɛn tum tuma. Dindali maa ka Yɛhudianim dimnim daa tɛhi ni bɛ ni gari ba yiko ku ba. Amaa ka Yɛhudianim maa n-daa lee ti nyaŋ bɛ dimnim maa.
en: The first law that the king had made was to be followed on the thirteenth day of Adar, the twelfth month. This was the very day that the enemies of the Jews had hoped to do away with them. But the Jews turned things around.

dag: Gibiɔn maa ka Yawɛ daa ti ka Sulemaana sanna zahindi ni yuŋ nti yɛl o, Suhim a ni bɔri ni n ti a shɛli.
en: That night the Lord appeared to him in a dream and asked him, What would you like me to give you.

dag: Di zɔntua maa daa kpala dundɔntitali polo, ka bɛ ŋme abie tihi pa di pilanim zuɣu di yaɣa zaa, ka di daa mali dunɔdura anii zaŋ chaŋ dunɔdali gbini.
en: The entrance room faced the outer courtyard, and the walls in the passageway were decorated with carvings of palm trees. Eight steps also led up to this gate.

dag: m-pahi o yiko shɛli din tumdi tuma tinim bɛn niŋ yɛda ŋɔ ni ni galisi shɛm la. Yiko shɛli din be ti ni ŋɔ mini Naawuni ni daa zaŋ yiko shɛli.
en: and what is the overwhelming greatness of Gods power that is working among us believers. This power is conferred by the energy of Gods powerful strength.

dag: Di saha a yi tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa, n ni garig a, bee chɛ ka n tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa, ka a garigi ma.
en: Then call to me, and I will answer you. Or let me speak, and you answer me.

dag: Ka Anabi Aizaia daa niŋ suhukpeeni gari lala yɛli ni Naawuni yɛliya: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa bi yuuni bɔri ma la nya ma; n zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa bi bɔhi n yɛla.
en: And Isaiah even dares to say, I was found by those who didnt look for me; I revealed myself to those who didnt ask for me. .

dag: Ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba bɛn daa be bɛ ni galim Yisa nyaandoliba maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim laɣim timdi diri ka nyura.
en: But the Pharisees and those who taught the law for the Pharisees began to complain to the followers of Jesus, Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and other sinners.

dag: Yawɛ, bɛ niŋ a niriba fitiina, ka nahim a ninvuɣ gahinda.
en: They crush your people, Lord ; they oppress those who belong to you.

dag: O ni daa mali binzahi pia maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: O daa mali di zaa ŋ-ŋmahindila taba n-chɛ ka di buɣisibu nyɛ yim, ka di biɛhigu gba nyɛ yim.
en: This, then, is how the carts were made; they were all alike, having the same size and shape.

dag: A zali di tariga ni di di chaŋ yaɣi di zuɣu, ka lala chɛ ka di ku lan tooi zo n-tiɛli dunia ŋɔ yaha.
en: You set a boundary they cannot cross so theyll never again cover the earth.

dag: Yi ni deei Yisa Masia n-leei yi Duuma la zuɣu, chɛliya ka yi min o laɣim be.
en: So live in Christ Jesus the Lord in the same way as you received him.

dag: O daa dila nam maa yuun pihinahi ni yini Jɛrusalɛm. O yabipaɣa n-daa nyɛ Absalom bipuɣiŋga Maaka.
en: He ruled in Jerusalem for forty-one years. His grandmothers name was Maacah; she was Abishaloms daughter.

dag: ni teebul la mini di zuɣu lahi la zaa ni firilatamdigu la mini di zuɣu tuma nɛma zaa ni tulaale zim tuɣilibu bimbini la.
en: the table and all its equipment, the lampstand and its equipment, the incense altar.

dag: Nyin ŋun daa chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ leei tiŋgban nɛli doya, ka wurim di tin kara, ka bi bahiri a ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb ka bɛ kuni la m-bala?.
en: who made the world a wasteland and tore down its cities, and wouldnt let his prisoners go home.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa n-daa su Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni mini di nyaaŋa binshɛŋa bɛ ni mali pindi li tuma fukumsi. Bɛna n-daa lan su Pateesa shɛli din yili di dunol ni.
en: In the Meeting Tent, the Gershonites had the job of taking care of the Holy Tent, the outer tent, and the covering. They also took care of the curtain at the entrance of the Meeting Tent.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bi nya shɛli di ka di yuui zuɣu ka Pool daa ti yiɣisi zani bɛ sunsuuni yɛli, N yilikpɛrilaannima, yi yi di daa wum n yɛligu la ka chɛ ka ti kpalim Kriit, ti naan ku nya gamu shɛli mini ashaara shɛli ti ni nya ŋɔ.
en: The men did not eat for a long time. Then one day Paul stood up before them and said, Men, I told you not to leave Crete. You should have listened to me. Then you would not have all this trouble and loss.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni yɛri ya, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ni fan ya Asiria naa nuu ni bahi la, yi bi mi ni o yɔhindi ya mi ni kum ni kɔnyuri kun ya maa.
en: Hezekiah your king is telling you that the Lord your God will save you from me. But he is lying, and you'll die of hunger and thirst.

dag: Ka Dauda mini sapashin kpamba daa pii Asaf mini Hɛman ni Jɛdutun bidibisi ni shɛba ni bɛ zaŋdi mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnim ni guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa ŋ-ŋmɛri ka yiini anabitali yila. Bɛn daa tum tuma maa kalinli mini bɛ tuma n-daa bɔŋɔ.
en: David and the leaders of the army separated the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun for special service. Their special service was to prophesy Gods message with harps, lyres, and cymbals. Here is a list of the men who served this way:.

dag: Di daa nyɛla kuɣa pinaayi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ chiriga n-chirigi Izraɛl bidibisi la yinoyino yuli pa kuɣili kam zuɣu, di daa ŋmanila nintu shɛŋa bɛ ni mali dihiri binyɛra zuɣu la, ka zuliya pinaayi la zuliya yini kam yuli pa kuɣili kam zuɣu.
en: There were twelve jewels on the judgment pouch—one jewel for each of the sons of Israel. Each stone had the name of one of the sons of Israel carved onto it, like a seal.

dag: Ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri yi gbaai biŋkɔbigu maa, di simdi ka o zaŋ o chɛra na ti wuhi shɛhira, ka di bi simdi ni o yo mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni gbaai biŋkɔb so maa zuɣu.
en: If the animal was attacked and ripped apart and its torn body is brought as evidence, no payment needs to be made.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi Hɔr Zoli maa gbini n-zaŋ doli Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo ni bɛ lɔɣi Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ maa gari. Ka niriba maa suhuri daa ti yiɣisi pam soli maa ni.
en: The Israelites left Mount Hor and traveled on the road that goes to the Red Sea. They did this to go around the country of Edom. But the people became impatient.

dag: N ni ti a alizanda nam saafɛbihi, ka a yi ti lo yɛl shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni, dina n-ni zani alizanda ni; ka a yi ti lɔrigi yɛl shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni, di mi ni ti lɔrigi alizanda ni gba.
en: I will give you the keys of the Kingdom of heaven; what you prohibit on earth will be prohibited in heaven, and what you permit on earth will be permitted in heaven.

dag: Ulam bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Bɛdan. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Giliad bihi, ka Giliad nyɛ Makiri bia, ka Makiri mi nyɛ Manaasa bia.
en: Ulams family: Bedan. This was the family of Gilead, Machirs son and Manassehs grandson.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli, N ni birigi chaŋ ti nya lahizibu din chɛ ka buɣim maa bi diri tutuɣu maa.
en: Then Moses said to himself, Let me check out this amazing sight and find out why the bush isnt burning up.

dag: Teeku Ʒiɛɣu daa nyaya ka zo; ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋmaligi lab di nyaaŋa.
en: The Red Sea looked and ran away; the Jordan River stopped flowing.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛl o bapir maa, O kahigimi wuhi ti ni yi nya bunsi maa. Amaa Samuɛl ni daa yɛl o nam yɛtɔɣa la dina, o daa bi saɣi yɛl o di shɛli yɛla.
en: Saul answered, He told us the donkeys had been found. But Saul didn't mention that Samuel had chosen him to be king.

dag: Hadadɛza kpambaliba ni daa nya ka Izraɛlnim tuhi nyaŋ ba maa, ka bɛ daa kana ti tim sandaani niŋ Dauda, ka leeg o ni su shɛba. Dinzuɣu ka Sirianim maa daa bi lan bɔri ni bɛ sɔŋ Ammɔnnim maa yaha.
en: When Hadadezers officers saw that Israel had defeated them, they made peace with David. They became his servants. So the Arameans refused to help the Ammonites again.

dag: Mbaye n niriba, pumpɔŋɔ teemiya Mɔab Naa Balak ni daa lo shɛm la yɛla, ka teei Bɛɔr bia Balaam ni daa garigi yɛl o shɛm la yɛla. Lan teemiya yi ni daa yi Shitim chani Giligal ka binshɛŋa niŋ ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ Yawɛ tiliginsim tuma yɛla la.
en: Don't forget the evil plans of King Balak of Moab or what Balaam son of Beor said to him. Remember how I, the Lord , saved you many times on your way from Acacia to Gilgal.

dag: Maligumaaniba zuɣulan kam nyɛla Naawuni ni zali so ni o zaŋdi pina mini sara maani maligu ŋun Naawuni sani; lala zuɣu di simdi ni ti maligumaana ŋɔ gba mali shɛli din ni zaŋ mali maligu.
en: Every high priest is appointed to present offerings and animal sacrifices to God, and so our High Priest must also have something to offer.

dag: Bɛ ni so nini ku nya li, naɣila Jɛfune ŋun nyɛ Kɛnizi nir la bia Kalɛb mini Nan bia Jɔshua, dama bɛn doli man Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: except Caleb and Joshua. They remained faithful to the Lord .

dag: A ni ti du n-tam gbuɣima mini tinvura zuɣu; a ni du n-tam gbuɣim polli mini wɔɣimaha zuɣu n-no ba.
en: You will have power to trample on lions and poisonous snakes.

dag: Di saha ka tinim bɛn nyɛ a niriba ni a ni gul shɛb kaman piɛgul ŋɔ kul ni puhir a sahakam ka paɣir a ʒiɛmani kam puuni.
en: We are your people, the sheep of your flock. We will praise you forever. We will praise you forever and ever!.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa kari Filistianim maa ti bahi, ka lab bɛ suɣa ni ti di nɛma.
en: When the Israelites came back from pursuing the Philistines, they looted their camp.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla a yi dol ti chaŋ, Yawɛ yi ti niŋ ti zaɣ viɛl shɛlikam, lala ka ti gba ni niŋ a.
en: If you come with us, we will share with you all the blessings that the Lord gives us.

dag: Yisifu dan maa ni daa wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa o paɣ ni zaŋ yɛl o ka lan yɛli, Lala ka a dabili maa niŋ ma, ka o suhu daa yiɣisi pam.
en: Josephs master listened to what his wife said, and he became very angry.

dag: Ka Aduna daa lan kɔri naɣilaa mini piɛlaa bɛn daa nyɛ niriba maa suhudoo sara maligu biŋkɔbiri la, ka o bidibisi maa daa taɣi binʒim zaŋ ti o, ka o kpaai li vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.
en: He killed the bull and the ram as a fellowship offering for the people. His sons brought him the blood, and he threw it on all four sides of the altar.

dag: Yi nini ni lan nya na so ŋun diri mali jilima su tiŋgbɔn shɛli din galisi pam.
en: Your eyes will see the King in his beauty. You will see the great land.

dag: Di saha ka bɛnkam zaa daa wum Izraɛl Naawuni yɛtɔɣa ka bɛ ni sɔhiri la daa laɣim gili ma zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa lab kulina maa yɛda kalinsi maa zuɣu. N daa kul ʒimi ka kɔŋ suhukpeeni hal ti paai zaawuni sara maligu saha.
en: Then everyone who respected Gods Law shook with fear. They were afraid because the Israelites who came back from captivity were not faithful to God. I was shocked and upset. I sat there until the evening sacrifice, and the people gathered around me.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, N dana, a daa po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ man ŋun nyɛ a dab paɣ ŋɔ sani yɛli, A bia Sulemaana ni ti di nam n kalinsi nyaaŋa n-ʒini n nam ʒiishee.
en: She answered, Your Majesty, you made me a solemn promise in the name of the Lord your God that my son Solomon would be king after you.

dag: Ijiptinim yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Nyama, Yawɛ ni ʒini sagbani din zɔri yomyom zuɣu n-ka Ijipti na; ka Ijipti wuna nya o ka bɛ ni sɔhira, ka Ijiptinim yɛma ŋma.
en: An oracle about Egypt. Look! The LORD is riding upon a swift cloud, and is coming to Egypt. Egypts idols will tremble before God; the Egyptians hearts will melt within them.

dag: Doo yi tum zina ni o kpee paɣa, bɛn kum o mini paɣ maa zaa.
en: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.

dag: yin zaŋmiya takɔbi ku tiŋ maa nima ka saɣim tiŋ maa zaa mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni hal ka zaŋ takɔb ku bɛ biŋkɔbiri.
en: you must take your swords and kill every one of them, and their livestock too.

dag: Lala ka a daa yu pagɔrisigu tuma a bilim ni, ka Ijiptinim daa tabisi a paɣisari biha ka zaŋ a saɣim la.
en: She relived the wicked days of her youth, when the Egyptians touched and fondled her young and nubile breasts.

dag: Di pɔ dunia ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla Naawuni napɔntamdigu; ka di pɔ Jɛrusalɛm gba, dama di nyɛla Natitamlan tiŋa;.
en: Dont make a vow using the name of the earth, because the earth belongs to him. Dont make a vow using the name of Jerusalem, because it also belongs to him, the great King.

dag: Dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn kpɛhi Naawuni nini, ka lo kpara ni bɛ tuhi Kpiɔŋlan Naa;.
en: for they raise a fist against God and try to overpower the Almighty.

dag: Faralan bi tuuli ni di, ka nandan dɔni ni alaafee, amaa n ni chɛ ka kum ku yi bihi, ka ku yi puuni bɛn kpalim.
en: The Lord will be a shepherd to the poor of his people and will let them live in safety. But he will send a terrible famine on you Philistines, and it will not leave any of you alive.

dag: N ni tum alahichi Yawɛ sani zuɣu, n ni deeg o suhuyiɣisili hal ka o ti lan zani n nyaaŋa n-kari ma saria, ka ti ma yɛlimaŋli. O ni zaŋ ma yihi neesim ni ka n ti nya o wuntitali ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: I have sinned against the Lord . And so I must endure his anger, until he comes to my defense. But I know that I will see him making things right for me and leading me to the light.

dag: Alɔbo ni lu yi pirigibu buta puuni yim zuɣu bee ka kum ku ba yi sani. Ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi n-ku yi pirigibu buta puuni yim zuɣu yi sani. Ka n wurim yi pirigibu buta puuni yim zuɣu mi dolisi pɔhim; ka ŋooi takɔbi kari doli ba.
en: A third of you will die here in Jerusalem from disease or starvation. Another third will be killed in war. And I will scatter the last third of you in every direction, then track you down and kill you.

dag: So yi bi yuri ka tum alahichi, ŋun bom yuun yini bunyaŋ mali alahichi tumbu sara.
en: But if one of you does wrong without knowing it, you must sacrifice a year-old female goat as a sacrifice for sin.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ wurim kpe yɔɣu maa, bɛ leela mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa bindirigu.
en: Because the sheep had no shepherd, they were scattered, and wild animals killed and ate them.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi yɛli ba, Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, di kuhiriya n zuɣu, amaa kuhimiyala yi mini yi bihi zuɣu.
en: Jesus turned to the women and said: Women of Jerusalem, don't cry for me! Cry for yourselves and for your children.

dag: O daa yihi tinzun buɣa mini binnana zaa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka lan wurim o ni daa me bimbin shɛŋa zaa zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zoli zuɣu mini Jɛrusalɛm la n-zaŋ li ti bahi tiŋ maa tariga.
en: He removed from the Temple the foreign gods and the image that he had placed there, and the pagan altars that were on the hill where the Temple stood and in other places in Jerusalem; he took all these things outside the city and threw them away.

dag: kaman chuɣu dal la. N ni vuui barina ka chɛn ya, ka yi ku lan di vi yaha.
en: The Lord has promised: Your sorrow has ended, and you can celebrate.

dag: Bɛ ni ti puh a ka ti a bɔrɔbɔro kpil ayi, ka a deei li bɛ nuu ni.
en: They will ask how youre doing and will offer you sacrificial bread, which you should accept.

dag: Hal nanim ni laɣindi ʒiini lɔri nia biɛri zaŋ chaŋ m polo la zaa yoli, mani a dabili ŋɔ kul ni bɔhind a zaligunima.
en: Even if rulers gather and scheme against me, your servant will contemplate your statutes!.

dag: Yawɛ ni yiɣisi tuhi kaman o ni daa niŋ shɛm Pɛrazim Zoli zuɣu mini Gibiɔn vinvamli ni la din ni chɛ ka o tum o ni lo ni o tum shɛm. O ni yɛn tum shɛli maa yi kul nyɛ yɛl saani kabo, o ni bahi tum o tuma din nyɛ alahiziba tuma maa naai.
en: The Lord will fight as he did at Mount Perazim and in the valley of Gibeon, in order to do what he intends to do—strange as his actions may seem. He will complete his work, his mysterious work.

dag: Bɛ ninani biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛba anahi maa daa malila ninsal ninni bɛ tooni polo, ka gbuɣinli ninni be bɛ nudiriti polo, ka naɣilaa ninni be bɛ nuzaa polo, ka lan mali tɔrili ninni bɛ nyaaŋa polo.
en: Each creature had the face of a human in front, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of a bull on the left, and the face of an eagle in back.

dag: Yawɛ, bɛ ni yili yila yɛl a tuma yɛla, dama nyin Yawɛ jilima galisiya pam.
en: They will sing about what you have done and about your great glory.

dag: Yi ni daa bi jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni suhupiɛlli yi ni mali binshɛɣukam pam la zuɣu.
en: If the Lord makes you wealthy, but you don't joyfully worship and honor him.

dag: Ka a yi ti wum niriba napɔna vubu balisam tihi maa zuɣu, di saha nyin lirim ba, dama man Naawuni n-daŋ a tooni ni n ti nyaŋ Filistia tɔbbihi maa.
en: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the trees, then attack, for God has attacked in front of you to defeat the Philistine army.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni zaɣisi ba zuɣu yi chɛ ka simdi kpe o mini dunianim sunsuuni, o yi lan deei ba, wula ka di lee ni be? Di ni ŋmanila kpiimba n-neei kum ni.
en: When Israel rejected God, the rest of the people in the world were able to turn to him. So when God makes friends with Israel, it will be like bringing the dead back to life.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi ti yɛli, Ti mali yɛm, Naawuni n-ni nyaŋ o, pa daadam.
en: Be careful you dont say, Weve found wisdom; God, not a person, will defeat him.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla biŋkɔb so bɛ ni zaŋdi maani sara tiri Yawɛ, ninsal yi zaŋ biŋkɔbigu ti Yawɛ, o nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.

dag: Amaa dimdi yi be so min o kpee sunsuuni, ka o do n-gu o nti chaŋ ti lir o ku dilana ka zo n-kuli fɔntinsi ŋɔ tin yin ni.
en: But suppose you deliberately murder your enemy in cold blood and then escape to one of those cities for protection.

dag: Niŋmi Yawɛ naani ni a suhu zaa, ka miri ka a niŋ amaŋmaŋ milinsi naani.
en: Trust in the LORD with all your heart; dont rely on your own intelligence.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa wum lala maa ka yɛli, N ni daa ŋma Jɔn Baptaizira so zuɣu la n-lan neei kum ni na maa.
en: But when Herod heard these rumors, he said, John, whom I beheaded, has been raised to life.

dag: Damaskusnim lan ka yaa, ka ŋmaligi ni bɛ guui, ka dabiɛm kpe ba. Biɛrim mini suhugarigu mali ba mi kaman paɣ so ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi.
en: The city of Damascus has become weak. The people want to run away. They are ready to panic. They are overcome with fear and pain, like a woman giving birth.

dag: Di bi simdi ni di nyɛ lala yinim sani; amaa chɛliya ka ŋun nyɛ yi zaa kpɛma lee zaŋ omaŋa zalila bia zaani, ka yi zaa zuɣulana zaŋ omaŋa leei ŋun tumdi bia tuma yi zaa ha sani.
en: But you must not be like that. The one with the most authority among you should act as if he is the least important. The one who leads should be like one who serves.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir anahi daba awɛi dali ka kum daa muɣisi tiŋ maa nim pam, ka bindirigu daa lan ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka niriba maa ni di.
en: On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine in the city reached a point that no food remained for the people.

dag: Farisiinim ni daa wum ka salo maa tɔɣisiri Yisa yɛla lala maa zuɣu ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim daa tim Naawuni duu tuumba ni bɛ ti gbaag o na.
en: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa boli sapashinnima ayi na ti yɛli ba, Malimiya shili n-zaŋ tɔbbihi kɔbisiyi mini wɔribariba pisopɔin ni kpan ŋmɛriba kɔbisiyi m-pa yimaŋ zuɣu ka yiɣisi kpe kurigu awɛi saha yuŋ ŋɔ n-chaŋ Siizaria.
en: The commander called in two of his officers and told them, By nine o'clock tonight have soldiers ready to go to Caesarea. Take along men on horseback and foot soldiers with spears.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, wuntizɔriba ni paɣ a yuli; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi ni ti be a sani.
en: The righteous will praise you indeed; they will live in your presence.

dag: Ti Duuma zuɣu, doliya dunia ŋɔ fukumsinim zaa yɛligu, di yi nyɛla nazuɣu ŋun su fukumsi.
en: The Lord wants you to obey all human authorities, especially the Emperor, who rules over everyone.

dag: Dindali maa bɛ tin shɛŋa din mali kpiɔŋ ni ti bemi kaman Hivinim mini Amɔrinim ni daa zo ka chɛ tin shɛŋa bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka di zani dabari la.
en: On that day, their strong cities will be like those abandoned by the Hivites and the Amorites; abandoned because of the Israelites. They will be a wasteland.

dag: Dinzuɣu timmi Jɔpa nti boli Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la na. O kpɛrila o tɔɣima Saimɔn ŋun nyɛ gbanzaba ka o yiŋ baɣi teeku nol la yiŋa.
en: Therefore, send someone to Joppa and summon Simon, who is known as Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, located near the seacoast.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Di saha yi ti paai ni di dabisa maa, Izraɛlnim mini Judanim ni ti laɣim tab kana ti kumdi bɔri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: The Lord said: People of Israel and Judah, when these things happen you will weep, and together you will return to your land and worship me, the Lord your God.

dag: Di saha ka m ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa daa yɛl ti, Yi mi ni m paɣ daa dɔɣ ba la bidibis ayi ti ma.
en: Our father said to us, You know that my wife Rachel bore me only two sons.

dag: A yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ ni tooi chɛ ka niriba fo bɛ noya? Ka a yi maani niriba ansarisi so ŋun di dih a vi?.
en: Do you think we dont have an answer for you? Do you think no one will warn you when you laugh at God?.

dag: Biŋkɔb so ŋun daa pun be ka ti lan kani la nyɛla naa ŋun pah anii, amaa o nyɛla nanima ayopɔin la ni yino, ka o gba ni bahi yoli.
en: You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.

dag: Ka yi yi bi tum taali ka diri wahala, ka mali suɣilo di puuni Naawuni zuɣu, yi ni nya paɣibu Naawuni sani.
en: One of you might have to suffer even when you have done nothing wrong. If you think of God and bear the pain, this pleases God.

dag: Zallakudura Naa ni daa ti zuliyanim bɛ tiŋgbana saha shɛl o ni daa woligi daadamnima, o daa zali zuliya kam tintarisi kaman Izraɛlnim kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: When God Most High divided up the nations— when he divided up humankind— he decided the peoples boundaries based on the number of the gods.

dag: Yiɣisima, kuhimi pampam zaawuni, tiŋguliba ni deeri tab tuma saha shɛl la. Chɛ ka a suhu saɣim pam ti Duuma tooni. Suhim o a bihi nyɛviya zuɣu; kum ni tarigi bi shɛb sɔŋ solɔɣu kam zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: Get up and cry out at nighttime, at the start of the night shift; pour out your heart before my Lord like water. Lift your hands up to him for the life of your children— the ones who are fainting from hunger on every street corner.

dag: Izraɛl bihi min o yaansi bɛn daa dol o kuli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihiyɔbunaayɔbu. O bidibisi paɣiba daa ka bɛ kalinli maa ni.
en: All of the persons going to Egypt with Jacob—his own children, excluding Jacobs sons wives—totaled persons.

dag: Nimaani ka bɛ daa kpah o tabili dapulli maa zuɣu, ka daa kpahi niriba ayi gba tabili dapula n-zaŋ sa m-pahi Yisa zuɣu: Yino o nudirigu polo, ŋun la mi o nuzaa polo, ka Yisa daa be bɛ sunsuuni.
en: There Jesus was nailed to the cross, and on each side of him a man was also nailed to a cross.

dag: bee ŋ-ŋmahindi binneen so ŋun gbamdi tiŋgbani zuɣu bee ŋ-ŋmahindi zahim bɛn be kom ni tiŋgbani puuni ŋɔ.
en: And dont make an idol that looks like anything that crawls on the ground or like a fish in the sea.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn pun tiɣi pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ zuɣu, dama kum ni ti wum ya. Mbusim be yinim bɛn lari pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ zuɣu, dama yi ni ti kum ka fabili.
en: How bad it will be for you people who are full now, because you will be hungry. How bad it will be for you people who are laughing now, because you will be sad and cry.

dag: Ka Zua bia Nɛtanɛl nyɛ Isaka zuliya zuɣulana;.
en: Next came the tribe of Issachar. Nethanel son of Zuar was the commander of that group.

dag: A daa kari zuliya shɛba ka zaŋ ba ʒili bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni. A daa darigi lala zuliyanim maa tibili, amaa ka chɛ bɛna.
en: You, by your own hand, removed all the nations, but you planted our ancestors. You crushed all the peoples, but you set our ancestors free.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka Piɛbil maa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah ayɔbu, ka tiŋgbani damda, ka wuntaŋ sabigi kaman bɛ ni zaŋ chinchin shɛli n-tim shim ni la, ka goli mi mooi kaman ʒim la.
en: I looked on as he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as funeral clothing, and the entire moon turned red as blood.

dag: bɛn kul tumdi tuumbiɛri ka deeri birapu niriba san la.
en: or full of meanness or who bribe others.

dag: Doo bee paɣa yi mali dalima o niŋgbuŋ ni ka di nyɛ zaɣ piɛla.
en: If white spots break out on your skin.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti yɛl o, Hɛzɛkia yɛliya, Zuŋɔ nyɛla nandahima mini ti zuɣu ni kpahibu ni vi dihibo dabisili. Bihi dɔɣibu saha paaya ka yaa kani n-dɔɣiri ba.
en: They said to Isaiah, King Hezekiah has commanded that today will be a special day for sorrow and sadness. It will be a very sad day, like the time a child should be born, but is not strong enough to come from its mothers womb.

dag: Ka Mikaya daa garigi yɛl o, Nyama, a yi ti zo n-kpe duu puuni ti sɔɣi, dindali maa ka a yɛn baŋ.
en: Micaiah answered, Look, what I said will happen! And when you see it, you will go into the deepest part of your house to hide.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Sal yi lee nya dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa ka ti kɔŋ o nyɛvili, nyɔ bɔ ka o lee di bee bin bɔ ka sal lee yɛn zaŋ o nyɛvili taɣi?.
en: Why would people gain the whole world but lose their lives? What will people give in exchange for their lives?.

dag: ka yɛl o, N ni zaŋ nama ŋɔ sulinsi mini di jilima zaa ti a, dama mani n-su li ka ni tooi zaŋ li ti n ni bɔri so.
en: The devil said to him, I will make you king over all these places. You will have power over them, and you will get all the glory. It has all been given to me. I can give it to anyone I want.

dag: Ka tulaale zim maa nyɔhi mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda wunsuhigu maa yi malaika ŋun daa ʒe Naawuni tooni maa nuu ni n-kpuɣ du zuɣusaa.
en: The smoke from the incense went up from the angels hand to God. The smoke went up with the prayers of Gods people.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yiɣisi Firawuna sani yi tiŋ maa tariga nti duh o nuhi zuɣusaa suhi Yawɛ, ka satahinsi maa mini sakuɣa maa daa chɛ, ka saa maa baai.
en: Moses left Pharaoh and the city, and spread out his hands to the LORD. Then the thunder and the hail stopped, and the rain stopped pouring down on the earth.

dag: Di bi wumdi so yɛligu; di bi deeri so saɣisigu; di bi niŋdi Yawɛ naani; di mi bi vuri miriti di Naawuni.
en: Forever rebellious and rejecting correction, Jerusalem refuses to trust or obey the Lord God.

dag: Bɛ yi zaŋ paɣisaribil ti doo, ka na bi kulis o, ka do so ti chirig o tiŋ puuni n-zaŋ o dɔni.
en: Suppose a man is caught in a town having intercourse with a young woman who is engaged to someone else.

dag: Di bi tuhi ni nir ŋubi nimdi bee n-nyu dam bee n-niŋ binshɛli din ni chɛ ka o kpee tuui lu.
en: It is better not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that hurts the faith of your brother or sister.

dag: M mabihi, pumpɔŋɔ m bɔri ni n teei ya n ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa yihi lahibal suŋ waazu tin ya la. Yi daa dee li ka ʒe di ni.
en: And now I want to remind you, my friends, of the Good News which I preached to you, which you received, and on which your faith stands firm.

dag: Nyin ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ, A tahi bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ wɔribariba mini bɛ yuri zaa lu n-kpi n-doya.
en: At your rebuke, Jacobs God, both chariot and horse were stopped dead-still.

dag: Naa Dairus nam dibu yuma anahi saha, ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti anabi Zakaria, gol so ŋun pah awɛi la daba anahi dali.
en: In the fourth year of Darius the king, the LORDs word came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, Kislev.

dag: ka yi nina ni ti yɛn nya shɛli ni ti kpɛhi ya yinyari.
en: What you see will be so horrible that you will go insane.

dag: ni oniɣisi kuɣa ni kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ pie taba binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la mini nyolɔrigu la zuɣu.
en: Also, bring onyx stones and other jewels to be put on the ephod and the judgment pouch.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi lee kul ŋahiri ŋahili ŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ polo? Bihi laamba n-di mimima, ka di zaŋ nyamdi bihi nyina ni.
en: Why do you people say this proverb: The parents ate the sour grapes, but the children got the sour taste .

dag: Yawɛ, dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, n ni paɣ a zuliya kam sani; ka yili yila paɣ a yuli.
en: Thats why I thank you, LORD, in the presence of the nations. Thats why I sing praises to your name.

dag: Yawɛ ni woligi ti m min a, Yawɛ ni bɔh a biɛri ti ma, amaa man ku zaŋ n nuu shih a.
en: Let the Lord be the judge. I hope the Lord will punish you for the wrong you did to me, but I wont fight you myself.

dag: Dinzuɣu so yi yɛn me n-tam di zuɣu, o yi zaŋla salima bee anzinfa bee kuɣ viɛla bee dari bee mɔri bee kaɣa me.
en: Some will use gold or silver or precious stones in building on the foundation; others will use wood or grass or straw.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ waɣ biɛ titali ŋun nyɛ kurimbuni ha waɣ so bɛ ni booni Fiɣisira ni Sintani ŋun yɔhim dunia zaa la min o malaikanima m-bahi dunia ni na.
en: It was thrown down out of heaven. The dragon and its angels were thrown to the earth.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yiɣisi Obɔt maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Abarim yɔɣu din daa miri Mɔabnim tintariga zaŋ lab wulimpuhili polo la ni.
en: then at Iye-Abarim in the desert east of Moab.

dag: Kpuɣim a nɛma maa buɣi a bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu bɛ ninni, ka zaŋ bini pɔb a nina n-ʒi li yi liɣa din ni chɛ ka a nini ku nya tiŋgbani. Dama n zaŋ a leela shihirili Izraɛlnim sani.
en: Let them watch you putting your pack on your shoulder and going out into the dark with your eyes covered, so that you can't see where you are going. What you do will be a warning to the Israelites.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti lan lab Galili tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Kɛna din nyɛ luɣ shɛli o ni daa zaŋ kom leei wain la. Ka gomnanti tuma zuɣulan so bidibiga ŋun daa be Kapɛrinium biɛra.
en: Jesus went to visit Cana in Galilee again. Cana is where he had changed the water into wine. One of the kings important officials lived in the city of Capernaum. This mans son was sick.

dag: M biɛhigu shee ni ti be bɛ sani ka n nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka bɛ gba nyɛ n niriba.
en: I will live there with them; I will be their God, and they will be my people.

dag: Sanbalat mini Tɔbaya ni Gɛshɛm ŋun daa nyɛ Laribu la ni ti dimnim bɛn pahi la daa wumya ni ti me gooni maa naai hal ka voya lan ka di ni, amaa di saha maa n daa na bi zaŋ pundi kpɛhi di dunoya la.
en: Now when Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arab, and the rest of our enemies heard that I had rebuilt the wall and that there were no gaps left in it.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nira n-deeri Naawuni yɛligu; amaa yinim ni pa Naawuni niriba maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi bi deeri o yɛligu maa.
en: Gods children listen to Gods words. You dont listen to me because you arent Gods children.

dag: Ka yi mini yi bidibisi ni yi bipuɣinsi ni yi daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni Lɛvinim bɛn be yi tinsi ni ti mali suhupiɛlli, dama Lɛvinim maa ka tarili bee fali yi sani.
en: Come to that place with all your people—your children, all your servants, and the Levites living in your towns. Enjoy yourselves together there with the Lord your God.

dag: Di yi ni nani, yin chɛliya ka yi mini sokam ʒini ni suhudoo.
en: Do the best you can to live in peace with everyone.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Zɛdɛkia, N yi yɛl a, a ni ku ma bee a ku ku ma? Ka n yi wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm a ku dee li.
en: Jeremiah replied, If I do, youll kill me! And if I tell you what to do, you wont listen to me.

dag: Ka a ba yi ti bɔri ma ka bi nya ma, nyin yɛlim o, Dauda suhi ma la soli ni o chaŋ o ya Bɛtilihɛm, dama o yiŋnim zaa yɛn malila yuuniyuuni sara.
en: If your father notices I am gone, tell him, David wanted to go home to Bethlehem. His family is having its own feast for this monthly sacrifice. David asked me to let him run down to Bethlehem and join his family.

dag: Ka o ti bo o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛlaa ŋun ka dalinli na ti ti maligumaana din nyɛ o taali sanyoo Yawɛ sani, ka a zahim o daa ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ taali sanyoo polo.
en: You shall bring to the priest as your repayment offering to the Lord a male sheep or goat without any defects. Its value is to be determined according to the official standard.

dag: N yi paɣi Naawuni n ni yɛn di bindir shɛli zuɣu, di chaŋ wula ka so ni galim ma n ni paɣi Naawuni bindir shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?.

dag: A ni saɣi je suli niŋ ti sahakam? A ni yiɣis a suhu bahi ti zuɣu sahakam? Yi ni yɛli shɛm m-bala, amaa yi tum tuumbiɛ shɛlikam yin ni tooi tum.
en: you beg me to stop being angry, but you won't stop sinning.

dag: Amaa ka Yɛhudianim daa nya zama maa, ka di niŋ ba nyuli ka bɛ ŋmɛri Pool ni tɔɣisiri ba yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa naŋgbankpeeni, ka tur o.
en: When the Jews saw the crowds, they were overcome with jealousy. They argued against what Paul was saying by slandering him.

dag: M bia, mali yɛm, ka chɛ ka n suhu piɛla, ka n ni tooi garigi ŋunkam galindi ma yɛtɔɣa.
en: My son, be wise. This will make me happy. Then I will be able to answer those who criticize me.

dag: Ka yuri daa balisira, ka bɛ takarifiɛma tɔri tiŋ yɔri vuri.
en: Then the horses came galloping on, stamping the ground with their hoofs.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti kpalim a yili ŋɔ ni ti chaŋ o sani ti maani bara n-suhir o liɣiri bee bɔrɔbɔro kpilli, ka ni ti yɛli, N suhir a, zaŋm ma zali maligumaana so zaani din ni chɛ ka n nyari bindirigu dira.
en: Anyone left from your household will come and beg him for a bit of silver or a loaf of bread, saying: Please appoint me to some priestly duty so I can have a scrap of bread to eat.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, N dan naa, n tumtumda n-daa yɔhim ma, man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ daa yɛl o mi, Pam m buŋ ŋɔ gali ti ma ka m ba n-doli naa chaŋ, dama a mi ni mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nyɛla wɔbiga.
en: Mephibosheth answered, My lord and king, my servant tricked me. I am crippled so I said to my servant, Ziba, Go saddle a donkey for me so that I can go with the king.

dag: Ninsalinim bi mi bɛ ni yɛn doli so shɛli paai li. Di ka ninvuɣ nɛma ni be luɣ shɛli.
en: No human knows the way.

dag: Nir yi be mɔpilli zuɣu yaɣ shɛli, di so ni o min o paɣa so ŋun bɔri zabili pam laɣim be yili ni.
en: Better to live on the roof than share the house with a nagging wife.

dag: ka ŋunkam ti shihi biŋgbamdigu din ni chɛ ka o kpe daɣiri ni bee di yi nyɛla ninsal sani ka o nya daɣiri maa, o daɣiri maa yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam;.
en: or who touches any swarming creature or another person who makes him unclean—whatever the uncleanness might be.

dag: Dama ti Duuma kul ku zaɣisiri nir sahakam.
en: My Lord definitely wont reject forever.

dag: Dama Yawɛ zali biɛri bɔhibu dabisili. O mi ni bɔhi biɛri maa ti Ziɔn.
en: The Lord has chosen the year and the day, when he will take revenge and come to Zion's defense.

dag: Dama nyin Yawɛ n-nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋun gari dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa; nyini n-gari dunia ŋɔ wuna zaa.
en: because you, LORD, are the Most High over all the earth, because you are so superior to all other gods.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi doli Masia wuhibu, amaa ka kpahi yaɣi di zuɣu chana, dilana maa ka Naawuni; ka ŋunkam mi doli Masia wuhibu nyɛla ŋun mali ti Ba Naawuni min o Bia.
en: Anyone who does not stay with the teaching of Christ, but goes beyond it, does not have God. Whoever does stay with the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

dag: Kum yi ti lu, o ni tilig a ka a ku kpi; tɔb tuhibu ni, o ni tilig a takɔbi kum ni.
en: In times of war and famine, God will keep you safe.

dag: A mi kparibuhi ni dɔɣiri saha shɛli? A na mi n-nya saŋkpaliŋ ni dɔɣiri shɛm?.
en: When do mountain goats and deer give birth? Have you been there when their young are born? *.

dag: ka yɛli, N dan naa, nyini n-daa yɛli, Adɔnija ni di nam n kalinsi nyaaŋa n-ʒini n nam ʒiishee.
en: Then he said, Your Majesty, have you announced that Adonijah would succeed you as king?.

dag: Pakoli maa ni da kpɛri ni o ti tooi kom maa na, ka o lan bol o yɛli, Piim mahili mali ma na.
en: As she left to get it, he asked, Would you also please bring me a piece of bread.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm maa zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ bi tooi gbaag o o yɛtɔɣa ni niriba maa ninni, amaa ka o ni garigi ba shɛm maa daa gari ba pam, ka bɛ fo.
en: There before the people they could not catch him in a thing, so they kept quiet, amazed at his answer.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi chɛ bɛ wuntitali tuma ka tumdi tuumbiɛri, bɛ ni kpi di zuɣu, bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa zuɣu bɛ ni kpi.
en: If good people change and become evil, they must die for the bad things they do.

dag: Dinzuɣu piimiya dɔbba pinaayi bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la ni niriba.
en: Now pick twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one per tribe.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋun bia n-lee ni suh o bindirigu ka o zaŋ kuɣili ti o.
en: Would any of you give your hungry child a stone, if the child asked for some bread?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa dii yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm! Chɛliya ka yi suhuri kpɛma. Mani m-bala.
en: At once, Jesus said to them, Don't worry! I am Jesus. Don't be afraid.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli Jɔnatan, Yɛlim ma a ni niŋ shɛli. Ka Jɔnatan yɛl o, N di zaŋla jaaŋgbee din be n nuu ni n-suɣi shiri di, dinzuɣu n-nyɛ ma, m mali shili ni n kpi.
en: Jonathan, Saul exclaimed, tell me what you did! I dipped the end of my walking stick in some honey and ate a little. Now you say I have to die.

dag: Ka ti mi ni Naawuni ŋun daa neei ti Duuma Yisa kum ni la ni ti neei ti gba kum ni pahi Yisa zuɣu, ka zaŋ ti mini ya tahi ŋun Naawuni sani.
en: We do this because we know that the one who raised the Lord Jesus will also raise us with Jesus, and he will bring us into his presence along with you.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ daa ti miri lubu ka bɛ ŋme kuŋ yɛli Izraɛl tɔbbihi, Sokam lab kul o ya o tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: At sunset all the Israelites cheered when they were told to go home. So they all went back to their hometowns.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ yɛli Samuɛl, Di lihir o niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu bee o wɔɣilim, man pun zaɣis o, dama Yawɛ ŋun bi lihiri kaman ninsal ni lihiri shɛm, ninsal ŋun lihirila niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu, amaa Yawɛ ŋun lihirila suhu ni.
en: But the Lord told him, Samuel, don't think Eliab is the one just because he's tall and handsome. He isn't the one I've chosen. People judge others by what they look like, but I judge people by what is in their hearts.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la so nyɛvili. N ni yaai n noli paɣ a.
en: Your constant love is better than life itself, and so I will praise you.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun cham ti nya, ka dɔro maa yi yɛligi yili maa ni, di nyɛla dɔr biɛɣu n-lu yili maa ni maa, yili maa nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.
en: the priest will return. If he finds that the infection has spread throughout the house, it is a case of infectious skin disease in the house; the house is unclean.

dag: di saha maa n daa bela o luɣili zuɣu kaman tumtumdiba kpɛm la. O suhu daa piɛli n zuɣu dabisili kam, ka n kul mali suhupiɛlli o sani sahakam.
en: I was beside him as a master of crafts. I was having fun, smiling before him all the time.

dag: Yi mi di lihiy o kaman o nyɛla yi dima, amaa lee saɣisimiy o mi kaman yi mabia la.
en: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm be kaman wain pipia la, ka zuliya kam bɛn gil li nyu li n-jeeni kaman danyuriba bɛn nyu m-buɣ la. Ka bɛ yi ti teei gili Jɛrusalɛm, bɛ ni teei gili Juda tinsi la gba.
en: Look, I will make Jerusalem like a cup of poison to the nations around her. The nations will come and attack that city, and all of Judah will be caught in the trap.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Dindali maa, n ni ti chɛ ka wuntaŋ lu wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka yuŋ zibi wuntaŋ maa ni.
en: The time is coming when I will make the sun go down at noon and the earth grow dark in daytime. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: M bi zaŋ mmaŋ dalimla ninsal shɛhira, amaa n yɛli ya la dimbɔŋɔ yi tiliginsim nyabu zuɣu.
en: I dont need anyone to tell people about me, but I remind you of what John said so that you can be saved.

dag: Ka Sisɛra daa dɔni gbihi di ni daa wum o pam zuɣu. Ka Jaɛl Hɛbɛr paɣ maa daa kpuɣi tanti kpaa mini zali m-puɣisi chaŋ ti zaŋ li ba Sisɛra tapaɣa n-kpahi li ti ba tiŋ ka o kpi.
en: But Jael, Hebers wife, picked up a tent stake and a hammer. While Sisera was sound asleep from exhaustion, she tiptoed to him. She drove the stake through his head and down into the ground, and he died.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Jarimiya yi kɔbiti din bi jari ŋɔ, ka miriya ka yi biriti yi bimbira niŋdi gɔhi ni.
en: This is what the Lord says to the people of Judah and to Jerusalem: Your fields have not been plowed. Plow those fields! Dont plant seeds among the thorns.

dag: di saha ka yi ti puhi dakulɔdakulo chuɣu, ka zaŋ yi suhuyubu pina kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka yi nya shɛlikam na.
en: At that point, perform the Festival of Weeks for the LORD your God. Offer a spontaneous gift in precise measure with the blessing the LORD your God gives you.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa kabi chaŋ buɣili Baal duu nti daai li luhi ka wurim di maligu bimbina la mini di binnana la n-chɛrisichɛrisi di zaa, ka ku Matan ŋun daa nyɛ Baal tindan la maligu bimbini maa tooni.
en: Then they all went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols there and killed Mattan, the priest of Baal, in front of the altars.

dag: Ka ŋun daa pa o zuɣu wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa ni n-daa nyɛ Ɛliɛza, o daa nyɛla Dɔdo bia, ka Dɔdo mi nyɛ Aho bia. Ŋuna n-daa be Dauda sani saha shɛli bɛ ni daa filim Filistianim bɛn lo tɔbu n-laɣim nimaani na, ka Izraɛlnim nya ba ka tiri gbin la.
en: Next, there was Eleazar son of Dodai who was there with David when he challenged the Philistines who had gathered for battle. The Israelites ran away.

dag: Ka Shamshɛrai mini Shɛharia ni Atalia.
en: Jeroham's descendants included Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri.

dag: Abishur paɣ yuli n-daa booni Abiheel, ŋuna n-daa dɔɣi Ahiban mini Molid.
en: Abishurs wifes name was Abihail, and she gave birth to Ahban and Molid for him.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a daai di gooni din gil li la luhi, ka di chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa gariti nimaani pɔhiri di wala?.
en: Why did you break down the fences around it? Now anyone passing by can steal its grapes;.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yɛlimi n dabili Dauda ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ tɔbbihi zaa naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Mani n-daa yih a mɔɣu ni piɛgulibo ni na ni a ti leegi n niriba Izraɛlnim toondana n-su ba.
en: You must say this to my servant David: This is what the Lord All-Powerful says: I chose you while you were out in the pasture following the sheep. I took you from that job and made you the leader of my people, the Israelites.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa zaŋ o bia Abija ŋun daa nyɛ Maaka bia la n-leei nabi kpɛma, dama o nia daa nyɛla o ti zaŋ o leei naa.
en: Rehoboam chose Abijah to be the leader among his own brothers. He did this because he planned to make Abijah king.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa yiɣisi n-damdi Hitinim bɛn daa su tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiŋa.
en: Then Abraham bowed before them.

dag: O biɛhi ŋmanila alabasita daantalisi din tam salima binzahi zuɣu. O biɛhigu ŋmanila Lɛbanɔn sida ti gahinda.
en: His legs are columns of marble on feet of gold. He stands there majestic like Mount Lebanon and its choice cedar trees.

dag: Dama saha shɛli kanna ka tiŋguliba ni ti be Ifriim zoya zuɣu ka kuhi bahina, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani Ziɔn. .
en: There will be a time when watchmen shout this message: Come, lets go up to Zion to worship the Lord our God! Even the watchmen in the hill country of Ephraim will shout that message.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa dii baŋ ni yiko shɛli yi o ni, ka ŋmaligi salo maa ni bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee shihi m binyɛrigu ŋɔ.
en: At that moment Jesus felt power go out from him. He turned to the crowd and asked, Who touched my clothes.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Izraɛlnim bɛn bɔrigi kaman piɛri la kɔŋko zuɣu ka n kana.
en: Jesus said, I was sent only to the people of Israel! They are like a flock of lost sheep.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, N ni kana nti chɛ ka o kpaŋ.
en: Jesus responded, Ill come and heal him.

dag: Dama o daa bi niŋ so nirilim, amaa ka daa naɣ lula faranim mini nandaamba ni suhugarigunim zuɣu n-ku ba.
en: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a ni n suhu zaa; n ni yɛl a daalahiziba tuma zaa yɛla.
en: I will praise you, Lord , with all my heart; I will tell of all the wonderful things you have done.

dag: Ka sokam ti nya ka di nyɛla man Yawɛ n-juui buɣim maa, ka di ku kpi. .
en: They will all see that I, the Lord , set it on fire and that no one can put it out.

dag: Ka Ilaija yɛl o, Zaŋm a bia maa ti ma. Ka o daa deei bia maa paɣ maa sani n-zaŋ o du jirambisa zuɣusaa o ni daa be du shɛl ni nti zaŋ o sɔŋ omaŋmaŋ garo zuɣu;.
en: Elijah said to her, Give me your son. He took the boy from her and carried him upstairs. He laid him on the bed in the room where he was staying.

dag: Ka sunsuuni dapua din be dapaɣa maa pirigili zuɣusaa polo la ni zaŋ yaɣ yini tariga hal ti paai yaɣ din la tariga.
en: with the center crossbar running the full length of the wall.

dag: o yi baŋ o ni tum alahichi shɛl maa, ŋun bom bunyaŋ ŋun ka dalinli m-mali sara o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: then as soon as the sin is called to your attention, you shall bring as your offering a female goat without any defects.

dag: N yi siɣisi mmaŋa n-lo noli, bɛ turi ma la n ni niŋ shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: I wept while I fasted— even for that I was insulted.

dag: Ka Dauda tuumba maa daa chaŋ Abigeel sani Kamɛl nti yɛl o, Dauda n-tim ti ni ti kana ti kpuɣ a na ti ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: When Davids servants reached Abigail at Carmel, they said to her, David has sent us to you so you can become his wife.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti yi n-chaŋ o sani tin tariga maa ha nti pah o zuɣu di vi.
en: So we should go to Jesus outside the camp and accept the same shame that he had.

dag: Yisa ni daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa ka di gar o pam, ka o yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dol o maa, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal Izraɛlnim ni n na ʒi n-nya ŋun niŋ yɛda ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: When Jesus heard this, he was surprised and said to the people following him, I tell you, I have never found anyone in Israel with faith like this.

dag: Bɛ gbila bɔɣili kpe tiŋgban ni katiŋa, ka di mini ninsalinim ni be shɛli waɣa, ka sochandiba bi mi bɛ yɛla. Bɛ yilila mihi zuɣu m-be katiŋa laana.
en: Far from where anyone lives Or human feet ever travel, They dig the shafts of mines. There they work in loneliness, Clinging to ropes in the pits.

dag: O kul tiri ma la dansi, o karitimi doli ma kaman tɔbbia la.
en: bursts me open over and over, runs against me like a strong man.

dag: Babilɔn nyɛla nam tiŋgban suŋ gari nam tiŋgbana zaa. Di nyɛla Kalidianim jilima ni bɛ ni mali shɛli nyuri bara. Man Naawuni ni wurim li kaman n ni daa wurim Sɔdom mini Gomɔra shɛm la.
en: Babylonia is the most beautiful kingdom of all; it is the pride of its people. But I, the Lord , will overthrow Babylon as I did Sodom and Gomorrah!.

dag: Ka o daa boli bia maa yuli Ikabɔd ka yɛli, Naawuni jilima yi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni! Bɛ ni daa fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la min o yidan ba ni o yidan ni daa kpi zuɣu.
en: She named the boy Ichabod, explaining, God's glory has left Israel—referring to the capture of the Covenant Box and the death of her father-in-law and her husband.

dag: Amaa di nyɛla nyini ŋun nyɛ n kpee ni m mini ŋun doli ni n zo simo.
en: But it was my closest friend, the one I trusted most.

dag: Di saha naa maa daa tɔɣisirila Gɛhaazi ŋun daa nyɛ Naawuni nir maa sɔŋda la yɛtɔɣa n-yɛr o, Yɛlim ma Ilaisha ni daa tum tuun kar shɛŋa zaa yɛla.
en: The king was talking with Gehazi, the servant of the man of God. The king said to Gehazi, Please tell me all the great things Elisha has done.

dag: Jɛhɔzadak ka bɛ daa gbaai chaŋ tinzun tiŋa saha shɛli Naawuni ni daa zaŋ Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim niŋ Nɛbukadnɛza nuu ni ka o gbahi ba chaŋ la.
en: Jehozadak was forced to leave his home when the Lord sent the people of Judah and Jerusalem away. Through Nebuchadnezzar, the Lord caused them all to be made prisoners in another country.

dag: Di mɔŋya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa mini kpibisi saria karibu din doli zaligu soli; ka di mɔŋya tarima mini nandana bɛ yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: Defend the poor and orphans. Protect the rights of the poor.

dag: ka di yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ a yaannim Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni. Ka dabiɛm daa gbaag Anabi Musa ka o ni sɔhira, ka o bi lan saɣi ni o lihi li.
en: I am the God of your ancestors, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Trembling with fear, Moses didnt dare to investigate any further.

dag: Bɛ yi wum bee bɛ yi zaɣisi li wumbu, bɛ ni baŋ ni anabi be bɛ sani. Dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: Those rebels may not even listen, but at least they will know that a prophet has come to them.

dag: Di ni naɣ simdi ni yi niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlimiya tab yɛlimaŋli, ka karimiya saria ka di doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka lan nyɛ din tiri suhudoo yi kootunim ni.
en: But you must be truthful with each other, and in court you must give fair decisions that lead to peace.

dag: Ka di daa ku ba suli pam ti yaɣi, ka bɛ piligi tɔri jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ Yisa shɛm.
en: The teachers and the Pharisees were furious and started saying to one another, What can we do about Jesus.

dag: Di piligimi kaman Anabi Aizaia ni daa sab shɛm la ni Naawuni yɛliya: N tumo m-bɔŋɔ; n ni tim o ka o daŋ a tooni nti mal a chandi maa soli ti a.
en: happened just as it was written about in the prophecy of Isaiah: Look, I am sending my messenger before you . He will prepare your way.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛli ŋ-ŋɔ maa naai ka o yiɣisi n-zaŋ kpa Jɛrusalɛm polo.
en: After Jesus said this, he continued on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bɔri ni n teeg a Naawuni ni daa ti a pin shɛli ka di be a ni n ni daa zaŋ n nuhi pa a zuɣu saha shɛl la yɛla. Tiɣisim li niŋ kaman nir ni tiɣisiri buɣim ka di taari diri shɛm la;.
en: That is why I want you to remember the gift God gave you. God gave you that gift when I laid my hands on you. Now I want you to use that gift and let it grow more and more, like a small flame grows into a fire.

dag: Di simdi ni yi tumdi din tuhi mini din viɛli Yawɛ sani, ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani, ka yi ti chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn viɛl shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ni daa po yi yaannim sani ni o ni zaŋ tin ya la ni.
en: You must do what is right and good—what pleases the Lord . Then everything will go well for you, and you can go in and take the good land that the Lord promised your ancestors.

dag: Dama tia mali tahima, bɛ yi ŋmaai li luhi, di ni lan kpiri, ka ku chɛ zoobu.
en: Indeed there is hope for a tree. If its cut down and still sprouting and its shoots dont fail.

dag: dama di saha maa Naawuni Shia Kasi ni ti wuhi ya yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: For the Holy Spirit will teach you at that time what you should say.

dag: Ka Pita daa puɣisiri doli Yisa nyaaŋa mali nti paai maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa yiŋ dundɔŋ ni n-chaŋ ti ʒi yili maa ni dunɔguliba sani ni o nya di bahigu.
en: Peter followed from a distance, as far as the courtyard of the High Priest's house. He went into the courtyard and sat down with the guards to see how it would all come out.

dag: Mɔdɛkai bapir so bipuɣiŋga daa beni ka o yuli booni Ɛsta. O Hiburu yuli mi daa nyɛla Hadasa. O daa viɛli pam. O ba min o ma zaa daa kpimi ka chɛ o, ka Mɔdɛkai zaŋ o n-wums o kaman omaŋmaŋ bipuɣiŋga la.
en: Mordecai had been a father to Hadassah , though she was really his cousin, because she had neither father nor mother. The girl had a beautiful figure and was lovely to look at. When her parents died, Mordecai had taken her to be his daughter.

dag: ka Aduna bihi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba maa mali buɣim, ka malimali dari viɛnyɛla niŋ buɣim maa ni.
en: while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing.

dag: ka zaŋ ya tahi gomnanim mini nazuɣuri tooni n zuɣu, ka yi ti niŋ n shɛhiranima bɛ mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani.
en: You will be taken to stand before governors and kings. People will do this to you because you follow me. You will tell about me to those kings and governors and to the non-Jewish people.

dag: Dum Pisiga Zoli zuɣu nti kpuɣ a zuɣu lihi bahi wulinluhili polo mini nuzaa polo ni nudirigu polo ni wulimpuhili polo, lihim li viɛnyɛliŋga, dama a ku du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ.
en: Go up to the top of Mount Pisgah. Look west, north, south, and east. Have a good look, but you will not cross the Jordan River.

dag: Yawɛ wurindi karimbaandan yili, amaa ka guli pakoli tiŋgbani tarisi.
en: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.

dag: N suh a ni n suhu zaa; zom ma nambɔɣu kaman a daalikauli ni wuhi shɛm.
en: I ask you with all my heart to have mercy on me, as you have promised!.

dag: n ni teei n ni lo yi mini binnɛma zaa alikauli shɛli maa yɛla; ka kom mi ku lan niŋ kokpɛɣu n-di binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: I will remember my promise to you and to all the animals that a flood will never again destroy all living beings.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, tiŋgban ni ti fabili, ka zuɣusaa ti zibigi. Mani n-yɛli lala, m mi pun lola di nia. N ku chɛ n ni lo ni n niŋ shɛli bee n-labi nyaaŋa.
en: The earth will mourn; the sky will grow dark. The Lord has spoken and will not change his mind. He has made his decision and will not turn back.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ nyama, biɛhiŋ kani, m mi ni a ni leei naa, ka Izraɛl nam ti nya zaashee zani a kɔbili ni.
en: I realize now that you will be the next king, and a powerful king at that.

dag: Yɛlimiya Izraɛlnima: Binshɛli yi yi doo tooni na, din yi o tooni na maa nyɛla daɣiri.
en: Say to the Israelites: Whoever has a genital discharge is unclean.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa zaŋ bɛ binyɛra teeri sɔŋdi sol ni; ka shɛb mi ŋahiri mɔɣu ni tiwula din mali vari sɔŋdi soli maa ni.
en: Many people spread clothes on the road, while others spread branches they had cut from the fields.

dag: Bɛ yi daai bɛ zuɣulaannim tampima zuɣu luhina, di saha ka bɛ ni baŋ ni n yɛrila yɛlimaŋli.
en: When their rulers are thrown down from rocky cliffs, the people will admit that my words were true.

dag: Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, Faashee ka a po. Ka Iso daa shiri po, ka zaŋ o kpamdi maa ti Yaakubu.
en: Jacob said, Give me your word today. And he did. He sold his birthright to Jacob.

dag: Yi bi mi ni ŋun mini pagɔrili laɣim min o leela niŋgbun yini? Dama di sabiya ni niriba ayi ni leei niŋgbun yini.
en: Dont you know that anyone who is joined to someone who is sleeping around is one body with that person? The scripture says, The two will become one flesh .

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ ka a ti yɛli ma, Cham ti yɛl a dan naa, Nyama, Ilaija be kpe, ka o ku ma? .
en: So how can you order me to go and tell the king that you are here? He will kill me.

dag: Pita mini Jɔn ni daa na kul wuhiri niriba maa saha shɛli maa ka maligumaaniba mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpɛma ni Sadusiinim dii vana ti zani bɛ tooni.
en: Peter and John were still speaking to the people when some priests, the officer in charge of the Temple guards, and some Sadducees arrived.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo nia ni bɛ di n nyɛvil la ni chaŋ ti be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: Those who are trying to kill me will be destroyed. They will go down to their graves.

dag: Yi ni mali binshɛŋa galisiya pam. Dina n-nyɛ: Yɛda niŋbu mini yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu ni baŋsim ni nimmoo niŋbu shɛlikam ni ni yi yurilim zaŋ chaŋ ti sani. Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka yi gba ni niŋdi shɛm galisi yurilim tuuni ŋɔ ni.
en: Be the best in this work of grace in the same way that you are the best in everything, such as faith, speech, knowledge, total commitment, and the love we inspired in you.

dag: Nyaandoliba bɛn daa yi Bɛnjamin mini Juda zuliya ni na. Bɛnjamin mini Juda zuliya niriba shɛb daa chaŋ Dauda sani birini la ni.
en: Once a group of men from the tribes of Benjamin and Judah went out to the fort where David was.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma daa niŋ yɛda ni Naawuni ni tooi neei Yisahaku kum ni; ka di bemi kaman lala n-daa shiri niŋ, dama ti yab Ibrahimma ŋun sani, Yisahaku daa bemi kaman ŋun shiri neei kum ni na.
en: He believed that God could raise people from death. And really, when God stopped Abraham from killing Isaac, it was as if he got him back from death.

dag: Dama Ɛzra daa zaŋ o suhu n-niŋla Yawɛ zaligu bɔhimbu ni, ka daa dol li, ka mali zaligu shɛŋa mini biɛhigu soya zaligunim wuhiri Izraɛlnima.
en: Ezra had spent his entire life studying and obeying the Law of the Lord and teaching it to others.

dag: Di saha ka so daa kana ti yɛli ba, Yi ni sa kpɛhi ninvuɣ shɛb duu la be Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuhiri niriba.
en: Just then someone came in and said, Now those men you put in jail are in the temple, teaching the people.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn pa lala, bɛ ŋmanila wurigu shɛli pɔhim ni ʒiɛri bahira.
en: Thats not true for the wicked! They are like dust that the wind blows away.

dag: Yi bi kpaŋsiri bɛn ka yaa la, yi bi tibiri bɛn biɛri la, yi bi niŋdi tana lɔri bɛn nya dansi la, yi bi taɣiri bɛn yirigi la na, yi mi bi bo bɛn bɔrigi la shee. Amaa yi zaŋla kiŋkansi mini ninkuunsi su ba.
en: You have not taken care of the weak ones, healed the ones that are sick, bandaged the ones that are hurt, brought back the ones that wandered off, or looked for the ones that were lost. Instead, you treated them cruelly.

dag: Ka yi biɛhigu bemi kaman ti biɛhigu zaŋ tabili ti Duuma gba biɛhigu, dama hal yi ni daa di wahala pam la zaa yoli, yi daa deei ti yɛligu maa ni suhupiɛl shɛli din yiri Naawuni Shia Kasi sanna la.
en: You imitated us and the Lord; and even though you suffered much, you received the message with the joy that comes from the Holy Spirit.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu ka kpabi yim zuɣu, ka di wɔɣilim ti nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi, ka di yɛliŋ gba nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi.
en: The judgment pouch should be folded double to make a square pocket. It should be span long and span wide.

dag: Yi bo biŋkumda, ka ŋma yila kaman Dauda ni daa ŋma yila shɛm la n-yiini li.
en: You sing foolish songs to the music of harps, and you make up new tunes, just as David used to do.

dag: A daa wuhi ba a Vuhim Dabisili din be kasi yɛla, ka daa zaŋ a zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi n-ti a dabili Musa ka o ti ba.
en: You told them about your special day of rest—the Sabbath. Through your servant Moses, you gave them commands, laws, and teachings.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bi lan ʒe Jɛrubaal malibu yim, o ni daa tum tuun sun shɛli ti Izraɛlnim la gba zuɣu.
en: They were not grateful to the family of Gideon for all the good that he had done for Israel.

dag: Yawɛ nol ni yɛligu ka o daa zaŋ nam zuɣusaa. Yawɛ nol ni yɛligu ka o daa zaŋ nam wuntaŋa mini goli ni saŋmarisi zaa.
en: The Lord spoke the command, and the world was made. The breath from his mouth created everything in the heavens.

dag: Yi ni di bindira, amaa ka ku tiɣi, ka kum na kul ni mali ya. Yi ni ti zaŋ yi binyara sɔɣi, amaa ka di ku tiligi. Ka yi yi ti zali binshɛŋa, n ni chɛ ka tɔbu di li.
en: You will eat, but still be hungry; you will store up goods, but lose everything— I, the Lord , will let it all be captured in war.

dag: Ka ti yi kahigi ti daalahichi wuhi Naawuni, o nyɛla ŋun ʒe o daalikauli nyaaŋa ka niŋdi din tuhi, ka ni chɛ ti daalahichi paŋ ti, ka kul ni kpihindi dinkam zaa bi doli wuntia soli ti biɛhigu ni bahira.
en: But if we confess our sins to God, he will keep his promise and do what is right: he will forgive us our sins and purify us from all our wrongdoing.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa yɛliya, Nyama, di ku yuui ka n kana, ka mali laara na ni n ti ti sokam kaman o tuma ni simdi shɛm!.
en: Look! Im coming soon. My reward is with me, to repay all people as their actions deserve.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ka yɛli, Yawɛ ni baŋ ni bɛ je ma zuɣu ka o ti ma bidibiga ŋɔ gba; ka daa bol o yuli Simiɔn.
en: She had a second son and named him Simeon, because she said, The Lord has heard that my husband doesn't love me.

dag: Dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ kul gbibila a nudirigu ni. Mani n-nyɛ ŋun yɛl a, Di zɔri dabiɛm; n ni sɔŋ a la.
en: I am the Lord your God. I am holding your hand, so don't be afraid. I am here to help you.

dag: Nyini n-wuhiri niriba tusatusa a yurilim din bi taɣira, amaa ka lee darigiri bihi tibili bɛ laamba taali zuɣu. Nyini Naawuni ŋun galisi, ka mali yiko, ka a yuli booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ.
en: You show kindness for a thousand generations, but you also punish people for the sins of their parents. You are the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti puhi di chuɣu, ka di pa ni ti zaŋ dabin kurili din nyɛ biɛr biɛɣu mini tuumbiɛtali puhi li, amaa di simdi ni ti zaŋla bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ka nyɛ bɔrɔbɔro din nyɛ alali mini yɛlimaŋli la puhi li.
en: so lets celebrate the feast with the unleavened bread of honesty and truth, not with old yeast or with the yeast of evil and wickedness.

dag: Ka kpamba pisinaanahi bɛn daa ʒi bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi Naawuni tooni la gbani n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: Then the twenty-four elders who sit on their thrones in front of God threw themselves face downward and worshiped God.

dag: N nuu kul ni pa o zuɣu sahakam; n nuu ni chɛ ka o mali kpiɔŋ.
en: I will support him with my right hand, and my arm will make him strong.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa yɛl o paɣa, Yiɣisima n-taɣ a biɛhigu ka so ku baŋ ni a nyɛla Jɛrɔbɔam paɣa n-chaŋ Shilo Anabi Ahija ni be luɣ shɛl la. Nyama, Anabi Ahija ŋun daa yɛli ma ni n ni leei Izraɛlnim naa la be nimaani.
en: Jeroboam said to his wife, Disguise yourself so that no one will recognize you, and go to Shiloh, where the prophet Ahijah lives, the one who said I would be king of Israel.

dag: Ka Musa daa chani nti paai luɣ shɛli gbe nimaani, ka Yawɛ daa kana ti bɔri ni o ku o.
en: During their journey, as they camped overnight, the LORD met Moses and tried to kill him.

dag: Baanabas mini Sool ni daa tum bɛ tuma naai, ka bɛ zaŋ Jɔn ŋun yuli daa lan booni Maak la pahi bɛmaŋ zuɣu yi Jɛrusalɛm n-lan chaŋ bɛ chandi shee.
en: Barnabas and Saul finished their mission and returned from Jerusalem, taking John Mark with them.

dag: Amaa pa sokam zaa m-mali dimbɔŋɔ baŋsim, dama yɛdaniŋdib bɛn pun mili buɣa yi di bindirigu ŋɔ tatabo, bɛ tɛhirimi ni di nyɛla bɛ ni shiri zaŋ shɛli mali buɣili, ka bɛ suhuri ni tɛha ni ka kpiɔŋ zuɣu chɛ ka di nyɛ daɣiri bɛ sani.
en: But not all people know this. Some have had the habit of worshiping idols. So now when they eat meat, they still feel as if it belongs to an idol. They are not sure that it is right to eat this meat. So when they eat it, they feel guilty.

dag: Timaŋmaŋ kom ka ti lan ŋmaligi dari nyura, ka lan ŋmaligi yɔri timaŋmaŋ dari zuɣu.
en: We drink our own water—but for a price; we gather our own wood—but pay for it.

dag: N daa lihiya n-nya ka tiŋgban shɛli din daa mali atam pam la leela tiŋgban nɛli, ka di fɔntinsi la zaa wurim do Yawɛ tooni, o suhuyiɣisili din galisi zuɣu.
en: I looked, and the good land had become a desert. All the cities in that land were destroyed by the Lord and his great anger.

dag: Di ku yuui ka n kana; gbib a ni mali shɛli kirikiri ka so ti ku fa a nam zuɣupiligu.
en: Im coming soon. Hold on to what you have so that no one takes your crown.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni mali kpiɔŋ, ka bɛ fɔntinsi nyɛ tiŋ kara, ka bɛ me goma gil li, ka din pahi nyɛla, ti nya Anaki zuliya nimaani.
en: There are, however, powerful people who live in the land. The cities have huge fortifications. And we even saw the descendants of the Anakites there.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu asiba ka Yawɛ bɔhi ma.
en: The next morning, the Lord.

dag: O yuri takarifiɛma mini o chɛchɛbunsi gbaya vuri ni ti chɛ ka bihi banim ku lan bɔhi bɛ bihi yɛla, bɛ bɔɣiri ti kul yɛn zalizalimi.
en: At the pounding of the stallions hooves, at the deafening roar of the chariots wheels, parents abandon children, so paralyzed are they with fear.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa ti yi nimaani n-chani Bɛtɛl. O ni daa yi soli n-chani ha, ka bidibbihi nya o m-maani o ansarisi yɛra, Zuɣupalo ŋɔ lana, chama! Zuɣupalo ŋɔ lana, chama.
en: Elisha left Jericho to go to Bethel, and on the way some boys came out of a town and made fun of him. Get out of here, baldy! they shouted.

dag: n teei n nuu jɛndi ya, ka zaŋ ya ti zuliya shɛba kaman bɛ ni ŋme tɔbu di ninvuɣ shɛba, ka n ti kun ya niriba maa sani n-kpihim yi birili tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. N ni ti kun ya, di saha ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: so I will punish you. You will be like the valuable things soldiers take in war. You will lose your inheritance and die in faraway lands. I will destroy your country! Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ŋunkam doli yɛlimaŋli soli nyɛla ŋun yi barina ni. Amaa ŋun doli bilikɔnsi soli, o gbini ni vii.
en: Honest people can always feel secure, but lying cheaters will be caught.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi, ŋ-ŋɔ ka yi yɛn suhiri alibarika niŋdi Izraɛlnim ni: yɛlimiya ba.
en: Tell Aaron and his sons: You will bless the Israelites as follows. Say to them.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa lee chani Filistianim maa sani nti tɛhiri bɛ naɣikɔra kubiɛlima mini bɛ lɛbiɛlima ni kpanbiɛlima ni gɔriti zaa.
en: Only the Philistines could sharpen iron tools. So if the Israelites needed to sharpen their plows, hoes, axes, or sickles, they had to go to the Philistines.

dag: Di saha ka Barakɛl bia Ɛlihu suhu daa yiɣisi. O daa nyɛla Buz daŋ ni nira, ka yi Ram malibu ni na. O suhu daa yiɣisimi bahi Ayuba zuɣu, o ni daa wuhi ni o ka taali, amaa ni Naawuni m-mali taali la zuɣu.
en: But a bystander named Elihu could not control his anger any longer, because Job was justifying himself and blaming God.

dag: Dinzuɣu suhimiya Naawuni ka o chɛ ka yɛla ŋɔ ti ku niŋ tu kikaa saha bee Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Pray to God that you will not have to run away during the winter or on a Sabbath!.

dag: Piim Lɛvinim Izraɛlnim puuni m-mali ba kasi.
en: Separate the Levites from the rest of the people of Israel and purify them.

dag: Bɛ yi ti kuhi boli ma, n ni garigi ba; n ni be bɛ sani bɛ muɣisigu nyabu saha, n ni tiligi ba ka ti ba jilima.
en: Whenever you cry out to me, Ill answer. Ill be with you in troubling times. Ill save you and glorify you.

dag: Yi ni yɛn ŋub li shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Somiya yi kpalansi, ka piri yi namda, ka kpuɣiya yi jaaŋgbɛhi gbibi, ka ŋub li yomyom, dama di nyɛla Yawɛ yaɣigari.
en: You are to eat it quickly, for you are to be dressed for travel, with your sandals on your feet and your walking stick in your hand. It is the Passover Festival to honor me, the Lord .

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o, Pumpɔŋɔ, cham ti nya a biɛyanim maa mini biŋkɔbiri maa mal alaafee, ka labina ti yɛli ma. Di saha ka o daa tim o ka o yi Hiburɔn vinvamli ni chaŋ Shɛkɛm.
en: His father told him, Go and see if your brothers are safe and if the flock is all right; then come back and tell me. So his father sent him on his way from Hebron Valley. Joseph arrived at Shechem.

dag: Ti kpamba mini ti tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa daa yɛlimi, Bomiya bindira niŋ yi nuu ni n-gbaai soli chaŋ ti nya ba yɛli ba, Ti nyɛla yi daba, ka chɛ m-bɔri ni ti mini ya lo tab alikauli.
en: Our elders and all the population of our land said to us, Take along supplies for the journey. Go meet them and say to them, We are your servants. So now make a treaty with us.

dag: Bɛn pa wuntizɔriba bɛn kul malila suhuyiɣisili; hal o yi lo ba mihi gba, bɛ bi suhir o bɔri sɔŋsim.
en: Those with impious hearts become furious; they dont cry out even though he binds them.

dag: N niriba bɛn suhiri ma, ka wurim be Itiɔpia mɔɣa duya la ni ti zaŋ pina na ti ti ma.
en: Even from distant Ethiopia my scattered people will bring offerings to me.

dag: Ka ti yi yihi yɛli ni ti min o mali dolintabitali ka be zibisim ni, dindina ti ŋmarila ʒiri ti yɛtɔɣa ni mini ti tuma puuni.
en: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.

dag: Ka suhimiya Naawuni tiri nazuɣuri mini bɛn su fukumsi din ni chɛ ka ti be ni alaafee, ka mali suhudoo n-niŋdi din luri Naawuni sizuura ka tumdi din tuhi daadamnim ninni;.
en: for kings and all others who are in authority, that we may live a quiet and peaceful life with all reverence toward God and with proper conduct.

dag: M mabihi, chɛliya ka yi biɛhigu kul be kaman m biɛhigu. Ti pun wuhi ya biɛrisuŋ soli, dinzuɣu kpahimmiya nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dol li.
en: Brothers and sisters, join together in following my example. Also, learn by watching those who are living the way we showed you.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N ni labisi Yaakubu zuliya azichi ti ba, ka zo bɛ ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa nambɔɣu. Tiŋ maa ni lan me n-tam di daboli zuɣu, ka nayil la ti lan be di ni daa pun be luɣ shɛl la.
en: The LORD proclaims: I will restore Jacobs tents and have pity on their birthplace. Their city will be rebuilt on its ruins and the palace in its rightful place.

dag: Ka Samuɛl nini daa bi lan nya Sool hal ti kpi. Amaa ka o suhu daa lee saɣim pam Sool zuɣu. Ka di daa niŋ Yawɛ yoli o ni daa pii Sool n-leei Izraɛlnim naa maa zuɣu.
en: After that Samuel never saw Saul again. Samuel was very sad for Saul. And the Lord was very sorry that he had made Saul king of Israel.

dag: Ka Dauda daa piripiri ba kaman Lɛvi bidibisi ni daa nyɛ shɛm: Gɛrishɔn mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: David divided the Levites into three groups, according to their clans: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ni lo nia shɛŋa nyɛla din kul ʒiɛya sahakam. Ka o suhu ni tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm kul ni be ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: But the LORDs plan stands forever; what he intends to do lasts from one generation to the next.

dag: Nuhu zuliya m-bɔŋɔ: Nuhu daa nyɛla wuntizɔra ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni, ka ka galimi o ʒiɛman ni.
en: This is the story of Noah. He had three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Noah had no faults and was the only good man of his time. He lived in fellowship with God.

dag: Ka Naawuni nir maa daa garigi yɛli naa, Hal a yi zaŋ a yiŋ pirigili ti ma, n ku dol a kuli. Ka m mi ku di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom kpe;.
en: No, I wouldn't go with you, even if you offered me half of your kingdom. I won't eat or drink here either.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niriba pam tooni ka n yɛn zaŋ laŋa n-labi pir a n-vo a n laŋ maa ni du na.
en: When many nations gather, I will catch you in my net and let them drag the net ashore.

dag: Bɛ daa lan chɛ ka Hashabia mini Jɛshaya bɛn daa yi Mɛrari daŋ ni na la ni bɛ dɔɣiriba ni bɛ bidibisi ninvuɣ pisi gba kana.
en: We were also sent Hashabiah and Jeshaiah from the family of Merari along with of their relatives.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, dahin shɛli kanna ka n ni ti pali n ni daa lo Izraɛlnim mini Judanim alikauli shɛl la.
en: The time is coming, declares the LORD, when I will fulfill my gracious promise with the people of Israel and Judah.

dag: Amaa nyin kul gbaam amaŋa yɛlli kam ni; mali suɣilo wahala dibu ni; tummi lahibal suŋ molo molibu tuma, ka tummi Naawuni ni piig a ni a tum tuun shɛl la.
en: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ tiŋgban ni Timnatisɛra din be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya tiŋgban ni zaŋ labi Gaash Zoli nuzaa polo la.
en: The Israelites buried Joshua on the land that he had been given. That was at Timnath Heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

dag: N naɣ ni niŋla ŋ-ŋɔ: N ni wurim n kambɔna ŋɔ, ka taɣi me zaɣ kara n-zaŋ m bindira mini m binkparisi zaa niŋ di ni;.
en: Then he thought, Heres what Ill do. Ill tear down my barns and build bigger ones. Thats where Ill store all my grain and goods.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ garigi yɛli Yisa, Ti bi mi. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Dindina n gba ku yɛli ya ŋun ti ma yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa.
en: They answered Jesus, We dont know. Jesus replied, Neither will I tell you what kind of authority I have to do these things.

dag: Bɛ ni daa diri maa ka o yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni yino ni yi n nyaaŋa.
en: During the meal Jesus said, I tell you, one of you will betray me.

dag: Ka Pool garigi yɛl o, Kpe ka di tu ni bɛ di ma saria, dama Naa Siiza ni zali sariakarita so tooni ka n zani ŋɔ. Amaŋmaŋ gba mi ni m bi tum Yɛhudianim taal shɛli.
en: Paul replied, Im standing before Caesars court. I ought to be tried here. I have done nothing wrong to the Jews, as you well know.

dag: Gibiɔn ba Jɛiɛl daa bela Gibiɔn. O paɣ yuli n-daa booni Maaka.
en: Jeiel was Gibeons father. Jeiel lived in the town of Gibeon. His wife was named Maacah.

dag: Ka Gaad daa ka Dauda sanna dindali maa ti yɛl o, Cham Aruna Jɛbusi nir la kabɔɣili la ni ti me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ nimaani.
en: That same day the prophet Gad came and told David, Go to the threshing place that belongs to Araunah and build an altar there for the Lord . So David went.

dag: Tiŋbihi mini saamba zaa zaligu yɛn nyɛla zaɣ yini; dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.

dag: n-daa mali ti paai di ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Salamis n-kpɛri nimaani Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni n-yihiri Naawuni yɛligu waazu tiri ba. Ka Jɔn Maak daa be bɛ sani sɔŋdi ba.
en: When they arrived at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues. They had John Mark with them to help in the work.

dag: Bɛ ku di vi zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu ni, ka kum yi ti lu, bɛ ni mali bindira pam.
en: They will not suffer when times are bad; they will have enough in time of famine.
