dag: O ni gul o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe o yim, amaa o ni zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛri bɛna m-bahi zibisim ni; dama ninsal ku tooi di nasara omaŋmaŋ yiko ni.
en: He protects the lives of his faithful people, but the wicked disappear in darkness; a man does not triumph by his own strength.

dag: O ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri naa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ saha shɛli maa, ka anabi Neetan mi kpɛna.
en: She was still speaking, when Nathan arrived at the palace.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nyɛla nyɛvili kɔbilinini din ni chɛ ka nir yi kum zana ni.
en: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people away from deathtraps.

dag: Bɛna ka n suhir a tira; m bi suhir a tirila dunianima. A ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ti ma maa ka n suhir a tira, dama bɛ nyɛla a niriba.
en: I am praying for them, but not for those who belong to this world. My followers belong to you, and I am praying for them.

dag: A ni di biɛla shɛli maa, a ni ti li bahi, ka a yɛtɔɣ viɛla bahi yoli.
en: You will eat scraps and vomit them out. You will waste your pleasant words.

dag: N dol a zaligunima, dama n yuri li pam.
en: I keep your laws; I love them so much!.

dag: Bɛ ku Izraɛl jilima zoya din du pam zuɣu, ka wɔɣira lu.
en: On the hills of Israel our leaders are dead! The bravest of our soldiers have fallen!.

dag: Ka Siria Naa Hazaɛl daa ti kani, ka o bia Bɛnhadad di nam zan o zaani.
en: Hazael died, and his son Benhadad then became king of Syria.

dag: Lala ka bɛ ni zaŋ n yuli suhi alibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim ni, ka n niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: They will place my name on the Israelites, and I will bless them.

dag: ka bɛ mini Ɛlam Naa Chɛdolaoma ni Goiim Naa Tidal ni Shiina Naa Amirafɛl ni Ɛlasa Naa Ariok ti gbaai tab tuhibu. Nanima anahi mini nanima anu n-daa lu tab zuɣu maa.
en: against the kings of Elam, Goiim, Babylonia, and Ellasar, five kings against four.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛtali ku tooi ba nir zali, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn nyaɣa kul ku vuɣi.
en: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka Yawɛ daa shiri niŋ lala. Ka Ijiptinim maa biŋkɔbiri zaa daa kpi, amaa ka Izraɛlnim bɛn so biŋkɔbigu daa bi kpi.
en: The next morning the Lord did what he said. All the farm animals of the Egyptians died, but none of the animals that belonged to the Israelites died.

dag: Nyama, o garitila n sani, ka m bi nyar o; o chana, amaa ka m bi mi ni o beni.
en: When he passes by, I cannot see him. He goes right past me, and I dont notice.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ piɛlahi gbana din niŋ moonsi pili suɣili maa, ka zaŋ teeku ni biŋkɔbbal shɛb gbana pili pa di zuɣu.
en: Then they made two more coverings for the Holy Tent. One covering was made from ram skins dyed red. The other covering was made from fine leather.

dag: Nyini Ijipti paɣipiɛliga, Cham Giliad ti bom tim. A ni niŋ tima pam maa zaa, yoli ka a niŋ li maa; a ku tibi kpaŋ.
en: Go up to Gilead and seek balm, virgin Daughter Egypt. You search out remedies in vain, for your disease is incurable.

dag: Ka bɛn daa doli Sool daa zaŋ o niŋ piɛɣu ni yuŋ du gooni n-zaŋ o siɣisi ti zali tiŋa.
en: But one night Saul's followers took him and let him down through an opening in the wall, lowering him in a basket.

dag: Dama bɛ niŋ zina, ka ku niriba. Bɛ niŋ zina bɛ buɣa sani, ka zaŋ bɛ ni daa dɔɣi m bi shɛb la ku n-ti ba ni bɛ ŋubi.
en: They committed adultery, so now blood is on their hands. They committed adultery with their idols, and they even took their children whom they had borne to me and offered them up to be consumed for them.

dag: ka bi nahindi saamba mini kpibisi ni pakoya bee n-kuri bɛn ka taali kpe, ka bi jɛmdi buɣa din nyɛ barina zaŋ chaŋ yi sani ŋɔ.
en: You must be fair to strangers. You must help widows and orphans. Dont kill innocent people in this place! And dont follow other gods, because they will only ruin your lives.

dag: Bɛna n-ni ti zaŋ takɔbi su Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ, ka lan zaŋ takɔbi su Nimrɔd tiŋgbɔŋ; ka Asirianim yi ti ka ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na ti be ti tintarisi bɛ ni fa ti bahi.
en: By force of arms they will conquer Assyria, the land of Nimrod, and they will save us from the Assyrians when they invade our territory.

dag: Chɛ ka anabi so ŋun zahim zahindi yɛlila zahindi maa yɛtɔɣa, amaa ŋun mi mali n yɛligu ŋun tɔɣisim n yɛligu maa yɛla ni ʒiɛyimtali. Mɔri mini alikama nyɛla yim? Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The prophet who has had a dream should say it is only a dream, but the prophet who has heard my message should proclaim that message faithfully. What good is straw compared with wheat?.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ti piɛbi zaɣ yini kɔŋko, di saha zuɣulaannim bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim dɔɣirikpamba la bɛn laɣimm a sanna.
en: When one is blown, the chiefs, the leaders of Israels divisions, will meet you.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛhab bia Ahazia daa yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, Chɛ ka n niriba pah a niriba zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ ŋarima maa chaŋ; amaa ka Jɛhɔshafat daa bi saɣi.
en: Ahaziah son of Ahab offered to let his sailors go with Jehoshaphat's sailors, but Jehoshaphat refused.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannim maa daa lan zaŋ bɛ pina ka sara maligu bimbini gbinna bɛ ni daa zaŋ sara maligu bimbini maa ti Naawuni ka booi kpam bahi di zuɣu saha shɛl la.
en: When Moses anointed the altar, the leaders brought offerings for its dedication. They gave their offerings to the Lord at the altar.

dag: yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Gɔg ŋun nyɛ Mɛshɛk mini Tubal nazuɣu ŋɔ, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa.
en: Tell him that this is what the Lord GOD says: Gog, you are the most important leader of the nations of Meshech and Tubal, but I am against you.

dag: yɛra, Bɛn yoli ka tuma ŋɔ ni na kul tumla awa yini kɔŋko, ka tinim bɛn lee di tuma ŋɔ wahala ka wuntaŋ kpe ti biɛɣu zaa pahi ŋɔ mini ba zaa yɔri ti nyɛ yim.
en: These who were hired last worked one hour, and they received the same pay as we did even though we had to work the whole day in the hot sun.

dag: Maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di nyɛla din kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka di kɔbiri paligi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu n-zaŋ kpe bintɔrili maa ni maa.
en: The priest shall examine you, and if the spot seems to be deeper than the surrounding skin and the hairs in it have turned white, he shall pronounce you unclean. It is a dreaded skin disease that has started in the boil.

dag: Bɛ tintariga daa kpuɣila Hɛlɛf zaŋ hal ti paai oki tia din be Zaananim la n-gari chaŋ hal ni Adaminɛkɛb mini Jabiniil m-mali lala hal ti paai Lakkum n-zaŋ hal ti paai di tariga Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni.
en: Its border went from Heleph to the oak in Zaanannim, on to Adaminekeb and to Jamnia, as far as Lakkum, and ended at the Jordan.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla saha din ka bahigu naa. Ka zuliya shɛb bɛn kpalim ni bahi yoli o tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni.
en: Our Lord , you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.

dag: Izraɛlnima, yɛlimiya, O yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Let Israel say it: Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zuɣulaan yino kam zaŋm o pina na ti malimi sara dahin yini kam, sara maligu bimbini maa zaŋ ti Naawuni la zuɣu.
en: The LORD said to Moses: One chief per day will present their offering for the dedication of the altar.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛbisi Izraɛlnima, ka sokam daa lab kuli ni bɛ ti deei bɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛŋa ti ba maa.
en: Joshua sent the people of Israel on their way, and each man went to take possession of his own share of the land.

dag: N yaa kuumi kaman salichee la, ka n zilinli chaŋ ti tabili n yɛno; a zaŋ ma sɔŋ la kum taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa bɛn suhuri daa yɛli ba ni bɛ zaŋmi binshɛli kana ka bɛ ti zaŋ li tum Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa ni o tum tuun shɛli maa zaa din nyɛ bɛ suhuyubu pina, bɛ daa zaŋdi li mi na ti tiri Yawɛ.
en: All the people of Israel who wanted to brought their offering to the Lord for the work which he had commanded Moses to do.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli naa, Anabi Neetan be kpe. Ka Neetan daa kpe naa sani nti damd o tooni n-zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa;.
en: Someone told David that he was there, and Nathan came in. He bowed with his face to the ground.

dag: Bɛ ni daa pii shɛb maa n-daa nyɛ: Daniɛl mini Hanania ni Mishɛl ni Azaria. Bɛ mi zaa daa yi la Juda zuliya ni na.
en: Among those chosen were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, all of whom were from the tribe of Judah.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili noli n-daa nyɛ Rubin zuliya maa tiŋgbani tariga. Fɔntiŋ kara mini tiŋkpansi ŋɔ ka Musa daa zaŋ ti Rubin zuliya maa ni bɛ su li.
en: This region with its towns and villages was the land for the Reuben tribe, and the Jordan River was its western border.

dag: Ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa bahi Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm maa noli zaŋ chaŋ Jɛrimia polo yɛli.
en: Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar gave orders concerning Jeremiah to Nebuzaradan the captain of the special guard.

dag: Yawɛ, saɣisim ma, amaa saɣisim ma kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka pa ni a suhuyiɣisili puuni, di yi pa lala n ni bahi yoli.
en: So correct us, Lord ! But please be fair. Dont punish us in anger, or you will destroy us!.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alikauli shɛli n ni ti yɛn lo ba dabisi shɛŋa din kanna puuni: N ni ti zaŋ n zaligunim niŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka sab li niŋ bɛ tɛha ni. .
en: This is the agreement I will make with my people in the future, says the Lord. I will put my laws in their hearts. I will write my laws in their minds. Jeremiah :.

dag: Paɣ yi zaɣisi ni o zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu, dindina di simdi ni o chɛ o zabiri m-bahi; amaa di yi nyɛ vi ni paɣ chɛ o zabiri bee m-pini, ŋun bom bini m-pil o zuɣu.
en: If a woman doesnt cover her head, then she should have her hair cut off. If it is disgraceful for a woman to have short hair or to be shaved, then she should keep her head covered.

dag: Ka a yi ti lan chɛ ka bɛ piɛbi kika biɛɣu pahi buyi, bɛn suɣa be nudirigu polo la bɛn yiɣisim gbaai chandi. Bɛ yi ti yɛn yiɣisi chaŋ saha shɛlikam, bɛn piɛbimi kika biɛɣu maa.
en: And when you blow a second series of short blasts, the camp on the south side will march. You will blow a series of short blasts to announce their march.

dag: Ninkura yiɣisi dunɔdali gbini, ka nachimba chɛ bɛ biŋkumda ŋmɛbu.
en: Elders have left the city gate; young people stop their music.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ be kasi bɛ Naawuni sani ka miri ka bɛ dihi bɛ Naawuni yuli vi; dama bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn zaŋdi bɛ Naawuni bindira n-nyɔri buɣim maani sara tiri Yawɛ, dinzuɣu di simdi ni bɛ be kasi.
en: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ yuun shɛli din pahiri pihinu la leei yuun kasi, ka moli yolisim nyabu molo ti bɛnkam be yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa. Di ni ti nyɛla nɛma labisi ti yuuni yi sani, ka sokam ni ti labi ti su o ni di pun su shɛlikam, ka lab o malibu sani.
en: This fiftieth year is sacred—it is a time of freedom and of celebration when everyone will receive back their original property, and slaves will return home to their families.

dag: Naawuni daa pun daŋ piig o mi pɔi ka naanyi ti nam dunia ŋɔ, amaa ka o daa lee ti yi palo la ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ puuni yi zuɣu.
en: He had been chosen by God before the creation of the world and was revealed in these last days for your sake.

dag: O ni dihi bɛn je a vi, ka ninvuɣ biɛri yiŋ ti ku lan beni.
en: but he will bring disgrace on those who hate you, and the homes of the wicked will vanish.

dag: Jɔsia bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɔhanan ŋun daa nyɛ o bikpɛma, ŋun pah ayi n-daa nyɛ Jɛhoyakim, ka ŋun pah ata nyɛ Zɛdɛkia, ka ŋun pah anahi nyɛ Shallum.
en: This is a list of Josiahs sons: The first son was Johanan. The second son was Jehoiakim. The third son was Zedekiah. The fourth son was Shallum.

dag: O daa yɛl lala ni o wuhi kum shɛli Pita ni daa ti yɛn kpi, ka di ti Naawuni jilima la. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yɛli Pita, Doli ma.
en: Jesus said this to tell how Peter would die and bring honor to God. Then he said to Peter, Follow me.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa maa daa boli kpeen so na ti yɛl o, Cham yomyom ti zaŋ Imla bia Mikaya na.
en: So King Ahab called in a court official and told him to go and get Micaiah at once.

dag: Yi daa bi zaŋ piɛri na nti mali sara nyo buɣim ti ma jilima. M bi muɣisi ya ni yi zaŋ sara maligunim na ti ti ma. M mi bi muɣisi ya ni yi zaŋ tulaale zim na ti tuɣili ti ma.
en: You have not brought your sheep as sacrifices to me. You have not honored me with your sacrifices. I did not force you to give gifts to me like slaves. I did not force you to burn incense until you became tired.

dag: N ni chɛ ka kom tɛli tiŋgbani din bɔri kom, ka chɛ ka kom zo n-tiɛli tiŋgbani din kuui. N ni zaŋ n shia niŋ a zuliya ni, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a bihi ni.
en: I will pour water for thirsty people, and streams will flow through the desert. I will pour my Spirit on your children, and I will bless your family.

dag: N ni tooi chɛ ka sagbana sabigi libilibi kaman di kumdila so kuli la.
en: I can make the skies dark. I can cover the skies in darkness as black as sackcloth.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa pii maligumaana Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas m-pahi bɛ daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpamba pia zuɣu n-tim ba Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili maa sani Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So the Israelites sent some men to talk to the people of Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh. The leader of these men was Phinehas, son of Eleazar the priest.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni ti chɛ o niriba bahi hal ka paɣ so ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi maa ti dɔɣi. Di saha Izraɛlnim bɛn na kpalim be dabitim ni la ni ti labi bɛ mabihi sanna.
en: Therefore, he will give them up until the time when she who is in labor gives birth. The rest of his kin will return to the people of Israel.

dag: Amaa ka o daa taai duŋ, ka tim tuumba Ijipti ni bɛ ti o yuri mini tɔbbihi pam na. O ni di nasara? Nira ŋun niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima ni tooi tiligi? O ni tooi saɣim alikauli ŋɔ ka tiligi? .
en: But the prince rebelled against him and sent messengers to Egypt to supply him with horses and a great army. Can such a person succeed? Can one who does these things escape? Can he overturn the agreement and escape capture?.

dag: Ka Sirianim maa daa kana ni bɛ ti liri Ilaisha, ka Ilaisha suhi Yawɛ yɛli, N suhir a, chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ zom! Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ shiri zom kaman Ilaisha ni daa suh o yɛli shɛm maa.
en: As the Syrian army came closer, Elisha prayed, Lord , make those soldiers blind! And the Lord blinded them with a bright light.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni daa laɣimna ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔhi ba, Ŋuni ka yi lee bɔri ni n yihi bahi? Barabas bee Yisa so bɛ ni booni Masia la.
en: So when the crowd gathered, Pilate asked them, Which one do you want me to set free for you? Jesus Barabbas or Jesus called the Messiah.

dag: Ka Abishai ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la daa ku Ɛdomnim ninvuɣ tusaanii Yalim Vinvamli ni.
en: Abishai, whose mother was Zeruiah, defeated the Edomites in Salt Valley and killed eighteen thousand of them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa yaai n noli, ka o zaŋ gbaŋ maa ti ma ni n ŋubi.
en: So I opened my mouth, and he gave me the scroll to eat.

dag: Bɛ niŋ buɣim nyo a jɛmbu duu maa, ka ta a ni be luɣ shɛl la daɣiri. Bɛ daai li luhi zaa.
en: They burned down your temple and badly disgraced it.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri soli ŋmanila bumbɔni. Bɛ bi mi bɛ ni tuuri binshɛŋa.
en: The road of the wicked, however, is dark as night. They fall, but cannot see what they have stumbled over.

dag: A ni daa wum shɛli n sani shɛhiranim pam ninni la, zaŋm li tom wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim ka nyɛ bɛn gba ni tooi zaŋ li wuhi bɛ tab la.
en: Take the things you heard me say in front of many other witnesses and pass them on to faithful people who are also capable of teaching others.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa zaŋ Dauda din viɛl zaa yɛla yɛl o ba Sool, ka lan yɛl o, Naa, di bi simdi ni a tum taali zaŋ chaŋ a dabili Dauda polo, dama o na ʒi n-tum a taali, ka o tuma zaa lan nyɛ din sɔŋd a.
en: So Jonathan spoke highly about David to his father Saul, telling him, The king shouldnt do anything wrong to his servant David, because he hasnt wronged you. In fact, his actions have helped you greatly.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa tɔɣisi Yaakubu yɛtɔɣa ʒii puuni yuŋ. O daa bol o mi, Yaakubu, Yaakubu. Ka o saɣi ka yɛli, N nyɛ ma.
en: God said to Israel in a vision at night, Jacob! Jacob! and he said, Im here.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee mini chiyaama buɣim kul dola palɔni Yawɛ sani, ka wula ka ninsalinim suhuri ni yɛla ku do palo ni o sani.
en: The Lord knows everything, even what happens in the place of death. So surely he knows what people are thinking.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ anzinfa kpila maa bahi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka yi n-chaŋ ti yil omaŋ mia.
en: Judas threw the money into the temple and then went out and hanged himself.

dag: Ti bi yaɣi Naawuni ni zali ti shɛm tariga ti ni daa ka yi sanna la puuni; dama tinima n-nyɛ bɛn daa tuui zaŋ Masia lahibal suŋ na ti tin ya.
en: And since you are within those limits, we were not going beyond them when we came to you, bringing the Good News about Christ.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ dansarika Yisa Masia zuɣu la mini ti mabia Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Failimɔn ŋun nyɛ ti tumtumdikpe so ti ni yuri la.
en: From Paul, a prisoner for the sake of Christ Jesus, and from our brother Timothy— To our friend and fellow worker Philemon.

dag: Di saha ka Yisahaku ni daa dii sɔhiri ka o bɔhi, Ka ŋuni n-lee pun go mɔɣu ku nimdi n-zaŋ na ti ti ma ka n ŋub di zaa, ka pun niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni pɔi ka a naanyi kana ŋɔ? O mi shiri nya alibarika.
en: Isaac started trembling and said, Then who brought me some wild meat right before you came in? I ate it and gave him a blessing that cannot be taken back.

dag: Ka naa maa daa ti daŋ yibu asibaasi ŋaraŋara saha n-niŋ yomyom chaŋ gbuɣima bɔɣili maa gbini.
en: At daybreak the king got up and ran to the pit.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, nyini ka n niŋ naani; n yɛliya, Nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni.
en: But I trust you, Lord , and I claim you as my God.

dag: ka Shɛmɛr nyɛ Mahili bia, ka Mahili nyɛ Mushi bia, ka Mushi nyɛ Mɛrari bia, ka Mɛrari mi nyɛ Lɛvi bia.
en: Shemer was Mahlis son. Mahli was Mushis son. Mushi was Meraris son. Merari was Levis son.

dag: dama Naawuni ŋun sani binshɛɣukam nanda.
en: For there is nothing that God cannot do.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ yi bi so ti ni bɛ nyo buɣim mali buɣili Molɛk ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi saɣim yi Naawuni yuli. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Do not hand over any of your children to be used in the worship of the god Molech, because that would bring disgrace on the name of God, the Lord .

dag: O chɛ ka di niŋda, di yi nyɛla tibidarigibo zuɣu bee o yurilim zuɣu.
en: to release their cargo— sometimes as punishment for sin, sometimes as kindness.

dag: O daa bi baŋ ni mani n-tir o kawana mini wain ni kpam ni anzinfa ni salin shɛli bɛ ni mali jɛmdi Baal la.
en: Israel didnt know that I, the Lord, was the one who gave her grain, wine, and oil. I kept giving her more and more silver and gold, but she used this silver and gold to make statues of Baal.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti saha shɛli, Yaakubu zuliya ni daa yi tinzun tiŋ ni saha shɛli.
en: When the people of Israel left Egypt, when Jacob's descendants left that foreign land.

dag: Ti lan yɛl a ni di bi tu ni maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim ni yiliyiiniba ni dunɔguliba ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tumtumdiba bɛn pahi yo farigu.
en: I want you men to know that it is against the law to make the priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, Temple servants, and other workers in Gods Temple pay taxes. They dont have to pay taxes, money to honor the king, or any customs fees.

dag: N suhu ni ti yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka yi dimnim ti nyaŋ ya, ka sun ya. Ka yi ti guura ka so bi kariti ya.
en: and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack.

dag: So di kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni naɣila maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim bɛn tumdi tuma la kɔŋko; bɛna n-ni tooi kpe di puuni, dama bɛna m-be kasi, amaa di simdi ka bɛnkam kpalim zaa saɣi Yawɛ ni zali ba shɛm maa.
en: No one is to enter the Temple buildings except the priests and the Levites who are on duty. They may enter, because they are consecrated, but the rest of the people must obey the Lord 's instructions and stay outside.

dag: O yuli yiko n-ti gbarigu ŋɔ alaafee maa; o yuli yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka yi nya ka wum din niŋ ŋɔ. Yɛda niŋbu zaŋ chaŋ Yisa sani zuɣu n-chɛ ka gbarigu maa nya alaafee zaa yi zaa ninni ŋɔ.
en: You see this man, and you know him. He put his faith in the name of Jesus and was made strong. Faith in Jesus made this man completely well while everyone was watching.

dag: Ka bɛ laɣim bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa sɔŋ kaman zunzuya ni laɣindi binyara shɛm la, ka yiɣiri luri di zuɣu kaman toli ni yiɣiri luri binyara zuɣu shɛm la.
en: They gathered spoil like insects; they rushed upon it like a swarm of locusts.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Sool, M mi lee nyɛ ŋuni, ka n daŋ niriba lee nyɛ banima bee m ba zuliya mi lee nyɛ banim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka n ti yɛn leei naa deemba.
en: David answered, How could I possibly marry your daughter? I'm not very important, and neither is my family.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nya Adɔnibɛzɛk Bɛzɛk maa n-chɛ ka bɛ min o zaŋ nya taba, ka bɛ daa nyaŋ Keenannim mini Pɛrizinim maa.
en: There they found Adoni-bezek at Bezek, fought against him, and defeated the Canaanites and Perizzites.

dag: Ka Musa daa taɣi ʒim maa pirigili niŋ taha ni zali, ka zaŋ di pirigili din kpalim maa kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa.
en: Moses took half of the blood of the animals and put it in bowls; and the other half he threw against the altar.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Ka bɔ ka bɛ lee nya a yili ŋɔ? Ka Hɛzɛkia garigi yɛl o, Bɛ nya binshɛɣukam zaa din be n yiŋa; ka binshɛli bi kpalim n nɛma dur la ni ka m bi zaŋ li wuhi ba.
en: What did you show them? Isaiah asked. Hezekiah answered, I showed them everything in my kingdom.

dag: di yi niŋ ka a nya paɣ viɛlli yi ni gbahi shɛb daba maa ni, ka bɔri ni a zaŋ o leeg a paɣa.
en: you may see among them a beautiful woman that you like and want to marry.

dag: N nyee nyɔni m biɛhigu; n ku beni hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Miligim ka chɛ ma, dama n dabisa kul nyɛla vuhim.
en: I hate my life—I give up. I dont want to live forever. Leave me alone! My life means nothing.

dag: Dinzuɣu n shia gbarigimi n ni, ka n yihi tahima n suhu ni.
en: I am ready to give up. I am losing my courage.

dag: nti gbaag o nuu ka yɛl o, Talita kumi! Di gbinni nyɛla, Bipuɣiŋga, n yɛr a mi, yiɣisima.
en: Then Jesus held the girls hand and said to her, Talitha, koum.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni ti ku zuliya shɛb bɛn zaa lo nia ni bɛ liri Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: The Lord says, At that time I will destroy the nations that came to fight against Jerusalem.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa ka n sanna nti zani baɣili ma ka yɛli, M mabia Sool, a nina maa neema! Ka n nina naa daa dii neei di saha maa, ka n nya o.
en: He came to me, stood by me, and said, Brother Saul, see again! At that very moment I saw again and looked at him.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣi salima mini anzinfa ni la shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili, ka gbahi bɛ ninvuɣ shɛba n-zaŋ ba kuli Samaria ti leei daba.
en: Joash took all the gold and silver, and all the objects he could find in the LORDs temple and the treasuries of the palace, along with some hostages and returned to Samaria.

dag: Ka n kurim n-teei dɔni m puli zuɣu, ka kul chani gindi n-fabindi dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: I am bent and bowed down. I am depressed all day long.

dag: Ka Lɛvi zuliya puuni niriba ti be bɛ ko fabinda, ka bɛ paɣiba be bɛ ko fabinda. Ka Shimɛi daŋ puuni niriba ti be bɛ ko fabinda, ka bɛ paɣiba be bɛ ko fabinda.
en: the clan of Levis house by themselves, and their women by themselves; and the Shimeites clan by themselves, and their women by themselves.

dag: amaa naɣ zalimiyala yi daazichi alizanda ni; nimaani ka di bi zahinda, ka lɛla ku saɣim li, ka tayiɣisi mi ku kab kpe n-zu li.
en: Instead, collect treasures for yourselves in heaven, where moth and rust dont eat them and where thieves dont break in and steal them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka bɛ sanna sagban wɔɣinli puuni. Sagban wɔɣinli maa daa zanila Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: The LORD appeared in the tent in a pillar of cloud; the cloud pillar stood at the tents entrance.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Kɔra, A min a nyaandoliba maa zaa ni Aduna sa kam Yawɛ tooni na biɛɣuni.
en: Then Moses said to Korah, You and all your followers will stand before the Lord tomorrow. Aaron will also be there with you and your followers.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba, ka yiɣisi tiŋ maa ni chaŋ Bɛtani ti gbe nimaani.
en: Then he left them and went out of the city to Bethany and spent the night there.

dag: Ka Biliha ŋun daa nyɛ Reechɛl dabipaɣ la bidibisi daa nyɛ Dan mini Naftali.
en: The sons of Bilhah, Rachels servant, were Dan and Naphtali.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, o daa shiri biɛra, hal ti yɛn kpimi gba; amaa ka Naawuni daa zo o nambɔɣu, ka di pala o kɔŋko ka o daa zo nambɔɣu maa, amaa zaŋ tabili man gba ni di chɛ ka n ku mali nandahima n-lan pahi.
en: He was sick and near death. But God helped him and me too, so that I would not have even more grief.

dag: Gbib a yɛda niŋbu min a suhu ni tɛha ka di ku mali galimi. Ninvuɣ shɛb ni bi doli suhu ni tɛha ŋɔ tatabo ni wuhi shɛm zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ yɛda niŋbu saɣim.
en: and keep your faith and a clear conscience. Some people have not listened to their conscience and have made a ruin of their faith.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa zaŋ zaligu din yi Yawɛ sanna zali Izraɛlnima. O daa yɛli ba, Yisifu zuliya niriba maa ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: So Moses gave the people of Israel the following command from the Lord . He said, What the tribe of Manasseh says is right.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul karim gbaŋ shɛli din yi Naa Atazɛrikisɛs sanna maa n-wuhi Rɛhum mini Shimshai ni bɛ tab la, bɛ daa dii zola yomyom chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm nti zaŋ kpiɔŋ muɣisi Yɛhudianim maa ka bɛ chɛ mɛbu.
en: As soon as this letter was read, Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors went to Jerusalem and forced everyone to stop rebuilding the city.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa bɔhi Naa Zɛdɛkia, Taali bɔ ka n lee tum a bee a kpambaliba bee niriba ŋɔ ka yi chɛ ka bɛ kpɛhi ma duu maa?.
en: Then I continued, Your Majesty, why have you put me in prison? Have I committed a crime against you or your officials or the nation?.

dag: Yawɛ zaŋm o nina lihi ya, ka niŋ ya nirilim.
en: May the Lord smile down on you and show you his kindness.

dag: Yi yi zaŋ binshɛli paŋ yi kpee ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl nira, yin miriya ka yi chɛ ka o niŋ ya nyɔri, di yi nyɛ liɣiri nyɔri bee bindira nyɔri bee yi ni kul zaŋ binshɛlikam paŋ o nyɔri.
en: When you lend money or food or anything else to Israelites, do not charge them interest.

dag: Amaa niɣi mini piɛri ni buhi bɛna, di deeya binshɛli zali bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛb zaashee n-tiligi ba, bɛ nyɛla bɛn be kasi. Niŋmiya bɛ ʒim mihi sara maligu bimbini, ka zaŋ bɛ kpam nyo buɣim mali sara; di ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim.
en: But you must not make a payment for the firstborn cow, sheep, or goat. These animals are holy. Sprinkle their blood on the altar and burn their fat as a sweet-smelling gift to the Lord .

dag: Amazia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitayinika. O ma yuli n-daa booni Jɛhɔadan. O ya n-daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Amaziah became king at the age of twenty-five, and he ruled in Jerusalem for twenty-nine years. His mother was Jehoaddin from Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Rabishake maa daa yɛli ba, Yɛlimiya Hɛzɛkia, Asiria na tital la ni bɔhir a shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋuni ka a lee niŋ naani?.
en: Then the field commander said to them, Say to Hezekiah: Assyrias Great King says this: Why do you feel so confident?.

dag: ka zaŋ salima alali m-mali zoligɔnim ayi n-ŋmɛl li kaman gabisi la n-zaŋ li ga kuɣa maa ni yɛn taɣili binshɛŋa ni maa.
en: Twist chains of pure gold together like a rope. Make two of these gold chains and fasten them to the gold settings.

dag: ka Mɛrayɔt nyɛ Zɛrahia bia, ka Zɛrahia nyɛ Uzi bia, ka Uzi nyɛ Buki bia.
en: son of Zerahiah, son of Uzzi, son of Bukki.

dag: Masia zuɣu ka tinim bɛn nyɛ Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim zaa ni tooi chaŋ ti Ba Naawuni sani o Shi yino la zuɣu.
en: We both have access to the Father through Christ by the one Spirit.

dag: Ka Lɛvi maa daa nyɛ Simiɔn bia, ka Simiɔn nyɛ Juda bia, ka Juda nyɛ Yisifu so bia, ka Yisifu maa nyɛ Jɔnam bia, ka Jɔnam mi nyɛ Ɛliakim bia.
en: Levi was the son of Simeon. Simeon was the son of Judah. Judah was the son of Joseph. Joseph was the son of Jonam. Jonam was the son of Eliakim.

dag: A bemi kaman tampiŋ la ka n sɔɣir a sani. Nyini n-nyɛ m birini din mali kpiɔŋ ni a tiligi ma; dama nyini n-nyɛ n tampiŋ ni m birini.
en: Be my rock of refuge where I can always escape. You commanded that my life be saved because you are my rock and my fortress.

dag: Amaa nyin kul gbaam amaŋa yɛlli kam ni; mali suɣilo wahala dibu ni; tummi lahibal suŋ molo molibu tuma, ka tummi Naawuni ni piig a ni a tum tuun shɛl la.
en: But you should control yourself at all times. When troubles come, accept them. Do the work of telling the Good News. Do all the duties of a servant of God.

dag: Naawuni yɛlimaŋtali zuɣu, o ni tiligi Ziɔn; o wuntitali zuɣu o ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni ka niŋ tuuba.
en: God is good and does what is right, so he will rescue Zion and the people who come back to him.

dag: Miriya ka yi booni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yuli yoliyoli, dama ŋunkam booni man Yawɛ yuli yoliyoli mali taali man Yawɛ sani.
en: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.

dag: Ka ti daa kuhi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, ka Yawɛ daa wum ti kuhigu maa, ka nya ti wahala mini ti tuun kpɛma tumbu ni ti muɣisigu maa.
en: We called out for help to you, the Lord God of our ancestors. You heard our cries; you knew we were in trouble and abused.

dag: Chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili din galisi la di ba.
en: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bi nya o taali din simdi ni bɛ ku o maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa yɛli Gomna Pailɛt ni o kum o.
en: They could not find any real reason why Jesus should die, but they asked Pilate to kill him.

dag: Dɔbba mini paɣiba n-daa kul pali duu maa ni, ka Filistianim nanim zaa gba be nimaani. Ka dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn kalinli daa nyɛ kaman tusaata daa be duu maa dufahirili zuɣusaa lihiri Samsin ni diɛmdi maa.
en: The building was crowded with men and women. All five Philistine kings were there, and there were about three thousand men and women on the roof, watching Samson entertain them.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahir anii dali, ŋun bom ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambih ayi n-ka Yawɛ tooni na Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni nti zaŋ ba ti maligumaana.
en: On the eighth day he shall take two doves or two pigeons to the entrance of the Tent of the Lord 's presence and give them to the priest.

dag: dama Naawuni deeri zuliya kam ni ninvuɣ so ŋun zɔr o ka tumdi din tuhi.
en: God is pleased with everyone who worships him and does right, no matter what nation they come from.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa lihir o ka tɛhiri ni o nuu maa ni mɔri bee ni o ni yiɣi lu n-kpi; amaa bɛ ni daa lih o yuui nti nya ka shɛli bi niŋ o maa, ka bɛ daa lan taɣ zilinli yɛli ni o nyɛla buɣili.
en: The people thought he would swell up or fall down dead. They waited and watched him for a long time, but nothing bad happened to him. So they changed their opinion. They said, He is a god.

dag: n-chaŋ ti ʒe Yisa sani kumda, ka o nintam tɔɣiri luri Yisa naba zuɣu, ka o mal li paɣiri Yisa naba maa, ka mal o zabiri nyɛhiri li, ka bɔbindi li ka zaŋ tulaale maa ʒiɛri li.
en: Standing behind him at his feet and crying, she began to wet his feet with her tears. She wiped them with her hair, kissed them, and poured the oil on them.

dag: Ka Atalia daa wum bɛ ni zɔri gindi ka paɣiri naa maa, ka o daa kpe Yawɛ duu maa ni niriba maa sani.
en: Athaliah heard the people cheering for the king, so she hurried to the Temple, where the crowd had gathered.

dag: Ka Yisahaku yɛl o, Nyama, n kurigiya, m mi ku tooi baŋ n kum dali.
en: Isaac said, You see that I am old and may die soon.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ ni ti garigi bɔh o, Ti Duuma, bɔ saha ka ti daa lee nya a ka kum bee kɔnyuri mal a bee ka a nyɛ sana bee n-chani gbinfini bee ka a biɛra bee m-be sarika ni, ka ti baɣa ka a ni.
en: Then those people will answer, Lord, when did we see you hungry or thirsty? When did we see you without a place to stay? Or when did we see you without clothes or sick or in prison? When did we see any of this and not help you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Yɛlim Izraɛlnima.
en: The Lord said to Moses.

dag: Ninvuɣ yino ŋun nyɛ Adam la alahichi tumbu zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka alahichi kpe dunia ŋɔ ni, ka alahichi maa tahi kum na. Dina n-chɛ ka kum paari sokam, dama sokam zaa tum alahichi.
en: Sin came into the world because of what one man did. And with sin came death. So this is why all people must die—because all people have sinned.

dag: Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu shɛli din bɔri ni a niŋ din tuhi ti ma ŋɔ. Wummi n kuhigu ŋɔ; gbilisim a tibili wum man ŋun nyɛ ʒiri ni ka so nol ni ŋɔ suhigu ŋɔ.
en: I am innocent, Lord ! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.

dag: Chɛ ka Yawɛ ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa yɛli lala, bɛna n-nyɛ o ni tiligi shɛb muɣisigu ni.
en: Repeat these words in praise to the Lord , all you whom he has saved. He has rescued you from your enemies.

dag: Zaŋmiya ʒilinsi biɛhigu bahi ka be, ka doliya tɛhi zilima soli.
en: Abandon your simplistic ways and live; walk in the way of understanding.

dag: Di simdi ka daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpɛm be yi sani.
en: Take with you one man from each tribe who is the head of his household.

dag: Dinzuɣu Iso ni daa nya ka o ba Yisahaku nini bi tiɣi Keenan paɣiba maa.
en: Esau saw from this that his father did not want his sons to marry Canaanite women.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛtali soli bo n-nya buni, di ku niŋ anfaani, amaa wuntitali tiligiri nir kum ni.
en: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.

dag: Yawɛ ni woligi ti m min a, Yawɛ ni bɔh a biɛri ti ma, amaa man ku zaŋ n nuu shih a.
en: May the LORD judge between me and you! May the LORD take vengeance on you for me, but I wont lift a hand against you.

dag: Di kari ma a sani bahi, a mi di yih a shia kasi n ni.
en: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Musa ni zali ni bɛ zaŋ binshɛŋa maa zaa na nti sɔŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni, ka niriba maa zaa daa vu m-miri ti zani Yawɛ tooni.
en: After the animals and the grain had been brought to the front of the sacred tent, and the people were standing there in the presence of the Lord .

dag: N dila suɣilo guhiri Naawuni, dama m mali tahima o sani.
en: I must calm down and turn to God; he is my only hope.

dag: nti yɛl o, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ a kurigiya, ka a bihi ŋɔ mi bi dol a naba, dinzuɣu bom naa ti ti ka o su ti kaman zuliya kam ni mali nanim shɛm ŋɔ.
en: The elders said to Samuel, Youre old, and your sons dont live right. They are not like you. Now, give us a king to rule us like all the other nations.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa bɔhi Gaad mini Rubin zuliya maa, Yi mabihi maa cham ti tuhi tɔbu ka yinim kpalim be kpe?.
en: Moses told the people from the tribes of Reuben and Gad, Will you let your brothers go and fight while you settle here?.

dag: ka chɛ ka bɛ di bɛ pin kasinim maa, ka di kpɛhi ba alahichi ni. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: by letting any unauthorized people eat them; this would bring guilt and punishment on such people. I am the Lord and I make the offerings holy.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu, ka Bɔaz yɛli Rut, Kamina ti deei bɔrɔbɔro suɣi kpam. Ka o daa kana ti ʒini kachɛriba maa sani, ka Bɔaz zaŋ chi bɔrɔbɔro ti o. Ka o daa ŋub li tiɣi ka guui shɛli.
en: At mealtime Boaz said to Ruth, Come and have a piece of bread, and dip it in the sauce. So she sat with the workers, and Boaz passed some roasted grain to her. She ate until she was satisfied, and she still had some food left over.

dag: Ka bɛ daa karim Naawuni zaligu din be litaafi maa ni, ka kahigi di ni yɛli shɛm wuhi. Bɛ daa wuhi di gbinni ka di chɛ ka niriba baŋ karimbu maa ni wuhi shɛm.
en: They read the Book of the Law of God . They made it easy to understand, and explained what it meant. They did this so that the people could understand what was being read.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, a bi niŋ tulaale niŋ n zuɣu, amaa paɣ ŋɔ ŋun zaŋ tulaale niŋ n naba.
en: You provided no olive oil for my head, but she has covered my feet with perfume.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun doli anyinsi soli biri shɛli ni ti kpuɣila mbusim, ka o suhuyiɣisili mi ku ti o nasara.
en: Troublemakers get in trouble, and their terrible anger will get them nowhere.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi tooi baŋ ni pa bɔrɔbɔro yɛla ka n yɛri maa? Ka daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Miriya Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim dabindi la.
en: Don't you know by now that I am not talking to you about bread? Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees!.

dag: Dama ŋun mali ni ti lan nya m-pahi m-mali pam, ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni mali biɛla shɛl la.
en: Everyone who has something will be given more. But people who don't have anything will lose even what little they have.

dag: Ti ku zaŋ ti bipuɣinsi ti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba bee n-kpuɣi bɛ bipuɣinsi ti ti bidibisi.
en: We promise not to let our daughters marry the people living around us. And we promise not to let our sons marry their daughters.

dag: Ka Naawuni sɔŋ Judanim gba n-ti ba naŋgbanyini ni bɛ niŋ naa min o kpambaliba ni zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm kaman Yawɛ yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Moreover, Gods power was at work in Judah, unifying them to do what the king and his officials had ordered by the LORDs command.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Juda zuliya niriba maa daa lan chaŋ ti tuhi Keenannim shɛb bɛn be zoya tinsi ni mini bɛn be Nɛgɛb ni bɛn be zolɔna ni tinsi ni la.
en: After this they went on to fight the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, in the foothills, and in the dry country to the south.

dag: Ka naa Sulemaana daa zaŋ aligum dari maa mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu min o yiŋ dunɔdura. O daa lan zaŋ li mali mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnima n-ti baansi, ka so daa na ʒi n-nya di tatabo Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Solomon used the wood to make stairs for the Temple and for his palace, and to make harps and lyres for the musicians. Nothing like that had ever been seen before in the land of Judah.

dag: Ka Mɔabnim maa daa yiɣis asibaasi, ka wuntaŋ nyeei kpe kom maa, ka bɛ nya ka di do bɛ tooni ha m-mɔhi kaman ʒim la.
en: When they got up that morning, the sun was shining across the water, making it look red. The Moabite troops took one look.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa yi nti bɔh o ma, Bɔ ka n lee yɛn suhi Naa? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Yɛlim o ni a bɔrila Jɔn Baptaizira zuɣu.
en: She left the banquet hall and said to her mother, What should I ask for? John the Baptists head, Herodias replied.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa suhuri daa kpaŋ ka bɛ gba zaŋ bindirigu di.
en: Everyone was encouraged and took some food. .

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa yɛli Izraɛl naa, Daŋ bɔhi Yawɛ m-baŋ o ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: But first lets ask the Lord for advice.

dag: Hiburɔn yuli piligu ni ha daa nyɛla Kiriatariba; Ariba ŋɔ n-daa nyɛ Anakinim ni wɔɣirili. Ka tɔbu daa chɛ tuhibu bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: In the past that city was called Kiriath Arba. It was named for the greatest man among the Anakites—a man named Arba. After this there was peace in the land.

dag: Hal di yi niŋ lala ŋun di laɣim yuri pam lo bee n-chɛ ka niriba maa labi Ijipti ni bɛ ti laɣim yuri pam na ti pahi; dama Yawɛ daa yɛliya, Di lan labiya nimaani yaha.
en: The king must not get more and more horses for himself. And he must not send people to Egypt to get more horses, because the Lord has told you, You must never go back that way.

dag: O ni wurim pihi din du mini birini goma zaa;.
en: against every tall tower; against every fortified wall.

dag: Yɛlimiya ti din yɛn niŋ pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, ka di chɛ ka ti baŋ ni yi shiri nyɛla wuna. Niŋmiya zaɣ viɛlli bee zaɣ biɛɣu ka di chɛ ka dabiɛm kpe ti ka ti tarigi.
en: Prove that you are gods by making your predictions come true. Do something good or evil, so we can be amazed and terrified.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi bɛn zaa daa be o sani chaŋ ti dɔni Ai nuzaa polo m-miri li, ka vinvamli do bɛ mini Ai sunsuuni.
en: They set up camp in full view of the town, across the valley to the north.

dag: Zaŋmiya piɛbil yino mali sara asiba, ka ti zaŋ piɛbil ŋun la mi mali zaawuni.
en: one in the morning and one in the evening.

dag: Ka Abishai Zɛruya bia la daa yɛli, Di simdi ni ti ku Shimɛi o ni daa tu Yawɛ ninvuɣ gahindili ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Zeruiahs son Abishai responded, Shouldnt Shimei be put to death for that—for cursing the LORDs anointed.

dag: Diri ka nyuri nyɛla din tahiri lari na; ka wain nyɛ din tiri nir suhupiɛlli; amaa liɣiri n-chɛ ka nir nyar o suhuyubu.
en: Feasts are made for laughter, wine cheers the living, and money answers everything.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan gbaai niriba maa yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ dunia ŋɔ neesim; ka ŋunkam doli ma ku be zibisim ni, amaa o ni malila nyɛvili neesim.
en: Once again Jesus spoke to the people. This time he said, I am the light for the world! Follow me, and you won't be walking in the dark. You will have the light that gives life.

dag: bee binyara din be zuɣusaa bee binyara din be tiŋgbani puuni bee binshɛŋa din be binnamda puuni zaa shɛli ku tooi yihi ti Naawuni yurilim din be ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni la ni.
en: neither the world above nor the world below—there is nothing in all creation that will ever be able to separate us from the love of God which is ours through Christ Jesus our Lord.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi du shɛli din daa tuhi sambani wulinluhili polo la mini di yaɣa ayi varandanima, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu. Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa sunsuuni mini di puuni duu ni di samban ni zɔŋ la.
en: Finally, the man measured the length of the west building, including the side rooms on each end, and it was also meters. The inside walls of the temple's porch and main room.

dag: n ni niŋ binshɛli din ni teer o yɛla zali n jɛmbu duu ni n niriba sunsuuni, ka ti o yuli din gari bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi. N ni ti o yu shɛli din kul ni beni sahakam ka ku kpi.
en: then your name will be remembered in my Temple and among my people longer than if you had sons and daughters. You will never be forgotten.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan niŋdi binshɛŋa ashilɔni ka di nyɛ din bi tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa sani. Ka bɛ daa lan me buɣijɛmbo shee zali bɛ fɔntinsi zaa ni mini tiŋkpan bihi ni ni bɛ ni me birini gili fɔntin shɛŋa ni;.
en: Even worse, the Israelites tried to hide their sins from the Lord their God. They built their own local shrines everywhere in Israel—from small towns to large, walled cities.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nahim Izraɛlnim ka niŋ ba alaka pam di yuuni maa ni. Yuun pisaayika ka bɛ daa nahim Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli Amɔrinim tiŋgban shɛli din be Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: In that same year those people destroyed the Israelites who lived on the east side of the Jordan River, in the area of Gilead. That is the land where the Amorites had lived. The Israelites suffered for years.

dag: Ka a niriba ŋɔ yi ti tum alahichi a sani, , ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka a chɛ ka bɛ dimnim kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ba ka gbahi ba kuli bɛ ya din be katiŋ bee din be yoma.
en: Everyone sins. But when your people sin against you, suppose you get angry enough to let their enemies drag them away to foreign countries.

dag: N ni daŋ wuhi ya yin ni zo so: Zomiyala Naawuni ŋun ni tooi ku daadam ka mali yiko din ni tooi zaŋ o shia niŋ buɣim ni ŋɔ. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, zomiy o.
en: God is the one you must fear. Not only can he take your life, but he can throw you into hell. God is certainly the one you should fear!.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim ni dunɔguliba ni yiliyiiniba ni ninvuɣ shɛba ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba ni Izraɛlnim zaa daa kuli ti ʒini bɛ fɔndi ni. Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ni daa ti zani, di saha Izraɛlnim zaa daa pun ʒini bɛ tinsi ni.
en: And so, by the seventh month, priests, Levites, temple guards, musicians, workers, and many of the ordinary people had settled in the towns of Judah.

dag: Leeban daa lan yɛli, A yi nahim m bipuɣinsi ŋɔ bee a yi kpuɣi paɣiba pahi bɛ zuɣu, ka n ʒi di yɛla, nyin teemi ni Naawuni n nyɛ m min a shɛhiralana.
en: Laban went on, If you mistreat my daughters or if you marry other women, even though I don't know about it, remember that God is watching us.

dag: Di saha ka o daa wuhi ma Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ Maligumaaniba Zuɣulan la ka o ʒe Yawɛ malaika tooni, ka Sintani ʒe o nudirigu polo ni o fiɣis o.
en: The angel showed me Joshua the high priest, standing in front of the angel of the Lord and Satan was standing by Joshuas right side. Satan was there to accuse Joshua of doing wrong.

dag: amaa a yi ku chɛ ka o dol ti chaŋ, ti ku chaŋ, dama doo maa daa yɛl ti, Yi yi ti bi ʒi yi tizo maa na, yi ti ku nya n ninni. .
en: If you are not willing, we will not go, because the man told us we would not be admitted to his presence unless our brother was with us.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi halibiɛri zuɣu ka Anabi Musa daa zali ya lala.
en: Jesus said to them, He wrote this commandment for you because of your unyielding hearts.

dag: Bɛ ni daa baptaizi yinim shɛb Yisa Masia ni la zaŋla Masia biɛhigu kaman binyɛrigu la ye.
en: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.

dag: Ka ti daa kpe Adiramitium ŋarin shɛli din daa yɛn yiɣisi doli yi Ɛsha tinsi din ʒi m-baɣi teeku nol la polo; ka Masidɔnia do so ŋun daa yi Tɛsalɔnaika na ka o yuli booni Aristakus la daa biɛl ti.
en: We went aboard a ship from Adramyttium, which was ready to leave for the seaports of the province of Asia, and we sailed away. Aristarchus, a Macedonian from Thessalonica, was with us.

dag: Naawuni Bia Yisa Masia lahibal suŋ m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This is the good news about Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

dag: Yɛnnim bɛn sani, nyɛvili soli durila zuɣusaa din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku siɣi tiŋgban ni kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ n-kul nyɛ ŋun galisi sahakam.
en: But you, LORD, are exalted forever!.

dag: ni nabihi bɛn mali salima, ka zaŋ anzinfa pali bɛ yinsi la n-di vuhira.
en: I wish I were buried with rulers who filled their graves with gold and silver.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Yi yi ni saɣi ka n sɔɣi n kpim maa kpe, yin wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ. Balimmiya Zɔhar bia Ɛfurɔn.
en: and spoke with them: If you yourselves allow me to bury my dead near me, listen to me and ask Ephron, Zohars son.

dag: Yɛlim ba, N nyɛla shihirili yi sani, n ni niŋ shɛm maa, lala nti yɛn niŋ ya. Bɛ ni ti gbahi ba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ tinzun tiŋ ti niŋ dabitim ni.
en: Tell them that what you have done is a sign of what will happen to them—they will be refugees and captives.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa zaa daa niŋ nia ni bɛ lab ba kuɣa. Di saha ka Yawɛ jilima daa yi polo Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la zuɣusaa, Izraɛlnim zaa ninni.
en: But the entire community intended to stone them. Then the LORDs glory appeared in the meeting tent to all the Israelites.

dag: Dina ka ti mali paɣiri ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Ba la, ka lan mal li turi ninsalinim bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni nam shɛba ŋ-ŋmahind omaŋ la.
en: With it we both bless the Lord and Father and curse human beings made in Gods likeness.

dag: N ni zaŋ Ijiptinim niŋ na biɛɣu ŋun mali putɔɣu nuu ni ka o su ba. Man yi Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord GOD All-Powerful says, I will give Egypt to a hard master. A powerful king will rule over the people.

dag: Ka Pita dii gbaai kari ka pɔri pɔri yɛra, Man ʒi doo maa. Di saha maa ka nolɔɣu dii kum.
en: Peter began to curse and swear, I don't know that man! Right then a rooster crowed.

dag: Ka o daa dii yiɣisi zani chana, dama o daa nyɛla yuun pinaayi bia, ka di daa niŋ ba alahiziba pam ti yaɣi.
en: The girl immediately stood up and began walking. The father and mother and the followers were amazed.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ tummi sara maligu shee mini sara maligu bimbini maa gbini tuma, ka di chɛ ka n suhu ku lan yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: Follow these instructions, so I won't become angry and punish the Israelites ever again.

dag: Bɛ mali noya, amaa di bi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ mali nina, amaa di bi nyara.
en: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.

dag: Nyin ŋun lihiri daadamnim ŋɔ, n yi tumla alahichi, tuun bɔ ka n lee tum a? Bɔ n-chɛ ka a kul zaŋ dolila mani? Ka a kul liritila mani? Bɔ n-niŋ ka n yɛla muɣis a?.
en: Why do you watch us so closely? What's it to you, if I sin? Why am I your target and such a heavy burden?.

dag: A nya ninvuɣ so ŋun tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa yomyom? Jɛrigu mali tahima gari dilana.
en: There is more hope for a stupid fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna. Zaŋm a tulaale tuɣindi labila m-mooi buɣim bimbini zuɣu niŋ tulaale zim pa di zuɣu n-zaŋ li chaŋ niriba maa sani yomyom ti mali sara ti ba, dama Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka alɔbo pun piligi.
en: Then Moses said to Aaron, Get your bronze pan and some fire from the altar. Then put incense in it. Hurry to the people and do the things that will make them pure. The Lord is angry with them. The trouble has already started.

dag: Karimi saria n-ti ma nasara, lihimi din tuhi.
en: My justice comes from you; let your eyes see what is right!.

dag: di ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ma. Di je suli n-kari man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ bahi. Nyini m-pun nyɛ n sɔŋda. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim ŋɔ, di chɛ ma bee n-zaŋ ma bahi.
en: Dont turn away from me. Dont be angry with your servant. You are the only one who can help me. My God, dont leave me all alone. You are my Savior.

dag: Dama n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu a ni, n ni chɛ ka bɛ ku niriba a ni solɔri zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi din jɛnd a maa ku niriba luɣilikam, ka kpiimba ti do a ni, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: I will hurl plague against it, and blood will run in its streets. When the sword comes against it from all sides, the slain will fall within it. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka a daa yihi ti Ijipti n-zaŋ ti na ti niŋ luɣ shɛli din bi viɛli ŋɔ? Luɣ shɛŋa nir ni yɛn biri chi bee n-sa fiig tihi bee n-sa wain tihi bee n-sa pumpɔrinchihi tihi kani, ka kom gba kani ka ti ni nyu.
en: Why did you bring us out of Egypt into this miserable place where nothing will grow? There's no grain, no figs, no grapes, no pomegranates. There is not even any water to drink.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yo Aruna salima laɣibaligu kɔbisiyɔbu o kabɔɣili maa zuɣu.
en: So David paid Araunah gold coins for his threshing place.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa daa yiɣisi nimaani n-chani ka lihiri Sɔdom polo; ka Ibrahimma daa chani doli ba ni o zali ba soli.
en: Then the men got up to leave. They looked toward Sodom and began walking in that direction. Abraham walked with them to send them on their way.

dag: Ka Adɔnibɛzɛk daa guui, ka bɛ kari dol o ti gbaag o ŋ-ŋmah o nubihilɔri min o napombihilɔri bahi.
en: He ran away, but they chased him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋla tiŋgbana ŋɔ zaa ti Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ŋun nyɛ n dabili ŋɔ, ka zaŋ mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ti o ni bɛ jɛmd o.
en: I am the one who has placed all these nations under the power of my servant, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia, and I have made even the wild animals serve him.

dag: Ka Judanim zaa daa zaŋ o bia Azaria ŋun daa nyɛ yuun pinaayɔbu bia la n-leei naa zal o ba Amazia zaani.
en: After his death the people of Judah made his son Azariah king, even though he was only at the time.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ dali ka bɛ mali shili, dama dali man Yawɛ ni yi Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu siɣina niriba maa zaa ninni.
en: and be ready for me on the third day. On the third day, the Lord will come down to Mount Sinai. And all the people will see me.

dag: Di bi tuhi ni ti tum niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma kaman bɛ ni shɛb ni daa tum shɛm, ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaata bahi yoli dahin yin la.
en: We must not be guilty of sexual immorality, as some of them were—and in one day twenty-three thousand of them fell dead.

dag: Biŋkɔbiri maa tab dubu saha ka n daa ti zahim zahindi nya ka bulahi bɛn duri buhi maa nyɛla zaɣ bomaboma mini bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ni bɛn nyɛ zaɣ bɔribɔri.
en: Once, when the flocks were mating, I dreamed that all the rams were either spotted or speckled.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa tɔɣisi Anab Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ zuliya shɛb polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is what the LORD told the prophet Jeremiah concerning the nations.

dag: A ni tooi vihi baŋ ni di bi gari biɛɣ pinaayi zuŋɔ ka n daa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni n ti jɛm Naawuni.
en: You can verify that I went up to worship in Jerusalem no more than twelve days ago.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka tɔbbihi daa chaŋ ti kabi bɛ ni daa kpahi niriba ayi shɛb tabili dapula zuɣu pahi Yisa zuɣu la ŋun daŋ tooni min o kpee la gbaya;.
en: So the soldiers went and broke the legs of the first man and then of the other man who had been crucified with Jesus.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn zaŋ yi ni lo nia shɛŋa sɔɣi Yawɛ, ka tumdi yi tuma zibisim ni ŋɔ zuɣu, dama yi yɛra, So bi nyari ti, So mi bi mi ti.
en: You are in for trouble, if you try to hide your plans from the Lord ! Or if you think what you do in the dark can't be seen.

dag: Yi yi po pɔri ni yi niŋ shɛli ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, yin di pihigi di palibu, dama biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni bɔhi di niŋbu yɛla yi sani ka di chɛ ka yi ku tum taali.
en: When you make a vow to the Lord your God, do not put off doing what you promised; the Lord will hold you to your vow, and it is a sin not to keep it.

dag: O daa yɛl lala ni o wuhi kum shɛli Pita ni daa ti yɛn kpi, ka di ti Naawuni jilima la. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yɛli Pita, Doli ma.
en: Then he said to Peter, Follow me.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya: Gol so ŋun pah anahi mini ŋun pah anu ni ŋun pah ayopɔin ni ŋun pahi pia puuni nolɔbo la zaa ha ni ti leela suhupiɛlli saha Judanim sani. Dinzuɣu yumiya yɛlimaŋli mini suhudoo.
en: The fasts held in the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months will become festivals of joy and gladness for the people of Judah. You must love truth and peace.

dag: Hal mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa kul kumdimi n-niŋd a, kulibɔna ni koma zaa ni nyuui, ka buɣim di mɔɣu ni zaa la zuɣu.
en: Wild animals have no water because of you; rivers and streams are dry, and pastures are parched.

dag: Suhugarigu chɛmi ka n yɛma ŋma; kpaŋsim ma kaman a yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: I am sad and tired. Say the word, and make me strong again.

dag: Ka nyin Bɛlishaaza ŋun nyɛ o bia ŋɔ mi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yɛla, amaa ka bi siɣis amaŋa.
en: But you who are his son, Belshazzar, you havent submitted, even though youve known all this.

dag: Yi mini yi tɔbbihi ni yi niriba pam bɛn be yi sani ni ti kana kaman sanʒiɛɣu, ka be kaman sagbani din limsi tiŋgban la.
en: You will invade like a sudden storm. You and all your troops, and the many peoples with you, will be like clouds covering the earth.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bo n-nya li, di ni ti ba nyɛvili, ka ti bɛ niŋgbuna zaa alaafee.
en: These words are the secret of life and health to all who discover them.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi suhuri ni zɔhiri shɛlikam zuɣu yɛla niŋ o nuu ni, dama o baɣa be yi ni.
en: Give all your worries to him, because he cares for you.

dag: hal ti paai palo din be dunoli zuɣusaa hal ni puuni duu la ni ni di samban ni. Ka bɛ ŋme binyara pa puuni duu maa dukpina zaa zuɣu mini di sunsuuni zaa ti gili.
en: The paneling stopped just above the doorway. These walls were decorated.

dag: Dama bɛ yi ti kpi, bɛ ku tooi zaŋ li mali chaŋ. Bɛ daazichi maa ku doli ba siɣi gballi ni.
en: because when they die, they wont take any of it with them. Their fantastic things wont accompany them down under.

dag: Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni yi ku dunia ŋɔ ni kɔr biɛri din be yi ni la. Dina n-nyɛ: Zina niŋbu mini daɣiri tuma ni niŋgbuŋ kɔre ni tɛhi biɛri ni binyara ni kɔre kpɛbu la. Binyara ni kɔre kpɛbu ŋmanila buɣijɛmbo.
en: So put to death the parts of your life that belong to the earth, such as sexual immorality, moral corruption, lust, evil desire, and greed .

dag: Ti nyɛla do yino bidibisi pinaayi; ka ti ni yino daa kani, ka ŋun nyɛ ti zaa biasani be ti ba maa sani Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: We are twelve brothers, all our fathers sons. One of us is gone, but the youngest is right now with our father in the land of Canaan.

dag: Alikizanda ŋun nyɛ daanya doora la daa tum ma zaɣ biɛɣu pam; ti Duuma ni bɔh o biɛri labisi o ni tum shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Alexander the metalworker caused me so much harm. The Lord will punish him for what he did.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi ne ka niŋ ma yɛda ku lan kpi hal abada. Ka bɔhi Maata, A niŋ dimbɔŋɔ yɛda.
en: And everyone who lives and believes in me will never really die. Martha, do you believe this.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ o nyaandoliba m-pa omaŋ zuɣu dol o.
en: So Jesus and his disciples got up and went with him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Hɛnadad bia Binnui ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛila yaɣili pirigili polo naa la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Bavvai son of Henadad, ruler of the other half of the Keilah District, built the next section;.

dag: O daa laɣisi m biriginsim zaa n-lo li kaman naɣikɔra dapua la. O nuhi ka o daa zaŋ lo li tabili taba n-zaŋ li pa n nyiŋgoli zuɣu, ka n yaa daa naai. N Duuma daa zaŋ ma tila n ni ku tooi zabi ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: He took note of all my sins and tied them all together; He hung them around my neck, and I grew weak beneath the weight. The Lord gave me to my foes, and I was helpless against them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yisahaku daa kpalim be Gɛra. Ka nimaani nim ni daa ti bɔh o bɔhigu zaŋ chaŋ o paɣ polo.
en: So Isaac settled in Gerar.

dag: Amaa di bahi ni mini di biɛma ni kom din ti ku niŋ nyaɣisim. Din ti kul yɛn nyɛla din mali yalim.
en: But the water in the marshes and ponds along the shore will not be made fresh. They will remain there as a source of salt.

dag: ka bo o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛnyaŋ bee bunyaŋ na nti ti Yawɛ o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu, ka di leeg o daalahichi maa sanyoo sara maligu, ka maligumaana zaŋ li yo o daalahichi maa samli.
en: and bring to the LORD as compensation for the sin that was committed a female from the flock, either a sheep or goat, as a purification offering. The priest will then make reconciliation for you, to remove your sin.

dag: Amaa dimdi yi be so min o kpee sunsuuni, ka o do n-gu o nti chaŋ ti lir o ku dilana ka zo n-kuli fɔntinsi ŋɔ tin yin ni.
en: But if someone does hate a neighbor and ambushes him, rising up against him and attacking him so he dies, and then escapes to one of these cities.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yiɣisi asiba n-yɛli Balak kpamba maa, Labimiya kuli yi ya, dama Yawɛ zaɣisiya ni n di doli ya chaŋ.
en: Then Balaam arose in the morning and said to Balaks officials, Go to your land, for the LORD has refused to allow me to go with you.

dag: Ka niriba daa jɛmdi waɣ biɛ titali maa, o ni daa zaŋ fukumsi din nyɛ omaŋmaŋ dini n-niŋ biŋkɔbigu la nuu ni zuɣu, ka bɛ daa jɛmdi biŋkɔbigu maa n-yɛra, Ŋuni n-lee ŋmani biŋkɔbigu ŋɔ bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tuh o tɔbu.
en: People worshiped the dragon because it had given its power to the beast, and they also worshiped the beast. They asked, Who is as powerful as the beast? Who can make war against it.

dag: Ka yi nɔdeebo yi ti niŋ pali, ti mali shili ni ti darigi bɛn tumdi nɔzaɣisibo tuma la tibili.
en: Once your obedience is complete, we are ready to punish any disobedience.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim yi ti zaɣisi ni bɛ ku chaŋ ti puhi Suɣa Tibu chuɣu maa, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka o ni daa chɛ ka alɔbo dɔr shɛŋa lu zuliya shɛb zuɣu la lu bɛ gba zuɣu.
en: This horrible disaster will strike the Egyptians and everyone else who refuses to go there for the celebration.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa bɔh o, Ti Duuma, ya polo ka dimbɔŋɔnim ti yɛn niŋ maa? Ka o yɛli ba, Bin kpiŋ ni be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka juri laana.
en: Then Jesus' disciples spoke up, But where will this happen, Lord? Jesus said, Where there is a corpse, there will always be vultures.

dag: O daa na bi ʒini tiŋ gba ka paɣ so pun wum o yɛla ka kana nti gban o tooni, dama alizin biɛɣu n-daa ʒi o bipuɣim bil zuɣu.
en: In fact, a woman whose young daughter was possessed by an unclean spirit heard about him right away. She came and fell at his feet.

dag: Di ŋmanila dabin shɛli paɣ ni yi zahim bɔrɔbɔro zim ŋmani buta n-zaŋ li gari di ni ŋɔri zali, ka di zaa ti mii piri la.
en: It is like this. A woman takes some yeast and mixes it with a bushel of flour until the whole batch of dough rises.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti daŋ yibu nolɔɣu kukoli saha chaŋ mɔɣu ni ni o ti suhi Naawuni.
en: Early in the morning, well before sunrise, Jesus rose and went to a deserted place where he could be alone in prayer.

dag: Miri ka a tu naa, hal di sɔɣi tu o; a mi miri ka a tu bundana, hal di tu o a duu puuni gba, dama di pa shɛli ka nooŋa bee binyiɣirigu kam ti zaŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa chaŋ ti yɛli.
en: Dont say bad things about the king. Dont even think bad things about him. And dont say bad things about rich people, even if you are alone in your home. A little bird might fly and tell them everything you said.

dag: ka yi chaŋ Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli ni n-chaŋ ti zani salichɛhi dunɔdali ni m moli n ni yɛn yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ nimaani.
en: and to go through Potsherd Gate out to Hinnom Valley. There I was to proclaim the message that he would give me.

dag: Ti yi doli Naawuni zaligunima dina n-nyɛ din wuhiri ni ti yuri ŋun Naawuni. Ka o zaligunim maa mi pala yɛlimuɣisira.
en: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.

dag: Daadam, fabilim Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ zuɣu, ka yɛl o, A tɛhiya ni a nyɛla gbuɣinli zuliya kam sani, amaa a ŋmanila nyɛbiga m-be mɔɣili ni. A luri a kulibɔna kom ni, ka zaŋ a naba siɣiri kom maa ni n-saɣim a kulibɔna maa puuni kom.
en: Human one, sing a lament for Pharaoh, Egypts king. Say to him: You consider yourself a young lion among the nations, but you are like the sea monster! You thrash about in your rivers, you roil the waters with your feet, and you muddy your rivers.

dag: Ka di daa chɛ ka Lɛvinim maa bi lan ʒiri Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa bee bɛ ni daa mali neen shɛŋa tumdi di tuma maa gindi yaha.
en: the Levites need no longer carry the dwelling or any of the equipment used in its service.

dag: N kul yɛla n noli vuhiri nyahigira, dama n suhu kul yɛla a zaligunim maa zuɣu.
en: In my desire for your commands I pant with open mouth.

dag: N daa yɛli ya, Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira bee n-zɔri ba dabiɛm.
en: So I said to you, Dont be upset or afraid of those people.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim shɛb daa yi Antiɔk mini Aikɔnium na nti lɛbigi niriba maa suhuri, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ lab Pool kuɣa hal ti tɛhi ni o kpimi ka vu o yihi bɛ tiŋ maa tariga.
en: Some Jews came from Antioch in Pisidia and from Iconium; they won the crowds over to their side, stoned Paul and dragged him out of the town, thinking that he was dead.

dag: Ka Pita chihi yɛli, Man bi mi bee m-baŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni. Ka zo n-yi nti ʒe dunol ni, ka nolɔɣu dii kum.
en: But he denied it. I don't know ... I don't understand what you are talking about, he answered, and went out into the passageway. Just then a rooster crowed.

dag: ni Sulemaana nɛma duri fɔntinsi ni o chɛchɛbunsi fɔntinsi ni o wɔribariba fɔntinsi m-pahi ŋun Sulemaana ni daa bɔri ni o me mɛr shɛŋa zaa zali Jɛrusalɛm ni Lɛbanɔn ni tiŋgbɔn shɛli o ni daa su maa zaa ni.
en: along with all the storage cities that belonged to Solomon, as well as the cities used for storing chariots and cavalry and whatever he wanted to build in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and throughout his kingdom.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda tɔbbihi mini Jɔab daa yi ŋmɛnditoli yɔɣu paana ni nɛma pam. Amaa di saha maa Abinɛr daa lan ka Dauda sani Hiburɔn. Dauda daa pun chɛbis o mi ka o chaŋ ni suhudoo.
en: Right then, Davids soldiers and Joab returned from a raid, bringing a great deal of loot with them. Abner was no longer with David in Hebron because David had sent him off in peace.

dag: Wuntizɔriba tɛha nyɛla din viɛla, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri saɣisigu nyɛla yɔhiŋ.
en: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.

dag: Miri ka a kpuɣi paɣa bee n-dɔɣi bidibisi bee bipuɣinsi kpe.
en: Dont marry or have children in this place.

dag: Amaa naa daa bi saɣi zaŋ Mɛfibɔshɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔnatan bia ka nyɛ Sool yaaŋa la ŋun ti ba, ŋun Dauda mini Sool bia Jɔnatan ni daa lo tab alikauli shɛli Yawɛ tooni la zuɣu.
en: But the king spared Mephibosheth, Jonathans son and Sauls grandson, because of the LORDs solemn pledge that was between them—between David and Sauls son Jonathan.

dag: Kul paɣimiya ti Ba Naawuni binshɛɣukam zaa puuni sahakam ti Duuma Yisa Masia yuli zuɣu.
en: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, always give thanks for everything to God the Father.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan ni Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ni Chɛrɛtinim ni Pɛlɛtinim daa chaŋ ti chɛ ka Sulemaana ba Naa Dauda buntaaŋa, ka bɛ zaŋ o chaŋ Gihɔn.
en: Zadok, Nathan, and Benaiah left and took along the two groups of David's special bodyguards. Solomon rode on David's mule as they led him to Gihon Spring.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ, N cham ti liri Filistianim maa? A ni zaŋ ba niŋ n nuu ni? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Dauda, Cham ti liri ba, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni.
en: David asked the Lord , saying, Should I go up to fight against the Philistines? Will you help me defeat them? The Lord answered, Yes, I certainly will help you defeat the Philistines.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yɛl o yiŋ nachin kpɛm ŋun su o binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi, Zaŋm a nuu niŋ n gbalipina lɔŋni.
en: Abrahams oldest servant was in charge of everything he owned. Abraham called that servant to him and said, Put your hand under my leg.

dag: O ni wuhi ba alahichi ni nyɛ shɛli, bɛ ni bi niŋ ma yɛda zuɣu.
en: The Spirit will show them that they are wrong about sin, because they didn't have faith in me.

dag: Yɛhudianim n-daa gbaai do so n ni tahi a sanna ŋɔ n-yɛn ku o, ka n daa wum ni o nyɛla Rom tiŋbia ka daa zaŋ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti fa o bahi.
en: The Jews seized this man and were about to kill him. I learned that he is a Roman citizen, so I went with my soldiers and rescued him.

dag: Amaa n yɛlila yinima: N ni zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔn maa tin ya, ka yi di li fali n-su li. Di nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun woligi ya ka chɛ zuliya shɛba.
en: But I have told you, You will certainly possess their fertile land; I am giving it to you to possess. It is a land full of milk and honey. I am the LORD your God, who has separated you from all other peoples.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi dunia ŋɔ ni yɛla viɛli pam. Ka m mali suhupiɛlli pam bɛ zuɣu.
en: Now as for the holy ones in the land, the magnificent ones that I was so happy about.

dag: Bɛ mali tiba, amaa di bi wumda. Bɛ mali nyɛhi, amaa di bi wumdi nyom.
en: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.

dag: Dama a suhuyiɣisili chɛmi ka ti dabisa garita; ti yuma kul naarimi kaman siɣimbu la.
en: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.

dag: Di saha ka n daa kpe di ni nti nya ka bɛ ŋmɛla biŋgbamda mini biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn bi be kasi zaa ni Izraɛl buɣa zaa kɔtomsi pa gooni maa zuɣu gili.
en: So I went in and looked. I saw statues of all kinds of reptiles and animals that you hate to think about. The statues were the filthy idols that the people of Israel worshiped. There were pictures of those animals carved all around on every wall!.

dag: A bi mi ni kurimbuni, saha shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ daadam niŋ dunia ni la.
en: Since the time of creation, everyone has known.

dag: Gbilisim a tibili wum sarikanim ŋuhibu, ka tiligi bɛ ni zali ni bɛ kum shɛb la a yiko din galisi pam la zuɣu.
en: Let the prisoners groaning reach you. With your powerful arm spare those who are destined to die.

dag: Di kali ma pah alahichinim ni. Di ku ma kaman ninvuɣ kuriba.
en: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal.

dag: Riuɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nahat mini Zɛra ni Shamma ni Miza.
en: Reuels sons were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

dag: Di nyɛla din chihiri ni nanim tum zaɣ biɛɣu, dama wuntitali soli ka bɛ doli zali nam.
en: Kings detest wicked deeds, for their thrones are founded on righteousness.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa ti lan zahim zahindi shɛli, ka zaŋ li yɛl o biɛyanim maa yaha. O daa yɛli ba mi: Nyamiya, n lan zahimla zahindi shɛli. N sa nyami ka wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi piniyini damdi ma tiŋa.
en: Then Joseph had another dream and told his brothers, I had another dream, in which I saw the sun, the moon, and eleven stars bowing down to me.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka o daa bɔhi Yisa bɔhigu pam, amaa ka o bi garig o.
en: Herod asked him a lot of questions, but Jesus did not answer.

dag: Itiɔpianim mini Ijiptinima n-daa yi nyɛ o yaa, ka di mi daa ka tariga. Putinim mini Libianim n-daa nyɛ bɛn sɔŋd o.
en: Ethiopia and Egypt made Thebes strong. Libya and the Sudan supported her.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa dii guui chaŋ ti du n-tam Filistia doo maa zuɣu, ka darigi ŋooi ŋun Filistia doo maa maŋmaŋ takɔbi di tɔɣu ni n-zaŋ li ku o, ka ŋma o zuɣu. Filistianim maa ni daa nya ka bɛ tiyaawumya maa kpi maa, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: Then David ran and stood over the Philistine. He grabbed the Philistines sword, drew it from its sheath, and finished him off. Then David cut off the Philistines head with the sword. When the Philistines saw that their hero was dead, they fled.

dag: ni Yawɛ yɛliya, Di chaŋya ti tuhi yi mabihi maa. Labimiya kuli, Man Yawɛ sani ka din niŋ maa yina. Di saha ka bɛ daa wum Yawɛ ni yɛli ba shɛm maa ka lab kuli, ka daa bi lan chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛrɔbɔam.
en: Say to them, The Lord says that you must not go to war against your brothers. Everyone, go home! I made all this happen. So all the men in Rehoboams army obeyed the Lord and went home. They did not attack Jeroboam.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya zuɣusa palli mini dunia palli; dama tuuli zuɣusaa mini tuuli dunia la daa vuuya, ka teeku gba lan kani.
en: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth disappeared, and the sea vanished.

dag: Dindali n ni ti tim tuumba ka bɛ yi n sani kpe ŋarima chaŋ ti kpɛhi Itiɔpianim bɛn bi mi bɛ yɛla ŋɔ dabiɛm pam. Biɛrim ni ti paai ba Ijiptinim mbusim dabisili maa dali, dama di kanna.
en: At that time I will send out messengers. They will go in ships to carry the bad news to Ethiopia. Ethiopia now feels safe, but the people of Ethiopia will shake with fear when Egypt is punished. That time is coming.

dag: Di saha ka n daa ŋmaligi lihi ni n nya ŋun yɛli ma lala maa. N ni daa lihi maa, ka n nya salima firilatamdis ayopɔin.
en: I turned around to see who was talking to me, and I saw seven gold lampstands.

dag: Ka yiɣisi nimaani yi zɔŋ ni. Ka yili maa ni bipuɣin so gba ti lan nya o ka yɛli bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa, Doo ŋɔ gba yi bela Yisa ŋun yi Nazarɛt na ŋɔ sani.
en: and went on out to the entrance of the courtyard. Another servant woman saw him and said to the men there, He was with Jesus of Nazareth.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa yiɣisi chaŋ Gɛshur nti zaŋ Absalom kuli Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Then Joab got up and went to Geshur and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yɛl o yiŋ nachin kpɛm ŋun su o binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi, Zaŋm a nuu niŋ n gbalipina lɔŋni.
en: One day, Abraham called in his most trusted servant and said to him, Solemnly promise me.

dag: Ka wuhiri shihir kara pam, hal ka chɛ ka buɣim yiri zuɣusaa lurina niriba ninni;.
en: It does great signs so that it even makes fire come down from heaven to earth in the presence of the people.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi ne ka niŋ ma yɛda ku lan kpi hal abada. Ka bɔhi Maata, A niŋ dimbɔŋɔ yɛda.
en: and those who live and believe in me will never die. Do you believe this.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti ŋme solɔɣu yi Asiria na, ka o niriba bɛn kpalim maa dol li kaman o ni daa mali soli ti Izraɛlnim shɛm saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti na la.
en: Then for his people who survive, there will be a good road from Assyria, just as there was a good road for their ancestors when they left Egypt.

dag: Buni chɛ ka nir nyarila zɔnim pam, amaa faranim bɛn ka zɔnima.
en: Riches increase ones friends, but the poor lose their friends.

dag: amaa di ku niŋ lala yinim sani. Dinzuɣu ŋun bɔri ni o nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ lee yi zaa ha bia;.
en: This, however, is not the way it is among you. If one of you wants to be great, you must be the servant of the rest;.

dag: Yi ni yɛli ba bahi, ka pɔhim ʒi ba chaŋ, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒe n-wurim ba. Di saha yi suhuri ni paligi man Yawɛ zuɣu; ka yi paɣi mani ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ.
en: You will throw them into the air, and the wind will blow them away and scatter them. Then you will be happy in the Lord . You will be proud of the Holy One of Israel.

dag: Ka dɔbba mini paɣiba pam daa kul niŋdi ti Duuma yɛda pahira.
en: Indeed, more and more believers in the Lord, large numbers of both men and women, were added to the church.

dag: Di saha ka Shɛkɛm gba daa yɛli Daina ba min o tizɔdɔbba maa, Yi yi saɣi ti ma, n ni tin ya yi ni kul yɛli ni yi bɔri shɛlikam.
en: Then Shechem said to Dinah's father and brothers, Do me this favor, and I will give you whatever you want.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa lan yɛl o, N tiŋgbani n-kul do a tooni maa, ʒinimi a ni bɔri ni a ʒini di ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: and told Abraham he could settle anywhere in his country.

dag: M bia, dim shiri, dama di nyɛla din viɛla, ka shikpam din tɔɣiri shigbaŋ ni na nyɛla din nyaɣis a noli ni.
en: My son, eat honey; it is good. Honey straight from the honeycomb is the sweetest.

dag: Ka Vuhim Dabisili dali maa daa ti paai, ka tiŋ maa zaa damna ni bɛ ti wum Naawuni yɛligu.
en: The next Sabbath nearly everyone in the town came to hear the word of the Lord.

dag: Amaa yuun shɛli din pahiri yuma anu ni, yi ni tooi di di wala, ka lala chɛ ka di woli wala pam tin ya: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Then, in the fifth year, you can eat the fruit from that tree. And the tree will produce more and more fruit for you. I am the Lord your God.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Judanim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ zaɣisi Yawɛ zalikpana la, ka bi dol o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la, amaa ka bɛ ʒiri ŋmabu chɛ ka bɛ birigi n-doli bɛ yaannim ni daa doli so shɛŋa la.
en: The Lord said: I will punish Judah for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They have rejected my teachings and refused to obey me. They were led astray by the same false gods their ancestors worshiped.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni, ka be kasi ŋɔ, a pala ŋun daa pun be kurimbuni ha? Ti ku kpi. Yawɛ, nyini n-zali ba ni bɛ kari saria; nyini ŋun nyɛ ti tampiŋ ŋɔ n-zali ba ni bɛ darigiri niriba tibili.
en: Lord , from the very beginning you are God. You are my God, holy and eternal. Lord , my God and protector, you have chosen the Babylonians and made them strong so that they can punish us.

dag: M banima mini m mabihi, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm zabi mmaŋ zuɣu ŋɔ.
en: Brothers and fathers, listen now to my defense.

dag: Di yuma anahi nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa chaŋ ti yɛli naa, Naa, n suhir a mi, chɛ ka n chaŋ Hiburɔn nti pali n ni daa lo Yawɛ alikauli shɛli nimaani.
en: After four years Absalom said to King David, Sir, let me go to Hebron and keep a promise I made to the Lord .

dag: o min o bidibis ayi la ʒili. Bɛ ni yino yuli n-daa booni Gɛrishom, dama o daa yɛlimi, N nyɛla sana m-be saan tiŋa.
en: and Gershom and Eliezer, her two sons. Moses had said, I have been a foreigner in a strange land; so he had named one son Gershom.

dag: Naa Ahaz ni daa yi Damaskus kuna, o daa chaŋmi ti nya bimbini maa. Di saha ka o daa vu m-miri bimbini maa nti du n-tam di zuɣu.
en: When Ahaz returned, he went to see the altar and to offer sacrifices on it. He walked up to the altar.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma yi kariti ti saria, o darigirila ti tibili ni ti di pahi dunianim zuɣu bahi yoli.
en: But when the Lord judges us, he punishes us to show us the right way. He does this so that we will not be condemned with the world.

dag: Ka o daa boli bidib so ŋun pah ayi mi yuli Ifriim, ka yɛli, Naawuni ti ma nama n ni di wahala tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni ŋɔ.
en: His second son was named Ephraim, which means God has made me a success in the land where I suffered.

dag: Yi ni kpi n-do mɔɣu ŋɔ ni; ka yinim bɛn yuma nyɛ yuun pisi zaŋ chani zaa, ka nyɛ bɛ ni daa sab shɛb yuya, ka yi nyɛ bɛn ŋum yi kparima ni niŋ ma la.
en: You will die right here in the desert, and your dead bodies will cover the ground. You have insulted me, and none of you men who are over years old.

dag: dama pako shɛb pun birigi doli Sintani.
en: But some of the younger widows have already turned away to follow Satan.

dag: Gbib ma kaman a ni lo alikauli shɛm la, ka m be. Di chɛ ka n di vi n tahima niŋbu ni.
en: Support me, Lord, as you promised, and I will live. I trust in you, so dont disappoint me.

dag: ti yɛra, Doo ŋɔ wuhirila niriba ni bɛ doli Naawuni zaligu ni bi wuhi shɛm n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: They said to Gallio, This man is teaching people to worship God in a way that is against our law.

dag: Noli deebu mini ʒiɛyimtali zuɣu ni chɛ ka nir daalahichi kpihim, ka Yawɛ jɛmbu ni chɛ ka nir yi zaɣ biɛɣu ni.
en: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.

dag: Ɛfa ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb mam la n-daa dɔɣi Haran mini Mɔza ni Gazɛz, ka Haran daa nyɛ Gazɛz ba.
en: Ephah was one of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran named his son after his brother Gazez.

dag: Bɛn daa fiɣis o maa ni daa yiɣisi zani bɛ daa bi zaŋ yɛtɔɣ biɛ shɛŋa n ni daa tɛhi ni bɛ ni zaŋ o tɔɣisi.
en: His opponents stood up, but they did not accuse him of any of the evil crimes that I thought they would.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinunaayi saha ka Rɛmalia bia Pɛka daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pisi.
en: Pekah son of Remaliah became king of Israel in Azariah's fifty-second year as king of Judah, and he ruled years from Samaria.

dag: ka din pahi pisi daa gbaai Ɛliata min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the twentieth to Eliathah, his family, and his relatives.

dag: dama bɛ yi kul lu buyopɔin, bɛ ni lan yiɣisi; amaa zaɣ biɛɣu ni ku ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: Good people might fall again and again, but they always get up. It is the wicked who are defeated by their troubles.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya, chɛliya ka ti be Yawɛ neesim ni chana.
en: Family of Jacob, let us follow the Lord .

dag: Ayuba ni daa suhi Naawuni ti o zɔnim maa nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa lan labisi Ayuba buni ti o. Yawɛ daa tila Ayuba o ni daa pun mali shɛli ʒii buyi zuɣu.
en: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa zaligu shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ doo min o paɣa polo ni zaŋ chaŋ doo min o bipuɣiŋga ŋun na be o ba yiŋa ka nyɛ paɣisarili polo m-bala.
en: These are the regulations that the LORD commanded Moses concerning a husband and his wife and between a father and his daughter while she is young and in her fathers household.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord said to Moses.

dag: Firawuna ni yɛli Izraɛlnim yɛla, Bɛ bela tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni dari ginda, ka ʒi bɛ ni kpari shɛli polo, ka tiŋgban nɛli taɣi ba zali.
en: Pharaoh will think to himself, The Israelites are lost and confused in the land. The desert has trapped them.

dag: Sania din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli mini binyara zahimbu din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli nyɛla Yawɛ dini. Bintibisa zaa din be kpalaŋ puuni nyɛla o tuma.
