en: The Lord wants weights and measures to be honest and every sale to be fair.

dag: Ka o daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Di simdi ka yi zɔri Yawɛ ka tum tuma maa ni ʒiɛyimtali ni yi suhu zaa.
en: He gave them the following instructions: You must perform your duties in reverence for the Lord , faithfully obeying him in everything you do.

dag: Pa yinim m-bo yɛla ŋɔ ti yimaŋa yi ni zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun mali ya chana la zuɣu?.
en: It's all your own fault! You stopped following me, the Lord your God.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ ni yino ŋun daa zo n-tiligi daa kana ti yɛli Ibram ŋun daa nyɛ Hiburu nira ka be Mamri ŋun daa nyɛ Amɔri nir la oki tihi gbini. Mamri min o mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ Ɛshikol mini Anɛr la daa nyɛla Ibram zɔnima.
en: At this time Abram the Hebrew was living near the oaks that belonged to Mamre the Amorite. Mamre and his brothers Eshcol and Aner were Abram's friends. Someone who had escaped from the battle told Abram.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ni sokam zaa be kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ, amaa Naawuni tiri sokam la pin kɔŋkɔba ka di saɣisirila o biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm; ka so dini be di ko ka chɛ o kpee dini.
en: I wish everyone could be like me. But God has given each person a different ability. He makes some able to live one way, others to live a different way.

dag: Ka Adam min o paɣ daa lan laɣim ka o dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Sɛt, dama O daa yɛlimi, Naawuni zaŋla bidib so ti ma ka o zani Ɛbɛl zaani, Keen ni daa ku Ɛbɛl la zuɣu.
en: Adam and his wife had another son. They named him Seth, because they said, God has given us a son to take the place of Abel, who was killed by his brother Cain.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ka yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ n yidan yipa ni zaŋ omaŋ tabili ma, dama n dɔɣi bidibis ata ti o; dinzuɣu ka o daa bol o yuli Lɛvi.
en: When Leah's third son was born, she said, Now my husband will hold me close. So this son was named Levi.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa zuɣu. Chɛliya ka dunia zaa baŋ di yɛla.
en: Sing to the LORD, who has done glorious things; proclaim this throughout all the earth.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, O yi di pala ŋun tum taali, ti naan ku tah o a sanna.
en: They answered, He is a criminal! That's why we brought him to you.

dag: Naawuni daa na ʒi n-yɛl o malaikanim ni so: Ʒinimi n nudirigu polo hal ka n ti chɛ ka a dimnim leeg a napɔntamdigu.
en: And God never said this to an angel: Sit at my right side until I put your enemies under your power. Psalm :.

dag: Ka sokam daa kpuɣ o laa m-mooi buɣim niŋ di ni, ka niŋ tulaale zim pa di zuɣu. Ka bɛ mini Musa ni Aduna daa zani Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: So each man got a pan and put burning incense in it. Then they stood at the entrance of the Meeting Tent. Moses and Aaron also stood there.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim pam bɛn mini Mariama daa doli kana la daa nya Yisa ni tum shɛm maa, ka niŋ o yɛda.
en: Many of the people who had come to visit Mary saw what Jesus did, and they believed in him.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ŋun diri ni ka bɛ ni diri shɛli yina; Ŋum mali kpiɔŋ ni ka din nyaɣisi yina. Ka di daa mali ti paai daba ata, ka bɛ na bi tooi baŋ ŋahili maa gbinni.
en: He said, Out of the eater came something to eat; Out of the strong came something sweet. Three days later they had still not figured out what the riddle meant.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ a ba Naawuni. Di zɔri dabiɛm ni a kuli Ijipti, dama n ni chɛ ka a daŋ niriba ti leei zuliya bɛn galisi pam.
en: He said, I am El, your fathers God. Dont be afraid to go down to Egypt because I will make a great nation of you there.

dag: Ka niriba maa ti labi ba kuɣa, ka zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba. Bɛ ni ti ku bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi, ka nyo bɛ yiya buɣim.
en: Let the assembly stone them! Let them carve them up with their swords, slay their sons and daughters, and burn their houses with fire!.

dag: Ka Musa daa garigi yɛli Yawɛ, M bi tooi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa, Firawuna ku bɔri ni o wum n yɛtɔɣa.
en: But Moses answered, You know I am a very poor speaker, and the king will never listen to me.

dag: Di sab Anabi Musa zaligu ni, Miri ka a zaŋ naŋgbampɔbirigu m-pɔbi naɣikɔrigu ŋun nɔri buri chi noli. Naɣikɔra zuɣu ka Naawuni yɛl lala maa?.
en: Yes, it is written in the Law of Moses: When a work animal is being used to separate grain, dont keep it from eating the grain. When God said this, was he thinking only about work animals? No.

dag: Paɣisarili mi daa yi yɛn yi paɣiba yili maa ni kpe nayili maa, o ni yɛli ni o bɔri shɛlikam, dina ka bɛ tir o ka o zaŋdi mali kpɛra.
en: When a young woman went to the king, she could wear whatever clothes or jewelry she chose from the women's living quarters.

dag: Dinzuɣu di yi nyɛla n dan ni yɛli ma chi mini alikama ni wain ni kpa shɛli yɛla la dina, zaŋmi li ti tinim bɛn nyɛ n dan tumtumdiba ŋɔ na.
en: Now, sir, you offered to give us wheat, barley, oil, and wine. Give them to my servants.

dag: ka o yɛli ba, N suhu saɣimya pam, hal di ŋmanila n yɛn kpimi. Yinim kpalimmiya kpe guhima.
en: and he said to them, My heart is so heavy with grief, I feel as if I am dying. Wait here and stay awake.

dag: N suhir a ni a niŋ suɣilo n-wum ti yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, dama ti bi bɔri ni ti chɛ ka a ʒini yuui.
en: I do not want to take up too much of your time, however, so I beg you to be kind and listen to our brief account.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Harada maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Makihilɔt.
en: They marched from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.

dag: Ka Yaakubu suhu daa yu Reechɛl ka o yɛli, N ni tum tuma yuma ayopɔin ti a, Reechɛl ŋun nyɛ a bipuɣiŋga biasani ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Jacob loved Rachel, so he said to Laban, I will work seven years for you if you will allow me to marry your daughter Rachel.

dag: Ti yi chɛ ka o niŋdi lala, sokam zaa ni niŋ o yɛda, ka Romnim kana ti saɣim ti Naawuni jɛmbu shee, ka bahi ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa yoli.
en: If we don't stop him now, everyone will put their faith in him. Then the Romans will come and destroy our temple and our nation.

dag: Nir suhu yi bɔri binshɛli ka o ka yɛm, di bi viɛla, ka nir ŋun chani yomyom ti yaɣi bahirila soli.
en: Being excited about something is not enough. You must also know what you are doing. Dont rush into something, or you might do it wrong.

dag: Ɛliashib mini Joyada ni Jɔhanan ni Jadua saha la, bɛ daa sab Lɛvinim dɔɣirikpamba mini maligumaaniba yɛla hal ti paai Pɛriʒia Naa Darius ʒiɛman ni.
en: In the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, the Levites and the priests were recorded as heads of families in the rule of Darius the Persian.

dag: Ka Sisɛra yɛl o, Ʒe dunoli maa ni. So yi ti kana ti bɔh a ni so be kpe, nyin yɛlim o ni so kani.
en: Stand at the entrance to the tent, Sisera told her. If someone comes by and asks if anyone is inside, tell them No. .

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛr a mi, a yuli m-booni Pita; tampiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu ka n yɛn me n cheechi tam hal ka kum mini di yiko ti ku tooi wurim li.
en: So I will call you Peter, which means a rock. On this rock I will build my church, and death itself will not have any power over it.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sabi luɣ shɛli polo shɛm la: Nyin gɔgbihira, yiɣisima n-neei kum ni! Ka Masia ti a neesim.
en: Everything that is revealed by the light is light. Therefore, it says, Wake up, sleeper! Get up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you. .

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ti Duuma NAAWUNI na ʒi n-niŋ shɛli ka bi kahigi li wuh o daba bɛn nyɛ o daanabinima.
en: When the Lord GOD decides to do something, he will first tell his servants, the prophets.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ma, Dimbɔŋɔnim maa nyɛla din ʒe pɔhima anahi din yi Yawɛ ŋun su dunia ŋɔ zaa la sanna zaani.
en: He answered, These are the four winds; they have just come from the presence of the Lord of all the earth.

dag: Zaŋmiya gali sabilifaa n-she biŋgolinsi niŋ tuuli pateesa la naŋgbambili, ka lan niŋ pateesa shɛli din pah ayi naŋgbambili gba lala.
en: Use blue cloth to make loops along the edge of the end curtain in one group. Do the same on the end curtain in the other group.

dag: Jɔshua ni daa ti kurigi saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ yɛl o, A kurigiya pam pumpɔŋɔ, amaa ka tiŋgban shɛli yi ni na yɛn deei mi na galisi pam.
en: Now Joshua had reached old age. The LORD said to him, You have reached old age, but much of the land remains to be taken over.

dag: Yi mi ni Masia daa kana ni o ti kpihimla ninsalinim daalahichi, ka alahichi ka o ni.
en: You know that he appeared to take away sins, and there is no sin in him.

dag: Di simdi ni ti ŋme goonje mini mɔɣilo paɣ a, ka ŋme biɛɣu paɣ a.
en: It is good to play for you on the ten-stringed instrument and lyre and to add the soft sounds of the harp to my praise.

dag: Ka Shimɛi daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ gali pa o buŋa n-chaŋ Gaat naa Akishi sani ni o ti bo o daba maa shee. Ka o daa shiri bo n-nya ba n-zaŋ ba lab yiŋ na.
en: so he saddled his donkey and went to King Achish at Gath to find them. He found them there and brought them back home.

dag: N kul ku tam yi yɛla. Nyama, n pun sab yi yuli niŋ n nutaya ni.
en: A picture of your city is drawn on my hand. You are always in my thoughts!.

dag: N ni yɛli Yawɛ zaligu yɛla. O yɛli ma, A nyɛla m bia; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka n dɔɣ a.
en: Let me tell you about the Lord s agreement: He said to me, Today I have become your father, and you are my son.

dag: Di chaŋya ti tuhi Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ yi mabihi maa. Labimiya kuli, n sani ka din niŋ maa yina. Ka bɛ daa wum Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa ka lab kuli kaman Yawɛ ni daa shiri yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: Don't go to war against the people from Israel—they are your relatives. Go home! I am the Lord , and I made these things happen. Rehoboam and his army obeyed the Lord and went home.

dag: amaa saha kanna, hal di paaya gba, ka Naawuni jɛmdi maŋa ni ti jɛm ti Ba Naawuni ni bɛ shihi zaa ni yɛlimaŋli, dama bɛ tatabo ka ti Ba Naawuni bɔri ni bɛ jɛmd o.
en: But the time is coming—and is here!—when true worshippers will worship in spirit and truth. The Father looks for those who worship him this way.

dag: Bɛ ti yɛn zahindila kom kɔpu buyi tir a ka a nyura. A ni ti nyuri li la bɛ ni zal a ni a nyu li saha shɛli.
en: You will also have a limited amount of water to drink, two cups a day.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a ni ti zaŋ ba zali luɣ shɛli din sarigiri shee n-chɛ ka bɛ sarigi lu m-bahi yoli.
en: You will put them in slippery places and make them fall to destruction!.

dag: Yi daa bɔrigimi kaman piɛr la, amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yipa ŋmaligi labila yi Piɛgula ŋun nyɛ ŋun gbibi ya la sanna.
en: You were like sheep that went the wrong way. But now you have come back to the Shepherd and Protector of your lives.

dag: Ka bɛ daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba n-chani zoya din du pam zuɣu tinsi ni ka yɛra, Tinima m-be kpe ŋɔ, ti ni kuli Yawɛ ni lo ti alikauli ni ti kuli tin shɛl maa ni, ti tum alahichi.
en: They rose early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain range, saying, Lets go up to the place the LORD told us to, for we have sinned.

dag: Ka bɛn daa guli kuruchunim maa nya din niŋ maa, ka zo n-chaŋ ti yɛli fɔnnim mini tiŋkpannima dinkam daa niŋ maa zaa.
en: When those who tended the pigs saw what happened, they ran away and told the story in the city and in the countryside.

dag: Wummi nyaɣisim a ni yuri paɣ so sani a ni mali nyɛvili shɛli din ka buchi dunia puuni ŋɔ, dama dina n-nyɛ a biɛhigu min a dunia ŋɔ ni tuma wahala tarili.
en: Enjoy life with your dearly loved spouse all the days of your pointless life that God gives you under the sun—all the days of your pointless life!—because thats your part to play in this life and in your hard work under the sun.

dag: Ka niriba daa ti sɔɣi ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni o zuɣu salo maa ni: Shɛb daa yɛrimi, O nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ. Ka shɛb mi yɛra, Aai! O nyɛla ŋun birigiri niriba.
en: The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, Jesus is a good man, while others were saying, He is lying to everyone.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat ni daa di nam n-su Judanim shɛm m-bala. O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam, o daa dila nam maa yuun pisinaanu Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Azuba, o daa nyɛla Shilihi bipuɣiŋga.
en: Jehoshaphat had become king of Judah at the age of thirty-five and had ruled in Jerusalem for twenty-five years. His mother was Azubah, the daughter of Shilhi.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa zaa ni bɛ doo kam mini paɣ kam suhim o ʒiʒiinikpee anzinfa mini salima nɛma.
en: Tell every man to ask his neighbor and every woman to ask her neighbor for all their silver and gold jewelry.

dag: Amaa Jɔnatan ŋun daa bi wum o ba ni po pɔri yɛli niriba maa shɛm maa, dinzuɣu ka o daa zaŋ jaaŋgbee din be o nuu ni tu shigbaŋ maa n-zaŋ o nuu nyɛhi li ti kpar o nol ni, ka o nini neei zaa.
en: But Jonathan hadnt heard his father make the people swear the pledge, so he dipped the end of the staff he was carrying into the honeycomb. When he ate some his eyes lit up.

dag: bee zilisigu yi kpe doo suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ o paɣ polo zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: o ni zaŋ paɣ maa ti zali Yawɛ tooni, ka maligumaana karim zaligu maa yɛla zaa bahi paɣ maa zuɣu.
en: or when jealousy overcomes a man and he is jealous of his wife. The priest will make the woman stand before the LORD and will follow all these instructions concerning her.

dag: Di saha ka n daa tɛhi n ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa yɛla ni n ni daa kpaŋ mmaŋ shɛm niŋ li, ka di zaa kul nyɛla din ka buchi. Di ŋmanila nir yi zɔri doli pɔhim, ka binshɛli ka dunia ŋɔ ni mali buchi.
en: Then I thought about all that I had done and how hard I had worked doing it, and I realized that it didn't mean a thing. It was like chasing the wind—of no use at all.

dag: Ka pirigili shɛli din daa nyɛ tɔbbihi bɛn chaŋ tɔb maa ni tarili la piɛri mini buhi kalinli daa nyɛla tuhi kɔbisita ni tuhi pihitanaayopɔin ni kɔbisinu.
en: The soldiers who went to war got , sheep.

dag: Ŋmɛmiya dawule paɣ o. Ŋmɛmiya dawule pampam paɣ o.
en: Praise God with cymbals, with clashing cymbals.

dag: Yawɛ jilima maa daa dolila wulimpuhili polo dunɔdali kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni.
en: and the Lord 's glory came through the east gate and into the temple.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Maligumaaniba maa daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa kpɛhi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni ha Luɣ Kasi shee la nti zali di zaashee chɛrubinim kpiŋkpama lɔŋni.
en: Then the priests carried the Covenant Box into the Temple and put it in the Most Holy Place, beneath the winged creatures.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaana Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas mini Izraɛlnim daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpamba maa daa yi Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba maa sani Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-zaŋ bɛ zilinkom lab Izraɛlnim maa sani Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti yɛli ba.
en: Then Phinehas and the leaders left the people of Reuben and Gad in the land of Gilead and went back to Canaan, to the people of Israel, and reported to them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti zaŋ kpar ʒiɛɣu yɛl o, ka wuɣ gɔhi zuɣupiligu pil o;.
en: They dressed him up in a purple robe and twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on him.

dag: Maligumaaniba zuɣulan kam nyɛla Naawuni ni zali so ni o zaŋdi pina mini sara maani maligu ŋun Naawuni sani; lala zuɣu di simdi ni ti maligumaana ŋɔ gba mali shɛli din ni zaŋ mali maligu.
en: Since all priests must offer gifts and sacrifices, Christ also needed to have something to offer.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: Then the word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: Ka Aduna yi ti kana ni o ti malimali firilanim maa asiba kam, ŋun tuɣilim tulaale zim din nyom viɛl sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Aaron will burn sweet-smelling incense on the incense altar every morning when he takes care of the lamps.

dag: amaa ka yipa kahigi wuhi palɔni pumpɔŋɔ la. Yɛlimaŋli maa kahigi wuhila palɔni pumpɔŋɔ anabinim sabbu puuni, ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ saha din ka bahigu lan ŋɔ chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa baŋ li ni di chɛ ka niriba niŋ yɛda ka deeg o noli.
en: but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith.

dag: Di maliya karimbaani ti yaɣi bee n-tɔɣisiri kapirichi yɛtɔɣa.
en: Stop bragging! Quit telling me how great you are.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi mali yi yaa nyuri bara? Yinim bɛn bi ʒe yim ŋɔ, yi yaa naarimi maa. Yi niŋ yi daazichi naani ka yɛra, Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi liri ti.
en: You brag about your strength, but you are losing your strength. You trust in your wealth to save you. You think no one would even think of attacking you.

dag: O daa chɛ ka poloya waɣi pam bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kpe m-pali bɛ nanim dugbɛra ni.
en: Frogs were everywhere, even in the royal palace.

dag: Bɛ daa niŋ naani, ka naani goo ti kuhi ba. Ka bɛ daa ti paai, ka bɛ laasabu parigi.
en: They are ashamed that they trusted; they arrive and are dismayed.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ li ka maligumaana sanna, ka maligumaana maa ti too li nukurigu pali n-yihi di chihili maa n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ la zuɣu; di nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me.

dag: N ni labi laŋ pil o gbaag o n-zaŋ o chaŋ Babilɔn ti kar o saria nimaani, o ni taai duŋ niŋ ma la zuɣu.
en: I will spread out a net to trap him. Then I will drag him to Babylon and see that he is punished for his unfaithfulness to me.

dag: O daa lan bɔhi, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a nya bimburiginli a mabia ninni, ka daantaliga lee sa amaŋmaŋ ninni ka a bi nya li?.
en: Why do you look at the speck in your brother's eye, but pay no attention to the log in your own eye?.

dag: Amaa a nyɛla ŋun tum tuun suma, dama a daa wurim Ashɛra ŋmahima zaa tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka zaŋ a suhu zaa niŋla Naawuni jɛmbu ni.
en: Nevertheless, there is some good to be found in you, in that you have removed the sacred poles from the land and set your mind to seek God.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim polo m-bɔŋɔ: Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ka ti daadam nyɛvil la yɛliya.
en: This is a message about Israel from the Lord , the Lord who spread out the skies, created the earth, and gave life to man. He says.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti lan dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Shɛla. Chɛzib ka o daa be ka dɔɣ o.
en: Then she gave birth to one more son and named him Shelah. She was in Chezib when she gave birth to him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa lan yi o nyaandoliba maa zuɣu Taibɛrias Teeku ni. O ni daa yi bɛ zuɣu shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Later, Jesus appeared again to his followers by Lake Galilee. This is how it happened:.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa nyɛ Amɔrinim mini Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinim bɛn daa pa Izraɛlnim la.
en: There were people left in the land who were not Israelites. There were Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

dag: Dama o ni na pɔri maa zuɣu ninvuɣ shɛba n-ni yuun o, ka maan o yɛla tir o hal ti paag o ba ni zali dabisi shɛli dali.
en: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.

dag: Ka bɛ bihi bɛn na bi mi li ni wum li, ka bɔhim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura lubu saha shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn be tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni yɛn gbaai Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili du nti deei li su la ni.
en: In this way your descendants who have never heard the Law of the Lord your God will hear it. And so they will learn to obey him as long as they live in the land that you are about to occupy across the Jordan.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya niriba daa bi kari Keenannim bɛn be Gɛza, ka Keenannim maa daa kpalim be nimaani pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Ephraim tribe did not get rid of the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, so the Canaanites lived there with Israelites all around them.

dag: Hal jɛra bɛn fo n-ʒiya, bɛ ni boli ba yɛnnima, bɛ yi bi yaai bɛ noya bɛ ni kali ba pahi yɛnnima ni.
en: After all, even fools may be thought wise and intelligent if they stay quiet and keep their mouths shut.

dag: Ŋunkam zaɣisi ni o ku niŋ o zo nirilim, zaŋla Kpiɔŋlan Naa zɔbu bahi.
en: Friends should be loyal to you in times of trouble, even if you turn away from God All-Powerful.

dag: Naawuni, kabisim bɛ nyina; Yawɛ, kabisim gbuɣim pola maa nyin wɔɣila la.
en: God, break their teeth out of their mouths! Tear out the lions jawbones, LORD!.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa zaŋ o nudirigu gbaai Ifriim n-zaŋ o zali tuhi Izraɛl nuzaa, ka zaŋ o nuzaa gbaai Manaasa n-zaŋ o mi zali tuhi Izraɛl nudirigu n-zaŋ ba na ti chɛ ka bɛ damd o tooni.
en: Joseph put Ephraim on his right side and Manasseh on his left side.

dag: Ka ŋun Musa daa zaŋ o nuhi pa Jɔshua zuɣu n-zaŋ o leei toondana kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o ni o niŋ shɛm.
en: Then Moses put his hands on him to show that he was the new leader. He did this just as the Lord told him to.

dag: O yi daa tum a taali bee n-di a samli, nyin chɛ ka di dolila mani.
en: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.

dag: ni Ɛnrimɔn ni Zɔra ni Jarimut.
en: Enrimmon, Zorah, Jarmuth.

dag: Yɛlim yɛm, N tizɔpaɣa n-nyɛ a. Ka boli tɛhi zilima mi N zɔsimo.
en: Say to wisdom, You are my sister; call understanding friend.

dag: Dama Daadam Bia min o malaikanim yi ti labina o Ba Naawuni jilima ni, o ni ti ti sokam bɛ tuma laara.
en: The Son of Man will come again with his Fathers glory and with his angels. And he will reward everyone for what they have done.

dag: ni yi ni ti tiligi m ba mini m ma ni m mabihi ni bɛ ni su shɛb zaa, ka fa ti nyɛviya kum ni bahi.
en: Tell me that you will allow my family to live—my father, mother, brothers, sisters, and all their families. Promise me that you will save us from death.

dag: Ibrahimma mam ŋun yuli daa booni Kɛtuura la ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛba n-daa nyɛ: Zimiran mini Jokishan ni Mɛdan ni Midian ni Ishibak ni Shua. Jokishan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shiiba mini Dɛdan.
en: Abraham had a concubine named Keturah, who bore him six sons: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. Jokshan had two sons: Sheba and Dedan.

dag: Ka Musa daa kpalim be Yawɛ sani wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣu pihinahi, o daa bi di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom. Ka o daa sabi alikauli maa yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ fukumsi zaligunim pia la pa bimparilana ayi maa zuɣu.
en: Moses stayed there with the Lord forty days and nights, eating and drinking nothing. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant—the Ten Commandments.

dag: O ni daa be suhusaɣiŋgu ni pam zuɣu ka o daa suhuri Naawuni ni nimmoo hal ka o niŋgbuŋ ni woligu ti tɔɣiri luri tiŋa kaman ʒim la.
en: In great anguish he prayed even more fervently; his sweat was like drops of blood falling to the ground.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n fabindi Mɔabnim mini Kirihɛrɛsinim zuɣu kaman kalambua ka bɛ piɛbiri la, dama bɛ ni daa nya bun shɛli zaa la naaya.
en: In my heart I moan for Moab, like a funeral song played on a flute. I mourn for the people of the town of Kir-Heres, because their wealth is gone. *.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa chaŋ Sool sani nti nya ka dabiɛm gbaai Sool pam ka o yɛl o, Nyama, mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ niŋ a ni yɛli ma ni n niŋ shɛli maa, m mi zaŋla n nyɛvili pa talima, ka niŋ a ni yɛli ma ni n niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The woman came over to Saul, and when she saw that he was completely terrified, she said, Your Majesty, I listened to you and risked my life to do what you asked.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ di gba mini di naa niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku niriba bɛn zaa be di ni, ka so daa bi kpalim; ka daa niŋ di naa kaman o ni daa niŋ Jɛriko naa shɛm la.
en: The LORD also gave it and its king into the power of Israel. With a sword, he struck it and everyone in it without mercy. He left no survivors in it. He did to its king exactly as he had done to the king of Jericho.

dag: Ka tibimiya barinima, ka neemiya kpiimba, ka chɛliya ka kɔnsi kpaŋda, ka karimiya alizin biɛri bahira. Yi dee li la yoli, yi gba timiya li yoli.
en: Heal the sick, raise the dead to life, heal people who have leprosy, and force out demons. You received without paying, now give without being paid.

dag: Ka bɛn yɛn ti bɛ suɣa pa bɛ zuɣu n-nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya. Simiɔn niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Zurishadai bia Shɛlumiɛl.
en: Those camping on one side of him are the tribe of Simeon. The chief of the people of Simeon is Shelumiel, Zurishaddais son.

dag: Bɛ tiɣila barina pua ka ni dɔɣi zaɣ biɛɣu, ka bɛ suhuri mali ʒiri ŋmabu shili.
en: These are the ones who plan trouble and do evil; their hearts are always full of deceit.

dag: Di daba anahi dali ka bɛ daa daŋ yibu asibaasi m-mali shili ni bɛ kuli, amaa ka paɣ maa ba maa yɛl o deemba maa, Ʒinimi suug a noli n-nya kpiɔŋ ka naanyi chaŋ.
en: On the morning of the fourth day they woke up early and got ready to go. But the woman's father said to the Levite, Have something to eat first. You'll feel better. You can go later.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛli, M bia maa ku doli ya chaŋ, dama o biɛli kpiya, ka o kɔŋko n-kpalim. Shɛli yi niŋ o yi ni yɛn chaŋ chandi shɛli ŋɔ ni, yi ni chɛ ka n dɔni kabiri puuni ni n kɔb piɛla ŋɔ ni suhugarigu.
en: But Jacob said to him, My son wont go down with you because his brothers dead and hes been left all alone. If anything were to happen to him on the trip you are taking, you would send me—old as I am—to my grave in grief.

dag: Di ni simdi ni yi yɛli shɛm nyɛla: Ti Duuma yi saɣi, ti ni be ka niŋ dimbɔŋɔ bee dini ŋɔ.
en: What you should say is this: If the Lord is willing, we will live and do this or that.

dag: Ka ŋun daa deei pɔŋ tusaanu la zaŋ pɔŋ tusaanu pahi di zuɣu na ti yɛl o yiŋlan maa, N dana, pɔŋ tusaanu ka a daa zaŋ ti ma, ka n nya pɔŋ tusaanu nyɔri pahi di zuɣu.
en: The one who had received five valuable coins came forward with five additional coins. He said, Master, you gave me five valuable coins. Look, Ive gained five more.

dag: Jɛhu daa dila Izraɛl nam maa ʒini Samaria yuun pihitaayika.
en: Jehu had ruled Israel years from Samaria.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛl o niriba maa, N ni tin ya chi mini wain ni kpam, ka yi tiɣi; ka chɛ ka zuliya shɛb ku tooi lan mali ya ansarisi yaha.
en: In answer to their prayers he said, I will give you enough grain, wine, and olive oil to satisfy your needs. No longer will I let you be insulted by the nations.

dag: Di yuma ayi nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa ti yɛn chɛ o piɛri kɔbiri Baalihazɔr din mini Ifriim bi wɔɣ ni tab la, ka daa boli nabihi zaa ni bɛ kana.
en: Two years later, Absalom's servants were cutting wool from his sheep in Baal-Hazor near the town of Ephraim, and Absalom invited all of the king's sons to be there.

dag: N yi baŋ a wuntia zaligunim maa, n ni paɣ a ni suhu yini.
en: As I learn your righteous judgments, I will praise you with a pure heart.

dag: N nyaya ka sokam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa dolila nachimbil so ŋun di nam zani naa zaani.
en: I saw all who live and walk under the sun following the next youth who would rise to take his place.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ wuhi Filistia tɔbbihi maa, ka Filistianim maa daa yɛli, Nyamiya, Hiburunim la yiri bɛ ni sɔɣi bɛmaŋ vo shɛŋa la ni na.
en: So they showed themselves to the Philistine fort, and the Philistines said, Look, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes theyve been hiding in.

dag: Dama ŋun yɛli, Miri ka a niŋ zina la n-nyɛ ŋun lan yɛli, Miri ka a ku ninsal la. Ka a yi bi niŋ zina, amaa ka lee ku ninsala, dindina a leei Naawuni zaligusaɣinda m-bala.
en: For the same one who said, Do not commit adultery, also said, Do not commit murder. Even if you do not commit adultery, you have become a lawbreaker if you commit murder.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chɛbisi salo maa, ka kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Magadan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: After Jesus had sent the crowds away, he got into a boat and sailed across the lake. He came to shore near the town of Magadan.

dag: Amaa ka a mi daa pun yɛli ma, N ni niŋ a zaɣ viɛlli, ka chɛ ka a zuliya ti be kaman mɔɣ bihigu la, ka so ku tooi kali ba. .
en: Lord, you said to me, I will be good to you. I will increase your family and make your children as many as the sands of the sea. There will be too many to count.

dag: Bɛ ni ti wurim Mɔab, ka di niriba ku lan beni, bɛ ni duhi bɛmaŋ ti yaɣi Yawɛ san la zuɣu.
en: Moab will be destroyed and will no longer be a nation, because it rebelled against me.

dag: Lala maa ni chɛ ka n suhuyiɣisili zani tariga zaŋ chaŋ a polo, ka n ŋmaligi n nyuli zabbu ka chɛ a, ka fo, ka n suhu ku lan yiɣisi.
en: Then I will stop being angry and jealous. I will calm down. I will not be angry anymore.

dag: Dunia shiri ni ti dahimdahim doya, ka bɛ ʒe di zaa. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The earth will lie shattered and ruined. The Lord has spoken and it will be done.

dag: Ka Reechɛl daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ka yɛli, Naawuni yihi ma vi ni.
en: She became pregnant and gave birth to a son and said, God has taken away my shame.

dag: Naa Darius daa pii kpambaliba kɔbiga ni pisi zal o tiŋgbɔŋ ni tuma zaashɛhi ni.
en: Darius thought it would be a good idea to choose satraps to rule throughout his kingdom.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Yi bi nya din niŋdi ya maa?.
en: So now, this is what the LORD of heavenly forces says: Take your ways to heart.

dag: Wulinluhili polo tintariga yɛn nyɛla Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku duli. Yi wulinluhili polo tintariga n-yɛn bala.
en: Your western border will be the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Dina n-ni ti chɛ ka yi niŋ n shɛhiranima.
en: But this will be your chance to tell about your faith.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn paɣir a dabisi muni puuni zaa; ka nyɛ bɛn tibigir a wuntitali.
en: Because of you they rejoice all day long, and they praise you for your goodness.

dag: Keenan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Sidɔn ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Hɛt.
en: Canaan's sons—Sidon, the oldest, and Heth—were the ancestors of the peoples who bear their names.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa boli maligumaaniba Zadok mini Abiata m-pahi Lɛvi zuliya ni niriba bɛn nyɛ: Uriɛl mini Asaaya ni Joɛl ni Shɛmaya ni Ɛliɛl ni Aminadab na.
en: David called in the priests Zadok and Abiathar and the six Levites, Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.

dag: O ni daa na kul yɛri lala saha shɛli maa, ka Jɔnatan, ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana Abiata bia la dii paana. Ka Adɔnija yɛl o, Kpɛmina, dama a nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ, ka ʒiri lahiba suŋ na.
en: While Joab was still speaking, Jonathan, son of Abiathar the priest, arrived. Adonijah said, Come here! You are a good man, so you must be bringing good news.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o pa yuri zuɣu n-ʒi o kuli Jɛrusalɛm nti zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni.
en: The people brought Amaziahs body back on horses. He was buried at Jerusalem with his ancestors in the City of David.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ dunia ŋɔ zaa naa; Yilimiya yila paɣ o!.
en: because God is king of the whole world! Sing praises with a song of instruction!.

dag: ni bɛ ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun ti yɛn kana la bee ti na yulim dilan soli.
en: to ask Jesus, Are you the one we should be looking for? Or must we wait for someone else.

dag: Shimiat bia Jɔzaka mini Shoma bia Jɛhɔzabad bɛn daa nyɛ o kpambaliba la n-daa ŋme o luhi, ka o kpi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o ti sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni. Ka o bia Amazia daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer were Joashs officers. These men killed Joash. The people buried Joash with his ancestors in the City of David. His son Amaziah became the new king after him.

dag: Ka o ba maa yi ka mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba, yin zaŋmiya o fali maa ti o dɔɣir so ŋun nyɛ o talahi nira o daŋ ni, ka o su li. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu Izraɛlnim sani kaman Yawɛ ni zali Musa shɛm.
en: And if his father has no brothers, the land must be given to his nearest relative in the clan. This is my law, and the Israelites must obey it.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi zaɣisi ma, yi lɛbila yi nyaansi biri ma, dinzuɣu ka n teegi n nuu m-bahi ya yoli. N niŋla suɣilo hal ka n nyee ti nyɔni.
en: My people, you abandoned me and walked away. I am tired of showing mercy; that's why I'll destroy you.

dag: bee gurugulana bee diɣili bee do so ŋun nina bi ne viɛnyɛla bee ŋun mali dɔr shɛli din zaɣisiri niŋgbuŋ ni bee ŋun mali yu kaɣima bee bɛ ni yihi do so lana.
en: anyone who is a hunchback or too small; anyone who has an eye disease, a rash, scabs, or a crushed testicle.

dag: Bakɔi piligu dali maa zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣim be du shɛl ni ka kpari di dunoya, dama bɛ daa zɔrila Yɛhudianima. Ka Yisa ti puhi zani bɛ sunsuuni na ka yɛli ba, Naawuni tim ya suhudoo.
en: It was still the first day of the week. That evening, while the disciples were behind closed doors because they were afraid of the Jewish authorities, Jesus came and stood among them. He said, Peace be with you.

dag: Ka anabi Aizaia daa ka Naa Hɛzɛkia sanna nti bɔh o, Ya ka niriba ŋɔ lee yina, ka wula ka bɛ lee yɛl a? Ka Hɛzɛkia garigi yɛl o, Bɛ yila katiŋ na; Babilɔn ka bɛ yina.
en: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah and asked him, What did these men say? Where did they come from? Hezekiah said, These men came from a faraway country, from Babylon.

dag: Jɛhoyakin yuma daa nyɛla yuma anii saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la chira ata ni biɛɣu pia. O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani.
en: Jehoiachin was years old when he became king of Judah. He was king in Jerusalem for three months and ten days. He did not obey God. He did what the Lord considered evil.

dag: Ŋunkam bi doli zaligu ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: The Levites will say, Cursed is the one who does not support this law and agree to obey it. Then all the people will say, Amen.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Keen, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi, ka a zuŋ a ninni?.
en: The Lord asked Cain, Why are you angry? Why does your face look sad?.

dag: Dama di simdi ni yɛm yɛtɔɣa yiri maligumaana nol ni na, ka niriba ni bɔr o wuhibu, dama o nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ tumo.
en: You priests should be eager to spread knowledge, and everyone should come to you for instruction, because you speak for me, the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Ka di daa gari bɛnkam daa yi mi a. A bahigu maa nyɛla din bie pam, ka a ku lan beni yaha. .
en: All the people in other nations were shocked about what happened to you. What happened to you will make people very afraid. You are finished.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ labimi kuli ni suhudoo, ka miri ka a chɛ ka Filistia nanim suhuri ti miligi a zuɣu.
en: So go back home now, and go in peace. Dont do anything to upset the Philistine rulers.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa taɣ o tɛha ka yɛli, N ku chɛ ka lala niŋ.
en: The Lord changed his mind and said, What you saw will not take place.

dag: Amaa o daa lee bi wurimla luɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa la; ka niriba daa na kul chani nimaani nti maani maligu, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim. Jɔtam n-nyɛ ŋun daa me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zuɣusaa polo dunol la.
en: It was Jotham who rebuilt the Upper Gate that led into the court around the Lord 's temple. But the local shrines were not destroyed, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.

dag: Dinzuɣu kahigimiya yi daalahichi wuhimi taba, ka suhimiya Naawuni tiri taba, ka di chɛ ka yi nya alaafee. Wuntizɔra nimmoo wunsuhigu mali yiko pam di tuma puuni.
en: For this reason, confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of the righteous person is powerful in what it can achieve.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi yi di nyɛla zoomba, yi naan ku mali taali, amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yɛliya ni yi nyara, dinzuɣu yi taali kpalim ʒi yi zuɣu.
en: Jesus said, If you were really blind, you would not be guilty of sin. But you say that you see, so you are still guilty.

dag: Dabiɛm gbaai ma, n jilima zoya kaman pɔhim n-ʒe li chaŋ la, ka n tɔŋsim zo kaman sagbani n-fuɣi gari la.
en: I am shaking with fear. They chased my honor away like dust in the wind. My safety disappears like a cloud.

dag: Yi galim ma yimyim bupia zuɣu, yi ni miligi n suhu shɛm maa vi bi mali ya?.
en: Isn't ten times enough for you to accuse me? Aren't you ashamed?.

dag: di saha maa bɛn ti be Judia, bɛn zom ti du zoya.
en: Then those who are in Judea must run away to the hills.

dag: Amaa zuŋɔ yi zaɣisi yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya azaaba mini muɣisigu ni maa. Ka yɛli, Aai! Bom naa ti ti. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yi zuliya kam laɣimmi tab gbilligbilli ka Yawɛ sanna.
en: I am your God, the one who rescues you from all your troubles and difficulties, but today you have rejected me and have asked me to give you a king. Very well, then, gather yourselves before the Lord by tribes and by clans.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abigeel, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun tim a na ka a ti tuhi ma soli ŋɔ mali alibarika!.
en: David told her: I praise the Lord God of Israel! He must have sent you to meet me today.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ tarimba ŋmanila nyee ni pɔhim, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira mi ka buchi. Nir yi zaŋ ba pa sania zuɣu, bɛ tibisim bi yaɣ lala; hal bɛ zaa tibisim yi laɣim, di bi paai nyee ni pɔhim tibisim gba.
en: People cannot really help. You cannot depend on them. Compared to God, they are nothing— no more than a gentle puff of air!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan zaŋ o yɛligu ti Hagai m-pahi buyi kulla gol yino maa biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali n-yɛl o.
en: That same day the Lord spoke to Haggai again and said:.

dag: Yi ni sokam lum o ma min o ba sizuura, ka gbibiya n vuhim dabisa la. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.

dag: Nadab ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum tuun shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: The rest of Nadabs deeds and all that he did, arent they written in the official records of Israels kings?.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa yɛli, Ŋun be tooni zɔrina maa ŋmanila Zadok bia Ahimaaz. Ka naa daa yɛli, O nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ, dinzuɣu lahibali suŋ ka o ʒirina maa.
en: The watchman said, I can see that the first one runs like Zadoks son Ahimaaz. Hes a good man, the king said, and is coming with good news.

dag: Di gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: MENE gbinni nyɛla Naawuni pun kali a nam dabisa m-paai di tariga.
en: This is the meaning of the word MENE: God has numbered the days of your rule. Its over!.

dag: Anabitali yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din be naa noli ni, ka o ka alahichi saria karibu ni.
en: When a king speaks, his words are law. So when he makes a decision, it is never a mistake.

dag: Ka n yi kariti alizin biɛri Biilzibul yiko ni, ka ŋun mi yiko ni ka yi niriba lee kariti ba bahira? Dinzuɣu yimaŋmaŋ niriba maa ni zaŋ yi nol ni yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi luhi ya.
en: If this is how I drive them out, how do your followers drive them out? Your own followers prove that you are wrong!.

dag: Chɛ ka maligumaaniba bɛn miri ma na ŋɔ gba mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi, di yi pa lala, man Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Even the priests who come near to the LORD must keep themselves holy, or the LORD will break loose against them.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza nam dibu yuun pisiyinika ni gol so ŋun pahir anu biɛɣu pia dali ka naa guliba sapashin kpɛma ŋun yuli daa booni Nɛbuzaradan ka o nyɛ Babilɔn naa kpambal la daa kpe Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Jerusalem was captured during Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year as king of Babylonia. About a month later, Nebuchadnezzar's officer in charge of the guards arrived in Jerusalem. His name was Nebuzaradan.

dag: Izraɛlnim chandi maa zaa puuni, sagbani maa daa yi ti vuui ka chɛ Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa, bɛ yiɣisirimi chaŋ.
en: Whenever the cloud rose from the dwelling, the Israelites would set out on their journeys.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa bɔhi nachimbil so ŋun yɛl o li maa, Wula ka a lee niŋ baŋ ni Sool min o bia Jɔnatan lu tɔb maa ni.
en: David asked, How do you know Saul and Jonathan are dead.

dag: Ka alizin biɛɣu maa daa luhi doo maa, ka kuhi pam ka naanyi chaŋ ka chɛ o.
en: The evil spirit shook the man hard, gave a loud scream, and came out of him.

dag: O daa laɣisi m biriginsim zaa n-lo li kaman naɣikɔra dapua la. O nuhi ka o daa zaŋ lo li tabili taba n-zaŋ li pa n nyiŋgoli zuɣu, ka n yaa daa naai. N Duuma daa zaŋ ma tila n ni ku tooi zabi ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: My steps are being watched; by his hand they are tripped up. His yoke is on my neck; he makes my strength fail. My Lord has handed me over to people I cant resist.

dag: Ka o daa lu bɛ zuɣu ŋ-ŋmɛri kabiri bɛ sakpuri mini bɛ gbalipina n-daa niŋ lala ku ba pam. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ Ɛtam ti kpe m-be tampiŋ lɔŋni.
en: He struck them hard, taking their legs right out from under them. Then he traveled down and stayed in a cave in the rock at Etam.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din niŋ ti maa zuɣu ka ti lɔri alikauli ŋɔ, ka sabi li sɔŋ, ka ti zuɣulaannim mini ti Lɛvinim ni ti maligumaaniba yuya sabi pa bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa tabili alikauli gbaŋ maa zuɣu.
en: Because of all that has happened, we, the people of Israel, hereby make a solemn written agreement, and our leaders, our Levites, and our priests put their seals to it.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri biriginsim yɛtɔɣa nyɛla zana din gbahiri ba, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn yiri yɛla ni.
en: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba ka bɛ ni sɔhira, dama bɛ daa tɛhiya ni alizini ka bɛ nya maa.
en: They were terrified, thinking that they were seeing a ghost.

dag: Yawɛ, a daa nya bɛ ni tum ma taali shɛm, karimi n yɛla maa saria.
en: Lord , you have seen my trouble. Now judge my case for me.

dag: Ka bipuɣin kpɛm daa ti yɛli biasani, Ti ba kurigiya, ka dɔbba mi ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni n-ni kpuɣi ti kaman bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm dunia ŋɔ zaa ni la.
en: One day his older daughter said to her sister, Our father is old, and there are no men anywhere for us to marry.

dag: Ka Batishiiba yɛl o, Yɛlima. Ka o yɛl o, N suhir a, yɛlim Naa Sulemaana ni o zaŋm Abishag Shunɛm paɣisarili la ti ma ka n niŋ m paɣa, ka o mi ku zaɣis a ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Adonijah continued, Ask King Solomon to let me marry Abishag from Shunem—he wont refuse you.

dag: O tim o yiŋ bipuɣinsi ni bɛ chaŋ tiŋ puuni luɣ shɛŋa din du pam shee ti boli niriba.
en: She sends out her female servants; she issues an invitation from the top of the city heights.

dag: yi mi miriya ka yi tam Man Yawɛ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la yɛla. Kul miriya ka yi jɛm buɣa.
en: and remember the solemn agreement between us. I will say it again: Do not worship any god.

dag: Pa ninvuɣ shɛba n-lan beni pahi yi zuɣu, amaa yinima n-kul nyɛ ti tahima mini ti suhupiɛlli ni ti nasara dibu barinyubo shɛli ti ni ti yɛn mali ti Duuma Yisa tooni o labbuna dali.
en: After all, it is you—you, no less than others!—who are our hope, our joy, and our reason for boasting of our victory in the presence of our Lord Jesus when he comes.

dag: Yisa tuumba maa daa wuhiri shihira pam, ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa niriba sani; ka yɛdaniŋdib la zaa daa laɣim be Sulemaana Kazala ni.
en: The apostles performed many signs and wonders among the people. They would come together regularly at Solomons Porch.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ŋmaligi chani kpari Sɔdom polo, amaa ka Ibrahimma na kul ʒe Yawɛ tooni.
en: So the men turned and started walking toward Sodom while Abraham stood there before the Lord .

dag: N yura, a viɛli pam, Ka a luɣ shɛli ka galimi.
en: How beautiful you are, my love; how perfect you are!.

dag: Ka doo maa daa gbibi binshɛli din buɣisiri la o nuu ni n-kpa wulimpuhili polo nti buɣisi mita kɔbisinu tariga, ka zaŋ ma siɣi kom maa ni, ka di ziliŋ nyɛ napɔŋkpuɣila tariga.
en: With the line in his hand, the man went out toward the east. When he measured off fifteen hundred feet, he made me cross the water; it was ankle-deep.

dag: Bɛ kul tuhirila bɛ karimbaan yɛtɔɣa bahira, tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa kul nyurila bara.
en: How much longer will criminals be proud and boast about their crimes?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ mi deei yi daalikauli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni yi nyɛla omaŋmaŋ niriba kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli ni di simdi ni yi dol o zaligunim la.
en: Since you have agreed to obey the Lord , he has agreed that you will be his people and that you will belong to him, just as he promised.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa ŋmaligi nimaani chaŋ ti nya Shafat bia Ilaisha maa ka o malila naɣikɔra siɣimsiɣim bupinaayi zuɣu ka bɛ be o tooni kɔra; omaŋmaŋ n-daa mali bɛn pahiri bupinaayi maa kɔra. Ka Ilaija daa chaŋ ti gar o sani ka pirig o binyɛrigu pa o zuɣu.
en: So Elijah left that place and went to find Elisha son of Shaphat. Elisha was plowing acres of land and was working on the last acre when Elijah came. Elijah went to Elisha and put his coat on Elisha.

dag: Sool ni daa ŋmaligi Samuɛl sani ni o chaŋ, ka Naawuni taɣ o suhu. Ka shihira ŋɔ zaa daa niŋ pali dindali maa.
en: When Saul turned to leave Samuel, God gave Saul a new nature. And everything Samuel had told him happened that day.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ya, Yi paai Amɔrinim zoya ni tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ti ti la ni.
en: and I told you, We have reached the hill country. It belongs to the Amorites now, but the Lord our God is giving it to us. He is the same God our ancestors worshiped, and he has told us to go in and take this land, so don't hesitate and be afraid.

dag: ka o daa ku doo kam ŋun be Ɛdom ;.
en: Joab and all the Israelites stayed there six months, until he had finished off every male in Edom.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛli Jɔshua.
en: After this, the angel encouraged Joshua by telling him that the Lord All-Powerful had promised:.

dag: Di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa niŋ a naani di vi; amaa chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn taari duŋ niŋd a ka di ka daliri la n-di vi.
en: Don't disappoint any of your worshipers, but disappoint all deceitful liars.

dag: Lɛvinima n-daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu. Bɛ ni ŋun daa daŋ mali me m-pan o zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Bani bia Rɛhum. Ka Hashabia ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛila yaɣili pirigili polo naa la daa mali me n-ti o yaɣili polɔnima.
en: The Levites who worked on the next sections of the wall were Rehum son of Bani; Hashabiah, who ruled half of the district of Keilah and did this work for his district;.

dag: Bɛ yi duɣi nimdi maa, Maligumaana ŋun yihim piɛ bɔɣu, ka pii maha din ka dabindi la zaɣ yini piɛɣu ni, ka pii karikaasi din ka dabindi la zaɣ yini n-zaŋ li niŋ Nazari nir maa nuhi ni o ni zaŋ o zuɣu shɛli ti Naawuni maa zabiri pinibu nyaaŋa.
en: The priest will take the shoulder from the ram after it is boiled, one piece of unleavened bread from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and place them in the hands of the nazirite after the ordained head is shaved.

dag: Ka Judas mini Silas bɛn daa nyɛ bɛn mal anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu pini la daa lan tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa pam kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri pahi.
en: Judas and Silas were prophets, and they said many things that encouraged and strengthened the brothers and sisters.

dag: bee ŋ-ŋmahindi binneen so ŋun gbamdi tiŋgbani zuɣu bee ŋ-ŋmahindi zahim bɛn be kom ni tiŋgbani puuni ŋɔ.
en: reptiles, or fish.

dag: Bɛ zuliya maa ni daŋ kam ni dɔbba bɛn daa naan tooi chaŋ tɔb ni kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisi ni kɔbisiyi.
en: As listed in their family records by generation, as heads of their households, mighty warriors, there were .

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu ka o yɛli, Niriba ŋɔ ni saɣim alikauli shɛli n ni daa lo bɛ yaannima, ka zaɣisi n nol la zuɣu.
en: Then the Lord would become furious with Israel and say, This nation has broken the covenant that I commanded their ancestors to keep. Because they have not obeyed me.

dag: Amaa ka n niriba bɛn tam n yɛla, ka mali binyara nyɔri buɣim maani sara tiri binshɛŋa din nyɛ ʒiri binyara. Bɛ tuui bɛ so shɛli din nyɛ so kurili maa zuɣu, ka taɣi doli so kpansi, din pa so lɔɣu.
en: Yet my people have forgotten me; they burn incense to idols. They have stumbled in the way they should go; they no longer follow the old ways; they walk on unmarked paths.

dag: N Duuma, a mi n suhu ni ye shɛli zuɣu zaa, a mi n siɣimbu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: O Lord, you know what I long for; you hear all my groans.

dag: Amaa ka Yaakubu daa kuli Sukɔt nti me o yili ka ti o biŋkɔbiri suɣa zali. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Sukɔt.
en: But Jacob went to Succoth. There he built a house for himself and small barns for his cattle. That is why the place was named Succoth.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa ni daa nya lala maa, ka bɛ teei dɔni n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa ka yɛra, Yawɛ n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni, Yawɛ n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni.
en: When the people saw this, they threw themselves on the ground and exclaimed, The Lord is God; the Lord alone is God.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa garigi yɛl o, Naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili!.
en: Then Daniel answered the king: Long live the king!.

dag: Di simdi ni yi ti zaŋla kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni bi kpe m-me sara maligu bimbini maa ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la di zuɣu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: You must not use cut stones to build the altar for the Lord your God. Offer burnt offerings on this altar to the Lord your God.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka yi kalinli ti ku lan galisi Yawɛ ni yɛn kari ya bahi zuliya shɛb ni maa.
en: The LORD will scatter you among the nations. Only a very few of you will survive in the countries where the LORD will drag you.

dag: Chɛ ka a min a ʒiʒiinikpee ʒini m-mali yi yɛtɔɣa, ka miri ka a zaŋ so daashili yɛla moli;.
en: Argue it out with your neighbor, and dont give away someones secret.

dag: Naawuni daa kahigi ashili nia shɛl o ni daa lo la wuhi ma. M pun sab di yɛla biɛla gbaŋ ŋɔ ni tin ya.
en: God revealed his secret plan and made it known to me. I have written briefly about this.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaija daa yɛli Ɛhab, Cham ti di ka nyu, dama saa vura.
en: Then Elijah said to King Ahab, Now go eat and drink. A heavy rain is coming.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ tɛha maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi tɛhiri tɛhi biɛri yi suhuri ni?.
en: Jesus knew what they were thinking. So he said, Why are you thinking such evil thoughts?.

dag: Bɛ yɛrila Naawuni, Zom ka chɛ ti! Ti bi bɔri ni ti baŋ a soli.
en: The wicked tell God to leave them alone; they don't want to know his will for their lives.

dag: Judas ni daa yiɣisi yi n-naai, ka Yisa yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ ka Daadam Bia jilima yipa yi palo, ka Naawuni gba jilima yi palo o zuɣu;.
en: After Judas had gone, Jesus said: Now the Son of Man will be given glory, and he will bring glory to God.

dag: Di saha ka Musa ŋun daa nyɛ Yawɛ dabili maa daa kpi nimaani Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali shɛm maa.
en: So Moses, the Lord 's servant, died there in the land of Moab, as the Lord had said he would.

dag: N yi tumdi li la mmaŋmaŋ suhu yubu zuɣu, dindina n simdi yɔri yɔbu; amaa di yi pala mmaŋmaŋ suhu yubu zuɣu, dindina Naawuni ni zali ma ni n tum shɛm m-bala.
en: If I did it because it was my own choice, I would deserve to be paid. But I have no choice. I must tell the Good News. So I am only doing the duty that was given to me.

dag: Di chɛ ka ʒiɛyimtali mini yɛlimaŋli yi a kɔbili ni. Zaŋmi li lo a nyiŋgol ni, ka sab li niŋ a suhu ni.
en: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa daa chaŋ luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Gɛtsɛmani la ka o ti yɛli ba, Ʒinimiya kpe ka n chaŋ tooni ha ti suhi Naawuni.
en: Then Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane. He said to the disciples, Stay here while I go and pray over there.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun ka buchi kul chanimi gindi ŋmari ʒiri.
en: Worthless liars go around.

dag: Hagai daa yɛliya ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Di ku yuui ka n dam zuɣusaa mini dunia ni teeku ni tiŋgbani;.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful said, In just a little while, I will once again shake things up. I will shake heaven and earth, and I will shake the sea and the dry land.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga kpamba fomi ʒi tiŋgban ni. Bɛ kɔrila taŋkpaɣu puɣi bɛ zuɣuri ka so buri. Jɛrusalɛm paɣisara zaŋla bɛ zuɣuri fi tiŋa.
en: The elders of Zion sit on the ground. They sit on the ground and are quiet. They pour dust on their heads. They put on sackcloth. The young women of Jerusalem bow their heads to the ground in sorrow.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ni lan deei Juda n-su tiŋgbɔŋ kasi maa, ka lan pii Jɛrusalɛm yaha.
en: The Lord will again choose Jerusalem to be his special city. Judah will be his share of the holy land.

dag: Ka doo maa daa zo n-kuli Hitinim tiŋgban ni n-daa ti me omaŋmaŋ tiŋa m-boli di yuli Luz; ka di yuli n-na kul bala hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: so they went to the land of the Hittites, where he built a town. He named the town Luz, and that is still its name.

dag: Wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi ti ku lan beni, ka sagbana ti kpabikpabi kaman sɔŋ la; ka saŋmarisi ti luna kaman wain tia vari la bee kaman fiig tia wala ni suuri luri shɛm la.
en: The sun, moon, and stars will crumble to dust. The sky will disappear like a scroll being rolled up, and the stars will fall like leaves dropping from a vine or a fig tree.

dag: Ka yi yi mali yi bina m-paŋdila ninvuɣ shɛb yi ni tɛhiri ni yi ti lan dee li bɛ sani yaha, paɣiri bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya? Dama alahichinim gba paŋdila bɛ daalahichilan taba ni bɛ ti lan deei bɛ ni paŋ ba shɛm maa tariga.
en: And if you lend only to those from whom you hope to get it back, why should you receive a blessing? Even sinners lend to sinners, to get back the same amount!.

dag: Kpahimmi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi, kpahimmi wuntizɔriba nya; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhudoo, bɛ ni mali zuliya bɛn dol bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.

dag: Bɛ ku zo n-yi zibisim ni, buɣim ni di bɛ wulimama, ka pɔhim ʒe bɛ puma bahi.
en: and they will not escape from darkness. They will be like trees whose branches are burned by fire, whose blossoms are blown away by the wind.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim zaka din nyɛ bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi tiri man Yawɛ la, n zaŋ li ti Lɛvinim ni di nyɛ bɛ tarili. Dinzuɣu ka m pun yɛli ni bɛ ku mali tiŋgbani Izraɛlnim sani.
en: But the Israelites will give one-tenth of everything they have to the Lord , and I will give that one-tenth to the Levites. That is why I said these words about the Levites: They will not get the land that I promised the Israelites.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa garigi yɛl o, Naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili!.
en: Daniel answered, King, live forever!.

dag: N Duuma, wummi n kuhigu! Gbilisim tibili wum n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ.
en: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?.

dag: Di saha ka naa mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be o sani maa mali sara Yawɛ sani.
en: Then King Solomon and all the people there offered sacrifices to the Lord .

dag: Ka do so daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o chani ni bɛ ti sɔɣi, ka nya Mɔab ŋmɛnditoya ka zaŋ kpim maa bahi Ilaisha siliga ni ka zo. Kpim maa ni daa kul lu siliga maa ni ha n-shihi Ilaisha kɔba, o dii neemi yiɣisi zani.
en: One time during a funeral, one of those bands was seen, and the people threw the corpse into Elisha's tomb and ran off. As soon as the body came into contact with Elisha's bones, the man came back to life and stood up.

dag: n-chɛ ka paɣ maa nyu kɔtɔɣu din tahiri tibidarigibo maa na. Ka ko shɛli din tahiri tibidarigibo maa na ni kpe paɣ maa ni n-ti o biɛrim pam.
en: Before he makes the woman drink the water, which may then cause her bitter pain.

dag: amaa Naawuni ni daa neei so kum ni maa ŋun daa bi pooi.
en: But the one God raised from death did not rot in the grave.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ Yawɛ ni tim o ni o ti yɛli Aduna shɛm yɛl o, ka wuh o o ni yɛl o ni o tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa zaa.
en: Moses told Aaron what the LORD had said about his mission and all the signs that the LORD had told him to do.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Sagbana yi ti mɔhi zaawun mahili, yi yɛrimi ni di sa ni neei biɛɣu ni.
en: But Jesus answered, When the sun is setting, you say, We are going to have fine weather, because the sky is red.

dag: Mikilɔt daa nyɛla Shimiam ba. Bɛmbɔŋɔ mini bɛ malibu daa ʒimi miri bɛ dɔɣiriba Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Mikloth was the father of Shimeam. They too lived near their relatives in Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Musa mini Aduna ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛl kpamba pinaayi bɛn ʒe bɛ daŋ niriba zaashee sɔŋ ba ka bɛ kali ba la.
en: These are the ones who were enlisted by Moses, Aaron, and the twelve chiefs of Israel, each from his own household.

dag: N yi nya jilima Firawuna min o chɛchɛbunsi ni o chɛchɛbunduhiriba ŋɔ zuɣu, di saha ka Ijiptinim maa ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The Egyptians will know for sure that I am the Lord .

dag: Bɛ daa yɛl o mi, Hɛzɛkia ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zuŋɔ nyɛla nandahima mini turi ni vi dihibo dabisili. Bihi dɔɣibu saha paaya ka yaa kani ŋ-ŋuhiri dɔɣiri ba.
en: They said to him, Hezekiah says this: Today is a day of distress, punishment, and humiliation. Its as if children are ready to be born, but theres no strength to see it through.

dag: Yi yi doli n zaligu, yi nyɛla n zɔnima.
en: And you are my friends, if you obey me.

dag: Ka Jɔram daa yɛli, Malimiya n chɛchɛbuŋ shili ti ma. Ka bɛ mal li shili ti o. Di saha ka ŋun Izraɛl Naa Jɔram mini Juda Naa Ahazia daa kpe bɛ chɛchɛbunsi ni n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛhu soli n-daa mali ti tuh o soli maa la Nabɔt Jɛziriil nir la puu ni.
en: Joram said, Get me my chariot! So the servant got Jorams chariot. Both King Joram of Israel and King Ahaziah of Judah got their chariots and drove out to meet Jehu. They met him at the property of Naboth from Jezreel.

dag: Sokam ni mali niriba ŋɔ ansarisi, ka salindi salima maani ba ansarisi yɛra, Mbusim be yinim bɛn laɣisi binshɛŋa din pa yi dini duhi ŋɔ zuɣu. Yi yɛn deeri binyara yi sandiriba sani sɔŋdi yi sani hal ti paai bɔ saha.
en: But soon enough, all those people will laugh at him and tell stories about his defeat. They will laugh and say, Its too bad that the man who took so many things will not get to keep them! He made himself rich by collecting debts.

dag: Doo yi yih o paɣa, ka paɣ maa yi o yiŋa n-chaŋ ti kuli do so, o ni tooi lan biɛhi o paɣ maa naba? Di tiŋgbani maa ku saɣim pam? Yi tum zina yi mamanim pam sani, ka lan yɛn labi n sanna? Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord said to the people of Israel: If a divorced woman marries, can her first husband ever marry her again? No, because this would pollute the land. But you have more gods than a prostitute has lovers. Why should I take you back?.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa bɔhi ba, Tuun bɔ ka yi lee tum maa? Yi bi mi ni nir kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ tooi nyari ashilɔni yɛla.
en: and Joseph said, What have you done? Didn't you know that a man in my position could find you out by practicing divination.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛhɔb bia ka nyɛ Zɔba naa la, saha shɛli ŋun Hadadɛza ni daa chaŋ ni o ti tuhi deei Yufretiiz Mɔɣili polo la.
en: David set out for the Euphrates River to build a monument there. On his way, he defeated the king of Zobah, whose name was Hadadezer the son of Rehob.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ Kɛdɛshi mini Dabɛrat ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa.
en: The Gershonites also received four towns from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh, Daberath, Ramoth, and Anem, including the pastureland around them.

dag: Amaa zaadali Taainim mini Sidɔnnim azaaba nyabu ni ti so yi dini.
en: But on the judgment day it will be worse for you than for Tyre and Sidon.

dag: Ka o kuhi yɛl o, Samsin, Filistianim kana ni bɛ ti lir a! Ka o yirigi neei ka yɛli, N yaai ni yi n-chaŋ kaman n ni yi pun chani shɛm la, ka dam mmaŋa ka shɛli ku gu ma soli. O daa bi baŋ ni Yawɛ lan ka o sani.
en: She called out, Samson, the Philistines are on you! He woke up from his sleep and thought, Ill escape just like the other times and shake myself free. But he didnt realize that the LORD had left him.

dag: Naawuni ni booni so Nyɛvili Yɛligu la daa pun bela piligu ni, ka ti daa wum o yɛla, ka ti nini daa nya o ka ti lih o hal ka ti zaŋ ti nuhi tabis o.
en: We write to you about the Word of life, which has existed from the very beginning. We have heard it, and we have seen it with our eyes; yes, we have seen it, and our hands have touched it.

dag: Sokam daa yola bɛkabɛka . Bɛ ni daa kali ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuma nyɛ yuun pisi zaŋ chani maa, bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla dɔbba tuhi kɔbisiyɔbunaata ni kɔbisinu ni pihinu.
en: They gave a beqa per person for everyone who was counted in the census, years old and above, , men.

dag: Samuɛl ni daa na maani sara maa ka Filistianim maa vu m-mirina ni bɛ ti liri Izraɛlnima; amaa ka Yawɛ kukoli daa tahi pam dindali maa m-birim Filistianim maa ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Izraɛlnima.
en: While Samuel was offering the sacrifice, the Philistines moved forward to attack; but just then the Lord thundered from heaven against them. They became completely confused and fled in panic.

dag: O chɛ ka wuntaŋ su wuntaŋ ni. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: The sun to rule the day— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: N sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ n-tirila Taitus ŋun nyɛ m bi maŋli ti daadiini soli yɛda niŋbu ni la. Ti Ba Naawuni mini Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira la niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni, ka zo a nambɔɣu ka ti a suhudoo!.
en: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!.

dag: Ka niriba tusaanahi niŋ dunɔguliba; ka niriba tusaanahi la mi zaŋdi n ni daa mali wumpaɣibo biŋkumdi shɛŋa la paɣiri Yawɛ.
en: , will be guards at the temple, and , will praise the Lord by playing the musical instruments I have given them.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu bɛn daa be o sani maa daa yiɣisi n-chaŋ ti paai Bɛso kulibɔŋ ni, ka bɛn daa be nyaaŋa la kpalim nimaani.
en: So David set off with six hundred men. They came to the Besor ravine, where some stayed behind.

dag: Bɛ lan labimi ti tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa bɛ yaannim bɛn daa zaɣisi n nol la ni daa tumdi kurimbuni ha la. Bɛ jɛmdila wuna. Izraɛlnim mini Judanim saɣim n ni daa lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛli maa.
en: They have sinned in the same way their ancestors did, by turning from me and worshiping other gods. The northern kingdom of Israel broke the agreement I made with your ancestors, and now the southern kingdom of Judah has done the same.

dag: Di simdi ka o ti zaŋ firilanim maa tamtam salima firilatamdigu maa zuɣu ka di doli soli Yawɛ tooni sahakam.
en: Aaron shall take care of the lamps on the lampstand of pure gold and must see that they burn regularly in the Lord 's presence.

dag: A yi ni tooi garigi ma, nyin garigim ma; malimi a yɛtɔɣa shili n-zani n tooni.
en: Now line up your arguments and prepare to face me.

dag: Iso ni daa wum o ba ni yɛl o shɛm maa, ka o kum suhusaɣiŋgu kumsi pam ka yɛl o ba, M ba, niŋm alibarika niŋ n gba ni.
en: Esau cried out in great distress, Father, give me a blessing too.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yihi bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim la zali di ko, ka daa tar li ka di doli bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li mali sara ti Yawɛ kaman di ni sabi shɛm Musa litaafi ni la, ka bɛ daa lan niŋ naɣilahi la gba lala.
en: Then they gave the animals to be used for burnt offerings to the different tribes. This was done so that the burnt offerings could be offered to the Lord the way the Law of Moses taught. And they did the same with the bulls.

dag: Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni ti gbibi ti ni daa pun wum yɛlimaŋ shɛŋa la viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣu ti ku ʒi ti chaŋ ka chɛ li.
en: That is why we must hold on all the more firmly to the truths we have heard, so that we will not be carried away.

dag: O ni lo a alikauli ni a zaŋm o leeg a tumtumda sahakam?.
en: Will he make a pact with you so that you will take him as a permanent slave?.

dag: ka Hɔshia ŋun daa nyɛ Azazia bia la daa nyɛ Ifriim zuliya ni kpɛma, ka Joɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Pɛdaya bia la mi nyɛ Manaasa zuliya pirigili la kpɛma.
en: Hoshea son of Azaziah, leader of the tribe of Ephraim; Joel son of Pedaiah, leader of West Manasseh;.

dag: Ka Bɔaz yɛl o, Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni. Hal a ni niŋ nirilim shɛli pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ gar a ni pun niŋ a yidan ma nirilim shɛl la. A naan tooi chaŋ ti bo nachimbil so ŋun nyɛ bundana bee faralana, amaa a bi niŋ lala.
en: Then Boaz said, May the Lord bless you, young woman. You have been very kind to me. Your kindness to me is greater than the kindness you showed to Naomi in the beginning. You could have looked for a young man to marry, rich or poor. But you did not.

dag: Ɛliɛza daa nyɛla Finɛhas ba, ka Finɛhas nyɛ Abishua ba.
en: Eleazar was Phinehas father. Phinehas was Abishuas father.

dag: Di saha yi yi ti suh o, o ni deei yi suhigu, ka yi yi ti ŋme kuŋa m-bɔri sɔŋsim, o ni yɛli, M be kpe ni n sɔŋ ya. Yi yi ni ti yi ni nahindi shɛb la vuhim, ka chɛ niriba ansarisi malibu ni yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu;.
en: When you beg the Lord for help, he will answer, Here I am! Don't mistreat others or falsely accuse them or say something cruel.

dag: Yɛligu maa daa lɛbila ninsala m-be ti sani, ka anfaani mini yɛlimaŋli pal o kɔbili ni. Ka ti nya o jilima shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni Bi gaŋ ŋun yi o Ba sanna jilima.
en: The Word became a man and lived among us. We saw his divine greatness—the greatness that belongs to the only Son of the Father. The Word was full of grace and truth.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa zaŋ o gɔrigu maa tim dunia ni n-wɔb dunia puu tiwala n-zaŋ li bahi Naawuni suhuyiɣisili wain tɔɣiri adaka titali ni.
en: So the angel swung his sickle on the earth, cut the grapes from the vine, and threw them into the wine press of God's furious anger.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti zahim li, ŋun daa pihi pam dini shɛli daa bi guui, ka ŋun mi daa pihi biɛla dini shɛli daa bi poog o. Sokam daa kul pihila o dibu tariga.
en: When they measured it, those who gathered much did not have too much, and those who gathered less did not have too little. Each had gathered just what he needed.

dag: Molimiya nolɔbo molo; laɣimmiya salo maa zaa na! Laɣimmiya kpamba mini bɛnkam zaa be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu la ni nti kum niŋ ŋun Yawɛ.
en: Tell the people that there will be a special time of fasting. Call them together for a special meeting. Bring the leaders and everyone living in the land together at the Temple of the Lord your God, and pray to the Lord .

dag: Bɛ tɛha din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ nyɛla din be zibisim ni; ka bɛ nuu ka Naawuni ni ti nyɛvil shɛl la ni, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn be ʒilinsi ni ka nyɛ suhutunanima.
en: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right.

dag: O chɛ ka tɔbu tuhibu chɛ dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam. O kab tɔbiri ka saɣim kpana, ka nyo nyɔtaɣirisi buɣim.
en: He stops wars all over the world; he breaks bows, destroys spears, and sets shields on fire.

dag: Teemiya din daa niŋ Lɔt paɣ la.
en: Remember Lot's wife!.

dag: Ka o ni daa tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa maa, ka shia daa kpe n ni n-yiɣisi ma zali n naba zuɣu, ka n daa wum ka o yɛri ma;.
en: As he spoke to me, a wind came to me and stood me on my feet, and I heard someone addressing me.

dag: Dama m mi ni Yawɛ galisiya; ti Duuma maa gari wuna zaa.
en: The Lord is much greater than any other god.

dag: Gɛrishom daa nyɛla Finɛhas daŋ zuɣulana, ka Daniɛl nyɛ Itama daŋ zuɣulana, ka Hatush.
en: from the descendants of Phinehas: Gershom; from the descendants of Ithamar: Daniel; from the descendants of David: Hattush;.

dag: N tɛhiya ni di simdi ni n chɛ ka ti mabia Ɛpafurɔditus ŋun nyɛ n tumtumdikpee mini n tɔbbikpee, ka lan nyɛ yi tumo ŋun sɔŋ ma la lab kuli yi sanna.
en: For now, I think I must send Epaphroditus back to you. He is my brother in Gods family, who works and serves with me in the Lords army. When I needed help, you sent him to me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Hiburɔn ti Kalɛb kaman Musa ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la; ka o daa kari Anaki bidibis ata la nimaani.
en: They gave Hebron to Caleb, just as Moses had commanded, and they drove out from there the three sons of Anak.

dag: bɛ daa kul darimi gindi tinsi, ka dari gindi nam sulinsi tiŋgbana.
en: wandering from nation to nation, from one kingdom to the next.

dag: O daa mali piɛri mini niɣi pam ni tumtumdiba gba pam, ka Filistianim daa ti zabir o nyuli di zuɣu.
en: Because he had many herds of sheep and cattle and many servants, the Philistines were jealous of him.

dag: Babilɔn naa wum bɛ yɛla, ka o bɔɣiri ni cheei kom. Ka biɛrim gbaag o; biɛrim shɛli din be kaman paɣ ni wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la.
en: Ever since your king heard about this army, he has been weak with fear; he twists and turns in pain like a woman giving birth.

dag: So ku tooi baŋ yɛl biɛɣu ni yɛn paag o saha shɛli. Ziŋgbahiri laŋ din mali putɔɣu ni gbahiri zahim shɛm ni zana ni gbahiri noombihi shɛm la, lala ka yɛl biɛɣu gba libigiri daadamnim gbahiri ba.
en: None of us know when we might fall victim to a sudden disaster and find ourselves like fish in a net or birds in a trap.

dag: Shɛhiralan ŋun ʒe yim bi ŋmari ʒiri, amaa ʒiri shɛhiralan ŋun kul tuhirila ʒiri bahira.
en: A reliable witness always tells the truth, but an unreliable one tells nothing but lies.

dag: Ka Pool daa zaŋ o nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa siɣi bɛ zuɣu na, ka bɛ tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa min anabitali yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi maa yiko ni.
en: When Paul placed his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them, and they began speaking in other languages and prophesying.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu puuni ka bɛ daa tuhi tin muna tɔbu di nasara. Bɛ daa zali din tuhi tumbu soli, ka daa deei Naawuni ni lo ba binshɛŋa alikaulinim la. Bɛ daa chɛ ka gbuɣima noya mum.
en: Their faith helped them conquer kingdoms, and because they did right, God made promises to them. They closed the jaws of lions.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yiɣisi Ramɛsis n-chaŋ Sukɔt, dɔbba kɔŋko kalinli daa nyɛla tuhi kɔbisiyɔbu m-pahi paɣiba mini bihi.
en: The Israelites set out on foot from Rameses for Sukkoth. There were about , men, not counting women and children.

dag: Zaŋm ninvuɣ so ŋun tu ma maa yihi sansani maa kpaŋa nti chɛ ka bɛn zaa wum o ni tu ma shɛm maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa o zuɣu ni, ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa lab o kuɣa.
en: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.

dag: Wummiya Hɔrɔnaimnim kuhigu na. Damili dambu mini saɣiŋgu pam.
en: The people of Horonaim will cry for help, as their town is attacked and destroyed.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli, N tum taali, m bia Dauda, labimina, n ku lan niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu yaha, dama a lihi n nyɛvili ka di nyɛ binsuŋ a sani zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ; nyama, n tum jɛrilim ka birigi pam.
en: Then Saul said, I have sinned! David, my son, come back! Because you considered my life precious today, I wont harm you again. I have acted foolishly and have made a huge mistake.

dag: Kom ni ti zɔri yir o ŋmana ni na, ka o bimbira tiɣi kom pam. O naa ni ti gari Agag. O nam ni ti du pam.
en: Water will drip from his branches; his seed will have plenty of water; his king will be higher than Agag, and his kingdom will be lifted up.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti ye bɛ ni zaŋ piɛkɔbiri mini gali piɛlli gari tab wuɣi situr shɛŋa.
en: When you weave cloth for clothing, you can use thread made of flax or wool, but not both together.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa wurim ba nimaani n-kpɛhi dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka bɛ daa chɛ tiŋ maa mɛbu.
en: So the Lord scattered them all over the earth, and they stopped building the city.

dag: Ka bɛn daa daŋ puu maa ni la ti kana n-tɛhiri ni bɛn ni deei gari lala; amaa ka o ti yo bɛ gba la tumtumda dabisi munimuni yɔri.
en: The workers who had been hired first thought they would be given more than the others. But when they were given the same.

dag: Ka bɛn ti zo n-tiligi ni ti bela zoya zuɣu kaman vinvamli ni ŋmana la. Ka bɛ zaa ti fabindi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: But some people will escape. The survivors will run to the mountains, but they will not be happy. They will be sad for all their sins. They will cry and make sad noises like doves.

dag: Yi bi lan yuuni n sara din be kasi la zuɣu. Amaa yi bola tinzunnima n-chɛ ka bɛ zani yi zaani n-yuuni di zuɣu n jɛmbu duu maa puuni.
en: Instead of following the proper ways to worship me, you have put foreigners in charge of worship at my temple.

dag: Ka chɛ ti taali paŋ ti kaman ti gba ni chɛri paŋdi bɛn tumdi ti taali shɛm la.
en: Forgive us the wrongs we have done, as we forgive the wrongs that others have done to us.

dag: ka yi ti bɔbindi gindi wuntaŋ ni kaman zoma ni bɔbindi gindi zibisim ni shɛm la, amaa ka ku nya soli ka bɛ naɣ ti kul filindi ya mi, ka fari yi nɛma waawaayili, ka so ku beni ŋun ni sɔŋ ya.
en: You will grope about in broad daylight like someone blind, and you will not be able to find your way. You will not prosper in anything you do. You will be constantly oppressed and robbed, and there will be no one to help you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ɛdomnim daa bɔhi Judanim biɛri ka dinzuɣu chɛ ka bɛ kpe taali ni bɛ ni bɔhi ba biɛri maa zuɣu.
en: The LORD God proclaims: Edom acted with excessive force against the house of Judah. The Judeans were guilty, but Edoms vengeance was excessive.

dag: N yura, kamina ka ti yi kpaŋa nti gbɛri tiŋkpansi.
en: Come, my lover, lets go out into the field; lets spend the night in the villages.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ din ni sɔŋ daadamnim bɛ dunia ŋɔ yili biɛhigu din bi yuura, ka ka buchi ŋɔ puuni? Bɛ nyɛviya chanimi gariti kaman shilinshia la. Dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli ba din yɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa?.
en: Life is short and meaningless, and it fades away like a shadow. Who knows what is best for us? Who knows what will happen after we are gone?.

dag: Di di dii bi simdi ni n lan sabi gbaŋ tin ya zaŋ chaŋ tɔto tɔhi ti Yisa nyaandoliba la yɛla polo;.
en: Its unnecessary for me to write to you about this service for Gods people.

dag: Do so daa be Jɛrusalɛm ka o yuli booni Simiɔn; o daa nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ ka zɔri Naawuni ni o suhu zaa. Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa be o ni, ka o daa yuuni Izraɛlnim Tiligira kandina soli.
en: A man named Simeon lived in Jerusalem. He was a good man who was devoted to God. He was waiting for the time when God would come to help Israel. The Holy Spirit was with him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa guhi ka di yuui ha, amaa ka o kul bi yoori zɔntua maa dunoya maa; ka bɛ daa zaŋ saafɛbia yooi li nya ka bɛ naa maa kpimi do tiŋa.
en: They waited as long as they thought they should, but when he still did not open the door, they took the key and opened it. And there was their master, lying dead on the floor.

dag: Ti bi lan nyari ti shihira la yaha; anabi so lan kani, ka so bi mi di yuusim tariga ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: We do not see any of our signs. There are no more prophets. And no one knows how long this will last.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni daa pii Izraɛlnim dahin shɛli la, n daa po pɔri bɛn Yaakubu zuliya maa sani, ka zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. N daa po pɔri yɛli ba, Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: You must tell them, This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day I chose Israel, I raised my hand to Jacobs family and made a promise to them in Egypt. When I let them know who I was, I raised my hand and said, I am the Lord your God.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa bɔh o, Ka ya polo ka ti lee yɛn nya bindirigu mɔɣu ŋɔ ni ti ninvuɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa ka bɛ di n-tiɣi.
en: His disciples said, This place is like a desert. Where can we find enough food to feed such a crowd.

dag: Saha shɛli yi yi ti yɛn yiɣisi chaŋ, Aduna min o bidibisi bɛn kpɛm suɣili maa ni nti yiligi pateesa shɛli din yiliya la n-zaŋ li pili Alikauli Adaka la.
en: When the Israelites travel to a new place, Aaron and his sons must go into the Meeting Tent and take down the curtain and cover the Box of the Agreement with it.

dag: Ka Jɔtam daa zo n-kuli Bɛr nti be nimaani, dama o daa zɔrila o biɛli Abimilɛk.
en: Then Jotham ran away. He fled to Beer and stayed there for fear of his brother Abimelech.

dag: Labisim a tiliginsim suhupiɛlli la ti ma, ka chɛ ka m mali pupiɛlim.
en: Return the joy of your salvation to me and sustain me with a willing spirit.

dag: dama a yihi ma kum ni. A mi ku saɣi n-chɛ a ni yuri so niŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee bee n-chɛ ka a dabili kpalim gballi ni pooi.
en: because you will not leave me in the place of death. You will not let your faithful one rot in the grave.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi ba! Chɛ ka zuliya kam baŋ ni bɛ kul nyɛla ninsalinima.
en: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.

dag: Bɛ ni yo a a pagɔrisigu tuma maa samli, ka a nya yi buɣijɛmbo alahichi tibidarigibo, ka baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ a Duuma Yawɛ.
en: You will be held accountable for your betrayals, and you will bear the sins of your idols. Then you will know that I am the LORD God.

dag: Amaa ka n yɛli, N tum tuma pam, amaa ka di ka nyɔri. N yihi n yaa tum, amaa ka shɛli bi yi di ni na. Amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ n nyaanzaana, ka n laara be n Naawuni sani.
en: I said, I have worked, but how hopeless it is! I have used up my strength, but have accomplished nothing. Yet I can trust the Lord to defend my cause; he will reward me for what I do.

dag: N yi ti niŋ buɣim dabi Ijipti, ka bɛnkam sɔŋdi ba maa lu, di saha bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will start a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers will be destroyed. Then they will know that I am the Lord !.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ li mali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunoli daantalisi ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu mini daanya sara maligu bimbini ni di daanya kurupooti la ni sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu nɛma.
en: With it he made the bases for the entrance of the Tent of the Lord 's presence, the bronze altar with its bronze grating, all the equipment for the altar.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni, ka dimbɔŋɔ na nyɛla din pɔra a sani, ka a lan yɛli n yili ni ti yɛn be shɛm saha shɛli din na kanna. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, a lan wuhi ma n zuliya ni ti yɛn be shɛm yuma din kanna.
en: Besides all these things, God, you let me know what will happen to my family in the future. Lord God, you have treated me like a very important man.

dag: Ka Zɛbul ŋun daa nyɛ tiŋ maa naa ni daa wum Ɛbɛd bia Gaal maa ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: When Zebul the citys ruler heard the words of Gaal, Ebeds son, he became angry.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb beni ka bɛ nini tiɣi bɛmaŋ kasitali, amaa ka lee bi yi bɛ daɣiri ni.
en: others think they are perfect, but they are stained by sin.

dag: Jɔnatan ni daa yɛn doli so shɛli chaŋ Filistia tɔbbihi maa sani maa zuɣu tampiŋ kara ayi n-daa doya; yini daa dola yaɣili ka yini mi do yaɣ din la. Tampiŋ yini yuli daa boonila Bɔzɛz ka yini mi yuli booni Sɛne.
en: Jonathan decided to get to the Philistine camp by going through the pass that led between Shiny Cliff and Michmash to the north and Thornbush Cliff and Geba to the south.

dag: O niŋ o mini Ahisamak bia Oholiab ŋun nyɛ Dan zuliya ni nir la yiko ni bɛ wuhi niriba.
en: The Lord is urging him and Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to teach others.

dag: O daa bɔh o mi, Bɔ n-chɛ ka naa zali zaligu kpeeni maa yomyom lala? Ka Ariok daa kahigi yɛla maa ni nyɛ shɛm yɛli Daniɛl.
en: He said to Arioch the kings royal officer, Why is the kings command so unreasonable? After Arioch explained the situation to Daniel.

dag: Dinzuɣu di bemi kaman Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yɛli shɛm la: Yi yi wum Naawuni kukoli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: So it is just as the Holy Spirit says: If you hear Gods voice today.

dag: N suhir a, kul tim ti la tarim bindirigu mini kom ka ti diri ka nyuri zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu pia, ka a zahim ti nya.
en: Test us for ten days, he said. Give us vegetables to eat and water to drink.

dag: O ni gbilisiri tibili wumdi n suhigu zuɣu, n kul ni suhir o hal ni n nyɛvil tariga.
en: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.

dag: Yi mi di maliya li ŋmahindi biŋkɔbigu ŋun be dunia ŋɔ ni bee ŋ-ŋmahindi nooŋa ŋun mali kpiŋkpama yiɣiri zuɣusaa.
en: or like an animal on the earth, or like a bird that flies in the sky.

dag: Hal bɛ ni kul laɣi zuliya shɛba zɔri maa zaa yoli, n ni laɣim bɛ zaa luɣ yini, ka di ku yuui ka bɛ piligi diri wahala bɛ nanim mini bɛ kpambaliba nuu ni.
en: But now I am going to gather them together and punish them. Soon they will writhe in pain when the emperor of Assyria oppresses them.
