dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Fukumsi zaligunim zaa ni, din nyɛ kpɛma nyɛla, Izraɛlnima, wummiya! Ti Duuma Naawuni nyɛla Duuma yino.
en: Jesus answered, The most important one says: People of Israel, you have only one Lord and God.

dag: A mi n ni be muɣisigu shɛl ni; zaŋmi n nintam niŋ a luɣuluɣu ni. Bee di yɛla bi sab be a litaafi ni?.
en: You yourself have kept track of my misery. Put my tears into your bottle— arent they on your scroll already?.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ puuni, m mali tahima ni n yi ti doli n naa chaŋ Siria buɣili Rimɔn jɛmbu duu nti damdi di tooni, biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ni chɛ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ taali.
en: So I hope that the Lord will forgive me when I accompany my king to the temple of Rimmon, the god of Syria, and worship him. Surely the Lord will forgive me.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri tuumbiɛri n-luhiri ba, amaa wuntizɔriba nyari kpɛhili shee bɛ biɛrisuntali zuɣu.
en: The wicked will be defeated by their evil, but good people are protected by their honesty.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni zaligu nyɛla din be kasi; Naawuni fukumsi zaligu nyɛla din be kasi mini din tuhi ni din viɛla.
en: So the Law itself is holy, and the commandment is holy, righteous, and good.

dag: Yawɛ zaŋla chirachira biɛhigu ti ba, ka bɛ chɛ ka Ijiptinim laani gindi bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni kaman danyura m-be o tiri ni laani gindi la.
en: The Lord has confused Egypt; its leaders have made it stagger and vomit like a drunkard.

dag: Yɛnnim gbaarila bɛmaŋa n-yiri zaɣ biɛɣu ni, amaa jɛra bɛn baɣa kani, ka bi gbaari bɛmaŋa.
en: Sensible people are careful to stay out of trouble, but stupid people are careless and act too quickly.

dag: N je yi chu shɛŋa yi ni puhiri la. M mi baɣa ka yi jɛma laɣiŋgunim ni.
en: I hate your festivals; I will not accept them. I dont enjoy your religious meetings.

dag: ka puu maa nyɛ dunia ŋɔ; ka alikama biɛlin suma maa nyɛ Naawuni nam ni bihi; ka piriŋkpana biɛlim la mi nyɛ Sintani bihi.
en: The field is the world. The good seed are the people in Gods kingdom. The weeds are the people who belong to the Evil One.

dag: O daa zali Judanim ni bɛ jɛmmila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la kɔŋko, ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi.
en: He commanded the people of Judah to do the will of the Lord , the God of their ancestors, and to obey his teachings and commands.

dag: Pool mini Baanabas ni daa be Aikɔnium maa ka bɛ daa ti doli taba chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu ti yihi waazu, ka Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim pam daa niŋ yɛda.
en: The same thing happened in Iconium: Paul and Barnabas went to the synagogue and spoke in such a way that a great number of Jews and Gentiles became believers.

dag: Dama dunia ŋɔ nanim lo tɔbu, ka nazuɣuri laɣim n-zaɣisi ti Duuma Naawuni min o Masia.
en: The kings of the earth prepared themselves, and the rulers met together against the Lord and his Messiah.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɛn be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni bi sab gbaŋ yɛl ti a yɛla, ka ti mabi shɛb bɛn mi ka ya ŋɔ na bi tɔɣisi a zaɣ biɛ shɛli yɛla ti sani.
en: They said to him, We have not received any letters from Judea about you, nor have any of our people come from there with any news or anything bad to say about you.

dag: Amaa yiŋbia maa yi yɛl o suhu ni ni o yiŋlan yuui kundi na, ka piligi bur o tab bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba, ka diri ka nyuri dam kuuna.
en: But if that servant says to himself that his master is taking a long time to come back and if he begins to beat the other servants, both the men and the women, and eats and drinks and gets drunk.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Kulimiya ka daa labina dabisili din pahir ata dali. Ka niriba maa daa kuli.
en: He answered them, Come back in three days. So the people left.

dag: Amaa ka n daa bi saɣi ti Balaam, ka o daa naɣ niŋla alibarika niŋ yi ni; ka n daa tiligi ya Balak nuu ni.
en: But I would not listen to Balaam, so he blessed you, and in this way I rescued you from Balak.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Kom ŋɔ zɔri kparila wulimpuhili polo yaɣili n-zɔri chani Araba vinvamli ni. Ka di yi zo nti lu teeku kom din bi zɔri ŋɔ ni, teeku kom maa ni niŋ ko nyaɣisili.
en: The man said: This water flows eastward to the Jordan River valley and empties into the Dead Sea, where it turns the salt water into fresh water.

dag: Liya bihi daa nyɛla Rubin ŋun daa nyɛ Yaakubu bituuli la mini Simiɔn ni Lɛvi ni Juda ni Isaka ni Zɛbulɔn.
en: His firstborn son was Reuben, whose mother was Leah. Jacobs other sons by Leah were Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni zaɣisi n yɛligu maa zuɣu.
en: So this is what the Lord All-Powerful says, You have not listened to my messages.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ waagasi mini bihim ni naɣilabil kpabili so bɛ ni daa kɔrigi duɣi maa nimdi na nti zali bɛ tooni, ka ʒe bɛ sani tia maa gbini ka bɛ dira.
en: Then Abraham took butter, milk, and the calf that had been prepared, put the food in front of them, and stood under the tree near them as they ate.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Kamiyana ti nya. Ka bɛ daa dol o nti nya o ni kpɛri shɛli, ka kpalim o sani dindali maa, dama di daa nyɛla zaawuni kurig anahi saha.
en: Jesus replied, Come and see! It was already about four o'clock in the afternoon when they went with him and saw where he lived. So they stayed on for the rest of the day.

dag: Ka pakoli maa daa bɔhi Ilaija, Bɔ ka n lee niŋ nyini ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir ŋɔ? A kamina ni a ti teei ma n daalahichi yɛla ka chɛ ka m bidibiga ŋɔ kpi.
en: The woman shouted at Elijah, What have I done to you? I thought you were God's prophet. Did you come here to cause the death of my son as a reminder that I've sinned against God.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka n shia siɣi Izraɛlnim zuɣu na, ka n ku lan ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ba. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Never again will I turn my back on the people of Israel, and my Spirit will live in them. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: N ni daa bol a maa, a daa vu m-miri ma; a daa yɛli ma, Di zɔri dabiɛm.
en: and came when I was in need. You told me, Don't worry.

dag: Lala zuɣu cheechi nyɛla Masia ŋun nyɛ cheechi zuɣu maa niŋgbuŋ; ka ŋun Masia nyɛ binshɛɣukam ni pali so ni, ka o mi nyɛ ŋun pali binshɛɣukam ni mini luɣ shɛlikam zaa hal ti puuri bahira.
en: which is his body. His body, the church, is the fullness of Christ, who fills everything in every way.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib shɛb daa yɛli, Karimba, a yɛli yɛlimaŋli.
en: Some of the teachers of the Law spoke up, A good answer, Teacher.

dag: A daa lan nya napɔnvari mini napombihi la ka di shɛli polo nyɛla yaɣiri, ka shɛli polo mi nyɛ kuriti. Di nam maa ni ti pirigi. Di ni ti mali kuriti kpiɔŋ la shɛli, kuriti maa mini yaɣiri ni gari tab la zuɣu.
en: As for the feet and toes that you saw, which were a mixture of potters clay and iron, that signifies a divided kingdom; but it will possess some of the unyielding strength of iron. Even so, you saw the iron mixed with earthy clay.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ li ka maligumaana sanna, ka maligumaana maa ti too li nukurigu pali n-yihi di chihili maa n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ la zuɣu; di nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: You will bring it to the priest, and the priest will take a handful from it—the token portion—and will burn it completely on the altar along with the food gifts for the LORD. It is a purification offering.

dag: Dama di daa simdi ni nyini n dan naa ku m ba daŋ niriba zaa, amaa ka a daa zaŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ m-pah a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn laɣindi diri zuɣu. N lan malila n ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-naɣ pahila n kum niŋ nyin naa.
en: You could have killed all my grandfathers family, but you did not do that. Instead, you included me among the people who eat at your own table. So I dont have a right to complain to the king about anything.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti nyaya ni di nyɛla bɛ biɛhiŋ zuɣu ka bɛ daa bi tooi nya vuhim maa.
en: We see, then, that they were not able to enter the land, because they did not believe.

dag: So ni tooi fa tɔbbihi ni tuhi tɔbu di binshɛŋa bɛ sani bee n-fa daba na biɛɣu nuu ni?.
en: Can you take away a soldier's loot? Can you rescue the prisoners of a tyrant?.

dag: Chɛ ka Izraɛlnim yɛli, Yawɛ yi di daa bi be ti polo.
en: What would have happened to us if the Lord had not been on our side? Tell us about it, Israel.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli, Foliŋga, niŋmi kom ŋɔ sunsuuni m-pirigi kom maa buyi.
en: God said, I command a dome to separate the water above it from the water below it.

dag: Ti ni daa na be yi san la, ti daa pun yɛli ya ni ti ni nya alaka, ka yi zaa mi ni lala n-shiri niŋ.
en: In fact, when we were with you, we kept on predicting that we were going to face problems exactly like what happened, as you know.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun yuri ka tum alahichi, o yi nyɛla tiŋbia bee tinzun nira, o mola Yawɛ maa, di simdi ni bɛ ku dilana.
en: But the person who acts deliberately, whether a citizen or an immigrant, and insults the LORD, that person will be cut off from the people.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun zabiri nyuli ni ŋun bɔhiri biɛri. Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun bɔhiri biɛri ni suhuyiɣisili pam. Yawɛ bɔhir o dimnim biɛri, ka yiɣisir o suhu pam bahir o dimnim zuɣu.
en: The LORD is a jealous and vengeful God; the LORD is vengeful and strong in wrath. The LORD is vengeful against his foes; he rages against his enemies.

dag: N lɔri nol la buyi dakulo kam, ka yihiri n ni nya shɛlikam zaka.
en: I go without eating for two days a week, and I give you one tenth of all I earn.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni!.
en: Shout praises to the Lord ! With all that I am, I will shout his praises.

dag: Samarianim maa ni daa wum Filip yɛligu ka nya o ni wuhiri shihir shɛŋa maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa deeg o yɛligu maa ni suhu yini.
en: The crowds were united by what they heard Philip say and the signs they saw him perform, and they gave him their undivided attention.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali teebuli, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita pihiwɛiayika ka di yɛlim nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanahi, ka di dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: He also made the table of acacia wood, three feet long, eighteen inches wide, and twenty-seven inches high.

dag: Ka Yisa kpah o zuɣu ni viɛnyɛliŋga, ka dii bah o ni o chama.
en: Sternly, Jesus sent him away.

dag: Bɛ yi daa yɛn ku niriba ayopɔin n-yo Keen kubu samli, so yi ku mani, yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ pisopɔinnaayopɔin ka bɛ yɛn ku n-yo man kubu samli.
en: so Cain will be paid back seven times and Lamech seventy-seven times.

dag: dindina, n ni zaŋ jaaŋgbee bu ba n-darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi zuɣu, ka zaŋ fiɛbiga n-fiɛbi ba darigi bɛ tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: then I will punish them for their sins; I will make them suffer for their wrongs.

dag: Amaa zaɣ biɛɣu ni paag a, ka a bi mi a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm. Bahiyoli ni paag a yim libig a, ka a ʒi di yɛla.
en: Disaster will come upon you, and none of your magic can stop it. Ruin will come on you suddenly— ruin you never dreamed of!.

dag: Ka n yɛli n suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ ninsalinim polo, Naawuni buɣisiri ba mi ni o wuhi ni ninsalinim ŋmanila biŋkɔbiri.
en: I know God is testing us to show us that we are merely animals.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ba, Kulimiya ti duɣi bindir suma n-di ka nyu binnyuri nyaɣisa, ka niŋya shɛli ti bɛn bi duɣi la, dama zuŋɔ nyɛla Yawɛ dabisili kasi. Di chɛliya ka nandahima mali ya, dama Yawɛ ni tiri suhupiɛlli shɛli n-nyɛ yi kpiɔŋ.
en: Now go home and have a feast. Share your food and wine with those who don't have enough. Today is holy to our Lord, so don't be sad. The joy that the Lord gives you will make you strong.

dag: Lamɛk daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyopɔin ni pisopɔinnaayopɔin ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: In all, Lamech lived years, and he died.

dag: N yi ti wurim ba kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni mini tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: When I scatter them among the other nations and in foreign countries, they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Gɛrishɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Leedan mini Shimɛi.
en: From the tribe of Gershon there were Ladan and Shimei.

dag: Amazia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa o piligu ni hal ni o bahigu ni, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim mini Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: The rest of Amaziahs deeds, from beginning to end, arent they written in the official records of Israels and Judahs kings?.

dag: Bɛ ni ti dihi sokam vi, ka siɣisi karimbaannima.
en: Its citizens have been put down, and its proud people have been brought to shame.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa kum niŋ Yawɛ yɛli, Ti tum alahichi a sani, dama ti chɛ nyini ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu, ka jɛmdila buɣa Baalnima.
en: They begged the Lord for help and confessed, We were unfaithful to you, our Lord . We stopped worshiping you and started worshiping idols of Baal.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim Yawɛ ni zal o ni o yɛli ba shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: Moses told the people of Israel everything the Lord had told him about the sacrifices.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbɛri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa gbini, dama bɛ tuma daa nyɛla bɛ guli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka yoori di dunoya biɛɣ asiba kam.
en: They would spend the night patrolling Gods house since they had guard duty and were responsible for unlocking it every morning.

dag: N ni tiligi m biŋkɔbiri maa, ka so ku lan nahim ba. Ka n ti woligi binshɛli din be piɛɣu min o kpee sunsuuni.
en: but I will rescue them and no longer let them be mistreated. I will separate the good from the bad.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi lan yɛli yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna yɛla, dama yɛlimuɣisirili maa nyɛla sokam maŋmaŋ yɛligu, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi taɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ka nyɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛligu.
en: So they must no longer use the words the Lord 's burden, because if any of them do, I will make my message a real burden to them. The people have perverted the words of their God, the living God, the Lord Almighty.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa niŋ ba nirilim ti ba bɛ ni kul suhi shɛlikam zaa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ijiptinim maa daazichi pam pahi chaŋ.
en: The Lord caused the Egyptians to be kind to the Israelites, so the Egyptians gave their riches to the Israelites.

dag: N yɛri ya mi, dindali maa yuŋ niriba ayi ni ti do bindo yini zuɣu, ka Naawuni ti kpuɣ yino ka chɛ ŋun la.
en: That night there may be two people sleeping in one room. One will be taken and the other will be left.

dag: Wain tihi kuuya, ka wain dii bi lan nyara, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhupiɛlli liɣi ʒini.
en: Grapevines have dried up: wine is almost gone— mournful sounds are heard instead of joyful shouts.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Nyin bi biɛɣu ŋɔ, amaŋmaŋ nol ni yɛtɔɣa ka n yɛn zaŋ kar a saria! A mi ni m mali halli, ka bɔri ni n nya binshɛɣukam yoli, ka chɛri n ni bi biri binshɛli bebɔ?.
en: Then the king said to him, What a bad servant you are! I will use your own words to condemn you. You said that I am a hard man. You said that I even take money that I didnt earn and gather food that I didnt grow.

dag: Di simdi ni a niŋ a ʒiʒiinikpee buŋ lala, di simdi ni a niŋ a ʒiʒiinikpee situra lala. A ʒiʒiinikpee binshɛɣukam yi bɔrigi, ka a nya li, di simdi ni a niŋ lala, di bi simdi ka a zaɣis o sɔŋbu.
en: That's what you should do if you find anything that belongs to someone else. Do whatever you can to help, whether you find a cow or sheep or donkey or some clothing.

dag: Yisa daa ŋahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wum o wuhibu maa ŋahili, dama bɛ daa mirila Jɛrusalɛm ka niriba maa tɛhiri ni o dii yɛn chɛmi ka Naawuni nam piligi.
en: The crowd was still listening to Jesus as he was getting close to Jerusalem. Many of them thought that God's kingdom would soon appear.

dag: N yɛli ya la dimbɔŋɔnima ni di chɛ ka n suhupiɛlli be yi ni, ka yi suhupiɛlli maa yaɣi.
en: I have told you this so that my joy may be in you and that your joy may be complete.

dag: Dama bɛ tɛhi bɛ ni niŋ shɛm yɛla, ka zo n-yi bɛ ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zaa maa ni, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni be, bɛ ku kpi.
en: He realizes what he is doing and stops sinning, so he will certainly not die, but go on living.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa maa mini Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.
en: King Ahab of Israel and King Jehoshaphat of Judah went to fight the Arameans at Ramoth Gilead.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa zalila niriba tɔto ka bɛ tɔhi, ka lan chɛ ka bɛ tum tuun kpɛma bɛ nuu ni m-me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la min omaŋmaŋ nam yili ni Millo ni Jɛrusalɛm gooni, ni Hazɔr ni Mɛgido ni Gɛza.
en: King Solomon used forced labor to build the Temple and the palace, to fill in land on the east side of the city, and to build the city wall. He also used it to rebuild the cities of Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer. .

dag: Man gba ni garigi, Man gba ni yɛli din be n suhu ni.
en: No! I will give my opinion.

dag: Niŋm ba kaman a ni daa niŋ Midiannim mini Sisɛra ni Jabin shɛm Kishɔn Mɔɣili ni la.
en: God, defeat them just as you defeated Midian. Do what you did to Sisera and Jabin at the Kishon River.

dag: N di darigi bɛ tibili yɛla ŋɔ zuɣu? Ka n di bɔhi zuliya ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo biɛri? n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Should I punish the people of Judah for doing these things? This message is from the Lord . You know I should punish a nation such as this. I should give it the punishment it deserves.

dag: Ka binshɛɣu din ti yɛn niŋ a bidibis ayi bɛn nyɛ Hofini mini Finɛhas ti yɛn nyɛla shihirili a sani. Bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa ti yɛn kpila dahin yini.
en: And what happens to your two sons Hophni and Phinehas will be a sign for you: they will both die on the same day.

dag: Ziɔnnim ni ti yɛli, Naawuni bɔhimi Babilɔnnim biɛri ti niŋgbuna dari tɔhi ŋɔ zuɣu. Jɛrusalɛmnim ni ti yɛli, Naawuni bɔhimi Babilɔnnim biɛri ti ʒim yihibu ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Let the people of Zion say, May Babylonia be held responsible for the violence done to us! Let the people of Jerusalem say, May Babylonia be held responsible for what we have suffered.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yi fari niriba, ŋun chɛli fabu maa ka tummila omaŋmaŋ nuu zuɣu tuma n-dihir omaŋa hal ka ni tooi sɔŋdi nandaamba.
en: Whoever has been stealing must stop it and start working. They must use their hands for doing something good. Then they will have something to share with those who are poor.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun ka buchi kul chanimi gindi ŋmari ʒiri.
en: Worthless, wicked people go around telling lies.

dag: Yinima n-nyɛ n dɔɣiriba, yi nyɛla n niŋgbuŋ mini n ʒim, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yinim ti yɛn bahindi nyaaŋa n-zaŋ man naa labisi.
en: You are my relatives! You are my flesh and bones! Why should you be the last to bring the king back.

dag: Di saha maa ka Sintani daa kpe Yisa nyaandoliba pinaayi maa ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Judas Isikariɔt la suhu ni;.
en: Then Satan entered into Judas, called Iscariot, who was one of the twelve disciples.

dag: Baanabas daa nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi pal o ka o mali yɛda pam. Ka niriba pam daa kpe ti Duuma jɛmbu ni pahi.
en: Barnabas was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and faith, and many people were brought to the Lord.

dag: amaa zaŋm ma ti sɔŋla m banim dooshee. Ʒimiya ma yi Ijipti ŋɔ kuli nti sɔɣi ma bɛ sɔɣibu shee. Ka Yisifu yɛl o, N ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Instead, bury me in the place where my ancestors are buried. I will do what you have asked, Joseph answered.

dag: Ka Amɔrinim daa muɣisi Dan zuliya niriba n-kari ba labisi zoya ni tinsi la ni, ka daa bi saɣi ni bɛ siɣi tintan ni na.
en: The Amorites were strong enough to keep the tribe of Dan from settling in the valleys, so Dan had to stay in the hill country.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli yɛli Bɛri bia Hozia Naa Uzia mini Naa Jɔtam ni Naa Ahaz ni Naa Hɛzɛkia bɛn daa nyɛ Juda nanim la ni Jɔash bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa la ʒiɛmana ni m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The LORDs word that came to Hosea, Beeris son, in the days of Judahs Kings Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, and in the days of Israels King Jeroboam, Joashs son.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛn biriti ka kumdi ti chɛ bɛ ni biri shɛli maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Then those who were sad when they planted will be happy when they gather the harvest!.

dag: Yi ni so yi mali taali ni o kpee, o ni buɣisi ni o zaŋ di yɛla maa tahi sariakaritiba bɛn pa Yisa yɛdaniŋdiba sani, ka pa ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda sani?.
en: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?.

dag: Ŋ-ŋɔ m mini nanim ni dunia saawaranima, bɛn daa lan lab me tin shɛŋa din wurim zaa ti bɛmaŋ la.
en: with kings and their advisors whose palaces lie in ruins.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛl o bia Jɔnatan min o tumtumdiba zaa ni bɛ kum Dauda. Amaa o bia Jɔnatan daa yuri Dauda yɛla pam.
en: Saul told his son Jonathan and all his officials that he planned to kill David. But Jonathan was very fond of David.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa yɛl o, Do so n-daa ti boli niriba pam ni bɛ ka o yiŋ na ti di bindira;.
en: Jesus told him: A man once gave a great banquet and invited a lot of guests.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ ni bɛ bari zana gbaag o o yɛtɔɣa puuni.
en: They plotted against him, trying to trap him in his words.

dag: Yawɛ, m bi duhi mmaŋa, m mi bi nyuri bara. M bi zaŋ binyara din galisi pam mini din viɛli pam yɛla muɣisi mmaŋa.
en: LORD, my heart isnt proud; my eyes arent conceited. I dont get involved with things too great or wonderful for me.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn kpi bela fɔŋ ni ŋuhira, ka bɛn mali dansi kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim, amaa ka Naawuni baɣa ka bɛ suhigu ni.
en: In the cities the wounded and dying cry out, but God ignores their prayers.

dag: Juda zuliya n-daa zaŋ bɛ tuuta daŋ yiɣisi doli tab gbilligbilli gbaai chandi. Aminadab bia Nashɔn n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana.
en: The banner of Judahs camp marched first with its military units. Nahshon, Amminadabs son, commanded its military.

dag: Amaa ka a daa zaŋ binyɛra ŋɔ sɔɣ a suhu ni. M mi ni a nia ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala.
en: But now I know that all that time you were secretly planning to harm me.

dag: Kootaali tandɔri n-daa kul yɛrigi Siddim vinvamli maa ni; ka Sɔdom mini Gomɔra nanim la daa ŋmaligi guuri ka bɛ ni shɛb faai lu kootaali tandɔri maa ni, ka bɛn kpalim mi zo nti du zoli.
en: The valley was full of tar pits, and when the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah tried to run away from the battle, they fell into the pits; but the other three kings escaped to the mountains.

dag: Niriba ni ti yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, wuntizɔriba mali laara. Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni ŋun kariti dunianim saria shiri beni.
en: People will say, The righteous are indeed rewarded; there is indeed a God who judges the world.

dag: Ka paɣ maa suh o ni o kari alizin biɛɣu maa o bia maa zuɣu bahi. Bɛ daa dɔɣ paɣ maa la Siria tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka o lee nyɛ Fɔnisia tiŋbia, ka nyɛ ŋun wumdi Giriikili.
en: She was not a Jew. She was born in Phoenicia, an area in Syria. She begged Jesus to force the demon out of her daughter.

dag: Ka puu maa atam kpuɣibu saha daa ti paai, ka o tim o yiŋbihi padiriba maa sani ni bɛ ti zaŋ o puu maa daatam ti o na.
en: When it was harvest time, the owner sent some servants to get his share of the grapes.

dag: Pa a ninvuɣ biɛtali ni galisi zuɣu? A tuumbiɛri ka tariga.
en: Isnt your wickedness massive, your iniquity endless?.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun wumdi Naawuni yɛligu, o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. Ŋun nyari Kpiɔŋlan Naa ʒii, o luya, amaa ka o nina bi pɔbi.
en: It comes from the Lord , the God All-Powerful. I bowed down to him and saw a vision of Israel.

dag: hal ka n ti chɛ ka a dimnim leeg a napɔntamdigu.
en: until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.

dag: Karimba, Anabi Musa daa sab zali ni so biɛli yi kpuɣi paɣa ka na bi zaŋ o dɔɣ bia ka kpi ka chɛ o, o tizo ŋun kpuɣim o pakoli maa dɔɣ bihi ti o biɛli maa.
en: Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a mans brother dies , leaving a widow but no children, the brother must marry the widow and raise up children for his brother.

dag: Dama nyama, n ni chɛ ka kokpɛɣu kpe dunia ŋɔ ni n-di vuhirigu kam zaa ŋun mali nyɛvili be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka binshɛɣukam zaa din be dunia ŋɔ ni kpi.
en: I'm going to send a flood that will destroy everything that breathes! Nothing will be left alive.

dag: Ka Izraɛl kpamba maa daa kana, ka Lɛvinim daa kpuɣi Alikauli Adaka maa.
en: When all the elders of Israel arrived, the Levites lifted the Box of the Agreement.

dag: Ka niriba anahi daa zaŋ gbalikpimalan so niŋ amaŋka ni ʒi o ka Yisa sanna.
en: Some people arrived, and four of them were bringing to him a man who was paralyzed.

dag: Amaa mani ŋuna, Yawɛ yiko min o shia ni zaligu ni yaa be n ni, ka n yɛli Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim bɛ biriginsim mini bɛ daalahichi ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: But as for me, the Lord fills me with his spirit and power, and gives me a sense of justice and the courage to tell the people of Israel what their sins are.

dag: Juda zuliya ni, Ɛlihu ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda mabihi ni yino la n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma, Isaka zuliya ni, Omri ŋun daa nyɛ Maikil bia la n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma.
en: Elihu, one of Davids brothers, leader of the tribe of Judah; Omri son of Michael, leader of the tribe of Issachar;.

dag: Ka o daa kɔrigi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la biŋkɔbigu, ka Aduna bidibisi daa taɣi binʒim n-zaŋ ti o, ka o kpaai li vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.
en: Next, Aaron killed the animal for the burnt offering. His sons brought the blood to him, and he sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

dag: dama m mi ni yi wunsuhigu mini Yisa Masia Shia sɔŋsim ni fa ma bahi.
en: because I know that by means of your prayers and the help which comes from the Spirit of Jesus Christ I shall be set free.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira; yi mali buchi pam gari jahinjɛya.
en: Dont be afraid. You are worth more than many sparrows.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yinima ninvuɣ shɛb zaa n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Jɛrusalɛm n-kuli Babilɔn la wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. But you had better listen to me now.

dag: A nyɛla a ma ŋun daa zaɣis o yidana min o bihi la bipuɣiŋga. A nyɛla a biɛyanim bɛn daa zaɣisi bɛ yidaannim mini bɛ bihi la tizo. A ma daa nyɛla Hiti paɣa, ka a ba mi nyɛ Amɔri doo.
en: You are just like your mother, who hated her husband and her own children. You are also like your sisters, who hated their husbands and children. Your father was an Amorite, and your mother was a Hittite.

dag: O zaŋ liɣiri pam mali chaŋ. O ku kuna, naɣila goli muni.
en: He took a pouch of money with him; he wont come home till full moon.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbɛri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa gbini, dama bɛ tuma daa nyɛla bɛ guli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka yoori di dunoya biɛɣ asiba kam.
en: They guarded the temple day and night and opened its doors every morning.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, niŋmiya ania n-lihi ma, dama m bi yɛn ŋmanya ʒiri yi ninni.
en: Now look at me— would I lie to your face?.

dag: Amaa ka Absalom daa zo. Ka nachimbil so ŋun daa guli nayili maa daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya niriba pam ni doli Hɔrɔnaim soli m-baɣisiri zoli kanna.
en: In the meantime Absalom had fled. Just then the soldier on sentry duty saw a large crowd coming down the hill on the road from Horonaim. He went to the king and reported what he had seen.

dag: Ŋun saɣindi maa ni ti liri tiŋ kam, ka tin shɛli ti ku yi. O ni ti wurim vinvamli ni tinsi, ka saɣim bɔpiɛligu ni tinsi, kaman Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: The Destroyer will come against every town. Not one town will escape. The valley will be ruined. The high plain will be destroyed. The Lord said this would happen, so it will happen.

dag: Amaa o ni daa nyɛ anabi zuɣu ka o daa mi ni Naawuni pun lo o alikauli ni o ni ti zaŋ o zuliya ni ninvuɣ so leei naa ka o zani o zaani.
en: He was a prophet, and he knew what God had promised him: God had made a vow that he would make one of David's descendants a king, just as David was.

dag: Ŋunkam ti zɔri ni o yi dabiɛm maa ni ni ti lu bɔɣili ni. Ka ŋunkam ti yiri bɔɣili maa ni na, tɔŋ ni gbaag o. Dama Mɔabnim tibidarigibo dali, n ni ti chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔnim niŋ ba. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Whoever tries to escape the terror will fall into the pits, and whoever climbs out of the pits will be caught in the traps, because the Lord has set the time for Moab's destruction.

dag: O daa lan yɛli yaha: N ti ku lan teei bɛ daalahichi mini bɛ biriginsim tuma yɛla hal abada.
en: And I wont remember their sins and their lawless behavior anymore. .

dag: A nuhi ka a daa zaŋ nam ma, tim ma yɛm, ka m baŋ a zaligunima.
en: Your hands have made me and set me in place. Help me understand so I can learn your commandments.

dag: dama o kanna ni o ti kari dunianim saria. O ni ti doli wuntia soli kari dunianim saria, O ni ti zaŋ yɛlimaŋli soli kari niriba saria.
en: before the LORD because he is coming to establish justice on the earth! He will establish justice in the world rightly; he will establish justice among all people fairly.

dag: amaa pirimiya namda, ka di yɛn ya daliyanima ayiyi.
en: You can wear sandals, but dont take extra clothes.

dag: Amaa ka Mikaya yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, ŋun Yawɛ ni yɛli ma shɛm, lala ka n yɛn yɛli.
en: I'll say whatever the living Lord tells me to say, Micaiah replied.

dag: Yinim Samaria paɣiba bɛn ŋmɛlim be kaman Bashan naɣ shɛb bɛ ni dihiri viɛnyɛliŋga la, wummiya, yi nahindi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa mini nandaamba, ka yɛri yi yidaannima, Timiya ti wain ka ti nyu.
en: Listen to this, you women of Samaria, who grow fat like the well-fed cows of Bashan, who mistreat the weak, oppress the poor, and demand that your husbands keep you supplied with liquor!.

dag: Naa ni ti fabili, ka nabia ti yihi tahima, ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa bɔɣiri ti sɔhira. N ni ti yɛn niŋ ba kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka kari ba saria kaman bɛ saria karibu ni nyɛ shɛm zuɣu. Ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The king will mourn, the prince will give up hope, and the people will shake with fear. I will punish you for all you have done, and will judge you in the same way as you have judged others. This will show you that I am the Lord .

dag: Bɛ ti zaŋm li mali bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi. Mani n-zaŋ li ti ba ka di nyɛ bɛ tarili bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli nyo buɣim mali sara ti ma maa ni, di nyɛla binshɛli din be kasi zaa kaman alahichi sanyoo bee taali sanyoo sara la.
en: It must not be baked with leaven. I have made it the priests share from my food gifts. It is most holy like the purification offering and the compensation offering.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba nyaɣisim pam, ka bɛ lo o alikauli ni bɛ ni ti o liɣiri.
en: They were very pleased and offered to pay Judas some money.

dag: Kulibɔn shɛŋa din kom nyuui mini tiŋgbani voya ni ni tampima voya ni n-nyɛ bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: They must live in the dry riverbeds, hillside caves, and holes in the ground.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o yihi biŋkpam din pili namanama zuɣu la mini biŋkpam din be namanama maa ni zaa.
en: The priest will give part of the fellowship offering as a gift to the Lord . He will offer the fat that is over and around the animals inner parts.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni yɛli shɛm la: Yi yi wum Naawuni kukoli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, yin miriya ka yi niŋ tipawumlinima kaman bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm taai duŋ la.
en: When it says, Today, if you hear his voice, dont have stubborn hearts as they did in the rebellion. .

dag: Neem a nina nya man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ min a niriba Izraɛlnim suhigu, ka gbilisi a tibili wum ti suhigu ti yi ti suh a saha shɛlikam.
en: I am your servant, and the people of Israel belong to you. So listen when any of us pray and cry out for your help.

dag: Ka Naawuni suhu daa paligi Sulemaana ni suhi binshɛli maa zuɣu.
en: The Lord was pleased that Solomon had asked for this.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun ŋmɛri ŋun nam o naŋgbankpeeni zuɣu. Yaɣiri ni tooi bɔhi yaɣimɛra, Bɔ ka a lee mɛra? bee m-bɔh o, A niŋ nuhi niŋ ma.
en: Does a clay pot dare argue with its maker, a pot that is like all the others? Does the clay ask the potter what he is doing? Does the pot complain that its maker has no skill?.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa yiɣisi Sin tiŋgban nɛli ni m-piri taba gbilligbilli n-chani kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba shɛm. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti paai Rɛfidim n-ti suɣa nimaani, amaa ka kom daa lee ka nimaani ka bɛ ni nyu.
en: The Israelites left the desert and moved from one place to another each time the Lord ordered them to. Once they camped at Rephidim, but there was no water for them to drink.

dag: Di to ni ninvuɣ so saɣi kpi wuntizɔra zuɣu, amaa di pa shɛli so ni saɣi kpi ninvuɣ sun so zuɣu.
en: It is a difficult thing for someone to die for a righteous person. It may even be that someone might dare to die for a good person.

dag: Nyini ka n kul lihira, nyini ŋun nam ʒiishee be zuɣusaa ŋɔ!.
en: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.

dag: Di ʒiɛmani maa ni naa daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di saha maa ka Dan zuliya niriba daa lihiri bɔri luɣ shɛli ni bɛ ʒini, dama Izraɛlnim ni daa pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti tab la, bɛ daa na bi ti ba bɛ tiŋgbani.
en: These things happened before kings ruled Israel. About this time, the tribe of Dan was looking for a place to live. The other tribes had land, but the people of Dan did not really have any to call their own.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima m-mali duu maa puuni zaa mini bimbin shɛli din be du shɛli din nyɛ Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee la zuɣu hal ka duu maa malibu tuma ti naai.
en: The inside of the Temple was covered with gold, and the altar in front of the Most Holy Place was covered with gold.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o n-zaŋ o chaŋ nayili dunɔdali din yuli daa booni wɔhu dunɔdal la gbini nti ku o nimaani.
en: She tried to escape, but the commanders caught and killed her near the gate where horses are led into the palace.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Naawuni daa pii ma n-leei lahibal suŋ ŋɔ molomoona mini di tumo ni di karimba.
en: I was appointed a messenger, apostle, and teacher of this good news.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa kari ti paai Sool min o bidibisi n-ku o bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ Jɔnatan mini Abinadab ni Malikishua.
en: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons, and they killed his sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.

dag: Ya polo ka ti lee chana? Ti mabihi maa ni labina ti yɛli shɛm maa chɛ ka ti suhuri fuŋ. Bɛ yɛliya, Niriba maa mali yaa ka lan wɔɣiwɔɣ gari ti, ka bɛ fɔntinsi maa galisi, ka bɛ me goma gil li hal ti taɣi sagbana. Hal ti nyala Anakinim nimaani. .
en: We are afraid, because the men who explored the land told us that the cities are large, with walls that reach to the sky. The people who live there are taller and stronger than we are, and some of them are Anakim. We have nowhere to go.

dag: Ka o daa shiri zaŋ bɛ zaa niŋ sarika ni daba ata.
en: He put them all in prison for three days.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni niŋ a ni lo ma alikauli ni a ni niŋ shɛlikam ti ma. Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam. Di zaŋ a nuhi tuma bahi.
en: You will do everything you have promised; Lord , your love is eternal. Complete the work that you have begun.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ toomiya li ti ti aŋgo zo. Ka bɛ tooi li ti ti o.
en: Then he said to them, Now dip out some water and take it to the man in charge of the feast. So they did what he said.

dag: Di chɛ ka a dabili nyari saɣisibu, ka di dolibu mali laara pam.
en: They give knowledge to me, your servant; I am rewarded for obeying them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ ninsal bemi kaman ti ni be shɛm, ka mi zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu, ka di pa shɛli ka o ti pɔhigi nyɛvili tia la walli di m-be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Then the Lord God said, Now these human beings have become like one of us and have knowledge of what is good and what is bad. They must not be allowed to take fruit from the tree that gives life, eat it, and live forever.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋunkam yɛn nyu bara, ŋun nyum li la ti Duuma zuɣu.
en: The Scriptures say, If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.

dag: Ka Miriam ŋun daa nyɛ anabi ka nyɛ Aduna tizɔpaɣ la daa zaŋ guŋgombil din mali chaɣisa, ka paɣiba zaa daa zaŋ guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa n-yi nti pah o zuɣu wari waa.
en: Miriam the sister of Aaron was a prophet. So she took her tambourine and led the other women out to play their tambourines and to dance.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ o ni lo o suhu ni ni o me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa dundɔŋ mini du shɛŋa din yɛn me n-gil li ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni daazichi zaashee ni bɛ ni yɛn zaŋdi pin shɛŋa maani sara tiri Naawuni zaashee zaa buɣisibu gbana ti Sulemaana.
en: He gave Solomon his plans for the courtyards and the open areas around the temple, and for the rooms to store the temple treasures and gifts that had been dedicated to God.

dag: Bɛnkam maani nandaamba ansarisi turila ŋun nam ba. Ka bɛnkam mali suhupiɛlli bɛ tab daashaara zuɣu ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: Those who mock the poor insult their maker; those who rejoice in disaster wont go unpunished.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Gidiɔn daa bɔhi Zɛba mini Zalimuna, Ninvuɣ banim ka yi daa lee ku Tabo la? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Bɛ zaa daa bela a ni be shɛm ŋɔ, bɛ daa ŋmanila nabihi.
en: Then Gideon said to Zebah and Zalmunna, You killed some men on Mount Tabor. What were the men like? Zebah and Zalmunna answered, They were like you. Each one of them seemed like a prince.

dag: O bituuli yuli n-daa booni Abidɔn, ka bɛn daa dol o nyaaŋa n-nyɛ: Zur mini Kish ni Baal ni Nadab.
en: his oldest son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim lola nia biɛɣu jɛndi ma.
en: Then the Lord said to me, The people of Judah and of Jerusalem are plotting against me.

dag: amaa ka bɛ ti zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa niŋdi Naawuni nam maa ni kpɛbu tahima la nti bahi bumbɔn ni; nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: But those who should be in the Kingdom will be thrown out into the darkness, where they will cry and gnash their teeth.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mɔab yaa naaya. Di lan ka yiko.
en: Moab's might has been crushed; its power has been destroyed. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dama n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu a ni, n ni chɛ ka bɛ ku niriba a ni solɔri zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi din jɛnd a maa ku niriba luɣilikam, ka kpiimba ti do a ni, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: I will send diseases on you and make blood flow in your streets. You will be attacked from every side, and your people will be killed. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka binnɛma anahi la ni yino daa zaŋ salima lah ayopɔin din pali Naawuni ŋun be hal ni saha din ka bahigu ŋɔ suhuyiɣisili n-ti malaikanima ayopɔin maa.
en: Then one of the four living beings gave seven golden bowls to the seven angels. The bowls were filled with the anger of God, who lives forever and ever.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri Nuhu yuun kɔbisiyɔbu ni yini puuni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali ka kom maa daa nyuui tiŋgban ni, ka Nuhu daa piligi binshɛli din pili ŋariŋ maa, ka lihi nya ka tiŋgbani ŋme pɔhim.
en: After that Noah opened the door of the boat. He looked and saw that the ground was dry. This was the first day of the first month of the year. He was years old.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayi dol o gbin na yɛra, Babilɔn din nyɛ tin titali din daa muɣisi zuliya kam ka bɛ nyu di kɔr biɛri wain la luya.
en: Another angel, a second one, followed and said, Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She made all the nations drink the wine of her lustful passion.

dag: Hal ka n kuhi pam bɔri sɔŋsim ka o zaɣisi n suhigu deebu.
en: Even when I cry out and ask for help, he does not listen to my prayer.

dag: Kasitali sara maligu biŋkɔbiri daa nyɛla naɣilahi kɔbisiyɔbu mini piɛri tusaata.
en: bulls and , sheep were brought as sacrifices to ask the Lord 's blessing.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ ni ti garigi bɔh o, Ti Duuma, bɔ saha ka ti daa lee nya a ka kum bee kɔnyuri mal a bee ka a nyɛ sana bee n-chani gbinfini bee ka a biɛra bee m-be sarika ni, ka ti baɣa ka a ni.
en: Then the people will ask, Lord, when did we fail to help you when you were hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in jail.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi yi ti bo ma ni yi suhuri zaa, yi ni nya ma.
en: You will worship me with all your heart, and I will be with you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Izraɛl daŋ niriba zaa yuya niŋ Izraɛl Nanim litaafi ni. Ka bɛ daa gbahi Judanim daba n-zaŋ ba kuli Babilɔn bɛ ni daa bi ʒe yim la zuɣu.
en: Everyone in Israel was listed in the official family records that were included in the history of Israel's kings. The people of Judah were taken to Babylonia as prisoners because they sinned against the Lord .

dag: Niriba ŋɔ tiri ma la jilima bɛ nyina zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee be katiŋ ni mani.
en: These people, says God, honor me with their words, but their heart is really far away from me.

dag: N ni darigi yi bihi tibili, ka zaŋ yi sara biŋkɔbiri bindi ʒe yi nina ni, ka kari ya n sani.
en: I will punish your children and rub your faces in the dung of the animals you sacrifice—and you will be taken out to the dung heap.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti ŋubi bin so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo muni bee biŋkɔbiri ni dar tɔhi binshɛli, dilan yi nyɛla tiŋbia bee sana, ŋun paɣim o situra, ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi leei ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: If any of you, whether Israelite or foreigner living among you, eats an animal that died by itself or was killed by some other animal, you will be unclean until evening. You must wash your clothes and bathe your whole body with water.

dag: Tulaale mini tulaalɛzim nyɛla din paligiri suhu, amaa yɛlimuɣisirili nyɛla din kabiri suhu.
en: Perfume and fragrant oils make you feel happier, but trouble shatters your peace of mind.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti kari ba yihi tin ya, yin di yɛliya yi suhuri ni, Ti wuntitali zuɣu ka Yawɛ zaŋ ti na ni ti ti ʒini tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. Di nyɛla niriba maa ninvuɣ biɛtali zuɣu ka Yawɛ kari ba tin ya maa.
en: Once the LORD your God has driven them out before you, dont think to yourself, Its because Im righteous that the LORD brought me in to possess this land. It is instead because of these nations wickedness that the LORD is removing them before you.

dag: M mi ni Yawɛ baɣa be nandaamba ni, ka o zabiri faranim zuɣu.
en: Lord , I know that you defend the cause of the poor and the rights of the needy.

dag: Ka man Jɔn daa wum ka kukoli maa lan yɛli, Yinim alizanda ni nim mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda ni Yisa tuumba ni anabinima, maliya suhupiɛlli o dahimbu maa zuɣu, dama Naawuni m-bɔh o biɛri tin ya maa.
en: The heavens should be happy with God's people and apostles and prophets. God has punished her for them.

dag: Ka naa daa tim ti yih o na. Tiŋ maa niriba maa naa n-daa yih o.
en: So the king of Egypt set him free. That nations leader let him out of jail.

dag: Bɛ ni boli ninvuɣ shɛb yuya ŋɔ maa nyɛla bɛn daa yi Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia saha la n-chaŋ ti nyo ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be nimaani ya buɣim n-kari ba bahi, ka ʒini nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ, dama mɔri daa be nimaani viɛnyɛla ka bɛ biŋkɔbiri ŋubira.
en: In the time of King Hezekiah of Judah, the men named above went to Gerar and destroyed the tents and huts of the people who lived there. They drove the people out and settled there permanently because there was plenty of pasture for their sheep.

dag: Ka ŋun bi damdi tiŋa n-jɛm li, bɛ ni zaŋ o ti bahi buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam ni.
en: And you said that anyone who did not bow down and worship it would be thrown into a flaming furnace.

dag: Kpiimba bi paɣiri Yawɛ, ka bɛn chaŋ ti be kpiimba biɛhigu shee gba bi paɣiri Yawɛ.
en: The Lord is not praised by the dead, by any who go down to the land of silence.

dag: Ŋuni ka Izraɛl naa lee yina kariti doli ŋɔ? Ŋuni ka a lee kariti doli ni a ku ŋɔ? A kariti dolila ba kpiŋ! A kariti dolila buduli zaɣ bila.
en: Look at what the king of Israel is trying to kill! Look at what he is chasing! A dead dog, a flea!.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn yi tindul na ni ti tuhi deei Fɔnisia tiŋgbɔŋ n-zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo hal ni Zarɛfat su. Ka Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn nyɛ Jɛrusalɛmnim ka yi tindul na nti be Saadis la mi ti tuhi deei Nɛgɛb tinsi su.
en: Those who remain of the Israelites will possess the land of the Canaanites as far as Zarephath; and those left from Jerusalem and who are now living in Sepharad will possess the cities of the arid southern plain.

dag: ka o daa boli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o yiŋ maa na nti yɛli ba, Nyamiya, o ni zaŋ Hiburu nir maa na ka o ti lihi ʒiɛm ti shɛm, o kpɛmina ni o ti zaŋ ma dɔni, ka n kuhi pam.
en: she called in her servants and said, Look! This Hebrew has come just to make fools of us. He tried to rape me, but I screamed for help.

dag: Ka bɛnkam zaa zaɣisi a Naawuni zaligunim maa dolibu bee n-zaɣisi naa zaligunim dolibu, bɛn darigim bɛ tibili pam. Di yi simdi ni bɛ ku ba bee n-kari ba yihi yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni bee n-fa bɛ nɛma zaa bee n-kpɛhi ba duu yin niŋmiya lala.
en: Anyone who does not obey the law of your God, or the law of the king, must be punished. Depending on the crime, they must be punished with death, or sent away to another country, or their property taken away, or put into prison.

dag: So yi chɛ ka o biŋkɔbiri ŋub so puu ni binyɛra bee o wain tihi puu bee n-chɛ o biŋkɔbigu bahi ka o chaŋ so puu ni nti ŋub o bindira, di simdi ka dilan zaŋ o puu ni bindira din niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga bee o wain tihi din wali viɛnyɛliŋga yo di samli.
en: A man might let his animal loose to graze in his field or vineyard. If the animal wanders into another persons field or vineyard, then the owner must pay. The payment must come from the best of his crop.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ni lo nia shɛŋa nyɛla din kul ʒiɛya sahakam. Ka o suhu ni tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm kul ni be ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.

dag: O ni yɛli, Yi ni ti bɔri ma ka ku nya ma; ka n ni ti yɛn be luɣ shɛli, yi ku tooi ka nimaani na la gbinni lee nyɛla wula?.
en: What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going.

dag: Dama yi nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ m-pii ya dunia ŋɔ niriba zaa sunsuuni n-zaŋ ya leeg o niriba bɛn nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda.
en: Israel, you are the chosen people of the Lord your God. There are many nations on this earth, but he chose only Israel to be his very own.

dag: Ka Nashɔn daa nyɛ Aminadab bia, ka Aminadab nyɛ Adimin bia, ka Adimin nyɛ Arini bia, ka Arini nyɛ Hɛzirɔn bia, ka Hɛzirɔn nyɛ Pɛrɛz bia, ka Pɛrɛz mi nyɛ Juda so bia.
en: son of Amminadab son of Admin son of Arni son of Hezron son of Perez son of Judah.

dag: Ka n yi be bɛ ni ka a mi be n ni, dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ leei zaɣ yini ni yɛlimaŋli, ka dunianim baŋ ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na, ka lan baŋ ni a yuri bɛn niŋ ma yɛda maa kaman a ni yuri ma shɛm.
en: Im in them and you are in me so that they will be made perfectly one. Then the world will know that you sent me and that you have loved them just as you loved me.

dag: Nyama, ka niriba daa gariti nya ka o do sol ni, ka gbuɣinli ʒe m-baɣ o. Ka bɛ daa ka anabi kurili maa ni be tin shɛli maa ni na nti yɛli bɛ ni nya shɛm.
en: Some people came walking by and saw the body and the lion standing by it. They went into the city where the old prophet lived and told people what they had seen on the road.

dag: Yisa ni daa baŋ ni niriba maa loya ni bɛ gbaag o ni kiŋkansi ti leei bɛ naa maa, ka o daa ŋoli yi bɛ sunsuuni n-chaŋ ti du zo shɛli zuɣu m-be nimaani o kɔŋko.
en: Jesus knew that the people planned to come get him and make him their king. So he left and went into the hills alone.

dag: Yɛlim o, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, A kula nira, ka lan deeg o ni su shɛli? Ka lan yɛl o, Yawɛ ni lan yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bahi ni lɛli Nabɔt ʒim luɣ shɛli maa, nimaani ka bahi yɛn lɛl a gba ʒim. .
en: Tell him that I, the Lord , say to him, After murdering the man, are you taking over his property as well? Tell him that this is what I say: In the very place that the dogs licked up Naboth's blood they will lick up your blood.

dag: Yɛm tiri yɛndan kpiɔŋ gari nanim pia bɛn be tiŋ puuni.
en: Wisdom will make you stronger than the ten most powerful leaders in your city.

dag: Naawuni zaŋ yi gba me n-tamla Yisa Masia tuumba min anabinim ni daa zali tanza shɛli din gbinni kuɣ gahindili nyɛ Yisa Masia maŋmaŋ la zuɣu.
en: You believers are like a building that God owns. That building was built on the foundation that the apostles and prophets prepared. Christ Jesus himself is the most important stone in that building.

dag: Ka tɔb daa ti lan lu Izraɛlnim maa mini Filistianim sunsuuni Gɔb yaha, ka Jaariɔrigim ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm nir la bia Ɛlhanan gba daa lan ku Goliat ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat nira ka o kpani dɔɣu daa be kaman kpalua dapua la.
en: There was another battle with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan son of Jair from Bethlehem killed Goliath from Gath, whose spear had a shaft as thick as the bar on a weaver's loom.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The LORD said to Moses.

dag: Amaa yinim ni ti mali suhupiɛlli ka yili yila kaman Naawuni chuɣu puhibu dali yuŋ. Yi ni ti mali suhupiɛlli kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn piɛbiri yuhi yiini yila chani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim tampiŋ ŋɔ zoli zuɣu.
en: There will be singing for you as on the night that people celebrate a festival. The heart will be joyful as it is when one goes with a flute to the LORDs mountain, to the rock of Israel.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni yi yi ti paai tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni n.
en: the following regulations for the people of Israel to observe in the land that he was going to give them.

dag: Bɛtɛl mini Ai — kɔbisiyi ni pisinaata.
en: from the towns of Bethel and Ai:.

dag: A nya Ɛhab ni siɣis omaŋ n sani shɛm bebɔ? O ni siɣis omaŋ n sani shɛm maa zuɣu, n ku lan chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu maa paag o o ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, amaa o bia ʒiɛman ni ka n ni ti chɛ ka di paag o daŋ niriba.
en: Have you noticed how Ahab has humbled himself before me? Since he has done this, I will not bring disaster on him during his lifetime; it will be during his son's lifetime that I will bring disaster on Ahab's family.

dag: O bi ʒe tibi nyɛvili soli zuɣu. O soli kpɛla yɔɣu, ka o bi mi lala.
en: Dont follow her. She has lost her way and does not even know it. Be careful. Stay on the road that leads to life.

dag: M bia, mali yɛm, ka chɛ ka n suhu piɛla, ka n ni tooi garigi ŋunkam galindi ma yɛtɔɣa.
en: My child, show good sense! Then I will be happy and able to answer anyone who criticizes me.

dag: Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari m-mali dapaɣa niŋ m biɛhigu shee maa.
en: Use acacia wood to make frames to support the Holy Tent.

dag: ti daag o yihi bɛ tiŋ maa tariga nti labir o kuɣa. Ka bɛn daa di o kubu maa shɛhira ka lan nyɛ bɛn yɛn ku o maa fuɣi bɛ binyɛra ti sɔŋ nachimbil so ŋun yuli daa booni Sool la tooni.
en: and dragged him out of the city. Then they started throwing stones at him. The men who had brought charges against him put their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi kali Lɛvinim pahi Izraɛlnim kalinli ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun zali Musa shɛm la.
en: But the Levites werent enlisted among the Israelites, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Malaika ŋun daa yɛli ma lala maa daa malila salima jaaŋgbee din nyɛ o ni mali shɛli buɣisiri binyara ni o ti buɣisi tiŋ maa mini di dunoya ni di gooni la.
en: The angel who spoke to me had a gold measuring stick to measure the city and its gates and its walls.

dag: Ka o daa ti o niriba subu yiko mini jilima ni kpiɔŋ ni di chɛ ka zuliya kam mini niriba balibu kam ni tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim tumdi tuma tir o. O yiko kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka o nam mi ku mali tariga.
en: He was crowned king and given power and glory, so that all people of every nation and race would serve him. He will rule forever, and his kingdom is eternal, never to be destroyed.

dag: Amaa yi ni ti yɛn niŋ ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti daamiya bɛ maligu bimbina luhi, ka wurim bɛ binwɔɣila la, ka chɛ ŋ-ŋmaai bɛ Ashɛrim la luhi tiŋa, ka nyo bɛ wuna buɣim.
en: Instead, this is what you must do with these nations: rip down their altars, smash their sacred stones, cut down their sacred poles, and burn their idols.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣ pinaayopɔin dali, ka ŋariŋ maa daa kana ti tam Ararat Zoli zuɣu.
en: and in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day, the ark came to rest on the Ararat mountains.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛm zuɣulaannim zaa bɛn daa be pii la ni wum lala, ka zo nti kpe Ɛlibɛrit jɛmbu duu ti sɔɣi.
en: There were some people who lived at the Tower of Shechem. When they heard what had happened to Shechem, they gathered together in the safest room of the temple of the god El Berith.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana ŋɔ mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ŋɔ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zali ma ni n zaŋ wuhi ya ka yi ti doli li yi ni chani ni yi ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni.
en: These are all the laws that the Lord your God commanded me to teach you. Obey them in the land that you are about to enter and occupy.

dag: O ni daa lihi ʒiɛm o ni po pɔri shɛŋa, ka saɣim alikauli maa, ka lan zaŋ o nuu kpɛhi tuun shɛŋa ni ŋɔ zuɣu, o ku tiligi.
en: He broke his oath and the treaty he had made. He did all these things, and now he will not escape.

dag: Ka daa dii yiɣisi di saha maa n-labir o ba maa sani. O ni daa ti na be katiŋ ha kanna ka o ba maa nya o ka nambɔɣu gbaag o pam; ka o yiɣisi zo nti tuh o soli m-bɔbi gbaag o ni suhupiɛlli.
en: So he left and went to his father. While the son was still a long way off, his father saw him coming and felt sorry for him. So he ran to him and hugged and kissed him.

dag: Paɣ ŋuni pul ni ka maasim kpikpikpi lee yina? Ka ŋuni n-lee dɔɣi ko shɛli din kilim yiri alizanda ni na ŋɔ?.
en: Who gives birth to the sleet and the frost.

dag: Bɛ shihi vu m-miri gballi ni, ka bɛ nyɛviya miri bɛn tahiri kum na.
en: We feel death and the grave taking us in their grip.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa bi saɣi ka yɛl o, Lab kuli nti yɛl a yiŋnim a Duuma ni zo a nambɔɣu ka tum tuun kar shɛli ti a ŋɔ yɛla.
en: But Jesus would not let him. Instead, he told him, Go back home to your family and tell them how much the Lord has done for you and how kind he has been to you.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Jɛfita zuɣu na. Ka o daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti tim Giliad mini Manaasa tiŋgbana ni n-gari chaŋ Mizipa din be Giliad tiŋgban ni la n-daa yi Mizipa din be Giliad tiŋgban ni maa gari chaŋ Ammɔnnim tiŋgban ni.
en: Then the LORDs spirit came on Jephthah. He passed through Gilead and Manasseh, then through Mizpah in Gilead, and from there he crossed over to the Ammonites.

dag: Binnɛma ayi kɔtomsi din wuhiri ni Naawuni jilima be bɛ sani n-daa tam adaka maa zuɣusaa n-kul lihiri di zuɣusaa luɣ shɛli din booni Naawuni nambɔzɔbo shee la. Amaa ti ku tooi wuhi yɛla ŋɔ zaa gbinni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Above the Box were the winged creatures representing God's presence, with their wings spread over the place where sins were forgiven. But now is not the time to explain everything in detail.

dag: Zadok ŋun daa nyɛ nachimbil tɔbutuhiri biiŋa ni suhukpeendan la gba daa zaŋ o daŋ ni sapashinnim pisinaayi na.
en: Zadok was also in that group. He was a brave young soldier. He came with officers from his family.

dag: Bɛ daa mɛla gooni zali duri maa tooni zaŋ labi dundɔntitali polo, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pisinaanu.
en: To the north was a privacy wall meters long.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli niriba maa, Di simdi ka yi teeri dabisili ŋɔ yɛla, di nyɛla yi ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dahin shɛli ka yi dabitim bandi ni la, dama Yawɛ yiko nuu n-daa yihi ya nimaani maa. Di bi simdi ka yi ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din mali dabindi.
en: Moses said to the people: Remember this day in the month of Abib. It is the day when the Lord 's mighty power rescued you from Egypt, where you were slaves. Do not eat anything made with yeast.

dag: Zuŋɔ yi dim maa be Nɔb; o ni kpilim o nuu gahi Ziɔn Zoli din nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm zol la gbini.
en: This day the army will stop at Nob and prepare to fight against Mount Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

dag: N ni yaai n noli yɛli a zaligunim din yi a nol ni na zaa yɛla.
en: I will repeat the laws we have heard from you.

dag: Bɛ daa tam o yiko yɛla, ka tam o ni daa tiligi ba bɛ dimnim nuu ni dahin shɛl la yɛla;.
en: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.

dag: Yawɛ be katiŋ ka chɛ ninvuɣ biɛri, amaa o deeri wuntizɔriba suhigu.
en: When good people pray, the Lord listens, but he ignores those who are evil.

dag: Ka Mariama ŋun daa nyɛ Magdala tiŋbia maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa nyaandoliba maa, N nya ti Duuma! Ka yɛli ba Yisa ni daa yɛl o shɛm la zaa.
en: Mary Magdalene left and announced to the disciples, Ive seen the Lord. Then she told them what he said to her.

dag: Amaa yi zaa yi tɔɣisirila anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka ŋun bi niŋ yɛda bee ŋun ka yi kalinli ni kpɛna, yi zaa ni yɛri shɛm maa ni chih o suhu, ka yi zaa ni yɛri shɛm maa ni lan vih o.
en: But if everyone is prophesying when an unbeliever or outsider comes in, they are tested by all and called to account by all.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ka Naawuni Shia Kasi ku tooi deei Naawuni Shia Kasi pina; di nyɛla jɛrilim o sani hal ka o ku tooi baŋ di yɛla, dama di nyɛla Naawuni Shia Kasi ni wuhiri yɛl shɛŋa.
en: People who do not have Gods Spirit do not accept the things that come from his Spirit. They think these things are foolish. They cannot understand them, because they can only be understood with the Spirits help.

dag: O ni ŋma ba luhi kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi kpaŋa ŋ-ŋmari tibɔŋ ni tihi luhiri shɛm la, ka di lu kaman Lɛbanɔn ti suma ni luri shɛm la.
en: God will cut down his enemies. Like the tall trees of Lebanon he will cut them down with an ax.

dag: Amaa Lɔt ni daa ti yi Sɔdom dindahin shɛli, ka buɣim ni chilibi buɣim daa yi zuɣusaa na ti di bɛ zaa ha la.
en: On the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and killed them all.

dag: Bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani kalinli daa yiɣisila tusaayɔbu ni kɔbisiyi.
en: and they had , men and boys at least one month old.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti ti baŋdiba maa salima mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli.
en: Use only gold and fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool, for making these clothes.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa chaŋ Dauda sani Zikilag saha shɛl o ni daa bi lan tooi yiri palo gɔr o yubu, Kish bia Sool zuɣu la gba daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi shɛb bɛn daa sɔŋ o tuhi tɔbu la.
en: David was living in Ziklag, where he had gone to escape from King Saul. There he was joined by many experienced, reliable soldiers.

dag: Dama bia maa yi bi doli ma kuli, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ n-tooi labi m ba sani? N zɔri ni n nini nya zaɣ biɛ shɛli din yɛn paai m ba maa.
en: How can I go back to my father if the boy is not with me? I cannot bear to see this disaster come upon my father.

dag: Ka n daa po n suhuyiɣisili puuni yɛli, Bɛ kul ku nya vuhim shee n sani! .
en: God became angry and told the people, You will never enter my place of rest! .

dag: Ka o yiŋbihi maa daa yi n-doli solɔri maa laɣim bɛ ni nya ninvuɣ shɛb zaa na; ninvuɣ biɛri mini ninvuɣ suma hal ka amiliya lɔbu duu maa ti tiɣi salo.
en: So the servants went out into the streets and gathered all the people they could find, good and bad alike; and the wedding hall was filled with people.

dag: Ka naa Ivilmɛrɔdak daa kul tir o o dabisili kam laɣ dira hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: And each day, for as long as Jehoiachin lived, the king gave him enough money to pay for whatever he needed.

dag: dama dɔbba anu ka a pun kuli ka yi, ka hal a ni na be so yiŋ pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ gba pala a yidana; dindina a shiri yɛli yɛlimaŋli.
en: You have been married to five men, and the man you live with now is not really your husband. You have told me the truth.

dag: Amazia daa nyɛla ŋun tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, amaa o daa bi tum li ni o suhu zaa.
en: Even though Amaziah obeyed the Lord by doing right, he refused to be completely faithful.

dag: Ka di ni yiri ninvuɣ so tooni na maa yi ti nya omaŋa, ŋun zaŋmi daba ayopɔin niŋ o daɣiri ni yibu dabisa, ka paɣ o situra, ka su ko viɛlli n-yi daɣiri ni.
en: Seven days after the man gets well, he will be considered clean, if he washes his clothes and takes a bath in spring water.

dag: Amaa man kul tumdila din tuhi. Zom ma nambɔɣu, ka fa ma bahi.
en: As for me, I do what is right; be merciful to me and save me!.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyama, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka alɔbo titali lu a niriba min a paɣiba ni a bihi ni a ni su shɛlikam zaa zuɣu;.
en: Because you have done these terrible things, the Lord will severely punish the people in your kingdom, including your own family, and he will destroy everything you own.

dag: Sɛt daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pinaayi, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: In all, Seth lived years, and he died.

dag: Yisa min o tuumba maa ni daa ti lan laɣim ka bɛ bɔh o, Ti Duuma, a ni chɛ ka lzraɛlnim nam lan kpe bɛ nuu ni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: The apostles were all together. They asked Jesus, Lord, is this the time for you to give the people of Israel their kingdom again.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl neesim ni leei buɣim zilinli. Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni leei buɣim zilinli n-di o gɔhi mini suligunyinyari dahin yini.
en: God, the light of Israel, will become a fire. Israel's holy God will become a flame, which in a single day will burn up everything, even the thorns and thistles.

dag: Bɛ daa paaya nti nya ka kuɣili din daa yo siliga maa nol la biligimi ka chɛ di noli maa.
en: When they found the stone rolled away from the entrance.

dag: N suhiri Naawuni ni o tin ya yiko o Shia Kasi zuɣu, ka o kpaŋsi yi suhuri o jilima azichitali puuni.
en: I ask that he will strengthen you in your inner selves from the riches of his glory through the Spirit.

dag: Ka bɛ daa guui li zali hal ni asiba kaman Musa ni daa yɛli ba shɛm maa, ka di daa bi saɣim bee n-wɔɣi zunzuya.
en: As Moses had commanded, they kept what was left until the next day; it did not spoil or get worms in it.

dag: dama bɛn zaa piila bɛ bun ni na ti tɔhi, amaa pakoli ŋɔ ŋun zaŋla o duu ni o yiŋ zaa na ti tɔhi.
en: All of them are giving out of their spare change. But she from her hopeless poverty has given everything she had to live on.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Amaa o daa lee bi tummi kaman o ba min o ma ni daa tum shɛm la; dama o daa wurim o ba ni daa me Baal binwɔɣinli shɛli zal la.
en: He sinned against the Lord , but he was not as bad as his father or his mother Jezebel; he pulled down the image his father had made for the worship of Baal.

dag: Hal o ni daa kul wuhi shihira pam niriba maa sani maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa bi niŋ o yɛda.
en: Jesus had done many miraculous signs before the people, but they didnt believe in him.

dag: Bɛnkam niŋ bɛ buni naani ni lu, amaa wuntizɔriba ni zoori kaman vamaha la.
en: Those who trust in their riches will fall like dead leaves, but good people will blossom.

dag: Dama Masia ni, nir yi guni bee o yi bi guni di zaa shɛli ka buchi, amaa yɛda niŋbu din tumdi di tuma yurilim ni n-nyɛ din mali buchi.
en: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.

dag: Bɛ chaŋ Ijipti nti bɔri sɔŋsim, ka bi niŋ ma saawara. Bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpɛla Firawuna yuli ni bɛ nya sɔɣibu shee Ijipti.
en: They go to Egypt for help without asking for my advice. They want Egypt to protect them, so they put their trust in Egypt's king.

dag: Ka o daa booi kpam maa bahi Aduna zuɣu ni m-mal o ka o niŋ kasi.
en: He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord .

dag: Hagai daa yɛliya ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Di ku yuui ka n dam zuɣusaa mini dunia ni teeku ni tiŋgbani;.
en: Before long I will shake heaven and earth, land and sea.

dag: N ni ti yihi ya yi daɣiri zaa ni, ka chɛ ka yi bindira niŋ pam ka kum ku lan lu yi zuɣu.
en: I will save you from all your uncleanness, and I will summon the grain and make it grow abundantly so that you wont endure famine.

dag: Bi shɛb bɛn doli zaligu nyɛla bɛn mali yɛm. Amaa bi shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋ pahi pulaannim zuɣu nyɛla bɛn dihiri bɛ banim mini bɛ manim vi.
en: Young people who obey the law are intelligent. Those who make friends with good-for-nothings are a disgrace to their parents.

dag: Ka Hushai ŋun daa nyɛ Ariki nir ka nyɛ Dauda zɔsimo la daa chaŋ Absalom sani ti yɛl o, Naawuni dolimi naa nyɛvili! Naawuni dolimi naa nyɛvili.
en: David's friend Hushai came to Absalom and said, Long live the king! Long live the king.

dag: Di simdi ka yi be kasi n sani; dama man Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be kasi, ka woligi ya zuliyanim ni ni yi nyɛ n dahalali.
en: You shall be holy and belong only to me, because I am the Lord and I am holy. I have set you apart from the other nations so that you would belong to me alone.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka sapashin kpamba mini sapashim bihi bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili ni tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi daa ka Musa sanna.
en: Then the officers who had commanded the army went to Moses.

dag: Zahima pam zahimbu mini yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ka buchi, amaa zomiyala Naawuni.
en: You should not let your useless dreams and bragging bring you trouble. You should respect God.

dag: O daa chɛ ka zibisim zibigi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, bɛ ni daa zaɣis o yɛligu zuɣu.
en: He sent darkness to cover their land, but the Egyptians did not listen to him.

dag: Ka Dauda daa be mɔɣu maa ni ka wum ni Nabal chɛrila o piɛri kɔbiri.
en: David was in the desert when he heard that Nabal was cutting the wool from his sheep.

dag: O bi zaŋdi kaburi jaambɔn titali buri buŋgu bee n-zaŋdi naɣikɔra tɔroko nɔri nili, amaa kaburi jaambɔn bila ka o zaŋdi buri buŋgu, ka zaŋdi li ŋmari nili.
en: Does a farmer use large boards with sharp teeth to crush dill seeds? No, and he doesnt use a wagon to crush cumin seeds. A farmer uses a small stick to break the hulls from these seeds of grain.

dag: ka ti nyaandolitab bɛn be Rom daa wum ti damli ka kana hal ti paai luɣ shɛŋa din daa booni Apius Daa mini Yilikpɛra Ata la shee ni bɛ tuhi ti soli. Pool ni daa nya ba, ka o suhu kpaŋ ka o paɣiri Naawuni.
en: The believers in Rome heard about us and came as far as the towns of Market of Appius and Three Inns to meet us. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and was greatly encouraged.

dag: Amaa ka Ɛdomnim daa yɛl o, Yi ku kpe ti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gari, yi yi niŋ lala, ti ni ŋmɛn ya tɔbu.
en: But the Edomites answered, We refuse to let you pass through our country! If you try, we will march out and attack you.

dag: Ka yi yi gbaai do so ka o zaŋ o kpee paɣ doya, yin kumiya bɛ niriba ayi maa; doo maa min o ni zaŋ paɣ so doya maa, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: If a man is caught having intercourse with another man's wife, both of them are to be put to death. In this way you will get rid of this evil.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Naawuni daa ti yɛn zahim Ibrahimma ka bol o, Ibrahimma! Ka Ibrahimma garigi yɛli, N-nyɛ ma.
en: Some time later God tested Abraham; he called to him, Abraham! And Abraham answered, Yes, here I am.

dag: Bɛn daa fiɣis o maa ni daa yiɣisi zani bɛ daa bi zaŋ yɛtɔɣ biɛ shɛŋa n ni daa tɛhi ni bɛ ni zaŋ o tɔɣisi.
en: When the accusers took the floor, they didnt charge him with any of the crimes I had expected.

dag: Amaa ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa niŋ karimbaani, ka bi wuh o wumpaɣibo ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni ni daa niŋ shɛm ti o maa polo. Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni suhu daa yiɣisi pam bah o mini Judanim ni Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu.
en: But Hezekiah was too proud to respond appropriately to the kindness he had received, and he, along with Judah and Jerusalem, experienced anger.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛla daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Bɛlanima; ka Ashibɛl daŋ niriba nyɛ Ashibɛlnima; ka Ahiram daŋ niriba nyɛ Ahiramnima;.
en: Benjamins descendants according to their clans: from Bela, the Belaite clan; from Ashbel, the Ashbelite clan; from Ahiram, the Ahiramite clan.

dag: Naawuni ni daa ti yɛn tim o Bikpɛm la dunia ŋɔ ni na o daa yɛlimi: Naawuni malaikanim zaa, jɛmmiy o.
en: But then, when he brought his firstborn into the world, he said, All of Gods angels must worship him. .

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ teebul la zali pateesa maa nyaaŋa, ka zaŋ firilatamdigu la zali tuhi teebuli maa zaŋ labi nudirigu polo, ka zaŋ teebuli maa zali nuzaa polo.
en: Outside the Most Holy Place put the table against the north side of the Tent and the lampstand against the south side.

dag: Ka Yisifu yɛli, Naawuni di saɣi ka n niŋ lala! Kulla n ni nya pipia maa so sani maa kɔŋko n-ni leei n dabili; amaa yinim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ, kulimiya yi ba sani ni alaafee.
en: Joseph said, Oh, no! I would never do that! Only the one who had the cup will be my slave. The rest of you may go back safe and sound to your father.

dag: Niriba bɛn be zibisim ni baŋdi a daalahiziba tuma yɛla? Bee bɛ baŋd a tiliginsim sɔŋsim yɛla bɛ tamsim shee?.
en: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?.

dag: Yi bemi kaman yidaampaɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi zina! Yi bi mi ni ŋun zaŋ omaŋ leei dunia ŋɔ zo nyɛla Naawuni dima? Dinzuɣu ŋunkam bɔri ni o zaŋ omaŋ leei dunia ŋɔ zo, dilana zaŋ omaŋ leela Naawuni dima.
en: Unfaithful people! Don't you know that to be the world's friend means to be God's enemy? If you want to be the world's friend, you make yourself God's enemy.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun cham ti nya, ka dɔro maa yi yɛligi yili maa ni, di nyɛla dɔr biɛɣu n-lu yili maa ni maa, yili maa nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.
en: the priest shall go and look. If it has spread, the house is unclean.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Miriya ka yi tumdi yi wuntia tuma ni niriba nyari ya m-paɣiri ya di zuɣu; yi yi niŋdi lala, yi ku nya laara yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ sani.
en: Be careful! When you do something good, dont do it in front of others so that they will see you. If you do that, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa daa ti chɛ ka bɛ bu ba, ka ku ba Ribila din be Hamat tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Bɛ ni daa gbahi Judanim maa bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni kuli tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm m-bala.
en: The king of Babylon struck them down, killing them in Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was exiled from its land.

dag: N tarigimi do tiŋa; tim ma nyɛvili palli kaman a yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: I lie defeated in the dust; revive me, as you have promised.

dag: Ka Filistia tɔbbi shɛba daa chaŋ ti gu Mikimash solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: The Philistines sent a group of soldiers to defend Michmash Pass.

dag: Yawɛ guli bɛn nyɛ tarimba. N daa be muɣisigu ni, ka o tiligi ma.
en: The Lord protects the helpless; when I was in danger, he saved me.

dag: Zaŋm bindira balibu kam gba n-niŋ ŋariŋ maa ni, ka di ti nyɛ a mini ba bindirigu.
en: Take some from every kind of food and stow it as food for you and for the animals.

dag: So daa bi zo a nambɔɣu n-niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim shɛli ti a nambɔzɔbo zuɣu. Amaa bɛ daa zaŋ a mi ti bahi samban ni, dama bɛ daa zaɣis a mi bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a dahin shɛli maa.
en: No one took enough pity on you to do any of these things for you. When you were born, no one loved you. You were thrown out in an open field.

dag: Bɛ ni ti pirig a situra, ka yeeg a yɛ viɛla zaa.
en: They will strip your clothing from you and remove your beautiful crown.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ ya niŋ ka vibi n suhuyiɣisili buɣim niŋ ya, ka yi ti nyɛligi di puuni.
en: Yes, I will gather them in Jerusalem, build a fire under them, and melt them with my anger.

dag: Siria naa mi ni ti kana ti liri Ijiptinima, amaa o ni ti kɔŋ nasara ka ŋmaligi lab kul o ya.
en: The northern king will attack the southern kingdom. But he will lose, and then he will go back to his own country.

dag: Yi yi ni dol o fukumsi zalikpan shɛlikam n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka jɛmd o ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shihi zaa.
en: The Lord says, You must listen carefully to the commands I give you today: You must love the Lord your God, and serve him with all your heart and all your soul. If you do that.

dag: Bɛ ni shɛb yila katinsi na, dinzuɣu n yi chɛ ka bɛ kuli ni kum bɛ ni ti tarigi sol ni.
en: If I send them home without feeding them, they will faint as they go, because some of them have come a long way.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ kuɣ viɛla pie taba n-dihi duu maa nachiinsi. Parivaim salima ka bɛ daa zaŋ dihi li nachiinsi.
en: He studded the room with precious stones for beauty; the gold was from Parvaim.

dag: Di saha ka chinchin shɛli din daa yili Naawuni jɛmbu duu sunsuuni la daa cheei di zuɣusaa hal ti siɣi di tiŋli. Ka tiŋgbani daa dam ka tampima bɔɣi.
en: Look, the curtain of the sanctuary was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook, the rocks split.

dag: Yɛnnim chɛ ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa viɛla; ka bɛ zaŋdi balima yɛtɔɣa niŋdi bɛ noya ni pahira.
en: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.

dag: N daa tɛhiya ni m biɛhigu nyaɣisim saha maa, n yɛn yila dunia yili chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka ku paai n saha.
en: I thought that in the prime of life I was going to the world of the dead, Never to live out my life.

dag: Amaa m Ba ni yɛn tim Sɔŋda so ŋun nyɛ o Shia Kasi, ka o zaŋ n yuli kana la ni ti wuhi ya binshɛɣukam zaa; ka n ni daa wuhi ya shɛlikam zaa la, o ni ti teei ya li.
en: The Companion, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you everything and will remind you of everything I told you.

dag: Bɛ chanila gbala ni yuŋ ti buɣiri kpiimba baɣiri, ka ŋubiri kuruchunim nimdi; ka piɛbiri buɣa maligu nimdi bim.
en: who sit in tombs and spend the night among rocks; who eat swines flesh with broth of unclean meat in their bowls.

dag: Ka wahu maa daa tuhi kom o nol ni na kaman mɔɣili kom la ni di zo n-doli paɣ maa ti di o.
en: Then the dragon poured water out of its mouth like a river. It poured the water toward the woman so that the flood would carry her away.

dag: Ka Nail Mɔɣili maa puuni zahim zaa daa kpi n-niŋ kom maa ni, ka di nyɔni, ka Ijiptinim daa kɔŋ Nail Mɔɣili maa ni kom maa nyubu; ka ʒim daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: The fish in the river died, and it smelled so bad that the Egyptians could not drink from it. There was blood everywhere in Egypt.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa yɛli bɛ zaa, Yɛlimaŋli, kom ni ka man baptaiziri ya, amaa ŋun be n nyaaŋa kanna mali yiko gari ma, hal ka man pɔri gba ni n gbaag o namda mal o ka o pirigi; ŋun ni ti zaŋla Naawuni Shia Kasi mini buɣim baptaizi ya.
en: So John said to all of them, I baptize you with water, but someone is coming who is much greater than I am. I am not good enough even to untie his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini maligumaaniba kpamba daa lɔri nia ni bɛ gbaai Yisa, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni bɛna ka o ŋahi ŋahili maa dalim maa, amaa ka daa lee zɔri niriba.
en: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses knew that Jesus was talking about them when he was telling this story. They wanted to arrest him right then, but they were afraid of the people.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Judanim la mini bɛ yaansi su n zoya ni tiŋgbana la. N ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn jɛmdi ma n-yɛn be nimaani.
en: I will bring out offspring from Jacob, and from Judah, heirs to my mountains. My chosen ones will take possession; my servants will dwell there.

dag: Di saha maa n daa ʒiɛla yi mini Yawɛ sunsuuni ni n zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa maa tɔɣisi ya, dama yi daa zɔrila dabiɛm buɣim maa zuɣu, ka daa bi du zoli maa zuɣu. Ka o daa yɛli.
en: But you were afraid of the fire. And you did not go up the mountain. So I stood between you and the Lord to tell you what the Lord said. He said.

dag: Dan zuliya bɛn daa be nimaani zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinunaayopɔin ni kɔbisiyɔbu. Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn yɛn kpalim nyaaŋa doli gbilligbilli ni bɛ tuuta.
en: There are , men in Dans camp. They will be the last to move when the people travel from place to place. Each group will have its own flag.

dag: Di biɛɣu pia nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa.
en: Ten days later the Lord spoke to me;.

dag: Amaa yɛl shɛŋa yi ni pun mi la zuɣu ka n niŋ suhukpeeni n-sab gbaŋ ŋɔ ni n teei ya di yɛla. Naawuni ni niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ n ni la zuɣu.
en: But in this letter I have been quite bold about certain subjects of which I have reminded you. I have been bold because of the privilege God has given me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yɛli ni ti kpe ŋariŋ n-yiɣisi chaŋ Itali, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Pool m-pahi dansarika shɛb zuɣu n-ti sapashin so ŋun yuli daa booni Julius. O daa sula tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa booni Naa Siiza Agasitus Maŋmaŋ Tɔbbihi la fukumsi.
en: When it was determined that we were to sail to Italy, Paul and some other prisoners were placed in the custody of a centurion named Julius of the Imperial Company.

dag: Barina ni paai tin shɛli maa lumi dahim, ka yili kam zaa dunoya kpari, ka so ku tooi kpe di ni.
en: In the city everything is in chaos, and people lock themselves in their houses for safety.

dag: So nahu yi ʒe n-ti o kpee nahu daŋa ka o kpi, bɛn kɔhimi naɣ nɛɔŋ maa m-pirigi liɣiri maa ti taba, ka lan pirigi naɣ kpiŋ maa gba ti taba.
en: If your bull kills someone else's, yours must be sold. Then the money from your bull and the meat from the dead bull must be divided equally between you and the other owner.

dag: A nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi bɛ tuma viɛnyɛliŋga? Bɛ yɛn jɛmdila nanima ka pa ni tarimba.
en: Show me someone who does a good job, and I will show you someone who is better than most and worthy of the company of kings.

dag: Ka puu maa atam kpuɣibu saha daa ti paai, ka o tim o yiŋbi so padiriba maa sani ni bɛ ti zaŋ o puu maa daatam shɛli ti o na.
en: When it was harvest time, he sent a servant to get his share of the grapes.

dag: Di saha maa ka anab shɛb daa yi Jɛrusalɛm chaŋ Antiɔk.
en: About that same time some prophets went from Jerusalem to Antioch.

dag: Ka Shitirai ŋun daa nyɛ Sharɔn nir la daa lihiri naɣ shɛb bɛn daa be Sharɔn ka Shafat ŋun daa nyɛ Adilai bia la daa lihiri naɣ shɛb bɛn be vinvamli ni.
en: Shitrai from Sharon was in charge of the cattle around Sharon. Shaphat son of Adlai was in charge of the cattle in the valleys.

dag: Amaa tinim ni lo kpara gari Izraɛlnim tooni chaŋ ti nya ʒiishee ti ba, ka ti bihi be bɛ ni me goma gili tin shɛŋa ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zuɣu la ni.
en: Then we will eagerly fight in front of the Israelites until we have brought them into their place. Our children will live in the fortified cities because of the lands inhabitants.

dag: Bɛ yuri maa ni ti galisi hal ka bɛ taŋkpagbiligu ti lim ya, ka wɔribariba mini bɛ tɔrokɔnim ni bɛ chɛchɛbunsi vuri ti chɛ ka yi dikiya sɔhigi, bɛ ni kpe yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kaman nira ni kpɛri tin shɛli din wurim ni shɛm la.
en: The clouds of dust raised by their horses will cover you. The noise of their horses pulling wagons and chariots will shake your walls as they pass through the gates of the ruined city.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ di niŋ bɛn daa nyɛ yi tab la alahiziba, yi ni bi lan doli ba tumdi tuun yoya ŋɔ zuɣu, dina n-chɛ ka bɛ saɣindi yi yuya.
en: Now those friends think it is strange that you no longer join them in all the wild and wasteful things they do. And so they say bad things about you.

dag: Ka o daa lan mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi n-zaŋ li pie tab kulis ayi n-gili lansi maa zaɣ yini n-zaŋ li pili biŋkpilli din tam daanya daantalisi la zaɣ yini zuɣu; ka daa lan niŋ din la gba lala.
en: with two rows of designs that looked like pomegranates.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlimiya Izraɛlnim zaa ni goli ŋɔ biɛɣu pia dali yiliyidan kam ŋun bom piɛbila o min o malibu zuɣu, ka yili kam ti mali piɛbila.
en: Give these instructions to the whole community of Israel: On the tenth day of this month each man must choose either a lamb or a young goat for his household.

dag: n-yɛli ba ni bɛ zaŋm bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaanahi mini biɛɣ pinaanu dabisa n-leei vuhim dabisa yuuni kam.
en: and told them: Each year you must celebrate on both the fourteenth and the fifteenth of Adar.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun bi guni, amaa ka doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm, Naawuni ku lih o kaman ŋun guni?.
en: Those who are not Jews are not circumcised. But if they do what the law says, it is as if they were circumcised.

dag: ka Abija daa laɣim dɔbba bɛn mali suhukpeeni din ni tuhi tɔbu ka lan nyɛ bɛn mi tɔb tuhibu ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinahi ni bɛ chaŋ tɔbu tuhibu. Ka Jɛrɔbɔam mi daa laɣim tɔbutuhiri biinsi bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinii ni bɛ tuhi taba.
