en: Abijah's army had , troops, and Jeroboam met him in battle with , troops.

dag: ka niŋ ba yiko ni bɛ karit alizin biɛri niriba zuɣu bahira.
en: and you will have authority to drive out demons.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni daa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni di binshɛɣukam zaa naai.
en: The heavens and the earth and all who live in them were completed.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o wain booriba kpɛm la labis o tuma ni, ka o lan zaŋdi ŋun Firawuna binnyura pipia maa ni binnyura maa ti tir o.
en: He restored the wine steward to his former position.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ biŋkpam maa pa bimbiha zuɣu, ka o daa zaŋ biŋkpam maa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: They placed these fat pieces on the animals breasts, and Aaron completely burned them on the altar.

dag: Ka ti suhiri Naawuni ni yi di tum birigi, ka di pala din wuhiri ni tinim nyaŋla timaŋ buɣisibu, amaa di lee nyɛla din ni chɛ ka yi tum din tuhi hal di ni kul be kaman ti nyɛla bɛn bi nyaŋ timaŋ buɣisibu maa la.
en: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni daŋ tila Judanim nasara, din ni chɛ ka Naa Dauda zuliya mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni yɛn nya jilima shɛli ku gari Judanim dini.
en: The Lord will save the people of Judah first, so the people in Jerusalem will not be able to brag too much. Davids family and the other people who live in Jerusalem will not be able to brag that they are better than the other people in Judah.

dag: Manaasa bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Asiriɛl, o mam ŋun daa nyɛ Aram paɣ la ni daa dɔɣi bi so, ŋuna n-daa lan dɔɣi Makiri ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad ba la.
en: By his Aramean concubine, Manasseh had two sons, Asriel and Machir. Machir was the father of Gilead.

dag: Ka ti yaannim maa mini Jɔshua daa ti zaŋ li kuli Naawuni ni daa yiɣisi zuliya shɛb ka chɛ tiŋgban shɛli ti ba la ni. Nimaani ka bɛ daa mal li be hal ti paai Naa Dauda ʒiɛmani saha.
en: Later on, our ancestors who received the tent from their fathers carried it with them when they went with Joshua and took over the land from the nations that God drove out as they advanced. And it stayed there until the time of David.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a nya bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm? A nya Izraɛlnim ni tumdi din chihiri pam shɛm kpe ni bɛ kari ma bahi katiŋa ka chɛ n jɛmbu duu ŋɔ? Amaa a na ni nya din chihiri shɛŋa din galisi pam gari lala.
en: God said to me, Mortal man, do you see what is happening? Look at the disgusting things the people of Israel are doing here, driving me farther and farther away from my holy place. You will see even more disgraceful things than this.

dag: Bɛ daa lan mali di daantalis anu mini di bansi, ka niŋ salima pa daantalisi maa zuɣuri ni mini di mihi zuɣu, amaa di ni yɛn tamdi bina anu shɛŋa zuɣu la dina, daanya ka bɛ daa zaŋ mal li.
en: They made five posts, covered them completely with gold, and set each of them on a gold-covered bronze stand. Finally, they attached hooks for the curtain.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yisa daa bi lan saɣi yiri palo gɔri Yɛhudianim maa ni, amaa ka daa yi nimaani chaŋla luɣ shɛli din miri yɔɣu ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Ifriim la, ka o min o nyaandoliba ti be nimaani.
en: Therefore, Jesus was no longer active in public ministry among the Jewish leaders. Instead, he left Jerusalem and went to a place near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim, where he stayed with his disciples.

dag: Di yi nyɛla nahu bee piɛɣu, yin di kɔrigiy o min o bia maa zaa dahin yini.
en: But you will not slaughter an ox or sheep and its offspring on the same day.

dag: Di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia yɔhim ya. O ku tooi tiligi ya n nuu ni.
en: Don't be fooled by Hezekiah. He can't save you.

dag: mini dɔr biɛɣu din be situra ni bee yil ni.
en: for mildew on pieces of cloth or in a house.

dag: Tahima shɛlikam bɛ ni niŋ zaŋ chaŋ o gbaabu polo ku di nasara. Hal niriba yi nya o, dabiɛm gbahiri ba mi.
en: Merely a glimpse of this monster makes all courage melt.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ ninsal bemi kaman ti ni be shɛm, ka mi zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu, ka di pa shɛli ka o ti pɔhigi nyɛvili tia la walli di m-be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The LORD God said, The human being has now become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, so he doesnt stretch out his hand and take also from the tree of life and eat and live forever.

dag: Ka n zoli maa ni nam vinvamli shɛli sɔŋ maa zuɣu ni chɛ ka yi guui kaman yi ni daa pun guui guuri shɛli tiŋgbani dambu la ni Juda naa Yuzaia saha la. Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti zaŋ wuntizɔriba m-pa omaŋ zuɣu kana.
en: You will escape through this valley that divides the mountain in two. You will flee as your ancestors did when the earthquake struck in the time of King Uzziah of Judah. The Lord my God will come, bringing all the angels with him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa du zo shɛli zuɣu ka boli ninvuɣ shɛb o ni bɔra, ka bɛ daa ka o sanna.
en: Then Jesus went up a hill and called to himself the men he wanted. They came to him.

dag: Ka dilan naan yili yila yɛli niriba, N daa tumla alahichi, ka bi lan gbibi yɛlimaŋli, amaa ka bɛ daa bi labisi di samli yo ma.
en: He will tell everyone, I sinned. I changed good into bad, but God didnt give me the punishment I deserved!.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa chɛ ka bɛ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti sɔɣ dɔni gili Gibia.
en: So the Israelites put some soldiers in hiding around Gibeah.

dag: Ka o daa vaai yiɣisi n-lɛb lu tiŋa n-fo n-do paɣ maa naba ni. Paɣ maa naba maa ni ka o daa yiɣ lɛb lu. O ni daa yiɣ lɛb lu luɣ shɛli maa, nimaani ka o daa dii kpi.
en: He sank to his knees, fell down and lay still at her feet. At her feet he sank to his knees and fell; he fell to the ground, dead.

dag: Ŋunkam bɔri ni o doli ma ka bi zaɣis o ba min o ma ni o paɣa ni o mabi dɔbba ni o tizɔpaɣiba ni hal zaŋ tabili omaŋmaŋ nyɛvili gba, o ku tooi niŋ n nyaandola.
en: Whoever comes to me and doesnt hate father and mother, spouse and children, and brothers and sisters—yes, even ones own life—cannot be my disciple.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa paai Jɛrusalɛm, o daa laɣimla Juda mini Bɛnjamin zuliya ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinii ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Izraɛlnim deei nam maa ti o.
en: When King Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he called together , of the best soldiers from the tribes of Benjamin and Judah. He intended to go to war and restore his control over the northern tribes of Israel.

dag: N tizɔpaɣa ni n daamiliya, a yurilim kpe ma nyaɣisim pam. M bɔr a yurilim gari wain. A tulaale nyom viɛl gari tulaale kam nyom.
en: Your love delights me, my sweetheart and bride. Your love is better than wine; your perfume more fragrant than any spice.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Bɛ yi ku niŋ Anabi Musa min anabinim yɛligu yɛda, hal so yi neei kum ni chaŋ ti yɛli ba, bɛ ku niŋ o gba yɛligu yɛda. .
en: But Abraham said to him, If your brothers wont listen to Moses and the prophets, they wont listen to someone who comes back from the dead.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛmnim mini Bɛtimilɔnim zaa daa laɣim chaŋ Shɛkɛm oki tia din nyɛ bɛ tiŋgban la gbini nti leei Abimilɛk nam.
en: Then all the leaders in Shechem and the house of Millo came together. Everyone gathered beside the big tree of the pillar in Shechem and made Abimelech their king.

dag: A zaligunim maa nyɛla n fali sahakam. Dina n-tiri ma suhupiɛlli.
en: Your commandments are my eternal possession; they are the joy of my heart.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaɣisi Balaam ni bɔri ni o niŋ shɛm maa; ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa naɣi zaŋla o noli yɛlibu maa leei alibarika tin ya, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa yuri ya zuɣu.
en: But the Lord your God refused to do what Balaam asked. Instead, the Lord changed the curse into a blessing for you, because the Lord your God loves you.

dag: Ka o daa ti yɛli ba, N nyaya ka yi ba bi lan bɔri n yɛla kaman o ni daa yi bɔri n yɛla shɛm la. Amaa m ba Naawuni la kul be n sani.
en: He said to them, I have noticed that your father is not as friendly toward me as he used to be; but my father's God has been with me.

dag: A mi dunia ŋɔ yɛliŋ ni nyɛ shɛm? A yi mi dimbɔŋɔ zaa, nyin yɛlim ma!.
en: And how large is the earth? Tell me, if you know!.

dag: Di saha ka Bɔaz daa yɛli Rut, M bia, chɛ ka n nyih a, di lan chaŋ so puu ni nti yihi kayiha ka pa ni m puu ŋɔ ni. Kul be paɣiba ŋɔ sani kpe n-tumm a tuma.
en: Then Boaz said to Ruth, Let me give you some advice. Don't gather grain anywhere except in this field. Work with the women here;.

dag: Ka n tin ya suhudoo yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka yi ti dɔni tiŋa, ka so ku varisi ya. N ni ti yihi biŋkɔb biɛri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka so ti ku lo tɔbu n-kpe yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: I will give you peace in your land, and you can sleep without being afraid of anyone. I will get rid of the dangerous animals in the land, and there will be no more war there.

dag: ka ti yiɣisi chaŋ Bɛtɛl. M bɔri ni m mɛla bimbini nimaani zali Naawuni so ŋun daa deei n suhigu n nandahima nyabu dali, ka be n sani n ni chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam la.
en: We are going to leave here and go to Bethel, where I will build an altar to the God who helped me in the time of my trouble and who has been with me everywhere I have gone.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa chɛ ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa niriba leei daba.
en: and made everyone the king's slaves.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn kpalim maa niŋ o mabia Abishai nuu ni ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Ammɔnnim maa.
en: He put the rest of the Israelite army under his brother Abishais command. These soldiers went out to fight against the Ammonite army.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyama, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka alɔbo titali lu a niriba min a paɣiba ni a bihi ni a ni su shɛlikam zaa zuɣu;.
en: So now, the Lord will soon punish your people with terrible suffering. He will punish your children, your wives, and all your property.

dag: Tiŋgbani, sɔhigim ti Duuma tooni. Sɔhigim ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ tooni.
en: Tremble, earth, at the Lord's coming, at the presence of the God of Jacob.

dag: N tuhi tuhiri suŋ; n zo tizɔbo la naai; n gbib yɛda niŋbu la.
en: I have done my best in the race, I have run the full distance, and I have kept the faith.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti yɛli Musa, Siɣimi ti saɣisi niriba maa, di yi pa lala bɛ ni kab kana ni bɛ ti nya man Yawɛ, ka bɛ pam ni kpi.
en: Then he said, Moses, go and warn the people not to cross the boundary that you set at the foot of the mountain. They must not cross it to come and look at me, because if they do, many of them will die.

dag: Amaa n kul ni mali suhupiɛlli sahakam, n ni yili yila paɣi Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: I will always tell people how great God is. I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu Masia ni daa yɛn ka dunia ŋɔ ni na, o daa yɛli Naawuni: A bi bɔri biŋkɔbiri sara maligu mini sara malibu balibu kam, amaa ninsal niŋgbuŋ ka a zaŋ ti ma.
en: So when Christ came into the world he said, You dont want sacrifices and offerings, but you have prepared a body for me.

dag: M bɔhirila bɔhigu ŋɔ: Bɛ daa bi wum? Bɛ daa wumya ni yɛlimaŋli; dama di sabiya: Bɛ kukoya damli gili dunia ŋɔ zaa; ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa paai dunia ŋɔ tarisi zaa.
en: But I ask: Is it true that they did not hear the message? Of course they did—for as the scripture says: The sound of their voice went out to all the world; their words reached the ends of the earth.

dag: Man Yawɛ maŋmaŋ ni wuh a zuliya maa zaa, ka chɛ ka bɛ nyamma yɛligi pam.
en: I will teach your children and make them successful.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnima n-nyɛ din tari ninsal daɣiri, amaa nir yi bi doli ni paɣibu kali soli m-paɣir o nuhi ka diri bindirigu, din bi tar o daɣiri.
en: These are what make you unclean. Eating without washing your hands will not make you unfit to worship God.

dag: Ka Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya maa daa yɛli, Ti ni niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zali tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ni ti niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The Gadites and the Reubenites answered, Well do just as the LORD has spoken to your servants.

dag: Bɛtilihɛmnim mini Nɛtɔfanim daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihiwɛiayika.
en: from the towns of Bethlehem and Netophah:.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti booni Jɛrusalɛm la Yawɛ nam ʒiishee, ka zuliya kam zaa ti laɣim ka Yawɛ tooni na Jɛrusalɛm maa, ka bɛ ti ku lan niŋ tipawumli n-doli bɛ maŋmaŋ suhuyubu din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu la.
en: When that time comes, Jerusalem will be called The Throne of the Lord , and all nations will gather there to worship me. They will no longer do what their stubborn and evil hearts tell them.

dag: N ni zaŋ n ni po ni n ni zaŋ shɛli ti Yawɛ n-ti o, o niriba zaa sani.
en: Ill keep the promises I made to the LORD in the presence of all Gods people.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim maa daa tooi niŋ bɛ dimnim maa bɛ ni bɔri shɛm. Bɛ daa zaŋla takɔbiri ku bɛ dimnim maa.
en: So the Jews could do what they wanted with their enemies. They attacked them with swords and slaughtered them.

dag: N yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ wuhirila n ʒiɛyimtali n suhu ni, ka n ni mi shɛli dina, ka n yɛn yɛli ni n suhu zaa.
en: My words come from a virtuous heart; my lips speak knowledge clearly.

dag: Bɛ ni ti labina ti ʒini m mahim. Bɛ ni ti yirigi puma kaman sambani puu la. Bɛ ni ti wali wala kaman wain tia la, ka bɛ nyom viɛlim ni ti ŋmanila Lɛbanɔn wain nyom viɛlim.
en: You will rest in my shade, and your grain will grow. You will blossom like a vineyard and be famous as the wine from Lebanon.

dag: Ka wula ka man Dauda ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ lee lan yɛn yɛli yaha zaŋ chaŋ a ni tibigi ma shɛm ŋɔ polo? A mi a dabili.
en: What more can I say? You have done so much for me. And I am only your servant. You know that.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa lan kpahi ŋarima din zɔri pam zali Ɛziɔngɛba din miri Ɛlat, ka be Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kulinol ni la.
en: King Solomon also built ships at Ezion Geber. This town is near Elath on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.

dag: Man Pool mini Silvanus ni Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Tɛsalɔnaika cheechi niriba bɛn nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni su shɛb la. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: Greetings from Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church of those in Thessalonica, who are in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Grace and peace be yours.

dag: Di nyaaŋa yi ni ti be n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim la ni, ka ti leei n niriba, ka n gba nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: You will once again live in the land I gave your ancestors; you will be my people, and I will be your God.

dag: Di saha ka n daa zaŋ wain duɣuri mini pipihi zali Rɛkabinim maa ka yɛli ba, Nyumiya wain.
en: I set out some large bowls full of wine together with some cups, and then I said to the Rechabites, Have some wine.

dag: Amaa n na ʒi n-zo ka chɛ piɛgulibo din nyɛ a ni zaŋ tuun shɛli ti ma maa bee m-bɔri ni zaɣ biɛɣu paa ba. A mi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din yiri n nol ni na; dama di daa niŋla a ninni.
en: Yet I didnt urge you to bring disaster; I didnt want the calamity to happen. You know what comes out of my mouth; its always before you.

dag: Suhuyiɣisililana tumdila jɛrilim, ka yɛndan mi nyɛ ŋun be baalim.
en: A quick-tempered person does stupid things, but it is also true that people dont like anyone who quietly plans evil.

dag: Ahitɔfɛl daa nyɛla naa Saawaralana, ka Hushai ŋun daa nyɛ Ariki nir la daa nyɛ naa zo sumo.
en: Ahithophel was the kings counselor. Hushai was the kings friend. Hushai was from the Arkites.

dag: Ninsal ni tooi mali buchi Naawuni sani? Ka hal ŋun mali yɛm ni tooi mali buchi o sani?.
en: Does God need our help? Even the wisest of us is not really useful to him.

dag: Man Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa zahim zahin shɛli maa m-bala. To, nyin Bɛlitishaaza, wuhim ma di gbinni. Dama baŋdiba zaa bɛn be n tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni so kani n-ni tooi wuhi ma di gbinni, amaa nyin ni tooi, dama wun shɛb bɛn be kasi shia be a ni.
en: Daniel, that was the dream that none of the wise men in my kingdom were able to understand. But I am sure that you will understand what it means, because the holy gods have given you some special powers.

dag: Ko zurili nyaɣisa, ka nir ni sɔɣi di bindir shɛli nyaɣisa.
en: Stolen water is sweet; food eaten in secret is pleasant.

dag: O suhu daa lan yiɣisi bahi Ayuba zɔnim ata la gba zuɣu bɛ ni daa bi tooi garigi Ayuba maa zuɣu; hal bɛ ni daa yɛli ni Ayuba mali galimi maa zaa yoli.
en: He was also angry with Job's three friends for not being able to prove that Job was wrong.

dag: Yi bi mi ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ daa lola alikauli din ka lɔrigibu n-zaŋ nam ti Dauda min o bidibisi ni bɛ su Izraɛlnim ʒiɛmani kam ni?.
en: You should know that the Lord , the God of Israel, gave David and his sons the right to be king over Israel forever. God gave this right to David with an agreement of salt.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab min o niriba maa daa vu m-miri ni bɛ ti tuhi Sirianim maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi guui.
en: Joab and his soldiers attacked the Syrians, and the Syrians ran from them.

dag: Pamiya buŋ nyaampara ti ma. Ka bɛ daa pa buŋ maa nyaampara ti o ka o ba.
en: Put a saddle on my donkey, he told them. After they did, he got on the donkey.

dag: Naawuni lo alikauli o luɣ kasi shee yɛli, N kpiɔŋ zuɣu, n ni pirigi Shɛkɛm; ka zaŋ Sukɔt Vinvamli tari.
en: God has made this promise in his Temple : I will win the war and rejoice in victory! I will divide this land among my people. I will give them Shechem. I will give them Succoth Valley.

dag: Chɛ ka a tuma yi zahira a daba sani; ka chɛ ka a jilima ŋɔ yi zahira bɛ bihi sani.
en: Let your servants see the wonderful things you can do for them. And let their children see your glory.

dag: Dama zuliya tital dini n-lee beni m-mali wuni ka di wuni maa miri ba kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni miri ti shɛm saha shɛli ti yi ti suh o ŋɔ?.
en: After all, is there any great nation that has gods as close to it as the LORD our God is close to us whenever we call to him?.

dag: Pool daa lan yɛli, N ni daa ti lab Jɛrusalɛm na nti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu suhiri Naawuni saha shɛli.
en: Later, I came back to Jerusalem. I was praying in the Temple area, and I saw a vision.

dag: Abana mini Faaripa mɔɣa din be Damaskus la bi so koma zaa din be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni? N naan dii ku chaŋ nimaani nti mim ka nya alaafee? Dinzuɣu ka o suhu daa yiɣisi pam ka o ŋmaligi chaŋ.
en: Arent the rivers in Damascus, the Abana and the Pharpar, better than all Israels waters? Couldnt I wash in them and get clean? So he turned away and proceeded to leave in anger.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi ti yɛli, Ti mali yɛm, Naawuni n-ni nyaŋ o, pa daadam.
en: You men cannot say that you have found wisdom. The answer to Jobs arguments must come from God, not people.

dag: Din kariya, ka n yɛli ni yi mali yɛlimaŋli. Ka pa ni n kpimi, n kul ku bahi n nimmaŋtali maa.
en: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lo o zoligɔnima n-zaŋ o niŋ gampiliga ni n-zaŋ o tahi ti ti Babilɔn naa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o niŋ duu ni di chɛ ka bɛ ku lan wum o kukoli Izraɛl zoya zuɣu yaha.
en: They put him in a cage and took him to the king of Babylonia. They kept him under guard, so that his roar would never be heard again on the hills of Israel.

dag: Bɛ gbala n-nyɛ bɛ yinsi sahakam. Nimaani ka bɛ kul yɛn be ʒiɛmani kam ni hal bɛ ni daa kul deei tiŋgbani paliti n-leei bɛ din la zaa yoli.
en: The grave will be their new home forever. And how much land they owned will not make any difference.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ, ka nyɛ n ni mali so nyuri bara. Nyini n-nyɛ n sɔɣisili shee m muɣisigu saha, dunia luɣilikam niriba ni ti ka a sanna ti yɛli, Ti yaannim daa bi di binshɛli fali n-naɣ pahila ʒiri mini binyoya din ka buchi.
en: Our Lord , you are the one who gives me strength and protects me like a fortress when I am in trouble. People will come to you from distant nations and say, Our ancestors worshiped false and useless gods.

dag: Amaa yi bi shɛb yi ni yɛli ni bɛ ni gbahi ba chaŋ la, n ni zaŋ ba kulisi nimaani ka bɛ ti baŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni ʒiɛm maa.
en: You were worried that your own children would be captured. But I, the Lord , will let them enter the land you have rejected.

dag: Nuhu bidibisi bɛn daa yi ŋariŋ maa ni na n-daa nyɛ: Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt. Ham daa nyɛla Keenan ba.
en: Noahs sons came out of the boat with him. Their names were Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

dag: Ohola ni daa kul nyɛ m paɣa maa zaa yoli, o daa na kul tumdila pagɔrisigu tuma. O kɔre daa kul bela o mamanim bɛn nyɛ Asirianim.
en: Then Oholah became unfaithful to me—she began to live like a prostitute. She began to want her lovers. She saw the Assyrian soldiers.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ naa maa nambɔɣu, ka o ku samli maa zaa o min o sunsuuni, ka chɛ ka o chaŋ.
en: The king felt sorry for him and let him go free. He even told the official that he did not have to pay back the money.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ olivi tihi dari m-mali dasara, ka di nyɛ zaɣ mɔɣiri n-zaŋ sa sunsuuni dunol ni.
en: For the entrance to the main room a rectangular doorframe of olive wood was made.

dag: Daadam, yi mabihi mini yi zuliya niriba ni yi tab Izraɛlnim bɛn be tinzun tiŋ ni ŋɔ zaa ka Jɛrusalɛmnim yɛra, Bɛ chaŋ katiŋa ka chɛ Yawɛ. Tinim ka bɛ zaŋ tiŋgbani ŋɔ ti ni ti su li.
en: Son of man, remember your brothers, the family of Israel. They were forced to leave their country, but I will bring them back. But now, the people living in Jerusalem are saying, Stay far away from the Lord . This land was given to us—it is ours.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninʒeensinima, o ni ti siɣisi ba; ka ŋunkam mi mali karimbaani ni ti nya filiŋ; ka niriba ti duhila Yawɛ kɔŋko dindali maa.
en: When that day comes, everyone who is proud will be put down. Only the Lord will be honored.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli ŋun duɣi bindirigu maa, Zaŋmi n ni di zaŋ nim shɛli ti a ka yɛl a ni a zaŋ li zali di ko la na.
en: Samuel said to the cook, Bring the piece of meat I gave you, which I told you to set aside.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ niriba alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Naa Dauda yaaŋa n-ni bala yɔɣɔ.
en: The crowds were all amazed at what Jesus had done. Could he be the Son of David? they asked.

dag: yi yi bi birigi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo n-doli jɛmdi wuna ka chɛ n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: But you must never disobey them in any way, or worship and serve other gods.

dag: Ŋun daa pah ayopɔin n-su chira ayopɔin ni n-daa nyɛ Hɛlɛz ŋun daa nyɛ Pɛlɔn nira ka yi Ifriim zuliya ni na la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: in the seventh month, Helez from Pelon in the territory of Ephraim;.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ nyɛvili, mani n-lan su kum ni neebu yiko; ka ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda, hal o yi kpi gba, o ni lan neei yaha.
en: Jesus said to her, I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me will live, even though they die.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa buɣisi Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ ni bɛ nya, ka daa taai duŋ niŋ o, ka bi dol o zaligunima, amaa ka bɛ daa ti ŋmaligi n-leei bɛn bi ʒe yim.
en: But they rebelled against Almighty God and put him to the test. They did not obey his commandments.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Naawuni nam lee ŋmanila bɔ bee bɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ li ŋmahindi?.
en: Jesus said, What is God's kingdom like? What can I compare it with?.

dag: Amaa di yi pala o pun lomi ni o ku o, ka di nyɛla Naawuni n-chɛ ka di niŋ, dindina n ni wuhi ya luɣ shɛli zali ka ŋun ku nir maa zo n-kuli nimaani.
en: If the killing wasnt on purpose but an accident allowed by God, then I will designate a place to which the killer can run away.

dag: ka yɛli, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka n dan naa ti kani man ŋun nyɛ o dabili ŋɔ sanna? Ka Dauda yɛl o, N yɛn dala a kabɔɣili ŋɔ m-me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ, ka di chɛ ka o vuug alɔbo ŋɔ ka chɛ niriba maa.
en: Araunah said, Why has my master and king come to his servant? David said, To buy this threshing floor from you to build an altar to the LORD, so the plague among the people may come to an end.

dag: O kari ma bahi zibisim ni, ka neesim shɛli kani.
en: He drove me deeper and deeper into darkness.

dag: A jilima zuɣu daa chɛ ka karimbaani kpe a suhu ni. A jilima zuɣu daa chɛ ka a saɣim a yɛm. N daa daag a luhi tiŋa, n daa yih a palɔni nanim tooni ni bɛ lih a viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: You were proud of being handsome, and your fame made you act like a fool. Because of this I hurled you to the ground and left you as a warning to other kings.

dag: Amaa o daa bi zaŋdi dari maa sɔŋdi biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn ka yaa la bɛn sani, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Leeban biŋkɔbiri nyɛ zaɣ gbarima, ka Yaakubu dina nyɛ bɛn mali yaa.
en: But he would not put out the branches when the weaker animals were mating. So Jacob got all of the healthy animals, and Laban got what was left.

dag: Dama o daa yɛl o suhu ni, Hal n yi kul shih o binyɛrigu gba, n ni nya alaafee.
en: She had said to herself, If I can just touch his clothes, I will be healed.

dag: Ka n ti pii maligumaana so ŋun ni ʒe ma yim ka tumdi n suhu mini n tɛha ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa; biɛhiŋ kani, n ni ti me o yili ti o, ka o ti be n ninvuɣ gahindili sani n-tumdi tuma sahakam.
en: I will choose a priest who will be faithful to me and do everything I want him to. I will give him descendants, who will always serve in the presence of my chosen king.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dundɔŋ ni dunoli din kpa wulimpuhili polo la din kul yɛn yomi ʒiɛya dabisa ayɔbu din nyɛ tuma tumbu dabisa la ni. Amaa Vuhim Dabisili dali mini goli palli tuuli dabisili dali, di simdi ni di yooi.
en: The Sovereign Lord says, The east gateway to the inner courtyard must be kept closed during the six working days, but it is to be opened on the Sabbath and at the New Moon Festival.

dag: ka niŋmi paɣikura kaman a manim la; ka niŋmi paɣisara mi kaman a tizɔpaɣiba la biɛr kasi zaa puuni.
en: Treat the older women like mothers. And treat the younger women with respect like sisters.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa, N dana, ka bɔ ka chɛchɛbunsi ŋɔ lee wuhira.
en: Then I asked the angel, Sir, what do these chariots mean.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Man Yawɛ yɛliya: N ni be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi ni yɛli shɛm ka n wum maa, n ni niŋ ya lala.
en: So tell them, The Lord says that he will surely do all those things to you that you complained about. This is what will happen to you:.

dag: Naa ni daa nyo Jɛrimia ni daa tɔɣisi Baruk yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ka o sabi li niŋ gban shɛli ni maa buɣim maa nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: I had told Baruch what to write on that first scroll, but King Jehoiakim had burned it. So the Lord told me.

dag: Yɛm malibu so salima nɛma zaa, ka a ku tooi zaŋ a suhu ni bɔri binshɛŋa zaa shɛli buɣisi li.
en: Her value exceeds pearls; all you desire cant compare with her.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi n-chaŋ Olivi Tihi Zol zuɣu kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm, ka o nyaandoliba gba dol o chaŋ.
en: Jesus went out to the Mount of Olives, as he often did, and his disciples went with him.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, Firawuna daa lan yɛli Yisifu, Mani n-nyɛ Firawuna, so ku tooi kpuɣ o nuu zuɣusaa bee n-vuug o napɔŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni, ka pa ni nyini m-bah o noli.
en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, I am Pharaoh; no one will do anything or go anywhere in all the land of Egypt without your permission.

dag: Bɛ ni yɛl a nam dariza yɛla, ka yɛl a yiko yɛla.
en: They will speak of the glory of your royal power and tell of your might.

dag: dama kaman zabigu ni zaani lɔŋni shɛm la, lala n-nyɛ ba. Bɛ ni yɛl a, Dim ka nyu. amaa di bi paai bɛ puu ni.
en: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, Take all you want! But they don't mean it.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa daa zaŋ ninvuɣ kpɛma tusaayopɔin mini tuumbaŋsimnim ni machɛlinim tuhili bɛn zaa mali kpiɔŋ din ni tooi tuhi tɔbu kuli Babilɔn.
en: There were soldiers. Nebuchadnezzar took all the soldiers and of the skilled workers and craftsmen. All these men were trained soldiers, ready for war. The king of Babylon took them to Babylon as prisoners.

dag: Yaɣigari Chuɣu kam puhibu saha daa yi ti paai, Gomna maa yihirila dansarika so niriba ni bɔri bahi.
en: It was customary during the festival for the governor to release to the crowd one prisoner, whomever they might choose.

dag: Ka Rubin zuliya daa lab mali me Hɛshibɔn mini Ɛliale ni Kiriataim.
en: The tribe of Reuben rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim.

dag: Ka Juda daa yɛl o ba Izraɛl, Chɛ ka bia maa doli ma ka ti yiɣisi chaŋ, ka di chɛ ka ti mini ya ni ti bihi ŋɔ ku kpi.
en: Then Judah said to his father, Let Benjamin go with me, and we will leave at once, so that none of us will starve to death.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛli ma, Sabimi a ni nya ʒii shɛli maa ka chɛ ka di yi zahira pa kuɣiparilana zuɣu, ka ŋun guura ni tooi karim li. .
en: The Lord gave me this answer: Write down clearly on tablets what I reveal to you, so that it can be read at a glance.

dag: Yɛhudianim adiini zaligunim nyɛla bin suma din ti yɛn kana ŋmahinli, ka pa binshɛŋa din nyɛ alali. Ka bɛ ni daa kul maani sara shɛŋa yuuni kam la daa bi tooi chɛ ka bɛn vu m-miri Naawuni di zuɣu be dɛde.
en: The Law of Moses is like a shadow of the good things to come. This shadow isn't the good things themselves, because it cannot free people from sin by the sacrifices offered year after year.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba daa teei di ni daa sab yɛli shɛm la yɛla. Di ni daa sab shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, n suhu zaa kul yɛla a jɛmbu duu zuɣu, ka di yɛla kul nyamdi n ni.
en: His disciples remembered that it is written, Passion for your house consumes me.

dag: N ni zaŋ zalikpan shɛŋa zaa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, doliya li viɛnyɛliŋga, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi be ka nabi, ka chaŋ ti ʒini Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri lo alikauli n-zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim la ni.
en: You must carefully perform all of the commandment that I am commanding you right now so you can live and multiply and enter and take possession of the land that the LORD swore to your ancestors.

dag: Ŋuni ka a lee viɛli gari? Siɣimiya tiŋgban ni ti dɔni pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni zuɣu.
en: Say to them: You may be more beautiful than the people of other nations, but you will also die and join the godless in the world below.

dag: Ka Ibram mini Haga daa dɔni, ka o niŋ pua. Haga ni daa nya ka o mali puu maa, ka o lihi ʒiɛm Zarai ŋun daa su o maa.
en: Abram had intercourse with Hagar, and she became pregnant. When she found out that she was pregnant, she became proud and despised Sarai.

dag: Yuun piniyini puuni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni daba ayopɔin dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: In the eleventh year, on the seventh day of the first month, the LORDs word came to me.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ suma n-nyɛ bɛn ni ti be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali nyɛ bɛn ni ti kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Honest people will live in the land, and those who do right will remain there.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, wuntizɔriba ni paɣ a yuli; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi ni ti be a sani.
en: Yes, the righteous will give thanks to your name, and those who do right will live in your presence.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, So yi lan yɛl a shɛli, nyin tahim o n sanna, ka o ku lan tooi niŋ a shɛli yaha.
en: If anyone speaks against you, bring him to me, and he will never trouble you again, the king replied.

dag: A mali nuu ka di be kaman Naawuni nuu? A mali kukoli din ŋmani saa tahibu kaman o kukol la?.
en: Are your arms as strong as mine? Do you have a voice like mine that is as loud as thunder?.

dag: Nyin naa, a yi shiri ni niŋ ma nirilim ka ti ma n ni bɔri shɛli, dindina m bɔri ni a mini Haman sa labina biɛɣuni nti di ka nyu binnyur shɛŋa n ni sa yɛn niŋ zali ya. Yi yi sa kana, n sa ni yɛl a n ni bɔri shɛli maa.
en: If I please the king, and if the king wishes to grant my wish and my desire, Id like the king and Haman to come to another feast that I will prepare for them. Tomorrow I will answer the kings questions.

dag: chɛliya ka paɣiba shini baalim cheechinim ni, dama bɛ ka soli ni bɛ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa. Di bi simdi ni bɛ nyɛ toondaannim kaman Naawuni zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: the women must not be allowed to speak. They must keep quiet and listen, as the Law of Moses teaches.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Ŋunkam mi chɛ ka bibihi bɛn niŋ ma yɛda ŋɔ ni yino birigi, bɛ yi di zaŋ nɛ karili lo dilan nyiŋgol ni zaŋ o bahi teeku ni di naan so o zuɣu.
en: It will be terrible for people who cause even one of my little followers to sin. Those people would be better off thrown into the ocean with a heavy stone tied around their necks.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali, Firawuna ni chɛ ka bɛ kana ti yih a nti lan zaŋ a labis a tuma ni; ka a ni lan zaŋdi Firawuna pipia maa ni binnyura maa ti tir o kaman a ni daa pun nyɛ o wain tɔɣira shɛm la.
en: Before the end of three days, Pharaoh will forgive you and allow you to go back to your work. You will do the same work for Pharaoh as you did before.

dag: Di veeni ni nir nya wahala la o bilim ni.
en: Its good for a man to carry a yoke in his youth.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ chira ata saha ka so daa ti yɛli Juda, Tama ŋun nyɛ a bia pakol la gɔrila pagɔrisigu, ka din pahi di zuɣu nyɛla, o niŋla pua o pagɔrisigu maa gɔbu ni. Ka Juda daa yɛli, Zaŋmiy o na ti niŋ buɣim nyo o.
en: About three months later, Judah was told, Your daughter-in-law Tamar has become a prostitute and is now pregnant because of it. And Judah said, Bring her out so that she may be burned.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa ŋmaligi lab Dɛbir ti liri ba.
en: Then Joshua and all the Israelites went back to Debir and attacked it.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ ma la zaɣ nɛɔŋ niŋ gballi ni, ka kahi kuɣa pa n zuɣu.
en: They threw me alive into a pit and then threw stones at me.

dag: Yawɛ Shia tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa n sani, ka o yɛligu be n zilinli zuɣu.
en: The LORDs spirit speaks through me; his word is on my tongue.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa chaŋ naa sani ti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ lala? Nyama, Abinɛr kala a sanna, ka bɔ niŋ ka a bah o ka o chaŋ?.
en: Joab came to the king and said, What have you done? Abner came to you, but you sent him away without hurting him! Why?.

dag: Baasha ni daa kul di nam maa, di daa bi yuui ka o ku Jɛrɔbɔam yiŋnim zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka anabi Ahija Shilo nir la yɛli shɛm la. O daa bi chɛ hal bɛ ni ninvuɣ yino gba; o daa kula bɛ zaa.
en: When Baasha became the new king, he killed everyone in Jeroboams family. He left no one in Jeroboams family alive. This happened just as the Lord said it would when he spoke through his servant Ahijah at Shiloh.

dag: Ibrahimma ka di leei Ibrahimma dini Hitinim bɛn daa ʒi tiŋ maa dunoli shee maa zaa ninni.
en: to Abraham as his property in the presence of the Hittites and of everyone at his citys gate.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa bol o bi so Zara ni dɔɣi ti o maa yuli Yisahaku.
en: Abraham named his son—the one Sarah bore him—Isaac.

dag: O ni nya dansi, ka kɔŋ jilima, ka o filiŋ maa ku lan naai;.
en: He will be dishonored and beaten up; he will be permanently disgraced.

dag: Teemiya yi zuɣulaannim bɛn daa wuhi ya Naawuni yɛtɔɣa la yɛla, ka kpahimya bɛ biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm hal ti paai kum la, ka chɛliya ka yi yɛda niŋbu be kaman bɛ yɛda niŋbu.
en: Remember your former leaders, who spoke God's message to you. Think back on how they lived and died, and imitate their faith.

dag: Di saha ka m bɔh o, Ŋun bia n-lee nyɛ a? Ka o yɛli ma, N nyɛla Bɛtuɛl bipuɣiŋga. Bɛtuɛl mi daa nyɛla Nahɔr mini Milika bidibiga. Ka n zaŋ nintua m-pir o, ka zaŋ bansi pir o.
en: I asked her who her father was, and she answered, My father is Bethuel the son of Nahor and Milcah. At once I put the ring in her nose and the bracelets on her arms.

dag: Yuŋ ti ku lan beni; bɛ mi ti ku bɔri firila bee wuntaŋ neesim, dama ti Duuma Naawuni maŋmaŋa nti yɛn nyɛ bɛ neesim, ka bɛ ni ti di nam hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Never again will night appear, and no one who lives there will ever need a lamp or the sun. The Lord God will be their light, and they will rule forever.

dag: Amaa n ni zo Juda zuliya nambɔɣu. Ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni fa ba bahi. M bi yɛn zaŋ tɔbiri bee takɔbi bee yuri bee wɔribariba fa ba bahi.
en: But I am the Lord God of Judah, and I will have mercy and save Judah by my own power—not by wars and arrows or swords and cavalry.

dag: Ka Ɛhab ni daa chaŋ ni o ti di ka nyu saha shɛli maa, ka Ilaija daa du Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu nti kurim n-zaŋ o nini kpa o duna;.
en: Ahab left, but Elijah climbed back to the top of Mount Carmel. Then he stooped down with his face almost to the ground.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Pa ʒii buyopɔin kɔŋko, amaa pisopɔin mi ʒii buyopɔin.
en: Jesus said, Not just seven times, but rather as many as seventy-seven times.

dag: n-zaŋ ti tahi kpe na nti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti ti, di nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam.
en: He brought us here and gave us this rich and fertile land.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa zaŋ kpa shɛli din kpalim be o nuu ni la n-ʒe ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa nudirigu polo tibinyaɣili min o nudirigu nubililɔɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu ni taali sanyoo sara ʒim la zuɣu.
en: Then the priest will put some of the oil that is left in his hand on the right earlobe, the right thumb, and the right big toe of the person needing purification—this oil will be placed on top of the blood of the compensation offering.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnima, yi nyee daa nyɔni ma mi, ka yi daa bi lan jɛmdi ma.
en: The Lord says, But you were tired of me, Israel; you did not worship me.

dag: Ka o tiba maa dii yooi, ka o zilinli lɛbigi ka o dii gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu.
en: At once the man could hear, and he had no more trouble talking clearly.

dag: Bɛ chanimi gindi bɔri bindirigu, ka bɔhira, Ya polo ka di lee be? Bɛ mi ni zibisim dabisili shee bi lan waɣa.
en: They scrounge around for food, all the while dreading the approaching darkness.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri jiɣindi shɛli zuɣu, amaa yi suhigu zaa puuni, yɛlimiya Naawuni yi ni bɔri shɛli, ka kul balimmiya Naawuni ni wumpaɣibo din yiri yi suhuri ni na.
en: Don't worry about anything, but in all your prayers ask God for what you need, always asking him with a thankful heart.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Mani n-nyɛ nyɛvili bindirigu maa. Ka ŋunkam ka n sanna, kum ku lan gbaag o; ka ŋunkam mi niŋ ma yɛda, kɔnyuri ku lan gbaag o hal abada.
en: Jesus replied, I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

dag: Man gba ni garigi, Man gba ni yɛli din be n suhu ni.
en: No, I will give my own answer now and tell you what I think.

dag: Chɛ ka buɣim salinɛma lu bɛ zuɣu. Chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ ba bahi bɔɣ zilima ni, ka bɛ ku lan tooi yi di ni na.
en: May red-hot coals fall on them; may they be thrown into a pit and never get out.

dag: Dama Naawuni bindirigu nyɛla din yi alizanda ni na, ka nyɛ din tiri dunianim nyɛvili.
en: Gods bread is the one who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.

dag: Ŋunkam kpuɣi paɣa nya binsuŋ, ka nya nirilim niŋbu Yawɛ sani.
en: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord .

dag: amaa yi ni shɛb bi niŋ li yɛda. Yisa daa pun mi piligu ni ha bɛn bi niŋ o yɛda ni nyɛ shɛba, ka lan mi ŋun ti yɛn yi o nyaaŋa ni nyɛ so.
en: But some of you refuse to have faith in me. Jesus said this, because from the beginning he knew who would have faith in him. He also knew which one would betray him.

dag: Ka zim shɛli din kpalim ni leei Aduna min o bidibisi dini, dama di nyɛla din be kasi bɛ ni zaŋ li nyo buɣim m-mali sara ti Yawɛ maa zuɣu.
en: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons as a most holy portion from the LORDs food gifts.

dag: Di saha ka Zɛbidii paɣa daa zaŋ o bih ayi kana ti gbani Yisa tooni n-suhir o binshɛli.
en: The mother of James and John came to Jesus with her two sons. She knelt down and started begging him to do something for her.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya N je paɣ yihibo, n je ni so niŋ o paɣa kiŋkansi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi nyɛ bɛn bi ʒe yim.
en: because he hates divorce, says the LORD God of Israel, and he also hates the one covering his garment with violence, says the LORD of heavenly forces. Guard your own life, and dont cheat.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi la ni Izraɛlnim zaa, Izraɛl ninvuɣ so bee saan shɛb bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi zaŋ o sara na, ka di nyɛla pɔri sanyoo sara bee omaŋmaŋ suhu yubu sara ni o ti nyo buɣim ti Naawuni.
en: to tell Aaron and his sons and everyone else the rules for offering sacrifices. He said: The animals that are to be completely burned on the altar.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn bi mi din sa yɛn niŋ yi nyɛviya biɛɣuni; dama yi ŋmanila paɣili din yi kpe, ka di bi yuui ka di lan yi la.
en: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.

dag: Di saha ka Zɛbidii paɣa daa zaŋ o bih ayi kana ti gbani Yisa tooni n-suhir o binshɛli.
en: Then Zebedees wife came to Jesus and brought her sons. She bowed before Jesus and asked him to do something for her.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋla sida dapaɣa n-kpahi tabili duu maa puuni dukpina gbinni zaŋ hal ti gbaai siiliŋ yɔɣira, ka zaŋ dari mali di puuni; ka zaŋ sipirɛs dapaɣa mi m-mali di puuni tiŋa.
en: the stone walls inside the Temple were covered with cedar boards from floor to ceiling. Then the stone floor was covered with pine boards.

dag: Nir yi mali biɛla ka wuntitali be di ni, di so ni nir mali pam ka di bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: Better a little with righteousness than great profits without justice.

dag: Ka yi ni ŋuni n-lee ko o wain tihi puu ka na bi di di wala? Dilan labimi kul o yiŋa, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb maa ni ka so di di nyaɣisim maa.
en: Or is there anyone here who has planted a vineyard but hasnt yet put it to good use? He can leave and go back to his house; otherwise, he might die in the battle and someone else would use the vineyard.

dag: ka mol ti Duuma faako tibu saha molo.
en: and announce that the time has come when the Lord will save his people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ paɣ maa yina, ka o tim ti yɛl o yidan ba Juda, Do so ŋun su nɛma ŋɔ n-ti ma pua maa. N suhir a, lihim li nya ŋuni n-lee su li. Nɛma maa n-nyɛ: nintua din mali dalinli ŋɔ mini zoligo ŋɔ ni jaaŋgbee ŋɔ.
en: The men went to Tamar to kill her, but she sent a message to her father-in-law that said, The man who made me pregnant is the man who owns these things. Look at them. Whose are they? Whose special seal and string is this? Whose walking stick is this.

dag: Tuma maa nyɛla balibubalibu, amaa kulla Naawuni yino maa n-chɛ ka di zaa tumdi sokam zaa ni.
en: And there are different ways that God works in people, but it is the same God who works in all of us to do everything.

dag: Ka Leeban yɛl o, Di pala ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni kali ni bipuɣiŋga ŋun nyɛ biasani daŋ o biɛli doo kulibu.
en: Laban replied, In our country the older daughter must get married first.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Maika ni chɛ ka n niŋdi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: O bu ma la paa ka n nyɛ o maligumaana.
en: He answered, I have an arrangement with Micah, who pays me to serve as his priest.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim dɔɣirikpamba maa daa ti zab bɛ ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Yisifu la nyuli n-gaŋ o, ka daa ti zaŋ o kɔhi Ijiptinim zuɣu; amaa ka Naawuni daa zan o nyaaŋa.
en: Jacob's sons became jealous of their brother Joseph and sold him to be a slave in Egypt. But God was with him.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, n suhir a, chɛ ka mani a dabili ŋɔ kpalim leegi n dan dabili ka chɛ bia maa, ka a chɛ ka o dol o biɛyanim maa kuli.
en: Now, please let your servant stay as your slave instead of the young man so that he can go back with his brothers.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa yi nti bɔh o ma, Bɔ ka n lee yɛn suhi Naa? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Yɛlim o ni a bɔrila Jɔn Baptaizira zuɣu.
en: The girl went to her mother and asked, What should I ask King Herod to give me? Her mother answered, Ask for the head of John the Baptizer.

dag: Gbaai yihila Goshɛn, Izraɛlnim ni daa be yaɣ shɛli polo maa, ka sakuɣa maa daa bi lu.
en: Only Goshen, where the Israelites lived, was safe from the storm.

dag: Dinzuɣu piɛguliba, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: So, shepherds, hear the LORDs word!.

dag: Ka baŋ daa be binzaa maa zuɣusaa, ka di dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi. Binzaa maa zuɣusaa polo mini di bintaɣirisi ni di dapaɣa daa nyɛla zaɣ mundili yini.
en: The top of the stand had a band running around the perimeter that was nine inches deep. The stand had its own supports and panels.

dag: Gbibiya n zaligunima. Di chɛliya ka naɣ bal shɛb zuliya du yi naɣinyama. Di biriya bimbira balibu buyi pu yin ni, yi mi di yɛnya taŋgari binyɛrigu.
en: You must keep my rules. Do not crossbreed your livestock, do not plant your field with two kinds of seed, and do not wear clothes made from two kinds of material.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa zali Izraɛlnim zaa ni bɛ bom tumtumdiba na ka bɛ ti tum tuma, ka bɛ ni daa bo tumtumdib shɛb na kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihita.
en: King Solomon called up a work gang of thirty thousand workers from all over Israel.

dag: amaa ka Yisa yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka bihi kam n sanna ka di karitiya ba, dama alizanda nam nyɛla bɛ tatabo dini.
en: Jesus said, Let the children come to me and do not stop them, because the Kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka alahichi su yi niŋgbuna din kpiri ŋɔ n-chɛ ka yi deei yi niŋgbuna maa noli tum di kɔr biɛri tuma.
en: But dont let sin control your life here on earth. You must not be ruled by the things your sinful self makes you want to do.

dag: Naawuni zom ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli n ni wuhi so shɛli ŋɔ min o niriba bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnima alali la zaa nambɔɣu, ka ti ba suhudoo!.
en: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo dɔriti gbaai Firawuna min o yiŋnima, Ibram paɣ Zarai maa zuɣu.
en: Then the LORD struck Pharaoh and his household with severe plagues because of Abrams wife Sarai.

dag: Ka di yi ti paai daba ayopɔin dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli.
en: Then, on the seventh day of this festival, you will have another special meeting. You will not do any work on that day.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba ni suhupiɛlli m-mali hal ti kpɛhi nayili maa.
en: Filled with joy and excitement, they enter into the kings palace.

dag: Ka ŋunkam be Masia ni, o bi tumd alahichi; ka ŋunkam kul tumd alahichi, dindina o na bi nya o bee m-mi o.
en: So everyone who lives in union with Christ does not continue to sin; but whoever continues to sin has never seen him or known him.

dag: Ka Naa Akishi kpambaliba daa bɔh o, Pa Dauda ŋɔ n-nyɛ o ya naa la? Pa o yɛla ka bɛ daa wari waa ka yiini yila yɛra, Naa Sool kula niriba tuhilituhili, ka Dauda mi ku tuhi piapia la? .
en: Achishs officers said, Isnt this David, the king of the land of Israel? He is the one the Israelites sing about. They dance and sing this song about him: Saul has killed thousands of enemies, but David has killed tens of thousands.

dag: O ni ti mali kpiɔŋ, amaa pa omaŋmaŋ yiko ni ka di ti yɛn yina. O ni ti saɣim binyara saɣindi biɛɣu, ka ni ti di nasara o ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni. O ni ti bahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yiko mini wuntizɔriba zaa yoli.
en: This king will be very powerful, but his power does not come from himself. This king will cause terrible destruction. He will be successful in everything he does. He will destroy powerful people—even Gods holy people.

dag: Teem a ni daa yɛli mani a dabili ŋɔ shɛm, ka m mali tahima di zuɣu la yɛla.
en: Remember your promise to your servant, for which you made me wait.

dag: Faranim mabihi zaa yi je ba, di ni niŋ wula ka bɛ zɔnima ku zo ka chɛ ba? Hal bɛ yi kul kpaŋ bɛmaŋ kabo ni bɛ boli ba labisina, bɛ ku lan nya ba.
en: If you are poor, your family will turn against you, and your friends will avoid you even more. You might beg them for help, but no one will come to help you.

dag: Di nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋsim ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ kul lihirila tiŋgbɔŋ maa viɛnyɛliŋga yuuni piligu ni hal ni di naabu ni.
en: The Lord your God takes care of this land and watches over it throughout the year.

dag: Waazuyihira maa yɛliya, Din ka buchi mi din ka buchi; di zaa nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Useless, useless, said the Philosopher. It is all useless.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ yuuni daa ti yɛn giligi, ka Siria tɔbbihi daa lo tɔb na ti liri Naa Jɔash. Bɛ daa lirila Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima n-ku bɛ zuɣulaannim zaa, ka di nɛma n-zaŋ li chaŋ ti ti Damaskus naa.
en: In the spring of the following year, the Syrian army invaded Judah and Jerusalem, killing all of the nation's leaders. They collected everything of value that belonged to the people and took it back to their king in Damascus.

dag: Ka Siria naa ni ti zaŋ o tɔbbihi chaŋ ti teei gili tiŋ shɛli din goma mali kpiɔŋ. Ka Ijipti tɔbbihi ni ti kɔŋ tuhibu, hal bɛ ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi gba ti ku lan mali kpiɔŋ.
en: When the northern king attacks, he will throw up a siege ramp and occupy a walled city. The southern forces will not be able to resist—not even its elite forces. No one will be strong enough to resist.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ o ni lo ni o niŋ o niriba maa zaɣ biɛ shɛli maa niŋbu.
en: So the Lord felt sorry for the people. He did not do what he said he might do—he did not destroy them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o yɛligu paai Hanani bia Jɛhu zaŋ chaŋ Baasha polo yɛli.
en: The Lord sent Jehu son of Hanani to say to Baasha:.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim ni bɛnkam zaa kpalim ka nyɛ bɛn daa yi Babilɔn labina maa daa yooi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Then the Israelites celebrated the dedication of Gods Temple with much happiness. The priests, the Levites, and all the other people who came back from captivity joined in the celebration.

dag: Dinzuɣu deemiya taba kaman Masia ni daa deei ti shɛm Naawuni paɣibu zuɣu la.
en: So welcome each other, in the same way that Christ also welcomed you, for Gods glory.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛri ya ni yi yi kul bɔri binshɛɣukam ka suhi Naawuni, yin niŋmiya yɛda ni yi ni nya li, ka yi shiri ni nya li.
en: So I tell you to ask for what you want in prayer. And if you believe that you have received those things, then they will be yours.

dag: Amaa ka bidibbil so daa ti nya ba ka chaŋ ti yɛli Absalom, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa zo yomyom ti kpe Bahurim do so yiŋa, doo maa daa malila kɔbiliga o yiŋa ka bɛ siɣi di puuni.
en: But a boy saw Jonathan and Ahimaaz and ran to tell Absalom. Jonathan and Ahimaaz ran away quickly. They arrived at a mans house in Bahurim. The man had a well in his courtyard. Jonathan and Ahimaaz went down into this well.

dag: Kpiɔŋlan Naa ni daa kari nanim nimaani, o daa chɛ ka sakuɣa lu Zalimɔn Zoli zuɣu na.
en: God All-Powerful, you scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.

dag: ka daa kpaŋsi li ka di leei zaligu Yaakubu sani, ka lan leei alikauli din ka bahigu Izraɛl san la.
en: God set it up as binding law for Jacob, as an eternal covenant for Israel.

dag: Zuɣulaan so ŋun daa pah anu n-su gol so ŋun pahi anu ni n-daa nyɛ Shamhut, o daa nyɛla Izira nira. Ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The fifth for the fifth month was the commander Shammoth the Zerahite. His division numbered .

dag: Filistianim ni daa wum ni Izraɛlnim laɣimla Mizipa, ka bɛ nanim daa lo tɔbu n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi ba. Ka Izraɛlnim daa wum li ka dabiɛm gbahi ba.
en: When the Philistines heard that the Israelites were meeting at Mizpah, they went to fight them. The Israelites were frightened when they heard the Philistines were coming.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu ku tooi su niriba, bee m-bariti niriba zana.
en: But still, he punishes rulers who abuse their people.

dag: Di saha bɛ mini Sool ni Izraɛl dɔbba zaa daa bela Ɛla Vinvamli ni n-tuhiri Filistianima.
en: They are with Saul and all the Israelite troops fighting the Philistines in the Elah Valley.

dag: N tiŋ kasi maa ŋmanila paɣ so ŋun dɔɣi ka bi wolisi.
en: My holy city is like a woman who suddenly gives birth to a child without ever going into labor.

dag: Babilɔnnim daa mɛla Sukɔtibɛnɔt buɣili zali, ka Kutinim me Nɛrigal buɣili zali, ka Hamatinim me Ashima buɣili zali.
en: the people of Babylon made idols of the god Succoth Benoth; the people of Cuth, idols of Nergal; the people of Hamath, idols of Ashima;.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A yi bɔri ni a niŋ shɛlikam dɛde, nyin cham ti kɔhi a ni mali shɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ ti nandaamba n-zali buni alizanda ni, di nyaaŋa ka kana ti doli ma.
en: Jesus said, If you want to be complete, go, sell what you own, and give the money to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven. And come follow me.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ buri pili, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba. Vi ni ti be bɛ zaa nina ni, ka bɛ zuɣuri zaa ti nyɛ zuɣukpina.
en: They will wear sackcloth and be covered with fear. You will see the shame on every face. They will shave their heads to show their sadness.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Pa yi ninvuɣ pinaayi ka m pii ka yi ni yino ti nyɛ Sintani nir la.
en: Then Jesus answered, I chose all twelve of you. But one of you is a devil.

dag: ka Ammiɛl pah ayɔbu, ka Isaka pah ayopɔin, ka Pɛulɛtai daa pah anii; dama Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: Ammiel was his sixth son, Issachar his seventh son, and Peullethai his eighth son. God really blessed Obed Edom.

dag: Wummiya vu shɛli din yɔri pampam tiŋ puuni ŋɔ, ka wumya vuri din yiri Naawuni jɛmbu duu na ŋɔ! Yawɛ n-darigir o dimnim tibili maa!.
en: Do you hear that noise in the city and those shouts coming from the temple? It is the Lord shouting as he punishes his enemies.

dag: Yɛligu maa daa lɛbila ninsala m-be ti sani, ka anfaani mini yɛlimaŋli pal o kɔbili ni. Ka ti nya o jilima shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni Bi gaŋ ŋun yi o Ba sanna jilima.
en: The Word became flesh and made his home among us. We have seen his glory, glory like that of a fathers only son, full of grace and truth.

dag: Ka Yawɛ garigi yɛli, N nɔrila zuliya kam niriba kaman wain tiwala la, ka so bi sɔŋ ma. Ka n daa no ba ni suli mini suhuyiɣisili, ka bɛ ʒim varim m binyɛrigu ka di gabisi zaa.
en: He answers, I walked in the winepress by myself. No one helped me. I was angry, and I trampled the grapes. The juice splashed on my clothes, so now they are stained.

dag: Di luhiya ni bɛ ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeen shɛli din ka nyɔri bee m-mali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ku niŋ ba zaɣ viɛlli?.
en: No one who is wise would talk the way you do or defend himself with such meaningless words.

dag: Naftali zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaanu ni kɔbisinahi.
en: These were the family groups from the tribe of Naphtali. The total number of men was .

dag: Ka yimaŋmaŋ ni mali wun shɛŋa la be ya? Bɛ yi ni tooi tiligi ya, yin chɛliya ka bɛ kana ti tiligi ya yi muɣisigu saha, dama yinim Judanima, yi fɔntinsi ni kul galisi shɛm, lala ka yi wuna gba galisi.
en: Go cry to the gods you made! There should be enough of them to save you, because Judah has as many gods as it has towns.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɔri nia biɛɣu birigiya, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nia viɛla nyari jilima mini ʒiɛyimtali niriba sani.
en: Whoever works to do good will find love and loyalty. It is a mistake to work at doing evil.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl taba, Chɛliya ka ti pii so leei ti zuɣulana n-lab Ijipti.
en: Then the people said to each other, Lets choose another leader and go back to Egypt.

dag: Di dabisa maa ni daadamnim ni ti bɔri kum ka ku nya; bɛ ni ti bɔri ni bɛ kpi, ka kum zo ka chɛ ba.
en: During those five months they will seek death, but will not find it; they will want to die, but death will flee from them.

dag: O bia Shɛmaya gba daa dɔɣi bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni kpamba, dama bɛ daa nyɛla bɛn mali baŋsim pam.
en: Obed Edom's oldest son, Shemaiah, had six sons: Othni, Rephael, Obed, Elzabad, Elihu, and Semachiah. They were important men in their clan because of their great ability; the last two were especially talented.

dag: Ka o daa siɣim pam ka yɛli, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim bɔri shihirili? Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim ku nya shihirili hal baabiɛla.
en: With an impatient sigh, Jesus said, Why does this generation look for a sign? I assure you that no sign will be given to it.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni maar a suhu shɛm ŋɔ nyɛla din pɔr a sani, bee zilimballi yɛtɔɣa maa m-pa shɛli a sani?.
en: God tries to comfort you, but that is not enough for you. We have spoken his message to you in a gentle way.

dag: Paɣ maa mi daa mali naɣipol kpabili o yiŋa, ka o daa dii yiɣisi yomyom chɛ ka bɛ kɔrigi naɣipolli maa, ka o niŋ zim ŋɔri mali bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi.
en: The woman had a fattened calf in the house, and she quickly butchered it. She took flour, kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ maa gba chɛmi ka n suhu dam, ka yiɣi yi di biɛhigu shee.
en: Oh, my mind is disturbed by this and is more troubled than usual.

dag: N dan naa, niriba maa ni niŋ shɛlikam zaŋ chaŋ anab Jɛrimia polo maa nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu. Bɛ zaŋ o niŋla kɔbiliga ni ni kum ku o, dama bindirigu lan ka tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: My master the king, these men have made a terrible mistake in treating the prophet Jeremiah the way they have; they have thrown him into the cistern where he will die of starvation, for theres no bread left in the city.

dag: Fiig tihi gbaai wolibu, ka wain tihi daai pum, ka di pum maa nyo kaman tulaale la. N yura ŋun nyɛ n ni yuri so pam, Yiɣisim ka n sanna.
en: Figs are beginning to ripen; the air is fragrant with blossoming vines. Come then, my love; my darling, come with me.

dag: Ka Saimɔn min o tab la daa chani bɔr o shee.
en: But Simon and his companions went out searching for him.

dag: Daadamnim zaa tumdila bɛ tuma zaa dibu zuɣu, amaa bɛ na ʒi n-di n-tiɣi.
en: People work and work to feed themselves, but they are never satisfied.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋɔŋ kom tiliginsim kɔbilisi puuni ni suhupiɛlli.
en: You will draw water with joy from the springs of salvation.

dag: ka o yina nti yɔhim zuliya kam bɛn be dunia luɣ anahi ŋɔ ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛ ni booni shɛb Gɔg mini Magɔg. O ni ti laɣim ba lo tɔbu; ka bɛ kalinli ni ŋmanila mɔɣ bihigu.
en: and he will go out to deceive the nations scattered over the whole world, that is, Gog and Magog. Satan will bring them all together for battle, as many as the grains of sand on the seashore.

dag: Chɛliya ma vuri ka n yɛli, ka chɛ ka din yɛn niŋ ma niŋ ma.
en: Be quiet and I will speak, come what may.

dag: Dindali maa ka Naawuni yɛla daa gbaai Dauda dabiɛm pam ka o yɛli, Ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ kuli.
en: Then David was afraid of God and said, How can I take the Covenant Box with me now.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ olivi tihi dari m-mali dasara, ka di nyɛ zaɣ mɔɣiri n-zaŋ sa sunsuuni dunol ni.
en: The two doors to the main room of the temple were made out of pine, and each one had two sections so they could fold open. The door frame was shaped like a rectangle and was made out of olive wood.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa nya ka Leeban bi lan bɔr o yɛla kaman o ni daa pun bɔr o yɛla shɛm la.
en: And Jacob saw that Laban no longer liked him as much as he used to.

dag: Bɛ bihi yi nya jilima, bɛ bi mi; ka bɛ yi nya filiŋ, so baɣa ka di ni.
en: If their sons are honored, they will never know it. If their sons do wrong, they will never see it.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛl o niriba maa, Mani n-daa wurim ya bahi ka yi chaŋ ti be luɣ shɛlikam, dinzuɣu yinim bɛn be tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa, Zomiya yi Babilɔn n-lab Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Look out; look out! Flee from the land of the north, says the LORD, for I will scatter you like the four winds of heaven, says the LORD.

dag: Niriba kul pɔrila pɔri, ka ŋmari ʒiri, ka kuri niriba, ka zura, ka niŋdi zina. Bɛ baɣa lan ka shɛlikam ni, kubu n-naɣ kul beni.
en: Cursing, dishonesty, murder, robbery, unfaithfulness— these happen all the time. Violence is everywhere.

dag: Ka paɣa maa daa lan yɛli, N dan naa, n suhir a, chɛ ka n yɛl a yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ. Ka o yɛl o, Yɛlima.
en: Then she asked, Your Majesty, may I say something? Yes, he answered.

dag: m-bol o yuli Nuhu ka yɛli, Bia ŋɔ ni sɔŋ ti ti tuun kpɛma tumbu ni, Yawɛ ni yɛli noli niŋ tiŋgban shɛli ŋɔ ni.
en: Lamech named his son Noah. Lamech said, We work very hard as farmers because God cursed the ground. But Noah will bring us rest.

dag: Puuni duu maa daa malila duno jaba, ka luɣ kasi shee la gba mali duno jaba.
en: There was a door at the end of the passageway to the Holy Place and one also at the end of the passageway to the Most Holy Place.

dag: Ka yi zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayi n-nyo buɣim mali chi sara din nyom viɛl ti Yawɛ. Ka binnyurigu sara din yɛn pahi di zuɣu n-nyɛ wain lita yini.
en: The accompanying grain offering must be two-tenths of an ephah of choice flour mixed with oil, as a food gift for the LORD, a soothing smell. The accompanying drink offering must be a quarter of a hin of wine.

dag: Yi tɔbbihi tuui lu, ka yɛli taba, Chɛliya ka ti labi timaŋmaŋ niriba sani ti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, takɔbi shɛl din kuri ti ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Hes tripped them up; they fall over each other and say, Lets get out of here and go home to our people, where we were born, far away from the oppressors sword.

dag: Di yi nyɛla n daa birigila soli maa zuɣu, ka chɛ ka n suhu ye n nina ni nya binshɛŋa zuɣu, ka daɣ shɛli yi be n nuhi ni.
en: If I have disobeyed him or even wanted to.

dag: O yɛli ma mi, Chɛ ka n chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm, dama n yiŋnim yɛn malila sara ti ya, ka m biɛli yɛli ni n kana. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ a yi baŋ ni a nini tiɣi ma, nyin chɛ ka n chaŋ ti nya m biɛyanim maa. Lala zuɣu ka o bi ka nyin naa bindirigu ŋɔ dibu shee na maa.
en: Please let me go, he said, because our family is celebrating the sacrificial feast in town, and my brother ordered me to be there. So then, if you are my friend, let me go and see my relatives. That is why he isn't in his place at your table.

dag: Ka zuliya shɛb gba niriba pam daa zaŋ bɛ biŋkɔbiri pam bɛn nyɛ piɛri ni buhi ni niɣi n-doli ba chaŋ.
en: A large number of other people and many sheep, goats, and cattle also went with them.

dag: Di yɛli a ʒiʒiinikpee, Cham ka sa labina biɛɣuni ka n zaŋ li ti a, di yi be a sani.
en: If your neighbor needs something you have, dont say, Come back tomorrow. Give it to him immediately.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn kul deeri yɔhiŋgu yɛtɔɣa din ka buchi.
en: And yet you trust in lies that will only hurt you.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Ŋunkam tum alahichi n sani, dilan yuli ka n ni kpihim litaafi maa ni.
en: But the Lord said to Moses, The only people I erase from my book are those who sin against me.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn tɔɣisiri karimbaan yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ jɛritali, ka zaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma leei zana bari ni bɛ gbahi bɛn na yoli yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be biriginsim puuni kalinli ni la.
en: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.

dag: Sulemaana daa yuri Yawɛ, ka dol o ba Dauda ni daa zal o shɛm, o daa naɣ maanila sara maligunim ka tuɣindi tulaale zim sara maligu bimbina zuɣu.
en: Solomon loved the Lord and followed his father David's instructions, but Solomon also offered sacrifices and burned incense at the shrines.

dag: Dindali maa ka Dɛbɔra mini Barak Abinɔam bia la daa yili yilli ŋɔ:.
en: On that day Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang this song:.

dag: Di saha ka Aduna daa teeg o nuu tiri Ijipti koma zaa, ka poloya daa yina n-yɛrigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: So Aaron raised his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs began coming out of the water and covered the land of Egypt.

dag: O yirimina kaman tipum la, ka lan kpi, o vuurila yomyom kaman shilinshia la, o bi yuura.
en: We are flowers that fade and shadows that vanish.

dag: Yawɛ, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi be a jɛmbu duu puuni? Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi be Ziɔn a daboli din be kasi la zuɣu?.
en: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord ?.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ nyɛla bɛn mi, amaa ka zaɣisi ni bɛ saɣi ni tum dunia piligu ni ha, Naawuni daa zaŋla o nol ni yɛtɔɣa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ. Kom ka Naawuni daa zaŋ nam dunia tiŋgbani ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka di yi kom ni na.
en: But these people dont want to remember what happened long ago. The skies were there, and God made the earth from water and with water. All this happened by Gods word.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ka o daa fa ba bahi, amaa ka bɛ daa yi o nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daalahichi daa chɛ ka bɛ nya filiŋ.
en: He saved his people many times, but they turned against him and did what they wanted to do. His people did many bad things.

dag: Di dabisa maa nyaaŋa ka ti daa mali shili n-yiɣisi chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: After spending some time there, we got our things ready and left for Jerusalem.

dag: Yuun pisinaayopɔin puuni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: In the twenty-seventh year, on the first day of the first month, the LORDs word came to me.

dag: Ka niriba ni ti yi wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili ni nuzaa mini nudirigu polo na ti ʒini Naawuni nam ni n-diri ka nyura.
en: People will come from the east, west, north, and south. They will sit down at the table in Gods kingdom.

dag: Ka Amasa daa kpi n-do o ʒim ni solɔɣu maa zuɣu. Ka ŋunkam daa yi kana ti nya o, dilan kpalindimi zani. Ka doo maa ni daa nya ka niriba kanna ti kpalindi zaani maa, ka o daa vuui Amasa solɔɣu maa zuɣu nti sɔŋ mɔri ni, ka zaŋ binyɛrigu pa o zuɣu.
en: Amasa's body, covered with blood, was lying in the middle of the road. Joab's man saw that everybody was stopping, so he dragged the body from the road out into the field and threw a blanket over it.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga kam ŋun mali tarili Izraɛlnim daŋ shɛli puuni, di simdi ni o kulila o yaannim daŋ ni doo, ka lala chɛ ka Izraɛl nir kam kul su o yaannim fali tarili ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: Every woman who inherits property in an Israelite tribe must marry a man belonging to that tribe. In this way all Israelites will inherit the property of their ancestors.

dag: Ka bɛn daa doli Sool daa zaŋ o niŋ piɛɣu ni yuŋ du gooni n-zaŋ o siɣisi ti zali tiŋa.
en: One night some followers that Saul had taught helped him leave the city. They put him in a basket and lowered it down through a hole in the city wall.

dag: nti nya o yɛl o, Sokam kul lihiri bɔrila a shee.
en: When they found him, they told him, Everyones looking for you.

dag: ka ba bɛ nanim bandi, ka zaŋ zoligɔnim lo bɛ nabihi.
en: binding their rulers in chains and their officials in iron shackles.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa gili Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa niŋ sunsuuni n-kari doli ba kuri ba n-zaŋ Nɔha hal ti paai Gibia wulimpuhili polo.
en: They encircled the Benjaminites, chased them from Nohah, and trampled them to the east of Gibeah.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi ma polo, n ni sabi Ijiptinim mini Babilɔnnim yuya, ka sabi Filistianim gba mini Taainim ni Itiɔpianim yuya ka yɛli, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim gba leela Jɛrusalɛm tiŋbihi.
en: God says, Some of my people live in Egypt and Babylon. Some of them were born in Philistia, Tyre, and even Ethiopia.

dag: Kuɣili maa daa galisiya pam, amaa ka bɛ daa ti paai nya ka kuɣili maa pun biligimi doya.
en: When they looked up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi din tuhi, ka tumdi wuntia tuma sahakam mali alibarika.
en: Happy are those who obey his commands, who always do what is right.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa kuli yiŋa nti nya ka alizin biɛɣu maa shiri zo ka chɛ o bia maa, ka o dola o bindoo zuɣu.
en: The woman went home and found her daughter lying on the bed. The demon was gone.

dag: Yi tumdila yi ba tuma. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti pala dagɔribihi; ti malila ba yino, ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni.
en: But you are doing exactly what your father does. Don't accuse us of having someone else as our father! they said. We just have one father, and he is God.

dag: Yi na bi baŋ? Yi na ʒi n-wum? Yawɛ n-kul nyɛ kurimbuni Naawuni. Ŋuna n-daa nam dunia ŋɔ zaa. Di bi wumd o, o mi bi gbarigira. So mi ku tooi baŋ o tɛha.
en: Surely you know the truth. Surely you have heard. The Lord is the God who lives forever! He created all the faraway places on earth. He does not get tired and weary. You cannot learn all he knows.

dag: Alikauli kurili maa yi di daa be dɛde, di di bi lan kpa talahi ni din pah ayi kana.
en: If there was nothing wrong with the first agreement, then there would be no need for a second agreement.

dag: Ka Balak daa lan tim kpamba bɛn mali jilima pam, ka zooi gar o ni daa tuui tim shɛb maa.
en: Then Balak sent a larger group of officials, who were even more important than the first ones.

dag: Ŋun wurindi niriba la kana ti liri ya. Guliya yi ni zaani gooni zuɣu luɣ shɛŋa tuhiri tɔbu la. Lihimiya soli zuɣu, lomiya kpara. Laɣimmiya yi tɔbbi kpɛma zaa.
en: An enemy is coming to attack you, so guard the strong places of your city. Watch the road. Get ready for war. Prepare for battle!.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, N di pun bi yɛl a ni a yi niŋ yɛda a ni nya Naawuni yiko ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Jesus replied, Didnt I tell you that if you believe, you will see Gods glory.

dag: Ka Lɛvi zuliya doo ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni daa ku so mam maa yɛli ba, M mini m mam n-daa chaŋ Gibia din nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋ la ni ni ti ti gbe.
en: The Levite whose concubine had been murdered answered, My concubine and I went to Gibeah in the territory of Benjamin to spend the night.

dag: ni tibikpara ni bansi ni sarisi.
en: the earrings, bracelets, and veils.

dag: Yi yi ti paai Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni, yin miriya ka yi ti tumdi zuliya shɛb bɛn be nimaani tuun shɛŋa din tumbu chihiri la.
en: Soon you will go into the land that the Lord your God is giving you. The nations that live there do things that are disgusting to the Lord , and you must not follow their example.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Yi ni zaŋ doo ŋɔ tahi n sanna nti yɛli ni o birigirila yi zuliya la, n vih o yi zaa ha ninni, amaa ka bi nya o taali ni yi ni fiɣis o shɛlikam zaa zuɣu maa.
en: and said to them, You brought this man to me and said that he was misleading the people. Now, I have examined him here in your presence, and I have not found him guilty of any of the crimes you accuse him of.

dag: N zaŋla n nina kpa a jɛmbu duu la, ka gbani paɣ a yuli a yurilim maŋli la min a ʒiɛyimtali la zuɣu, dama a duh a yuli min a yɛligu gari shɛlikam.
en: I bow toward your holy temple and thank your name for your loyal love and faithfulness because you have made your name and word greater than everything else.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛl o niriba maa, N ni tin ya chi mini wain ni kpam, ka yi tiɣi; ka chɛ ka zuliya shɛb ku tooi lan mali ya ansarisi yaha.
en: He answered them: Now I am going to give you grain and wine and olive oil, and you will be satisfied. Other nations will no longer despise you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka anab so ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This showed the full meaning of what the prophet said:.

dag: M bia, zom Yawɛ ka zom naa, ka miri ka a zaɣisi bɛ so noli;.
en: Son, respect the Lord and the king, and dont join with those who are against them.

dag: Niriba maa zaa ni, ninvuɣ kɔbisiyopɔin bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi ka nyɛ gɔbisinima daa be bɛ ni. Bɛ ni ninvuɣ yino kam daa nyɛla ŋun ni tooi zaŋ kuɣili niŋ kuɣilɔŋ ni n-lab ninsal zabigu gba ka ku nyahigi li.
en: In this army there were left-handed experts who could sling a rock at a target the size of a hair and hit it every time.

dag: Ka bɛ nina maa dii neei. Ka Yisa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni viɛnyɛliŋga yɛli, Miriya ka yi yɛli so di yɛla.
en: and their sight was restored. Jesus spoke sternly to them, Don't tell this to anyone.

dag: Di saha maa niriba pam ni ti zaɣisi ma dolibu, ka yi tab nyaansi, ka je taba.
en: During that time many believers will lose their faith. They will turn against each other and hate each other.

dag: O ni daa paai naa sani, ka naa bɔh o, Mikaya, ti cham ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnim bee ti di chaŋ? Ka Makaya garigi yɛl o, Chamiya, yi ni di nasara; Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba niŋ nyin naa nuu ni.
en: Micaiah went and stood before King Ahab. The king asked him, Micaiah, should we go and attack the Arameans at Ramoth Gilead or not? Micaiah answered, Yes, go and be successful! The Lord will let you take the city.

dag: ka yɛli, A ni yɛn kana ti paai shɛli tariga n-yɛn bɔŋɔ; di tirisi tooni. Kpe ka a kɔgbana din mali karimbaani maa yɛn zani.
en: and said, You may come this far, no farther; here your proud waves stop?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka a lan zaŋ piɛla ŋun la na nti chɛ ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa o zuɣu ni.
en: Bring the other ram to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.

dag: N ni ti yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi yi zuɣu, ka pɔbisi n suhuyiɣisili buɣim bahi yi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ya niŋ putɔɣunim bɛn mi niriba kubu looloochi nuu ni.
en: My furious anger will scorch you like fire, and I will hand you over to cruel men who are experts in killing.

dag: Yinim bɛna, yi zaŋla ʒiri leei situra ye; yi zaa nyɛla timalaannim bɛn ka buchi.
en: But you men try to cover up your ignorance with lies. You are like worthless doctors who cannot heal anyone.

dag: Nyini n-galisi, ka su yiko mini jilima ni nasara ni nam dariza zaa, dama nyini n-su binshɛɣukam din be zuɣusaa ni tiŋa. Yawɛ, nyini n-nya duhibu gari sokam zaa.
en: To you, LORD, belong greatness and power, honor, splendor, and majesty, because everything in heaven and on earth belongs to you. Yours, LORD, is the kingship, and you are honored as head of all.

dag: Ka o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi zaa daa kana ni bɛ ti maag o suhu, amaa ka o daa zaɣisi ka yɛli, N ni kum m bia maa zuɣu hal ti paag o kpiimba biɛhigu shee. Lala ka o ba daa kum o zuɣu.
en: All of Jacob's children came to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. No, he said, I will go to my grave, mourning for my son. So Jacob kept on grieving.

dag: Ŋunkam bi yuri ma je ni o doli n yɛligu. Yɛl shɛŋa yi ni wumdi ŋɔ pala n dini, amaa di nyɛla m Ba ŋun tim ma na maa dini.
en: Those who do not love me do not obey my teaching. And the teaching you have heard is not mine, but comes from the Father, who sent me.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim a suhuyiɣisili puuni, lum n dimnim bɛn suhu yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu la zuɣu; n Naawuni, malimi shili, a zali saria karibu saha.
en: Get up, LORD; get angry! Stand up against the fury of my foes! Wake up, my God; you command that justice be done!.

dag: N kul bela zibisim ni chana ka wuntaŋ kani; ka n ʒe kpamba laɣiŋgu ni n-kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim.
en: I go about in gloom, without any sunshine; I stand up in public and plead for help.

dag: M bɔri ni yi di ma suɣilo ka n tɔɣisi ya jɛritali yɛtɔɣa biɛla. N suhiri ya ni yi shiri dim ma suɣilo!.
en: I hope that you will put up with me while I act like a fool. Well, in fact, you are putting up with me!.

dag: ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram yiniyini pahi piɛlabih ayopɔin la zaɣ yino kam zuɣu.
en: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zaŋla yabiga nyuhi niriba ŋɔ, ka zaŋ lɔɣu ni be ko shɛl ni nyuhi ba.
en: Therefore, this is what the LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, says: Im going to feed this people bitter food and give them poison to drink.

dag: Di buɣisibu wɔɣilim gari dunia ŋɔ wɔɣilim. Ka di yɛliŋ gari teeku.
en: and these mysteries outreach the earth and the ocean?.

dag: ni bɛ ti to jina baŋ bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm sɔɣ gbaai Yisa ku o.
en: They were plotting to arrest Jesus by cunning tricks and to kill him.

dag: ni Ain ni Juta ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi ni di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ti ba. Fɔntiŋ kara awɛi ka bɛ daa yihi Juda mini Simiɔn zuliya niriba tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: Ain, Juttah, and Beth Shemesh, with their pasture lands: nine cities from the tribes of Judah and Simeon.

dag: Pita daa lan yɛli yaha, M mabihi, n ni maan yɛli ya ti yab Naa Dauda yɛla. O daa kpiya ka bɛ sɔɣ o, ka o gballi na be kpe hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: My brothers, I can tell you for sure about David, our great ancestor. He died, was buried, and his tomb is still here with us today.

dag: Bɛ yɛrimi, Kamiyana ka ti ku n-naai bɛ zuliya maa. Di chɛliya ka so ti lan teei Izraɛlnim yuli yɛla yaha.
en: Come on, they say, lets wipe them out as a nation! Let the name Israel be remembered no more.

dag: A ni be alizanda ni a biɛhigu shee din be kasi ka mali jilima ŋɔ, lihim na nya. A baɣa ni daa yi be ti ni shɛm ni a yiko la lee kpalimla ya? A yurilim min a nambɔzɔbo la lan kani zaŋ kana ti sani.
en: Please, look down from the heavens. See what is happening now. Look down at us from your great and holy home in heaven. Where is your strong love for us? Where is your compassion? Why are you hiding your kind love from me?.

dag: ka bɛ mabih ayopɔin maa zaa daa kpuɣ o, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣ bihi ka kpi; di nyaaŋa ka paɣ maa gba daa kpi.
en: All seven brothers married the woman and died. None of the brothers had any children with her. And she was the last to die.

dag: ka daa kpihi buɣim din mali dabiɛm, ka daa tiligi takɔb kum ni. Bɛ daa nya kpiɔŋ bɛ gbariginsim saha. Bɛ daa nyɛla tɔbutuhir biinsi bɛn tuhi nyaŋ tinzun tinsi tɔbbihi.
en: and put out raging fires and escaped from the swords of their enemies. Although they were weak, they were given the strength and power to chase foreign armies away.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Di saha n ni ti nyɛ Izraɛlnim zaa Naawuni, ka bɛ mi nyɛ n niriba.
en: This is what the Lord said, At that time I will be the God of all the tribes of Israel. And they will be my people.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛli, Mbaye! Yawɛ zaŋla ti nanima ata ŋɔ na ni o ti niŋ Mɔabnim nuu ni.
en: Joram cried out, This is terrible! The Lord must have led us out here to be captured by Moab's army.

dag: Naa, a nyɛla na titali gari nanim zaa. Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ n-ti a nam maa; ka lan ti a yiko mini kpiɔŋ ni jilima.
en: King, you are the most important king. The God of heaven has given you a kingdom, power, strength, and glory.

dag: Di zaa ni ti saɣim, amaa nyin kul ni beni sahakam. Di ni ti kpi kaman siturili la. A taɣiri li mi kaman situra la, ka di kul kpira.
en: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.

dag: ŋun pah ata gba kpuɣ o; lala ka bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa zaa daa kpuɣ o, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ka kpi.
en: and then the third. The same thing happened to all seven—they died without having children.

dag: Ka n ku zo o bihi nambɔɣu, dama bɛ nyɛla pagɔrili bihi.
en: You children are the result of her unfaithfulness, and I'll show you no pity.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Dauda daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ. Ka zama maa zaa daa paɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Yawɛ maa, ka silim bɛ zuɣuri tiŋa n-jɛm Naawuni, ka lu naa sizuura.
en: Then David said to all the group of people gathered together, Now give praise to the Lord your God. So all the people gave praise to the Lord God, the God their ancestors worshiped. They bowed to the ground to give honor to the Lord and to the king.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tuhi nyaŋ na shɛb maa n-nyɛ: Jɛriko naa mini Ai.
en: the king of Jericho one.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza vali ma. O kabisi ma; o chɛ ka n kpalimla zaɣ vuɣu. O vali ma mi kaman wahu ni vaani bini shɛm la. O vali m bin viɛla tiɣi, ka tuhi ma bahi.
en: The king of Babylonia cut Jerusalem up and ate it. He emptied the city like a jar; like a monster he swallowed it. He took what he wanted and threw the rest away.

dag: ka yɛra, Nyam Babilɔn ŋɔ ni galisi shɛm! Mani m-me li zali ni di nyɛ n tin titali, ka di wuhi n yiko mini n kpiɔŋ ni n nam dariza ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The king declared, Isnt this Babylon, the magnificent city that I built as the royal house by my own mighty strength and for my own majestic glory.

dag: Yi daalahichi zaɣisibu moli mɔbu puuni bɛ na bi yihi yi ni so ʒim ku o.
en: None of you have yet been hurt in your battle against sin.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim ni bɛ puhim Yaɣigari chuɣu maa.
en: So Moses told the people to observe the Passover.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Doɛg, Nyin lum maligumaaniba maa zuɣu n-ku ba. Ka Doɛg ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛdom nir maa daa lu maligumaaniba maa zuɣu. Dindali maa o daa kula bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn so tan piɛla din be kaman mukuriti la ninvuɣ pihiniinaanu.
