en: Saul turned to Doeg, who was from Edom, and said, Kill the priests! On that same day, Doeg killed priests.

dag: O daa nyɛla yɛndana n-gari yɛnnim zaa. Hal o daa nyɛla yɛndana n-gari Ɛtan ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛzra nir la mini Hɛman ni Kalikol ni Darida bɛn daa nyɛ Mahol bihi la. Ka o yuli daa du pam zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ba zaa ni.
en: He was the wisest of all men: wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol, and his fame spread throughout all the neighboring countries.

dag: Ka a boli tuumbaŋdiba bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb n ni zaŋ baŋsim ti na nti chɛ ka bɛ she binyɛra ti Aduna ka o leei m maligumaana.
en: Tell all who are skilled, to whom I have given special abilities, to make clothing for Aaron for his dedication to serve me as a priest.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Daadam Bia yi ti ʒin o jilima nam ʒiishee dunia palli din kanna ni, yinim bɛn dol o ŋɔ gba ni ti ʒini nam ʒiishɛhi pinaayi ni n-kari Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la saria.
en: Jesus said to them, I assure you who have followed me that, when everything is made new, when the Human One sits on his magnificent throne, you also will sit on twelve thrones overseeing the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Bɛ yi daai bɛ zuɣulaannim tampima zuɣu luhina, di saha ka bɛ ni baŋ ni n yɛrila yɛlimaŋli.
en: Let their judges be put to death. Then everyone will know that I told the truth.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka yi leei maligumaaniba ni zuliya kasi. A ni yɛn yɛli Izraɛlnim maa yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa m-bala.
en: You will be a special nation—a kingdom of priests. Moses, you must tell the Israelites what I have said.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ʒini Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-nyɛ sana n-yuui pam.
en: Then Abraham lived a long time as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla sokam dim ka nyuma, ka diri bɛ tuma nyaɣisim. Di nyɛla Naawuni pini.
en: Moreover, this is the gift of God: that all people should eat, drink, and enjoy the results of their hard work.

dag: Ti daa bi bɔri paɣibu so sani, di yi nyɛla yi sani bee shɛb sani, hal ti di mali soli ni ti tooi suhi ya binshɛŋa ti ni nyɛ Masia tuumba la zuɣu.
en: We did not try to get praise from anyone, either from you or from others.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda mabia Shamma dapala Jɔnadab daa yɛli, N dana, di tɛhi ni bɛ ku nabihi maa zaa, Amnɔn kɔŋko n-kpi. Absalom n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o, ka dimbɔŋɔ maa nyɛla o ni pun lo shɛli dahin shɛli o ni daa zaŋ kiŋkansi dɔn o tizɔpaɣa Tama la zuɣu.
en: But Jonadab, the son of Davids brother Shimeah, said, My master shouldnt think that all the young princes have been killed—only Amnon is dead. This has been Absaloms plan ever since the day Amnon raped his sister Tamar.

dag: Ka n yɛtɔɣa mini n waazu yihibu daa pala yɛm yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din yi ninsalinim baŋsim ni na, amaa di daa yila Naawuni Shia Kasi tuma min o yiko ni na.
en: My message and my preaching werent presented with convincing wise words but with a demonstration of the Spirit and of power.

dag: Man Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa zahim zahin shɛli maa m-bala. To, nyin Bɛlitishaaza, wuhim ma di gbinni. Dama baŋdiba zaa bɛn be n tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni so kani n-ni tooi wuhi ma di gbinni, amaa nyin ni tooi, dama wun shɛb bɛn be kasi shia be a ni.
en: That is what I, King Nebuchadnezzar, dreamed. Now, Belteshazzar, tell me what it means. None of the wise men in my kingdom can tell me what that dream means. But Belteshazzar, you can interpret the dream because the spirit of the holy gods is in you.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa piila din nyɛ jɛrilim dunia ŋɔ ni ni o zaŋ li dihi yɛnnim vi; ka daa pii din nyɛ bin chɔɣima dunia ŋɔ ni ni o zaŋ li dihi yikolaannim vi;.
en: But God chose what the world considers foolish to shame the wise. God chose what the world considers weak to shame the strong.

dag: Ka zaŋ waagasi kpil pia ŋɔ mi ti ti bɛ yaɣili maa sapashin kpɛma, ka nya a biɛyanim maa daalaafee ni nyɛ shɛm, ka ʒi shɛhirili bini bɛ sani mali kuna.
en: And take these ten cheeses to the commanding officer. Find out how your brothers are getting along and bring back something to show that you saw them and that they are well.

dag: A yɛligu ka n zaŋ sɔɣi n suhu ni, ni di chɛ ka n ku tum alahichi a sani.
en: I study your teachings very carefully so that I will not sin against you.

dag: hal n ni bi tum taali, ka kul suhiri Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga maa zaa yoli.
en: But there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.

dag: Ka chinchin shɛli din daa yili Naawuni jɛmbu duu sunsuuni la daa cheei di zuɣusaa hal ti siɣi di tiŋli.
en: The curtain of the sanctuary was torn in two from top to bottom.

dag: Ka niriba nya teeku puuni kɔsoya, ka dunia ni tam tanza shɛŋa zuɣu yi zahira Yawɛ tahigu mini pɔhim shɛli din yiri o nyɛvoya ni na vuri zuɣu.
en: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ zoligɔnim ayi la noya gɔhi bintaɣindisi la. Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ zaŋ li gɔhi binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima la tooni.
en: They fastened the other ends of the gold chains to the settings on the shoulder pieces. They fastened these to the front of the ephod.

dag: A zaŋ a yiko nuu tilig a niriba bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu mini Yisifu zuliya la.
en: With your mighty arm you redeemed your people; redeemed the children of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

dag: So miri ka o ti ta Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ pin kasi shɛŋa na ti mali sara ti Yawɛ la daɣiri.
en: I warn you not to treat lightly the offerings that are brought by the people of Israel.

dag: Di bɔhiya so biɛri bee n-tu so labisi, amaa lee niŋmiyala alibarika niŋmi bɛn niŋdi ya zaɣ biɛɣu ni, dama dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka Naawuni daa boli ya ni di chɛ ka yi tooi nya o daalibarika.
en: Do not pay back evil with evil or cursing with cursing; instead, pay back with a blessing, because a blessing is what God promised to give you when he called you.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri lu yi zuɣu, ka bɛ be yi sani n-gbahi yi bihi mini yi niɣi n-chɛ ka yi kalinli filim, ka yi soya bili mɔri.
en: I will send dangerous animals among you, and they will kill your children, destroy your livestock, and leave so few of you that your roads will be deserted.

dag: Ibrahimma bia Ishimail ŋun nyɛ Haga, Zara dab paɣa ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti paɣ ni daa dɔɣ so la zuliya m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This is the list of Ishmaels family. Ishmael was Abraham and Hagars son.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Juda zuliya maa daŋ kam na ti zali, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Zɛra daŋ; ka o daa zaŋ Zɛra daŋ maa ni sokam ni o malibu zali, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Zabidi yiŋnima.
en: He brought the tribe of Judah forward, clan by clan, and the clan of Zerah was picked out. Then he brought the clan of Zerah forward, family by family, and the family of Zabdi was picked out.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wuɣiri situr piɛla ni ti yihi tahima, ka bɛn ʒi kpalu dari ni ninni biɛhigu ti taɣi.
en: Those who make cloth from flax, who weave it into linen, will all be sad.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim bɛn diri wahala Jɛrusalɛm, ka buɣi ka di pala wain ka yi nyu ŋɔ, wummiya!.
en: You suffering people of Jerusalem, you that stagger as though you were drunk.

dag: Ka Pool garigi yɛl o, Kpe ka di tu ni bɛ di ma saria, dama Naa Siiza ni zali sariakarita so tooni ka n zani ŋɔ. Amaŋmaŋ gba mi ni m bi tum Yɛhudianim taal shɛli.
en: Paul said, I am standing at Caesars judgment seat now. This is where I should be judged. I have done nothing wrong to the Jews, and you know it.

dag: Paɣimiy o; ŋuna n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun tum tuun kara din mali dabiɛm ka yi nina nya maa.
en: He is your praise, and he is your God—the one who performed these great and awesome acts that you witnessed with your very own eyes.

dag: Yi booni ma la yi karimba ni yi Duuma; yɛlimaŋli mi n-shiri nyɛ li, dama lala n-nyɛ ma.
en: You call me Teacher. And you call me Lord. And this is right, because that is what I am.

dag: O ni tooi sɔŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari zahimbu pumpɔŋɔ, dama omaŋmaŋ daa nya zahimbu ka di wahala.
en: And now he can help those who are tempted, because he himself was tempted and suffered.

dag: O yi yɛli, Bu shɛb bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ka n yɛn zaŋ yo a, buhi maa zaa ti dɔɣirila bubihi shɛb bɛn liɣisiliɣisi; ka o yi lan yɛli, Bu shɛb bɛn mali bomaboma ka n yɛn zaŋ yo a, buhi maa zaa ti dɔɣirila bubihi shɛb bɛn mali bomaboma.
en: If he said, The speckled ones will be your payment, the whole flock gave birth to speckled young. And if he said, The striped ones will be your payment, the whole flock gave birth to striped young.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili bɔpiɛligu ni yaɣiri tiŋgbani din daa be Sukɔt mini Zɛrɛda sunsuuni la ni ka Naa daa chɛ ka bɛ mali nɛma maa.
en: The king cast them in clay molds in the Jordan Valley between Succoth and Zarethan.

dag: Amaa anabi so ŋun ti zaŋ wuna yuya tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa bee anab so ŋun zaŋ n yuli tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n ni bi zal o ni o tɔɣisi, di daanab maa ni kpi.
en: However, any prophet who arrogantly speaks a word in my name that I havent commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods—that prophet must die.

dag: Naawuni ni daa zali ba zaligu shɛli din yɛli ni hal biŋkɔbigu yi shihi zoli maa, bɛn labim o kuɣa ku bee n-to o piɛm la daa kpɛhi ba dabiɛm ka nyaŋ ba dolibu.
en: because they could not bear the order which said, If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned to death.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ nahu bee piɛɣu ŋun mali daŋ mini binshɛɣukam din bi niŋ kamaata mali sara ti ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla din chihiri ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: You must not sacrifice to the Lord your God an ox or sheep that has anything wrong with it. The Lord your God would hate that.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa Yisa daa chani gindila Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka daa bi lan saɣi chani gindi Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, Yɛhudianim bɛn be nimaani ni daa lo ni bɛ ku o la zuɣu.
en: After this Jesus traveled throughout Galilee. He didnt want to travel in Judea, because the Jewish authorities wanted to kill him.

dag: A ni ti nya n ni yɛn niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ Izraɛlnim ni, ka di biɛr a ka a zabiri ba nyuli; amaa nyin daŋ ni so ku lan nya kɔb piɛlli o zuɣu ni hal abada.
en: Your family will have a lot of trouble. I will be kind to Israel, but everyone in your family will die young.

dag: Ka tinzun nir ŋun yɛn be yi sani niŋ daba ayi bee ŋun yɛn be yi sani sahakam o yi bɔri ni o mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim la, ŋun niŋmi kaman yi ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: And if at any time foreigners living among you, whether on a temporary or a permanent basis, make a food offering, an odor that pleases the Lord , they are to observe the same regulations.

dag: N suhu saɣimmi ka kuui kaman mɔri la, ka n kɔre ka bindirigu ni gba.
en: I am beaten down like dry grass; I have lost my desire for food.

dag: Ka Sool daa tim tuumba ni bɛ chaŋ ti nya Dauda, ka lan yɛli ba Ʒimiy o min o garo maa zaa na ka n ti ku o.
en: Saul sent the messengers back to check on David for themselves. Bring him to me on his bed, he ordered, so he can be executed.

dag: ka daa gari n salalaantab tooni Yɛhudianim adiini soli dolibu ni; ka di nyɛla n suhu ni daa kul ye n yaannim kaya dolibu zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: I was ahead of most other Jews of my age in my practice of the Jewish religion, and was much more devoted to the traditions of our ancestors.

dag: Ka Naa Agiripa yɛli Gomna Fɛstus, Doo maa yi di bi yɛli ni o ni zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋ Naa Siiza sani, nir naan tooi zaŋ o bahi kpe.
en: And Agrippa said to Festus, We could let him go free, but he has asked to see Caesar.

dag: Di chɛliya ka dimbɔŋɔ niŋ ya alahiziba, dama saha kanna ka bɛnkam zaa be gbala ni ni ti wum o kukoli.
en: Don't be surprised! The time will come when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of Man.

dag: Bimbɔ ka tumtumdiba lee nyari bɛ tuma puuni?.
en: What do we gain from all our work?.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba, Yumiya Yawɛ! Yawɛ guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim, amaa ka darigiri ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ karimbaandan tibili pam.
en: Love the Lord , all his faithful people. The Lord protects the faithful, but punishes the proud as they deserve.

dag: Yi ni nyɛ n ninvuɣ gahinda, ka n tiri ya jilima, ka yuri ya la zuɣu, n ni zaɣisi zuliya pam niriba, ka tiligi ya.
en: You are precious to me, and I have given you a special place of honor. I love you. Thats why I am willing to trade others, to give up whole nations, to save your life.

dag: Amaa lee maliyala suhupiɛlli yi mini Masia ni laɣim di wahala ni di chɛ ka yi suhuri ti paligi, ka yi tooi mali suhupiɛlli pam saha shɛl o jilima yi ti yi palo la.
en: But you should be happy that you are sharing in Christs sufferings. You will be happy and full of joy when Christ shows his glory.

dag: Aai! Hal ninsalinim zaa yi nyɛ ʒirinima, Naawuni ŋun kul nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana kaman di ni sab Naawuni Kundi ni shɛm la: Nyin Naawuni ku mali galimi a yɛtɔɣa ni, ka so mi ku ŋme a naŋgbankpeeni a saria karibu ni.
en: No, indeed! God tells the truth, even if everyone else is a liar. The Scriptures say about God, Your words will be proven true, and in court you will win your case.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu saha shɛli n ni daa wum yi ni niŋ ti Duuma yɛda mini yi ni yuri Yisa nyaandoliba zaa shɛm yɛla, di chɛ ka.
en: Since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all Gods people, this is the reason that.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, Yinim Judanim zaa mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni Naa Jɛhɔshafat, Wummiya; Yawɛ ni yɛli ya shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di zɔriya dabiɛm, ka di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhiri salo pam zuɣu, dama tɔb maa pala yi dini, amaa di nyɛla Naawuni dini.
en: Jahaziel said, Listen to me King Jehoshaphat and everyone living in Judah and Jerusalem! The Lord says this to you: Dont be afraid or worry about this large army, because the battle is not your battle. It is Gods battle!.

dag: Ka o yiŋbihi maa daa yi n-doli solɔri maa laɣim bɛ ni nya ninvuɣ shɛb zaa na; ninvuɣ biɛri mini ninvuɣ suma hal ka amiliya lɔbu duu maa ti tiɣi salo.
en: Then those servants went to the roads and gathered everyone they found, both evil and good. The wedding party was full of guests.

dag: Bɛ daa lan yɛli Jɔshua, Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ti. Ka din pahi nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa suhuri fuŋmi ti zuɣu.
en: They said to him, The Lord really has given us all the land. All the people in that country are afraid of us.

dag: ni tulaale shɛli bɛ ni booni kasia la kilɔgiram ayɔbu, ka yi ti zaŋ luɣ kasi shee sania la zahim di zaa. Ka a bo olivi kpam lita anahi pahi di zuɣu.
en: and pounds of cassia. Use the official measure to measure all these things. Also get gallon of olive oil.

dag: ni Bɛtinimira ni Bɛtiharan, ka me buzɔna zali bɛ piɛri mini buhi, ka me goondahi gil li.
en: Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fortified cities and walled enclosures for flocks.

dag: Jɔtam ni daa lan tum tuun shɛŋa zaa min o ni daa tuhi tɔb shɛŋa zaa ni o biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm zaa, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl mini Juda nanim litaafi ni.
en: The other events of Jotham's reign, his wars, and his policies, are all recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel and Judah .

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa zaŋ zuliyanim maa zaa zali ka bɛ vihi nya, ka piila Bɛnjamin zuliya.
en: Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near. Then Samuel began to choose the new king. First, the tribe of Benjamin was chosen.

dag: Di saha ka m bɔh o, Ŋun bia n-lee nyɛ a? Ka o yɛli ma, N nyɛla Bɛtuɛl bipuɣiŋga. Bɛtuɛl mi daa nyɛla Nahɔr mini Milika bidibiga. Ka n zaŋ nintua m-pir o, ka zaŋ bansi pir o.
en: Then I asked her, Whose daughter are you? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahors son whom Milcah bore him. I put a ring in her nose and bracelets on her arms.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni laɣiŋgu titali ni. Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim kɔbil nini ŋɔ!.
en: Bless God in the great congregation; bless the LORD from Israels fountain.

dag: Baasha ni daa kul di nam maa, di daa bi yuui ka o ku Jɛrɔbɔam yiŋnim zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka anabi Ahija Shilo nir la yɛli shɛm la. O daa bi chɛ hal bɛ ni ninvuɣ yino gba; o daa kula bɛ zaa.
en: The Lord 's prophet Ahijah had earlier said, Not one man or boy in Jeroboam's family will be left alive. And, as soon as Baasha became king, he killed everyone in Jeroboam's family.

dag: N yi ti zaŋ bindiripooli din nyɛ m peenzala la to a, piɛma din kuri niriba ka n yɛn zaŋ to a ku a, ka chɛ ka bindiripooli kul luri a zuɣu mɔŋ a bindirigu.
en: I told you I would send you terrible times of hunger. I told you I would send you things that would destroy you. I told you that I would take away your supply of food and that those times of hunger would come again and again.

dag: Amaa ka Jona suhu daa miligi pam, ka o suhu yiɣisi.
en: Jonah was very unhappy about this and became angry.

dag: O daa kurigiya zaa, ka mali azichi mini jilima, ka o dabisa daa ti pali, ka o naanyi kpi, ka o bia Sulemaana daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: David died when he was old. He had lived a good, long life and had many riches and honors. His son Solomon became the new king after him.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, Naawuni nini daa ti bi tiɣi bɛ zaa; kulla bɛ ni biɛla kɔŋko ka o nini daa tiɣi, ka daa chɛ ka bɛn kpalim la zaa bahi yoli mɔɣu ni luɣ kɔŋkɔba shee.
en: But God was not pleased with most of those people, so they were killed in the desert.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa yɛli Zara mi, Nyama, n zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhili ti a tizɔdoo maa ni di wuhi bɛnkam zaa be a sani mini sokam zaa ni a bi tum taali.
en: Then he said to Sarah, I have given your brother , pieces of silver as proof to everyone that you have done nothing wrong.

dag: Naawuni ŋɔ soli nyɛla din be tibi. Yawɛ daalikauli niŋdi pali. O nyɛla nyɔtaɣirigu n-taɣiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa zɔr kpɛr o yuli.
en: Your way is perfect, Lord , and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.

dag: Nyama, a du m-bala Ijiptinima bɛ mi nyɛla kaɣili jaaŋgbe kabili din ni kuhi ŋun dihiri li nuu. Lala ka Ijipti naa Firawuna be zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn du m-ba o polo. .
en: You are expecting Egypt to help you, but that would be like using a reed as a walking stick—it would break and jab your hand. That is what the king of Egypt is like when anyone relies on him.

dag: Ka doo maa yɛli, A ni zaŋ paɣ so ti ma ni o be n san la, ŋuna n-zaŋ tia maa walli maa ti ma ka n di.
en: The man said, The woman you put here with me gave me fruit from that tree. So I ate it.

dag: O daa yi Pita zuɣu, ka daa ti yi o nyaandoliba pinaayi la gba zuɣu.
en: that he appeared to Peter and then to all twelve apostles.

dag: Tol bɔbili kana nti lu ti tiŋgbɔŋ zuɣu. Bɛ mali yiko pam, ka lan galisi hal nti ka kalinli. Bɛ nyina dirimi kaman gbuɣinli nyina la, ka bɛ nyindari be kaman gbuɣinnyaŋ nyindari la.
en: A powerful nation with countless troops has invaded our land. They have the teeth and jaws of powerful lions.

dag: Amaa leemiyala bɛn tumdi yɛligu maa ni wuhi shɛm, ka pa ni bɛn yɔhim bɛmaŋ wumdila di ni yɛli shɛm kɔŋko.
en: Do not deceive yourselves by just listening to his word; instead, put it into practice.

dag: Nyini n-daa nam n niŋgbuŋ luɣilikam zaa; nyini n-daa zaŋ ma tuɣi taba m ma pul ni.
en: You are the one who created my innermost parts; you knit me together while I was still in my mothers womb.

dag: Judanim kuhirimi, ka bɛ fɔntinsinim tarigi; bɛ dola tiŋgban ni ni suhugarigu, ka Jɛrusalɛmnim kuhigu chaŋ haliya.
en: The nation of Judah cries for people who have died. The people in the cities of Judah grow weaker and weaker. They lie on the ground. People in Jerusalem, cry to God for help.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kali binshɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ binzahindigu zahim li, ka daa sabi binshɛɣukam tibisim ni nyɛ shɛm sɔŋ di saha maa.
en: Everything was counted and weighed, and the total weight was recorded.

dag: Pa n nuhi ka n daa zaŋ nam dimbɔŋɔnim zaa.
en: Remember, I made all these things! Isaiah :-.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Pita mini Zɛbidii bih ayi la pah omaŋ zuɣu, ka suhugarigu mini suhusaɣiŋgu daa gbaag o pam.
en: He told Peter and the two sons of Zebedee to come with him. Then he began to be very sad and troubled.

dag: Ka di yi ti paai daba ayopɔin dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli.
en: Then on the last day of the festival, you must once again rest from work and come together for worship.

dag: ka dihi ti nam n-zaŋ ti leei maligumaaniba ni ti jɛmd o Ba Naawuni. Ŋuna n-simdi tibigibu, ka simdi ni o su yiko hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: and made us a kingdom of priests to serve his God and Father. To Jesus Christ be the glory and power forever and ever! Amen.

dag: Huram daa lan mali daanya taha pia, ka di buɣisibu nyɛ mita yini ni sɛntimita pihinii, ka di zaɣ yini kam daa deerila kom litanim kɔbisinii.
en: Hiram also made ten small bronze bowls, one for each stand. The bowls were almost two meters across and could hold about liters.

dag: A bi bɔri biŋkɔbiri sara maligu mini sara maligu balibu kam; a mi bi bɔri alahichi kpihimbu sara maligunima bee bɛ ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb shɛba m-maani sara nyɔri ba buɣim bimbini zuɣu la; amaa a luɣila n tiba ti ma.
en: You do not want sacrifices and offerings; you do not ask for animals burned whole on the altar or for sacrifices to take away sins. Instead, you have given me ears to hear you.

dag: Di dubihi mini di pilanim ni di zɔntua mini dina la daa nyɛla yim, ka takɔriti be di ni zaa gili ni di zɔntua maa ni. Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: Its rooms, side walls, and porch also measured the same as the other gates. There were windows all around the gateway and its porch. The gateway was cubits long and cubits wide.

dag: A ni ti ŋmanila ninvuɣ so ŋun do teeku sunsuuni, ka ŋmani ŋun do ŋariŋ puuni daantaliga zuɣu.
en: You will feel as if you were out on the ocean, seasick, swinging high up in the rigging of a tossing ship.

dag: N daa wum a yɛligu, ka dee li, ka a yɛligu maa niŋ ma nyaɣisim, ka ti ma suhupiɛlli, dama nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ n su ma.
en: Your words came to me, and I ate them up. They made me very happy. I was glad to be called by your name, Lord God All-Powerful.

dag: Dabiɛm mini suhuchihibo n-daa lu bɛ zuɣu. A nuu din galisi ŋɔ zuɣu, bɛ kul fomi doya chichi kaman kuɣili la hal ka nyin Yawɛ niriba ti gari; hal ka a ni daa tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb la ti gari.
en: They will be filled with fear when they see your strength. They will be as still as a rock, Lord , while your people, the ones you made, pass by.

dag: Binnɛma ayi kɔtomsi din wuhiri ni Naawuni jilima be bɛ sani n-daa tam adaka maa zuɣusaa n-kul lihiri di zuɣusaa luɣ shɛli din booni Naawuni nambɔzɔbo shee la. Amaa ti ku tooi wuhi yɛla ŋɔ zaa gbinni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Above the Box were the Cherub angels that showed Gods glory. These Cherub angels were over the place of mercy. But we cannot say everything about this now.

dag: Ka Ɛlihu daa lan yɛli.
en: Be patient and listen a little longer to what I am saying on God's behalf.

dag: Di niŋdiya din bi tuhi yi saria karibu ni, di niŋya faralan nirilim bee n-chɛ yi ni di yɛn niŋ shɛm bundan zuɣu, amaa doliya wuntia soli n-kariti saria.
en: You must not act unjustly in a legal case. Do not show favoritism to the poor or deference to the great; you must judge your fellow Israelites fairly.

dag: Doo bee paɣ yi mali yum o zuɣu ni bee o teeŋa ni.
en: When any of you, male or female, have a sore on your head or chin.

dag: zaɣ biɛɣu ku tooi paag a, ka alɔbo shɛli mi ku tooi mir a yiŋ na.
en: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa boli maligumaaniba Zadok mini Abiata m-pahi Lɛvi zuliya ni niriba bɛn nyɛ: Uriɛl mini Asaaya ni Joɛl ni Shɛmaya ni Ɛliɛl ni Aminadab na.
en: David called together these six Levites and the two priests, Zadok and Abiathar.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa ŋmaligi yɛli ba, Yinim suhutunanim bɛn bi niŋdi anabinim yɛligu yɛda ŋɔ!.
en: Then Jesus said to them, How foolish you are, how slow you are to believe everything the prophets said!.

dag: Miriya ka yi booni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yuli yoliyoli, dama ŋunkam booni man Yawɛ yuli yoliyoli mali taali man Yawɛ sani.
en: You must not use the name of the Lord your God to make empty promises. If you do, the Lord will not let you go unpunished.

dag: Yisa ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ bahi, o daa yiɣisila nimaani n-kpe ŋariŋ yi kpaŋa. Ka salo daa wum o chandi maa damli, ka yi tinsi ni n-chaŋ bɛ naba zuɣu kar o naba.
en: After Jesus heard about John, he crossed Lake Galilee to go to some place where he could be alone. But the crowds found out and followed him on foot from the towns.

dag: Naa Ahaz muɣisigu ŋɔ ni daa ti kɔŋ tim saha shɛli o daa maan kpɛla din bie nti yaɣi tumbu ni zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani.
en: In Ahazs troubles, he sinned worse and became more unfaithful to the Lord .

dag: Man Daniɛl kɔŋko n-daa nya ʒii maa. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be n sani bɛn daa bi nya li, amaa ka dabiɛm lee gbahi ba pam ka bɛ zo nti sɔɣi.
en: Although the people who were with me did not see the vision, they became so frightened that they scattered and hid.

dag: Wummiya Hɔrɔnaimnim kuhigu na. Damili dambu mini saɣiŋgu pam.
en: Listen to the cries for help from Horonaim: Destruction and massive devastation.

dag: Nyama, mɔɣili kopaliga yi ti kpɛma, o bi zɔri dabiɛm; ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili kopaliga yi ŋmɛr o noli o suhu ʒimi.
en: It remains calm and unafraid with the Jordan River rushing and splashing in its face.

dag: N ni zaŋ li ti tinzunnima, ka bɛ zaŋ li ti dunia ŋɔ ninvuɣ biɛri, ka di leei bɛ ni ŋme n-di shɛli. Bɛ ni ti ta li daɣiri.
en: I will let foreigners rob them, says the Lord , and lawbreakers will take all their wealth and defile it.

dag: M mabihi, ti Duuma Yisa Masia n-nyɛ Duuma ŋun nyɛ Jilimalana. Ka yi ni doli yɛda niŋbu adiini so shɛli o ni zal la zuɣu, di yaaya so yuri ka chɛ so.
en: My friends, as believers in our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, you must never treat people in different ways according to their outward appearance.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔhi taba, O ni di tɔɣisiri ti yɛtɔɣa sol ni ka kahigiri Naawuni litaafinim wuhiri ti la, di di bi kpe ti suhuri ni pam.
en: They said to each other, Werent our hearts on fire when he spoke to us along the road and when he explained the scriptures for us.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ daa kul timd anabinim bɛ sani waawaayili, dama o niriba maa mini ŋun Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la yɛla daa mal o nambɔɣu.
en: Time and time again, the LORD, the God of their ancestors, sent word to them through his messengers because he had compassion on his people and his dwelling.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni!.
en: Praise the Lord ! My soul, praise the Lord !.

dag: Yisahaku ni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Yaakubu ni naai, ka Yaakubu ŋmalig o ba Yisahaku sani yi, di daa bi yuui ka o biɛli Iso yi o mɔɣu gɔbu maa paa na.
en: Isaac finished giving his blessing, and as soon as Jacob left, his brother Esau came in from hunting.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Mani m-bɔŋɔ; di pun sabi n yɛla Kundi ni.
en: and so I answered, Here I am; your instructions for me are in the book of the Law.

dag: Amaa ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ omaŋmaŋ taali? Chɛli n daashilɔni taali.
en: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa kana ti zani miri niriba maa zaa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ saha ka yi leei kul yɛn chɛ yi tɛha buyiyi ŋɔ? Yawɛ n-yi nyɛ Naawuni, yin doliy o, ka Baal n-yi nyɛ Naawuni, yin doliy o. Ka niriba maa daa bi garigi yɛl o shɛli.
en: Elijah stood in front of them and said, How much longer will you try to have things both ways? If the Lord is God, worship him! But if Baal is God, worship him! The people did not say a word.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Ka ŋunkam lu kuɣili maa zuɣu ni chɛrisichɛrisi, amaa kuɣili maa mi yi lu so zuɣu, di ni niɛm o buɣibuɣi kaman zim la.
en: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken. If that stone falls on you, it will crush you.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna, Yi bi niŋ ma yɛda, ka bi wuhi n ni be kasi shɛm Izraɛlnim sani, dinzuɣu yi ku zaŋ ba kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ ti ba maa ni.
en: But the Lord reprimanded Moses and Aaron. He said, Because you did not have enough faith to acknowledge my holy power before the people of Israel, you will not lead them into the land that I promised to give them.

dag: m-pahi o yiko shɛli din tumdi tuma tinim bɛn niŋ yɛda ŋɔ ni ni galisi shɛm la. Yiko shɛli din be ti ni ŋɔ mini Naawuni ni daa zaŋ yiko shɛli.
en: and how very great is his power at work in us who believe. This power working in us is the same as the mighty strength.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu tarili ni nyɛ shɛli Naawuni sani m-bala. Naawuni ni zaŋ tarili shɛli zali ba m-bala.
en: This is a wicked persons lot from God, their heritage decreed by God.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zo n-chaŋ ti zaŋ o na, ka o ni daa kana nti zani niriba maa sani, o daa wɔɣ gari sokam.
en: So they ran and brought Saul out to the people, and they could see that he was a foot taller than anyone else.

dag: N yɛr a mi ni a ku tooi yi nimaani faashee a ti yo bɛ ni zal a san shɛli zaa, ka di laɣifu ku guui.
en: I tell you, you will not get out of there until you have paid every cent you owe.

dag: Wummi n suhigu, dama bɛ filim ma. Tiligim ma n dimnim nuu ni, dama bɛ mali yaa gari ma.
en: Listen to my cry for help, for I am sunk in despair. Save me from my enemies; they are too strong for me.

dag: Amaa kulibɔŋ bee kɔbil shɛli din mali kom, din nyɛla din ka daɣiri. Amaa binshɛɣukam din shihi binkpiŋ ni leei din nyɛ daɣiri.
en: but a spring or a cistern remains clean, although anything else that touches their dead bodies is unclean.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Juda nayili polo m-bɔŋɔ: A ŋmanila Giliad n sani, ka ŋmani Lɛbanɔn zoya, amaa m poya ni n ni zaŋ a leei tiŋgban nɛli, ninsalinim ni ka luɣ shɛli.
en: Listen to what I think about it: The palace of Judah's king is as glorious as Gilead or Lebanon's highest peaks. But it will be as empty as a ghost-town when I'm through with it.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa kpi ti zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti min o laɣim be, di yi nyɛ ti bela ti nyɛviya ni bee ti yi gbihirila kum puuni.
en: Jesus died for us so that we can live together with him. It is not important if we are alive or dead when Jesus comes.

dag: Paɣ yi wolisiri ni o dɔɣi, o malila suhusaɣiŋgu o biɛrim nyabu saha ni paai zuɣu; amaa o yi ti dɔɣi bia maa naai, o bi lan teer o biɛrim maa yɛla yaha, o ni dɔɣi bia dunia ni maa zuɣu.
en: When a woman gives birth, she has pain because her time has come. But when the child is born, she no longer remembers her distress because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.

dag: Ka bɛ shɛb bɛn kpalim, alɔbo ni di ba, ka bɛ pakoya ku kum bɛ kuya.
en: Their survivors will be buried with the dead; their widows wont weep.

dag: Ka Pool daa garigi yɛli Di chaŋ wula ka yi kuhiri ŋ-ŋmari n yɛma? M mali shili gu shɛlikam, pa ni bɛ ti lo ma mihi Jɛrusalɛm n-kpɛhi duu kɔŋko, amaa n loya ni n ti kpi nimaani gba n Duuma Yisa yuli zuɣu.
en: But he answered, What are you doing, crying like this and breaking my heart? I am ready not only to be tied up in Jerusalem but even to die there for the sake of the Lord Jesus.

dag: Niriba maa zɔrimi ni bɛ tiligi bɛ ni ŋooi takɔb shɛli mini bɛ ni vooi tɔb shɛli ni bɛ to barina ni.
en: They were running from swords that were ready to kill. They were running from bows that were ready to shoot. They were running from a hard battle.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ tooi mali sara din ni tiɣi Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ nini, ka suh o naa min o bihi nyɛviya zuɣu.
en: I want them to be able to offer pleasing sacrifices to God and to pray for me and my family.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm din lu dahim ŋɔ, yilimi suhupiɛlli yila! Dama Yawɛ tilig o tiŋa, ka maag o niriba suhuri.
en: Break into shouts of joy, you ruins of Jerusalem! The Lord will rescue his city and comfort his people.

dag: A ni yɛn yɛl o shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyama, n yɛn wurimla n ni daa me shɛli zali, ka vuɣi n ni daa sa shɛli tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: But I, the Lord , am tearing down what I have built and pulling up what I have planted. I will do this to the entire earth.

dag: Bakɔi piligu dali asibaasi, di ni daa na bi neei zaa saha shɛli ka Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la daa chaŋ siliga maa gbini nti nya ka kuɣili din daa yo siliga maa nol la biligimi doya.
en: On Sunday morning while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been rolled away from the entrance.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt lan bɔhi ba yaha, Ka wula ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ Yisa so bɛ ni booni Masia la? Ka bɛ zaa yɛli, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: What, then, shall I do with Jesus called the Messiah? Pilate asked them. Crucify him! they all answered.

dag: O ni daa kpi kum shɛl la, o daa kpimi yim zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo, amaa nyɛvil shɛli o ni mali be ŋɔ, Naawuni zuɣu ka o be maa.
en: He died to sin once and for all with his death, but he lives for God with his life.

dag: ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Cham ti yɛli niriba maa ka bɛ mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi zuŋɔ ni biɛɣuni, ka chɛ ka bɛ paɣi bɛ situra zaa.
en: And the Lord said to Moses, Today and tomorrow you must prepare the people for a special meeting. They must wash their clothes.

dag: Naawuni dan ya la shaara, dinzuɣu di leeya ninsalinim daba.
en: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.

dag: Ka sokam daa nya o ni chani ka paɣiri Naawuni maa.
en: Everyone saw him walking around and praising God.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka piɛguliba maa daa yi ni labiri kuna ka yiini yila paɣiri Naawuni bɛ ni daa wum ka nya shɛm maa zuɣu, dama di daa kul nyɛla kaman malaika la ni daa yɛli ba shɛm.
en: The shepherds went back to their sheep, praising God and thanking him for everything they had seen and heard. It was just as the angel had told them.

dag: ka tiri kum ni kuri shɛb bindira, ka tiri nandaamba bɛ ni kɔŋ shɛli, dindina yi neesim ni neei zibisim ni m-be kaman wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha neesim la.
en: Give your food to the hungry and care for the homeless. Then your light will shine in the dark; your darkest hour will be like the noonday sun.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi tin tariga nti siɣi wain adaka maa puuni nɔra, ka ʒim daa zɔri yiri wain tɔɣiri adaka maa ni na n-zo n-chaŋ hal ti paai kaman kilomita kɔbisita wɔɣilim tariga, ka di zilim mi paai wɔhu nyɔɣu tariga.
en: The grapes were squeezed out in the wine press outside the city, and blood came out of the wine press in a flood two hundred miles long and about five feet deep.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka ti daa kpam Taitus jaande ni o ni daa pun piligi niŋdi shɛm la o kul niŋmi lala n-naai yurilim tuuni ŋɔ yi gba sani.
en: As a result, we challenged Titus to finish this work of grace with you the way he had started it.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ijipti Naa wain boora min o bɔrɔbɔro shɛra daa ti tum birigi bɛ dan Ijipti naa maa.
en: Some time later, both the wine steward and the baker for Egypts king offended their master, the king of Egypt.

dag: Yi bi mi ni binshɛɣukam din kpɛri ninsal nol ni chani ti kpɛrila o pul ni n-gariti ti yira?.
en: Don't you know that the food you put into your mouth goes into your stomach and then out of your body?.

dag: Yisa ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri ba yɛtɔɣa maa ka zuɣulan so daa kana nti damd o tooni yɛl o, M bipuɣiŋga n-na kul yoli kpi; amaa kamina nti zaŋ a nuu pa o zuɣu ka o lan niŋ nyɛvililana yaha.
en: While Jesus was still speaking, an official came and knelt in front of him. The man said, My daughter has just now died! Please come and place your hand on her. Then she will live again.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa ti lan labina pahi buyi nti shih o ka yɛli, Yiɣisim di ka nyu, di yi pa lala a chandi maa ni ti nyaŋ a.
en: The Lord 's angel returned and woke him up a second time, saying, Get up and eat, or the trip will be too much for you.

dag: A mi ni a nyɛla zoomba sowuhira mini bɛn be zibisim ni firila.
en: you are sure that you are a guide for the blind, a light for those who are in darkness.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku bɛ maligumaaniba, ka bɛ pakoya daa bi tooi kum bɛ zuɣu.
en: Priests died by violence, and their widows were not allowed to mourn.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛli Manɔa, N ni daa yɛli paɣ maa shɛlikam zaa la, di simdi ni o dol li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Your wife must be careful to do everything I told her, the Lord 's angel answered.

dag: O daa zaŋla Bɛnjamin zuliya maa ni niriba tuhili pa omaŋ zuɣu na. Ka Ziba ŋun daa nyɛ Sool daŋ niriba tumtumda la daa zaŋ o bidibisi pinaanu min o tumtumdiba pisi n-zo n-daŋ naa tooni chaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni.
en: About people from the tribe of Benjamin came with Shimei. Ziba the servant from Sauls family also came. Ziba brought his sons and servants with him. All these people hurried to the Jordan River to meet King David.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn da ba ku ba mi bi nya tibidarigibo; ka bɛn kɔhi bɛ nimdi mi yɛli, Ti paɣiri Naawuni! Ti leei bundaannima. Hal piɛri maa maŋmaŋ piɛguliba maa daa bi zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: Buyers kill their sheep and are not punished. Those who sell the sheep say, Praise the Lord , I am rich! The shepherds dont feel sorry for their sheep.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyamiya, niriba yi nuzaa polo tiŋgbɔŋ ni kanna. Bɛ nyɛla zuliya shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ka lo tɔbu n-yi katiŋ damdi dunia ŋɔ bɔba ni yaɣa ni.
en: The Lord says, People are coming from a country in the north; a mighty nation far away is preparing for war.

dag: ka naanyi di bindirigu n-lan nya kpiɔŋ. Ka Sool daa kpalim Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn daa be Damaskus sani n-niŋ daba ayi;.
en: and after he had eaten, his strength came back. Saul stayed for a few days with the believers in Damascus.

dag: Amaa naɣilaa maa min o gbaŋ ni o nimdi ni o bindi dina, o daa zaŋ li yila bɛ biɛhigu maa shee kpaŋa nti nyo li buɣim kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: Moses took the bulls skin, its meat, and its body waste outside the camp. He burned these things in a fire outside the camp. He did everything just as the Lord commanded him.

dag: ka o yɛl o mabihi maa, Bɛ zaŋla n liɣiri labisi niŋ ma, dina m-be n kpalaŋ ni ŋɔ. Ka bɛ suhuri daa fuŋ di zuɣu, ka bɛ ni sɔhiri ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Ka tuun bɔ ka Naawuni lee tum ti ŋɔ.
en: He said to his brothers, My silvers been returned. Its right here in my sack. Their hearts stopped. Terrified, they said to each other, What has God done to us.

dag: Hal saŋkpaliŋ zomi ka chɛ o biliɛɣu mɔɣu ni, dama mɔri lan kani.
en: Even the mother deer in the field leaves her newborn baby alone, because there is no grass.

dag: Hiburɔn bidibisi ni, Jɛria n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Amaria pa, Jahaziɛl n-daa pah ata, ka Jɛkamiam pah anahi.
en: Kohath's third son, Hebron, had four sons: Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.

dag: Amaa n ni yɛlimi, M Ba, chɛ ka a yuli nya jilima. Di saha ka kukol shɛli vuri daa yi alizanda ni na yɛra, M pun chɛ ka di nya jilima; amaa n ni lan chɛ ka di nya jilima pahi.
en: So Father, bring glory to yourself. A voice from heaven then said, I have already brought glory to myself, and I will do it again.

dag: Ka Jabɛz daa ti suhi Izraɛlnim Naawuni yɛli, N suhir a ni a chɛ ka a daalibarika be n ni, ka chɛ ka n tiŋgbani galisi, ka a zaŋ a nuu pa n zuɣu n-tiligi ma zaɣibiɛɣ kam zaa ni, ka zaɣibiɛɣ ku niŋ ma. Ka Naawuni daa ti o o ni suh o shɛli maa.
en: Jabez prayed to the God of Israel and said, I pray that you would bless me and give me more land! Be near me and dont let anyone hurt me! Then I will not have any pain. God gave Jabez what he asked for.

dag: Ka bɛn daa dol o liɣi ʒiɛya n-wumdi kukoli maa, amaa ka lee bi nya so.
en: Those traveling with him stood there speechless; they heard the voice but saw no one.

dag: Ka teeku maa kom pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim leei ʒim, ka teeku maa ni binnɛma zaa pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim kpi, ka ŋarima din daa pa teeku maa kom zuɣu diba ata kam puuni zaɣ yini saɣim.
en: a third of the creatures living in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.

dag: N yura ŋmanila mɛɛr kpalambila m-pa m biha sunsuuni.
en: A sachet of myrrh is my love to me, lying all night between my breasts.

dag: ni Azimavɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Baharum nir la ni Ɛliaba ŋun daa nyɛ Shaalibɔn nir la.
en: Azmaveth from Baharum; Eliahba from Shaalbon.

dag: Ka niŋgbuŋ din poori ŋɔ yi ti leei din bi poora, ka niŋgbuŋ din kpiri ŋɔ mi ti leei din bi kpira, di saha maa di ni ti niŋ kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Kum kɔŋ nasara!.
en: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, Death has lost the battle!.

dag: Ka Barizillai ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nir la daa yi Rɔgɛlim n-chaŋ naa sani Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni ni o ti doli naa du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa.
en: Now Barzillai the Gileadite had come down from Rogelim. He accompanied the king to the Jordan River to send him off there.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, nyini ka n zaŋ n nina lihira. A sani ka n sɔɣi. Di chɛ ma ka m bahi yoli!.
en: But I keep trusting in you, my Sovereign Lord . I seek your protection; don't let me die!.

dag: Ka dunianim suhuri ni paligi bɛ kum maa zuɣu, ka bɛ ni mali suhupiɛlli ka tiri tab pina, anabinima ayi maa ni daa yi nahindi dunianim shɛm la zuɣu.
en: Everyone on the earth will be happy because these two are dead. They will have parties and send each other gifts. They will do this because these two prophets brought much suffering to the people living on earth.

dag: di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛ kurili, ka di simdi ka maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni. O di lan zaŋ o niŋ duu yaha, o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: it is leprosy that has been there for a long time. The priest must announce that the person is unclean. He does not have to wait until after a period of separation, because he already knows that the person is unclean.

dag: Ka o tuma dabisa daa ti naai ka o kul o yiŋa.
en: When his time of service was finished, he went home.

dag: N di n-tiɣi kaman chuɣu ka m puhi la, ka yaai n noli paɣ a ni suhupiɛlli.
en: My soul will feast and be satisfied, and I will sing glad songs of praise to you.

dag: Niriba pam daa sab yɛl shɛŋa din daa pun niŋ ti sani.
en: Dear Theophilus: Many people have done their best to write a report of the things that have taken place among us.

dag: Ka bua maa ni deei bɛ tuumbiɛri zaa ʒi n-chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka o ti zaŋ bua maa bahi mɔɣu maa ni.
en: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.

dag: So ka tɛha bee baŋsim din ni chɛ ka o baŋ ka yɛli: N zaŋla dari maa pirigili mali buɣim n-zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini nimdi she di buɣimsala ni ŋubi, ka ŋmaligi zaŋ din kpalim mali binshɛli din bi tu ni m mali n-damdi di tooni jɛm li.
en: The maker of idols hasn't the wit or the sense to say, Some of the wood I burned up. I baked some bread on the coals, and I roasted meat and ate it. And the rest of the wood I made into an idol. Here I am bowing down to a block of wood.

dag: N dihi dimbɔŋɔ tabili, dinzuɣu m mi ni n na ni be. M mini ya zaa na ni be ka n sɔŋ chɛ ka yi tooni chandi mini yi suhupiɛlli zooi pahi yi yɛda niŋbu puuni.
en: I am sure of this, and so I know that I will stay. I will stay on with you all, to add to your progress and joy in the faith.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Zaŋm chɛribo kuɣa mali pilima n-guni Izraɛlnima, ka di niŋ din pahi napɔŋ buyi.
en: Then the Lord told Joshua, Make some knives out of flint and circumcise the Israelites.

dag: A daanabinim nyala ʒiinim din pa yɛlimaŋli mini ʒiinim din nyɛ yɔhiŋ. Bɛ bi kahigir a daalahichi wuhir a din ni chɛ ka a yi dabitim ni. Amaa bɛ tɔɣisirila anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ ʒiri, ka di kpɛh a yɔɣu.
en: Your prophets had nothing to tell you but lies; Their preaching deceived you by never exposing your sin. They made you think you did not need to repent.

dag: Saha shɛli maligumaaniba maa ni daa yi luɣ kasi shee maa na, bɛ daa bi lan doli zaɣila nyɛla yaakaza, dama maligumaaniba maa zaa daa pun malila bɛmaŋa.
en: All the priests who were there did the ceremony to make themselves holy. Then, as they came out of the Holy Place, they stood together, but not in their special groups.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ naa nini daa galimi, ka o yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm niriba tuma yɛla teebu ni be yɛlikura litaafi shɛl ni la na, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li na.
en: That night the king could not sleep, and he had a servant read him the records of what had happened since he had been king.

dag: Ti ni daa be yi sani maa, ti daa bahi ya noli ni ŋun je ni o tum tuma bi simdi ni o di.
en: We also gave you this rule: If you don't work, you don't eat.

dag: N suhir a, deemi n ni zaŋ pin shɛl na ti ti a maa, dama Naawuni n-niŋ ma nirilim ti ma n ni mali shɛlikam maa, ka m mi mali pam. Lala ka Yaakubu daa balim o hal ka o ti dee li.
en: So I beg you to also accept the gifts I give you. God has been very good to me. I have more than I need. Because Jacob begged Esau to take the gifts, he accepted them.

dag: Firawuna daa lan niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun chɛ ka Musa yɛli shɛm la.
en: and, just as the Lord had foretold through Moses, the king would not let the Israelites go.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni ti zaŋla chira ayopɔin sɔɣi ba din ni chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa mali.
en: The Israelites will spend seven months burying dead bodies and cleaning up their land.

dag: ka n tiri ba nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka bɛ ti ku bahi yoli, ka so mi ku tooi fa ba n nuu ni.
en: and I give them eternal life, so that they will never be lost. No one can snatch them out of my hand.

dag: Amaa nyini n-chɛ ka a shia kanna ti kpɛri bɛ ni, ka bɛ leeri a ni nam shɛba; ka a ti tiŋgbani nyɛvil palli.
en: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.

dag: Ka a ti booi li bahi Aduna min o bidibisi zuɣu ni m-mali ba ka bɛ be kasi, ka leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi n tuma.
en: Then anoint Aaron and his sons, and ordain them as priests in my service.

dag: Di daa bi yuui, ka o kuhi yɛli, Wɔribariba be chɛchɛbuŋ ni, ka yuri ayi vɔri li kanna! Di saha ka o daa lan yɛli, Babilɔn luya, di luya! Ka di wuna binnana zaa lu n-wurisiwurisi do tiŋa.
en: Look! I see a man in a chariot with a team of horses. The messenger said, Babylon has been defeated! It has fallen to the ground! All the statues of her false gods were thrown to the ground and broken to pieces.

dag: Ka Ɛbɛd bia Gaal maa daa yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Abimilɛk, ka tinim Shɛkɛmnim ti jɛmd o? Gidiɔn bia mini Zɛbul ŋun nyɛ o sapashin kpɛm la daa bi jɛmdila Hamɔr ŋun daa nyɛ Shɛkɛmnim yab la niriba? Ka bɔzuɣu ka ti yɛn jɛm o?.
en: Gaal, Ebeds son, said, Who is Abimelech, and who are we of Shechem that we ought to serve him? Didnt this son of Jerubbaal and his deputy Zebul once serve the men of Hamor, Shechems father? Why should we of all people serve him?.

dag: Tinzunnim yi be zuliya shɛb sani, yin tim ba bɛ tarili nimaani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will assign the immigrants inheritance with the tribe with whom they reside. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: amaa n daa bi nya Yisa Masia tuumba maa ni so naɣila ti Duuma tizo Jeemsi.
en: But I didnt see any other of the apostles except James the brother of the Lord.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ nti dalim siliga maa noli kuɣili la, ka zali tɔbbihi ka bɛ gul li.
en: So they left and made the tomb secure by putting a seal on the stone and leaving the guard on watch.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ be ti sani. Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ti ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our place of safety. Selah.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Ɛbɛl daa mali sara din so Keen dini, ka di daa tiɣi Naawuni nini, ka o deeg o pini maa ka lih o wuntizɔra. Ɛbɛl pun kpi, amaa o yɛda niŋbu puuni o na kul tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: Because Abel had faith, he offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. God was pleased with him and his gift, and even though Abel is now dead, his faith still speaks for him.

dag: A pun wum Asiria naa ni niŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa shɛm ni o ni saɣim li zaa shɛm yɛla. A tɛhiya ni nyin ni tiligi?.
en: You have heard what the kings of Assyria did to all the other countries. We destroyed them completely. Will you be saved? No!.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa ti lan liri vinvamli ni nim maa n-lan tuhi ba, ka di bɛ nɛma.
en: Soon the Philistines returned to the valley and started plundering it again.

dag: Naawuni ni saɣisi ninvuɣ so mali suhupiɛlli. Dinzuɣu miri ka a ʒiɛm Kpiɔŋlan Naa saɣisigu.
en: You are fortunate when God corrects you. So dont complain when God All-Powerful punishes you.

dag: n naŋgbampiba ku ŋma ʒiri, ka n zilinli mi ku tɔɣisi yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa.
en: I will not be a hypocrite. I will not lie.

dag: Ka n nyee daa ti nyɔni piɛguliba ata shɛb bɛn daa je ma, ka n kari ba gol yini puuni.
en: I removed three shepherds in one month when I grew impatient with them. Moreover, they detested me.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka bɛ ni ti kana ti zaŋ binshɛɣukam din be a yiŋ puuni min a yaannim ni daa bo binshɛɣukam zali hal ni zuŋɔ la n-kuli Babilɔn, ka di shɛli ku kpalim. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The time is coming when everything in your house and everything your ancestors have saved until today will be carried away to Babylon. Nothing will be left! The Lord All-Powerful said this.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa lan tirisi tooni ha ti zani luɣ muɣiliŋga shee ka palo lan kani ka nir ni tooi birigi nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo.
en: The LORDs messenger persisted and crossed over and stood in a narrow place, where it wasnt possible to turn either right or left.

dag: Naawuni, chɛ ka a tibiginsim du n-gari zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka a jilima be dunia ni zaa.
en: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.

dag: Nir yi na bi wum yɛtɔɣili bahigu ka daŋ garigibu, di nyɛla jɛrilim mini vi.
en: It's stupid and embarrassing to give an answer before you listen.

dag: Amaa Sulemaana daa bi zaŋ Izraɛlnim leeg o daba ni bɛ tumd o tuma, bɛna n-daa nyɛ o tɔbbihi min o sapashin kpamba ni kpamba bɛn daa su o chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba fukumsi.
en: Solomon did not force any of the Israelites to be his slaves. They were soldiers, government officials, officers, captains, and chariot commanders and drivers.

dag: Nimaani ka ti daa nya ŋariŋ shɛli din chani Fɔnisia, ka ti kpe li chaŋ.
en: We found a ship going to Phoenicia, so we got on board and sailed off.

dag: Wain kurili mini wain palli niriba yɛm.
en: and have been unfaithful to me, their Lord . My people, you are foolish because of too much pleasure and too much wine.

dag: ka zaŋ yi tizɔbil maa ti ma na, dina n-ni chɛ ka m baŋ ni yi pala puɣisiriba, amaa ka nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛriba, ka n naanyi zaŋ yi mabia maa tin ya ka yi gɔri kɔhigu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. .
en: But bring your youngest brother to me, so I can be certain that you are honest men and not spies. After that, I'll let your other brother go free, and you can stay here and trade.

dag: Tuumba maa ni daa ti paai Gibia din nyɛ Sool ya la nti yɛli yɛlli maa ka di lu niriba tiba ni, bɛ daa dii duhila kuŋa n-kuhiri pampam.
en: Some of the messengers went to Gibeah, Saul's hometown. They told what was happening at Jabesh, and everyone in Gibeah started crying.

dag: ka yɛli li, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: M bi ʒe a nyaaŋa, nyini Seir Zoli. N teela n nuu jɛnd a ni n chɛ ka a zani dabari bahi yoli.
en: Tell the people what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying: I am your enemy, mountains of Edom! I will make you a desolate wasteland.

dag: Juda zuliya ni, ninvuɣ tuhi pinaayi ka bɛ daa tabili, Rubin zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Gaad zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi.
en: from the tribe of Judah: , from the tribe of Reuben: , from the tribe of Gad: .

dag: Naa, a dooshee ka tɛha daa ti ka a sanna zaŋ chaŋ dahin shɛli ha yɛla polo; ka Naawuni ŋun kahigiri ashiya wuhiri niriba ŋɔ daa wuh a din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha yɛla.
en: King, as you were lying there on your bed, you began thinking about what might happen in the future. God can tell people about secret things—he has shown you what will happen in the future.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan bɔhi ba yaha, Ka wula ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ yi ni booni so Yɛhudianim Naa ŋɔ.
en: Pilate asked the people again, So what should I do with this man you call the king of the Jews.

dag: ni Zanɔa ni Adulam ni di tiŋkpansi ni Lakishi ni di puri ni Azɛka ni di tiŋkpansi ka bɛ daa ʒini Bɛrishiiba zaŋ hal ni Hinnom Vinvamli ni.
en: Zanoah, Adullam, Lachish, and Azekah. In fact, they settled the towns from Beersheba in the south to Hinnom Valley in the north.

dag: a ni zaŋ zali zuliya kam zaa ninni ŋɔ.
en: and foreign nations will also see this.

dag: Ka yi yi pɔhi yi wain tihi wala, di nyaaŋa yin di lan chaŋ ti yihi di zaɣ yaha; di nyɛla sana mini kpibiga ni pakoli dini.
en: When you gather the grapes from your vineyard, you must not go back to gather the grapes you left. They will be for the foreigners, the orphans, and the widows.

dag: Tɔbbi ŋuni m-mi n-chaŋ tɔbu ni nti su omaŋmaŋ bindirigu fukumsi? Ka ŋuni m-mi n-sa tihi ka ku di di wala? Bee ŋuni m-mi n-guli niɣi ka ku nyu bɛ bihim?.
en: Who joins the army and pays their own way? Who plants a vineyard and doesnt eat its fruit? Who shepherds a flock and doesnt drink its milk?.

dag: O ni daa nya ka Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim pam gba kanna ni o ti baptaizi ba ka o bɔhi ba, Yinim garinsi zuliya ŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee saɣisi yi mi ni yi zo n-yi mbusim shɛli din ti yɛn kana ŋɔ ni?.
en: Many Pharisees and Sadducees came to where John was baptizing people. When John saw them, he said, You are all snakes! Who warned you to run from Gods judgment that is coming?.

dag: Ka tɔroko maa daa chaŋ ti kpalim zani Bɛtishɛmɛshi maa do so ŋun yuli daa booni Jɔshua la puu ni. Kuɣ titali daa do nimaani, ka bɛ daa wɔri tɔroko maa dari n-kɔri niɣi maa pa di zuɣu n-nyo buɣim m-mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: The cart entered the field belonging to Joshua of Beth-shemesh and stopped right by a large stone. They chopped up the wood of the cart and offered the cows as an entirely burned offering to the LORD.

dag: nti kurim lihi di ni nya ka bimpiɛlli doya, amaa ka o lee bi kpe di ni.
en: He bent down and looked in. He saw the pieces of linen cloth lying there, but he did not go in.

dag: Ka Ada daa dɔɣi Ɛlifaz ti Iso; ka Basɛmat dɔɣi Riuɛl ti o;.
en: Esau and Adah had a son named Eliphaz. Basemath had a son named Reuel.

dag: Ka o daa boli maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba na nti bɔhi ba, Ya polo ka bɛ daa lee yɛli ni bɛ ni ti dɔɣi Masia la.
en: Herod called a meeting of all the leading Jewish priests and teachers of the law. He asked them where the Messiah would be born.

dag: Yinim Mɔabnima, yimiya yi fɔntinsi ni chaŋ ti be tampima ni. Benya kaman ŋman so ŋun te o tiɛɣu vokabili noli ni la.
en: You people who live in Moab, leave your towns! Go and live on the cliffs! Be like the dove that makes its nest in the sides of a ravine.

dag: Ka Musa daa du zoli maa zuɣu Naawuni sani. Ka Yawɛ ti bol o zoli maa zuɣu yɛl o, A ni ti yɛn yɛli Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: while Moses went up to God. The LORD called to him from the mountain, This is what you should say to Jacobs household and declare to the Israelites.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla kikahi piɛbbu mini tɔbu zambu bubu dabisili din yɛn lu bɛ ni me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa mini bɛn wɔɣila din du pam zuɣu.
en: of trumpet calls and battle cries against fortified cities and mighty fortresses.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Ŋun daanfooni mini sabbu n-lee be di ni ŋɔ.
en: Whose image and inscription is this? he asked.

dag: Ka nandahima daa gbaai Izraɛlnim zaŋ chaŋ Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa polo, Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim noya woligi la zuɣu.
en: The Israelites were very sad, because the Lord had almost wiped out one of their tribes.

dag: Bɛ duhimi bɛ yee paɣi Naawuni, ka zaŋ takɔbiri din mali noya ayiyi gbibi.
en: Let the high praises of God be in their mouths and a double-edged sword in their hands.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Bɛ yi ku niŋ Anabi Musa min anabinim yɛligu yɛda, hal so yi neei kum ni chaŋ ti yɛli ba, bɛ ku niŋ o gba yɛligu yɛda. .
en: But Abraham said, If they will not listen to Moses and the prophets, they will not be convinced even if someone were to rise from death.

dag: Yisa Masia dapulli zuɣu kum yɛla nyɛla jɛrilim bɛn be bahi yoli sol ni sani, amaa tinim bɛn tiligi ŋɔ sani, di nyɛla Naawuni yiko.
en: For the message about Christ's death on the cross is nonsense to those who are being lost; but for us who are being saved it is God's power.

dag: Lɛvinim bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la, Lɛvi zuliya niriba maa zaa ti ku mali tarili bee fali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, bɛ ni ti dirila sara binshɛŋa din nyɛ Yawɛ dini.
en: The priestly tribe of Levi is not to receive any share of land in Israel; instead, they are to live on the offerings and other sacrifices given to the Lord .

dag: Chɛ ka Izraɛlnim puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu di puhibu saha.
en: Let the Israelites keep the Passover at its appointed time.

dag: Ka Dilaila daa ti yɛli Samsin, Niŋm ania wuhi ma din chɛ ka a mali kpiɔŋ pam maa, ka wuhi ma nir ni yɛn niŋ shɛm lo a mihi nyaŋ a.
en: So Delilah said to Samson, Please tell me what makes you so strong. If someone wanted to tie you up and make you helpless, how could he do it.

dag: N daa yɛli ya, Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, dinzuɣu miriya ka yi jɛm Amɔrinim shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi ni be ŋɔ wuna la. Amaa ka yi zaɣisi n noli.
en: Then I said to you, I am the Lord your God. You will live in the land of the Amorites, but you must not worship their false gods. But you did not obey me.

dag: Miriya ka yi ni so nyɛ niŋgbuŋ kɔrɛlana bee m-be kaman Iso ŋun baɣa daa ka Naawuni yɛla ni ka zaŋ o kpamdi taɣi saɣiŋmani yin la.
en: Watch out for immoral and ungodly people like Esau, who sold his future blessing for only one meal.

dag: Man maŋmaŋ ni ti pa nina lihiri dilana, ka yih o n niriba ni, o ni zaŋ o bia ti Molɛk n-ta m biɛhigu shee daɣiri, ka dihi n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ vi zuɣu.
en: I will be against them and separate them from their people, because they gave their children to Molech. They showed that they did not respect my holy name. And they made my holy place unclean.

dag: Zuliya shɛli na mi n-taɣi bɛ wuna, hal bɛ ni kul pa Naawuni maa zaa? Amaa n niriba bɛn zaŋla binshɛli din ka nyɔri taɣi bɛ jilima.
en: Has a nation switched gods, though they arent really gods at all? Yet my people have exchanged their glory for what has no value.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa di tinsi maa ni nɛma zaa tabili di niɣi. Amaa bɛ daa zaŋ takɔb ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tinsi maa ni zaa; ka bi chɛ bɛ ni yino gba.
en: The Israelites kept for themselves all the things and all the animals they found in the cities. But they killed all the people there. They left no one alive.

dag: Di saha ka Pita daa yiɣisi zan o nyaandolitab maa sunsuuni. Bɛ daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pisi laasabu ka o yɛli ba.
en: During this time, the family of believers was a company of about one hundred twenty persons. Peter stood among them and said.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zo o nambɔɣu. Amaa yihimiya ninvuɣ so ŋun ka taali maa ʒim yihibu taali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani.
en: No mercy will be shown to you. Israel must rid itself of murderers, so that all will go well.

dag: O daa niŋla lala hal ti paai nayili samban dunol ni. O daa bi kpe nayili maa, dama bɛ daa bi saɣiri ka ninvuɣ so ŋun pili buɣu zaŋdi li kpɛri nayili.
en: But he could go only as far as the palace gate, because no one wearing sackcloth was allowed inside the palace.

dag: O ni daa yɛri maa, o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka tiŋgbani bɔɣi bɛ naba ni.
en: As soon as he finished speaking these words, the ground under them split open.

dag: Ŋunkam ti mo Yawɛ, o yi nyɛla Izraɛl tiŋbia bee sana, bɛn kum o, Izraɛlnim maa zaa bɛn labim o kuɣa.
en: And anyone who blasphemes the LORDs name must be executed. The whole community will stone that person. Immigrant and citizen alike: whenever someone blasphemes the Lords name, that person will be executed.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Yuza zuɣu, ka o daa chɛ ka o lu n-kpi nimaani Naawuni tooni, o ni daa zaŋ o nuu gbaai Alikauli Adaka maa zuɣu.
en: The Lord became very angry with Uzzah and killed him because he touched the Holy Box. So Uzzah died there before God.

dag: Yi ni bo biŋkɔb shɛb mali sara kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm, yin bomiya binyɛra maa pahi biŋkɔbigu kam zuɣu.
en: Do this for every one of these animals that you give.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka shihir bɔ ka a yɛn wuhi ka ti nya ka niŋ a yɛda? Alahiziba tuun bɔ ka a lee tumda?.
en: They replied, What miracle will you perform so that we may see it and believe you? What will you do?.

dag: Di chɛliya ka dimbɔŋɔ niŋ ya alahiziba, dama saha kanna ka bɛnkam zaa be gbala ni ni ti wum o kukoli.
en: Dont be surprised at this. A time is coming when all people who are dead and in their graves will hear his voice.

dag: Ka maligumaana ŋun yɛn yih o daɣiri ni maa ni zaŋ dilan mini binyɛra maa ti zali Yawɛ tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni.
en: The priest shall take you and these offerings to the entrance of the Tent of the Lord 's presence.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl daa kpuɣi wuna maa n-zaŋ niŋ laakum gal ni n-du n-ʒi di zuɣu. Ka Leeban daa vihi suɣili maa ni zaa bo li ka bi nya li.
en: Rachel had hidden the gods inside her camels saddle, and she was sitting on them. Laban looked through the whole tent, but he did not find the gods.

dag: O daa deei liɣiri maa Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba sani anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhili ni kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbunaanu, ka di nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu zaligu ni wuhi anzinfa laɣibaligu shɛm tariga la.
en: Moses collected the silver from the firstborn men of the Israelites. He collected shekels of silver, using the official measure.

dag: Chibimi gooni voli bɛ ninni n-kahi a nɛma doli nimaani yi.
en: While the people are watching, make a hole in the wall and go out through that hole in the wall.

dag: Chɛ ka o paɣa leei pakoli, ka o bihi leei kpibisi.
en: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;.

dag: Dama o kul chɛrila o gala sɔŋ tiŋa, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani biisim kpɛr li.
en: She leaves her eggs on the earth, lets them warm in the dust.

dag: Pool daa lan yɛli, N ni daa ti lab Jɛrusalɛm na nti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu suhiri Naawuni saha shɛli.
en: I went back to Jerusalem, and while I was praying in the Temple, I had a vision.

dag: Asa mini Izraɛl Naa Baasha daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu hal ni bɛ nyɛviya tariga.
en: There was war between Asa and Israels King Baasha throughout their lifetimes.

dag: O daa nyɛla ŋun yuli du ninvuɣ pihita maa puuni, amaa o yuli daa bi du m-paai wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa. Ka Dauda daa zaŋ o leei tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa guli ŋun Dauda la zuɣulana.
en: He was outstanding among The Thirty, but not as famous as The Three. David put him in charge of his bodyguard.

dag: O kul malila Naawuni biɛhigu sahakam, amaa o daa bi tɛhi ni di simdi ni o duh omaŋa n-wuhi ni o mini Naawuni saɣiya.
en: He always had the nature of God, but he did not think that by force he should try to remain equal with God.

dag: Ka ti ni shɛb chaŋ siliga maa gbini nti nya ka paɣiba maa ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, dama bɛ shiri bi nya o.
en: So some of our group went to the tomb too. It was just as the women said. They saw the tomb, but they did not see Jesus.

dag: nti ʒini Goshɛn tiŋgban ni miri ma. Zaŋm a bihi min a yaansi ni a biŋkɔbbaligu ni a niɣi ni a ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa na;.
en: You will live near me in the region of Goshen with your children and grandchildren, as well as with your sheep, goats, cattle, and everything else you own.

dag: Bɔ ka a lee mi ka tinim bi mi li? Bɔ gbinni ka a lee baŋ ka tinim bi baŋ li?.
en: There is nothing you know that we don't know.

dag: Ti zaa ba pala ba yino? Pa Naawuni yino n-nam ti? Ka wula ka ti bi ʒe tab yim, ka saɣindi Naawuni ni daa lo ti yaannim alikauli shɛli maa?.
en: Don't you know that we all have God as our Father? Didn't the one God create each of us? Then why do you cheat each other by breaking the agreement God made with your ancestors?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋubi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni vamahili kam, ka saɣim bɛ puri atam.
en: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.

dag: Dama nir yi bari zana noombil ninni, yoli ka o bari li maa.
en: Its useless to cast a net in the sight of a bird.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka paɣ maa daa yiɣisi kuli nti paai sariga maa sɔŋ, ka lan zaŋ o pako chinchina maa so.
en: After returning home, Tamar took off the veil and dressed in her widow's clothes again.

dag: ka n suhu kpe bɛ ni ashilɔni ka n jɛm ba.
en: and my mind has been secretly enticed, and threw a kiss with my hand.

dag: Dabisili ŋɔ nyɛla yin ni teeri dabisi shɛli yɛla, ka di simdi ni yi puhiri di chuɣu n-tiri Yawɛ jilima. Zaŋmiya li leei zaligu yi ʒiɛmani kam ni ka gbib li.
en: You will always remember tonight—it will be a special festival for you. Your descendants will honor the Lord with this festival forever.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ di chɛ ka n ʒim yi n-lu tiŋa tiŋgban shɛli din mini Yawɛ shee wɔɣa ni taba ŋɔ ni, dama Izraɛl naa kana ti kariti doli ma kaman nir ni kariti doli kɔriŋga zoya zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Dont let my blood spill on the ground apart from the LORDs presence, because the king of Israel has come out looking for a single flea like someone hunting a partridge in the mountains.

dag: ka yi yi gbib li viɛnyɛliŋga, dina n-nyɛ yi ni tiligi shɛli zuɣu, ka naɣila yi daa naɣ niŋla yɛda yoli.
en: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.

dag: Ka Pita teei Yisa ni daa yɛl o ni o ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni o bi mi ŋun Yisa ka nolɔɣu naanyi kum la yɛla, ka daa yi nti kum pam.
en: Then he remembered what Jesus had told him: Before the rooster crows, you will say three times that you dont know me. Then Peter went outside and cried bitterly.

dag: Amaa di lee bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛl la: Ti Duuma Naawuni, ninsal lee nyɛla bɔ ka a tɛhir o yɛla bee daadam bia lee nyɛla bɔ ka a baɣa be o ni?.
en: Instead, someone declared somewhere, What is humanity that you think about them? Or what are human beings that you care about them? .

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ kaman Musa ni suh o shɛm maa, ka poloya bɛn daa be bɛ yinsi dundɔna ni mini bɛ puri ni zaa daa kpi.
en: And the Lord did what Moses asked. The frogs died in the houses, in the yards, and in the fields.

dag: Kpahimmiya Izraɛlnim ni niŋdi shɛm: Bɛn diri sara maligu bindira la nyɛla bɛn mini Naawuni mali dolintabitali sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu tuma ni.
en: Consider the people of Israel; those who eat what is offered in sacrifice share in the altar's service to God.

dag: Ka niriba pam bɛn pun kpi la ni ti neei kum ni, ka bɛ ni shɛb ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka shɛb mi ti di vi din ka bahigu.
en: Many of those who lie dead in the ground will rise from death. Some of them will be given eternal life, and others will receive nothing but eternal shame and disgrace.

dag: Amaa ka nachin kpɛm maa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni ti ma nasara shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, di bi simdi ni yi chɛ ka n lan kpalim be kpe, timiya ma soli ka n labi n dan sani.
en: But he said, Don't make us stay. The Lord has made my journey a success; let me go back to my master.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa chani gindi tiŋkpan shɛŋa din be Siizaria Filipai tiŋgbɔŋ ni; bɛ ni daa chani maa ka o ti bɔhi ba, Niriba lee yɛri ni n nyɛla ŋuni.
en: Then Jesus and his disciples went away to the villages near Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked them, Tell me, who do people say I am.

dag: Yawɛ suhu ni ti yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu. O ni ti bahi dunia ŋɔ ni wuna zaa yoli, ka zuliya shɛb bɛn be teeku noli mini kom ni gili zuliya shɛba ti gban o tooni jɛm o bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔna ni.
en: I will fiercely attack. Then every god on this earth will shrink to nothing, and everyone of every nation will bow down to me, right where they are.

dag: Dama Yawɛ m-pun zaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili n-sɔŋ ti mini yinim Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba ŋɔ sunsuuni wuhi ti tintarisi ni nyɛ shɛm, dinzuɣu yi ka tarili Yawɛ sani. Di saha, di pa shɛli ka yi yaansi ti chɛ ka ti yaansi chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu.
en: The LORD has set the Jordan as a border between us and you people of Reuben and Gad. You have no portion in the LORD! So your children might make our children stop worshipping the LORD.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi chaŋ hal ti paai zoya ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Ifriim n-zaŋ gari Shalisha tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti bi nya ba, ka zaŋ gari Shaalim ka bɛ ti ka nimaani. Di saha ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ gari Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni nti bi nya ba.
en: Saul and the servant went through the hill country of Ephraim and the territory of Shalishah, but they could not find the donkeys. Then they went through the territories of Shaalim and Benjamin, but still there was no sign of the donkeys.

dag: Dama nyama, Ijiptinim ni ti laɣim ba, ka Mɛmfisinim sɔɣi ba, ka lan deei bɛ daazinfa neen viɛla la, ka gɔhi bili bɛ yinsi.
en: The people of Israel left because the enemy took everything from them. But Egypt will take the people themselves. Memphis will bury them. Weeds will grow over their silver treasures, and thorns will grow where the Israelites lived.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ Ofiri salima bee kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni booni oniɣisi la bee safaya buɣisi li.
en: or precious stones.

dag: Yi mi ni di bela Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo Keenannim bɛn be Araba la tiŋgban ni. Tiŋgbani din be Giligal tooni polo m-baɣi Mɔre oki tia la.
en: These mountains are on the other side of the Jordan River in the land of the Canaanites living in the Jordan Valley. These mountains are toward the west, not far from the oak trees of Moreh near the town of Gilgal.

dag: Ka Keenan paɣ so ŋun daa be di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni daa ka Yisa sanna ti kuhiri yɛra, N Duuma ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu! Alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi m bipuɣiŋga zuɣu m-muɣisir o pam.
en: Suddenly a Canaanite woman from there came out shouting, Lord and Son of David, have pity on me! My daughter is full of demons.

dag: Dama di nyɛla zaligu Izraɛl; di nyɛla Yaakubu Naawuni zaligu.
en: This is the law in Israel, an order from the God of Jacob.

dag: Zalim Izraɛlnim zaligu. Yɛlim ba, yi yi ti paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni yɛn zaŋ tin ya maa tintarisi n-yɛn bɔŋɔ.
en: Speak to the Israelites and tell them this: You will soon enter the land of Canaan. I am giving you that land to be your very own. These will be its borders:.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim buta ka n daa suhi n Duuma di zuɣu ni o yihi li n ni.
en: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.

dag: Dindali maa, niriba ni ti yɛli, Ti Naawuni m-bɔŋɔ! Ti pun guhir o mi ni o tiligi ti. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti ni pun guhiri so la m-bala. Chɛliya ka ti mali suhupiɛlli o ni tiligi ti maa zuɣu.
en: At that time, people will say, The Lord has saved us! Let's celebrate. We waited and hoped— now our God is here.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, A ku tooi nya n ninni, dama ninsal ku tooi nya n ninni ka lan be.
en: but I won't let you see my face, because anyone who sees my face will die.

dag: Dauda ni daa nya ka Naawuni deeg o suhigu Aruna Jɛbusi nir maa kabɔɣili maa ni maa, ka o daa mali sara nimaani.
en: When David saw that the Lord had answered his prayer, he offered more sacrifices there at the threshing place.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Siria Naa Rɛzin mini Rɛmalia bia Pɛka daa kana ti tuhi Judanima.
en: It was while he was king that the Lord first sent King Rezin of Syria and King Pekah of Israel to attack Judah.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ ti piligi Aroa mini fɔn tin shɛli din daa be vinvamli sunsuuni zaŋ kpa Gaad din be Jaza polo la.
en: They crossed the Jordan River and began with Aroer and the town in the middle of the river valley. From there they went toward Gad and on as far as Jazer.

dag: Ka bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa kul tuhi chani tooni shia ni bɔri luɣ shɛlikam polo. Bɛ daa kul chanimi ka bi ŋmaligira.
en: The four living creatures went wherever the Spirit led them, and they moved together without turning their bodies, because each creature faced straight ahead.

dag: Ka saɣiŋgu kul be di puuni, ka nahiŋgu mini ŋarili kul be di ni.
en: Disaster lives inside it; oppression and fraud never leave the town square.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa mali Shɛkɛm din be Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoya ni la me m-be nimaani; ka daa ti lan yi nimaani n-chaŋ ti me Pɛnuɛl.
en: Jeroboam fortified Shechem at Mount Ephraim and lived there. From there he also fortified Penuel.

dag: Lɔt saha la gba, lala n-daa nyɛ li: Bɛ daa diri ka nyura; ka dari ka kɔhira; ka biriti ka mɛri yiya.
en: It will be as it was in the time of Lot. Everybody kept on eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.

dag: ka Ahitub nyɛ Amaria bia, ka Amaria nyɛ Azaria so bia, ka Azaria so maa nyɛ Mɛrayɔt bia.
en: son of Amariah son of Azariah son of Meraioth.

dag: ka Yawɛ bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee yɛn yɔhim Ɛhab ka o chaŋ ti lu Ramɔtigiliad? Ka yino yɛli ni ŋ-ŋɔ, ka ŋun la mi yɛli ni ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: The Lord asked, Who will deceive Ahab so that he will go and be killed at Ramoth? Some of the angels said one thing, and others said something else.

dag: Abiata ni daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulana saha shɛl la ka ŋun Naa Dauda daa chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti ŋub bɔrɔbɔro shɛŋa din daa chihiri ni so ŋubi naɣila maligumaaniba kɔŋko la, hal ka daa pii li nti ti bɛn daa be o sani la.
en: It was during the time of Abiathar the high priest. David went into the house of God and ate the sacred loaves of bread that only priests are allowed to eat. He also gave some to his followers.

dag: Giriikinim shɛb daa be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kana ni bɛ ti jɛm Naawuni chuɣu maa puhibu ni la kalinli ni.
en: Some Greeks were among those who had gone to Jerusalem to worship during the festival.

dag: N yi bol o ka o saɣi, m bi niŋ yɛda ni o ni gbilisi tibili wum n yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Even if I called and he answered, I cannot believe he would listen to me.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yi ti chɛ ka n sariakaribo yɛlibiɛri anahi lu Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu, di ku viɛla, dina n-nyɛ takɔbi mini fifali ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛri ni alɔbo din yɛn kuri ninsalinima mini biŋkɔbiri bɛn be di ni la.
en: The LORD God proclaims: How much more if I send all four of these terrible acts of judgment—sword, famine, wild animals, and plague—against Jerusalem, to eliminate both humans and animals?.

dag: Amaa yi yi yɛli, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni yɛra, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna ŋɔ zuɣu, m pun tim na ti yɛli ya, Di lan yɛliya, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna. .
en: But if you insist on saying, This is the LORDs message, the LORD says to you: Because you have made this claim—this is the LORDs message—when I told you not to proclaim the LORDs message.

dag: Chɛ ka ŋumbɔŋɔ amiliya dakulo ŋɔ naai pɔi, ka ti zaŋ ŋuni maa gba ti a, ka a tum tuma o zuɣu ti ma yuma ayopɔin pahi.
en: Complete the celebratory week with this woman. Then I will give you this other woman too for your work, if you work for me seven more years.

dag: Nyama, yi yi lo noli yi ŋmɛrila tab naŋgbankpeeni ka zabiri buri taba buri biɛɣu. Yi ni lɔri noli maa shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ ku chɛ ka Naawuni deei yi suhigu.
en: You even get angry and ready to fight. No wonder God won't listen to your prayers!.

dag: Naawuni, yiɣisim zani n-zab amaŋ zuɣu! Teemi jɛra ni maan a ansarisi dabisi muni zaa puuni shɛm la yɛla.
en: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm yi nyɛla ʒiri amaa ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni yɛlimaŋli zani ka o nya jilima, dindina wula ka o ni lan kari ma saria kaman alahichilana?.
en: But what if my untruth serves God's glory by making his truth stand out more clearly? Why should I still be condemned as a sinner?.

dag: Ka saŋmarisi luri tiŋ na kaman sanʒiɛ titali ni yi yiɣisina nti ʒe fiig tia ka di wal kaha suuri luri shɛm la.
en: The stars of the sky fell to the earth as a fig tree drops its fruit when shaken by a strong wind.

dag: Kul zanimiyala yim saɣi ni yi tum taali, ni yi daa taai duŋ zaɣisi man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka zaŋ yi yurilim yaɣiri saamba sani ti mahili kam gbini ka bi deei n noli. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Just admit that you rebelled and worshiped foreign gods under large trees everywhere.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa zaŋ salima maa dooi mali binnan shɛli n-zaŋ li zal o ya Ofira, ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa chani ti jɛmdi li. Ka di daa leei zana Gidiɔn min o malibu sani.
en: Gideon made an idol from the gold and put it in his hometown, Ophrah. All the Israelites abandoned God and went there to worship the idol. It was a trap for Gideon and his family.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Haman, To, zaŋm kpariti maa mini wɔhu maa yomyom chaŋ ti niŋ Mɔdɛkai ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia nira ka ʒi nayili dunol ni la lala. Niŋm o a ni kul wuhi shɛm maa zaa, ka di chɛ ka shɛli pooi.
en: Go quickly, the king commanded Haman. Get the robe and the horse and do just as you have suggested for Mordecai the Jew. He is sitting near the kings gate. Do everything that you suggested.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni yɛli, Bɛ ni zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋun daa yihi bɛ yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka ŋmaligi doli buɣa n-jɛmdi li la zuɣu ka Yawɛ chɛ ka yɛl biɛri ŋɔ zaa paai ba maa. .
en: People will answer, It is because they abandoned the Lord their God, who brought their ancestors out of Egypt. They gave their allegiance to other gods and worshiped them. That is why the Lord has brought this disaster on them.

dag: Ti mi yi yɛli ni ninsalinima n-daa zal li, niriba ni lab ti kuɣa, dama sokam zaa saɣiya ni Jɔn Baptaizira daa nyɛla anab maŋli.
en: But if we say that Johns baptism was from someone else, the people will stone us to death. They all believe that John was a prophet.

dag: amaa n ni yɛli zuliya shɛli maa nim yi chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu, n ni taɣi n tɛha, ka ku lan chɛ ka n ni lo ni alɔbo shɛli lu bɛ zuɣu maa paai ba.
en: But if the people of that nation change their hearts and lives and stop doing evil things, I will change my mind and not bring on them the disaster I planned.

dag: Ka Musa daa yi n-chaŋ ti tuh o deemba maa soli lu o sizuura, ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ. Ka bɛ daa puhi tab bɔhi tab daalaafee yɛla; ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpe Musa suɣili ni.
en: When they arrived, Moses went out and bowed down in front of Jethro, then kissed him. After they had greeted each other, they went into the tent.

dag: Yi ni nyɛ bɛn deei Naawuni noli zuɣu, di chɛliya ka kɔr biɛri be yi biɛhigu ni kaman di ni daa be yi ni shɛm yi ni daa na be ʒilinsi puuni la.
en: In the past you did not have the understanding you have now, so you did the evil things you wanted to do. But now you are children of God, so you should obey him and not live the way you did before.

dag: Chɛ ka o zabi niriba bɛn nyɛ tarimba zuɣu; ka fa nandaamba bahi ka darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nahindi ba tibili.
en: May the king be fair to the poor. May he help the helpless and punish those who hurt them.

dag: Dinzuɣu zomiya nambɔɣu kaman yi Ba Naawuni ni zɔri nambɔɣu shɛm.
en: Be merciful just as your Father is merciful.

dag: Fiig tihi gbaai wolibu, ka wain tihi daai pum, ka di pum maa nyo kaman tulaale la. N yura ŋun nyɛ n ni yuri so pam, Yiɣisim ka n sanna.
en: The green fruit is on the fig tree, and the grapevines in bloom are fragrant. Rise up, my dearest, my fairest, and go.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan bɔhi Yawɛ, ka o daa yɛl o, Di yi kpe chaŋ ti liri ba, amaa gilim bɛ nyaaŋa chaŋ ti liri ba tulaale tihi la tooni polo.
en: David asked the Lord what he should do, and the Lord answered: Don't attack them from the front. Circle around behind and attack from among the balsam trees.

dag: ansarisimaaniba mini ninvuɣ turiba ni yɛri ti shɛm ti dimnim mini bɛn bɔri ni bɛ bɔhi ti biɛri ninni la zuɣu.
en: from hearing the sneers and insults of my enemies and those who hate me.

dag: Jɛhoyakim ʒiɛmani maa ni ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa kana ti liri Judanima, ka Jɛhoyakim daa zaŋ omaŋ ti o n-jɛm o yuma ata; di nyaaŋa ka o daa ti zaɣis o jɛmbu.
en: In the time of Jehoiakim, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon came to the country of Judah. Jehoiakim served Nebuchadnezzar for three years. Then Jehoiakim turned against Nebuchadnezzar and broke away from his rule.
