dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa bi deei n noli bee n-wum n yɛligu. Sokam daa niŋ tipawumli n-tumdi tuumbiɛri kaman bɛ suhuri ni bɔri shɛm. Dinzuɣu ka n daa chɛ ka tibidarigibo shɛŋa zaa yɛla n ni daa yɛli n daalikauli lɔbu puuni la lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: But they didnt listen or pay attention; they followed their own willful ambitions. So I brought upon them all the punishments I prescribed for violating this covenant—for refusing to obey.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Ti suŋ ku wali wal biɛri, ka ti biɛɣu mi ku wali wal suma.
en: A good tree does not produce bad fruit. And a bad tree does not produce good fruit.

dag: Ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga maa daa yɛl o, Chama. Di saha ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa zo n-kuli ti boli bia maa ma na.
en: Please do, she answered. So the girl went and brought the baby's own mother.

dag: Lala ka yi niŋ zaɣisi Naawuni zaligu yi yaannim kaya maa dolibu zuɣu.
en: You are teaching them not to respect their father. So you are teaching that it is not important to do what God said. You think it is more important to follow those traditions you have.

dag: N ni yili yila paɣi nyin ŋun nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, dama nyin Naawuni n-nyɛ m birini, nyin Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun wuhi ma yurilim maŋli ŋɔ.
en: I will sing praises to you, my strength, because God is my stronghold, my loving God.

dag: Ka wula ka nir yɛn niŋ? Dama bɛ ni wum ni a kana.
en: What should we do now that our people have heard you are here?.

dag: Alizin biɛri ni daa nahindi shɛb zaa gba daa nya alaafee.
en: They came to hear him and to be healed from their diseases, and those bothered by unclean spirits were healed.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu? Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka o lee tum? Ka bɛ maan mɔhi vuri pam yɛli, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Pilate said to them, Why? What wrong has he done? They shouted even louder, Crucify him.

dag: Yawɛ yiko puuni, o daa kpahi n zuɣu ni ni n di doli niriba maa naba. O daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord spoke to me with his great power and warned me not to be like these people. He said.

dag: Amaa maligumaana yi zaŋ o liɣiri da dabili ka o leeg o ni su so, dabili maa ni tooi di li; ka bɛ ni dɔɣi dab shɛb o yiŋ gba ni tooi di o bindirigu maa.
en: But a priest's slaves, bought with his own money or born in his home, may eat the food the priest receives.

dag: N ni chɛ ka m piɛma varim ʒim. N ni chɛ ka n takɔbi ŋmahi n ni ku shɛba mini n ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb nimdi mini ʒim din yi n dimnim bɛn nyɛ zab wɔɣilanim la ni na.
en: Ill make my arrows drink much blood, while my sword devours flesh, the blood of the dead and captured, flowing from the heads of enemy generals.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ bɔzuɣu ka ti lan yɛn bo kum ti timaŋa? Dama buɣim titali ŋɔ ni ti di ti. Ti yi lan wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ kukoli pahi, ti ni kpi.
en: But why should we risk death again? That terrible fire will destroy us. We are sure to die if we hear the Lord our God speak again.

dag: Di saha maa ka dɔro daa gbaai Hɛzɛkia hal ka o ti miri kpibu. Ka Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, Malim shili, dama a ku kpaŋ, a ni kpi. .
en: Around that same time, Hezekiah became deathly ill. The prophet Isaiah, Amozs son, came to him and said, This is what the LORD says: Put your affairs in order because you are about to die. You wont survive this.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa ti kpi, ka bɛ niŋ tim ʒe o niŋgbuŋ n-zaŋ o niŋ kum adaka ni Ijipti. O daa niŋ dunia yil la yuun kɔbiga ni pia.
en: So Joseph died in Egypt at the age of ; his body was embalmed and put in a coffin.

dag: Di saha ka Kɔra daa laɣim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa taai duŋ maa zaa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni. Ka Yawɛ jilima neesim daa neei niriba maa zaa sani.
en: Meanwhile, Korah had convinced the rest of the Israelites to rebel against their two leaders. When that happened, the Lord appeared in all his glory.

dag: Bɛ tuumbiɛri maa chɛ ka bɛ ku lan tooi ŋmaligi kpa bɛ Naawuni polo. Dama yolimyolim maa pun kpe bɛ kɔbili ni, ka bɛ bi lan mi Yawɛ.
en: Their deeds dont allow them to return to their God, because the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they dont know the LORD.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa vuhim yuuni maa ni ti niŋ bindira tin ya, yi mini yi daba bɛn nyɛ paɣiba mini dɔbba ni yi ni bu shɛb paa ni san kam ŋun be yi sani.
en: However, you and your slaves and your hired workers, as well as any domestic or wild animals, may eat whatever grows on its own.

dag: Teemiya o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa yɛla, ka teei o ni tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa min o ni daa kari saria shɛm yɛla.
en: You descendants of Abraham, his servant; you descendants of Jacob, the man he chose: remember the miracles that God performed and the judgments that he gave.

dag: Kpahimi bɛn tumd alahichi la zuɣu ni palɔni din ni chɛ ka dabiɛm kpe bɛn kpalim la.
en: Discipline those who are sinning in front of everyone so that all the others will be afraid.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛliya ni ti ni ti tiligi ti dimnim nuu ni, ka lan tiligi bɛnkam zaa je ti gba nuu ni.
en: He will save us from our enemies and from the power of all those who hate us.

dag: Musa ni daa sabi zaligu ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa niŋ kundi ni naai zaa.
en: Moses carefully wrote all these teachings in a book. When he finished.

dag: O zaŋ zuliya shɛb tiŋgbɔna ti o niriba n-wuhi ba o yiko tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: He has shown his power to his people by giving them the lands of foreigners.

dag: Daadamnim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa pa shɛli o sani; ŋuna n-su malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni mini daadamnim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni fukumsi. Ka so ku tooi goog o ka o chɛ o ni bɔri shɛli niŋbu bee m-bɔh o, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ lala?.
en: All of earths inhabitants are nothing in comparison. The Most High does whatever he wants with heavens forces and with earths inhabitants. No one can contain his power or say to him, What do you think you are doing.

dag: Ŋuna n-yeeri nanim kpariti, ka sooni ba piɛtɔnima.
en: and makes slaves of kings.

dag: Ula bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ara mini Hanniɛl ni Rizia.
en: Ullas sons were Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi ni alahichilaan yino yi niŋ tuuba, Naawuni malaikanim gba malila suhupiɛlli o zuɣu.
en: In the same way, I tell you, the angels of God rejoice over one sinner who repents.

dag: Kom ni ka man baptaiziri ya yi ni niŋ tuuba zuɣu, amaa ŋun na be n nyaaŋa kanna mali yiko gari ma hal ka man pɔri gba ni n kpuɣ o namda gbibi. Ŋun ni ti zaŋla Naawuni Shia Kasi mini buɣim baptaizi ya.
en: I baptize you with water so you will give up your sins. But someone more powerful is going to come, and I am not good enough even to carry his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ Izraɛl bidibisi maa yuya din sabi pa sariakaribo nyolɔrigu zuɣu la n-ye m-pa o nyɔɣu zuɣu saha shɛl o yi ti kpe luɣ kasi shee la, ka di nyɛ bɛ yɛla teebu shihirili Yawɛ sani sahakam.
en: When Aaron enters the Holy Place, he must wear the judgment pouch. In this way he will wear the names of the twelve sons of Israel over his heart. And the Lord will always be reminded of them.

dag: Bɛ di chɛ ka bɛ suhuri zɔhiri zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni mali shɛlikam ʒibu na polo, dama Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ luɣ viɛlli shee ka bɛ yɛn ʒini. .
en: They can leave their possessions behind, because they will be given the best of everything in Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu di nachimba ni ti lu di zama laɣiŋgu shee, ka bɛ ti ku di tɔbbihi zaa dindali maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Yes, her young men will fall in the streets, and her soldiers will be silent on that day, declares the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yɛl o, Ti ni doli solɔɣu maa gari; ka ti mini ti biŋkɔbiri yi nyu yi kom, ti ni yo di zuɣu; ti ni kul bɔri shɛli nyɛla yi chɛ ka ti kana ti gari.
en: The Israelites said to him, Well go up by the road. If we drink from your water, either we or our livestock, well pay for it. Its a small matter. We would only ask to cross on foot.

dag: Ifriim nyɛla m biyurigu. O nyɛla n suhu ni yuri so pam. N yi kul galim o bushɛm, lala ka n lan teer o yɛla. Dinzuɣu m puu biɛri o zuɣu pam. Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni zo o nambɔɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Isnt Ephraim my much-loved child? Dont I utterly adore him? Even when I scold him, I still hold him dear. I yearn for him and love him deeply, declares the LORD.

dag: M Ba yuri ma, n ni zaŋ n nyɛvili sɔŋ ni n ti lan kpuɣ li la zuɣu.
en: The Father loves me because I give my life. I give my life so that I can get it back again.

dag: Naa Ahaz ni daa yi Damaskus kuna, o daa chaŋmi ti nya bimbini maa. Di saha ka o daa vu m-miri bimbini maa nti du n-tam di zuɣu.
en: On his return from Damascus, Ahaz saw that the altar was finished.

dag: N ni guli tiŋ ŋɔ ka tiligi li mmaŋmaŋ zuɣu ni n dabili Dauda zuɣu.
en: I will defend this city and protect it, for the sake of my own honor and because of the promise I made to my servant David.

dag: Nyini n-wuhi ma nyɛvili soli, ka suhupiɛl maŋli kul be a sani; ka nyaɣisim kul be a nudirigu ni sahakam.
en: You will show me the path that leads to life; your presence fills me with joy and brings me pleasure forever.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa daa zan o nyaaŋa n-yɛli ni o ni yɛli shɛm maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: The Jews reinforced the action against Paul, affirming the truth of these accusations.

dag: N yur a zaligunim maa pam. Di nyɛla n saawaranima.
en: Your instructions give me pleasure; they are my advisers.

dag: Dama bɛ daa kul palila tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa hal ka tiŋgbani ti ku n-sabigi. Ka bɛ daa ŋubi sakuɣa la ni daa bi saɣim bimbil shɛŋa la mini tiwala zaa, ka va mahali bee tihi vari bee puri ni bimbilima daa lan ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: They covered the ground until it was black with them; they ate everything that the hail had left, including all the fruit on the trees. Not a green thing was left on any tree or plant in all the land of Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N loya ni n chɛ ka alɔbo lu yi zuɣu, ka n kpihim Judanim zaa birili.
en: So then, I, the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, will turn against you and destroy all Judah.

dag: N ni nya ka shɛli viɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Di simdi ni ninsalinim diri ka nyura, ka di bɛ tuma zaa nyaɣisim dunia ŋɔ ni dabisa biɛla shɛli Naawuni ni ti ti ŋɔ puuni, dama ti tarili m-bala.
en: Here is what I have found out: the best thing we can do is eat and drink and enjoy what we have worked for during the short life that God has given us; this is our fate.

dag: Binnui so mi daŋ ni: Shimɛi so yaha.
en: Shimei, Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah, Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai, Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah, Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph from the family of Binnui;.

dag: Dama Ifriimnim mali maligu bimbina pam pahi ni bɛ tumdi alahichi. Ka di leei alahichi tumbu maligu bimbina bɛ sani.
en: Ephraim built more and more altars, and that was a sin. They have been altars of sin for Ephraim.

dag: Ʒiɛman biɛɣu ŋɔ nim ninvuɣ yino gba nini ku nya n ni daa po pɔri ni n zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ viɛl shɛli ti yi yaannim maa.
en: Not one of you evil people who are alive now will go into the good land that I promised to your ancestors.

dag: O daa malila pua, ka wolisiri n-kuhiri ni biɛrim pam ni o dɔɣi.
en: She was pregnant and cried out with pain because she was about to give birth.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa daa mali ti paai Bɛtani, ka o daa kpuɣ o nuhi zuɣusaa n-niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Jesus led his disciples out to Bethany, where he raised his hands and blessed them.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nanim tiɣisirila tab ʒiina, ka zuɣulaannim laɣindi tɔri jina jɛndiri Yawɛ min o ni pii na so la yɛra.
en: The earths rulers take their stand; the leaders scheme together against the LORD and against his anointed one.

dag: Yi yi ni doli n ni zaŋ fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa zaa zaani ya ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol o soya zaa, ka zaŋ yimaŋ ti o.
en: Obey faithfully everything that I have commanded you: Love the Lord your God, do everything he commands, and be faithful to him.

dag: M mi ni Yawɛ baɣa be nandaamba ni, ka o zabiri faranim zuɣu.
en: I know the Lord will provide justice for the poor and will defend the helpless.

dag: amaa bɛnkam daa deeg o ka niŋ o yuli yɛda, bɛna ka o niŋ yiko ni bɛ leei Naawuni bidɔɣirisi.
en: But some people did accept him. They believed in him, and he gave them the right to become children of God.

dag: Ka bɛn yɛn ti bɛ suɣa pa bɛ zuɣu n-nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya. Simiɔn niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Zurishadai bia Shɛlumiɛl.
en: On one side of Reuben will be the tribe of Simeon, with Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai as the leader of its , troops.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa yɛl o, Cham ti yɛli naa maa ni biɛhiŋ kani, o ni kpaŋ; amaa Yawɛ lee kahigi wuhi ma ni o ni bahi kpi.
en: Elisha said to him, Go and tell him, You will definitely recover, but actually the LORD has shown me that he will die.

dag: O ni daa kul nya ba, ka o kɔre kpe bɛ ni, ka o tim tuumba bɛ sani Kalidia tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Aroused just by looking at them, she sent messengers to them in Chaldea.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yi chɛ ka a kpalim zani dabari kaman niriba ni na ʒi n-ʒini tin shɛŋa ni, n yi zaŋ a niŋ kɔbulli ni, ka ko titali lim a.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: Tyre, you will become an old, empty city. No one will live there. I will cause the sea to flow over you. The great sea will cover you.

dag: Di simdi ni yi puhiri bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi maa chuɣu, dama dindali maa ka n daa yihi yi zuliya maa gbilligbilli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Dinzuɣu di simdi ka yi gbibi dabisili maa yi ʒiɛmani kam ni ka di nyɛ zaligu sahakam.
en: You should observe the Festival of Unleavened Bread, because on this precise day I brought you out of the land of Egypt in military formation. You should observe this day in every generation as a regulation for all time.

dag: A yɛliya, Mbusim be n zuɣu. Yawɛ zaŋ suhugarigu pahi m biɛrim zuɣu; n ŋuhirimi hal ti tarigi, ka bi nyari vuhim. .
en: you are saying, I give up! The Lord has added sorrow to my troubles. I am worn out from groaning, and I can't find any rest.

dag: Amaa so yi kani ŋun ni wuhi di gbinni, yin chɛliya ka bɛ shini baalim cheechi puuni, ka naɣ mal li tɔɣisiri li mi ni Naawuni mini bɛmaŋmaŋa bɛ suhuri ni.
en: But if no one is there who can explain, then the one who speaks in strange tongues must be quiet and speak only to himself and to God.

dag: M bela n dimnim bɛn be kaman gbuɣima bɛn ŋubiri ninsalinim la sunsuuni. Bɛ nyina ŋmanila kpana mini piɛma; ka bɛ zilima mi ŋmani takɔbiri din diri pam.
en: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, mani n-kul nyɛ Naawuni. So ku tooi fa nira n nuu ni bahi; so ku tooi gu n ni yɛn tum shɛli soli.
en: I am God now and forever. No one can snatch you from me or stand in my way.

dag: N ni daa nya ʒii shɛli maa daa ŋmanila n ni daa pun nya ʒii shɛli saha shɛl o ni daa kana ni o ti wurim tiŋ maa la, ka lan ŋmani n ni daa nya ʒii shɛli n ni daa be Kɛba Mɔɣili noli la. Ka n daa teei dɔni n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa.
en: The vision that I saw was like the vision I saw by the Kebar Canal. I bowed with my face to the ground.

dag: Kum dimbu yiko nyɛla alahichi; ka alahichi yiko nyɛ zaligu.
en: Death gets its power to hurt from sin, and sin gets its power from the Law.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka anab so ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. Dina n-nyɛ ni Naawuni yɛliya: N ni yaai n noli ŋahi ŋaha, ka yɛli binshɛŋa din sɔɣi tum dunia piligu ni ha la yɛla.
en: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, I will use stories to speak my message and to explain things hidden since the creation of the world.

dag: Dindali maa yi ni ti zaŋ n yuli suhi Naawuni; ka m bi yɛli ni n ni ti suhi m Ba tin ya.
en: In that day you will ask in my name. Im not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.

dag: So di yɔhim omaŋa! So yi be yi ni n-tɛhi ni o nyɛla ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni yɛndana, ŋun leemi jɛrigu din ni chɛ ka o leei yɛndana.
en: You should not fool yourself. If any of you think that you are wise by this world's standards, you should become a fool, in order to be really wise.

dag: Di saha maa ka anabinima ayi bɛn daa nyɛ Hagai mini Zakaria ŋun daa nyɛ Iddo bia la daa piligi m-mali Izraɛl Naawuni yuli n-tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa tiri Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm ka nyɛ o ni su shɛb la.
en: Then the Lord God of Israel told the prophets Haggai and Zechariah to speak in his name to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. And they did.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa siɣi niriba maa sani nti zaŋ li yɛli ba.
en: So Moses went down to the people and told them these things.

dag: Saimɔn Pita pun wuhi ti Naawuni ni daa tuui pii bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni bɛ leeg o niriba shɛm yɛla.
en: Simon Peter has told us how God showed his love for the non-Jewish people. For the first time, God accepted them and made them his people.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla nyin daadam, a niriba bɛn ʒe goma gbini mini bɛn ʒe dunoya ni yɛri taba, ka sokam yɛri o ʒiʒiinikpee, Kamiyana ti wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din yi Yawɛ sanna ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: And now about you, son of man. Your people lean against the walls and stand in their doorways talking about you. They tell each other, Come on, lets go hear what the Lord says.

dag: Di yi pa lala, n ni chɛ ka zɔhi pam yi n-yɛrigi a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ puuni n-lir a min a kpambaliba ni a niriba zaa. A yiŋ mini Ijipti yili kam ni ti palila zɔhi; ka bɛ ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa gba ni ti palila zɔhi.
en: If you don't, he will send swarms of flies to attack you, your officials, and every citizen of your country. Your houses will be full of flies, and the ground will crawl with them.

dag: Pɛriʒia mini Lidia ni Libia tɔbbihi daa nyɛla bɛn be a tɔbbihi bɛn nyɛ a tɔbutuhiri biinsi la ni. Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ nyɔtaɣirisi mini bɛ kuriti zuɣupila sɔŋ a ni. Bɛ daa tir a jilima.
en: Soldiers from Persia, Lydia, and Libya served in your army. They hung their shields and their helmets in your barracks. They are the men who won glory for you.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni daa ti lu ka di zibiri saha shɛli, ka buɣim nyokpilli mini buɣim mokpalli daa kana ti kpe nimdi din ŋmahiŋmahi doya maa sunsuuni gari.
en: After the sun went down, it got very dark. The dead animals were still on the ground, each animal cut into two pieces. Then a smoking firepot and a flaming torch passed between the halves of the dead animals.

dag: Di chaŋya; di chɛliya ka yi dimnim maa ti kun ya, dama Yawɛ ka yi sani.
en: Dont go into that land. The Lord is not with you, so your enemies will easily defeat you.

dag: Ti Duuma niŋsim m-bala, ka di mali ti alahiziba. .
en: This is something the Lord has done, and it is amazing to us. .

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa chaŋ o sani nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a tɔɣisiri niriba maa la yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni.
en: The followers came to Jesus and asked, Why do you use these stories to teach the people.

dag: Yaansi nyɛla ninkura jilima zuɣupiligu; ka bihi mi jilima nyɛ bɛ laamba.
en: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.

dag: Ka zaŋ waagasi kpil pia ŋɔ mi ti ti bɛ yaɣili maa sapashin kpɛma, ka nya a biɛyanim maa daalaafee ni nyɛ shɛm, ka ʒi shɛhirili bini bɛ sani mali kuna.
en: And here, take these ten wedges of cheese to their unit commander. Find out how your brothers are doing and bring back some sign that they are okay.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka n fabila paag a sanna. Tim ma baŋsim kaman a ni pun lo ma alikauli shɛm.
en: Let my cry reach you, LORD; help me understand according to what youve said.

dag: N zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa niŋ n suhu ni, ka zahim di zaa nya wuntizɔriba mini yɛnnim tuma ni be Naawuni nuu ni shɛm. Di yi nyɛ yurilim bee jɛlinsi, so ku tooi baŋ. Binshɛɣukam din paari ba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: I thought long and hard about all this and saw that God controls the actions of wise and righteous people, even their love and their hate. No one knows anything about what lies ahead.

dag: Naawuni ŋun daa bi zaɣisi ni omaŋmaŋ Bia kpi, amaa ka daa zaŋ o ti ti zaa ŋɔ, o ku zaŋ binshɛɣukam din kpalim zaa gba pah o zuɣu ti ti?.
en: Certainly not God, who did not even keep back his own Son, but offered him for us all! He gave us his Son—will he not also freely give us all things?.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim bɛn ku wum a yɛligu, dama bɛ bi bɔri ni bɛ wum n yɛligu maa; Izraɛlnim zaa ni nyɛ bɛn suhuri kpɛma mini tipawumlinim zuɣu.
en: But the house of Israel—they will refuse to listen to you because they refuse to listen to me. The whole house of Israel is hardheaded and hard-hearted too.

dag: Ka Samsin daa yɛli, Buŋ yɛno kɔbili ka n zaŋ ku ninvuɣ tuhili. Buŋ yɛno kɔbili ka n zaŋ ku ba n-laɣim ba sɔŋ gbilligbilli.
en: After the fighting was over, he made up this poem about what he had done to the Philistines: I used a donkey's jawbone to kill a thousand men; I beat them with this jawbone over and over again.

dag: Bɛn ti be katiŋa, alɔbo ni di ba, bɛn be yoma, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, bɛn mi ti kpalim, kum ni ku ba. Lala ka n ni ti yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Whoever is far off will die of plague, whoever is nearby will fall to the sword, and whoever finds refuge will die of famine. Ill satisfy my wrath against them!.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa piɛbi kikaa n-gooi tɔbbihi maa ka bɛ daa chɛ Izraɛlnim maa kari doli ka labina.
en: Then Joab blew a trumpet to signal his troops to stop chasing Israel's soldiers.

dag: N daa sabi gbaŋ ti cheechi na; amaa ka Diɔtrifiiz ŋun bɔri ni o nyɛ bɛ toondan la bi lihi ma ni m mali yiko zaŋ chaŋ n ni yɛli shɛm maa polo.
en: I wrote a letter to the church, but Diotrephes will not listen to what we say. He always wants to be the leader.

dag: Dinzuɣu shia ni ka niŋgbun shɛl ni ni nyɛ niŋgbuŋ kpiŋ shɛm la, lala ka yɛda niŋbu din bi tumdi tuma gba nyɛ yɛda kpiŋ.
en: As the lifeless body is dead, so faith without actions is dead.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmiya m-bahi naai li! Chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye di naabu zuɣu kaman yi suhuri ni daa ye di piligibu zuɣu shɛm la; zaŋmiya yi ni mali shɛli niŋ li.
en: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.

dag: Lɛmiya yuri galigɛnima bamiya tɔbutuhiri yuri, Pilimiya kuriti zuɣupila zani yi zaashɛhi. Sahimiya yi kpana, ka yɛn ya kuriti gbaɣinɔnima.
en: Saddle the horses; mount the stallions! Take your positions with helmets on! Polish your spears; put on your armor!.

dag: Dinzuɣu n-chɛ ka di niŋ ma nyaɣisim, ka m mali suhupiɛlli; ka n niŋgbuŋ gba tiligi;.
en: Thats why my heart celebrates and my mood is joyous; yes, my whole body will rest in safety.

dag: Bomiya Yawɛ ni o kpiɔŋ; Doliya din ni chɛ ka yi kul be o sani sahakam.
en: Depend on the Lord for strength. Always go to him for help.

dag: Yisa daa ti chaŋ Jɛriko nti tim di tiŋ puuni garita.
en: Jesus was going through Jericho.

dag: N ni zaŋ zuliya biɛri na ka bɛ ti deei bɛ yiya su. N ni chɛ ka bɛn mali yaa karimbaani naai, ka bɛ ta bɛ luɣ shɛŋa din be kasi daɣiri.
en: Ill bring up the cruelest nations, and they will seize their houses. Ill break their proud strength, and their sanctuaries will be defiled.

dag: Ti Duuma, neema! Bɔ n-niŋ ka a gbihira? Neema! Di chɛ ti bahi sahakam!.
en: Wake up, Lord! Why are you asleep? Rouse yourself! Don't reject us forever!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ dabili Jɔshua Nan bia maa daa kpi. O daa niŋ dunia yil la yuun kɔbiga ni pia.
en: Not long afterwards, the Lord 's servant Joshua died at the age of .

dag: Ka Ibrahimma nachin kpɛm maa daa zaŋ o nuu niŋ Ibrahimma gbalipina lɔŋni, ka po pɔri zaŋ chaŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa polo.
en: So the servant put his hand between the thighs of Abraham, his master, and made a vow to do what Abraham had asked.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Daadam Bia yi ti ʒin o jilima nam ʒiishee dunia palli din kanna ni, yinim bɛn dol o ŋɔ gba ni ti ʒini nam ʒiishɛhi pinaayi ni n-kari Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la saria.
en: Jesus answered: Yes, all of you have become my followers. And so in the future world, when the Son of Man sits on his glorious throne, I promise you will sit on twelve thrones to judge the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Naɣikɔra yi ka luɣ shɛli, bindirigu gba kani, naɣikɔra yaa puuni ka bindirigu pam yirina.
en: A barn with no cattle might be clean, but strong bulls are needed for a good harvest.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ti yɛli Akishi, A suhu yi yu ma, nyin tim ma a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tinsi ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛli ka n ʒini, dama wula ka man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ min a lee yɛn laɣim ʒi na tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Then David said to Achish, If you approve of me, please give me a place in one of the towns in the country so I can live there. Why should I, your servant, live in the capital city with you.

dag: Chɛ ka n jɛma tiɣ a nini, dama m mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ zuɣu.
en: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.

dag: Ka o daa shiri taɣi doli so shɛli, ka bi lan dol o ni daa pun doli so shɛli ka Bɛtɛl na maa.
en: So he took a different road home. He did not go back the same way he came to Bethel.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu hal nti naai bɛ birili n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti bɛ mini bɛ yaannim ŋɔ ni.
en: I will bring war, starvation, and disease on them until there is not one of them left in the land that I gave to them and their ancestors.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Rɛkab bia Jɔnadab kul ku kɔŋ bidibiga ŋun ni jɛmdi ma sahakam. .
en: so I promise that your clan will be my servants and will never die out.

dag: Ka Ibram daa yɛli Lɔt, Di chɛ ka naŋgbankpeeni kpe m min a sunsuuni; a mi di chɛ ka naŋgbankpeeni kpe a biŋkɔbiguliba mini m biŋkɔbiguliba sunsuuni, dama ti nyɛla dɔɣim.
en: Then Abram said to Lot, We are relatives, and your men and my men shouldn't be quarreling.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa deei bɛ bindira maa shɛli di, ka bi suhi Yawɛ n-niŋ o saawara di zuɣu.
en: The Israelites took some of their supplies, but they didnt ask for any decision from the LORD.

dag: Ka malaika daa yi alizanda ni na ti kpaŋsir o suhu.
en: Then a heavenly angel appeared to him and strengthened him.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Zɔri, wula ka a lee niŋ hal ti kpe kpe na ni ka bi ye amiliya lɔbu chuɣu ŋɔ binyɛrigu? Ka o kɔŋ garigibu.
en: He said to him, Friend, how did you get in here without wedding clothes? But he was speechless.

dag: Ka Akishi daa zaŋ Zikilag ti o dindali maa, dinzuɣu ka Juda nanim na kul su Zikilag hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: So Achish gave him the town of Ziklag, and for this reason Ziklag has belonged to the kings of Judah ever since.

dag: O daa lan mali pipih anahi ka di ŋmani alimɔnd pum mini di bintira kɔtomsi ni tipuma kɔtomsi n-zaŋ li tam firilatamdigu maa maŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: and four on the stem.

dag: N ni yiini yila paɣiri Yawɛ hal ni n nyɛvili tariga; n ni kul be ŋɔ, n ni yiini yila paɣiri n Naawuni.
en: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.

dag: Di saha ka Ahimɛlɛk daa garigi yɛli, Naa, a sapashin kpamba ŋɔ ni ŋuni n-lee ʒe a yim kaman Dauda ŋun nyɛ nyin naa deemba, ka lan nyɛ a tɔbbi shɛb bɛn gul a sapashin kpɛma ni ŋun mali jilima a yili ŋɔ n-gari sokam la?.
en: Ahimelech answered, David is very faithful to you. Not one of your other officers is as faithful as David. He is your own son-in-law and the captain of your bodyguards. Your own family respects David.

dag: Ka bɛ zaani zuɣusaa asiba mini zaawuni kam m-paɣiri ka tibigiri Yawɛ.
en: The Levites stood every morning and gave thanks and praise to the Lord . They also did this every evening.

dag: Shihirili shɛli din yi Yawɛ sanna n-wuhi ni o ni niŋ o ni lo a alikauli ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: A bɔri ni mahim chaŋla tooni polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia bee di lab nyaaŋa polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia.
en: Isaiah replied, The Lord will give you a sign to prove that he will keep his promise. Now, would you prefer to have the shadow on the stairway go forward ten steps or go back ten steps.

dag: Hɛzirɔn bia Kalɛb min o paɣiba Azuba ni Jɛriɔt daa dɔɣi bihi. O bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛshɛr mini Shɔbab ni Aridɔn.
en: Hezron's son Caleb married Azubah and had a daughter named Jerioth. She had three sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

dag: Absalom daa niŋ yuma ayi Jɛrusalɛm ka o nini bi nya naa.
en: Absalom lived two years in Jerusalem without seeing the king.

dag: Ti mi ni Masia ni daa neei kum ni maa, o ku lan kpi yaha; dama kum lan ka o yiko.
en: Christ was raised from death. And we know that he cannot die again. Death has no power over him now.

dag: Bɛ mali nuhi, amaa di bi tabisiri shɛli. Bɛ mali naba, amaa di bi chana. Bɛ ku tooi zaŋ bɛ kukoya yɛli shɛli.
en: They have hands, but cannot feel. They have feet, but cannot walk. No sounds come from their throats.

dag: Naawuni, yiɣisim kari dunianim saria, dama nyini n-su zuliya kam zaa.
en: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.

dag: Di saha ka Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la daŋ niriba maa daa garigi yɛli Izraɛlnim daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpamba maa.
en: Then the people of Reuben, the people of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh answered the heads of the military units of Israel.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni!.
en: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.

dag: Puhimiya ti mabihi bɛn be Laodisia mini paɣ so ŋun yuli booni Nimfa la ni yɛdaniŋdiba bɛn laɣind o yiŋ la ti ma.
en: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.

dag: Ka Ɛlikana min o yiŋnim maa daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba n-jɛm Yawɛ ka lab kuli bɛ ya Rama. Ka Ɛlikana min o paɣ Hanna daa ti dɔni, ka Yawɛ teei Hanna yɛla.
en: Elkanah and his family got up early the next morning and worshiped the Lord . Then they went back home to Ramah. Later the Lord blessed Elkanah and Hannah.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim zaa daa laɣimna nti muɣi dunoli.
en: All the people of the town gathered in front of the house.

dag: Dama bɛ ni ti zaŋ o ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, ka bɛ mal o ansarisi ka dih o vi, ka tuhi nintɔri vie o.
en: He will be handed over to the Gentiles, who will make fun of him, insult him, and spit on him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ wain maa ti bɛ ba ka o nyu dindali maa yuŋ, ka bipuɣin kpɛm maa daa kpe ka o min o ba ti dɔni, ka o ba bi mi o ni dɔni o sani saha shɛli ni o ni yiɣisi saha shɛli.
en: That night they got their father drunk, and the older daughter got in bed with him, but he was too drunk even to know she was there.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka Ibrahimma daa ti lihi nya o ni chani luɣ shɛli maa ka di be katiŋ ha.
en: On the third day, Abraham looked up and saw the place at a distance.

dag: Ka Pool daa mirig o nina kpa jintɔriba maa ka yɛli, M mabihi, m bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ n suhu ni tɛha nyɛla din tuhi Naawuni sani.
en: Paul looked at the council members and said, Brothers, I have lived my life in a good way before God. I have always done what I thought was right.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tim ti boli Pool na ka Tɛɛtulus gbaag o fiɣisibu yɛra, N dan Filiksi, a zuɣu ka ti ʒiya ni alaafee, ka a tumdi tuun suma tiri ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa.
en: After the governor summoned Paul, Tertullus began to make his case against him. He declared, Under your leadership, we have experienced substantial peace, and your administration has brought reforms to our nation.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Mbaye, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, a daa yɔhim Jɛrusalɛmnim pam n-yɛli, Shɛli ti ku niŋ ya, amaa ka takɔbi ti be bɛ kukoya ni.
en: I said, You are the Lord God. So why have you fooled everyone, especially the people of Jerusalem? Why did you promise peace, when a knife is at our throats.

dag: Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaayopɔin saha ka Ɛhab bia Ahazia daa di Izraɛl nam ʒi Samaria. O daa diya n-sula Izraɛlnim yuma ayi.
en: Ahaziah was the son of Ahab. He became king of Israel during the th year that King Jehoshaphat ruled Judah. Ahaziah ruled in Samaria for two years.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni yi suhuri mini yi tɛha leela zaɣ pala zaa.
en: Instead, renew the thinking in your mind by the Spirit.

dag: dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninʒeensinim liriti ma mi. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninkuunsinim lo nia ni bɛ ku ma. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni.
en: Strangers who dont even think about God have turned against me. Those powerful men are trying to kill me. Selah.

dag: Ti ni ŋma a ni bɔri Lɛbanɔn dakuɣ shɛŋa zaa ti a, ka lo li n-zaŋ niŋ teeku ni n-dolisi kom tahi Jɔpa na, ka yi kana ti kpuɣi li kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: and we will cut as much wood as you need from Lebanon. We will tie the logs together and float them by sea to the town of Joppa. Then you can carry the wood to Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu n labila Jɛrusalɛm na nti zo li nambɔɣu, bɛ ni lab me n jɛmbu duu la yaha, ka n chɛ ka bɛ teei bimbuɣisirigu m-buɣisi Jɛrusalɛm. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So the Lord says, I will come back to Jerusalem and comfort her. The Lord All-Powerful says, Jerusalem will be rebuilt, and my house will be built there.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa tim o sapashin so ŋun su tɔbbihi pihinu fukumsi min o tɔbbihi pihinu maa o sani. Ka sapashini maa daa chaŋ Ilaija sani ka o ti ʒila zoli zuɣu, ka o yɛl o, Naawuni nira, naa yɛliya, Siɣim na. .
en: So at once he sent an army officer and soldiers to meet Elijah. Elijah was sitting on top of a hill at the time. The officer went up to him and said, Man of God, the king orders you to come down and talk with him.

dag: ka Adina daa nyɛ Harim daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma, ka Hɛlikai daa nyɛ Mɛrayɔt daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: The leader of Harims family was Adna. The leader of Meremoths family was Helkai.

dag: Ka bɛ bihi maa yi zooi mɔɣu maa ni n-niŋ yaa, bɛ chanimi ka ku lan labi bɛ sani yaha.
en: In the wilds their young grow strong; they go away and don't come back.

dag: Ka yi yi pɔhi yi wain tihi wala, di nyaaŋa yin di lan chaŋ ti yihi di zaɣ yaha; di nyɛla sana mini kpibiga ni pakoli dini.
en: And when you pick your grapes, go over the vines only once, then let the poor have what is left.

dag: Ka bɛ zaŋ o na. Alizin birigu maa ni daa nya Yisa ka o dii yiɣisi bia maa, ka o lu m-bilinda, ka nintɔfuɣifuɣi ŋar o noli.
en: They brought the boy, and as soon as the demon saw Jesus, it made the boy shake all over. He fell down and began rolling on the ground and foaming at the mouth.

dag: Di zaŋ a ŋmani nyɛvili niŋ mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛr la nuu ni; di tam a tarimba nyɛviya yɛla sahakam!.
en: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.

dag: ka zaŋ o ti niŋ bɔɣili ni. Kom daa ka bɔɣili maa ni, di daa nyɛla zaɣ kuŋ.
en: Then they took him and threw him into the well, which was dry.

dag: Pita ni daa ti lab Jɛrusalɛm ka bɛn doli Yɛhudianim gunibu kali soli daa galim o.
en: When Peter went to Jerusalem, those who were in favor of circumcising Gentiles criticized him, saying.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal ka man ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, Naa Jɛhoyachin ŋun nyɛ Juda Naa Jɛhoyakim bia ŋɔ yi di nyɛ n nintu shɛli n ni mali dihiri binyara zuɣu la, ka di piri n nudirigu ni gba, n naan darigi fuɣ a n nubil maa ni.
en: As surely as I live, says the Lord , I will do this to you, Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah: Even if you were a signet ring on my right hand, I would still pull you off.

dag: Dama bɛ yi ti kpi, bɛ ku tooi zaŋ li mali chaŋ. Bɛ daazichi maa ku doli ba siɣi gballi ni.
en: They will not take anything with them when they die. They will not take their wealth with them.

dag: Asiba zaŋ chaŋ zaawuni bɛ pun kpi. Bɛ kul kpirimi zaa, ka bi mi di yɛla.
en: They are smashed between morning and evening; they perish forever without anyone knowing.

dag: Yuuni maa ni daa ti gari, ka bɛ daa lan lab o sanna yuuni din paya ni ti yɛl o, N dana, ti ku sɔɣ a, ti di ti liɣiri zaa; ka ti niɣi zaa nyɛla nyin n dan dini; ti lan ka binshɛɣu nyin n dan tooni m-pahila ti niŋgbuna ŋɔ mini ti puri.
en: Then the people came to him and said: Sir, there's no way we can hide the truth from you. We are broke, and we don't have any more animals. We have nothing left except ourselves and our land.

dag: Ka Rut daa yɛl o, N dana, a niŋ ma nirilim pam. Hal m biɛhigu ni kul bi paag a paɣisara bɛn tumd a tuma ŋɔ ni yino gba biɛhigu maa zaa yoli, a kpaŋsi ma a ni tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ shɛm maa puuni.
en: Then Ruth said, I hope I can continue to please you, sir. You are very kind. I am only a servant and not even one of your own servants. But you have said kind words to me and comforted me.

dag: Bɛ nia zaa nyɛla bɛ daai ninvuɣ so ŋun ʒe zaashe titali ni luhi; bɛ nyɛla bɛn yu ʒiŋmabo. Alibarika yɛtɔɣa m-be bɛ noya ni, amaa ka turi yɛtɔɣa lee be bɛ suhuri ni.
en: You only want to bring him down from his place of honor; you take pleasure in lies. You speak words of blessing, but in your heart you curse him.

dag: ka wɔr piɛla vɔri chɛchɛbuŋ din pah ata, ka wɔr fufuhisi vɔri chɛchɛbuŋ din pah anahi mi.
en: The third chariot had white horses, and the fourth chariot had horses that were heavily spotted.

dag: Bɛ daa pun bar o la bandi ka lɔr o zoligɔnima, ka o chihiri li ka kabiri bandi maa; ka so ku tooi maag o nini.
en: Many times people had put chains on his hands and feet, but he broke the chains. No one was strong enough to control him.

dag: Bɛ yɛri ni bɛ nyɛla yɛnnima, ashee bɛ nyɛla jɛra.
en: They claim to be wise, but they are fools.

dag: Dama Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa yɛliya: Ti Duuma yɛli n Duuma: Ʒinimi n nudirigu polo hal ka n ti nyaŋ a dimnima ti a ka a du n-tam bɛ zuɣu.
en: David himself, inspired by the Holy Spirit, said, The Lord said to my lord, Sit at my right side until I turn your enemies into your footstool.

dag: N gbibila n wuntitali kirikiri ka ku wɔɣisi li; n suhu bi wuhi ni m mali galimi m biɛhigu ni dahin shɛli.
en: I will never give up my claim to be right; my conscience is clear.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka m biɛrim maa bi naara? Bɔzuɣu ka di zaɣisi naabu? Yɛlimaŋli a ŋmanila kulibɔn shɛli din nyɛ yɔhiŋ; ka ŋmani ko shɛŋa din nyuui.
en: Why am I always in pain? Why is my wound incurable, so far beyond healing? You have become for me as unreliable as a spring gone dry!.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ a niriba Izraɛlnim leeg a dahalali niriba sahakam; ka nyin Yawɛ nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: You have chosen Israel to be your people forever, and you have become their God.

dag: Yawɛ, zahimmi ma, ka buɣisi ma nya; buɣisim n suhu mini n tɛha.
en: Look closely at me, Lord , and test me. Judge my deepest thoughts and emotions.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri kabirila sida tihi luhira. Yawɛ kabi Lɛbanɔn sida tihi luhi.
en: The Lord s voice shatters great cedar trees. The Lord breaks the great cedars of Lebanon.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli.
en: Job said:.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Sintani, Ya polo ka a lee yina? Ka Sintani garigi yɛli Yawɛ, N yila dunia ni na, n chaŋmi ti gɔŋgo ka chaŋchaŋ gili di ni.
en: The Lord asked him, What have you been doing? Satan answered, I have been walking here and there, roaming around the earth.

dag: Ka di buɣisibu chɛriga ni ti yi nyaaŋa chaŋ katiŋa n-tuhi hal ni Garɛb daboli gbini, di nyaaŋa ka ŋmaligi chaŋ Gɔa.
en: And the boundary line will continue from there on the west to the hill of Gareb and then around to Goah.

dag: Ka niriba daa jɛmdi waɣ biɛ titali maa, o ni daa zaŋ fukumsi din nyɛ omaŋmaŋ dini n-niŋ biŋkɔbigu la nuu ni zuɣu, ka bɛ daa jɛmdi biŋkɔbigu maa n-yɛra, Ŋuni n-lee ŋmani biŋkɔbigu ŋɔ bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tuh o tɔbu.
en: and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛli Dauda, Yuria bi kul o yiŋa. Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yuria, Pa gɔrim yɔɣu ka a yina maa? Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi kuli yiŋa.
en: When David heard that Uriah had not gone home, he asked him, You have just returned after a long absence; why didn't you go home.

dag: Dama alahichi tumbu yɔri nyɛla kum, amaa Naawuni pini nyɛla nyɛvili din ka bahigu ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: For sin pays its wage—death; but God's free gift is eternal life in union with Christ Jesus our Lord.

dag: ka o ti yɛl o din ni tilig o min o yiŋnim zaa.
en: Then Peter would tell him how he and everyone in his house could be saved.

dag: Di simdi ka bɛ ti zaŋ bɛ ʒim maa vie bɛ dunɔpaɣira mini bɛ dunoya zuɣusahi luɣ shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni yɛn ŋubi nimdi maa.
en: The people are to take some of the blood and put it on the doorposts and above the doors of the houses in which the animals are to be eaten.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu ka naanyi ŋmaligi chaŋ.
en: After Jesus had placed his hands on the children, he left.

dag: dama Naawuni ni nam dunia ŋɔ hal ni zuŋɔ ka ti nin na bi nya wahala shɛŋa zaa ni ti beni, ka di tatabo mi ku lan niŋ.
en: In those days there will be great suffering such as the world has never before seen and will never again see.

dag: Ka bɛnkam ʒe yim hal ti paai biɛɣ tuhili ni kɔbisita ni pihitanaanu la tariga mal alibarika!.
en: Happy are those who remain faithful until , days are over!.

dag: Dama biɛri bɔhibu saha mini binshɛɣukam zaa din daa sab zalila palibu saha nti yɛn bala.
en: The prophets wrote many things about the time when God will punish his people. The time I am talking about is when all these things must happen.

dag: Tahimi pam, ka di shini! Duhim a kukoli kaman kikaa kumsi la n-yɛli n niriba Izraɛlnima bɛ tipawumli mini bɛ daalahichi yɛla.
en: Shout the message! Don't hold back. Say to my people Israel: You've sinned! You've turned against the Lord .

dag: ni Parua bia Jɛhɔshafat ŋun daa be Isaka tiŋgban ni la.
en: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah was in charge of the territory of Issachar.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa pii ninvuɣ shɛb niriba maa ni ka bɛ nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni toondaannima ni Izraɛl zuliya kam ni zuɣulaannima.
en: Moses and Aaron, together with these twelve tribal leaders.

dag: O ni daa yi niŋdi niriba ayopɔin shɛb saawara n-daa nyɛ: Karishɛna mini Shɛtar ni Adimata ni Tarishish ni Mɛrɛs ni Marisɛna ni Mɛmukan bɛn daa nyɛ Pɛriʒia mini Miidia tuma zuɣulaannim bɛn ʒe zaashe kara ni o nam sulinsi maa ni la.
en: Those he most often turned to for advice were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan—seven officials of Persia and Media who held the highest offices in the kingdom.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa gindi fɔntinsi mini tiŋkpansi yihiri waazu, ka mali Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ yɛla wuhiri niriba. Ka o nyaandoliba pinaayi la daa be o sani.
en: The next day, Jesus traveled through some cities and small towns. Jesus told the people a message from God, the Good News about Gods kingdom. The twelve apostles were with him.

dag: Ka biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn mali naba anahi ka chani bɛ nyinyari zuɣu nyɛla bɛn nyɛ daɣiri bini yi sani, ka ŋunkam shihi bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Of all the animals that walk on four feet, the ones that walk on their paws are unclean for you—anyone who touches their dead bodies will be unclean until evening.

dag: ka duhi bɛ yee yɛli, Ti dan Yisa, zom ti nambɔɣu.
en: and shouted, Jesus, Master, have pity on us.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zali ya yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm zaa di saha maa.
en: At the same time I gave you instructions for everything else you were to do.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ kali tinzunnim bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kaman o ba Dauda ni daa chɛ ka bɛ kali ba shɛm la. Ka bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisi niriba tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinunaata ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: Then Solomon counted all the immigrants in the land of Israel, as his father David had done, and the total was .

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan laɣim maligumaaniba kpamba mini zuɣulaannima ni salo maa zaa na.
en: Pilate called all the people together with the leading priests and the Jewish leaders.

dag: Nyin paɣa, wula ka a ni tooi baŋ ni a zuɣu ku tilig a yidana? Ka nyin doo mi, wula ka a ni tooi baŋ ni a zuɣu ku tilig a paɣa?.
en: And besides, how do you know if you will be able to save your husband or wife who isn't a follower?.

dag: Naa maa ni daa wum paɣ maa yɛtɔɣa maa, ka o darigi toog omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu, ka doli gooni maa zuɣu garita. Ka niriba nya o ka o yɛla buɣu ka di be o binyɛrigu tiŋli.
en: When the king heard the womans story, he ripped his clothes. And as he passed by along the wall, the people could see that he was wearing mourning clothes underneath.

dag: Ka yi ni ŋuni n-lee bo paɣa ka bɛ na bi kulis o na? Dilan labimi kuli yiŋa, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb maa ni ka so kpuɣ o paɣ maa.
en: Is there any man here who is engaged to be married? That man should go back home. If he dies in the battle, another man will marry the woman he is engaged to.

dag: Toli nyɛla bɛn ka naa, amaa bɛ nyɛla bɛn doli tab chana sariasaria.
en: Locusts: they have no king, but they move in formation.

dag: Ifriim bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shutɛla mini Bɛrɛd ni Tahat ni Ɛliada ni Tahat.
en: Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn ʒi, ka lan ka baŋsim; yi bela zibisim ni, dunia ŋɔ tiŋgbani tanzahi zaa dammi.
en: None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.

dag: A ku ŋmaligi a nini bahi kpaŋ biɛla, ka chɛ ma hal ka n ti vali n nintɔri?.
en: You never look away from me or leave me alone for a second.

dag: N dana, ka ti daa yɛl a, ti mali ba ka o nyɛla ninkurili, ka mali tizo ŋun nyɛ ti ba maa ni daa dɔɣ so o ninkurilim ŋɔ ni. O biɛli daa kpimi ka chɛ ka o kɔŋko n-kul kpalim o mabihi ni; ka o ba maa yur o pam.
en: So we told you, Our father is a very old man. In fact, he was already old when Benjamin was born. Benjamin's brother is dead. Now Benjamin is the only one of the two brothers who is still alive, and our father loves him very much.

dag: N daa darigi deei nam maa la Dauda daŋ ni ti a, amaa ka a ti bi be kaman n dabili Dauda ŋun daa doli n zalikpana, ka doli ma ni o suhu zaa ka tumdi din tuhi n san la.
en: Davids family was ruling the kingdom of Israel, but I took the kingdom away from them and gave it to you. But you are not like my servant David. He always obeyed my commands and followed me with his whole heart. He did only what I accepted.

dag: Di saha maa yi ni ti yɛli, Ti min a n-daa yi laɣindi diri ka nyura, ka a be pala zuɣu wuhiri ti la.
en: Then you will start saying, We dined with you, and you taught in our streets.

dag: Dinzuɣu n-chɛ ka di wɔɣ zuɣusaa gari mɔɣu ni tihi zaa. Di wulikpani daa bara, ka di wula wɔɣa, di ni daa nyari kom pam zoori la zuɣu.
en: And so it became higher than all the trees of the field. Its branches became abundant; its boughs grew long. Because of the plentiful water, it grew freely.

dag: M biɛhigu shee suɣili maa nyaaŋa zaŋ lab wulinluhili polo, di simdi ka yi mali dapaɣa ayɔbu niŋ li.
en: Make six more frames for the back of the Holy Tent.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa sabi tibidarigibo maa yɛla niŋ litaafi ni m-paɣ li niŋ kɔtɔɣu maa ni.
en: The priest should write these warnings on a scroll. Then he should wash the words off into the water.

dag: Yi yi baŋ dimbɔŋɔnima ka dol li, yi ni nya alibarika.
en: Since you know these things, you will be happy if you do them.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, labisim doo maa paɣa ti o; dama o nyɛla anabi, ka o suhi Naawuni ti a ka a be. Amaa a yi bi labis o ti o, nyin baŋmi ni biɛhiŋ kani a min a ni su ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ni kpi.
en: But now, give the woman back to her husband. He is a prophet, and he will pray for you, so that you will not die. But if you do not give her back, I warn you that you are going to die, you and all your people.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o ni kɔrisikɔrisi da shɛŋa maa sɔŋ biŋkɔbiri maa tooni kɔnyuri bɔɣili gbini luɣ shɛli biŋkɔbiri maa ni kanna ti nyuri kom. Ka biŋkɔbiri maa daa yi ti kana ni bɛ ti nyu kom ka duri taba.
en: Then he put the branches where the sheep and goats would see them while they were drinking from the water trough. The goats mated there.

dag: Ka Ɛli daa yi suhiri alibarika niŋdi Ɛlikana min o paɣ maa ni ka yɛri Ɛlikana, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka a paɣ ŋɔ dɔɣi bihi ti a ka bɛ zan o ni zaŋ bi so ti ŋun Yawɛ ŋɔ zaani. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ lan lab kuli bɛ ya.
en: Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife. He would say, May the Lord give you more children through Hannah who will take the place of the boy she prayed for and gave to the Lord . Elkanah and Hannah went home.

dag: Di kul ni ʒiɛya sahakam kaman goli ŋun kul nyɛ shɛhiralana m-be sagbana ni ŋɔ.
en: It will be securely established forever; like the moon, a faithful witness in the sky. Selah.

dag: Nyin Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga, ŋmɛlim amaŋ ka ŋuhimi kaman paɣ ŋun wolisira, dama pumpɔŋɔ a ni yi fɔntiŋ ŋɔ ni chaŋ ti be mɔɣu ni. Ka di nyaaŋa, a ni ti kuli Babilɔn. Nimaani ka a ni ti nya faako. Nimaani ka Yawɛ ni ti tilig a a dimnim nuu ni.
en: Writhe and scream, Daughter Zion, like a woman in labor! Now you will leave the city and dwell in the open field; you will go to Babylon. There you will be rescued; there the LORD will redeem you from the power of your enemies.

dag: Yi daa zaŋ wuntizɔra taali n-ku o, amaa o bi zaɣisi ya.
en: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, and they do not resist you.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti mali di tatabo bee m-booi li bahi ninvuɣ yiriŋ zuɣu ni, bɛn yihimi dilan o niriba laɣiŋgu ni. .
en: Whoever makes any like it or uses any of it on anyone who is not a priest will no longer be considered one of my people.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ daanya mali gaɣa kɔtomsi n-tuɣituɣi taba n-zaŋ li kaai vili kɔniŋdi bini maa nyingol ni ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita anu.
en: All around the outer edge of the rim of the tank were two rows of bronze gourds, which had been cast all in one piece with the rest of the tank.

dag: O daa zaŋla Bɛnjamin zuliya maa ni niriba tuhili pa omaŋ zuɣu na. Ka Ziba ŋun daa nyɛ Sool daŋ niriba tumtumda la daa zaŋ o bidibisi pinaanu min o tumtumdiba pisi n-zo n-daŋ naa tooni chaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni.
en: A thousand men from Benjamin were with him. Ziba too, the servant of Sauls house, along with his fifteen sons and twenty servants, rushed to the Jordan ahead of the king.

dag: A bela a biɛhigu shee ka chɛ ka saa yiri zuɣusaa luri zoya zuɣu na, ka tiŋgbani diri a tuma nyɔri.
en: From the sky you send rain on the hills, and the earth is filled with your blessings.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka Naawuni daa ka Naa Sulemaana sanna ti yɛl o, Suhimi ma a ni bɔri ni n ti a shɛli.
en: God appeared to Solomon that night in a dream and said, Solomon, ask for anything you want, and I will give it to you.

dag: Amaa ka wain tia maa bɔhi ba, N chɛli n wain shɛli din tiri wuna mini ninsalinim suhupiɛlli la tɔɣibu, ka leei tihi naa.
en: But the vine replied to them, Should I stop providing my wine that makes gods and humans happy, so that I can go to sway over the trees.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka Mariama kumda, ka Yɛhudianim bɛn dol o na maa gba kumdi maa, ka o suhu saɣim pam, ka o siɣim.
en: When Jesus saw that Mary and the people with her were crying, he was terribly upset.

dag: Ka naa maa mini Juda kpamba ni Jɛrusalɛmnim maa zaa zaŋ tabili maligumaaniba mini anabinim ni sokam zaa ni wɔɣira ni tarimba zaa daa chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka o ti karim Naawuni zaligu kundi shɛli bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ka bɛ wum.
en: and together they went to the Temple, accompanied by the priests and the prophets and all the rest of the people, rich and poor alike. Before them all the king read aloud the whole book of the covenant which had been found in the Temple.

dag: Shɛlini bɛ daa turi ya ka muɣisiri ya palɔni, ka shɛlini mi yi daa nyɛla bɛn pahi bɛ ni niŋdi yi tab shɛb lala zuɣu.
en: Sometimes people said hateful things to you and mistreated you in public. And sometimes you helped others who were being treated that same way.

dag: Sagbani maa mini teeku maa ni ka bɛ zaa daa deei baptaizibu din wuhiri ni bɛ nyɛla Anabi Musa nyaandoliba.
en: All were baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea.

dag: Dama bɛ zaa daa bɔrimi ni bɛ kpɛhi ti dabiɛm ka tɛhira, Bɛ kɔba ni ni chɔɣisi, ka bɛ kɔŋ tuma tumbu. Ka n daa suhi Naawuni yɛli, N Naawuni, kpaŋsim n kɔba ni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: They were trying to frighten us into stopping work. I prayed, But now, God, make me strong.

dag: Nyin Bɛtilihɛm, tiŋ din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ, a pala tin bila Juda nabihi sani, dama a ni ka na so ŋun ni su n niriba Izraɛlnim ni ti yina. .
en: You, Bethlehem, land of Judah, by no means are you least among the rulers of Judah, because from you will come one who governs, who will shepherd my people Israel.

dag: ka o bidibisi daa taɣi binʒim ti o, ka o zaŋ o nubil tim ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li ʒe sara maligu bimbini zuɣu binyila la, ka kpaai binʒim maa bahi sara maligu bimbini maa naba zaashee.
en: His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, smeared some on the four corners of the bronze altar, and poured out the rest at its foot.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa lan damdi tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim tiŋa.
en: But Abraham bowed before the Hittites.

dag: O ʒiɛla luɣ shɛŋa din du zuɣu mini so naŋgban kpansi ni sochira zuɣu.
en: Wisdom stands at the top of the hill, by the road where the paths meet.

dag: Malaika ŋun daa yɛli ma lala maa daa malila salima jaaŋgbee din nyɛ o ni mali shɛli buɣisiri binyara ni o ti buɣisi tiŋ maa mini di dunoya ni di gooni la.
en: The angel who talked with me had a measuring rod made of gold. The angel had this rod to measure the city, its gates, and its wall.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi daa yɛli doo maa ni yi mali tizo m-bo suhusaɣiŋgu ŋɔ ti ma.
en: Jacob asked, Why did you cause me so much trouble by telling the governor you had another brother.

dag: Di yi shiri nyɛla yi duhila yimaŋa n-jɛndi ma, ka zaŋ n filiŋ ŋɔ jɛndi ma.
en: You want me to look bad to make yourselves look good. You say my troubles are proof that I did wrong.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, A ni saɣi tahi ma ŋmɛnditoya maa sani? Ka o garigi yɛli Dauda, Pom Naawuni ni a ku ku ma bee n-zaŋ ma niŋ n dan maa nuu ni pɔi, ka n naanyi zaŋ a tahi bɛ sani.
en: Will you take me to those Amalekites? David asked. Yes, I will, if you promise with God as a witness that you won't kill me or hand me over to my master.

dag: Ka naa maa daa bol o na ti yɛl o, Nyin zaɣ yoli ŋɔ! A ni daa balim ma la, n daa bi ku a samli la zaa ti a?.
en: The king called the first official back in and said, You're an evil man! When you begged for mercy, I said you did not have to pay back a cent.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa kul tɔŋdi pahiri Naa Darius nam ʒiɛman ni zaŋ tabili Naa Sairus ŋun daa nyɛ Pɛriʒia nir la gba nam ʒiɛman ni.
en: All went well for Daniel while Darius was king, and even when Cyrus the Persian ruled.

dag: Lala ka o daa niŋ me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa naai, ka zaŋ sida dapuhi mini di dapaɣa n-siili li.
en: The roof of the temple was made out of beams and cedar boards. The workers finished building the outside of the temple.

dag: Ka doo kam ŋun bi guni, bɛn yihim o o daŋ ni, o ni bi gbibi n daalikauli maa zuɣu.
en: Abraham, this is the agreement between you and me: Any male who is not circumcised will be cut off from his people because he has broken my agreement.

dag: Ti ni nya nɛma balibu kam din mali shaara, ka ŋme n-di nɛma pam ti pali ti yinsi.
en: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.

dag: M mabihi, n suhu zaa yuya ni mmaŋmaŋ zuliya tiligi, ka n kul suhiri Naawuni tiri ba di zuɣu.
en: Dear friends, my greatest wish and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.

dag: Ka Dauda daa baŋ ni Sool lo o la zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu, ka daa yɛli Abiata ŋun nyɛ maligumaana maa, Zaŋmi tan la na.
en: When David learned that Saul was planning to harm him, he told the priest Abiathar, Bring the priestly vest now.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa sɔŋ Judanima ka bɛ tuhi deei zoya ni tinsi la, amaa ka lee bi tooi kari bɛn daa be bɔpiɛligu ni la, bɛ ni daa mali kuriti chɛchɛbunsi la zuɣu.
en: Thus the LORD was with the tribe of Judah, and they took possession of the highlands. However, they didnt drive out those who lived in the plain because they had iron chariots.

dag: Kom ni binneen shɛba yi ni yɛn diri n-nyɛ: Binshɛɣukam din be kom ni ka mali gɔhi mini paɣiri teekunim puuni bee kulibɔna ni, yin ŋubimiya ba.
en: You are allowed to eat the following from all water animals: You may eat anything in the water that has fins and scales, whether in sea or stream.

dag: Amaa ka o daa taai duŋ, ka tim tuumba Ijipti ni bɛ ti o yuri mini tɔbbihi pam na. O ni di nasara? Nira ŋun niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima ni tooi tiligi? O ni tooi saɣim alikauli ŋɔ ka tiligi? .
en: But the king of Judah rebelled and sent agents to Egypt to get horses and a large army. Will he succeed? Can he get away with that? He cannot break the treaty and go unpunished!.

dag: Binnamdi so ku tooi sɔɣi Naawuni, dama binshɛɣukam dola palɔni o sani. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti zaa ni ti yɛn kahigi ti bebu ni nyɛ shɛm wuhi so.
en: There is nothing that can be hid from God; everything in all creation is exposed and lies open before his eyes. And it is to him that we must all give an account of ourselves.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ Taitus polo, o nyɛla n tumtumdikpee ŋun pahi n zuɣu ka ti tumdi ni ti sɔŋ ya; ka zaŋ chaŋ ti mabihi la mi polo, bɛ nyɛla cheechi tuumba Masia jilima nyabu zuɣu.
en: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa puuni, di yi nyɛ yɛtɔɣa ni bee tuma ni, yin niŋmiya di zaa ti Duuma Yisa yuli ni, ka paɣimiya ti Ba Naawuni o zuɣu.
en: Everything you do or say, then, should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks through him to God the Father.

dag: Ɛzra ni daa suhiri n-kahigiri bɛ daalahichi wuhiri Naawuni, ka kumdi ka luri Naawuni jɛmbu duu tooni shɛm maa, ka Izraɛlnim dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bihi pam daa laɣim o sani. Bɛ gba daa kumiya pam.
en: While Ezra was praying and confessing, weeping and bowing down before Gods house, a very large crowd of men, women, and children of Israel gathered around him. The people also wept in distress.

dag: Niŋmiya kaman n ni niŋdi shɛm. N kul kpaŋdi mmaŋa ni n tiɣi sokam nini n ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni, ka di pala mmaŋmaŋ sɔŋsim zuɣu, amaa di nyɛla niriba pam sɔŋsim zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ tiligi.
en: I always try to please others instead of myself, in the hope that many of them will be saved.

dag: N lan ka suhupiɛlli, suhusaɣiŋgu m-mali ma. Biɛrim be n suhu ni.
en: No healing, only grief; my heart is broken.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, yi yi ti laɣim ni yi di ti Duuma Bindirigu maa, yin guhimiya taba.
en: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Ninvuɣ so ŋun tiri Yawɛ jilima mal alibarika. Ŋun yu o zaligunim mali alibarika.
en: Praise the Lord ! Happy is the person who honors the Lord , who takes pleasure in obeying his commands.

dag: Dama ti yab Ibrahimma yi daa yi taali ni Naawuni sani la o tuma zuɣu, o daa naan mal li kuuna, amaa ka pa ni Naawuni sani.
en: Because if Abraham was made righteous because of his actions, he would have had a reason to brag, but not in front of God.

dag: Daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Ti Duuma ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ sahi takɔbi, ka nyɛhi li ka di neei.
en: Mortal man, prophesy. Tell the people what I, the Lord, am saying: A sword, a sword is sharpened and polished.

dag: Bɛ ni daa pirigi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ tiŋgbana ti Izraɛlnim shɛm m-bɔŋɔ. Ɛliɛza ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la mini Nan bia Jɔshua ni Izraɛl zuliyanim kpamba n-daa pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa tari ba.
en: Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders of all the tribes of Israel decided what land to give to the people.

dag: Bɛ ni ninvuɣ suŋ ŋmanila suligunyinyaɣu, ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ maŋli mi ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ gɔ shɛŋa sa n-gili. Bɛ tibidarigibo dabisili la biɛɣu neeya, anabinim bɛn ŋmani tiŋguliba ni daa pun yɛli ba dabisi shɛli yɛla la. Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ birimbu saha paaya.
en: Even the best and most honest of them are as worthless as weeds. The day has come when God will punish the people, as he warned them through their watchmen, the prophets. Now they are in confusion.

dag: Jɛrigu ku tooi baŋ li; ka ŋun ka laasabu ku tooi baŋ dimbɔŋɔ.
en: This is something a fool cannot know; someone who is stupid cannot understand:.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛn chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa yɛli ni a daa lola a niriba maa zaɣ biɛɣu zuɣu ka a zaŋ ba chaŋ zoya ni ni a ti ku ba kpihim bɛ birili dunia yili? Yihim a suhuyiɣisili titali ŋɔ a suhu ni, ka chɛ a niriba ŋɔ zaɣ biɛɣu maa niŋbu.
en: If you do, the Egyptians will say that you brought your people out here into the mountains just to get rid of them. Please don't be angry with your people. Don't destroy them!.

dag: Be a biɛhigu shee din be kasi alizanda ni ka lihi tiŋ na n-niŋ alibarika niŋ a niriba Izraɛlnim min a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti ŋɔ ni kaman a ni daa po pɔri yɛli ti yaannima ni di nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam la.
en: Please look down from your holy home, from heaven itself, and bless your people Israel and the fertile land that you have given us—a land full of milk and honey—just like you promised our ancestors.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti kuhi boli Yawɛ yuli ni tiligi. Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiligi ni ti be Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu mini Jɛrusalɛm kaman Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm. Yawɛ ni boli ninvuɣ shɛba ni ti be bɛn kpalim maa ni.
en: Then I, the Lord will save everyone who faithfully worships me. I have promised there will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and among them will be my chosen ones.

dag: Ti tiligimi kaman nooŋa n-tiligi tɔha tɔŋ gbaabu ni la. Tɔha tɔŋ kabiya ka ti tiligi.
en: We escaped like a bird from the hunters trap; the trap was broken so we escaped!.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa pali bɛ zaa, ka bɛ piligi tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi maa yiko ni.
en: The Holy Spirit took control of everyone, and they began speaking whatever languages the Spirit let them speak.

dag: Yawɛ sizuura lubu viɛla; ka nyɛ din kul be sahakam. Yawɛ zaligu shɛŋa din pahi nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka nyɛ wuntia zaa.
en: Honoring the LORD is correct, lasting forever. The LORDs judgments are true. All of these are righteous!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ba yina ti bɔhi ba, N duumanima, ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ tiligi.
en: He led them outside and asked, Honorable masters, what must I do to be rescued.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli, M Ba Naawuni, nyin ŋun su alizanda mini dunia ŋɔ, m paɣir a, dama a zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnima n-sɔɣi yɛnnim mini baŋdiba, ka lee kahigi li wuhila biliɛri;.
en: Then Jesus said, I praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth. I am thankful that you have hidden these things from those who are so wise and so smart. But you have shown them to people who are like little children.

dag: Amaa nyini zanim baɣili ma kpe, ka n yɛl a fukumsi zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, ka a zaŋ wuhi ba ka bɛ ti dol li n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba ni bɛ su maa ni.
en: but you come back here to me. After I tell you my laws and teachings, you will repeat them to the people, so they can obey these laws in the land I am giving them.

dag: Di ʒin ya liɣiri din nyɛ salima bee anzinfa, hal di zaŋya kɔbo gba n-niŋ yi liɣiri kolibihi ni.
en: Don't take along any gold, silver, or copper coins.

dag: Zoya ni gili Jɛrusalɛm shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ gil o niriba, pumpɔŋɔ hal ni sahakam.
en: Mountains surround Jerusalem. Thats how the LORD surrounds his people from now until forever from now!.

dag: dama buni bi beni sahakam, ka nam zuɣupiligu mi kul ku beni ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Neither wealth nor nations last forever.

dag: Anabi maa n-nyɛ ŋun guli Ifriimnim bɛn nyɛ n Naawuni niriba ŋɔ, amaa ka bɛ bari noongbahiri zana bɛ soya zuɣu, ka dimdi be bɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: God has sent me as a prophet to warn his people Israel. Yet wherever I go, you try to trap me like a bird. Even in God's Temple the people are the prophet's enemies.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka doo ŋmaligir o ba min o ma sani n-zaŋd omaŋ tabind o paɣa, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa be kaman ninvuɣ yino la.
en: This is the reason that a man leaves his father and mother and embraces his wife, and they become one flesh.

dag: Naa Uzia ni daa niŋ binshɛŋa pahi o piligu ni hal ni o bahigu ni, anabi Aizaia ŋun daa nyɛ Amɔz bia la daa sab li.
en: The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz recorded all the other things that King Uzziah did during his reign.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ tia maa, ka yi mi nyɛ di wula; ŋun kul tuɣ ma ka n gba tuɣ o, ŋuna n-wandi wala pam; dama yi yi bi tuɣ ma, yi ku tooi niŋ shɛli.
en: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Hal sokam zaa yi ni zo ka chɛ a, man kul ku zo ka chɛ a.
en: Peter replied, If everyone else stumbles because of you, Ill never stumble.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, faashee bɛ maan labi dɔɣi ninsala, di yi pa lala o ku tooi nya Naawuni nam.
en: Jesus replied, I tell you for certain that you must be born from above before you can see God's kingdom.

dag: Ka o daa ba buŋ maa n-yi soli chani ha ka gbuɣinli chirig o n-gbaag o ku o, ka vu o sɔŋ sol ni; ka buŋ maa ʒe m-baɣ o; ka gbuɣinli maa gba ʒe m-baɣ o.
en: On the way home, a lion attacked and killed the man of God. His body was lying on the road while the lion stood next to it. The donkey stood nearby.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Samsin daa ti bɔri paɣ so ŋun be Sɔrɛk Vinvamli ni ka o yuli booni Dilaila.
en: Some time later, Samson fell in love with a woman named Delilah, who lived in Sorek Valley.

dag: Yɛlim yɛm, N tizɔpaɣa n-nyɛ a. Ka boli tɛhi zilima mi N zɔsimo.
en: Treat wisdom as your sister, and insight as your closest friend.

dag: Ŋun daa lan pahi n-nyɛ Baruk bia Maasɛya ŋun daa nyɛ Kolihɔze yaaŋa la. O yaannim shɛba n-daa lan nyɛ Hazaaya mini Adaya ni Joyarib ni Zakaria so mi bɛn daa nyɛ Shilo daŋ ni niriba la.
en: and Maaseiah son of Baruch son of Col-hozeh son of Hazaiah son of Adaiah son of Joiarib son of Zechariah son of the Shilonite.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yi ti gbaai niŋbu, di saha yin kpuɣimiya yi zuɣuri lihi zuɣusaa, dama yi tiliginsim saha ti miritimi maa.
en: When all of this starts happening, stand up straight and be brave. You will soon be set free.

dag: Bɛ gbahi Judanim daba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ka bɛ ti diri wahala, ka tumdi dabitim tuma. Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ bela tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka bi nya vuhim shee. Bɛn daa kari doli ba maa zaa gbahi ba bɛ nandahima pam puuni.
en: The people of Judah are slaves, suffering in a foreign land, with no rest from sorrow. Their enemies captured them and were terribly cruel.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, pa Yawɛ milinsi ni ka n kana ni n ti saɣim tiŋgbani ŋɔ? Yawɛ n-yɛli ma, Cham ti saɣim tiŋgbani maa. .
en: Whats more, do you think Ive marched against this place to destroy it without the LORDs support? It was the LORD who told me, March against this land and destroy it.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ a nam maa ku lan chaŋ tooni, dama Yawɛ pun piig o suhu ni yu ninvuɣ so n-zaŋ o leeg o niriba naa, dama a bi doli Yawɛ ni zal a shɛm.
en: But now your rule will not continue. Because you have disobeyed him, the Lord will find the kind of man he wants and make him ruler of his people.

dag: N ni zaŋ wumpaɣibo sara ti Yawɛ, ka jɛm o.
en: So Ill offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving to you, and Ill call on the LORDs name.

dag: Ka daa lan kpihim zaligu shɛli din mini di soya daa galindi ti ka kul nyari ti taali la n-daa zaŋ li kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu n-yihi li zaa bahi.
en: he canceled the unfavorable record of our debts with its binding rules and did away with it completely by nailing it to the cross.

dag: Ka Balak daa lan tim kpamba bɛn mali jilima pam, ka zooi gar o ni daa tuui tim shɛb maa.
en: Balak continued to send other officials more numerous and important than these.

dag: ka a ku a dan Ɛhab daŋ niriba, ka di chɛ ka m bɔhi Jɛzibɛl biɛri o ni daa ku n daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim mini n dab shɛb zaa bɛn pahi la zuɣu.
en: You must destroy the family of Ahab your king. In this way I will punish Jezebel for the deaths of my servants, the prophets, and the deaths of all the Lord s servants who were murdered.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Chɛl paɣ ŋɔ baalim! Chɛ ka o niŋ li gu n sɔɣibu dali.
en: Then Jesus said, Leave her alone. This perfume was to be used in preparation for my burial, and this is how she has used it.

dag: Ka tuun biɛri ni ti yɛn zooi zuɣu ni chɛ ka niriba pam yurilim filim.
en: Because disobedience will expand, the love of many will grow cold.

dag: Nyama, dabisi shɛŋa kanna ka n ni ti mɔŋ a min a yab yiŋnim zaa yaa, ka ninkurigu ti ku be yi daŋ maa ni yaha.
en: The time is coming when I will destroy all your descendants. No one in your family will live to be an old man.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa lee chani Filistianim maa sani nti tɛhiri bɛ naɣikɔra kubiɛlima mini bɛ lɛbiɛlima ni kpanbiɛlima ni gɔriti zaa.
en: The Israelites had to go to the Philistines to get their plows, hoes, axes, and sickles sharpened;.

dag: Di saha ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa yiɣisi kuli ti be Ninive.
en: Then the Assyrian emperor Sennacherib withdrew and returned to Nineveh.

dag: ka o yɛligu mi ka yi suhuri ni, dama yi bi niŋ o ni tim so na la yɛda.
en: The Fathers teaching does not live in you, because you dont believe in the one the Father sent.

dag: Bɛ daa kpaŋsi n suhu kaman bɛ ni daa kpaŋsi yi gba suhuri shɛm; ka bɛn niŋdi lala maa simdi paɣibu.
en: They have been a great encouragement to me and to you as well. You should recognize the value of such people.

dag: Anabi shɛb bɛn daa daŋ m min a tooni na kurimbuni ha la daa tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-yɛri tɔbu tuhibu mini kum ni alɔbo yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndiri tiŋgbɔna mini nam shɛŋa din niriba mali kpiɔŋ.
en: The prophets who came before you and me long ago prophesied war, disaster, and disease against many lands and great kingdoms.

dag: ka bɛ nyu li ka tam bɛ fara yɛla, ka ku lan teei bɛ suhugarigu yɛla.
en: Let them drink and forget their poverty and unhappiness.

dag: M mabia, a yurilim maa zuɣu chɛ ka n nya suhupiɛlli mini suhukpaŋsibo, dama Yisa nyaandoliba nyari suhukpaŋsibo a sani.
en: My brother, you have shown love to Gods people, and your help has greatly encouraged them. What a great joy and encouragement that has been to me.

dag: ka lan zaŋ jɛsint mini agɛt ni amɛtisit la m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir ata.
en: a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst were in the third row;.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali biɛɣu daa ti neerina ka bɛ daŋ yibu ti chaŋ gili tiŋ maa kaman bɛ ni daa yi pun gindi li shɛm la napɔŋ buyopɔin. Kulla dindali maa kɔŋko ka bɛ daa gil li napɔŋ buyopɔin maa.
en: On the seventh day, they got up at dawn and marched around the city seven times. They marched in the same way they had marched on the days before, but on that day they marched around the city seven times.

dag: Jɛrigu n-yihiri suhuyiɣisili palo ni. Amaa yɛndan ŋun kul gbib li la baalim.
en: Fools show all their anger, but the wise hold it back.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa chaŋ Asirianim sansan ni dindali maa yuŋ nti ku bɛ tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinii ni tusaanu. Ka niriba daa yiɣisi asibaasi n-nya ka kpiimba n-kul do luɣilikam zaa.
en: That night the LORDs messenger went out and struck down one hundred eighty-five thousand soldiers in the Assyrian camp. When people got up the next morning, there were dead bodies everywhere.

dag: n-nyɛ ŋun ni nyu Naawuni suhuyiɣisili wain shɛli o ni booi niŋ o suhuyiɣisili pipia ni ka binshɛli bi pilisi di ni la. Ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ chilibi buɣim n-nahim dilana malaika kasinim mini Piɛbil la tooni.
en: they themselves will also drink the wine of Gods passionate anger, poured full strength into the cup of his wrath. They will suffer the pain of fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and the Lamb.

dag: So ni tooi mɔŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn deei Naawuni Shia Kasi kaman ti gba ni daa deei shɛm la kom baptaizibu.
en: These people have received the Holy Spirit just as we have. Surely no one can stop them from being baptized with water, can they.

dag: Di saha ka Aduna daa yɛli Musa, N dana, di darigi ti tibili, ti ni tum jɛrilim ka tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: he said to Moses, Please, sir, do not make us suffer this punishment for our foolish sin.

dag: Ka a yi ti lan bɔrila shɛlikam pahi ni a zaŋ tum a Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tuma, nyin yihim li nayili kpanjɔɣu la ni.
en: If you need to get anything else for the temple, you may have the money you need from the royal treasury.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni, teemi dimbɔŋɔnim yɛla, dama bɛ ta maligumaaniba tuma zaŋ tabil a ni daa lo maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim alikauli shɛl la daɣiri.
en: Remember, God, how those people defiled both the office of priest and the covenant you made with the priests and the Levites.

dag: Nyini n-daa zaŋ kɔba mini jila tuɣituɣi ma, ka zaŋ niŋgbuŋ mini gbaŋ pili ma.
en: You put me together with bones and muscles, and then you clothed me with skin and flesh.

dag: Ka anabinim maa zaa daa yɛli anabitali yɛtɔɣ yini maa, ka yɛra, Chamiya Ramɔtigiliad ti di nasara. Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba niŋ naa nuu ni.
en: All the prophets agreed that Ahab should attack the Syrians at Ramoth and promised that the Lord would help him defeat them.

dag: Zuliya pam niriba ni ka yi neesim maa ni na, ka nanim ka yi biɛkaali neesim ni na.
en: Nations and kings will come to the light of your dawning day.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ gballi maa gbini, ka o suhu ti lan saɣim pam. Gballi maa daa nyɛla siliga, ka kuɣili yo di noli.
en: Jesus was deeply disturbed again when he came to the tomb. It was a cave, and a stone covered the entrance.

dag: Ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa yɛli Jɛrimia, N zɔrila Yɛhudianim bɛn zo nti pahi Babilɔnnim maa zuɣu la, bɛ ti zaŋ ma niŋ bɛ nuu ni ka bɛ niŋ ma alaka zuɣu.
en: But the king answered, I am afraid of our own people who have deserted to the Babylonians. I may be handed over to them and tortured.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa me sara maligu bimbini zali, ka boli di yuli Ɛl Ɛlɔhi Izraɛl .
en: He built an altar there to honor God. He named the place El, the God of Israel.

dag: ka baŋdi ŋaha mini yɛliŋmahima din nyɛ yɛnnim yɛtɔɣa mini bɛ saliŋlɔha.
en: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.

dag: Ka o daa ʒiya n-wumdi Pool waazu, ka Pool ti mirig o nina kpa o n-nya ka o mali yɛda din ni chɛ ka o kpaŋ.
en: The man was listening to Paul speak, when Paul saw that he had faith in Jesus and could be healed. So he looked straight at the man.

dag: Ka bɛ daa wuh o min o yiŋnim zaa ti Duuma yɛligu.
en: Then they preached the word of the Lord to him and to all the others in the house.

dag: ni Ifriim Dunɔdal la zuɣusaa ni Dunɔdal Kurili la gbini ni Zahim Dunɔdali ni Hananɛl Pia ni Kɔbiga Pia la gbini m-mali hal ti paai Piɛri Dunɔdal la gbini, ka bɛ daa kana ti zani Guliba Dunɔdal la gbini.
en: Ephraim Gate, Old Gate, Fish Gate, Hananel Tower, Hundred Tower, and on to Sheep Gate. Finally, we stopped at Gate of the Guard.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni daa yiɣisi Seir zoya zuɣu, a ni daa yi Ɛdom tiŋgban ni chana, tiŋgbani daa dammi, ka saa luna. Iin, ka sagbana daa chɛ ka saa luna.
en: LORD, when you set out from Seir, when you marched out from Edoms fields, the land shook, the sky poured down, the clouds poured down water.

dag: bɛ ni ti mali bihim pam ka o ŋubiri waagasi; dama ŋunkam ti kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ni ti diri waagasi mini shiri.
en: will have enough milk to make yogurt. In fact, everyone left in the land will eat yogurt and honey.

dag: Yi ni sab gbaŋ shɛli ti ma la, bɛ lɛbigi li karim wuhi ma.
en: After your letter was translated and read to me.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔh o, Ka daɣila a nyɛla naa? Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li. Bɛ daa dɔɣi ma dunia ŋɔ ni ni n dila yɛlimaŋli shɛhira. Ka ŋunkam suhu ye yɛlimaŋli zuɣu wumdi n yɛligu.
en: So Pilate asked him, Are you a king, then? Jesus answered, You say that I am a king. I was born and came into the world for this one purpose, to speak about the truth. Whoever belongs to the truth listens to me.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim daa ti bɔr o shee chuɣu maa ni, ka bɔhir o yɛla yɛra, Ya polo ka o lee be.
en: At the festival the Jewish leaders were looking for him. They said, Where is that man.

dag: Paɣimiya yi situra daba ayopɔin dali din ni chɛ ka yi be kasi. Di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi kpe sansani ŋɔ ni na.
en: On the seventh day you must wash your clothes; then you will be ritually clean and will be permitted to enter the camp.

dag: O ni dihi bɛn je a vi, ka ninvuɣ biɛri yiŋ ti ku lan beni.
en: Maybe your enemies will be humiliated and the homes of the wicked destroyed.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Neesim ni be yi sani yuui biɛla. Ka yi ni mali neesim maa zuɣu, kul chamiya; di yi pa lala zibisim ni ti paai ya. Ŋun chani zibisim ni bi mi o ni kpari shɛli polo.
en: Jesus answered, The light will be among you a little longer. Continue on your way while you have the light, so that the darkness will not come upon you; for the one who walks in the dark does not know where he is going.

dag: Ka bɛ kɔbiri ŋmani paɣiba zabiri, ka bɛ nyina be kaman gbuɣinli nyina la.
en: Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion.

dag: Amaa yɛl shɛŋa yi ni pun mi la zuɣu ka n niŋ suhukpeeni n-sab gbaŋ ŋɔ ni n teei ya di yɛla. Naawuni ni niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ n ni la zuɣu.
en: But I have spoken to you plainly and have tried to remind you of some things. God treated me with undeserved grace!.

dag: Amaa Nuhu kɔŋko ka Yawɛ nini daa naɣ kul tiɣi.
en: But as for Noah, the LORD approved of him.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, m bi yu ni ninvuɣ biɛri kpi. Amaa m bɔri ni ninvuɣ biɛri niŋla tuuba ka be, dama yinim Izraɛlnima, bɔzuɣu ka yi lee yɛn kpi.
en: Say to them, This is what the LORD God says: As surely as I live, do I take pleasure in the death of the wicked? If the wicked turn from their ways, they will live. Turn, completely turn from your wicked ways! Why should you die, house of Israel?.

dag: Yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka simdi ni nir dee li zaa. Dina n-nyɛ: Yisa Masia daa ka dunia ŋɔ ni na ni o ti tiligila alahichinima; mani mi n-nyɛ alahichilana n-gari sokam.
en: This is a true saying, to be completely accepted and believed: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners. I am the worst of them.

dag: ka zaŋ ya tahi gomnanim mini nazuɣuri tooni n zuɣu, ka yi ti niŋ n shɛhiranima bɛ mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani.
en: They will haul you in front of governors and even kings because of me so that you may give your testimony to them and to the Gentiles.

dag: Ti Naawuni daalibarika nuu daa pa ti zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ Shɛrɛbia ŋun yi Mahili ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi bia ni Izraɛl yaaŋa zuliya ni na la ti ti. O min o dɔɣiriba ni o bidibisi kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisaayika.
en: Because we were favored by God, they brought us Sherebiah, a skillful man of the family of Mahli, Levis son and Israels grandson, together with his sons and relatives so that there were eighteen in total.

dag: Suhusaɣiŋgu paai Gazanima, ka Ashikɛlɔnnim fo. Yinim Anaki zuliya niriba bɛn kpalim ŋɔ, bɔ saha ka yi yɛn chɛ binyara zaŋ ŋmahiri yimaŋa?.
en: Great sorrow has come to the people of Gaza, and Ashkelon's people are silent. How long will the rest of Philistia mourn?.

dag: O kpee ka dunia ni, o nyɛla binnɛɔŋ ŋun bi zɔri dabiɛm.
en: No other creature on earth is so fearless.

dag: Dama kum daa mali ma, ka yi ti ma bindirigu; ka kɔnyuri daa mali ma, ka yi ti ma kom; n daa nyɛla sana, ka yi deei ma kpɛhi yi yinsi;.
en: I was hungry and you fed me, thirsty and you gave me a drink; I was a stranger and you received me in your homes.

dag: Ka Ɛhud daa yɛli ba, Doli ya ma, dama Yawɛ zaŋ yi dimnim Mɔabnim niŋ yi nuu ni. Ka bɛ daa dol o chaŋ ti gu so shɛli Mɔabnim ni yɛn doli gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, ka daa bi saɣi ka so doli nimaani du.
en: He told them, Follow me, for the LORD has handed over your enemies the Moabites. So they followed him, and they took control of the crossing points of the Jordan in the direction of Moab, allowing no one to cross.
