dag: Zaŋm anzinfa mini salima din nyɛ pin shɛŋa Hɛlidai mini Tɔbija ni Jɛdaya bɛn yi Babilɔn na la ni zaŋ ti la n-chaŋ Zɛfania bia Jɔsia yiŋa yomyom.
en: Take silver and gold from the exiles who came from Babylon, from Heldai, from Tobijah, and from Jedaiah. As for you, go that same day to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn mini ninvuɣ kɔbisita bɛn daa be o sani maa daa kana ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du m-biɛhiri bɛ dimnim maa naba, ka di daa wum ba pam.
en: After Gideon and his troops had chased the Midianites across the Jordan River, they were exhausted.

dag: Di yi kpe n-gari kpe m-be kaman munaafichilana a niriba sunsuuni, ka miri ka a yi n-zani a kpee nyɛvili yihibu zuɣu. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Do not spread lies about anyone, and when someone is on trial for his life, speak out if your testimony can help him. I am the Lord .

dag: mɔɣu ni mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni, maliya suhupiɛlli! Tihi din be nyɔŋ puuni zaa, yi gba yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila.
en: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yi di daa bi chɛ ka shɛb tiligi, ti tiŋ maa naan bemi kaman Sɔdom mini Gomɔra.
en: If the LORD of heavenly forces had not spared a few of us, we would be like Sodom; we would resemble Gomorrah.

dag: ka Mɛrayɔt nyɛ Zɛrahia bia, ka Zɛrahia nyɛ Uzi bia, ka Uzi nyɛ Buki bia.
en: Meraioth was the son of Zerahiah. Zerahiah was the son of Uzzi. Uzzi was the son of Bukki.

dag: Ka bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaata dali daa ti paai, dabisi shɛli dali naa zaligu maa ni daa yɛn tum tuma. Dindali maa ka Yɛhudianim dimnim daa tɛhi ni bɛ ni gari ba yiko ku ba. Amaa ka Yɛhudianim maa n-daa lee ti nyaŋ bɛ dimnim maa.
en: The thirteenth day of Adar came, the day on which the royal proclamation was to take effect, the day when the enemies of the Jews were hoping to get them in their power. But instead, the Jews triumphed over them.

dag: Di saha ka Pita daa siɣi ninvuɣ shɛb Kɔniilius ni daa timna maa sani ti yɛli ba, Mani n-nyɛ yi ni bɔri so maa. Ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-lee tahi ya na.
en: So Peter went downstairs and told them, Im the one you are looking for. Why have you come.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa daa garigi yɛli Dauda, N ka bɔrɔbɔro zim kpe, bɔrɔbɔro kasi n-naɣ beni; nachimba maa bɛn dee mini paɣiba yi bi dɔni, bɛ ni tooi ŋub li.
en: The priest said, I don't have any ordinary bread, only sacred bread; you can have it if your men haven't had sexual relations recently.

dag: Bɛ daa sabirila maligumaaniba mini bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi ni bɛ bibihi ni bɛ ninvuɣ gbaliŋ maa zaa yuya, dama bɛna n-daa ʒe yim ka mali bɛmaŋ kasi.
en: They were all registered together with their wives, children, and other dependents, because they were required to be ready to perform their sacred duties at any time.

dag: Ka o daa yi nimaani chaŋ Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu, ka daa ti yi nimaani lab Samaria.
en: Elisha left Bethel and went to Mount Carmel and from there he went back to Samaria.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N saha na bi paai; amaa yinim nyɛla bɛn kul mali saha sahakam.
en: Jesus answered, My time hasn't yet come, but your time is always here.

dag: ka chɛ ka o su binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi. Di yɛliya ni Naawuni daa zaŋ ninsala n-leei ŋun su binshɛɣukam fukumsi. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni shɛli kani ka Naawuni bi wuhi ni ninsal su li, amaa ti bi nya ka ninsal su binshɛɣukam zaa pumpɔŋɔ.
en: And you have put everything under our power! God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti je suli niŋ o, ka zo n-kul o ba yiŋ Bɛtilihɛm Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti niŋ chira anahi nimaani.
en: But his slave woman had an argument with him. She left him and went back to her fathers house in Bethlehem in Judah. She stayed there for four months.

dag: Ʒilinsi saha la ha Naawuni daa di ti suɣilo, amaa pumpɔŋɔ o zali shɛlikam zaa ni sokam niŋmi tuuba;.
en: God overlooks ignorance of these things in times past, but now directs everyone everywhere to change their hearts and lives.

dag: ka zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli she bantabiga mini zuɣupila, ka lan zaŋ tan piɛli viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli she jɛŋjɛŋŋmahi.
en: the turban of fine linen, the decorated turbans of fine linen, the linen undergarments of fine twisted linen.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, ti bi lan lihiri so kaman daadamnim ni lihir o shɛm; hal ti ni daa lihi Masia kaman daadamnim ni lihir o shɛm la, ti bi lan lihir o lala.
en: From this time on we dont think of anyone as the world thinks of people. It is true that in the past we thought of Christ as the world thinks. But we dont think that way now.

dag: ka sagbani maa zuɣu chɛ ka Maligumaaniba maa kɔŋ bɛ tuma tumbu, dama Yawɛ jilima n-daa pal o jɛmbu duu maa.
en: The priests could not continue their work because the Temple was filled with the Glory of the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ ba bɔhi ba, So dini ka o lee doli? Ka o bidibisi maa daa wuh o anab so ŋun daa yi Juda na maa ni doli so shɛli. Ka o yɛl o bidibisi maa.
en: The old prophet said, Which way did he go when he left? So the sons showed their father which road the man of God from Judah had taken.

dag: A yu zaɣ biɛɣu gari zaɣ viɛlli, ka yu ʒiri ŋmabu gari yɛlimaŋli yɛlibu.
en: You love evil more than good; you love lying more than speaking what is right. Selah.

dag: A kul moola a nini lihiri bɔri n shee kaman gbuɣinli la, ka lan tumdi tuma jɛndiri ma.
en: If I have any success and feel proud, you hunt me down like a lion and show your power over me.

dag: Vumiya miri Naawuni, ka o mi vu m-miri ya. Yinim alahichinim ŋɔ, paɣimiya yi nuhi; yinim tɛhaayiyinim ŋɔ, malimiya yi suhuri ka di be kasi.
en: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.

dag: dama o nyɛla Naawuni ni zali so a sɔŋsim zuɣu. Amaa a yi tum birigi, nyin zom dabiɛm, dama o bi sula fukumsi maa yoli; o nyɛla Naawuni ni zali so ni o zaŋ ŋun Naawuni suhuyiɣisili darigi bɛn tum birigi tibili.
en: It is Gods servant given for your benefit. But if you do whats wrong, be afraid because it doesnt have weapons to enforce the law for nothing. It is Gods servant put in place to carry out his punishment on those who do what is wrong.

dag: Miri ka a bɔhi, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka yuun shɛŋa din gari la so pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ? Dama lala bɔhigu pala yɛm bɔhigu.
en: Never ask, Oh, why were things so much better in the old days? It's not an intelligent question.

dag: Di tahigu maa nyɛla din yɛr o yɛla, ka niɣi gba mi ni saa kanna.
en: Thunder announces the approaching storm, and the cattle know it is coming.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Mɔabnim dindali maa, ka nya vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun pihinii.
en: That day the Israelites defeated Moab, and there was peace in the land for eighty years.

dag: ka ŋun pahi anahi nyɛ Mishimana, ka ŋun pahi anu nyɛ Jɛrimia.
en: Mishmannah fourth, Jeremiah fifth.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi, n ku lan di li naɣila di gbinni ti niŋ pali Naawuni nam ni.
en: I tell you, I wont eat it until it is fulfilled in Gods kingdom.

dag: Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi anabi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ Ɛlamnim polo Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia nam dibu piligu ni.
en: Not long after Zedekiah became king of Judah, the Lord told me to say: People of Elam, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will kill the archers who make your army strong.

dag: Ka do so yi mali bidibiga ŋun nyɛ tipawumlilana ŋun bi deer o ba min o ma noli, ka bɛ yi darig o tibili o ni bi deeri bɛ yɛligu zuɣu.
en: Now if someone has a consistently stubborn and rebellious child, who refuses to listen to their father and mother—even when the parents discipline him, he wont listen to them.

dag: A zuɣulaannim nyɛla tipawumlinim mini tayiɣisi zɔnima. Bɛ zaa yuri birapu dibu ni faɣiri dibu. Bɛ bi sɔŋdi kpibisi bɛ saria dibu ni, ka bi saɣiri ka pakoya zaŋdi bɛ yɛlimuɣisira kani bɛ sanna.
en: Your rulers are rebels and friends of thieves. They demand bribes and accept money for doing wrong. They take money to cheat people, and they dont speak up for widows and orphans. They will not even listen to their cries for help.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ bindiri shɛli din yi alizanda ni na maa. Di bi be kaman yi yaannim ni daa di shɛli ka kpi la, amaa ŋunkam di bindirigu ŋɔ dina, dilan ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: I am not like the bread that your ancestors ate. They ate that bread, but they still died. I am the bread that came down from heaven. Whoever eats this bread will live forever.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Yisifu, Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ daa yi n zuɣu Luz Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: Jacob told Joseph: God All-Powerful appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, where he gave me his blessing.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun be kasi, ka bi go ka mi bi puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa, bɛn yihim dilan n niriba ni, o ni bi mali Yawɛ sara maa di saha la zuɣu, ka o daalahichi kpalim o zuɣu.
en: But any persons who are clean and not on a trip, yet dont keep the Passover, those persons will be cut off from their people, because they didnt present the LORDs offering at its appointed time. Those persons will bear their sin.

dag: Ka n ni ti chɛ ka alahiziba tumtumsa tum zuɣusaa ha, ka wuhi shihira din nyɛ ʒim mini buɣim ni nyɔhi dunia tiŋgbani puuni;.
en: I will cause wonders to occur in the heavens above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and a cloud of smoke. .

dag: O bom ŋman ʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋman bih ayi na nti ti maligumaana Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni daba anii dali.
en: On the eighth day you shall bring two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the entrance of the Tent of the Lord 's presence.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daanya mali nyɔtaɣirisi zali di zaani, ka o zaŋ li niŋ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa ʒe n-guli nayili dunol la kpamba nuu ni.
en: King Rehoboam made more shields to put in their places, but they were made from bronze. He gave them to the guards on duty at the palace gates.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔb so ʒim kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili puuni nti yo alahichi samli luɣ kasi shee, di bi simdi ka so ŋubi di nimdi maa. Di simdi ni yi nyo li la buɣim.
en: But no purification offering can be eaten if blood from it is brought into the meeting tent to make reconciliation in the holy place; it must be burned with fire.

dag: Ka Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba daa wum o kum maa yɛla, ka chaŋ ti zaŋ o ti sɔɣi.
en: When Johns disciples heard what had happened, they came and took his dead body and laid it in a tomb.

dag: N ni kari ya n sani bahi kaman n ni daa kari yi mabihi bɛn nyɛ Ifriim zuliya la zaa bahi shɛm la.
en: I will drive you out of my sight as I drove out your relatives, the people of Israel. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa lihi nya Naawuni jɛmbu duu din nyɛ o shɛhira tanti jɛmbu duu m-be alizanda ni la, ka di yooi.
en: After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ din ni sɔŋ daadamnim bɛ dunia ŋɔ yili biɛhigu din bi yuura, ka ka buchi ŋɔ puuni? Bɛ nyɛviya chanimi gariti kaman shilinshia la. Dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli ba din yɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa?.
en: Because who knows whats good for human beings during life, during their brief pointless life, which will pass away like a shadow? Who can say what the future holds for people under the sun?.

dag: Ka Rubin daa bɔhi ba, N daa bi yɛli ya ni yi di niŋ bia maa shɛli? Amaa ka yi daa zaɣisi wumbu. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, o kubu maa biɛri m-bɔhiri ti maa.
en: Reuben spoke up, Didn't I tell you not to harm the boy? But you wouldn't listen, and now we have to pay the price for killing him.

dag: M biyurisi, ti suhuri yi bi wuhi ti ni ti mali galimi, ti ni mali suhukpeeni Naawuni sani.
en: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.

dag: Gol ŋɔ biɛɣ pinaanahi dali zaawuni doliya di kaya ni di zaligunim zaa soli m-puhi li di puhibu saha.
en: in the evening of the fourteenth day of this month and do it by following all the regulations.

dag: Mɛshɛzabɛl bia Pɛtahia ŋun daa yi Zɛra daŋ ni na, ka nyɛ Juda zuliya nir la n-daa nyɛ ŋun ʒe niriba zaani Pɛriʒia Naa sani saria dibu shee bɛ yɛlli kam ni.
en: Pethahiah son of Meshezabel told the people what the king wanted done.

dag: Ka chɛliya ka ti chɛ ka ti biɛhigu be dɛde kaman bɛn be neesim ni, ka pa ni bɛn tumdi yoliyoli bee n-nyuri dam kuuna. Ti miri ka ti tum niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma mini zina balibu kam. Ti mi miri ka ti bɔri zabili bee n-zabiri nyuli.
en: We should live in a right way, like people who belong to the day. We should not have wild parties or be drunk. We should not be involved in sexual sin or any kind of immoral behavior. We should not cause arguments and trouble or be jealous.

dag: Naftali ŋmanila walinyaŋ so ŋun gɔr o yubu, ka dɔɣi bi viɛla.
en: Naphtali, you are a wild deer with lovely fawns.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, pa Anabi Musa n-daa tin ya bindiri shɛli din yi alizanda ni na maa; amaa m Ba n-tiri ya bindiri maŋli din yiri alizanda ni na maa.
en: Jesus then told them, I tell you for certain that Moses wasn't the one who gave you bread from heaven. My Father is the one who gives you the true bread from heaven.

dag: Doo maa yuli n-daa booni Nabal, ka o paɣa mi yuli booni Abigeel. Paɣ maa daa viɛl pam, ka mali yɛm. Amaa ka doo maa ŋun daa nyɛ jɛrigu ka mali biɛm pam. O daa nyɛla Kalɛb daŋ ni nira.
en: This mans name was Nabal. He was from Calebs family. Nabals wife was named Abigail. She was a wise and beautiful woman, but Nabal was a mean and cruel man.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba pia la daa wum lala ka je suli niŋ Jeemsi mini Jɔn.
en: When the other ten followers heard this, they were angry with James and John.

dag: dama ŋunkam kul nyurila bihim nyɛla ŋun yɛm na bi goligi wuntia yɛtɔɣa puuni, ka o na kul nyɛla bia.
en: Anyone who has to drink milk is still a child, without any experience in the matter of right and wrong.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm Aduna jaaŋgbee maa labisi ti sɔŋ Alikauli Adaka maa tooni, ka di nyɛ shihirili duŋ taariba maa sani, ka a chɛ ka bɛ chɛ bɛ kparima ni ŋumdi niŋdi ma, di yi pa lala, bɛ ni kpi.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses, Return Aarons staff in front of the chest containing the covenant to serve as a sign to the rebels so that their complaints against me end and they dont die.

dag: Ka alizin birigu maa kuhi, ka lan yiɣisi bia maa pam ka naanyi zo ka chɛ o; ka bia maa be kaman o kpimi la hal ka sokam tɛhi ni o shiri kpimi.
en: The evil spirit screamed. It caused the boy to fall on the ground again, and then it came out. The boy looked as if he was dead. Many people said, He is dead.

dag: O daa lan bo sida dakuɣiri din ka kalinli, dama Sidɔnnim mini Taainim daa ʒi sida dakuɣiri maa pam na ti ti Dauda.
en: He also brought an endless supply of cedar logs from the cities of Sidon and Tyre.

dag: Bɛ daa bu o la paa ni o kpɛhi ma dabiɛm n-chɛ ka n tum alahichi lala niŋbu ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ saɣim n yuli, ka mali ma ansarisi.
en: He was hired to frighten me and to make me sin by acting in this way. Then they could give me a bad name and discredit me.

dag: Chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili din galisi la di ba.
en: Pour out your anger on them; let your indignation overtake them.

dag: Ka a noli mɔɣisibu ŋmani wain viɛlli din chani viɛnyɛliŋga. Dindina, n yuya ni wain maa paagi n yura maa n-zo n-tiɛli o naŋgbampiba min o nyina.
en: Your palate is like excellent wine ... ... flowing smoothly for my love, gliding through the lips and teeth.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim bɛn daa doli Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl mini Jɛshua kulina la: Sɛraya mini Jɛrimia ni Ɛzra.
en: These are the priests and the Levites who came up with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra.

dag: N yi ti ŋari zuɣusaa kɔsoya ka saa bi lan mira bee toli yi ti ŋubiri yi bimbilima bee n-chɛ ka alɔbo lu n niriba maa zuɣu.
en: Suppose I hold back the rain or send locusts to eat the crops or make my people suffer with deadly diseases.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli Ahija, Zaŋmi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la na. Dama din dali maa Izraɛlnim daa zaŋla Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa mali chaŋ.
en: Bring the ephod here, Saul said to Ahijah the priest.

dag: Ti wumya ni ti ni shɛb daa ka yi sanna nti mali yɛl shɛŋa doli ya ni yi niŋ, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi suhuri bi doya, amaa pa tinima n-wuhi ba lala maa.
en: We have heard that some who went from our group have troubled and upset you by what they said; they had not, however, received any instruction from us.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ifriim zuliya niriba daa kana ti bɔhi Gidiɔn, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa yɛn chaŋ ti tuhi Midiannim ka bi bol ti? Bɔzuɣu ka a niŋ ti lala? Ka bɛ daa galim o pam di zuɣu.
en: The men of Ephraim were angry with Gideon. When they found him, they asked, Why did you treat us this way? Why didnt you call us when you went to fight against the Midianites.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuya daa sabi pa binshɛŋa bɛ ni daa zaŋ tabili maa zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Hakalia bia Nɛhimia ŋun daa nyɛ gomna la, mini Zɛdɛkia ni.
en: Upon the seals are the names of Governor Nehemiah, Hacaliahs son, and Zedekiah.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni wuh a so shɛli a ni yɛn doli; n shiri ni wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka gul a.
en: The Lord says, I will teach you the way you should go; I will instruct you and advise you.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia alali nyɛla ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia o suhu ni, ka gunibu maŋli mi nyɛ suhu ni yɛla din nyɛ Naawuni Shia ni niŋdi shɛli, ka di pala niŋgbuŋ ni kɔŋko yɛla. Ka dilana nyari paɣibu la Naawuni sani, ka pa ni ninsalinim sani.
en: Instead, it is the person who is a Jew inside, who is circumcised in spirit, not literally. That persons praise doesnt come from people but from God.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa zo Izraɛlnim nambɔɣu ka niŋ ba nirilim; ka sɔŋ ba; o ni daa lo Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu alikauli shɛl la zuɣu ka o daa bi chɛ ka bɛ zaa kpi. O mi daa bi zaɣisi ba hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: but the Lord was kind and merciful to them. He would not let them be destroyed, but helped them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. He has never forgotten his people.

dag: Amaa ka Baanabas mini Pool bɛn nyɛ Yisa tuumba la daa wum lala ka dari tɔhi bɛ binyɛra, ka zo nti kpe salo maa ni kuhiri yɛra.
en: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, understood what the people were doing, they tore their own clothes. Then they ran in among the people and shouted to them:.

dag: Luɣimiya yi tiba wum ka kanya n sanna. Wummiya n yɛligu, ka tiligi. N ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛli din ku yiɣisi, ka niŋ ya nirilim shɛli n ni daa lo alikauli ni n ni niŋ Dauda la.
en: Listen closely to what I say. Listen to me so that you will live. I will make an agreement with you that will last forever. It will be an agreement you can trust, like the one I made with David— a promise to love him and be loyal to him forever.

dag: Yɛhudianima adiini kali soli dolibu puuni kɔsins ayɔbu daa ʒe nimaani bɛ ni paɣibu zuɣu, ka di zaa zaɣ yiniyini daa naan tooi deei ko guŋgɔna ayɔbuyɔbu bee ayopɔinpɔin.
en: At the feast there were six stone water jars that were used by the people for washing themselves in the way that their religion said they must. Each jar held about liters.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu ka niriba diri Naawuni daalikauli maa nyɔri, dindina ninsal yɛda niŋbu ka buchi, ka Naawuni daalikauli maa gba ka buchi.
en: For if what God promises is to be given to those who obey the Law, then faith means nothing and God's promise is worthless.

dag: Ka bɛ ni pam bɛn daa nyɛ bukpahinim laɣisi bɛ tabibi tumbu kundinim na nti nyɔri buɣim niriba maa ninni; ka bɛ daa mali di liɣiri laasabu ka di paai kaman ninvuɣ tusaanu dahin yini tuma yɔri.
en: Some of them had used magic. These believers brought their magic books and burned them before everyone. These books were worth about , silver coins.

dag: Ka shɛb yɛli, Ŋuna m-bala. Ka shɛb mi yɛli, Aai, o ŋman o mi. Ka omaŋmaŋ yɛli ba, Mani m-bala.
en: Some of them said he was the same beggar, while others said he only looked like him. But he told them, I am that man.

dag: Dinzuɣu, poloya ŋɔ zaa ni yi a min a yiŋnim zaa yinsi, ka lan yi a kpamba min a niriba zaa yinsi. Bɛ ni bela Nail Mɔɣili la ni kɔŋko.
en: The frogs will leave you, your houses, your officials, and your people. Theyll stay only in the Nile.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa po n suhuyiɣisili puuni yɛli, Bɛ kul ku nya vuhim shee n sani.
en: In his anger, God told them, You people will never enter my place of rest.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba suhugarigu, ka bɛ gbaag o bɔhibu yinoyino, Mani? Mani.
en: This made the disciples sad, and one after another they said to Jesus, You surely don't mean me.

dag: Di daliri zuɣu chɛ ka nayili tɔbbihi zaa mini bɛn zaa kpalim be kpe ŋɔ baŋ ni m be sarika ŋɔ ni la Masia zuɣu.
en: The whole Praetorian Guard and everyone else knows that Im in prison for Christ.

dag: Ka Tɔi ŋun daa nyɛ Hamat naa daa wum ni Dauda tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza min o tɔbbihi zaa;.
en: King Toi of Hamath heard that David had defeated Hadadezers whole army.

dag: n-zaŋ o ti sɔɣi omaŋmaŋ silig pal shɛli o ni daa yoli chib tampiŋ ni la ni; ka daa bilim kuɣ titali na ti yo di noli, ka ŋmaligi kuli.
en: and placed it in his own tomb, which he had just recently dug out of solid rock. Then he rolled a large stone across the entrance to the tomb and went away.

dag: Nyin ŋun daa chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ leei tiŋgban nɛli doya, ka wurim di tin kara, ka bi bahiri a ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb ka bɛ kuni la m-bala?.
en: Is this the man who destroyed cities and turned the world into a desert? Is this the man who never freed his prisoners or let them go home.

dag: Ka bihi daa ti var o pul ni ka o yɛli, Di yi yɛn nyɛ ŋ-ŋɔ n ni be? Ka o daa chaŋ ni o ti bɔhi Yawɛ nya.
en: But the boys pushed against each other inside of her, and she said, If this is what its like, why did it happen to me? So she went to ask the LORD.

dag: Shɔbal bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Alivan mini Manahat ni Ɛbal ni Shɛfi ni Onam. Zibiɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Aiya mini Ana.
en: Shobals family: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. Zibeons family: Aiah and Anah.

dag: Niriba daa chɛla vuri ka gbilisiri tibili guhiri n ni yɛn di ba kpamli alizam shɛli.
en: Everyone listened in silence to my welcome advice.

dag: Izraɛlnima, dindali maa, Yawɛ ni ti doli Yufretiiz Mɔɣili zaŋ hal ni Ijipti tintariga n-laɣim ya yinoyino kaman bɛ ni yihiri chi ka chɛri wurigu shɛm la.
en: On that day, from the Euphrates to the Egyptian border, the Lord will gather his people one by one, as threshing separates the wheat from the chaff.

dag: N ni zaŋ suhu palli tin ya, ka zaŋ shi palli niŋ yi ni. N ni yihi yi suhu din be ka kuɣili ŋɔ yi ni, ka zaŋ suhu balli niŋ yi ni.
en: I will take away your stubborn heart and give you a new heart and a desire to be faithful. You will have only pure thoughts.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua.
en: Then the Lord said to Joshua:.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ buɣ shɛŋa din daa be bɛ sani ka bɛ booni li Baalnim la mini buɣili Ashitarɔt labi, ka jɛmdila Yawɛ kɔŋko.
en: So the Israelites got rid of the Baals and the Astartes and worshipped the LORD only.

dag: Ka n jilima yi ti garita, n ni zaŋ a niŋ tampiŋ maa lɔŋni, ka zaŋ n nuu pɔb a hal ti gari naai.
en: As my glorious presence passes by, Ill set you in a gap in the rock, and Ill cover you with my hand until Ive passed by.

dag: Ŋuna n-zaŋ a min a mabihi bɛn zaa nyɛ Lɛvinim la mir omaŋa. Di zaa yoli ka yi lan bɔri maligumaanitali tuma gba?.
en: He has allowed you and all your fellow Levites with you to approach him. Yet you also seek the priesthood?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zali saha shɛl o ni yɛn niŋ li maa ka yɛli, Biɛɣuni ka man Yawɛ sa yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: The Lord has set the time for this to happen. He said, Tomorrow the Lord will make this happen in this country.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima mali nyɔtaɣirisi kɔbisita, ka zaɣ yini kam daa di salima din tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ata, ka o daa zaŋ di zaa niŋ Lɛbanɔn dakuɣuri yil la ni.
en: and three hundred smaller shields, each covered with about eight pounds of beaten gold. He had them all placed in the Hall of the Forest of Lebanon.

dag: N goonje kumsi leela fabila, ka n yua kumsi be kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kumdi kukoya.
en: My lyre is for mourning, my flute, a weeping sound.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinahi ni tusaanahi la daa zani nam ʒiishee la mini binnɛma anahi la ni kpamba la tooni n-yili yil palli. Ka so daa naan ku tooi bɔhim yilli maa m-pahila bɛn bɛn daa tiligi dunia ni la kɔŋko.
en: The , people stood before the throne, the four living creatures, and the elders; they were singing a new song, which only they could learn. Of the whole human race they are the only ones who have been redeemed.

dag: Dama biɛri bɔhibu saha mini binshɛɣukam zaa din daa sab zalila palibu saha nti yɛn bala.
en: This time of punishment is what is written about in the Scriptures.

dag: Amaa o yi wum di yɛla ka di niŋ daba yi ha, di nyaaŋa ka o ti yɛn zaɣisi li, dindina paɣ maa taali ni ʒi doo maa zuɣu.
en: But if he waits until the next day to stop her from keeping her promise, he is the one who must be punished.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun daa kpalim zani puu maa sunsuuni, ka bɛ zabi di zuɣu n-ku Filistianim maa, ka Yawɛ daa tiligi ba ni nasara dibu tital la.
en: he and David stood in the middle of the field, held their ground, and defeated the Philistines. So the LORD achieved a great victory.

dag: Ka n ku zo o bihi nambɔɣu, dama bɛ nyɛla pagɔrili bihi.
en: I will not show mercy to her children; they are the children of a shameless prostitute. She herself said, I will go to my lovers—they give me food and water, wool and linen, olive oil and wine.

dag: Saha paaya ni nyin Yawɛ niŋ shɛli, dama niriba saɣim a zaligu.
en: Do something, Lord ! They have broken your Law.

dag: So yi bi saɣi li, yin di chɛliya ka yi baɣa be o ni.
en: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa ʒi ma n-chaŋ mɔɣu ni Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, ka n ti nya paɣ so ka o ʒi biŋkɔb ʒiɛɣu zuɣu, ka Naawuni mɔbu yuya nyaɣim biŋkɔbigu maa luɣilikam, ka o mali zuɣur ayopɔin ni yila pia.
en: The Spirit took control of me, and the angel carried me to a desert. There I saw a woman sitting on a red beast that had names insulting to God written all over it; the beast had seven heads and ten horns.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa n-lihiri bɔri paɣisar viɛlli, ka daa ti nya Abishag ŋun daa nyɛ Shunɛm paɣisarili n-zaŋ o na ti ti naa.
en: They looked everywhere in Israel until they found a very beautiful young woman named Abishag, who lived in the town of Shunem. They brought her to David, and she took care of him. But David did not have sex with her.

dag: Dama a nyɛla tarimba ni sɔɣiri so sani; ka nyɛ nandaamba bɛn be nandahima ni ni sɔɣiri so sani. A sani ka bɛ ni be ka sanʒiɛɣu pɔhim ku tooi niŋ ba shɛli, ka wuntaŋ tulim gba ku paai ba. Putɔɣunim ni daa liriti niriba kaman kikaa saha sanʒiɛɣu la.
en: You have been a safe place for poor people in trouble. You are like a shelter from floods and shade from the heat when powerful men attack. They are like rain streaming down the walls that protect us from the storm.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya ni do so daa yi tɔb maa ni n-zo hal ni Shilo dindali maa, o daa dari tɔhi la o situra, ka kɔri taŋkpaɣu puɣ o zuɣu.
en: One of the men who ran from the battle was a man from the tribe of Benjamin. He tore his clothes and put dust on his head to show his great sadness.

dag: M mabihi, yi ni so yi ti birigi ka chɛ yɛlimaŋli la, ka so ŋmalig o labisi di ni.
en: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.

dag: Wari yi beni o suhu bi zɔhiri o yiŋnim zuɣu, dama o yiŋnim zaa yɛrila situr tibisa.
en: She doesn't worry when it snows, because her family has warm clothing.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yiɣisi dol o lab kul o yiŋa nti di bindirigu ka nyu kom.
en: So the man of God went back with the old prophet. He ate food in his home and drank water.

dag: Zuliya shɛb buɣili na mi n-fa o tiŋgbɔŋ Asiria naa nuu ni bahi?.
en: Were any of the gods of the other nations able to rescue their lands from the power of Assyrias king?.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mɔabnim yɛliya, Judanim kul bemi kaman zuliya shɛb ni be shɛm.
en: The Lord God said, The people of Moab thought Judah was no different from any other nation.

dag: Yawɛ kɔŋko ka m mali, ka a tiri ma n ni bɔri shɛlikam, ka n dahin shɛli ha biɛhigu yɛla zaa bela a nuu ni.
en: You, Lord , are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.

dag: Ka n daa ti yɛli piɛri maa, N ku lan nyɛ yi gula. Yi ni bɛn yɛn kpi, kpima; ka bɛn yɛn bahi yoli, bahi yoli; ka chɛ bɛn kpalim ka bɛ ŋmaligi ŋub taba.
en: Then I said, I quit! I will not take care of you! I will let those who want to die, die. I will let those who want to be destroyed, be destroyed, and those who are left will destroy each other.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa zaŋ o nuu pa paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba maa zuɣu, ka niriba maa daa lan nab pahi ka niŋ yaa.
en: So God treated the midwives well, and the people kept on multiplying and became very strong.

dag: Dama a mini mɔɣu ni kuɣa ni ti lo tab alikauli. Ka a mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ti be ni suhudoo.
en: for you will make an agreement with the stones of the field; and the beasts of the field will be at peace with you.

dag: Ŋun yi taali ni Naawuni sani kul ni bela yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, amaa o yi tiri gbini, n suhu ku piɛl o zuɣu.
en: My righteous people, however, will believe and live; but if any of them turns back, I will not be pleased with them.

dag: ni Shɛmaya ni Joyarib ni Jɛdaya.
en: Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah.

dag: Yawɛ, a nirilim niŋbu puuni, ka a daa ba ma zali kaman zo shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ la; a lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ma, ka dabiɛm gbaai ma pam.
en: Yes, Lord , while you were kind to me, I felt that nothing could defeat me. But when you turned away from me, I was filled with fear.

dag: Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ lala n-zaŋ talim Baanabas mini Sool ni bɛ ti ti cheechi kpamba.
en: They did this, then, and sent the money to the church elders by Barnabas and Saul.

dag: Ka Musa daa labi Yawɛ sani ti yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, niriba ma tum alahichi titali, dama bɛ zaŋla salima mali buɣili.
en: Moses returned to the Lord and said, The people have committed a terrible sin. They have made a gold idol to be their god.

dag: Amaa ka o daa bɔhi ŋun yɛl o lala maa, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ m ma, ka banim mi nyɛ a tizɔbihi.
en: Jesus replied, Who is my mother? Who are my brothers.

dag: Zaŋmiya bidib tuuli kam ti ma. Bɛ ni kul tuui dɔɣi binshɛɣukam ka o nyɛ zaɣ lɔɣu, ninsal bee biŋkɔbigu Izraɛlnim sunsuuni nyɛla n dini.
en: Dedicate to me all your oldest children. Each first offspring from any Israelite womb belongs to me, whether human or animal.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya ni, ninvuɣ tusaanahi ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: from Levi, .

dag: Dama n yi suhuri Naawuni tinzun yɛtɔɣ shɛl ni, n shia n-suhiri maa, amaa di ka buchi zaŋ chaŋ m milinsi polo.
en: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.

dag: Labimiya kuli, dama n kurigiya pam ni doo kulibu. Ka hal n yi tɛhi ni tahima na ni beni, ka kul doo yuŋ ŋɔ gba n-dɔɣi bidibisi.
en: You must go back home, because I am too old to marry again. Even if I got married tonight and later had more sons.

dag: O ni yɛn nyɛ Nazari nir dabisa shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa puuni, o miri ka o pini o zuɣu hal ka o ni wolig omaŋ ti Yawɛ saha shɛli maa ti gari. Di simdi ka o be kasi, ka chɛ ka o zabiri zooi wɔɣawɔɣa.
en: The hair of a Nazirite is sacred to me, and as long as you are a Nazirite, you must never cut your hair.

dag: Di simdi ni ŋun deeri wuhibu zaŋdi bin suma balibu kam tiri ŋun wuhir o.
en: Whoever is being taught Gods word should share the good things they have with the one who is teaching them.

dag: Pa a Naawuni zɔbo zuɣu n-chɛ ka a niŋ o naani? Pa a nimmaŋtali zuɣu n-chɛ ka a mali tahima?.
en: You respect God and live right, so don't lose hope!.

dag: Jɛra n-wuhiri bɛ suhuyiɣisili yomyom, amaa yɛnnim baɣa ka turi ni.
en: Fools reveal their anger right away, but the shrewd hide their contempt.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ ʒiɛmana din pahir anahi ni ka bɛ ni ti lab kpe na, dama Amɔrinim tuumbiɛri na bi galisi yaɣi.
en: The fourth generation will return here since the Amorites wrongdoing wont have reached its peak until then.

dag: ka di puuni zahim zaa kpi n-niŋ di kom maa ni ka di nyɔni, ka Ijiptinim kɔŋ li nyubu. .
en: The fish in the Nile are going to die, the Nile will stink, and the Egyptians wont be able to drink water from the Nile.

dag: n-ti Nɛria bia Baruk ŋun daa nyɛ Masɛya yaaŋa la, m mabia Hanamɛl mini shɛhiranim bɛn daa dihi bɛ nuhi dabu gbana maa zuɣu la ni Judanim zaa bɛn daa be guliba dundɔŋ maa ni ninni.
en: and gave them to Baruch, the son of Neriah and grandson of Mahseiah. I gave them to him in the presence of Hanamel and of the witnesses who had signed the deed of purchase and of the people who were sitting in the courtyard.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ pateesa maa yili bansi maa, ka zaŋ Alikauli Adaka la na ti zali di puuni, ka pateesa maa woligi luɣ kasi shee ka chɛ luɣ kasi zaa luɣ kasi shee la.
en: Hang the veil under the clasps, and put the chest containing the covenant there behind the veil. The veil will separate for you the holy from the holiest space.

dag: Amaa tinim kul ku nyu bara yaɣi di ni simdi ni ti nyu bara shɛm tariga; ti kul ni ʒiɛla Naawuni ni zali ti ni ti tum shɛm tariga la puuni hal ni zaŋ chaŋ yi gba sani.
en: As for us, however, our boasting will not go beyond certain limits; it will stay within the limits of the work which God has set for us, and this includes our work among you.

dag: O nyɛla tampiŋ ŋun ka ŋmali. O tuma nyɛla din viɛl zaa, ka o soya zaa nyɛ din tuhi. O nyɛla Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim ka ka galimi. O nyɛla ŋun bebu tuhi ka be tibi.
en: The Lord is the Rock, and his work is perfect! Yes, all his ways are right! God is true and faithful. He is good and honest.

dag: Ninsalinim pihiri kuɣa sɔŋda ni bɛ baŋ din beni, amaa Yawɛ kɔŋko n-zaan o ni bɔri shɛli.
en: The dice are cast into the lap; all decisions are from the LORD.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa zo ka chɛ bɛ buɣa, ka Dauda daa chɛ ka bɛ nyo li buɣim.
en: Then David ordered his troops to burn the idols that the Philistines had left behind.

dag: Naawuni gbaɣisi n tɔbu ka filim ma, lala zuɣu ka bɛ liri ma ka binshɛli bi gu ba soli.
en: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.

dag: n teei n nuu jɛndi ya, ka zaŋ ya ti zuliya shɛba kaman bɛ ni ŋme tɔbu di ninvuɣ shɛba, ka n ti kun ya niriba maa sani n-kpihim yi birili tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. N ni ti kun ya, di saha ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Because you did, I will hand you over to other nations who will rob you and plunder you. I will destroy you so completely that you will not be a nation any more or have a country of your own. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Yurilim saha beni, ka jɛlinsi saha beni. Tɔbu tuhibu saha beni, ka tɔbu tuhibu ni kani saha shɛli beni.
en: There is also a time for love and hate, for war and peace.

dag: Naa Dairus nam dibu yuma anahi saha, ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti anabi Zakaria, gol so ŋun pah awɛi la daba anahi dali.
en: On the fourth day of Chislev, the ninth month of the fourth year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord again spoke to me.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ ni shɛb nyɛla bɛn doli yɛŋkiŋkabina soli n-kpɛri yiya ni ti liriti paɣ shɛb bɛn yɔhimbu bi to, ka lan nyɛ bɛn daalahichi taali muɣisiri ba ka kɔre balibu kam mali ba niŋdi di yubu la.
en: Some of them go into homes and get control over weak women, whose lives are full of sin—women who are led into sin by all the things they want.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni m-baai du teeku duli kul o ya.
en: Boarding a boat, Jesus crossed to the other side of the lake and went to his own city.

dag: Di zaŋ a ŋmani nyɛvili niŋ mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛr la nuu ni; di tam a tarimba nyɛviya yɛla sahakam!.
en: Dont give us like a helpless dove to those wild animals. Never forget your poor, suffering people.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a ni kari Ohola mini Oholiba saria, ka yɛli ba bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa?.
en: The Lord said to me, Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then tell them about the terrible things they have done.

dag: Lab kul a yiŋa nti yɛli tuun kar shɛl a Duuma Naawuni ni tum ti a ŋɔ yɛla. Ka o daa chaŋ ti moli Yisa ni tum o tuun kar shɛli maa yɛla gili tiŋ maa zaa.
en: Go back home and tell everyone how much God has done for you. The man then went all over town, telling everything that Jesus had done for him.

dag: Amɔn yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam, o daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuma ayi.
en: Amon was years old when he became king, and he ruled for two years in Jerusalem.

dag: Hal ti nyari ka yɛnnim kpira, ka jɛra mini bɛn ka laasabu gba kpira. Bɛ zaa mi kpirimi n-chani ka chɛri bɛ daazichi tiri shɛba.
en: Anyone can see that even the wise die, as well as the foolish and stupid. They all leave their riches to their descendants.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi ba, Sal yi lee nya dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa ka ti kɔŋ o nyɛvili, nyɔ bɔ ka o lee di?.
en: Will you gain anything if you win the whole world but are yourself lost or defeated? Of course not!.

dag: Di saha ka nachin kpɛm maa daa yihi anzinfa mini salima binyara ni chinchina ti Ribɛka; ka ti o tizɔdoo maa min o ma gba nachiinsi binshɛŋa din liɣiri galisi pam.
en: The servant brought out gold and silver jewelry and clothing and gave them to Rebekah. To her brother and to her mother he gave the finest gifts.

dag: Yisifu daa bol o bidib kpɛm yul la Manaasa dama o daa yɛlimi, Naawuni chɛ ka n tam n wahala la zaa mini n dɔɣiriba yɛla.
en: He said, God has made me forget all my sufferings and all my father's family; so he named his first son Manasseh.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma chaŋ dunɔdali din daa kpa wulimpuhili polo la gbini.
en: The man took me to the gate that faces east.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa yɛli, Ami! Paɣimiya Yawɛ.
en: Bless the LORD, Israels God, from forever in the past to forever always. And let all the people say, Amen! Praise the LORD!.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni yɛri ya, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ni fan ya Asiria naa nuu ni bahi la, yi bi mi ni o yɔhindi ya mi ni kum ni kɔnyuri kun ya maa.
en: Hezekiah is fooling you. You are being tricked into staying in Jerusalem so that you will die from hunger and thirst. Hezekiah says to you, The Lord our God will save us from the king of Assyria.

dag: Nyini n-su zuɣusaa, ka su tiŋgbani gba; ka su dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni, nyini n-daa nam li.
en: Everything in heaven and earth belongs to you. You made the world and everything in it.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrɔbɔam paɣ maa daa yiɣisi kuli Tiriza. O ni daa kul mali ti kpɛri bɛ yiŋ dunol ni, ka bia maa dii leei Naawuni dini.
en: Jeroboams wife went back to Tirzah. As soon as she stepped into the house, the boy died.

dag: Ka n daa bahi noli ni bɛ vihim yɛlli maa, ka bɛ daa vihi n-nya ka kurimbuni ha zaŋ kana zuŋɔ tiŋ maa shiri nyɛla tin shɛli din bi zani tuhi nam fukumsi, ka duŋtaariba mini gadamanima n-kul pali di ni.
en: I gave an order for the writings of the kings before me to be searched. The writings were read, and we found out that Jerusalem has a long history of rebellion against kings. Jerusalem has been a place where rebellion and revolt has happened often.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa tim tuumba ni bɛ chaŋ ti gbaai Dauda na. Ka bɛ daa paai ti nya anab bɔbili, ka bɛ tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka Samuɛl nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana, ka Naawuni Shia daa siɣi Sool tuumba maa zuɣu na ka bɛ gba tɔɣis anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: So he sent some men to arrest David. But when they came to the camps, there was a group of prophets prophesying. Samuel was standing there leading the group. The Spirit of God came on Sauls messengers and they began prophesying.

dag: Juda bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Pɛrɛz mini Hɛzirɔn ni Karimi ni Hur ni Shɔbal.
en: These are some of the descendants of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

dag: Ka ŋmahi piɛlaa maa, ka paɣ o nyɔri min o biɛhi n-zaŋ li pahi nimdi maa mini binzuɣu la zuɣu.
en: Cut up the ram, wash its insides and legs, and lay all of its parts on the altar, including the head.

dag: Saha shɛli Rom naa ni daa zaŋ Gallio leei Akaianim gomna la, ka Yɛhudianim daa niŋ naŋgban yini n-chaŋ ti gbaai Pool n-vo o tahi saria karibu shee.
en: During the time that Gallio was the governor of Achaia, some of the Jews came together against Paul. They took him to court.

dag: Naawuni ni saɣiri ka suhusaɣiŋgu shɛli paari nir nyɛla din chɛ ka o niŋdi tuuba n-nyari tiliginsim, ka di pa din tahiri suhumiligibo na; amaa dunia ŋɔ ni chɛ ka nir nyari suhusaɣiŋgu shɛli nyɛla din tahiri kum na.
en: Godly sadness produces a changed heart and life that leads to salvation and leaves no regrets, but sorrow under the influence of the world produces death.

dag: Nini ku tooi yɛli nuu, A ka ma buchi; ka zuɣu mi ku tooi yɛli napɔŋ, A ka ma buchi.
en: So the eye cant say to the hand, I dont need you, or in turn, the head cant say to the feet, I dont need you.

dag: Yi zura, ka kuri niriba, ka niŋdi zina, ka ŋmari ʒiri pɔri pɔri, ka maani maligu tiri Baal, ka jɛmdi buɣ shɛŋa yi ni daa pun bi mi.
en: You steal and murder; you lie in court and are unfaithful in marriage. You worship idols and offer incense to Baal, when these gods have never done anything for you.

dag: A yi tum alahichi, Naawuni bimbɔ ka di yɛn pii? Ka a yi birigi bushɛm, bɔ ka di yɛn niŋ o?.
en: If you sin, that does no harm to God. If you do wrong many times, does that affect him?.

dag: Zalim Izraɛlnim ka bɛ bɔri olivi kpa viɛlli na nti niŋdi firila ni din ni chɛ ka firila maa kul ne n-ʒiɛya sahakam.
en: Command the Israelites to bring their best olive oil for the lamp that must be lit each evening.

dag: ka o zaŋ Makipɛla siliga din be o palo la tariga la ti ma yi ninni; ka n yo o di liɣiri ka di leegi n dini, ka m mali n kpiimba sɔɣiri nimaani.
en: to give me his own cave in Machpelah at the edge of his field. Let him give it to me for the full price, to be witnessed by you, as my own burial property.

dag: So mi ni yɛli, Bindirigu nyɛla puli dini, ka puli gba nyɛ bindirigu dini. Yɛlimaŋli, amaa Naawuni ni ti saɣim di zaa yim. Niŋgbuŋ bi bela kɔr biɛri tuma tumbu zuɣu; amaa di nyɛla ti Duuma dini, ka ti Duuma gba nyɛ niŋgbuŋ dini.
en: You also say, Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food. But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Siizaria ka bɛ zaŋ Pool ti zali Gomna maa tooni, ka zaŋ gbaŋ maa ti o.
en: They took him to Caesarea, delivered the letter to the governor, and turned Paul over to him.

dag: Ka yi ni ti be Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri yi yaannim sani ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti bɛ mini bɛ zuliya la ni yuui, di nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam.
en: that the Lord promised your ancestors and their descendants. It's rich with milk and honey, and you will live there and enjoy it for a long time.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa niŋ lala, ka daa bo niɣ ayi bɛn bihi na mɔɣiri na nti zaŋ tɔroko maa ga ba, ka zaŋ naɣibihi maa niŋ duu n-yo ba niŋ di ni.
en: The Philistines did what the priests and magicians said. They found two cows that had just had calves and tied them to the wagon. But they kept the calves at home in a pen.

dag: Ka Zabai bia Baruk daa niŋ nimmoo mali me gooni maa gɔŋbu shee yaɣ shɛli hal ti paai maligumaaniba zuɣulana Ɛliashib yiŋ dunoli shee m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Baruch son of Zabbai built the next section, as far as the entrance to the house of the High Priest Eliashib;.

dag: Di saha ka naazɔnim bɛn daa kul be o san la yɛl o, Naa, chɛ ka bɛ vihi nya paɣisara bɛn nyɛ paɣipiɛl viɛla na ti ti a.
en: Then the king's personal servants said: Your Majesty, a search must be made to find you some beautiful young women.

dag: Ka o daa ba buŋa chaŋ ti ŋmaligi zolɔŋni n-tuhi Dauda min o niriba maa soli ka bɛ kanna.
en: Abigail rode her donkey down to the other side of the mountain. She met David and his men coming from the other direction.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ku chɛ ka n ni yɛn chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli paai Jɛrusalɛm maa niŋ a ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni ka a nini nya li. N ni chɛ ka a ti yi dunia yili ni suhudoo. Ka tuumba maa daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa lab ti yɛli Naa Jɔsia.
en: So I will let you die in peace, before I destroy this place. The men left and took Huldah's answer back to Josiah.

dag: Di saha ka Ahimɛlɛk daa garigi yɛli, Naa, a sapashin kpamba ŋɔ ni ŋuni n-lee ʒe a yim kaman Dauda ŋun nyɛ nyin naa deemba, ka lan nyɛ a tɔbbi shɛb bɛn gul a sapashin kpɛma ni ŋun mali jilima a yili ŋɔ n-gari sokam la?.
en: Ahimelech answered, David is the most faithful officer you have! He is your own son-in-law, captain of your bodyguard, and highly respected by everyone in the royal court.

dag: Yɛl shɛŋa n ni pun wuhi ya la n-chɛ ka yinim mali zaa ka ka daɣiri ŋɔ.
en: You are already clean because of what I have said to you.

dag: Amaa m pun suhi Naawuni a zuɣu ni a yɛda di filim; ka a yi ti lan lab zani dɛde, nyin kpaŋsim a mabihi suhuri.
en: However, I have prayed for you that your faith wont fail. When you have returned, strengthen your brothers and sisters.

dag: Bɛ ni daa laɣim maa ka bɛ yihi Yisa tuumba ayi maa na nti zali bɛ sunsuuni m-bɔhi ba, Ŋun yiko bee ŋun yuli ka yi lee zaŋ tum yi ni tum tuun shɛli ŋɔ.
en: They made Peter and John stand before all the people. They asked them over and over, How did you make this crippled man well? What power did you use? By whose authority did you do this.

dag: Ka Ɛsta garigi yɛl o, Ti dim maa n-nyɛ Haman ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ. Di saha maa ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Haman naa mini Ɛsta tooni.
en: Esther replied, That evil Haman is the one out to get us! Haman was terrified, as he looked at the king and the queen.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yiɣisi dindali maa n-zo Sool sani kuli Gaat Naa Akishi sani.
en: So David left, fleeing from Saul, and went to King Achish of Gath.

dag: Ka n gbaai yila yilibu n suhu ni yuŋ, ka zaŋ n suhu sɔŋ tiŋa n-suhi Naawuni, ka bɔhi n suhu:.
en: Each night my mind is flooded with questions:.

dag: Ka Mɛnahɛm daa ti kani, ka o bia Pɛkahia di nam zan o zaani.
en: Menahem died and was buried with his ancestors. His son Pekahiah became the new king after him.

dag: Nyama, a pun wum Asiria naa ni pun niŋ tiŋgbɔna pam shɛm n-saɣim li zaa la yɛla. Ka a tɛhiya ni nyin ni tiligi?.
en: You yourself have heard what Assyrian kings do to other countries, wiping them out. Is it likely that you will be saved?.

dag: A mini Dɛdannim daa niŋdila wɔrinyaampara daabiligu.
en: The people of Dedan supplied you with saddle blankets.

dag: Naa, di gbinni m-bala. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli ni di yɛn niŋ a shɛm m-bala.
en: Your Majesty, this is the dreams meaning: It is the sentence of the Most High, delivered to my master the king.

dag: yi yi ni po Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ ni yi ni gbibi yɛlimaŋli, ka doli zaligu ni wuntitali, dindina o ni niŋ alibarika niŋ zuliya shɛb ni yi zuɣu, ka bɛ ti mal o nyuri bara.
en: it will be right for you to swear by my name. Then all the nations will ask me to bless them, and they will praise me.

dag: O ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga, ka a bol o yuli Yisa, dama o ni ti tilig o niriba bɛ daalahichi ni.
en: She will have a son, and you will name him Jesus—because he will save his people from their sins.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan Hilikia daa yɛli gbaŋŋmara Shafan, N nyala Naawuni zaligu kundi la Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni; ka daa zaŋ kundi maa ti Shafan ka o karim li.
en: While Shaphan was at the temple, Hilkiah handed him a book and said, Look what I found here in the temple— The Book of God's Law . Shaphan read it.

dag: hal ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm ti niŋ pali; ka Yawɛ yɛligu daa wuhi ni o ka taali.
en: until what he predicted actually happened, until what the LORD had said proved him true.

dag: Jɛhiɛl bidibisi ni, Zɛtam min o mabia Joɛl n-daa nyɛ bɛn su Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni Azichi fukumsi.
en: Jehielis family: Zetham and Joel his brother were in charge of the treasuries of the LORDs temple.

dag: Alibarika ni ti be yi tinsi ni mini yi puri ni.
en: He will bless you in the city and in the field.

dag: Zaŋmiya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali nina ka nyɛ zoomba la na, ka zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali tiba ka nyɛ tikpiranim la na.
en: God says, Summon my people to court. They have eyes, but they are blind; they have ears, but they are deaf!.

dag: Putɔɣunim muɣisigu lan ka nimaani; ka di ni wum shɛb la nya vuhim.
en: In the world of the dead, the wicked and the weary rest without a worry. *.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti Duuma, nyama, n-nyɛ takɔbir ayi! Ka o yɛli ba, Di ni saɣi.
en: They said to him, Lord, look, here are two swords. He replied, Enough of that.

dag: Lala ka yi ni shɛb daa be. Amaa ka Naawuni daa paɣi yi daalahichi bahi, ka mali ya ka yi be kasi. Ka yi leei wuntizɔriba ti Duuma Yisa Masia yuli mini Naawuni Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: Some of you were like that. But you have been purified from sin; you have been dedicated to God; you have been put right with God by the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka di simdi ni paɣ zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu malaikanim zuɣu, ka di wuhi ni so su o fukumsi.
en: On account of the angels, then, a woman should have a covering over her head to show that she is under her husband's authority.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa kpaŋsi Pool suhu ka o lo nia ni o ni doli Masidɔnia mini Akaia polo chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm; ka daa lan yɛli ni o yi paai Jɛrusalɛm, shee ka o gari Rom gba.
en: Once these things had come to an end, Paul, guided by the Spirit, decided to return to Jerusalem, taking a route that would carry him through the provinces of Macedonia and Achaia. He said, After I have been there, I must visit Rome as well.

dag: Niɣi mini bɛ ni booni biŋkɔb so bɛɛr la ni ti laɣim ŋubiri mɔri, ka bɛ bihi ti laɣim doya. Ka gbuɣinli ni ti ŋubiri mɔri kaman nahu la.
en: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young will lie down together, and a lion will eat straw like an ox.

dag: Ka Musa daa ti bɔhi alahichi sanyoo sara maligu bua la yɛla, ka nya ka bɛ pun zaŋ o nyo buɣim, ka o suhu yiɣisi bahi Ɛliɛza mini Itama bɛn nyɛ Aduna bidibisi bɛn daa kpalim maa zuɣu ka o bɔhi ba.
en: Then Moses asked about the male goat for the purification offering, and discovered that it had already been burned. He was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, Aarons remaining sons, and asked.

dag: Bɛ laɣindimi sɔɣiri dooni ni bɛ nya n ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa, ka maani tahima ni bɛ ku ma.
en: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.

dag: Gɛrishɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Leedan mini Shimɛi.
en: Gershon had two sons: Ladan and Shimei.

dag: Tins ayɔbu maa yɛn nyɛla Izraɛlnim mini saamba bɛn ʒi bɛ sani ni saan shɛb bɛn gariti tiliginsim tinsi, ka ŋunkam ku ninsala sarati kubu ni tooi zo n-kuli nimaani.
en: They will be places of protection for anyone who lives in Israel and accidentally kills someone.

dag: ni Hilikia bia Sɛraya ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛshulam yaaŋa la. O yaannim shɛba n-daa lan nyɛ Zadok mini Mɛrayɔt ni Ahitub ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan la.
en: Seraiah son of Hilkiah son of Meshullam son of Zadok son of Meraioth son of Ahitub the officer of Gods house.

dag: Ka Yisa daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro la ti ba, ka daa zaŋ zahim la gba pahi ba.
en: Jesus came, took the bread, and gave it to them. He did the same with the fish.

dag: Bɛ ninani biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛba anahi maa daa malila ninsal ninni bɛ tooni polo, ka gbuɣinli ninni be bɛ nudiriti polo, ka naɣilaa ninni be bɛ nuzaa polo, ka lan mali tɔrili ninni bɛ nyaaŋa polo.
en: Each living creature had four different faces: a human face in front, a lion's face at the right, a bull's face at the left, and an eagle's face at the back.

dag: Ka n daa lo nia ni n niŋ din ni ti ma nyaɣisim. Amaa ka di gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: I said to myself, Come, I will make you experience pleasure; enjoy what is good! But this too was pointless!.

dag: Yɛlimaŋ kpani kahigi wuhi dimbɔŋɔ puuni, ka man sani n nyaya ka di wuhirila Masia mini cheechi yɛla.
en: That secret truth is very important—I am talking about Christ and the church.

dag: Bɛna n-ni ti kpɛri n jɛmbu duu, bɛna n-ni ti kani n sara maligu bimbini gbini na nti tumdi n tuma, ka doli n zaligunima.
en: They alone will enter my Temple, serve at my altar, and conduct the Temple worship.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛli Gaad ni o yɛlim Dauda ni o cham ti me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ Aruna ŋun nyɛ Jɛbusi nir la kabɔɣili ni.
en: The Lord 's angel told the prophet Gad to tell David that he must go to Araunah's threshing place and build an altar in honor of the Lord .

dag: M bi paɣiri ya n ni yɛn wuhi ya wuhibu shɛli ŋɔ puuni, dama yi yi laɣim di bi sɔŋdi ya, amaa di naɣ saɣindi ya mi.
en: Now I dont praise you as I give the following instruction because when you meet together, it does more harm than good.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, dimbɔŋɔnim zaa taali ni ti ʒi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba zuɣu.
en: Believe me when I say that all these things will happen to you people who are living now.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka n daa yiɣisi n suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu bɛ ni daa ku niriba tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni mini bɛ buɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa zaŋ ta li daɣiri la zuɣu.
en: I let them feel the force of my anger because of the murders they had committed in the land and because of the idols by which they had defiled it.

dag: Yuria ni daa ka Dauda sanna, ka o ti puh o bɔhi Jɔab mini tɔbbihi maa zaa yɛla ni tɔb maa ni chani shɛm.
en: When Uriah arrived, David asked him if Joab and the troops were well, and how the fighting was going.

dag: Ka Jɔshua min o tɔbbihi daa yiɣisi Giligal lu soli n-gbaai chandi yuŋ hal ti kab ti liri ba libigi ba.
en: Joshua quickly attacked them, having come up overnight from Gilgal.

dag: Yawɛ bɔhiya, N di darigi bɛ tibili dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu? N di bɔhi zuliya ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo biɛri.
en: Give me one good reason not to punish them as they deserve. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa lan yɛl o ni Mɔdɛkai nyɛla Yɛhudia nir la zuɣu chɛ ka o lo ni pa Mɔdɛkai kɔŋko ka o ni ku. Dinzuɣu ka Haman daa bo soli ni o ku Yɛhudianim zaa bɛn nyɛ Mɔdɛkai zuliya m-be Naa Ahasivɛrɔs nam sulinsi maa ni luɣilikam zaa.
en: Haman had learned that Mordecai was a Jew. But he was not satisfied to kill only Mordecai. He also wanted to find a way to destroy all of Mordecais people, the Jews, in all of Xerxes kingdom.

dag: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ sapashin kpamba bɛn daa su tɔbbihi zaa la yi nti yɛli ba, Gbaamiy o tim tɔbbihi maa sunsuuni chaŋ, ka so yi dol o na, yin zaŋmiya takɔbi ku dilana. Dama maligumaana maa daa yɛliya, Di kuny o Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ puuni.
en: Jehoiada did not want Athaliah killed in the Temple area, so he called out the army officers and said, Take her out between the rows of guards, and kill anyone who tries to rescue her.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋun bia n-lee ni suh o bindirigu ka o zaŋ kuɣili ti o.
en: Would any of you who are fathers give your son a stone when he asks for bread?.

dag: Ka niriba maa garigi yɛli Gidiɔn, Ti ni zaŋ li ti a ni ti suhuri zaa. Ka bɛ daa teei binyɛrigu sɔŋ, ka sokam zaa zaŋd o ni ŋme n-di tibikpar shɛŋa na ti pari di zuɣu.
en: The people answered, We'll be glad to give them to you. They spread out a cloth, and everyone put on it the earrings that he had taken.

dag: So be yi ni n-nyari wahala? O suhimi Naawuni. So be yi ni m-mali suhupiɛlli? O yilimi yila paɣi Naawuni.
en: Are any among you in trouble? They should pray. Are any among you happy? They should sing praises.

dag: faashee m bo biɛhigu shee ti Yawɛ; biɛhigu shee din nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ dini.
en: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.

dag: Yi vinvam shɛŋa din mali kulim puuni zaa daa palila chɛchɛbunsi, ka wɔribariba ʒe dunɔdaya ni.
en: The fertile valleys of Judah were filled with chariots; soldiers on horseback stood in front of Jerusalem's gates.

dag: Di saha ka Bɔaz daa yɛli Rut, M bia, chɛ ka n nyih a, di lan chaŋ so puu ni nti yihi kayiha ka pa ni m puu ŋɔ ni. Kul be paɣiba ŋɔ sani kpe n-tumm a tuma.
en: Then Boaz said to Ruth, Listen, child. Stay here in my field to gather grain for yourself. There is no need for you to go to any other field. Continue following behind my women workers.

dag: Jaadai bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Rɛgɛm mini Jɔtam ni Gɛshan ni Pɛlɛt ni Ɛfa ni Shaaf.
en: Jahdais sons were Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

dag: Dunia niriba ŋmanila nooŋa tiɛɣu, ka n laɣim bɛ daazichi n-vaai li kaman nir ni vari gala shɛm la, ka so bi zaŋ o kpiŋkpaŋ gahi ma bee n-yaag o noli ni o chɛ n-kari ma.
en: I have conquered the whole world! And it was easier than taking eggs from an unguarded nest. No one even flapped a wing or made a peep.

dag: Di saha yɛlimaŋtali ni ti be tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka wuntitali mi ti be tiŋgban shɛli din vuhir ni.
en: Then justice will reside in wild lands, and righteousness will abide in farmlands.

dag: Ka m mi ni o zaligu nyɛla din tiri nyɛvili din ka bahigu. Dinzuɣu n ni yɛri shɛlikam nyɛla m Ba ni wuhi ma ni n yɛli shɛm.
en: I know that his commandment is eternal life. Therefore, whatever I say is just as the Father has said to me.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, N gba ni bɔhi ya bɔhigu, ka yi yi garigi m bɔhigu maa, m mi ni yɛli ya yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim maa zaa ni yi shɛl na.
en: Jesus replied, I have a question for you. If you tell me the answer, Ill tell you what kind of authority I have to do these things.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita daa chaŋ ti kpe ŋariŋ maa n-vo laŋ din pali ziŋ kara maa duna. Zahim maa kalinli daa nyɛla kɔbiga ni pihinunaata, amaa bɛ ni daa zooi shɛm maa zaa yoli, laŋ maa daa bi cheei.
en: Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net ashore full of big fish, a hundred and fifty-three in all; even though there were so many, still the net did not tear.

dag: amaa ka Pool ŋun daa bi tɛhi ni di luhiya ni bɛ lan ʒi ninvuɣ so ŋun daa zani Pamfilia ŋ-ŋmaligi lab ka chɛ ba ka bi doli ba paai bɛ tuma tariga la.
en: But on their first trip John Mark did not continue with them in the work. He had left them at Pamphylia. So Paul did not think it was a good idea to take him this time.

dag: Ka Barak yɛli Dɛbɔra, A yi ni doli ma chaŋ, n ni chaŋ; amaa a yi ku doli ma chaŋ, dindina n gba ku chaŋ.
en: I'm not going unless you go! Barak told her.

dag: Yɛlimaŋ kpani kahigi wuhi dimbɔŋɔ puuni, ka man sani n nyaya ka di wuhirila Masia mini cheechi yɛla.
en: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.

dag: Ka o daa zani kpiimba mini ninvuɣ nɛma sunsuuni, ka alɔbo maa chɛ.
en: This stopped the plague, and he was left standing between the living and the dead.

dag: Ɛlikana bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Amasai mini Ahimɔt.
en: Elkanahs sons were Amasai and Ahimoth.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Siɣimi ti zaŋ Aduna pah amaŋ zuɣu duna, amaa di chɛ ka maligumaaniba mini niriba maa kab ka man Yawɛ sanna, ka n suhu ti yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: The LORD said to him, Go down, and bring Aaron back up with you. But the priests and the people must not break through and come up to the LORD. Otherwise, the LORD will break loose against them.

dag: Bɛ ni gbib a bɛ nuhi ni ka a napɔŋ ku tuui kuɣili.
en: They will hold you up with their hands to keep you from hurting your feet on the stones.

dag: Nyin ka n kul zaŋ mmaŋ dalim n dɔɣibu saha hal ni wayo, nyini n-daa yihi ma m ma puli ni na. N kul ni paɣir a sahakam.
en: I have relied on you all my life; you have protected me since the day I was born. I will always praise you.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlimaŋli soli be ti katiŋa, ka din tuhi gba bi paari ti. Ti bɔrila firila, amaa ka zibisim n-gil ti, ti bɔri neesim, amaa ka bela bumbɔn ni.
en: Because of all this, justice is far from us, and righteousness beyond our reach. We expect light, and there is darkness; we await a gleam of light, but walk about in gloom.

dag: Hal Saimɔn maŋmaŋ gba daa niŋ yɛda ka deei kom baptaizibu; di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ omaŋ tabili Filip n-nyari shihira mini alahiziba tuun shɛŋa din daa niŋdi maa, ka di gar o pam.
en: Simon himself also believed; and after being baptized, he stayed close to Philip and was astounded when he saw the great wonders and miracles that were being performed.

dag: Yawɛ soli dolibu nyɛla gooni din mali kpiɔŋ bɛn biɛhigu be tibi sani, amaa di nyɛla din kuri ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: The Lord protects those who do right, but he destroys those who do wrong.

dag: Dabiɛm kpe Ziɔn alahichinim ka bɛ ni sɔhira. Ka bɛ yɛra, Naawuni saria karibo ŋmanila buɣim din diri sahakam. Ka ti ni ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tiligi buɣim maa ni.
en: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Those who do wrong shake with fear. They say, Can any of us live through this fire that destroys? Who can live near this fire that burns forever.

dag: Amaa chɛ ka a nuu pa ŋun be a nudirigu polo la zuɣu, ŋun nyɛ a ni ti so kpiɔŋ ti amaŋ la.
en: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.

dag: Ka Samsin bɔhi ba, Yi ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, M poya ni n ku chɛn ya, faashee ka m bɔhi ya biɛri labisi ka naanyi chɛ.
en: When Samson found out what they had done, he went to them and said, You killed them! And I won't rest until I get even with you.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka zuliya balibu kam nianim kpalindi yoli; ka lan chɛ ka bɛ ni lo nia ni bɛ niŋ shɛm zaani soli.
en: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.

dag: Ka bɛ dii mɔhiri vuri, ka ŋari bɛ tiba n-kabi chaŋ o sani.
en: Everyone there started shouting loudly, covering their ears with their hands. Together they all ran at Stephen.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti gbaag o nuu ni yiɣis o ʒili; ka o niŋgbun biisim maa dii maai, ka o yiɣisi niŋ ba saani.
en: Jesus went to her. He took hold of her hand and helped her up. The fever left her, and she served them a meal.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa wum ni o neei kum ni, ka Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la nya o maa, bɛ daa bi niŋ li yɛda.
en: Even though they heard that Jesus was alive and that Mary had seen him, they still would not believe it.

dag: Ka o daa zo n-chaŋ Saimɔn Pita mini nyaandol so Yisa ni daa yuri la sani nti yɛli ba, Bɛ yihi ti Duuma siliga la ni, ka ti bi mi bɛ ni zaŋ o ti sɔŋ luɣ shɛli.
en: She went running to Simon Peter and the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and told them, They have taken the Lord from the tomb, and we don't know where they have put him.

dag: ni oniɣisi kuɣa ni kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ pie taba binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la mini nyolɔrigu la zuɣu.
en: gemstones; and gems for setting in the priests vest and in the priests chest pendant.

dag: Ka miriya ka yi ŋmaligi n-jɛm binyoya din ka buchi, ka ku tooi tiligi ya ŋɔ, dama di ka buchi.
en: Idols are only statues—they cant help you. So dont worship them. Idols cant help you or save you. They are nothing!.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be o sani mini bɛ malibu na ka bɛ ti ʒini Hiburɔn fɔndi ni.
en: He also took his men and their families, and they settled in the towns around Hebron.

dag: Ka bɛ ni bɛn kpalim daa guui tiligi zaŋ kpa mɔɣu polo n-zo hal ni Rimɔn kuɣili la gbini. Ka bɛ daa ŋme n-ku bɛ ninvuɣ tusaanu sol ni. Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa na kul kariti doli ba hal ni Gidom ti lan ku bɛ ninvuɣ tusaayi.
en: When they turned back and fled toward the desert to the rock of Rimmon, the Israelites picked off another five thousand men on the main roads. And when they caught up with them at Gidom, they struck down two thousand more.

dag: ka zaŋ o ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni bɛ mal o ansarisi ka fiɛb o, ka kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu; amaa di daba ata dali, o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: They will hand him over to the Gentiles to be ridiculed, tortured, and crucified. But he will be raised on the third day.

dag: Di saha ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn min o daa chaŋ maa yɛli, Ti ku tooi tuhi niriba maa, dama bɛ mali kpiɔŋ gari ti.
en: But the other men replied, Those people are much too strong for us.

dag: Wummiya vuri! Wummiya, di kanna. Vuri pam n-yi nuzaa polo na ni di ti chɛ ka Juda fɔntinsi zani dabari, ka leei yɔbahi gɔbu shee.
en: Listen! News has come! There is a great commotion in a nation to the north; its army will turn the cities of Judah into a desert, a place where jackals live.

dag: Di nyaaŋa bɛ daa bi niŋ o daalikauli yɛda, ka daa ʒiɛm tiŋgbɔn viɛlli maa.
en: But then they refused to go into the wonderful land of Canaan. They did not believe that God would help them defeat the people there.

dag: amaa ka o yɛli ma, Di niŋ lala! N nyɛla a min a mabihi bɛn nyɛ anabinima ni bɛn dol litaafi ŋɔ puuni yɛligu la dab kpee. Jɛmmi la Naawuni.
en: But he said to me, Dont do that! Im a servant just like you and your brothers and sisters, the prophets, and those who keep the words of this scroll. Worship God.

dag: Ka Sɛt daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Ɛnɔsh. Di saha maa ka ninsalinim daa piligi jɛmdi Yawɛ.
en: Seth also had a son. He named him Enosh. At that time people began to pray to the Lord .

dag: Amaa ka yi daa zaɣisi ni yi ku wum n yɛligu, ka zaŋ yi nuhi tum tuma n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi tum yimaŋ barina. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But the Lord himself says that you refused to listen to him. Instead, you made him angry with your idols and have brought his punishment on yourselves.

dag: Niŋmiya saani ka kparima ni ŋumbu ka di puuni.
en: Open your homes to each other without complaining.

dag: Yi bo biŋkumda, ka ŋma yila kaman Dauda ni daa ŋma yila shɛm la n-yiini li.
en: You like to compose songs, as David did, and play them on harps.

dag: Ka din daa niŋ ba suhugarigu gari shɛlikam nyɛla o ni daa yɛli ba ni bɛ nini ku lan nya o la. Ka bɛ daa biɛl o tahi ŋariŋ gbini.
en: They were especially grieved by his statement that they would never see him again. Then they accompanied him to the ship.

dag: Dama bindirigu bi kpɛrila ninsal suhu ni, amaa o pul ni ka di kpɛra, ka gariti yira.
en: because it does not go into your heart but into your stomach and then goes on out of the body.

dag: A yi zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ, ka na kul gbib ba.
en: If you keep refusing.

dag: Yi daalahichi zaɣisibu moli mɔbu puuni bɛ na bi yihi yi ni so ʒim ku o.
en: You are struggling against sin, but you have not had to give up your life for the cause.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naa Sulemaana daa mali buni mini yɛm n-gari dunia ŋɔ ni nanim zaa.
en: King Solomon became greater in riches and wisdom than any other king on earth.

dag: N yi teei dahin shɛli ha yɛla, n suhu saɣindimi. Dina n-nyɛ: m mini salo ni daa yi doli chani Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka mani n-nyɛ bɛ toondan la. Bɛ mi daa yi nyɛla salo bɛn mali suhupiɛlli yiini yila, ka duhiri bɛ yɛhi m-paɣiri Naawuni.
en: Sorrow floods my heart, when I remember leading the worshipers to your house. I can still hear them shout their joyful praises.

dag: Nyɛvili wɔɣinli bela yɛm nudirigu ni, ka buni mini jilima be di nuzaa ni.
en: With her right hand, Wisdom offers long life—with the other hand, riches and honor.

dag: N ni ti yihi ya di puuni na nti zaŋ ya niŋ tinzunnim nuu ni, ka bɛ kari ya saria.
en: I will lead you out of the city, hand you over to foreigners, and execute judgments against you.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ salima pa di zuɣu, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: He covered it with pure gold and made a gold molding all around it.

dag: Paɣimiya ti Duuma ŋun kul gbib ti dabisili kam ŋɔ. Naawuni n-nyɛ ti tiliginsim.
en: Bless the Lord! The God of our salvation supports us day after day! Selah.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi daag o yihi bɛ tiŋ maa tariga nti zaŋ o tam bɛ tiŋ maa ni daa me n-tam zo shɛli zuɣu naŋgbaŋgbiriŋ ni bɛ daag o luhi zoli maa lɔŋni sa ka o kpi.
en: They got up and forced Jesus to go out of town. Their town was built on a hill. They took Jesus to the edge of the hill to throw him off.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa saɣim a zaligunima, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum a ni yɛli shɛm. Ti tum alahichi a sani, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka a chɛ ka nopoli yɛtɔɣa din sab a dabili Musa zaligu ni la di ti.
en: All Israel broke your laws and refused to listen to what you said. We sinned against you, and so you brought on us the curses that are written in the Law of Moses, your servant.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ bɛ ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb la pali zoya zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku ninvuɣ shɛb la ti lu a daboya zuɣu min a vinvama ni ni a kɔsoya ni.
en: I will cover its mountains with those who are killed. There will be dead bodies all over your hills, in your valleys, and in all your ravines.

dag: Ka Dauda daa gbahi wɔribariba tuhili ni kɔbisiyopɔin mini tɔbbihi bɛn chani tiŋa tuhi pisi; ka daa yihi chɛchɛbunsi kɔbiga yuri zali ka chɛ n-chihi wɔr shɛb bɛn kpalim zaa jila.
en: David captured seventeen hundred of his cavalry and twenty thousand of his foot soldiers. He kept enough horses for a hundred chariots and crippled all the rest.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmaligi ka chɛ dimbɔŋɔnim leela bɛn birigi yɛtɔɣ chɔɣima tɔɣisibu puuni.
en: Because they missed this goal, some people have been distracted by talk that doesnt mean anything.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kɔrigi Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛbil la goli so ŋun pahir ayi maa biɛɣu pinaanahi dali. Ka vi daa gbahi maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinima, ka bɛ daa mali bɛmaŋ kasi, ka zaŋ bɛ ni nyɔri sara shɛli buɣim la kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: They slaughtered the Passover lambs on the fourteenth day of the second month. Ashamed of themselves, the priests and the Levites made themselves holy and brought entirely burned offerings to the LORDs temple.

dag: Fɔntin shɛli ni niriba ni daa kul palila n-leei dabari maa! Tin shɛli din daa nyɛ tin titali niriba sani la nti be kaman pakoli maa. Tin shɛli din daa nyɛ nabipuɣiŋga fɔntinsi ni la leela dabili.
en: Jerusalem once was a city full of people, but now the city is so empty. She was one of the greatest cities in the world, but now she is like a poor widow. She was once a princess among cities, but now she has been made a slave.

dag: Di saha ka n daa ŋmaligi lihi ni n nya ŋun yɛli ma lala maa. N ni daa lihi maa, ka n nya salima firilatamdis ayopɔin.
en: I turned to see who was talking to me. When I turned, I saw seven golden lampstands.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa duhi Sulemaana pam Izraɛlnim zaa sani, ka lan chɛ ka o nam mali dariza pam gari na shɛb bɛn daa pun daŋ o tooni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa zaa.
en: The Lord made Solomon very great. All the Israelites knew that the Lord was making him great. He gave Solomon the honor that a king should have. No king in Israel before Solomon had such honor.

dag: Ka o nachin kpɛm maa daa yo bɛn daa yoli kana maa tumtumda dabisi munimuni yɔri.
en: The workers who were hired at five oclock came to get their pay. Each worker got one silver coin.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ mi niŋmi ni di chɛ ka di ni sab shɛm bɛ zaligu ni ni bɛ kul je ma la yol la niŋ pali.
en: This, however, was bound to happen so that what is written in their Law may come true: They hated me for no reason at all.

dag: Dama pagɔrili naŋgbampiba malisimi kaman shiri la, ka o yɛtɔɣa be polipoli gari kpam.
en: The lips of a mysterious woman drip honey, and her tongue is smoother than oil.

dag: di zaa yoli, a ni zaŋ ma bahi daɣiri ni, ka mmaŋmaŋ situra gba zaɣisi ma.
en: God would still push me into the slime pit, and even my clothes would hate to touch me.

dag: Bɛ ni ti dihi yɛnnim vi. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ ba chaŋ ka di gari ba. Bɛ ni zaɣisi Yawɛ yɛligu ŋɔ, yɛm bɔ ka bɛ lan mali?.
en: Your wise men have rejected what I say, and so they have no wisdom. Now they will be trapped and put to shame; they won't know what to do.

dag: Naawuni ni lo nia shɛli ni di saha ti paai ka o pal li la nyɛla ni o ti laɣim binnamda zaa luɣ yini: Binnamda bɛn be alizanda ni mini bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka Masia ti nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana.
en: This is what God planned for the climax of all times: to bring all things together in Christ, the things in heaven along with the things on earth.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ ni bɛ bari zana gbaag o o yɛtɔɣa puuni.
en: so they could catch him saying something wrong.

dag: Amaa ka Kalɛb daa chɛ ka niriba maa zaa fo baalim Musa tooni, ka o yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ yomyom ti deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒini; dama ti ni tooi nyaŋ ba.
en: Now Caleb calmed the people before Moses and said, We must go up and take possession of it, because we are more than able to do it.

dag: Ka Sool yɛli Dauda, A ku tooi chaŋ ti tuhi Filistia doo maa, dama a na nyɛla bia, ka o mi nyɛ doo ŋun pun tuhiri tɔbu o bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: No, answered Saul. How could you fight him? You're just a boy, and he has been a soldier all his life.

dag: Amaa ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi Naa Amɔn nyaaŋa maa zaa, ka zaŋ o bia Jɔsia leei naa zal o zaani.
en: But the people of Judah killed all the servants who planned against King Amon. Then the people chose Amons son Josiah to be the new king.

dag: Di pa shɛli bɛ ŋme n-dila nɛma, ka bɔri ni bɛ pir li tari taba; ka tɔbbia kam nya paɣisar yino bee bɛba ayi, ka Sisɛra nya chinchin suŋ, ka man gba nya nɛma maa ni yɛri zaɣ suma ayi ye.
en: Sisera and his troops are finding treasures to bring back— a woman, or maybe two, for each man, and beautiful dresses for those women to wear.

dag: n ni ʒe kɔbiliga ŋɔ gbini, ka paɣisar so yi ti kana ni o ti ŋɔŋ kom, ka n yɛl o, N suhir a, niŋm a koyuli ŋɔ ni kom biɛla ti ma ka n nyu.
en: while I am here at the well. When a young woman comes out to get water, I'll ask her to give me a drink.

dag: Man Yawɛ lan yɛli, So na ʒi n-zaŋ wain tiwal viɛla labi, amaa o naɣ zaŋdi li mi dooi wain. Dinzuɣu n gba ku bahi n niriba zaa yoli, n ni tiligi bɛ puuni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi ma.
en: The Lord says, When there is new wine in the grapes, people squeeze out the wine. But they dont completely destroy the grapes because the grapes can still be used. I will do the same thing to my servants. I will not destroy them completely.

dag: Malimiya m biɛhigu shee mini di puuni nɛma ka di be kaman n ni yɛn wuh a ka yi mal li shɛm.
en: Make it and all its furnishings according to the plan that I will show you.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni n-kul niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim tiri daadamnim sahakam.
en: God does all this again and again;.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: So yi ni tooi zaŋ bini buɣisi zuɣusaa bee n-vihi baŋ tiŋgbani puuni tanzahi ni nyɛ shɛli, di saha n ni zaɣisi Izraɛlnim bɛ ni tum tuun shɛŋa zaa zuɣu.
en: Can you measure the heavens? Can you explore the depths of the earth? That's how hard it would be for me to reject Israel forever, even though they have sinned. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Musa daa ʒini ni o mali niriba yɛla, ka niriba maa daa ʒe n-gili Musa asiba hal ni zaawuni.
en: The next day, Moses had the special job of judging the people. There were so many people that they had to stand before him all day.

dag: O ŋmɛri bɔbili din nyaɣisira pari kom zuɣu o nyaaŋa. So ni tɛhi ni kɔbulli maa ni nyɛla zabipiɛla.
en: and it leaves behind a trail of shining white foam.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o maani maligu tir o laŋ maa, ka zaŋdi pina tir o daasau maa, dama dina n-tir o azichi, ka chɛ ka o diri bindir viɛla.
en: His net helps him live like the rich and enjoy the best food. So the enemy worships his net. He makes sacrifices and burns incense to honor his net.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihitanaanu ni kɔbisinahi.
en: The total number of men counted from the tribe of Benjamin was .

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia chɛ ka suhudoo mini yurilim ni yɛda be ti mabihi la zaa ni.
en: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!.

dag: Ka tintariga maa ni lan kpuɣi ni n-zaŋ hal ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni, di tariga yɛn nyɛla Teeku Kpiŋ ni. Yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa mini di tintarisi din gil li m-bala.
en: then south along the Jordan River to the Dead Sea. These will be the four borders of your land.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Jɔnatan, Nyama, biɛɣuni sa nyɛla goli palli dabisili, ka di simdi ni m mini naa sa laɣim ʒini di bindirigu; amaa chɛ ka n chaŋ ti sɔɣi mɔɣu ni hal ti paai daba ata dali zaawuni.
en: Okay, listen, David answered Jonathan. Tomorrow is the new moon, and Im supposed to sit with the king at the feast. Instead, let me go and Ill hide in the field until nighttime.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa lan zaŋ o nuhi shihi o nina maa; ka zom maa lan neeg o nina lihi yaha, ka o nina maa dii neei zaa, ka o nyari binshɛɣukam viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Then Jesus placed his hands on the mans eyes again. He looked with his eyes wide open, his sight was restored, and he could see everything clearly.

dag: Jɔnatan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Pɛlɛt mini Zaza. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla Jɛramiil daŋ niriba.
en: Jonathan had two sons, Peleth and Zaza. All these were descendants of Jerahmeel.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan bi kɔri kɔbu saha, ka puri atam kpuɣibu saha yi ti paai o bi nyari shɛli.
en: Some people are too lazy to plant seeds. So at harvest time, they look for food and find nothing.

dag: Dama nyamiya, ŋuna n-nam zoya, ka nam pɔhim. O kahigi din be o suhu ni n-wuhi ninsala. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka yuŋ zibira. O nyɛla ŋun chani gindi dunia ŋɔ ni. O yuli m-booni Yawɛ, Naawuni ŋun nam binshɛɣukam zaa!.
en: I created the mountains and the wind. I let humans know what I am thinking. I bring darkness at dawn and step over hills. I am the Lord God All-Powerful!.

dag: Ka salo maa ni shɛb tahiri yɛri ni ŋ-ŋɔ nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ; ka shɛb mi yɛri ni ŋ-ŋɔ nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ. O ni daa bi tooi baŋ yɛlli maa zuɣu ni di naba maa zuɣu ka o daa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm Pool tahi tɔbbihi maa yiŋ na.
en: Some in the crowd shouted one thing, others something else. There was such confusion that the commander could not find out exactly what had happened, so he ordered his men to take Paul up into the fort.

dag: Ka Maika daa zaŋ Lɛvi zuliya nachimbil maa leeg o maligumaana, ka o daa kpalim be ŋun Maika yiŋa.
en: Micah chose him to be his priest. So the young man became a priest and lived in Micahs house.

dag: Yi ni zaŋ suɣilo n-niŋ ania gbibi n yɛligu maa zuɣu, n ni ti yihi ya muɣisigu shɛli din yɛn paai dunia ŋɔ nim zaa la ni.
en: Because you have kept my command to endure, I will also keep you safe from the time of trouble which is coming upon the world to test all the people on earth.

dag: Ka bua maa ni deei bɛ tuumbiɛri zaa ʒi n-chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka o ti zaŋ bua maa bahi mɔɣu maa ni.
en: So the goat will carry all the peoples sins on itself into the empty desert. The man who leads the goat will let it loose in the desert.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa paɣ maa dɔɣir so ni ti di nam. Ka lala naa maa ni ti chaŋ ti liri Siria naa min o tɔbbihi n-kab kpe bɛ sansan ni nti tuhi nyaŋ ba.
en: A branch from her roots will rise up in his place. Attacking the army, he will enter the walled fortress of the northern king. He will fight with them, and he will conquer.

dag: Yi yi ti paai Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni di leei yi fali shɛli yi ni yɛn su la ni, ka yi deei li su n-ʒini di ni.
en: After you have occupied the land that the Lord your God is giving you and have settled there.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka ninvuɣ so ŋun be nyam va naɣisaa maa tampiligim n-zaŋ li ti zali tiŋ tariga luɣ shɛli din be nyam, ka di nyɛ Izraɛlnim dini; ka bɛ mal li niŋdi kom din yihiri nir daɣiri ni la ni. Di nyɛla daɣiri yihibu sara.
en: A man who isn't unclean must collect the ashes of the burnt cow and store them outside the camp in a clean place. The people of Israel can mix these ashes with the water used in the ceremony to wash away sin.

dag: Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu, dama bɛ birigi n sani. Bahiyoli n-doli ba, dama bɛ zaɣisi ma. N naan tiligi ba, amaa ka bɛ beni ŋmarila ʒiri pari ma.
en: Trouble and destruction will be their reward for rejecting me. I would have rescued them, but they told me lies.
