dag: ka di be kaman taŋkpa balli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni n-chɛ ka bintɔra din puhigiri niŋdi yuma tɔri ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam zaa.
en: The ashes will turn to soot over the whole land of Egypt. It will cause skin sores that will break out in blisters on people and animals in the whole land of Egypt.

dag: Saha shɛli Yisa ni daa ti paai kaman yuun pihita, ka o daa piligi o tuma, ka niriba daa tɛhi ni o nyɛla Yisifu bia. Yisifu daa nyɛla Hɛli bia.
en: Jesus was about years old when he began his ministry. People supposed that he was the son of Joseph son of Heli.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ Sool tumtumda ka o yuli booni Ziba la daa be nimaani, ka bɛ daa bol o ti Naa Dauda ka o ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ Ziba? Ka o garigi yɛli, Naa, mani.
en: There was a servant from Sauls household named Ziba, and he was summoned before David. Are you Ziba? the king asked him. At your service! he answered.

dag: Fiɛbiga mini zuɣu ni kpahibu nyɛla din tiri yɛm, amaa bɛ ni chɛ bi so bahi, dihirila o ma vi.
en: Correction and discipline are good for children. If they have their own way, they will make their mothers ashamed of them.

dag: Dindina nir yi mɔɣi tampiligim di so. O suhu ni tɛha m-birig o maa, ka o ku tooi tilig omaŋa bee n-yɛli, N ni gbib binshɛli n nudirigu ni ŋɔ pala Naawuni.
en: How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods?.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua tuumba ayi maa daa yi zoya maa polo labina chaŋ ti du mɔɣili n-labi Nan bia Jɔshua sani n-daa ti yɛl o dinkam zaa niŋ ba.
en: Then the two men came back down from the highlands. They crossed the Jordan and came to Joshua, Nuns son. They told him everything that had happened to them.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn darigila Babilɔn naa tibili n-tabil o tiŋgbɔŋ kaman n ni daa darigi Asiria naa tibili shɛm la.
en: Because of this, I, the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, will punish King Nebuchadnezzar and his country, just as I punished the emperor of Assyria.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ka buchi ka naabu? Bee bɔ n-lee muɣisi ya ka yi na kul tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa?.
en: So why don't you keep quiet? What's bothering you?.

dag: Amaa ti paɣiri Naawuni ŋun tiri ti nasara ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu ŋɔ.
en: Thanks be to God, who gives us this victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!.

dag: N yi ti tim Aritimas bee Tikikus a sanna, nyin kpaŋm amaŋ ka n sanna Nikɔpolis, dama n loya ni m be nimaani kikaa saha.
en: I will send Artemas and Tychicus to you. When I send them, try hard to come to me at Nicopolis. I have decided to stay there this winter.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni ti chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm be kaman kuɣ tibisili la, ka zuliya shɛli niriba bɛn ti bɔri ni bɛ kpuɣ li ni nya yɛlli. Ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam ni ti niŋ naŋgban yini kana ni bɛ ti liri li.
en: But I will turn Jerusalem into a heavy stone that crushes anyone who tries to lift it. When all nations on earth surround Jerusalem.

dag: Kamiyana ti nya Yawɛ ni tum shɛm. Nyamiya o ni tum tuun shɛŋa ka di mali dabiɛm dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Look at the powerful things the Lord has done. See the awesome things he has done on earth.

dag: Ka o daa me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani, ka boli di yuli Ɛlbɛtɛl, Naawuni ni daa kahig omaŋ wuh o saha shɛl o ni daa yi o biɛli sani zɔri la zuɣu.
en: Jacob built an altar there and called it God of Bethel, because that was the place where God had appeared to him when he was running from Esau.

dag: N sabi yɛtɔɣa biɛla din be gbaŋ ŋɔ ni n-tin ya la Silvanus ŋun nyɛ n ni lihi so m mabia ŋun ʒe yim la sɔŋsim ni. M bɔri ni n kpaŋsila yi suhuri, ka lan yɛli ya ni dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daanfaani maŋli yɛla. Dinzuɣu ʒiɛnya di ni dɛde.
en: I have written and sent these few lines to you by Silvanus. I consider him to be a faithful brother. In these lines I have urged and affirmed that this is the genuine grace of God. Stand firm in it.

dag: dinzuɣu m Ba Naawuni ni zali ma nam shɛm, lala ka n gba zali ya nam.
en: So I give you authority to rule with me in the kingdom the Father has given me.

dag: Nyama, n Duuma NAAWUNI daa wuhi ma, ka n nya ka o namla toli ka bɛ galisi pam, bɛ ni daa chɛ nayili wɔrimɔri, ka mɔri maa lan piligi puhirina saha shɛli.
en: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: He was making locusts. This was at the time the second crop began to grow, after the kings people had cut the first crop.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la: Di yi nyɛla din to ni wuntizɔra tiligi, wula ka di ni be bɛn bi luri Naawuni sizuura mini alahichinim la sani.
en: If it is hard for even a good person to be saved, what will happen to the one who is against God and full of sin? Proverbs :.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ka nimaani na, bɛ ni yihi binyoya mini binshɛŋa din chihiri la zaa di ni.
en: When that happens, I want you to clear the land of all those idols I hate so much.

dag: M mabihi, ti bɔri ni yi baŋ Naawuni daalibarika din be Masidɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni cheechinim ni yɛla.
en: And now, brothers and sisters, we want to tell you what Gods grace has done in the churches in Macedonia.

dag: Yiliyiiniba daŋ ni: Ɛliashib. Dunɔguliba daŋ ni: Shallum mini Tɛlɛm ni Uri.
en: Of the singers: Eliashib. Of the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam niŋ yɛda mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: I am telling you the truth: he who believes has eternal life.

dag: Amaa ka o ba daa zaɣisi ka yɛli, M bia, m mi ni Manaasa gba zuliya ni ti galisi; amaa o tizo ŋɔ ni ti gar o, ka o zuliya ni ti galisi pam.
en: But his father said, Son, I know what I am doing. It's true that Manasseh's family will someday become a great nation. But Ephraim will be even greater than Manasseh, because his descendants will become many great nations.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa chɛ ka dɔr biɛri mini alɔbo dɔriti ni daa mali shɛb pam kpaŋ, ka kari alizin biɛri niriba zuɣu bahi, ka neei zoomba pam gba nina.
en: Right then Jesus healed many people of their sicknesses and diseases. He healed those who had evil spirits and made many who were blind able to see again.

dag: Pa ti ninni ka bindira maa zaa zani m-bahi yoli, ka suhupiɛlli mini nyaɣisim lan ka ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu?.
en: Our food is already gone; there's no more celebrating at the temple of our God.

dag: Gaad zuliya tiŋgban ni, bɛ ni daa yihi tin shɛŋa mini di momaha tiŋgbana ti ba n-daa nyɛ Ramɔt din daa be Giliad la mini Mahanaim ni di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: And from the tribe of Gad the Merarites received the towns of Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim, Heshbon, and Jazer, including the pastureland around them.

dag: O nina ŋmanila ŋmana bɛn ʒe kɔzɔrim noli, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ bihim paɣi shɛba.
en: His eyes are like doves by channels of water. They are bathing in milk, sitting by brimming pools.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka o yɛli Bɛtɛl bimbin la mini buɣa jɛmbu duri din be Samaria tinsi ni shɛm la shiri ni ti niŋ pali.
en: The message he gave by the LORDs word concerning the altar of Bethel and all the shrines in the towns of Samaria will most certainly come true.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Juda daa yɛli Onan, Zaŋm a biɛli pakoli maa dɔni, ka niŋ di ni simdi ni a niŋ shɛm wuhi ni o yidan tizo n-nyɛ a, ka zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ti a biɛli maa.
en: Judah said to Onan, Go to your brothers wife, do your duty as her brother-in-law, and provide children for your brother.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa piligi galindi tin shɛŋa nim bɛn daa nya o daalahiziba tuun kar shɛŋa o ni daa tum bɛ tinsi ni ka bɛ bi niŋ tuuba la.
en: Then Jesus criticized the cities where he did most of his miracles. He criticized these cities because the people there did not change their lives and stop sinning.

dag: Ka saa nyaɣisibu mini saa tahibu ni kukoya vuri pam yiri nam ʒiishee maa gbin na; ka buɣim mokpala ayopɔin din nyɛ Naawuni shih ayopɔin la sa nam ʒiishee maa tooni dira.
en: Lightning flashes and noises of thunder came from the throne. Before the throne there were seven lamps burning, which are the seven Spirits of God.

dag: Nir yi zɔri o taba dabiɛm, di nyɛla zana, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ Yawɛ naani ni yi yɛla ni.
en: It is dangerous to be concerned with what others think of you, but if you trust the Lord , you are safe.

dag: Noombihi bɛn gbahiri binnɛma dira bi mi di soli ni be shɛli, ka suligu nini na ʒi n-nya li.
en: Wild birds know nothing about the way to these places. No falcon has ever seen it.

dag: Ka di niŋ ba alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔtaa nira n-lee bɔŋɔ hal ka sanʒiɛɣu mini kɔgbana ti wumd o noli.
en: The men were amazed. They said, What kind of man is this? Even the wind and the water obey him.

dag: Amaa Ɛliɛza ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bidibisi ka kpi. O daa dɔɣila bipuɣinsi ko. Ka Kish ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ maa ni nir la bidibis daa kpuɣ o bipuɣinsi maa.
en: Eleazar had no sons, only daughters, and they married their uncle's sons.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ n-yihi ya kuriti nyɛligibu daaŋa ni na Ijipti ni yi ti leei omaŋmaŋ ni su ninvuɣ shɛba kaman yi ni nyɛ shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: But you are the Lord 's people, because he rescued you from Egypt, that fiery furnace.

dag: Adam daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pihita, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: and died at the age of .

dag: Ka Dauda daa fa Hadadɛza sapashin kpamba ni daa mali salima nyɔtaɣiri shɛŋa n-zaŋ li kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Hadadezer's officers had carried their arrows in gold cases hung over their shoulders, but David took these cases and brought them to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa suhi alibarika niŋ Firawuna ni ka yiɣisi kuli.
en: Then Jacob blessed Pharaoh and left from his meeting with him.

dag: Kika biɛɣu ni kum tiŋ ni, ka dabiɛm ku gbahi niriba? Yɛlibiɛɣu ni niŋ tiŋ ni, ka pa ni Yawɛ n-niŋ li?.
en: If a rams horn is blown in a city, wont people tremble? If disaster falls on a city, is it the LORD who has done it?.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa dii darigi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu ka yɛli, O mɔri Naawuni! Bɔ ka ti lan bɔri shɛhiranim ni ti niŋ yaha? Yi zaa wum o ni mɔri Naawuni shɛm.
en: The high priest then tore his robe and said, This man claims to be God! We don't need any more witnesses! You have heard what he said.

dag: N daa zaŋ tɔbbihi bɛn mali chɛchɛbunsi ni yuri n-kana ti ku ba. N daa ŋme ba luhi ka bɛ kɔŋ yiɣisibu. N daa pɔbisi ba mi bahi kaman bɛ ni pɔbisiri kpihiri firila mia buɣim shɛm la.
en: He led a mighty army to destruction, an army of chariots and horses. Down they fell, never to rise, snuffed out like the flame of a lamp!.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa lan lab gbi kɔbil shɛŋa bɛ ni daa pun gbi o ba Ibrahimma ʒiɛman ni la, dama Filistianim n-daa ŋar li Ibrahimma kum nyaaŋa. Ka Yisahaku daa zaŋ o ba ni daa zaŋ yu shɛŋa bol kɔbilisi maa la n-lan bol li.
en: Long before this time, Abraham had dug many wells. After he died, the Philistines filled the wells with sand. So Isaac went back and dug those wells again. He gave them the same names his father had given them.

dag: ka zaŋ bula yino mal alahichi sanyoo sara, ka di kpihim yi daalahichi.
en: You must also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin.

dag: Dinzuɣu, a yi yɛn tum shɛlikam, nyin tummi li ni a kpiɔŋ zaa; dama kpiimba biɛhigu shee din nyɛ a ni kuni luɣ shɛli maa, tuun shɛli bee tɛhi shɛli bee baŋsim bee yɛm ka nimaani.
en: Work hard at whatever you do, because there will be no action, no thought, no knowledge, no wisdom in the world of the dead—and that is where you are going.

dag: Fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa Naawuni ni daa zaŋ ti Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu ni o zaŋ ti Izraɛlnima m-bala.
en: These are the commands that the LORD gave Moses on Mount Sinai for the Israelites.

dag: Ŋun daa pah anii n-su chira anii ni n-daa nyɛ Sibɛkai ŋun daa yi Husha na ka nyɛ Zɛra daŋ ni nir la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: in the eighth month, Sibbecai from Hushah of the Zerah clan;.

dag: Dinzuɣu tɔɣisimiya ka niŋmiya kaman bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni ti yɛn zaŋ o zaligu shɛli din tiri yolisim la kari shɛb saria.
en: Speak and act like people who will be judged by the law that sets us free.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaana ti zaŋ o nubil tim alahichi sanyoo maligu ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li ti vie binyila din be bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu la, ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim bahi sara maligu bimbini maa naba zaashee.
en: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood of the animal, put it on the projections at the corners of the altar, and pour out the rest of it at the base of the altar.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ni bɛ laɣimmi Babilɔn baŋdiba zaa na ka bɛ ti wuhi ma zahindi maa gbinni.
en: Then I commanded every wise man in Babylonia to appear in my court, so they could explain the meaning of my dream.

dag: Leeban ni daa wum o tizɔpaɣ bia Yaakubu yɛla maa, ka o guui ka o sanna nti bɔb gbaag o m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ka zaŋ o kul o yiŋa. Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Leeban binshɛlikam zaa.
en: When Laban heard about Jacob his sisters son, he ran to meet him. Laban embraced him, kissed him, and invited him into his house, where Jacob recounted to Laban everything that had happened.

dag: N ni daa kul tɛhiri ʒii maa yɛla saha shɛli, ka n daa nya malaika ka o yi zuɣusaa siɣina. O daa nyɛla ŋun niŋ shili gu viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: While I was in bed, having this vision, a holy angel came down from heaven.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya. Naawuni daa zaŋ ba leeg o bihi ka chɛ ka bɛ mal omaŋmaŋ jilima; ka daa lo ba alikauli ka zaŋ o fukumsi zaligunima ti ba; ka daa wuhi ba o jɛmbu soli ka lo ba alikaulinima.
en: They are the people of Israel, Gods chosen children. They have the glory of God and the agreements he made between himself and his people. God gave them the Law of Moses, the Temple worship, and his promises.

dag: Ka o daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so di yɛla.
en: Then Jesus ordered them, Do not tell anyone about me.

dag: Bɛ niŋgbuna zaa sheei lu, ka nir ku lan tooi nya li, ka bɛ kɔba din daa bi tooi nyarila yina.
en: Their bodies waste away to nothing; you can see all their bones;.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa be bia maa sani hal ka o mali ti zooi. O daa bela mɔɣu ni n-daa ti leei tɔha ŋun mi piɛm tɔbu viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: God remained with the boy; he grew up, lived in the desert, and became an expert archer.

dag: Doliya n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani ni yi bihi sani yi kalinsi nyaaŋa sahakam, dama yi yɛn niŋdila din viɛl mini din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Observe and obey all these words that I am commanding you so that things always go well for you and your children later because you did what was good and right in the LORD your Gods eyes.

dag: O chanimi kahind o nimbihi ka mal o napɔna vuri tiŋa, ka mal o nubihi tirita.
en: winking and giving signals to deceive others.

dag: Amaa o bihi bɛn filim bɛmaŋ la lan pala o bihi. Bɛ bela ʒiri biɛhigu o sani. Bɛ nyɛla ʒiɛman golimanim bɛn biɛhigu bi tuhi.
en: But you lie and cheat and are unfaithful to him. You have disgraced yourselves and are no longer worthy to be his children.

dag: M mi yi wahala dibu ni yi fara yɛla, amaa yinima n-lee nyɛ azichinima. Ka lan mi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-jɛndiri ya, ka yɛri ni bɛ nyɛla Yɛhudianim la gba yɛla. Bɛ pala Yɛhudianima, amaa bɛ nyɛla Sintani jɛmdiba.
en: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.

dag: Ka bɛn daa lab kulina maa daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣu pinaanahi dali.
en: On the fourteenth day of the first month, the returned exiles celebrated the Passover.

dag: O daa pun daŋ timla ninvuɣ so ka o daŋ bɛ tooni. Dilana n-daa nyɛ Yisifu so bɛ ni daa zaŋ kɔhi ka o leei dabili la.
en: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt.

dag: ni Zif ni Tɛlɛm ni Biilɔt.
en: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth.

dag: Bɛ tuumbiɛri maa tirila naa suhupiɛlli, ka bɛ biɛriyoli maa tiri bɛ kpamba suhupiɛlli.
en: The Lord says, People deceive the king and his officers by their evil plots.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n kul kpaŋdi mmaŋa n-tumdi din tuhi ni di chɛ ka n ku mali galimi n suhu tɛha ni Naawuni mini salinim sani.
en: And so I do my best always to have a clear conscience before God and people.

dag: Ka a chɛ ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa ŋubi nimdi maa mini bɔrɔbɔro shɛli din be piɛɣu puuni la Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili ŋɔ dunol ni.
en: then Aaron and his sons are to eat it together with the three kinds of bread at the entrance to the sacred tent.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, M pun yɛli ya ka yi bi niŋ yɛda. N ni mali m Ba yuli tumdi tuun shɛŋa maa n-diri ma shɛhira;.
en: Jesus answered, I told you already, but you did not believe. I do miracles in my Fathers name. These miracles show who I am.

dag: Yawɛ tim a a ni tum shɛm maa laara. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni so baɣiri ni a ni kana ni a ti sɔɣ ŋɔ ni ti a laara din galisi.
en: The Lord will reward you for all the good things you have done. The Lord , the God of Israel, will pay you in full. You have come to him for safety, and he will protect you.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi biŋkɔbbaligu mini yi niɣi zaa chaŋ kaman yi ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka suhiya Naawuni daalibarika niŋ n ni.
en: You can even take your flocks and herds, as you asked. Just go! And bring a blessing on me as well.

dag: Amaa ka o kpee la daa tah o zuɣu ka bɔh o, A bi zɔri Naawuni? A bi nya ka bɛ bahi noli ni bɛ kum ti min o zaa?.
en: But the other criminal told the first one off, Don't you fear God? Aren't you getting the same punishment as this man?.

dag: Sabimi dimbɔŋɔ zali ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna nima, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ni na bi dɔɣi bi shɛba ti paɣi Yawɛ.
en: Future generations must also praise the Lord , so write this for them:.

dag: Ka naa daa chaŋ Giligal, ka Chimham daa dol o chaŋ; ka Judanim zaa mini Izraɛlnim pirigili gba daa zaŋ naa lu soli.
en: When the king had crossed, escorted by all the people of Judah and half the people of Israel, he went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went with him.

dag: Ka man Jɔn daa wum ka kukoli maa lan yɛli, Yinim alizanda ni nim mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda ni Yisa tuumba ni anabinima, maliya suhupiɛlli o dahimbu maa zuɣu, dama Naawuni m-bɔh o biɛri tin ya maa.
en: Rejoice over her, heaven—you saints, apostles, and prophets—because God has condemned her as she condemned you.

dag: N ni daa kana saha shɛl la, bɛ daa nyɛla biɛla; ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ yipa nabimi pam, ka n yi kul ŋmaligi kpa luɣ shɛlikam polo, Yawɛ niŋdila alibarika niŋ a ni. Amaa ka pumpɔŋɔ, bɔ saha ka man lee yɛn zaŋ wolim gbaai ti n yiŋnim gba.
en: When I came, you had little. Now you have much, much more. Every time I did something for you, the Lord blessed you. Now it is time for me to work for myself—it is time to do things for my family.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suɣilo tumdi din tuhi ka bɔri jilima mini paɣibu ni niŋgbuŋ din ku pooi la, Naawuni ni ti ti ba nyɛvili din ka bahigu;.
en: Some people live for Gods glory, for honor, and for life that cannot be destroyed. They live for those things by always continuing to do good. God will give eternal life to them.

dag: Yɛlimiya Amasa, A nyɛla n niŋgbuŋ mini n ʒim, zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, n yi bi zaŋ a leei n tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma n-zali Jɔab zaani, Naawuni ŋun niŋmi ma zaɣ biɛɣu, hal ŋun niŋmi ma zaɣ biɛɣu pam gba. .
en: And tell Amasa, You're my nephew, and with God as a witness, I swear I'll make you commander of my army instead of Joab.

dag: Binnɛma maa daa yi chana, kalima maa baɣi ba mi chana. Ka binnɛma maa daa yi wuɣi du zuɣusaa, kalima maa gba wuɣirimi du zuɣusaa.
en: Whenever the creatures moved, the wheels moved with them, and if the creatures rose up from the earth, so did the wheels.

dag: Dunia zuliya kam, paɣimiya Yawɛ. Zaŋmiya jilima ti Yawɛ ka wuhi ni o mali kpiɔŋ.
en: Praise the Lord , all people of every nation; praise the Lord s glory and power.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi zɔri nambɔɣu ti ku nya nambɔzɔbo saria karibu puuni; amaa ŋun zɔri nambɔɣu ni ti di nasara saria karibu puuni.
en: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful!.

dag: Firawuna ni daa mirina, ka Izraɛlnim maa daa lihi bɛ nyaaŋa n-nya ka Ijiptinim maa kani bɛ sanna, ka dabiɛm daa gbahi ba pam, ka bɛ kuhi pam niŋ Yawɛ.
en: When the Israelites saw the king and his army marching against them, they were terrified and cried out to the Lord for help.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa ti tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa be Gɛba la; ka Filistianim maa daa wum di yɛla. Ka Sool daa chɛ ka bɛ piɛb kikaa gili bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa m-mooni molo yɛra, Hiburunima, wummiya.
en: Jonathan attacked the Philistine fort at Geba, and the Philistines heard about it. So Saul sounded the alarm throughout the land and said, Hebrews! Listen up.

dag: Yaa ti Duuma ni ti Naawuni, nyini n-simdi tibigibu ni jilima tibu ni yiko malibu, dama nyini n-nam binshɛɣukam zaa, a yubu ni ka a daa nam li, ka chɛ ka di be.
en: Our Lord and God! You are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. For you created all things, and by your will they were given existence and life.

dag: Di saha ka o tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Bɛɔr bia Balaam daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ, Ninvuɣ so ŋun nyari viɛnyɛliŋga daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Balaam said: I am the son of Beor, and my words are true, so listen to my message!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa moli zaligu maa gili ni bɛ kum baŋdiba maa zaa, ka bɛ daa lihiri bɔri Daniɛl min o tab la ni bɛ ku bɛ gba.
en: King Nebuchadnezzars order to kill all the wise men was announced. The kings men were sent to look for Daniel and his friends to kill them.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa zaŋ kpa shɛli din kpalim be o nuu ni maa ʒe ŋun yi daɣiri ni maa zuɣu ni n-yo o daalahichi maa samli Yawɛ sani.
en: He will put the oil that is left in his palm on the head of the person to be made clean. In this way he will make that person pure before the Lord .

dag: Fam ma baɣiri firibu ni bahi. Tiligim ma n dimnim nuu ni. Tiligim ma kɔbulli ŋɔ ni.
en: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.

dag: A min a paɣa ni a bidibisi la ni bɛ paɣiba yim ŋariŋ maa ni na.
en: Go out of the ark, you and your wife, your sons, and your sons wives with you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Sool daa tim tuumba Jɛsi sani ti yɛl o, Zaŋm a dapala Dauda ŋun guli piɛri la ti ma na.
en: So Saul sent messengers to Jesse to say, Send me your son David, the one who keeps the sheep.

dag: Ka Pool daa siɣi nti kurim o sani m-bɔbind o ka yɛli, Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira, dama o na nyɛla nyɛvililana.
en: Paul went down to where Eutychus was, knelt down beside him, and put his arms around him. He said to the other believers, Dont worry. He is alive now.

dag: N ni tib n niriba maa, ka ti bɛn be yoma mini bɛn be katinsi zaa suhudoo. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will create reason for praise: utter prosperity to those far and near, and I will heal them, says the LORD.

dag: Ka naŋgbanyintali bɔ n-lee be Masia mini Sintani sunsuuni? Bee yɛdaniŋdiba mini bɛn pa yɛdaniŋdiba yɛla kpɛri tab ni?.
en: How can there be any unity between Christ and the devil ? What does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛtali yɛla n-kul yiri bɛ suhuri ni na, ka nia biɛri lɔbu yɛla kul be bɛ tɛha ni.
en: their hearts pour out evil, and their minds are busy with wicked schemes.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o ba tizɔpaɣ dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ba dɔɣira ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: or a sister of your father or mother.

dag: Nanim ni ti be kaman yi banim la, ka bɛ paɣiba bɛn nyɛ nanim be kaman yi manima. Bɛ ni ti damdi ya tiŋa ka lun ya sizuura. Ka yi baŋ ni mani n-shiri nyɛ Yawɛ; ka bɛnkam zaa guhiri n sɔŋsim ku di vi.
en: Kings will be like fathers to you; queens will be like mothers. They will bow low before you and honor you; they will humbly show their respect for you. Then you will know that I am the Lord ; no one who waits for my help will be disappointed.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, Bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili ma yurilim puuni, n ni fa ba bahi. Bɛn mi n yuli, n ni guli ba.
en: The Lord says, If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.

dag: Iso zuliya bɛn daa nyɛ nanima m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛ daa nyɛla Iso bituuli Ɛlifaz bidibisi. Bɛn daa nyɛ nanim maa n-nyɛ: Tɛman mini Omari ni Zɛfo ni Kɛnaz.
en: Esau and Adah's oldest son was Eliphaz, and the clans that descended from him were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz.

dag: A nyiŋgoli ŋmanila Dauda pii shɛli bɛ ni daa me di kulisi tam tab zuɣu ka nyɔtaɣirisi yiliyil li la. Di zaa daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiriba nyɔtaɣirisi.
en: Your neck is like the tower of David, round and smooth, with a necklace like a thousand shields hung around it.

dag: N ni zaŋ zalikpan shɛŋa zaa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, doliya li viɛnyɛliŋga, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi be ka nabi, ka chaŋ ti ʒini Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri lo alikauli n-zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim la ni.
en: Israel, do you want to go into the land the Lord promised your ancestors? Do you want to capture it, live there, and become a powerful nation? Then be sure to obey every command I am giving you.

dag: Ka o mini niriba maa gbaai saawara naai, ka o daa pii baansi shɛba ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ neen kasinim yɛna ti yili yila paɣi Yawɛ. Ka baansi maa daa gari tɔbbihi maa tooni ka ŋme kuŋ yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o yurilim bi naara.
en: After consulting with the people, Jehoshaphat appointed musicians to play for the LORD, praising his majestic holiness. They were to march out before the warriors, saying, Give thanks to the LORD because his faithful love lasts forever.

dag: O daa bi chɛ ka so niŋ ba fitiina, o daa daŋ kpahi nannim zuɣuri ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo.
en: But the Lord did not let anyone mistreat them. He warned kings not to harm them.

dag: O lan ka kpe, o neei kum ni. Teemiya o ni daa na be Galili ka yɛli ya.
en: He is not here; he has been raised. Remember what he said to you while he was in Galilee:.

dag: Ka maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa yɛli tɔbbihi bɛn yi tɔb maa na, Yawɛ ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Musa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Then Eleazar the priest spoke to the soldiers. He said, These are the rules that the Lord gave to Moses for soldiers coming back from war.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli bɛ tampiŋ bi be kaman ti Tampiŋ ŋɔ. Hal ti dimnim maa gba mi lala.
en: Even our enemies know that only our God is a Mighty Rock.

dag: Ishitɔn daa nyɛla Bɛtirafa mini Pasia ni Tɛhina ba, ka Tɛhina mi daa nyɛ Irinahash ba, bɛna n-nyɛ Rɛkanima.
en: who had three sons: Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. Tehinnah was the founder of the city of Nahash. The descendants of these men lived in Recah.

dag: N ni darigi dunia ŋɔ nim tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu, ka darigi ninvuɣ biɛri tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu. N ni siɣisi karimbaannim mini bɛnkam duhiri bɛmaŋa ni putɔɣunima.
en: The Lord says, I will bring disaster on the earth and punish all wicked people for their sins. I will humble everyone who is proud and punish everyone who is arrogant and cruel.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa ŋmaai Izraɛl zuɣu ni o nyoli kaman kpikpal tia wulli bee gbiŋgbaŋ la bahi dahin yini.
en: So the LORD cut off head and tail, palm branch and reed from Israel in one day.

dag: Di ti tumiya tuma, di nyɛla zaligu yi ʒiɛmani kam ni sahakam yi ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: You must not do any work! This is a permanent rule throughout your future generations wherever you live.

dag: Ŋunkam mini yɛnnim be leerila yɛndana, amaa ŋun mini jɛra be nyarila biɛrim.
en: Keep company with the wise and you will become wise. If you make friends with stupid people, you will be ruined.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Naa Agiripa mini Bɛɛnis di nachiinsi pam, ka bɛ mini sapashinnim mini tiŋ maa ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri daa chaŋ ti kpe bɛ laɣiŋgu duu. Ka Gomna Fɛstus daa tim ka bɛ ti zaŋ Pool na.
en: The next day Agrippa and Bernice made a big show as they came into the meeting room. High ranking army officers and leading citizens of the town were also there. Festus then ordered Paul to be brought in.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti kpɛri Jɛrusalɛm, tiŋ maa zaa daa dammi ka bɛ bɔhira, Ŋuni n-lee bala.
en: And when Jesus entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred up. Who is this? they asked.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini Izraɛl kpamba ni sapashin kpamba bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili fukumsi daa chaŋ Obɛdɛdom yiŋ ni bɛ ti zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: David, the leaders of Israel, and the army commanders were very happy as they went to Obed-Edom's house to get the sacred chest.

dag: Amaa ka a dabili nini daa ti moog o tuma zuɣu, ka doo maa zo n-tiligi. Ka Izraɛl naa maa yɛl o, A saria karibu ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala; dama amaŋmaŋ pun wuhi samli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Your servant got busy doing this and that, and the prisoner disappeared. Israels king replied, It appears you have decided your own fate.

dag: Buŋ maa ni daa nya Yawɛ malaika maa, ka o chaŋ ti tabili gooni n-zaŋ Balaam napɔnvaɣu sooi gooni maa; ka o daa lan fiɛbi buŋ maa.
en: When the donkey saw the angel, it walked so close to one of the walls that Balaam's foot scraped against the wall. Balaam beat the donkey again.

dag: Amaa man ni yɛlimi, Yawɛ, n tum alahichi a sani, zom ma nambɔɣu ka tib ma.
en: But me? I said, LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me because I have sinned against you.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa galim alikauli kurili ʒiɛmani maa ni niriba yɛli: Yi Duuma yɛliya, Dabisi shɛŋa saha kanna, ka n ni ti lo Izraɛlnim mini Judanim alikauli palli.
en: But God found something wrong with the people. He said, The time is coming, says the Lord, when I will give a new agreement to the people of Israel and to the people of Judah.

dag: Biŋkɔbiri kul yɛrigila mɔɣu ni; ka bindira kul zibigi vinvama ni, ka bɛ tahira, ka laɣim duhiri bɛ yɛhi yiini yila suhupiɛlli zuɣu.
en: The fields are covered with sheep; the valleys are full of wheat. Everything shouts and sings for joy.

dag: dama ti Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla buɣim din dira.
en: because our God is indeed a destroying fire.

dag: Manaasa zuliya niriba n-daa su Tapua tiŋgbani maa, amaa Tapua fɔŋ din daa ʒi Manaasa zuliya niriba tintariga la dina, Ifriim zuliya niriba n-daa su li.
en: The land around Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, but the town itself did not. The town of Tappuah was at the border of Manassehs land, and it belonged to the people of Ephraim.

dag: Ka niriba daa nya o, ka bo nachimba pihita n-chɛ ka bɛ kana ti be o sani.
en: When the Philistines saw what Samson was like, they told of their young men to stay with him at the party.

dag: Ka paɣ maa garigi yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, n Duuma, amaa ba shɛb bɛn do laa gbini diri bihi bindir burisa din luri tiŋa.
en: The woman replied, Lord, even puppies eat the crumbs that children drop from the table.

dag: Ka di nyaaŋa kɔr biɛri yi tiɣi pua, di dɔɣirila alahichi; ka alahichi mi yi ti bi zaa, di tiɣirila pua n-dɔɣi kum.
en: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.

dag: Wuntitali nyɛla din guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi, amaa alahichi nyɛla din bahiri ninvuɣ biɛri yoli.
en: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.

dag: Ka ti Duuma Yisa daa ti baŋ lala ka yi Judia labiri Galili.
en: Therefore, he left Judea and went back to Galilee.

dag: Ti lan wuhiri li ti biɛr kasi puuni mini baŋsim ni ni suɣilo dibu ni ni nirilim niŋbu ni ni Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yurilim maŋli ni.
en: By our purity, knowledge, patience, and kindness we have shown ourselves to be God's servants—by the Holy Spirit, by our true love.

dag: Salo maa ni daa yi n-naai, ka o kpe nti gbaai bipuɣiŋga maa nuu, ka o neei n-yiɣisi zani.
en: But after the crowd had been sent out of the house, Jesus went to the girl's bedside. He took her by the hand and helped her up.

dag: ka goli daa kpalim zani di jilima shee; a piɛma neesim din daa gariti yomyom la min a kpani din daa nyaɣisira la zuɣu.
en: The sun and the moon lost their brightness. They stopped shining when they saw your bright flashes of lightning. That lightning was like spears and arrows shooting through the air.

dag: ka zaŋ o nudirigu nubila n-tim kpa shɛli din be o nuzaa ni maa n-zaŋ mihi Yawɛ tooni buyopɔin.
en: and with a finger of his right hand sprinkle some of it seven times there in the Lord 's presence.

dag: Kɛdar peentɔriba bɛn nyɛ tɔbutuhiriba la ni ti kpalimla biɛla. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Only a few of the archers, the great soldiers of Kedar, will be left alive. The Lord , the God of Israel, told me this.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yɛli ni o paɣ Zara nyɛla o tizɔpaɣa. Ka Gɛra Naa Abimilɛk daa tim ti zaŋ Zara na.
en: Abraham said of his wife Sarah, Shes my sister. So King Abimelech of Gerar took her into his household.

dag: ka zaŋ suhudoo lahibal suŋ molo molibu leei namdanim piri.
en: On your feet wear the Good News of peace to help you stand strong.

dag: Ka nam ʒiishɛhi pisinaanahi gili nam ʒiishee maa, ka kpamba pisinaanahi ye binyɛr piɛla, ka pil salima zuɣupila n-ʒi nam ʒiishɛhi maa ni.
en: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.

dag: A yurilim maŋli nyɛla din du m-paai zuɣusaa; ka a ʒiɛyimtali mali hal ti paai sagbana.
en: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa taɣ omaŋ biɛhigu, ka taɣi binyɛr shɛŋa ye n-zaŋ niriba ayi pa omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ paɣ maa sani yuŋ, ka o ti yɛl o, Vihim nya n-ti ma, ka chɛ ka n ni yɛn boli ninvuɣ so yuli ŋɔ shia yina.
en: So Saul disguised himself; he put on different clothes, and after dark he went with two of his men to see the woman. Consult the spirits for me and tell me what is going to happen, he said to her. Call up the spirit of the man I name.

dag: Dama a tiligi ma kum ni, ka chɛ ka m bi lu ni di chɛ ka m be a tooni n-chani nyɛvili neesim puuni.
en: because you have rescued me from death and kept me from defeat. And so I walk in the presence of God, in the light that shines on the living.

dag: Amaa baŋmiya ni Yawɛ m-pii wuntizɔra ti omaŋa; ka n yi bol o, ŋun Yawɛ wumdi m boligu.
en: Know this: the LORD takes personal care of the faithful. The LORD will hear me when I cry out to him.

dag: Ka o daa ti be o buɣili Nisirok duu n-jɛmdi li, ka o bidibisi bɛn nyɛ Adirammɛlɛk mini Sharɛza daa zaŋ takɔbi ku o ka zo n-kuli Ararat tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka o bia Ɛsarihadɔn daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Later, while he was worshipping in the temple of his god Nisroch, his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer killed him with a sword. They then escaped to the land of Ararat. His son Esarhaddon succeeded him as king.

dag: nti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti ba, a ni daa lo bɛ yaannim alikauli ni a ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli din mali atam mini anfaani ti ba la.
en: You gave them this rich and fertile land, as you had promised their ancestors.

dag: Bɛ ni daa paai bɛ daa laɣimla Yisa nyaandoliba zaa ha n-yɛli ba Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka bɛ tum shɛlikam zaa min o ni daa mali soli ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka bɛ niŋ yɛda shɛm yɛla.
en: After arriving in Antioch, they called the church together. They told the people what God had helped them do and how he had made it possible for the Gentiles to believe.

dag: Yawɛ, n kul guhirila a tiliginsim, ka dol a zaligunima.
en: Lord , I am waiting for you to save me. I obey your commands.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa yɛli Rut, Pirigim a ni ye binyɛr shɛli pa zuɣusaa ŋɔ n-teei li sɔŋ. Ka o daa pirigi li na, ka o tooi chi ka di ni paai kaman kilɔgiram pisi n-kpaai niŋ o di ni, ka kpuɣi li sɔŋ o ka o ʒi li kuli.
en: Then he told her to spread out her cape. And he filled it with grain and placed it on her shoulder. When Ruth got back to town.

dag: ni Ɛdom ni Mɔab ni Ammɔnnim.
en: Then I went to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon.

dag: Ninni zaɣ yini daa nyɛla ninsal ninni, ka di ŋmaligi kpa abie tia maa ni be shɛli polo. Ka ninni din la mi nyɛ gbuɣim polli ninni, ka ŋmaligi kpa abie tia din la polo. Bɛ daa ŋme ba pala Naawuni jɛmbu duu dukpina zuɣu zaa gili.
en: One face was a mans face looking toward the palm tree on one side. The other face was a lions face looking toward the palm tree on the other side. They were carved all around on the Temple.

dag: Yi ni nya kpahimbu shɛŋa pam la zaa kpalimla yoli? Di yi shiri nyɛla yoli, m bɔri ni m baŋ.
en: Did all your experience mean nothing at all? Surely it meant something!.

dag: Bipolli, mali suhupiɛlli a bipolitali saha. Chɛ ka a suhu piɛl a bipolitali saha. Dol a suhu ni bɔri shɛm, ka niŋm a ni bɔri shɛm. Amaa lee baŋmi ni Naawuni ni ti kar a saria di zaa maa zuɣu.
en: Young people, enjoy your youth. Be happy while you are still young. Do what you want to do, and follow your heart's desire. But remember that God is going to judge you for whatever you do.

dag: Amaa di yɛliya tammɛriba zuɣulaannim maa ni bɛ malim bɛ ni di laɣ shɛli yi ni zaŋ ti ba maa laasabu n-wuhi ya, dama bɛ doli yɛlimaŋli soli bɛ tuma ni.
en: Dont count the money that you give to the workers. They can be trusted.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ nyama, biɛhiŋ kani, m mi ni a ni leei naa, ka Izraɛl nam ti nya zaashee zani a kɔbili ni.
en: Now I am sure that you will be king of Israel and that the kingdom will continue under your rule.

dag: Bɛ bela bɛ olivi tihi folinsi ni n-kahindi kpam, ka kahindi wain, amaa ka kɔnyuri kuri ba.
en: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.

dag: M bia, binshɛli din yaɣi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, nyin zom li. Litaafinim pam sabbu nyɛla din ka zanibu shee, ka bɔhimbu pam nyɛ din gbarigiri nira.
en: My child, I warn you to stay away from any teachings except these. There is no end to books, and too much study will wear you out.

dag: Nandan gbansɔɣu ni tooi niŋ bindirigu pam, amaa ka bɛn doli soli din bi tuhi fa li.
en: The poor might have good land that produces plenty of food, but bad decisions can take it away.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim ni bɛnkam zaa kpalim ka nyɛ bɛn daa yi Babilɔn labina maa daa yooi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Then the people of Israel—the priests, the Levites, and all the others who had returned from exile—joyfully dedicated the Temple.

dag: Ŋuna ka dunɔgula yoori dunoli tira; ka o boon o piɛri maa yuya ka be bɛ tooni, ka piɛri maa wumd o boligu ka dol o.
en: The guard at the gate opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

dag: Bɛ ni me goon shɛŋa din du ka mali yaa taɣi bɛmaŋ la zaa ni kab lu tiŋ dahim zaa.
en: He will destroy their high walls and safe places. He will throw them down into the dust on the ground.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ Yisa ni kahig omaŋa wuhi o nyaandoliba m-pahi siɣim buta o kum ni neebu la nyaaŋa.
en: This was now the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from the dead.

dag: Asiria beni, ka di tɔbbihi zaa gbala gil li, takɔbiri ka bɛ daa zaŋ ku bɛ zaa.
en: Assyria is there, and all its assembly round about his grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword.

dag: Nyin gba mir o, dama o daa chihi ti yɛligu pam.
en: But watch out for him, because he opposes our teaching.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii yiɣisi di saha maa lab Jɛrusalɛm nti nya ka Yisa tuumba piniyini maa mini ninvuɣ shɛb laɣim ʒiya.
en: They got up right then and returned to Jerusalem. They found the eleven and their companions gathered together.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ baŋ ni o bi yɛri ba mi ni bɛ miri bɔrɔbɔro dabindi, amaa ni Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim wuhibu yɛla ka o yɛri maa.
en: Then the followers understood what Jesus meant. He was not telling them to guard against the yeast used in bread. He was telling them to guard against the teaching of the Pharisees and the Sadducees.

dag: Bɛ suhuri kul yɛla yi zuɣu, ka bɛ suhiri Naawuni tiri ya Naawuni daalibarika din galisi pam yi ni la zuɣu.
en: And so with deep affection they will pray for you because of the extraordinary grace God has shown you.

dag: Zuliya kam nanim laɣim pahi Ibrahimma Naawuni la niriba zuɣu. Naawuni n-su dunia ŋɔ yiko zaa. Ŋuna n-simdi duhibu pam.
en: The leaders of all people are gathered with the people of Abrahams God because the earths guardians belong to God; God is exalted beyond all.

dag: Yi lan wum ka di pun sab yɛli kurimbuni ha, Miri ka a yi a pɔri nyaaŋa, amaa niŋmila a ni pɔ pɔri ni a niŋ shɛli maa ti ti Duuma.
en: You know our ancestors were told, Don't use the Lord's name to make a promise unless you are going to keep it.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa be Dauda sani Pasidamim saha shɛli Filistianim ni daa lo tɔb na ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnim chi puu ni ka Izraɛlnim ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ ba la.
en: During a battle against the Philistines at Pas-Dammim, all the Israelite soldiers ran away.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali Yisa chani maa ka Sairiini do so ŋun yuli daa booni Saimɔn yi tinshee garita, ka bɛ gbaag o nti zaŋ Yisa dapulli maa ʒil o ni o ʒi li doli Yisa.
en: As Jesus was being led away, some soldiers grabbed hold of a man named Simon who was from Cyrene. He was coming in from the fields, but they put the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi n-kɔri ba ti alizinnima.
en: They sacrificed their own sons and daughters to demons!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Dum Abarim zoya din pie tab ŋɔ zuɣu ti nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim maa.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Go up the Abarim Mountains and look out over the land that I am giving to the Israelites.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa boli Musa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni n-yɛl o:.
en: Then the LORD called to Moses and said to him from the meeting tent.

dag: Amaa bɛ gul maa yi nya ka tɔbu kanna, ka o bi piɛbi kikaa maa, ka niriba maa bi baŋ ka tɔbu maa di ba, bɛ daalahichi zuɣu ka tɔbu maa di ba maa, amaa n ni zaŋ bɛ kum maa taali ʒilila bɛ gula maa.
en: But suppose the person watching fails to sound the warning signal. The enemy will attack and kill some of the sinful people in that country, and I, the Lord , will hold that person responsible for their death.

dag: Gɛrishɔn daŋ niriba ni daa deei fɔntin shɛŋa zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila tinsi pinaata m-pahi di zaa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee zuɣu.
en: The various families of the clan of Gershon received a total of thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

dag: Yi yi po pɔri ni yi niŋ shɛli ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, yin di pihigi di palibu, dama biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni bɔhi di niŋbu yɛla yi sani ka di chɛ ka yi ku tum taali.
en: When you make a promise to the LORD your God, dont put off making good on it, because the LORD your God will certainly be expecting it from you; delaying would make you guilty.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lan nya malaika so ŋun mali yiko pam ka o yi zuɣusaa siɣirina ka zaŋ sagbani n-ye kaman chinchin la, ka sagani booi gil o zuɣu, ka o ninni be kaman wuntaŋa, ka o biɛhi mi be kaman buɣim zilima la.
en: Then I saw another powerful angel coming down from heaven. The angel was dressed in a cloud. He had a rainbow around his head. The angels face was like the sun, and his legs were like poles of fire.

dag: Lala ka o daa niŋ me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa naai, ka zaŋ sida dapuhi mini di dapaɣa n-siili li.
en: Solomon finished building the main part of the Temple and then covered it inside with cedar boards.

dag: Jɛrimia ni daa yi Tɔfɛt din nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o ni o chaŋ ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa luɣ shɛli maa labina, o daa zanila Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔŋ ni yɛli niriba.
en: Then I left Topheth, where the Lord had sent me to proclaim his message. I went and stood in the court of the Temple and told all the people.

dag: Yɛlim ba yaha, Yi yi ti yihi zaɣ viɛla maa zaka di ni, yinim Lɛvinim yin zaŋmiya din kpalim kaman kabɔɣili ni chi bee wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili ni wain zaka la.
en: You will say to them: When you have presented the best portion, it will be considered for the Levites equivalent to the produce of the grain and the produce of the winepress.

dag: Musa daa ti tim tuumba Ɛdom naa sani, ka bɛ yi Kadɛshi chaŋ ti yɛl o, A mabihi Izraɛlnim ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A mi wahala shɛli ti ni pun nya zaa yɛla.
en: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom. They said, This message is from your kinsmen, the tribes of Israel. You know the hardships we have suffered.

dag: Yawɛ maŋmaŋ tarili nyɛla o niriba. Yaakubu n-nyɛ o tarili.
en: but the Lord himself takes care of Israel.

dag: Ka Omri daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Samaria; ka o bia Ɛhab daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Omri died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Ahab succeeded him as king.

dag: Ka zom maa ʒiʒiinitab mini bɛn daa pun mi ka o nyɛ barimaana la ti bɔhira, Pa doo ŋɔ n-yi ʒiya maani bara la.
en: The mans neighbors and those who used to see him when he was a beggar said, Isnt this the man who used to sit and beg.

dag: Ka di sabi yɛli, Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka doo ŋmaligir o ba min o ma sani n-zaŋd omaŋ tabind o paɣa, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa be kaman ninvuɣ yino la.
en: And God said, That is why a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife. And the two people will become one.

dag: Ka Atalia bia Jɛshaya daa nyɛ Ɛlam daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba pisopɔin daa pah o zuɣu.
en: of Elam, Jeshaiah, Athaliahs son and with him men.

dag: Amaa ka Hɛshibɔn naa Sihɔn daa bi saɣi ni ti gari, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa chɛ ka o suhu kpaŋ ka o niŋ tipawumli maa ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ o niŋ yi nuu ni kaman o ni niŋ shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him.

dag: Ka di wulinluhili polo daa mali pateesanim din wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka mali daantalisi pia ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu pia, ka daantalisi maa bansi mini di mihi la daa nyɛ anzinfa.
en: On the west side there were curtains yards long, with ten posts and ten bases and with hooks and rods made of silver.

dag: Ka dunia nanim mini tiŋgbana zuɣulaannima ni sapashinnima ni bundaannima ni yikolaannima ni sokam zaa bɛn nyɛ daba bee bilichinnima zo nti sɔɣi zoya voya ni mini tampima lɔna ni.
en: Then all the people—the kings of the world, the rulers, the army commanders, the rich people, the powerful people, every slave, and every free person—hid themselves in caves and behind the rocks on the mountains.

dag: Baŋmi dimbɔŋɔ: ʒiɛmana din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni nandahima ni ti beni sahasaha.
en: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.

dag: Ka chaŋ ti shihi kpim maa daamaŋka, ka bɛn daa ʒir o maa kpalim zani. Ka o kuhi boli kpim maa, Nachimbila, n yɛr a mi, yiɣisima.
en: He stepped forward and touched the stretcher on which the dead man was being carried. Those carrying him stood still. Jesus said, Young man, I say to you, get up.

dag: Man Nɛbukadnɛza daa ʒila n yiŋ baalim, ka n nyamma kul pahira n nam yili maa puuni.
en: I, Nebuchadnezzar, was at my palace. I was happy and successful.

dag: Gbuɣima ti ku be nimaani, biŋkɔb biɛɣu mi ti ku doli soli maa. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiligi kɔŋko nti yɛn dol li.
en: There will be no dangers on that road. There will be no lions there to hurt people or any dangerous animals on it. That road will be for the people God saves.

dag: Ti mini ti yaannim zaa tum alahichi. Ti nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri, ka tum tuumbiɛri.
en: We have sinned as our ancestors did; we have been wicked and evil.

dag: Niriba maa ni ti nahindi taba, ka sokam ti nahind o kpee; ka bipala ku tiri bɛ kpamba jilima, ka tarimba ku tiri bɛ zuɣulaannim jilima.
en: The people will turn against each other. Young people will not respect those who are older. The common people will not respect important leaders.

dag: Ka o yi ka bipuɣiŋga, yin zaŋmiy o fali ti o mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba.
en: If he has no daughter, his brothers will inherit the land.

dag: Yisa alizanda ni labbu saha ni daa ti miri, o daa lo nia ni o chaŋla Jɛrusalɛm.
en: As the time approached when Jesus was to be taken up into heaven, he determined to go to Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi chɛ ka anabinim ni daa yɛli shɛm la ti niŋ pali yi ni. Bɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: So be careful! Dont let what the prophets said happen to you:.

dag: ka mol ti Duuma faako tibu saha molo.
en: and to proclaim the year of the Lords favor.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa daa fiɣis o pam;.
en: The leading priests accused Jesus of many things.

dag: Hɔdia so mi ni Hashum ni Bɛzai ni.
en: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai.

dag: Hɔdia paɣ ŋun daa nyɛ Naham tizɔpaɣ la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Gamnim bɛn daa be Kɛila la yaannim mini Maakatinim bɛn daa be Ɛshitɛmɔa la yaannima.
en: Mereds wife was Nahams sister. Mereds wife was from Judah. The sons of Mereds wife were the father of Keilah and Eshtemoa. Keilah was from the Garmites. And Eshtemoa was from the Maacathites.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ a nimdi bahi zoya zuɣu, ka zaŋ a niŋgbuŋ maa pali vinvama ni.
en: Your flesh I will set upon the mountains, and I will fill the valleys with your gore.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka sariakaritib la daa tim pirinsi nti yɛli dansarika gula maa ni o yoomi Pool mini Silas bahi ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: The next morning the Roman officials sent some soldiers to tell the jailer, Let these men go free.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam wumdi n yɛligu ka bi dol li, dilan ŋmanila tammɛr so ŋun daa bi gbi tiŋa n-zal o yili tampiŋ zuɣu. Ka kom daa ti kpe n-gil li ka di dii lu zaa, ka di lubu maa bie pam la.
en: But the people who hear my words and do not obey are like a man who builds a house without preparing a foundation. When the floods come, the house falls down easily and is completely destroyed.

dag: Dinzuɣu siɣisimiya yimaŋa Naawuni nuu din mali yiko la ni, ka di chɛ ka o ti duhi ya o ni yu saha shɛli.
en: Therefore, humble yourselves under Gods power so that he may raise you up in the last day.

dag: di bahi bamdi a ni nyɛ ŋun mi Yɛhudianim kaya mini bɛ naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu ni nyɛ shɛm yɛla zuɣu. N suhir a ni a niŋ suɣilo wum n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ:.
en: particularly since you know so well all the Jewish customs and disputes. I ask you, then, to listen to me with patience.

dag: Ka yi yi mali sara, di simdi ka yi ŋub li dindali maa bee dindali cheei biɛɣu, ka di shɛli yi guui zani hal ni daba ata dali, yin zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim.
en: It must be eaten on the day of your sacrifice or the following day; whatever is left over on the third day must be burned with fire.

dag: Kul leemiya jɛra! Kul leemiya zoomba! Buɣimiya n-chani laana, ka bi nyu wain bee binnyuri kpɛma!.
en: Be surprised and amazed! You will become drunk, but not from wine. Look and be amazed! You will stumble and fall, but not from beer.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa kana ti dii ŋme Naa Hɛrɔd o ni daa bi tiri Naawuni jilima la zuɣu, ka zunzuya wɔɣ o ni ŋ-ŋub o ka o kpi.
en: At once the angel of the Lord struck Herod down, because he did not give honor to God. He was eaten by worms and died.

dag: Di chɛ ka kɔgbana lim ma bee n-chɛ ka kɔbulli di ma bee n-chɛ ka bɔɣ zilinli mum ma niŋ.
en: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.

dag: M bi lan yɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni pumpɔŋɔ, dama n labirila a sanna, amaa bɛn kul ni beni. M Ba Suŋ, gbib ba a yuli din nyɛ yu shɛli a ni daa wuhi ma la zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka bɛ leei zaɣ yini kaman m min a ni nyɛ zaɣ yini shɛm.
en: And now I am coming to you; I am no longer in the world, but they are in the world. Holy Father! Keep them safe by the power of your name, the name you gave me, so that they may be one just as you and I are one.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe Firijia mini Galɛshia tiŋgbana ni garita, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa bi saɣi ni bɛ yihi waazu Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Paul and those with him went through the areas of Phrygia and Galatia because the Holy Spirit did not allow them to tell the Good News in the province of Asia.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaana Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas mini Izraɛlnim daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpamba maa daa yi Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba maa sani Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-zaŋ bɛ zilinkom lab Izraɛlnim maa sani Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti yɛli ba.
en: Then Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest and the leaders left the people of Reuben and Gad in the land of Gilead and came back to the Israelites in the land of Canaan. They brought word back to them.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa zalila niriba tɔto ka bɛ tɔhi, ka lan chɛ ka bɛ tum tuun kpɛma bɛ nuu ni m-me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la min omaŋmaŋ nam yili ni Millo ni Jɛrusalɛm gooni, ni Hazɔr ni Mɛgido ni Gɛza.
en: King Solomon forced slaves to work for him to build the Temple and his palace. Then he used these slaves to build many other things. He built the Millo and the city wall around Jerusalem. Then he rebuilt the cities of Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.

dag: Di saha ka Mɔdɛkai daa yɛli ba ni bɛ labimi ti yɛli Ɛsta: Di tɛhiri ni a ni be nayili maa wuhiya ni a ni yi kum ni gari Yɛhudia nir kam.
en: he had them respond to Esther: Dont think for one minute that, unlike all the other Jews, youll come out of this alive simply because you are in the palace.

dag: Yi ni ti tuuri wuntaŋ ni, ka anabinim pahi yi zuɣu ka yi tuuri yuŋ. N ni saɣim yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: You will stumble by day; and at nighttime so will your prophet, and I will destroy your mother.

dag: Wain kola ŋɔ daa nyɛla zaɣ pala ka ti yi yiŋ na, ka nyam di ni chahi shɛm. Ka ti binyɛra ŋɔ mini ti namda ŋɔ gba chahila so wɔɣinli maa chandi ni.
en: These wineskins were new when we filled them. But here they are, split open. These clothes and sandals of ours are worn out from the very long journey.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi Firawuna sani labira, ka bɛ nya Musa mini Aduna ka bɛ ʒiɛya guhiri ba.
en: When they left Pharaoh, they met Moses and Aaron, who were waiting for them.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ paɣi Yawɛ yuli, dama o kɔŋko yuli tibisi gari yuli kam. O jilima galisiya dunia ni mini zuɣusaa.
en: Let all of these praise the LORDs name because only Gods name is high over all. Only Gods majesty is over earth and heaven.

dag: Miri ka a leei dabiɛm bini n sani, nyini n-nyɛ n ni yɛn sɔɣi so sani m muɣisigu saha.
en: Do not be a terror to me; you are my place of safety when trouble comes.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi yi n-chaŋ sara maligu bimbini din be Yawɛ tooni la gbini nti mal li ka di be kasi, ka zaŋ naɣilaa maa mini bulaa maa ʒim shɛli n-niŋ binyila din be sara maligu bimbini la ni ti gili.
en: he must then go out to the altar for burnt offerings and purify it. He must take some of the bull's blood and some of the goat's blood and put it all over the projections at the corners of the altar.

dag: Di yi di nyɛla n dimnima n-di maani ma ansarisi, n naan tooi deei li; ka n datahi n-yi di diri dari niŋdi ma, n naan tooi sɔɣi ka bɛ ku nya ma.
en: If it were an enemy making fun of me, I could endure it; if it were an opponent boasting over me, I could hide myself from him.

dag: Mɔabnim dula bɛ buɣa zoya, ka chaŋ ti kpe bɛ buɣa jɛmbu duri ni n-fabili niŋ ba je, ka di bi sɔŋ ba.
en: The people of Moab wear themselves out going to their mountain shrines and to their temples to pray, but it will do them no good.

dag: Amaa n ti ku darigi deei nam maa zaa o nuu ni, dama n ni ti zaŋ zuliya yini ti a bia maa n dabili Dauda mini Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ n ni pii shɛli leegi n tiŋ la zuɣu.
en: When I do, I will still let him rule one tribe, because I have not forgotten that David was my servant and Jerusalem is my chosen city.

dag: Ŋunkam wum yinim bɛn nyɛ n nyaandoliba ŋɔ yɛligu wumla n yɛligu, ka ŋunkam zaɣisi ya zaɣisila mani; ka ŋunkam mi zaɣisi ma zaɣisila ŋun tim ma na.
en: When anyone listens to you my followers, they are really listening to me. But when anyone refuses to accept you, they are really refusing to accept me. And when anyone refuses to accept me, they are refusing to accept the one who sent me.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli, bɛ daa zu ma la Hiburu tiŋgbɔŋ ni na; ka kpe gba, m bi tum taal shɛli ka di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ ma kpɛhi sarika.
en: I was kidnapped from the land of the Hebrews, and here in Egypt I haven't done anything to deserve being thrown in jail.

dag: A yuli daa duya zuliya kam zaa ni a viɛlim maa zuɣu. Dama n ni daa ti a jilima shɛli la zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka a niŋ viɛlim zaa maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You became famous for your beauty, all because I made you so lovely! This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Ka a yi kɔhi binshɛli ti a kpee bee a yi da binshɛli a kpee sani, yin di ŋariya taba.
en: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi wumbu, ka kul dolila bɛ kal kura la.
en: But the people living in Israel ignored that command and kept on following their old customs.

dag: Kulla di saha maa ka niriba tusa gari shɛm daa laɣimna hal ti nɔri tab naba bɛ galisim zuɣu, ka Yisa daa daŋ piligi saɣisir o nyaandoliba yɛra, Miriya Farisiinim dabindi din nyɛ bɛ bilikɔnsi la;.
en: As thousands of people crowded together, so that they were stepping on each other, Jesus said first to his disciples, Be on guard against the yeast of the Pharisees—I mean their hypocrisy.

dag: Ka dindali maa ni daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim Vuhim Dabisili dazɔhigu dali zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Yisa sɔɣi di ni, dama siliga maa shee daa bi wɔɣ ni nimaani.
en: Because it was the Jewish Preparation Day and the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus in it.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi kun ya. N ni ti kari ya saria Izraɛl tintariga, ka yi ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and you will be killed in battle in your own country. Then everyone will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Gɛra pisi n-yɛn nyɛ shɛkal yini. Shɛkal pihiyɔbu n-yɛn nyɛ mina zaɣ yini yi sani.
en: The standard unit of weight will be the shekel . One shekel will equal gerahs , and shekels will equal one mina .

dag: Ka bɛ daa tim ti yɛli Jɛzibɛl, Ti lab Nabɔt kuɣa ku o.
en: The message was sent to Jezebel: Naboth has been put to death.

dag: Di saha paɣisarili maa ba min o ma bɛn zaŋmi paɣ maa paɣipalitali shihira na ti wuhi tiŋ maa kpamba dunɔdali gbini.
en: If this happens, the bride's father and mother must go to the town gate to show the town leaders the proof that the woman was a virgin.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yiɣisi asiba m-pa o buŋ nyaampara doli Mɔab kpamba maa chaŋ.
en: So Balaam got up the next morning and saddled his donkey, then left with the Moabite officials.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Di zɔri ba, dama m pun zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni. Ka bɛ ni so ku tooi zani yi tooni.
en: Then the LORD said to Joshua, Dont be afraid of them. I have given them into your power. Not a single one of them can stand up against you.

dag: ka Ɛbɛl mi daa zaŋ o buzɔŋ ni piɛbil tuuli ni o kpam na nti mali sara, ka Yawɛ Naawuni nini daa tiɣi Ɛbɛl min o sara maa.
en: Then Abel brought the first lamb born to one of his sheep, killed it, and gave the best parts of it as an offering. The Lord was pleased with Abel and his offering.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa nya Dauda ka ʒiɛm o, dama o daa kul nyɛla bisariŋga ka mal alaafee, ka viɛli pam.
en: When the Philistine looked David over, he sneered at David because he was just a boy; reddish brown and good-looking.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim bɛn mali yɛm ŋɔ, wummiya: Din kariya ka Naawuni tum tuumbiɛri! Din kariya ka Kpiɔŋlan Naa tum taali!.
en: You men can understand, so listen to me. God would never do what is evil! God All-Powerful would never do wrong.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, M bia, a yɛda niŋbu n-chɛ ka a kpaŋ. Kulimi ni suhudoo.
en: Jesus said to her, My daughter, you are made well because you believed. Go in peace.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Judanima, ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka Judanim maa nyaŋ ba.
en: So the Israelites fled before Judah, and God gave Judah the victory.

dag: Ti mi ni timaŋmaŋ biɛr kurili daa pahila o zuɣu ka bɛ kpahi ti tabili dapulli zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti daalahichi biɛr kurili maa kpi, ka ti ku lan nyɛ alahichi daba.
en: We know that the persons we used to be were nailed to the cross with Jesus. This was done, so our sinful bodies would no longer be the slaves of sin.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, Kamiya kpe na nti wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm.
en: Joshua spoke to the people: Come here and listen to what the Lord our God said he will do!.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Izraɛl do so bee saamba bɛn be Izraɛl do so yi ti zaŋ o bia ti Molɛk, bɛn kum o; tiŋ maa nim bɛn labim o kuɣa.
en: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.

dag: Chɛ ka vi di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn maani ma ansarisi yɛra, N-yɛwaa! N-yɛwaa! la.
en: May those who make fun of me be dismayed by their defeat.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun ti o niriba Izraɛlnim vuhim kaman o ni daa pun lo alikauli shɛm la; ka o yɛtɔɣ yini gba bi kɔŋ palibu kaman o ni daa pun chɛ ka o dabili Musa yɛli shɛm la.
en: Praise the Lord ! He promised to give rest to his people, Israel. And he has given us rest! He used his servant Moses and made many good promises to the people of Israel. And he has kept every one of them!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna, Cham tiŋgban nɛli ni ti tuhi Musa soli. Ka o daa chaŋ ti tuh o soli Naawuni zol la gbini m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: The LORD said to Aaron, Go into the desert to meet Moses. So he went, and Aaron met him at Gods mountain and greeted him with a kiss.

dag: Nuhu bidibisi n-daa nyɛ; Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt.
en: The sons of Noah were Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

dag: O daa zaŋla chɛchɛbun gahinda kɔbisiyɔbu ni Ijipti chɛchɛbunsi zaa, ka tɔbbihi daa be di zaa ni.
en: He took six hundred elite chariots and all of Egypts other chariots with captains on all of them.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun nyɛ ŋun ti yɛn di nam n-zaŋ kurigu jaaŋgbee su zuliya kam, ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka bɛ to n-kpuɣ o bia maa zuɣusaa n-zaŋ o tahi Naawuni sani o nam ʒiishee.
en: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne.

dag: Nir yi lo wahu kabire o dimbu nyaaŋa, di ku ku ŋun lo o kabire maa buchi.
en: Knowing how to charm a snake is of no use if you let the snake bite first.

dag: n-yɛli, Yi ma daa ŋmanila gbuɣinnyaŋ gahindili gbuɣima sunsuuni. O daa dola gbuɣim pola sunsuuni n-wumisir o bihi.
en: What a lioness your mother was! She raised her cubs among the fierce male lions.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be Bɛtilihɛm maa ka Mariama dɔɣibu saha paai.
en: and while they were in Bethlehem, the time came for her to have her baby.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri nambɔɣu mal alibarika, dama Naawuni ni ti zo bɛ gba nambɔɣu.
en: Happy are those who are merciful to others; God will be merciful to them!.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri chi zim viɛl shɛli; ka yi zaŋ di kilɔgiram ata pahi naɣila yino kam zuɣu, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi m-pahi piɛla yino zuɣu.
en: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram.

dag: Ka doo maa daa ti lan yiɣisi ni o kuli, ka o deemba maa lan balim o hal ka o ti lan gbe yaha.
en: When the man got ready to set out, his father-in-law persuaded him, and he spent the night there again.

dag: ka daa chaŋ luɣ shɛli katiŋa din nyɛ daba ata soli chandi ka chɛ Yaakubu, ka Yaakubu daa gbib ŋun Leeban biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn kpalim la.
en: He put a three-day trip between himself and Jacob, while Jacob was watching the rest of Labans flock.

dag: Cham Naa Dauda sani yomyom ti bɔh o, N dan naa, a daa bi po pɔri man ŋun nyɛ a dab paɣ ŋɔ sani ni a ni chɛ ka m bia Sulemaana ti di nam n-ʒin a nam ʒiishee? Ka di chaŋ wula ka Adɔnija nti di nam.
en: Go say to David, You promised me that Solomon would be the next king. So why is Adonijah now king.

dag: Biɛɣu pihinahi ka bɛ daa zaŋ niŋ tim maa ʒe o niŋgbuŋ maa, dama bɛ ni daa yi zaŋdi dabisi shɛŋa n-tumdi di tuma m-bala. Ka Ijiptinim daa zaŋ biɛɣ pisopɔin kum o kuli.
en: When the Egyptians prepared the body in this special way, they waited days before they buried the body. Then the Egyptians had a special time of sadness for Jacob. This time was days.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu daa chɛ ka Jɔshua zaŋ takɔbi tuhi nyaŋ Amalɛknim maa zaa.
en: So Joshua defeated Amalek and his army with the sword.

dag: ka gbaan o tooni, di yi pa lala, o suhu ni yiɣisi ka o chɛ ka yi bahi yoli soli ni, dama o suhu yiɣisiri yomyom. Bɛnkam zaa sɔɣ o sani mali alibarika.
en: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla gɔhi tihi din yi Sɛnir na m-mali a dapaɣa zaa. Bɛ daa ŋmahila Lɛbanɔn sida tihi daantalisi na ti sa a ni.
en: For you they made your deck of cypress from Senir. To make your mast, they took cedar from Lebanon.

dag: Ka bɛnkam zaa zaɣisi a Naawuni zaligunim maa dolibu bee n-zaɣisi naa zaligunim dolibu, bɛn darigim bɛ tibili pam. Di yi simdi ni bɛ ku ba bee n-kari ba yihi yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni bee n-fa bɛ nɛma zaa bee n-kpɛhi ba duu yin niŋmiya lala.
en: Let judgment be strictly carried out upon anyone who does not obey the Instruction from your God and the law of your king, including death, banishment, confiscation of property, or imprisonment.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka Juda nam maa niŋ yaa pam, ka bɛ daa kul ʒe Sulemaana bia Rɛhɔbɔam maa nyaaŋa hal ni yuma ata, dama yuma ata maa ni zaa bɛ daa kul dolila Dauda mini Sulemaana naba.
en: This strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and for three years they supported Rehoboam son of Solomon and lived as they had under the rule of King David and King Solomon.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba bɛn nyɛ Farisiinim ni daa nya ka Yisa mini alahichinima ni farigudeeriba laɣim diri maa, ka bɛ bɔh o nyaandoliba, Bɔzuɣu ka o mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim laɣim timdi dira ka nyura.
en: Some teachers of the Law, who were Pharisees, saw that Jesus was eating with these outcasts and tax collectors, so they asked his disciples, Why does he eat with such people.

dag: Yinim teeku noli tinsinim mini Sidɔnnima, maamiya yi ni. Yi daabihi bela teeku ni bɔri azichi tiri ya.
en: Wail, you merchants of Sidon! You sent agents.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔh o, Wula ka n lee yɛn tooi niŋ chaŋ? Dama Sool yi wum di yɛla o ni ku ma. Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Bom naɣisaa chaŋ ti yɛli, N kamina ni n ti mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: How can I do that? Samuel asked. If Saul hears about it, he will kill me! The Lord answered, Take a calf with you and say that you are there to offer a sacrifice to the Lord .

dag: Ka gooni maa yi ti lu, bɛ ni bɔhi ya, Yi ni daa zaŋ binshɛli paligi li la lee be ya? .
en: People will then ask the workers why the paint didn't hold it up.

dag: O daa zaɣis o biɛhigu shee din be Shilo ka nyɛ tanti du shɛl ni o ni daa be ninsalinim sunsuuni la.
en: God abandoned the sanctuary at Shiloh, the tent where he had lived with humans.

dag: Ti Duuma lan yɛli: Dinzuɣu yimiya buɣa ni na n-woligi yi ko ka chɛ ba; ka di niŋya din ni ta nir daɣiri, ka n deei ya.
en: The Lord also says, Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you.

dag: Ka kawaan kɔr ayopɔin din nyɛ biisim polo pɔhim ni ŋme shɛli ka di zaɣi daa to n-yina pahi kawaan kara maa zuɣu.
en: Just then, seven ears of grain, scrawny and scorched by the east wind, sprouted after them.

dag: O daa tum tuumbiɛri Yawɛ sani kaman Ɛhab daŋ niriba ni daa niŋ shɛm la, dama o ba kum nyaaŋa, bɛna n-daa nyɛ o saawaranim bɛn luh o.
en: Ahaziah did evil in the Lord s sight. That is what Ahabs family did. Ahabs family gave advice to Ahaziah after Ahaziahs father died. They gave Ahaziah bad advice that led to his death.

dag: Nandahima zuɣu chɛ ka n tarigimi; nintam kul mahigirila m bindoo yuŋ kam; ka n nintam maa chɛ ka n difiɛli kul mahigi gbati.
en: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.

dag: amaa Masia dapulli zuɣu kum yɛla waazu ka tinim yihira. Yɛhudianim sani di nyɛla kuɣituurili, ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mi sani di nyɛla jɛrilim;.
en: As for us, we proclaim the crucified Christ, a message that is offensive to the Jews and nonsense to the Gentiles;.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣisi bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi mini zimburisa din guui pali piɛri pinaayi.
en: Then the disciples took up twelve baskets full of what was left of the bread and the fish.

dag: Yɛm piligu ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bom yɛm, ka a ni yɛn bo shɛli pahi nyɛla tɛhi zilima.
en: The beginning of wisdom: Get wisdom! Get understanding before anything else.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa dihili ni ti nyɛla dɛde hal bɛ ni mali tarili bɛ dɔɣiriba ni kɔhiri bɛ daŋ ni neen shɛŋa ni la zaa yoli.
en: he is allowed to eat equal portions, despite the finances he has from his family.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri ye binyoya jɛmbu mini din chihiri tumbu zuɣu la, n ni chɛ ka bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ŋmaligi lu bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But those who worship idols will be punished and get what they deserve. I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: Ka n daa yiɣisi ni n yoog o ka o gari. N ni daa zaŋ n nuu gbaai bɛ ni gbaari binshɛli yoori dunoli ni n yooi, n nuhi daa puɣila mɛɛr zim, ka n nubihi daa tɔɣiri mɛɛr kom.
en: I got up to open for my lover, myrrh dripping from my hands, myrrh scented lotion dripped from my fingers onto the handles of the lock.

dag: Bɛ puuni ka kuɣ tuuli ti yɛn yina. Bɛ puuni ka suɣili kpaa ti yɛn yina. Bɛ puuni ka tɔbutuhiri tɔbu ti yɛn yina. Bɛ puuni ka zuɣulan kam ti yɛn yina.
en: From among them will come rulers, leaders, and commanders to govern my people.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n wuhi tuumbiɛrinima a soya, ka alahichinim ŋmaligi lab a sanna.
en: I will teach the guilty how you want them to live, and the sinners will come back to you.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim zani! Yaa n Naawuni, tiligim ma! A labi n dimnim zaa tapaɣisi, ka ŋme n-kabi ninvuɣ biɛri nyina.
en: Lord , get up! My God, come rescue me! If you hit my enemies on the cheek, you will break all their teeth.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnima, yi nyee daa nyɔni ma mi, ka yi daa bi lan jɛmdi ma.
en: Jacob, you did not pray to me. Israel, you became tired of me.

dag: Bɛ gbiri kɔsoya tampima ni, ka bɛ nina nyari binviɛla kam.
en: As they tunnel through the rocks, They discover precious stones.

dag: Dama yimaŋmaŋ nina daa nya Yawɛ ni tum tuun kar shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: Your own eyes witnessed each of these powerful acts the LORD performed.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli bɛ ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb chaŋ maa Yawɛ ni daa wuhi ma binshɛŋa zaa.
en: and I told them everything the Lord had shown me.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: Let the person who has ears, hear.

dag: Asirianim yi ti wum Yawɛ kukoli, ka nya o ni darigi bɛ tibili shɛm, bɛ ni tarigi.
en: When the Assyrians hear the Lord 's voice and see him striking with his iron rod, they will be terrified.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa nini daa shiri neei, ka bɛ nya ka bɛ bela bɛ zaɣim, ka bɛ daa ŋahi fiig tia vari she n-zaŋ so.
en: As soon as they had eaten it, they were given understanding and realized that they were naked; so they sewed fig leaves together and covered themselves.

dag: Ka yiɣisi guui chaŋ Ɛli sani ti yɛl o, A ni boli ma la, n-nyɛ ma. Amaa ka Ɛli garigi yɛl o, M bi bol a, labimi ti dɔni. Ka o daa labi ti dɔni.
en: and ran to Eli and said, You called me, and here I am. But Eli answered, I didn't call you; go back to bed. So Samuel went back to bed.

dag: Ka bɛ mini bɛ tɔbbihi zaa daa laɣimna. Bɛ tɔbbihi maa daa galisiya pam hal ka bɛ galisim maa daa ti ŋmanila mɔɣ bihigu; ka bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi gba daa galisi pam.
en: They came with all their soldiers—an army with as many men as there are grains of sand on the seashore. They also had many horses and chariots.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka dɔr shɛli din ka tibbu gbaag o nyɔri.
en: After this happened, the Lord struck Jehoram with an incurable stomach disease.

dag: Ɛdom beni, di nanim mini di kpamba kpiɔŋ maa zaa, bɛna n-doya m-pahi bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb la zuɣu maa. Bɛ mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni n-laɣim doya pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun be kpiimba biɛhigu shee la zuɣu maa.
en: Edom is there with her kings and rulers. They were powerful soldiers, but now they lie in the world of the dead with the uncircumcised who were killed in battle.

dag: Stiivin yɛligu ŋɔ ni daa lu bɛ tiba ni maa, ka di dim bɛ nyinyɛhi ni ka bɛ suhuri yiɣisi pam, ka bɛ je suli niŋ o.
en: As the members of the Council listened to Stephen, they became furious and ground their teeth at him in anger.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka doo ŋmaligir o ba min o ma sani n-zaŋd omaŋ tabind o paɣa ka bɛ niriba ayi maa be kaman ninvuɣ yino.
en: As the scripture says, For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and unite with his wife, and the two will become one.

dag: mini nolɔɣu ŋun cheena ni bulaa ni na so ŋun be o niriba tooni gamdi giŋgaani.
en: the strut of a rooster or a male goat; and a king with his army.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli Naa. Di yi niŋ nyin Naa nyaɣisim, ka a yu ni a niŋ man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nirilim, n suhir a ni a timmi ma Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni n yaannim gbala ni do tin shɛli ni la ka n ti lab me li zali.
en: and then I said to the emperor, If Your Majesty is pleased with me and is willing to grant my request, let me go to the land of Judah, to the city where my ancestors are buried, so that I can rebuild the city.

dag: Fɔnisia, kummiya ka chɛ ka nandahima mali ya. Zomiya kuli Speen.
en: Cross over to Tarshish; wail, inhabitants of the coast.

dag: Ka Naa maa mi ni ti garigi yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni daa niŋdi m mabihi ŋɔ nirilim hal zaŋ tabili bɛ ni bɛn daa pɔri la, mani ka yi daa niŋdi maa.
en: The king will answer, Whenever you did it for any of my people, no matter how unimportant they seemed, you did it for me.

dag: So be yi ni n-nyari wahala? O suhimi Naawuni. So be yi ni m-mali suhupiɛlli? O yilimi yila paɣi Naawuni.
en: If any of you are suffering, they should pray. If any of you are happy, they should sing.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa tim ti yɛli Taai Naa Hiram, A ni daa ti m ba Dauda sida dari ka o me o yil la, niŋmi n gba lala.
en: Solomon sent the following message to King Hiram of Tyre: Years ago, when my father David was building his palace, you supplied him with cedar logs. Now will you send me supplies?.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Reechɛl ni o nyɛla o ba dɔɣim, ka nyɛ Ribɛka bia, Ka Reechɛl daa guui kuli ti yɛl o ba.
en: Jacob told Rachel that he was related to her father and that he was Rebekahs son. She then ran to tell her father.

dag: ni bɛ ni mali binshɛŋa kpihiri firilanima ni taha ni chɛrisi. O daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali buɣim moori lahi. Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunoli pundi mini luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee dunoli pundi zaa daa nyɛla salima.
en: He used pure gold to make the lamp snuffers, bowls, pans, and the censers. He used pure gold to make the doors for the Temple, the inside doors for the Most Holy Place and the doors for the main hall.

dag: Di saha ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn min o daa chaŋ maa yɛli, Ti ku tooi tuhi niriba maa, dama bɛ mali kpiɔŋ gari ti.
en: But the men who went up with him said, We cant go up against the people because they are stronger than we.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ tuma ni chɛ ka yi kɔŋ n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la, ka n chɛ ka yi chaŋ ti tumdi tuma tiri yi dimnima yi ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni. Dama n suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila buɣim, ka di kul ni diri sahakam.
en: You will have to give up the land I gave you, and I will make you serve your enemies in a land you know nothing about, because my anger is like a fire, and it will burn forever.

dag: O daa ku na shɛb bɛn yuya du. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: he killed famous kings; his love is eternal;.

dag: N jɛmbu duu yi ti be bɛ sani saha shɛlikam, di saha zuliya kam ni ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ m-mali Izraɛlnim ka bɛ be kasi. .
en: Every nation on earth will know that my temple is in Israel and that I have chosen the Israelites to be my people.

dag: Yawɛ baɣa be ti ni. O ni niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni. O ni niŋ alibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim ni. O ni niŋ alibarika niŋ Aduna zuliya ni.
en: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.

dag: Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n wuhi n kpiɔŋ mini n kasitali ka zuliya pam nya li, ka baŋ ma. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: In this way I will show all the nations that I am great and that I am holy. They will know then that I am the Lord .

dag: Di saha nir ni ti yi o mabia nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o; ka doo ni ti yi o bia nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o, ka bihi gba ti zaɣisi bɛ banim mini bɛ manima, ka zaŋ ba puhi kubu.
en: Brothers and sisters will betray one another and have each other put to death. Parents will betray their own children, and children will turn against their parents and have them killed.

dag: Lom mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ alikauli ni a ni gbib ma viɛnyɛliŋga. Di chɛ ka karimbaannim nahim ma.
en: Promise that you will help your servant; don't let the arrogant oppress me!.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Samsin; ka bia maa daa mali ti zooi, ka Yawɛ niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: Later, Manoah's wife did give birth to a son, and she named him Samson. As the boy grew, the Lord blessed him.

dag: Ka o zaŋ naɣilaa maa yi kpaŋa bɛ biɛhigu maa shee nti nyo buɣim kaman o ni di nyo o tuuli naɣilaa la shɛm la, di nyɛla zama alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: The priest must carry this bull outside the camp and burn it, just as he burned the other bull. This is the sin offering for the whole community.

dag: Gɛrishom bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Libini mini Jahat ni Zimma.
en: Of Gershom: his son Libni, his son Jahath, his son Zimmah.

dag: amaa ka niŋ tipawumli n-dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu n-jɛmdi Baalinima kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa wuhi ba shɛm la zuɣu.
en: Instead, they have been stubborn and have worshiped the idols of Baal as their ancestors taught them to do.

dag: Di saha maa bɛ ni ti ʒini saria karibu ʒiya n-fa o yiko maa, ka bah o yoli kahikahi.
en: Then the court will sit in session. His rule will be taken away— ruined and wiped out for all time.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lar o. Amaa ka o daa kari bɛ zaa yihi, ka zaŋ bipuɣiŋga maa ba min o ma pahi bɛn daa be o san la zuɣu kpe bipuɣiŋga maa ni daa do du shɛli ni maa.
en: They started making fun of him, so he put them all out, took the child's father and mother and his three disciples, and went into the room where the child was lying.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka daa doli Jɛrɔbɔam daalahichi tumbu soli min o ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi shɛl la soli.
en: Baasha also disobeyed the Lord by acting like Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun doli wuntitali soli o tuma zaa ni, ka zɔri nambɔɣu o ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa ni.
en: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, faithful in all his deeds.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa bɔhi Balaam, Bɔzuɣu ka a fiɛbi buŋ maa buta ŋɔ zaa? N kamina ni n ti gu a soli, dama m bi yu a ni chani chandi shɛli maa.
en: The angel said, You had no right to treat your donkey like that! I was the one who blocked your way, because I don't think you should go to Moab.

dag: Bɛ zaa mi yɛn dɔnila taŋkpaɣu ni, ka zunzuya di ba.
en: But all alike die and are buried; they all are covered with worms.

dag: Amaa n ni niŋ a yurilim din galisi ŋɔ naani. M mali suhupiɛlli a ni tiligi ma zuɣu.
en: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.

dag: O ka ba bee ma bee zuliya; o ka piligu, o mi ka bahigu, amaa o ŋmanila Naawuni Bia, ka kul nyɛ maligumaana hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: There is no record of Melchizedek's father or mother or of any of his ancestors; no record of his birth or of his death. He is like the Son of God; he remains a priest forever.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋgbani daa sɔhigi ka dam; ka zuɣusaa tanzahi daa sɔhigi ka dam o suhuyiɣisili zuɣu.
en: The earth rocked and shook; the skys foundations trembled and reeled because of Gods anger.

dag: Amaa ka Absalom daa kpaŋ omaŋ hal ka o ti saɣi ka Amnɔn mini nabihi maa zaa daa dol o chaŋ.
