en: Absalom kept begging David. Finally, David let Amnon and all the kings other sons go with Absalom.

dag: Ka dilan naan yili yila yɛli niriba, N daa tumla alahichi, ka bi lan gbibi yɛlimaŋli, amaa ka bɛ daa bi labisi di samli yo ma.
en: Each one will say in public, I have sinned. I have not done right, but God spared me.

dag: N yɛli barinyuriba, Di nyuriya bara. Ka yɛli ninvuɣ biɛri mi, Di maliya karimbaani.
en: I said to the arrogant, Dont be arrogant! To the wicked I said, Dont exalt your strength!.

dag: Bɛ ni bi yuri ka kɔŋ zaligunim maa dolibu maa zuɣu, bɛ bom bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini bɛ daalahichi sanyoo sara tahi Yawɛ tooni na ka maligumaana ti zaŋ li mali sara Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu, ka Yawɛ chɛ bɛ taali maa.
en: So the priest will make the whole community of Israel pure, and they will be forgiven for the mistake they made. Since they made the mistake, they must bring a gift and a sin offering to the Lord .

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Amaa miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi kɔr biɛri mini danyubo ni dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda ti dihi ya sɔŋ, ka dindali maa ti dii libigi ya.
en: Be careful not to spend your time having parties and getting drunk or worrying about this life. If you do that, you wont be able to think straight, and the end might come when you are not ready.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima pa di zuɣu m-mal li kpuɣiri teebuli maa.
en: Use acacia wood to make the poles, and cover them with gold. The poles are for carrying the table.

dag: Ka Obadia bɔhi Ilaija, Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka n lee tum ka a bɔri ni a chɛ ka Ɛhab ku man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ?.
en: Obadiah replied: King Ahab would kill me if I told him that. And I haven't even done anything wrong.

dag: Ka Pool garigi yɛl o, Di yi nyɛla saha biɛla bee pam puuni, pa a kɔŋko gba, amaa bɛn zaa be kpe n-wumdi n yɛligu ŋɔ, n di bi zaɣisi ni yi zaa be kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ kul gbaai yihila zoligɔnim din lo ma ŋɔ.
en: Paul responded, Whether it is a short or a long time, I pray to God that not only you but also all who are listening to me today will become like me, except for these chains.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku Ainim maa zaa naai bɛ ni daa kari ba ti zali mɔɣu ni luɣ shɛl la, bɛ zaa daa labila Ai tiŋ puuni nti zaŋ takɔbiri ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni zaa.
en: Israel finished killing the entire population of Ai that had chased them out into the open wasteland. All of them were finished off without mercy. Then all Israel went back to Ai and struck it down without mercy.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma yaha, Di pun niŋ! N nyɛla Alfa mini Omega . Di gbinni nyɛla, Piligu ni Bahigu. Kɔnyuri ni wum ninvuɣ shɛb la, n ni ti ba nyɛvili kom din nyɛ kɔbilisirim la yoli.
en: Everything is finished! I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will freely give water from the life-giving fountain to everyone who is thirsty.

dag: Yi Naawuni yɛliya, Maamiya n niriba suhuri, maamiya bɛ suhuri!.
en: Comfort my people, says our God. Comfort them!.

dag: Kunduna mini piɛri ni ti laɣim doya, ka jɛŋgbina mini bubihi ti laɣim doya, ka naɣibihi mini gbuɣimbihi ni gbuɣim pola ti laɣim doya, ka bihi ti vɔri ba chana.
en: Then wolves will live at peace with lambs, and leopards will lie down in peace with young goats. Calves, lions, and bulls will all live together in peace. A little child will lead them.

dag: tɔbu ni lu yi zuɣu, ka yi birininim la zaa ti wurim. Di ni ti bemi kaman Naa Shaliman ni daa ŋme Bɛtaribɛlnim tɔbu, ka wurim li, ka zaŋ bihi mini bɛ manim tɔri taba n-kuri ba shɛm la.
en: So your armies will hear the noise of battle, and all your fortresses will be destroyed. It will be like the time Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel. At that time of war, mothers were killed with their children.

dag: M piɛri maa daa wurim kpe yɔɣu nti be zoya zaa mini daboli kam zuɣu dari ginda. M piɛri maa daa wurim kpe yɔɣu m-be dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam ni, ka so kani ŋun ni lihi bo bɛ shee.
en: So my sheep were scattered across the earth. They roamed on hills and mountains, without anyone even bothering to look for them.

dag: Amaa man Yawɛ nti yɛn zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi, ka di niŋ pali. Di ti bi lan yɛn yuui yaha. Amaa yinim duŋtaariba ŋɔ ʒiɛman ŋɔ ni ka n ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ka chɛ ka di niŋ pali. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I am the LORD! The word that I speak is the word that I will speak! It will happen and be delayed no longer. In your own days, household of rebels, I speak a word and make it happen. This is what the LORD God says!.

dag: Bɛ doonila bɛ zaɣim yuŋ kam, ka ka situra. Bɛ ka binshɛli din ni pili wari saha.
en: spend the night naked, unclothed, in the cold without a cover.

dag: N yi yɛli, N garo ni maai n suhu, n garibil ni chɛ ka n fabila naai;.
en: If I say, My couch will comfort me, my bed will diminish my murmuring.

dag: Ka Dauda daa laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa zali o ni daa mali luɣ shɛli zal li maa.
en: So David summoned all the people of Israel to Jerusalem in order to bring the Covenant Box to the place he had prepared for it.

dag: Yɛlim niriba maa mi ni Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya, n zaŋla nyɛvili soli mini kum soli sɔŋ ya.
en: Then I told them that the Lord had said: People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord , give you the choice of life or death.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kɔri taŋkpaɣu duhiduhi, ka me teei gili goma ni bɛ ku niriba pam. Firawuna min o tɔbbihi pam bɛn mali yaa ku tuhi tɔbu maa sɔŋ o.
en: Pharaoh wont help him. There will be no strong force or mighty army in battle when siege ramps are set up and towers are built to eliminate many lives.

dag: Dunɔguliba zuɣulaannim anahi bɛn daa nyɛ Lɛvinim la n-daa nyɛ bɛn su Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni du shɛŋa mini neen shɛŋa din mali bukaata fukumsi.
en: The four full-time guards were Levites, and they supervised the other guards and were responsible for the rooms in the temple and the supplies kept there.

dag: Ka a zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa ti o, n ni ti be a min o zaa noya ni, ka wuhi ya yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Speak to him and tell him what hes supposed to say. Ill help both of you speak, and Ill teach both of you what to do.

dag: Naawuni, n nyɛla ŋun ka yaa ni nandana. Kam n sanna yomyom. Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n sɔŋsim ni n tiligira, di yuui.
en: I am only a poor, helpless man. God, please hurry to me. You are my helper, the one who can save me. Lord , dont be too late!.

dag: Di saha ka pɔhim daa yi Yawɛ sani n-ʒe kɔrinsi teeku ni na ti luhi gili suɣa maa shee luɣilikam m-paai kilomita bɔbili wɔɣilim tariga, ka bɛ ni do tiŋ shɛm dubu nyɛ kaman mita yini laasabu.
en: A wind from the LORD blew up and brought quails from the sea. It let them fall by the camp, about a days journey all around the camp and about three feet deep on the ground.

dag: yi yi ni po Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ ni yi ni gbibi yɛlimaŋli, ka doli zaligu ni wuntitali, dindina o ni niŋ alibarika niŋ zuliya shɛb ni yi zuɣu, ka bɛ ti mal o nyuri bara.
en: Make promises only in my name, and do what you promise! Then all nations will praise me, and I will bless them.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi gba na kuli ka fahim? Yi bi mi ni binshɛɣukam din kpɛri ninsal pul ni bi tar o daɣiri?.
en: You are no more intelligent than the others, Jesus said to them. Don't you understand? Nothing that goes into you from the outside can really make you unclean.

dag: Ka tɔb maa daa kpaɣi mii Sool, ka peentɔriba daa to o piɛm ti o daŋa.
en: The fighting was heavy around Saul. The archers shot Saul with their arrows and wounded him.

dag: Ka ti yi zaɣisila Yawɛ ka me sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ ni ti zaŋdi biŋkɔbiri maani sara pari di zuɣu nyɔri buɣim bee n-zaŋdi bindira sara bee suhudoo sara pari di zuɣu, ŋun Yawɛ maŋmaŋ ŋun darigim ti tibili.
en: If weve built ourselves an altar to turn away from following the LORD or to offer on it an entirely burned offering or gift offering, or to perform well-being sacrifices on it, let the LORD himself seek punishment.

dag: Dama bɛ daa lan mɛla buɣa jɛmbu shee mini binchunchuna zali, ka me buɣili Ashɛrim binnana n-tamtam zoli kam zuɣu; ka me shɛŋa mi zali timahili kam gbini.
en: They built high places, memorial stones, and sacred poles. They built them on every high hill and under every green tree.

dag: Sanbalat ni daa wum ni ti lan piligi mɛri gooni maa, o suhu daa yiɣisiya pam, ka o puuni zaa diri buɣim ka o piligi maani Yɛhudianim ansarisi.
en: When Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he became angry and raged. He mocked the Jews.

dag: Amaa ka Ahaz daa yɛli, N ku yɛl o. N ku buɣisi Yawɛ ni n nya.
en: But Ahaz said, I will not ask for a sign as proof. I will not test the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ shɛb mi daa baai du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli n-zo nti kpe Gaad mini Giliad tiŋgbana ni. Di saha Naa Sool ŋun daa na bela Giligal, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani maa zaa niŋgbuna ti sɔhira.
en: others crossed the Jordan River into the territories of Gad and Gilead. Saul was still at Gilgal, and the people with him were trembling with fear.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ dunia ŋɔ niŋ o nuu ni? Ka ŋuni n-lee zaŋ dunia zaa fukumsi ti o?.
en: From the very beginning, God has been in control of all the world.

dag: Ka so yi je o kpee ka daag o luhi bee n-zaŋ bini lab o bee n-sɔɣi dɔni gu o ku o.
en: You might hit someone with your hand or push someone or throw something at them and kill them. If you did that from hate, you are a murderer, and you must be killed. A member of the dead persons family can chase you and kill you.

dag: ŋun nyɛ Shamma ŋun daa nyɛ Harar nir la bia ni Ahiam ŋun daa nyɛ Sharar Harar nir la bia.
en: the son of Shammah from Harar; Ahiam son of Sharar from Harar;.

dag: Naawuni zom ti nambɔɣu, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni; ka ŋmalig a nini lihi ti ni yurilim.
en: God, show mercy to us and bless us. Please accept us! Selah.

dag: Ka o kul zaɣisira, amaa di nyaaŋa ka o ti yɛli o suhu ni, Wun ni m bi zɔri Naawuni ka mi bi lihiri nyari daadam kam ŋɔ zaa yoli.
en: But the judge did not want to help the woman. After a long time, the judge thought to himself, I dont care about God. And I dont care about what people think.

dag: Ti yi bi ʒe yim, ŋun kul ni ʒe yim, dama o ku tooi yi omaŋ nyaaŋa.
en: If we are disloyal, he stays faithful because he cant be anything else than what he is.

dag: Lala ka n yɛn niŋ n-chɛ ka pagɔrisigu tuma naai tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka di leei saɣisigu ti paɣiba zaa, ka bɛ ku lan tum pagɔrisigu tuma kaman yi ni daa tum shɛm maa.
en: I will get rid of sinful prostitution in this country, so that women everywhere will be warned not to act as you have.

dag: Samarianim ni ti ʒi bɛ tuumbiɛri zambu, dama bɛ zaɣisi bɛ Naawuni. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, ka zaŋ bɛ biliɛri fiɛbi tiŋ chɛrisichɛrisi, ka karigi bɛ paɣipuhinim puya.
en: Samaria will be punished for turning against me. It will be destroyed in war— children will be beaten against rocks, and pregnant women will be ripped open.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa pirig o binyɛrigu m-pɔripɔri li zaŋ fiɛb kom maa, ka kom maa daa pirigi buyi n-daai ti dɔni di yaɣ ayi maa zaa hal ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa ti doli tiŋgban kuŋ zuɣu du duli.
en: Elijah then took his coat, rolled it up, and hit the water. Then the water was divided in two! Both of them crossed over on dry ground.

dag: Ka ŋunkam dɔni tiŋa yili maa ni, ŋun paɣim o situra, ka ŋunkam di bindirigu yili maa ni, ŋun paɣim o situra.
en: Anyone who lies down in the house must wash their clothes. Anyone who eats in the house must also wash their clothes.

dag: N niŋ ti Duuma naani ni yi ku doli din be di ko ka chɛ n ni doli so shɛl la. Ka ŋun chirindi ya yi kul nyɛ sokam, o ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.

dag: Yawɛ yi ti yiɣisi ni o dam dunia ŋɔ, niriba ni ti zo nti kpe tampima lɔna voya ni mini tiŋgbani vokaba ni ni bɛ tilig o dabiɛm zɔbu ni min o jilima dabiɛm zɔbu ni.
en: When the Lord comes to shake the earth, people will hide in holes and caves in the rocky hills to try to escape from his anger and to hide from his power and glory.

dag: N zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa niŋ n suhu ni, ka zahim di zaa nya wuntizɔriba mini yɛnnim tuma ni be Naawuni nuu ni shɛm. Di yi nyɛ yurilim bee jɛlinsi, so ku tooi baŋ. Binshɛɣukam din paari ba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: I thought about these things. Then I understood that God has power over everyone, even those who are wise and live right. Anything can happen to any one of us, and so we never know if life will be good or bad.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ tamla nyɛvili din ka bahigu tahima zuɣu. Naawuni ŋun ku ŋma ʒiri ŋɔ daa lo ti nyɛvili ŋɔ alikauli la ʒiɛmana din gari la ha ni.
en: Their faith and this knowledge are based on the hope of eternal life that God, who doesnt lie, promised before time began.

dag: Pita ni daa baŋ lala maa, ka o chaŋ Jɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Maak la ma Mariama yiŋa. Niriba pam n-daa laɣim be nimaani suhiri Naawuni.
en: Aware of his situation, he went to the home of Mary, the mother of John Mark, where many people had gathered and were praying.

dag: Niriba pam bɛn nyɛ tipawumlinima, ka lan nyɛ bɛn tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ chɔɣima ni bɛn yɔhindi niriba beni, di bahi bamdi yɛdaniŋdiba bɛn na kul doli Yɛhudianim adiini soli kaya la.
en: This is important, because there are many people who refuse to obey—people who talk about worthless things and mislead others. I am talking especially about those who say that men who are not Jews must be circumcised to please God.

dag: Ka ŋun bi be nyam maa yi shihi binshɛlikam, di ni leei din bi be nyam, ka ŋunkam mi shihi li ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni.
en: Whatever an unclean person touches is unclean, and anyone else who touches it remains unclean until evening.

dag: Ti ni tɔɣisiri zuɣu ni kpahibu yɛl shɛŋa yɛla ŋɔ daliri nyɛla ni di kpaŋsi yurilim din yiri suhu din ka daɣiri mini suhu ni tɛha din ka galimi ni yɛda niŋbu maŋli ni na.
en: You must teach people to have genuine love, as well as a good conscience and true faith.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ Yisifu binyɛrigu maa sɔŋ baɣil omaŋ hal ka Yisifu dan maa ti kuna.
en: She kept his robe with her until Joseph's master came home.

dag: ka a kɔrigi piɛlaa maa, ka zaŋ o ʒim shɛli n-laɣi Aduna min o bidibisi maa nudiriti tib nyaɣa mini bɛ nudiriti nubihilɔri ni bɛ nudiriti napombihilɔri, ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam zaa.
en: Kill the ram and place some of its blood on Aaron's right ear lobe, his right thumb, and the big toe of his right foot. Do the same for each of his sons and splatter the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.

dag: yɛli, Doo ŋɔ daa yɛliya ni o mali yiko din ni tooi wurim Naawuni jɛmbu duu la, ka lan me li daba ata sunsuuni.
en: and said, This man said, I am able to tear down God's Temple and three days later build it back up.

dag: Bee miri ka a tum zina.
en: Be faithful in marriage.

dag: Amaa galimi ni ka m biɛhigu ni zuɣu, a sɔŋ ma, ka zaŋ ma zal a tooni sahakam.
en: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl neesim ni leei buɣim zilinli. Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni leei buɣim zilinli n-di o gɔhi mini suligunyinyari dahin yini.
en: The light of Israel will become a fire, its holy one a flame, which will burn and devour its thorns and thistles in a single day.

dag: Nyɛvili din ka bahigu maa nyɛla ni ninsalinim baŋ nyin ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maŋli ŋɔ, ka baŋ man Yisa Masia so a ni timna la.
en: Eternal life is to know you, the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, the one you sent.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dinzuɣu nyamiya, n je anabi shɛb bɛn zuri n yɛligu bɛ tab sani la.
en: Therefore, Im against the prophets who steal my words from each other, declares the LORD.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa o ni ti ŋmaligi yɛli bɛn ʒe o nuzaa polo la mi, Yinim bahiyolinim ŋɔ, wariya ti kpe azaaba buɣim shɛl ni Naawuni ni daa mali gu Sintani min o malaikanim la.
en: Then he will say to those on his left, Get away from me, you who will receive terrible things. Go into the unending fire that has been prepared for the devil and his angels.

dag: Di saha ka o daa lan yɛli Ibram, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun daa yih a Ur din be Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a ka a su li.
en: Then the Lord said to him, I am the Lord , who led you out of Ur in Babylonia, to give you this land as your own.

dag: Sɛt ni daa dɔɣi Ɛnɔsh maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni ayopɔin. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: Seth had more children.

dag: Ka o ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Ka yi mi lee yɛli ni n nyɛla ŋuni? Ka Pita garigi yɛl o, A nyɛla Masia, Naawuni ni tim so na.
en: He asked them, And what about you? Who do you say that I am? Peter answered, The Christ sent from God.

dag: Amaa bɛ nyina ni daa na gbab nimdi maa ka di na bi lu bɛ puuni saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi niriba maa zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka alɔbo titali lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: While there was still plenty of meat for them to eat, the Lord became angry with the people and caused an epidemic to break out among them.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Yisifu, Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ daa yi n zuɣu Luz Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: Jacob said to Joseph, Almighty God appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan and blessed me.

dag: Dama ŋuna n-yɛri sakuɣa, Lum tiŋgban ni, ka yɛli sa titali ŋɔ, Lumina pam.
en: He says to the snow, Fall on the earth. And he says to the rain, Pour down on the earth.

dag: Bɛ ni ti daai Taai goma luhi, ka wurim di binwɔɣila, ka n ti yihi di taŋkpaɣu ka chɛ ka di kpalim tampin nɛli doya.
en: When they destroy the walls of Tyre and throw down its towers, I will scrape off all its dirt and make it into a bare rock.

dag: Bɛ ni be yi sani yi sunsuuni tin shɛli bɛ ni pii yi tinsi maa ni ka di nyɛ din viɛl bɛ sani. Miriya ka yi ti muɣisi ba.
en: Instead, you must let them choose which one of your towns they want to live in. Don't be cruel to runaway slaves.

dag: Nɛbo — pihinunaayi.
en: The family of Nebo.

dag: Di ni ti leei teeku sunsuuni luɣ shɛli bɛ ni deeni lansi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. Di ni leei niriba ni yɛn ŋmɛri diri nɛma luɣ shɛli.
en: Fishermen will dry their nets on it, there where it stands in the sea. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken. The nations will plunder Tyre.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa bi garig o. Ka o nyaandoliba balim o yɛli, Karim paɣ maa, dama o kuhiri doli ti.
en: But Jesus did not say a word to her. His disciples came to him and begged him, Send her away! She is following us and making all this noise.

dag: Amaa nyin min a niriba ŋɔ na bi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ zɔbu kpɛhi yi kɔbili ni.
en: But I know that you and your officials dont really fear and respect the Lord yet.

dag: Bɛ dim maa zaŋla ziŋgoo gbahi bɛ zaa, ka zaŋ o laŋa n-vo ba na ti niŋ o daasau ni, ka di niŋ o nyaɣisim ka o suhu paligi.
en: The Chaldean brings all of them up with a fishhook. He drags them away with a net; he collects them in his fishing net, then he rejoices and celebrates.

dag: Ka Shimɛi daa kul turi ba ka yɛra, Wara, wara, nyin ninvuɣ kur ŋɔ, nyin ninvuɣ yoli ŋɔ.
en: This is what Shimei said as he cursed David: Get out of here! Get out of here! You are a murderer! You are despicable!.

dag: Yi ni tooi chɛ ka nandaamba birim bɛ nia lɔbu ni, amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.

dag: Vinnyaɣili chɛ ka fara gbaari nira, amaa ka tuma tumbu viɛnyɛliŋga mi chɛ ka nir leeri bundana.
en: Laziness brings poverty; hard work makes one rich.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim maa mini Firawuna yuri ni chɛchɛbunsi ni wɔribariba zaa ni o tɔbbihi zaa daa doli Izraɛlnim maa ti paai ba, ka bɛ dola teeku noli luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Pihahirɔt din daa be Baalizɛfɔn tooni polo la.
en: The Egyptian army, with all the horses, chariots, and drivers, pursued them and caught up with them where they were camped by the Red Sea near Pi Hahiroth and Baal Zephon.

dag: Miriya ka yi taɣi Naawuni Shia Kasi zali;.
en: Dont suppress the Spirit.

dag: dama Yawɛ yɛli ma, Miri ka a di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom nimaani bee n doli so shɛli a ni di doli kana labi. .
en: The Lord said I can't eat or drink anything and that I can't go home the same way I came.

dag: Bihi n-nahindi n niriba, ka paɣiba su ba. N niriba, yi zuɣulaannima m-birigi ya, ka chɛ ka yi tum yi soya.
en: Even children will defeat my people, and women will rule over them. My people, your guides lead you the wrong way, and they destroy the path you should follow.

dag: N ni zaŋ sara maligu shɛŋa ti ni mali nyɔri buɣim la n-ka a jɛmbu duu na; n ni zaŋ binshɛŋa n ni po pɔri ni n zaŋ ti a la ti a;.
en: So I bring sacrifices to your Temple. When I was in trouble, I asked for help and made promises to you. Now I am giving you what I promised.

dag: A yɛligu nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, dinzuɣu zaŋm a yɛlimaŋli maa m-mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: Your word is the truth. So let this truth make them completely yours.

dag: Bɛ malila bindirigu dibu shili, ka yɛrigi kpahisi sɔŋ nimaani, ka bɛ ʒini di ka nyu. Ka sapashin kpamba yiɣisi niŋ kpam mali bɛ nyɔtaɣirisi.
en: In Babylon the high officials were having a feast. They were eating and drinking, when someone shouted, Officers, take your places! Grab your shields.

dag: dama ninsal sujee mini Naawuni wuntia tuma bi dol taba.
en: Anger does not help you live the way God wants.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu n-kariti bɛn kɔhiri nɛma yihiri.
en: When Jesus entered the temple, he started chasing out the people who were selling things.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, Nyamiya, yi yi chaŋ yin chamiya ti sɔɣi dɔni tiŋ maa gulinyaaŋa; di kaɣiya ti do katiŋa ka chɛ tiŋ maa, ka maliya shili viɛnyɛliŋga gu;.
en: He commanded them, Look. You are to ambush the city from behind. Dont move too far away from the city. Be ready, all of you.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa jɛm Yawɛ Jɔshua ni daa be o nyɛvil ni saha shɛl la zaa zaŋ tabili zuɣulaannim shɛb bɛn daa be Jɔshua kum nyaaŋa, ka daa mi Yawɛ ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa ti Izraɛlnim la yɛla.
en: Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua. They had known every act the LORD had done for Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu sokam bɔɣiri ni cheei kom, ka bɛ ku lan mali suhukpeeni.
en: Then all hands will fall limp; every human heart will melt.

dag: Ka bɛn daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa bɔhi, Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tiligi.
en: The people who heard him asked, Who, then, can be saved.

dag: ka yihi bɛn daa be dabitim ni bɛ bebu puuni zaa kum dabiɛm zuɣu la bahi.
en: He set free those who were held in slavery their entire lives by their fear of death.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni daa niŋ shɛm nyɛla, di daa chɛ ka alahichi tumbu galisi; amaa alahichi tumbu ni galisi shɛm maa Naawuni daalibarika galisiya gari lala.
en: Law was introduced in order to increase wrongdoing; but where sin increased, God's grace increased much more.

dag: O daa ku na kara. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the one who struck down great kings— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Ka tintariga maa ni lan kpuɣi ni n-zaŋ hal ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni, di tariga yɛn nyɛla Teeku Kpiŋ ni. Yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa mini di tintarisi din gil li m-bala.
en: The border will descend to the Jordan. Its limit will be the Dead Sea. This will be your land with its borders all around.

dag: Nudirigu polo din buɣisibu ti yɛn nyɛ kilomita ayi ni mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu la ni ti malila dunɔdaya ata. Simiɔn zuliya dunɔdali mini Isaka zuliya dunɔdali ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya dunɔdali.
en: There are three gates on the south side measuring . miles: one gate for Simeon, one gate for Issachar, and one gate for Zebulun.

dag: M mabihi mini n zɔnim zuɣu, n ni yɛli, Chɛ ka suhudoo be a ni.
en: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.

dag: Ka naa suhu daa ti giri zaŋ chaŋ Amnɔn kum maa polo, o ni daa nya ka o lan kani maa zuɣu, ka o suhu lan yu ni o kari Absalom naba.
en: King David was comforted after Amnon died, but he missed Absalom very much.

dag: Ka so yi paŋ biŋkɔbigu o kpee sani, ka biŋkɔbigu maa ti kpi bee n-nya daŋa, ka bindana maa kani, di simdi ka ŋun paŋ o maa yo o samli zaa;.
en: When someone borrows an animal from another and it is injured or dies while the owner isnt present, full payment must be made.

dag: Hal n ni pa so dabili maa zaa yoli, n zaŋ mmaŋ leela sokam zaa dabili din ni chɛ ka n tooi tiligi niriba pahi.
en: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.

dag: Ka daɣila di daa bi simdi ni Masia nya wahala ŋɔ zaa ka naanyi nya jilima.
en: Was it not necessary for the Messiah to suffer these things and then to enter his glory.

dag: Ka Yawɛ jilima daa yiɣisi zani chɛrubinim maa zuɣusaa n-chaŋ ti tam Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunɔbia zuɣu, ka sagbani maa daa pali duu maa puuni. Ka Yawɛ jilima neesim daa pali dundɔŋ maa.
en: and the brightness of the Lord 's glory moved from above the creatures and stopped at the entrance of the temple. The entire temple was filled with his glory, and the courtyard was dazzling bright.

dag: Yawɛ, a nyɛla ŋun wumdi nandaamba suhigu; ka lan nyɛ ŋun kpaŋsiri bɛ suhuri, ka ni gbilis a tibili wum.
en: You will listen, O Lord , to the prayers of the lowly; you will give them courage.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Anatɔtnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku a la polo m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛ yɛra, Miri ka a lan zaŋ Yawɛ yuli tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa yaha, di yi pa lala ti ni ku a.
en: The people of Anathoth wanted me killed, and they told me that they would kill me if I kept on proclaiming the Lord 's message.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o viɛla, ka o yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Praise the Lord because he is good to us, and his love never fails.

dag: N yi yɛli, N ni tam n fabila maa yɛla, ka yihi suhugarigu ŋɔ n suhu ni, ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: I could say, I will not complain. I will forget my pain and put a smile on my face.

dag: Ti yi nyɛla bɛn zuɣuri lɛbigi, di nyɛla Naawuni zuɣu; ka ti yi nyɛla ninvuɣ maŋa, di nyɛla yi zuɣu.
en: If we are crazy, its for Gods sake. If we are rational, its for your sake.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Bɛ daa tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa yɛla, ka ŋmaligi jɛmdila Baalnim mini Ashɛranima.
en: The Lord saw that the Israelites did evil things. They forgot about the Lord their God and served the false gods Baal and Asherah.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim ni zɔri Juda tiŋgbɔŋnima, ka bɛ yi ti boli Juda yuli bɛ ni so sani, dabiɛm ni gbaag o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni lɔri nia shɛli zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo zuɣu.
en: The land of Judah brings fear to everyone in Egypt. Anyone in Egypt who hears the name Judah will be afraid. This will happen because the Lord All-Powerful has planned terrible things to happen to Egypt.

dag: ka alizin biɛri maa daa balim o yɛli, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim ŋɔ ni.
en: Send us into the pigs! they begged. Let us go into the pigs.

dag: Kaman kom ni nyuui biaŋ ni, ka kulibɔŋ kom nyuui ka di kuui shɛm la.
en: Water vanishes from the sea; a river dries up completely.

dag: amaa Masia dapulli zuɣu kum yɛla waazu ka tinim yihira. Yɛhudianim sani di nyɛla kuɣituurili, ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mi sani di nyɛla jɛrilim;.
en: But this is the message we tell everyone: Christ was killed on a cross. This message is a problem for Jews, and to other people it is nonsense.

dag: Bɛ daanzinfa bee bɛ salima ti ku tooi tiligi ba Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili dabisili maa dali. O suhuyiɣisili buɣim ni ti di dunia ŋɔ zaa. Dama o ni ti chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam naai naari biɛɣu.
en: Moreover, their silver and their gold wont be able to deliver them on the day of the LORDs fury. His jealousy will devour the entire land with fire; he will make an end, a truly horrible one, for all the inhabitants of the land.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli biriginsim soli, Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba pahi tuumbiɛrinim zuɣu n-darigi bɛ tibili. Naawuni tim Izraɛlnim suhudoo!.
en: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!.

dag: ni salima alali firila tamdisi din diba anu daa ʒe Luɣ Kasi shee tooni nudirigu polo, ka diba anu mi ʒe di nuzaa polo la ni tipuma kɔtomsi ni firilanim ni salima gbabɔnima.
en: the lampstands of pure gold, five on the right and five on the left in front of the inner sanctuary; the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs of gold.

dag: Ka daa zaŋ Kum mini Kpiimba Biɛhigu Shee maa bahi buɣim teeku ni. Buɣim teeku maa ni kpɛbu n-nyɛ kum din pahi buyi la.
en: Then Death and the Grave were thrown into the fiery lake. This, the fiery lake, is the second death.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa malaikanim ni daa tɔɣisi la kahigi wuhi ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka ŋunkam daa bi dol li bee n-deei di noli yi daa nya tibidarigibo din simd o.
en: The message given to our ancestors by the angels was shown to be true, and those who did not follow it or obey it received the punishment they deserved.

dag: Ka anabinim shɛb bɛn daa be Bɛtɛl daa yina ti bɔhi Ilaisha, A mi ni Yawɛ ni kpuɣ a zuɣulan maa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-chaŋ ka chɛ a bebɔ? Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛli ba, Iin, m mi. Amaa shiniya yi noli.
en: A group of prophets who lived there went to Elisha and asked him, Do you know that the Lord is going to take your master away from you today? Yes, I know, Elisha answered. But let's not talk about it.

dag: sapashini maa daa yɛlila Naawuni nir maa, Hal Yawɛ yi yooi zuɣusaa soya bahi gba, lala ku tooi niŋ! Ka Naawuni nir maa yɛl o, A nini sa ni nya bindirigu maa, amaa ka a noli lee ku to li.
en: to which the officer had answered, That can't happen—not even if the Lord himself were to send grain at once! And Elisha had replied, You will see it happen, but you won't get to eat any of the food.

dag: ni nanim shɛb bɛn daa be nuzaa polo zoya zuɣu tinsi ni la ni Araba din daa be Kinɛrɔt nudirigu polo la ni tintan ni tinsi la nima ni Nafɔtido din daa be wulinluhili polo la nima.
en: and to the kings of the north in the hill country and in the desert. Jabin sent the message to the kings of the Kinnereth, the Negev, and the western foothills. He also sent the message to the king of Naphoth Dor in the west.

dag: Amaa nyini zanim baɣili ma kpe, ka n yɛl a fukumsi zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, ka a zaŋ wuhi ba ka bɛ ti dol li n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba ni bɛ su maa ni.
en: But you, Moses, must stay here with me. I will tell you all the commandments, the regulations, and the case laws that you must teach the Israelites to do in the land that I am giving them to possess.

dag: Ka so yi tum taali zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim shɛli polo, di simdi ni o zani yim zaŋ chaŋ o ni tum taal shɛli maa polo.
en: at that point, when you have become guilty of sin in one of these ways, you must confess how you have sinned.

dag: ka zaŋ anzinfa mali di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu pihinahi. Ka dapaɣ yini ni ti mali di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ayi, ka dapaɣili kam ti mali diba ayi, ka di dashɛbir ayi shɛb di ni.
en: Then make forty silver bases to go under the twenty boards. There will be two bases under the first board for its two pegs, two bases under the next board for its two pegs, and so on.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaayɔbu ni kɔbisinu.
en: His military unit and those enlisted in it are .

dag: Ka o ni ti ti yinim bɛn diri wahala ŋɔ zaŋ tabili ti gba vuhim. O ni ti niŋla lala saha shɛli ti Duuma Yisa min o malaikanim yi ti yi palo zuɣusaa siɣirina o yiko mini buɣim din diri puuni.
en: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels.

dag: Di tuhiya a sani ni a niŋ a ni zaŋ a nuhi tum tuun shɛli alaka ka lihi ʒiɛm li, ka lee yurila ninvuɣ biɛri ni lo shɛli?.
en: Do you enjoy hurting me? Do you enjoy ignoring me while smiling at what evil people say?.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim zaa daa naanyi gbi la kɔbilisi gili Nail Mɔɣili maa ni bɛ nya kɔnyurim, dama bɛ daa naan ku tooi lan nyu Nail Mɔɣili kom maa yaha.
en: All the Egyptians dug along the bank of the river for drinking water, because they were not able to drink water from the river.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ nahu mini buŋa n-tabili taba ni bɛ ko.
en: Do not hitch an ox and a donkey together for plowing.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisiyinika puuni gol so ŋun pahir anu daba ayopɔin dali, ka Babilɔn naa kpambal so ŋun daa nyɛ o tɔbbihi sapashin kpeen so ŋun yuli daa booni Nɛbuzaradan la daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: On the seventh day of the fifth month of the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia, Nebuzaradan, adviser to the king and commander of his army, entered Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ ni me goon shɛŋa din du ka mali yaa taɣi bɛmaŋ la zaa ni kab lu tiŋ dahim zaa.
en: The walls of their fortresses will be knocked down and scattered in the dirt.

dag: Di pa shɛli o ni taɣ o tɛha, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka yi nya atam pam. Dina n-ni chɛ ka yi zaŋ chi mini wain ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Perhaps the Lord your God will change his mind and bless you with abundant crops. Then you can offer him grain and wine.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna, A bihi bɛn be a ʒiɛman ni zaa ŋun mali dalinli, ŋun miri ka o mirina ni o ti zaŋ o Naawuni bindirigu mali sara.
en: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other.

dag: Ŋuna n-ni ti me jɛmbu duu ti ma jilima. N ni ti leeg o ba, ka o mi leei m bia, ka n chɛ ka o nam mali yaa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni sahakam.
en: He will be the one to build a temple for my name. Hell become my son, and Ill become his father, and Ill establish his royal throne over Israel forever.

dag: dama zuliya kam pun nyu o kɔr biɛri wain la, ka dunia nanim niŋ zina o sani, ka dunia kɔhigɔriba niŋ bundaannima o kɔr biɛri din galisi pam maa zuɣu.
en: All the peoples of the earth have drunk the wine of her sexual sin and of Gods anger. The rulers of the earth sinned sexually with her, and the merchants of the world grew rich from the great wealth of her luxury.

dag: Ka niriba daa yi daŋdi yibu chan o sani Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni ti wumd o yɛtɔɣa.
en: All the people rose early in the morning to hear him in the temple area.

dag: hal nti paai dahin shɛli o ni daa ti o tuun shɛb o ni pii la zaligu Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ka lab alizanda ni la.
en: until the day he was taken up to heaven. Before he was taken up, he gave instructions by the power of the Holy Spirit to the men he had chosen as his apostles.

dag: ni o kpaŋsi yi suhuri zaa, ka chɛ ka yi mali kpiɔŋ yi zaɣ suŋ kam tumbu mini yi yɛtɔɣ suŋ kam tɔɣisibu ni.
en: May he encourage your hearts and give you strength in every good thing you do or say.

dag: Nyin ka n vili gbibi, ka a nudirigu kul gbib ma ka n ku lu.
en: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka malaika ŋuni maa garigi yɛli: Di ni niŋ biɛɣ tusaayi ni kɔbisita. Di nyaaŋa ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni lan lab mali zani di zaashee.
en: The other answered, It will be , evenings and mornings before the temple is dedicated and in use again.

dag: Amaa yinim ta li daɣiri yi ni yɛli ni ti Duuma bindirigu shee bi be nyam, ka di bindirigu maa nyɛ bɛ ni ni tooi ʒiɛm shɛl la zuɣu.
en: But you people show that you dont respect my name. You say that the Lords altar is unclean. And you dont like the food from that altar.

dag: Musa daa yi zaŋ o nuu duhi zuɣusaa, Izraɛlnim nyarila yaa n-tuhiri nyandi Amalɛknim maa, o mi daa yi ti zaŋ o nuu siɣisi tiŋa, Amalɛknim maa nyarila yaa n-tuhir nyɛndi Izraɛlnim maa.
en: As long as Moses held up his arms, the Israelites won, but when he put his arms down, the Amalekites started winning.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba piniyini la daa chaŋ Galili zo shɛli zuɣu Yisa ni daa wuhi ba la.
en: Now the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus told them to go.

dag: Ka daɣila yi tɛhiya ni Naawuni ŋun ku kari saria n-ti o ninvuɣ gahindi shɛb bɛn suhir o wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ kam la nasara? O ku sɔŋ ba yomyom?.
en: Wont God provide justice to his chosen people who cry out to him day and night? Will he be slow to help them?.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa boli Musa mini Aduna na yomyom ti yɛli ba, N tum taali Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa sani ni yi gba sani.
en: Then the king hurriedly called Moses and Aaron and said, I have sinned against the Lord your God and against you.

dag: Ka malaika so ŋun daa daŋ tooni na maa yɛli malaika so ŋun doli nyaaŋa na maa, Guui chaŋ ti yɛli nachimbil so ŋun mali bimbuɣisirigu maa ni niriba pam mini niɣi pam n-yɛn be Jɛrusalɛm; ka di be kaman tiŋkpansi din ka goma la.
en: He said to him, Run! Say to this young man: Jerusalem will be inhabited like open fields because of the throngs of people and cattle inside it.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Zɔri, ŋuni n-lee zaŋ ma leei yi sariakarita bee yi falitarita.
en: But Jesus said to him, Who said I should be your judge or decide how to divide your fathers things between you two.

dag: Ka kpim maa dii neei kum ni n-yiɣisi ʒini gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, ka Yisa zaŋ o ti o ma maa.
en: Then the boy sat up and began to talk, and Jesus gave him back to his mother.

dag: Ka du shɛli din daa ʒe Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee duu maa tooni wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita pisaayika.
en: The room in front of the Most Holy Place was feet long.

dag: Amaa o ni yɛli shɛm maa yi nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka shɛhira shɛli kani din wuhiri ni paɣisarili maa daa nyɛla ŋun pali.
en: But if the charge is true and there is no proof that she was a virgin.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala maa, ka ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa n-nya Yisa ka o ʒiɛya, amaa ka o lee bi baŋ ni Yisa m-bala.
en: When Mary said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there. But she did not know that it was Jesus.

dag: Ka paɣ bundan maa daa ti yɛl o yidana, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni do so ŋun doli yiri ti sanna waawaayili ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ninvuɣ gahindili.
en: The woman said to her husband, Look, I can see that Elisha is a holy man of God. He passes by our house all the time.

dag: Amaa nyin bi taɣira, ka a yuma mi ka tariga.
en: You are always the same. You are God for all time.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim suhuri daa yiɣisi ka bɛ ŋmɛr o ni yɛli shɛm maa naŋgbankpeeni ka bɔhiri taba, Wula ka doo ŋɔ ni tooi zaŋ o niŋgbuŋ ti ti ka ti ŋubi.
en: This started an angry argument among them. How can this man give us his flesh to eat? they asked.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be muɣisigu ni mini sama ni daa doli shɛba ni bɛnkam nini daa bi lan tiɣi bɛ biɛhigu zaa daa zo n-chaŋ o sani ka o ti leei bɛ zuɣulana. Ka bɛn daa be o sani maa zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi.
en: People who were oppressed or in debt or dissatisfied went to him, about four hundred men in all, and he became their leader.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna.
en: Then the Lord said to Aaron.

dag: ni Ashan mini di momaha tiŋgbana ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi mini di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: Ashan, Juttah, and Beth Shemesh. They got all the cities and the fields around them.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa doli yiini yila, ka ŋmɛri mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnima ni dawulɛnima ni guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa, ka piɛbiri kikahi n-wari waa ni bɛ yaa zaa Naawuni tooni.
en: while David and all Israel celebrated in Gods presence with all their strength, accompanied by songs, zithers, harps, tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.

dag: Ka anabi Aizaia daa ka Naa Hɛzɛkia sanna nti bɔh o, Ya ka niriba ŋɔ lee yina, ka wula ka bɛ lee yɛl a? Ka Hɛzɛkia garigi yɛl o, Bɛ yila katiŋ na; Babilɔn ka bɛ yina.
en: Isaiah asked Hezekiah, Where did these men come from? What did they want? They came all the way from Babylonia, Hezekiah answered.

dag: N nyɛla ŋun pɔra ka bɛ ʒiɛm ma, amaa m bi tam a zaligunim yɛla.
en: I am unimportant and despised, but I do not neglect your teachings.

dag: Man ŋuna, di pala m malila baŋsim gari sokam zuɣu ka Naawuni kahigi ashili maa gbinni wuhi ma maa, amaa o niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka nyin naa baŋ zahindi maa gbinni mini tɛhi shɛŋa din daa ka a sanna maa gbinni.
en: Now this mystery was revealed to me, not because I have more wisdom than any other living person but so that the dreams meaning might be made known to the king, and so that you might know the thoughts of your own mind.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa ti paai tiŋkpan shɛli, ka paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Maata zaŋ o ti kpɛh o yiŋa.
en: While Jesus and his followers were traveling, he went into a town, and a woman named Martha let him stay at her house.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zaŋmiya yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la nimdi pahi yi sara maligunim nimdi zuɣu ŋubi.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, says: Go and offer as many burnt offerings and sacrifices as you want. Eat the meat of those sacrifices yourselves.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ din be daadam suhu ni ka pa ni daadam maŋmaŋ shia din be o ni maa zuɣu? Lala ka so gba ku tooi baŋ din be Naawuni suhu ni ka pa ni Naawuni Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: Who knows a persons depths except their own spirit that lives in them? In the same way, no one has known the depths of God except Gods Spirit.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa yi ti bi saɣi ni o dol a na, dindina a yi m pɔri ŋɔ taali ni; ka lee miri ka a zaŋ m bia maa kulisi nimaani.
en: If the woman wont agree to come back with you, you will be free from this obligation to me. Only dont take my son back there.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa wum ni Shɛkɛm saɣim o bipuɣiŋga Daina, amaa ka o daa di suɣilo shini hal ka o bidibisi bɛn daa mali niɣi be mɔɣu ni la ti kuna.
en: Jacob learned that his daughter had been disgraced, but because his sons were out in the fields with his livestock, he did nothing until they came back.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim mi n-ni ti zani Ɛbal zoli zuɣu n-yɛli noli dibu yɛtɔɣa maa. Bɛna n-nyɛ: Rubin zuliya niriba mini Gaad zuliya niriba ni Asha zuliya niriba ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba ni Dan zuliya niriba ni Naftali zuliya niriba.
en: And these tribes will stand on Mount Ebal to read the curses: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

dag: Hal o daa mɛla buɣa jɛmbu shee Juda zoya tinsi ni, ka daa chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛmnim bi lan ʒe yim, ka lan chɛ ka Judanim birigi.
en: He even built pagan places of worship in the Judean highlands and led the people of Judah and Jerusalem to sin against the Lord .

dag: Niriba ayi yi vara, bɛ ni yino ni luh o kpee, amaa niriba ayi ni tooi luhi ninvuɣ yino. Mih ata gabiga bi chihiri yom.
en: Two people can resist an attack that would defeat one person alone. A rope made of three cords is hard to break.

dag: O daa lan tum alahiziba tuma Ham tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka daa lan tum tuun shɛŋa din mali dabiɛm Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: He did amazing things there in Hams country ! He did awesome things at the Red Sea!.

dag: Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Ishimail bidibisi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ yuya m-boli bɛ tiŋkpansi mini bɛ ni daa be luɣ shɛŋa. Bɛ daa nyɛla toondaannim pinaayi bɛ zuliyanim ni.
en: These were the names of Ishmaels sons. Each son had his own camp that became a small town. The twelve sons were leaders over their own people.

dag: Yi nyɛla ti shɛhiranima, ka Naawuni gba di ti shɛhira m-pahi yi zuɣu ni zaŋ chaŋ yinim bɛn nyɛ yɛdaniŋdiba ŋɔ polo, ti biɛhigu wuhiya ni ti dolila wuntia soli ka tumdi din tuhi ka ka galimi.
en: When we were there with you believers, we were pure, honest, and without fault in the way we lived. You know, just as God does, that this is true.

dag: ka o yɛl o dɔɣira maa, Naomi ŋun yi Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la mali tiŋgbani din nyɛ ti dɔɣira Ɛlimɛlɛk dini m-bɔri ni o kɔhi li.
en: Boaz said to the redeemer, Naomi, who has returned from the field of Moab, is selling the portion of the field that belonged to our brother Elimelech.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla bɛ biɛhigu puuni zaa, bɛ bela zibisim ni n-dira ni suhuyiɣisili mini sujee, ka dɔriti gbaari ba.
en: Besides all this, they are always gloomy at mealtime, and they are troubled, sick, and bitter.

dag: Ka yil maa lana daa yi bɛ sani ti yɛli ba, M mabihi, doo maa nyɛla n sana, dinzuɣu di tumiya tuun biɛɣu ŋɔ bee n-tum vi tuuni ŋɔ.
en: The old man went outside and said, My friends, please don't commit such a horrible crime against a man who is a guest in my house.

dag: mini Bɛndɛka ŋun daa be Makaz la ni Shaalibim ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi ni Ɛlɔnbɛtihanan.
en: Bendeker: the cities of Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh, Elon, and Beth Hanan.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa malim shili n-ka Jɛhɔshafat Vinvamli ni na. Ka n ti ʒin nimaani n-kari zuliya kam bɛn gili luɣilikam zaa la saria.
en: Wake up, nations! Come to Jehoshaphat Valley. There I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni ti kpihim kum birili, ka nyahi sokam zaa nintam, ka vuui o niriba ni nyari filiŋ shɛl la dunia ŋɔ ni zaa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Sovereign Lord will destroy death forever! He will wipe away the tears from everyone's eyes and take away the disgrace his people have suffered throughout the world. The Lord himself has spoken.

dag: Ka bɛ zaŋ kpahi din wɔɣilim nyɛ milimita pisopɔinnaanu n-kpahi gili di puuni zaa. Teebuya maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa yɛn zaŋdi sara maligu nimdi para.
en: Hooks, three inches wide, were securely fixed all the way around. The tables were for the flesh of the offerings.

dag: Ka yuma din kpalim maa yi na galisi, ŋun yom o ni daa deei laɣ shɛli yuma maa zuɣu, ka di nyɛ o ni yo laɣ shɛli ni o deeg omaŋa.
en: If there are still many years before the year of Jubilee, the one sold must give back a large part of the price. It all depends on the number of years.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛsta daa boli Hatak ŋun daa nyɛ nayili namɔɣili so naa ni daa zaŋ ti o ni o sɔŋd o la na nti yɛl o ni o cham ti bɔhi Mɔdɛkai nya din niŋ o ni din tahi lala na.
en: Esther then sent for Hathach, one of the royal eunuchs whose job it was to wait on her. She ordered him to go to Mordecai and find out what was going on and why he was acting this way.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb ni ti kpalim Jɛrusalɛm mini Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ loya ni o chɛ ka di niŋ lala.
en: Those who remain will go out from Jerusalem, and those who survive will go out from Mount Zion. The zeal of the LORD of heavenly forces will do this.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Yi na mi n-nya ka nir nyo firila zaŋ lɔɣu pil li bee n-zaŋ li zali garo lɔŋni, ka pa ni firila tamdigu zuɣu?.
en: Jesus also said: You don't light a lamp and put it under a clay pot or under a bed. Don't you put a lamp on a lampstand?.

dag: Di saha man gba ni saɣi ni amaŋmaŋ nudirigu ni tooi ti a nasara.
en: Then I, even I, will praise you, for your strong hand has delivered you.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka niriba pam niŋ o yɛda.
en: After Jesus said this, many of the people put their faith in him.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti boli niriba na ti yɛli ba, Luɣimiya yi tiba wum ka baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni:.
en: Jesus called the people to him. He said, Listen and understand what I am saying.

dag: Ka ʒiɛman shɛli din dolina puuni, yi bihi yi ti yiɣisina yi kalinsi nyaaŋa bee saan so yi ti yi tinshee katiŋ na n-nya Yawɛ ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli mini nahiŋgu shɛli paai tiŋgbani maa.
en: Future generations, your children after you, or foreigners from distant lands will say: Look at all that lands plagues and the sicknesses that the LORD laid on it!.

dag: Di saha ka shɛb dii tuhiri nintɔri viɛr o, ka pɔb o nina ka ŋmɛr o ka yɛra, Wuhim ti a daanabitali ni nyɛ shɛm. Ka bɛn daa guli Yisa maa gba ŋmɛr o.
en: Some of them began to spit on Jesus, and they blindfolded him and hit him. Guess who hit you! they said. And the guards took him and slapped him.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ suhudoolana ka daa neei ti Duuma Yisa ŋun nyɛ Piɛgul Suŋ o daalikauli din ka bahigu ʒim zuɣu kum ni la.
en: May the God of peace, who brought back the great shepherd of the sheep, our Lord Jesus, from the dead by the blood of the eternal covenant.

dag: Ka so yi ti yɛn nahim ba, buɣim ni yi bɛ ni na n-di bɛn nyɛ bɛ dimnim maa, ka ŋunkam ti yɛn nahim ba lala n-yɛn niŋ o ka o kpi.
en: Any enemy who tries to harm them will be destroyed by the fire that comes out of their mouths.

dag: N ni lo ni n niŋ dunia ŋɔ zaa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N teegi n nuu ni n-darigi niriba tibili.
en: This is the plan that has been made for all the earth; this is the hand extended over all the nations.

dag: Miriya ka yi dihi yɔhiŋgu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ tabili. Dina n-nyɛ: Yawɛ jɛmbu duu m-bɔŋɔ, Yawɛ jɛmbu duu m-bɔŋɔ, Yawɛ jɛmbu duu m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Stop believing those deceitful words, We are safe! This is the Lord 's Temple, this is the Lord 's Temple, this is the Lord 's Temple.

dag: Ka Pool daa tɔɣisi ba yɛlimaŋtali mini maŋgbibbu ni zaadali saria karibu yɛla, ka dabiɛm gbaai Gomna Filiksi ka o yɛli Pool, Na yim pɔi; n yi ti lan nya dahima, n ni bol a.
en: When he spoke about upright behavior, self-control, and the coming judgment, Felix became fearful and said, Go away for now! When I have time, Ill send for you.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa lab kulina maa mini bɛnkam zaa daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ bali bɛ ni, ka woligi bɛmaŋ ka chɛ zuliya shɛb bɛn daa be nimaani daɣiri tuma ni bɛ jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni la zaa daa laɣim di li.
en: The sacrifices were eaten by all the Israelites who had returned from exile and by all those who had given up the pagan ways of the other people who were living in the land and who had come to worship the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan mali oniɣisi kuɣa n-zaŋ li tam salima bintaɣindisi ni, ka zaŋ chiriga chirigi Izraɛl bidibisi la yuya pa di zuɣu kaman bɛ ni chirigiri nintu shɛli bɛ ni mali dihiri binyɛra zuɣu shɛm la.
en: They prepared the gemstones by mounting them in gold settings and engraving on them the names of Israels sons, like an official seal is engraved.

dag: Biŋkɔbiri maa tab dubu saha ka n daa ti zahim zahindi nya ka bulahi bɛn duri buhi maa nyɛla zaɣ bomaboma mini bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ni bɛn nyɛ zaɣ bɔribɔri.
en: When the flocks were mating, I looked up and saw in a dream that the male goats that mounted the flock were striped, speckled, and spotted.

dag: Dabiɛm ni ti gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛ tahima niŋ Itiɔpia ni mini bɛn mali Ijipti nyuri bara la, ka vi gbahi ba.
en: Those who have put their trust in Ethiopia and have boasted about Egypt will be disillusioned, their hopes shattered.

dag: ni daanya sara maligu bimbini la mini di daanya kurupooti ni di dapuhi ni di zuɣu nɛma zaa ni tahili la ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu.
en: the bronze altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;.

dag: Amaa ka o daa tim bɛ sunsuuni gari chaŋ o chandi.
en: but he walked through the middle of the crowd and went his way.

dag: amaa ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa zaŋ ma niŋ piɛɣu ni n-kpuɣ ma tiri tiŋ maa gooni vol ni n-siɣisi tiŋ ha ka n yi o nuu ni.
en: But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.

dag: ka zaŋ o yiko niŋ dabitim ni, ka chɛ o jilima ti ti dimnima.
en: God let his power be held captive, let his glory go to the enemys hand.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa yɛli, N ni chɛ ka yi chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni ti mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa, amaa di chaŋya katiŋ ti yaɣi. Suhimiya Naawuni ti ma.
en: The king said, I will let you go to sacrifice to the Lord , your God, in the desert, if you do not go very far. Pray for me.

dag: Amaa di ni shɛba ni ti gali, bɛ ni ti yihi bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi ka bɛ ka n sanna, ka a yi ti nya bɛ biɛhigu mini bɛ tuma, a suhu ni maai zaŋ chaŋ n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa zaa lu Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu maa polo.
en: Yet a few survivors will be left. Sons and daughters will be brought out to you. When you see their ways and their deeds, you will be consoled for the evil that I inflicted on Jerusalem, for all that I brought against it.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ a niriba Izraɛlnim leeg a dahalali niriba sahakam; ka nyin Yawɛ nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: You have made Israel your own people forever, and you, Lord , have become their God.

dag: Jɛhoyakim bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛkɔnia mini Zɛdɛkia.
en: Jehoiakims sons were Jehoiachin, his son, and Zedekiah, his son.

dag: A yi ti karim gbaŋ ŋɔ naai, nyin zaŋmi li lo n-tabili kuɣili n-zaŋ li ti bahi Yufretiiz Mɔɣili sunsuuni.
en: When you finish praying, tie the scroll to a rock and throw it in the Euphrates River. Then say.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni, Hɛlɔn bia Ɛliab n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from Zebulun, Eliab, Helons son.

dag: Ka yi ni zaŋ yi bimbɔba maa na ti mali gahibu sara vuhim dabisi shɛli dali maa neei biɛɣu, yin kalimiya dabisa hal ti paai bakɔi ayopɔin dɛde.
en: Seven weeks after you offer this bundle of grain, each family must bring another offering of new grain.

dag: Ka juri daa ti kana ni bɛ ti di ba, ka Ibram kari ba.
en: Later, large birds flew down to eat the animals, but Abram chased them away.

dag: N daa nyɛla nandaamba ba; ka daa zaani saamba nyaaŋa bɛ yɛla ni.
en: I was like a father to the poor. I helped people I didnt even know win their case in court.

dag: Wula ka bipala lee yɛn niŋ n-chɛ ka bɛ soya be kasi? A yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm ka bɛ ni doli n-chɛ ka di be kasi.
en: How can a young person live a pure life? By obeying your word.

dag: Dinzuɣu kahigimiya yi daalahichi wuhimi taba, ka suhimiya Naawuni tiri taba, ka di chɛ ka yi nya alaafee. Wuntizɔra nimmoo wunsuhigu mali yiko pam di tuma puuni.
en: So then, confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, so that you will be healed. The prayer of a good person has a powerful effect.

dag: ka a kɔrig o n-zaŋ o ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam zaa.
en: Then slaughter the ram. Take its blood and throw it against all the altars sides.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa, Sa daŋmi yiɣisibu biɛɣ asiba n-chaŋ ti zani Firawuna tooni yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Hiburunim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: The Lord then said to Moses, Early tomorrow morning meet with the king and tell him that the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says, Let my people go, so that they may worship me.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛliya, N ni yihi Judanim gba n sani bahi kaman n ni daa yihi Izraɛlnim bahi shɛm la, ka zaɣisi Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ n ni daa pii tiŋ shɛl la mini du shɛli n ni daa yɛli, Kpe n yɛn nyɛ n jɛmbu shee la. .
en: The Lord said, I will desert the people of Judah, just as I deserted the people of Israel. I will reject Jerusalem, even though I chose it to be mine. And I will abandon this temple built to honor me.

dag: Saa malila ba? Bee ŋuni n-daa lee chɛ ka bɛ dɔɣi maligim din tɔɣiri luri ŋɔ?.
en: Does either the rain or the dew have a father?.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim ni dunɔguliba ni yiliyiiniba ni ninvuɣ shɛba ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba ni Izraɛlnim zaa daa kuli ti ʒini bɛ fɔndi ni. Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ni daa ti zani, di saha Izraɛlnim zaa daa pun ʒini bɛ tinsi ni.
en: The priests, the Levites, the Temple guards, the musicians, many of the ordinary people, the Temple workers—all the people of Israel—settled in the towns and cities of Judah.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Rɛkab bia Jɔnadab kul ku kɔŋ bidibiga ŋun ni jɛmdi ma sahakam. .
en: So the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, says: There will always be a descendant of Jonadab son of Recab to serve me.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti gbahi ba na ti ti o ma; ka o ma daa zaŋ ba duɣi bindir nyaɣisili shɛli o ba ni yuri pam.
en: So Jacob went out and got two goats and brought them to his mother. His mother cooked the goats in the special way that Isaac loved.

dag: So miri ka o ti niŋ bindirigu ti bɛn kumdi kuyila ni o maai bɛ suhuri bɛ kpiimba maa zuɣu bee n-ti ba binnyurigu ni bɛ nyu ka bɛ suhuri maai hal di yi kul nyɛla bɛ banim bee bɛ manim kum zuɣu gba.
en: No one will eat or drink with anyone to offer comfort when a loved one dies. No one will show sympathy, not even for someone who has lost a father or mother.

dag: Ka o ma daa ŋmaligi yɛli yili maa ni bihi, O yi ti yɛli ya ni yi niŋm shɛlikam, yin niŋmiya li.
en: Jesus' mother then told the servants, Do whatever he tells you.

dag: Bihi banim mini bihi manim nya filiŋ a ni. Ka bɛ fari saamba bɛn be bɛ sani nɛma, ka niŋdi kpibisi mini pakoya din bi tuhi.
en: None of you in the city honor your parents. You cheat foreigners and take advantage of widows and orphans.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ, yi nyɛla tuumbiɛri taali ni ʒi shɛb zuɣu. Yi nyɛla bi shɛb bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri. Yi nyɛla bɛn zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ, ka lɛb yi nyaaŋa bir o!.
en: Oh, what a sinful nation! Their guilt is like a heavy weight that they must carry. They are evil, destructive children. They left the Lord and insulted the Holy One of Israel. They turned away and treated him like a stranger.

dag: Hal o ni daa bi tum tuumbiɛ shɛli, ka ʒiri daa ka o nol ni maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa gbi o gballi garila tuumbiɛrinim gbala ni; ka daa sɔɣ o pahi bundan zuɣu.
en: His grave was among the wicked, his tomb with evildoers, though he had done no violence, and had spoken nothing false.

dag: Dabisili din pah ayopɔin dali, zaŋmiya naɣilah ayopɔin mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the seventh day of this festival, you must offer bulls, rams, and lambs that are one year old. There must be nothing wrong with them.

dag: N ni chɛ li ka di bahi yoli. N ku wahi di nyoya ni bahi bee m-mali di ni, ka suligunyinyari mini gɔhi zooi lim li. N ni chɛ ka sagbana ku tɔɣisi kom bahi di ni.
en: I will turn my vineyard into useless land. No one will care for the plants or work in the field. Weeds and thorns will grow there. I will command the clouds not to rain on it.

dag: dama o zali dabisili ni o ti chɛ ka o ni pii so la zaŋ wuntia biɛhigu kari dunianim saria. Lala zuɣu ka o daa neeg o ni daa pii so maa kum ni ni di leei shɛhira sokam zaa sani.
en: He has decided on a day when he will judge all the people in the world in a way that is fair. To do this he will use a man he chose long ago. And he has proved to everyone that this is the man to do it. He proved it by raising him from death.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli ba, Nyama, n zaŋ binyɛra din bindi tiŋgban ni zaa ka mali biɛlim mini tia kam din wala mali kpila n-tin ya ni yi dira;.
en: Then God said, I now give to you all the plants on the earth that yield seeds and all the trees whose fruit produces its seeds within it. These will be your food.

dag: ka bɛ daa nya ka Anabi Musa mini Anabi Ilaija puhi zan o sani ka bɛ min o tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: Then the three disciples saw Moses and Elijah talking with Jesus.

dag: Miri ka a zaŋ a zo bee a ba zo bahi, ka miri ka a ti chaŋ a dɔɣira yiŋa a muɣisigu saha. A ʒiʒiinikpee ŋun be yoma so a mabihi bɛn be katiŋa.
en: Don't desert an old friend of your family or visit your relatives when you are in trouble. A friend nearby is better than relatives far away.

dag: A ni zaŋ binshɛli biri maa kul nyɛla bimbiɛlli ka pa ni bimbilli maŋmaŋa, di pa shɛli di ni nyɛla kabiɛlli bee bimbiɛl shɛli.
en: And when you plant something, what you plant does not have the same body that it will have later. What you plant is only a seed, maybe wheat or something else.

dag: Di saha ka Hanun daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Dauda tuumba maa m-pini ba, ka ŋmahi bɛ binyɛra bɛ sakpuɣa zuɣu, ka bahi ba, ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: Hanun arrested David's officials and had their beards shaved off and their robes cut off just below the waist, and then he sent them away.

dag: Dinzuɣu di gbihiriya, dama yi gba bi mi yi Duuma ni yɛn labina dahin shɛli.
en: Therefore, stay alert! You dont know what day the Lord is coming.

dag: ka me bimbini n-chɛ ka di kuɣa do m-pa tab zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga tam zoli ŋɔ zuɣu n-ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ; ka zaŋ naɣila so ŋun pah ayi la mali sara zaŋ o pa Ashɛra ŋmahinli binwɔɣinli shɛli a ni daai luhi la dari zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim.
en: Then build the right kind of altar for the Lord your God. Build it on this high ground. Then kill and burn the bull on this altar. Use the wood from the Asherah pole to burn your offering.

dag: Yi ŋmanila abie tihi din vuɣisi waɣa. Yi ŋmanila pu shɛŋa din do m-baɣ mɔɣili. Yi ŋmanila aloosi ti shɛŋa Yawɛ ni sa. Yi ŋmanila sida ti shɛŋa din ʒe m-baɣi kom.
en: You are like rows of palm trees planted by the streams. You are like gardens growing by the rivers. You are like sweet-smelling bushes planted by the Lord . You are like cedar trees growing by the water.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n lan yɛri ya, saha kanna, hal di paaya gba, ka kpiimba ni ti wum Naawuni Bia maa kukoli, ka bɛnkam ti wum li ni mali nyɛvili.
en: I tell you for certain the time will come, and it is already here, when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen to it will live!.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka zuliya niŋdi yaa, di nyaaŋa ka o bahi ba yoli. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka zuliya yɛligira, di nyaaŋa ka o zaŋ ba bahi.
en: makes nations prominent and destroys them, expands nations and leads them astray.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni ka o yihi ma bɛn bi niŋ yɛda ka be Judia la nuu ni, ka n ni ti yɛn tum tuun shɛli Jɛrusalɛm la ti tiɣi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be nimaani la nini.
en: Pray that I will be saved from those in Judea who refuse to accept our message. And pray that this help I am bringing to Jerusalem will please Gods people there.

dag: Ti mabihi, yi daa nya wahala mi kaman Naawuni cheechinim din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la niriba bɛn nyɛ Yisa Masia ni su shɛb la. Yi daa nya alaka yimaŋmaŋ zuliya sani mi kaman bɛ gba ni daa nya alaka Yɛhudianim sani shɛm.
en: Our friends, the same things happened to you that happened to the churches of God in Judea, to the people there who belong to Christ Jesus. You suffered the same persecutions from your own people that they suffered from the Jews.

dag: Yi ni ti laɣim niriba maa, dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bibihi zaŋ tabili saamba bɛn be yi fɔntinsi ni, ka bɛ ti wum li, ka bɔhim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura lubu, ka gbaai bɛmaŋa n-doli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa din be zaligu ŋɔ puuni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Call together all the men, women, and children, and the foreigners who live in your towns, so that everyone may hear it and learn to honor the Lord your God and to obey his teachings faithfully.

dag: Ŋuna n-yeeri nanim kpariti, ka sooni ba piɛtɔnima.
en: He strips kings of their authority and makes them slaves.

dag: Ɛlam daŋ — tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihinunaanahi.
en: of Elam .

dag: O daa niŋ yɛm n-zaŋ o bidibisi maa shɛba tahi Juda mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋgbana yaɣa zaa ni ti ʒili bɛ ni me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa la zaa ni, ka ti ba bɛ ni bɔri shɛlikam, ka lan bo paɣiba pam ti ba.
en: Rehoboam acted wisely and spread all his sons through all the areas of Judah and Benjamin to every strong city. And Rehoboam gave plenty of supplies to his sons. He also looked for wives for them.

dag: Ti zaŋdila ti nyɛviya pari talima n-chani ti bɔri bindirigu na, dama tɔbutuhiriba be mɔɣu ni.
en: Murderers roam through the countryside; we risk our lives when we look for food.

dag: Kaman yim bee buyi ka kɔhigɔriba mini bɛn kɔhiri nɛma balibu kam daa kana ti gbe Jɛrusalɛm gooni maa sambani polo.
en: Once or twice some merchants spent the night outside Jerusalem with their goods.

dag: Ka n yi be bɛ ni ka a mi be n ni, dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ leei zaɣ yini ni yɛlimaŋli, ka dunianim baŋ ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na, ka lan baŋ ni a yuri bɛn niŋ ma yɛda maa kaman a ni yuri ma shɛm.
en: I will be in them, and you will be in me. So they will be completely one. Then the world will know that you sent me and that you loved them just as you loved me.

dag: ni Taanak naa ni Mɛgido naa.
en: Taanach, Megiddo.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa be Jɛrusalɛm, ka me goondahi gili fɔntinsi ni di taɣi Judanima.
en: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem and built strong cities in Judah to defend against attacks.

dag: Yihimiya li bɛ tarili maa ni n-zaŋ ti maligumaana Ɛliɛza ka o zaŋ mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: Take that share from the soldiers half of the things they took in war. Then give these things to Eleazar the priest. That part will belong to the Lord .

dag: Ka o kɔre daa kul be o mamanim bɛn yoya be kaman bunsi yoya, ka bɛ bɔri paɣiba kaman yuri la ni.
en: She remembered the lovers who excited her there, who were like animals in their sexual desires and abilities.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa boli Dauda na ti yɛl o dimbɔŋɔ zaa, ka zaŋ o tahi Sool sani, ka Dauda ti lan be o sani kaman o ni daa yi pun be o sani shɛm la.
en: So Jonathan summoned David and told him everything they had talked about. Then Jonathan brought David back to Saul, and David served Saul as he had previously.

dag: Gɛmaria bia Mikaya ŋun daa nyɛ Shafan yaaŋa la ni daa wum Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaa gbaŋ maa puuni.
en: Micaiah, the son of Gemariah and grandson of Shaphan, heard Baruch read from the scroll what the Lord had said.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti puɣisi kaai tiŋ maa daa ti chirigi do so ka o yi tiŋ maa ni na, ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti suhir a, wuhim ti so shɛli din kuni tiŋ ŋɔ ni, ka ti niŋ a nirilim.
en: While the spies were watching the town, a man came out, and they told him, If you show us how our army can get into the town, we will make sure that you aren't harmed.

dag: Gomna Filiksi ni daa wum lala ka mi mi soli ŋɔ yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga la zuɣu ka o daa chɛ bɛ yɛtɔɣa maa zali soli ka yɛli ba, Sapashin kpɛm Lisias n-ni kana ka n naanyi ŋmaai yi yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Felix knew a lot about the Lord's Way. But he brought the trial to an end and said, I will make my decision after Lysias the commander arrives.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ Taitus polo, o nyɛla n tumtumdikpee ŋun pahi n zuɣu ka ti tumdi ni ti sɔŋ ya; ka zaŋ chaŋ ti mabihi la mi polo, bɛ nyɛla cheechi tuumba Masia jilima nyabu zuɣu.
en: Now about Titus—he is my partner. He is working together with me to help you. And about the other brothers—they are sent from the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.

dag: Ka Obɛdɛdom daa yina ti deei duno shɛli din daa be nudirigu polo la, ka bɛ daa zaŋ nɛma duri fukumsi niŋ o bidibisi nuu ni.
en: Obed-Edom was then chosen to guard the South Gate, and his sons were chosen to guard the storerooms.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛn kpuɣi yi puri atam, yin di kpuɣiya yi putarisi zaa daatam bee ka yi ti lan labi ti yihi binyiha yi daatam kpuɣibu maa nyaaŋa.
en: When you harvest your lands produce, you must not harvest all the way to the edge of your field; and dont gather up every remaining bit of your harvest.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa mini Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.
en: So Israels king and Judahs King Jehoshaphat attacked Ramoth-gilead.

dag: Saha shɛlikam bɛ daa yi ti kpuɣi Alikauli Adaka maa chana, Musa yɛrimi, Yawɛ, yiɣisim chɛ ka a dimnim wurim, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je a ŋmalig a tooni guui.
en: When the people lifted the Holy Box to move the camp, Moses always said, Get up, Lord ! May your enemies be scattered. May your enemies run away from you.

dag: Ka bɛ yi yihi kuɣa maa, ka kaɣisi tari maa ka lan ta li, di nyaaŋa ka dɔro maa lan puhi yili maa ni yaha.
en: Maybe someone took away the old stones and plaster and put in new stones and plaster. And maybe mildew again appears in that house.

dag: Shɛm ni daa dɔɣi Aripakishad maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinu. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After that Shem lived years. He had other sons and daughters.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɛriko naa, Nyama, Izraɛlnim shɛb ka kpe na yuŋ ŋɔ ni bɛ ti puɣisi nya ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni be shɛm.
en: The king of Jericho heard that some Israelites had come that night to spy out the country.

dag: dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam ni ka n yih a na; ka bol a ka a yi dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam ni katiŋ na, ka n yɛl a, A nyɛla n dabili. Mani m-piig a ka bi zaɣis a.
en: You were in a faraway country, but I reached out to you. I called you from that faraway place. I said, You are my servant. I chose you, and I have not rejected you.

dag: Bɛ yi yiɣiri luri zoya zuɣu, di vurimi kaman chɛchɛbunsi vubu la; ka lan vuri kaman buɣim n-diri mokuma ka di tahiri la. Bɛ lan ŋmanila tɔbbi gbaliŋ n-teei zani ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi tɔb la.
en: They roar over mountains like noisy chariots, or a mighty army ready for battle. They are a forest fire that feasts on straw.

dag: Miri ka a doli ninvuɣ biɛri soli. Miri ka a doli tuumbiɛtumdiba soli.
en: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣisi zaɣ chɛhi din guui m-pali piɛri pinaayi.
en: After everyone had eaten all they wanted, Jesus' disciples picked up twelve large baskets of leftovers.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni nyɛ bɛn yi Naawuni ni na maa zuɣu, di bi simdi ni ti tɛhi ni Naawuni ŋmanila buɣ shɛŋa tuumbaŋdiba ni zaŋ salima mini anzinfa ni kuɣa maani bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛm puuni la.
en: Since we are God's children, we should not suppose that his nature is anything like an image of gold or silver or stone, shaped by human art and skill.

dag: Dinzuɣu Oholiba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka a ni ŋmalig a mamanim shɛb sani chaŋ ni suhuyiɣisili la suhuri yiɣisi bahi a zuɣu, ka n chɛ ka bɛ yi luɣilikam na ti lir a.
en: So Oholibah, this is what the Lord GOD says: You became disgusted with your lovers, but I will bring them here, and they will surround you.

dag: Kul zahimmiya binyɛra sania zuɣu ka di paara ni yɛlimaŋli, ka zaŋmiya kuruwa maŋli zahindi yi binyɛra ka di paana din ni chɛ ka yi yuui Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: Instead, you must have only one weight, complete and correct, and only one ephah, also complete and correct, so that your life might be long in the fertile land the LORD your God is giving you.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu hal nti naai bɛ birili n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti bɛ mini bɛ yaannim ŋɔ ni.
en: I will send the sword, famine, and disease against them until they vanish from the fertile land that I gave to their ancestors.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka Pool daa zaŋ niriba anahi maa n-chɛ ka o mini ba mali bɛmaŋa n-kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ni bɛ ti wuhi bɛmaŋ malibu maa ni yɛn naai dahin shɛli ka maligumaana mali sara bɛ zaa yinoyino zuɣu.
en: The following day Paul took the men with him and went through the purification ritual with them. He entered the temple and publicly announced the completion of the days of purification, when the offering would be presented for each one of them.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛl o kpamba bɛn be o sani zaa, Yiɣisimiya ka ti zo, di yi pa lala ti ti ku tooi lan zo n-yi Absalom nuu ni. Ti zomiya yomyom, di yi pa lala o ni gbahi ti pumpɔŋɔ n-niŋ ti zaɣ biɛɣu, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku ya ŋɔ nima.
en: So David said to all his officials who were with him in Jerusalem, We must get away at once if we want to escape from Absalom! Hurry! Or else he will soon be here and defeat us and kill everyone in the city.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ n shɛhiralana bela alizanda ni, ka ŋun ʒe n nyaaŋa nyɛla ŋun be zuɣusaa.
en: Surely now my witness stands in heaven; my advocate is on high.

dag: ka ania niŋbu tahiri biɛrisuntali na, ka biɛrisuntali tahiri tahima na.
en: And this patience is proof that we are strong. And this proof gives us hope.

dag: Ka napaɣ Atalia daa wum vuri maa, ka kpe niriba maa sani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: When Athaliah heard the noise made by the guard and the people, she went to the people at the LORDs temple.

dag: Ŋuna n-fari ninkura yɛm ka mali ba chana; ka chɛ ka sariakaritiba leeri jɛra.
en: He takes away the wisdom of rulers and makes leaders act like fools.

dag: Ka Dauda tuumba maa daa chaŋ Abigeel sani Kamɛl nti yɛl o, Dauda n-tim ti ni ti kana ti kpuɣ a na ti ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: His servants went to Carmel with this message, David sent us to get you. He wants you to be his wife.

dag: Ka Absalom mini Izraɛlnim daa dɔni sansani Giliad tiŋgban ni.
en: The Israelites under Absalom's command set up camp in the region of Gilead.

dag: Firawuna yuri min o chɛchɛbunsi ni o chɛchɛbunduhiriba la ni daa siɣi teeku maa puuni, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka teeku maa kom lan nahi taba n-lim ba, amaa Izraɛlnim maa bɛn daa dolila teeku tiŋ kuŋ zuɣu ti du.
en: When Pharaohs horses, chariots, and cavalry went into the sea, the LORD brought back the waters of the sea over them. But the Israelites walked through the sea on dry ground.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa ni kum o kuli, ka sɔɣ o, dama o kɔŋko n-nyɛ Jɛrɔbɔam bi so bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ sɔɣi gballi ni; dama o kɔŋko ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ nini tiɣi Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ ni.
en: All Israel will cry for him. They will bury him, but he is the only one from Jeroboams family who will be buried. This is because he is the only one in Jeroboams family who pleased the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kɔrigi naɣilaa maa, ka zaŋ bia maa mi chaŋ ti ti Ɛli.
en: They slaughtered the bull, then brought the boy to Eli.

dag: di saha yin bom zim viɛlli lita ata n-zaŋ kpam lita ayi ŋmir li;.
en: a grain offering of pounds of flour mixed with pints of olive oil is to be presented.

dag: ni Shimirɔnmɛrɔn naa ni Akishaf naa.
en: Shimron Meron, Achshaph.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nim zaa jɛmd a mi; bɛ yiinila yila paɣir a, bɛ yiinila yila paɣir a yuli.
en: All the earth worships you, sings praises to you, sings praises to your name! Selah.

dag: ni bindir viɛla din niŋdi kurimbuni ha zoya zuɣu ni bindira din niŋdi pam dabo kura zuɣu.
en: You will have a rich harvest from the slopes of the ancient hills.

dag: Yawɛ po Yaakubu zuɣu n-yɛli, N kul ku tam bɛ tuumbiɛri maa yɛla.
en: The Lord , the God of Israel, has sworn, I will never forget their evil deeds.

dag: O ŋmanila gbuɣinli n-yiɣisi o sɔɣisili shee, dama bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa leei dabari tɔb biɛ shɛli din lu di ni la min o suhuyiɣisili pam la zuɣu.
en: Like a lion leaving its den, the Lord has abandoned his people to the destruction of war.

dag: N ni darigi bɛn be Ijipti maa tibili kaman n ni daa darigi Jɛrusalɛmnim tibili ka chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu shɛm la.
en: I will punish those who live in the land of Egypt, just as I punished Jerusalem with war, famine, and disease.

dag: Ka Filip daa bɔ n-nya Nataniɛl yɛl o, Ti nya Anabi Musa ni daa sab so yɛla o zaligu kundinim ni min anabinim gba ni daa sab so yɛla la. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa Yisifu bia ŋun yi Nazarɛt na la.
en: Philip found Nathanael and said to him, We have found the one Moses wrote about in the Law and the Prophets: Jesus, Josephs son, from Nazareth.

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa yɛl o dinkam niŋ o mini Haman ni daa yɛli ni o ni yo laɣ shɛli tariga ka bɛ zaŋ niŋ naa kpanjɔɣu ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ ku Yɛhudianim zaa la yɛla.
en: Mordecai told him everything that had happened to him and just how much money Haman had promised to put into the royal treasury if all the Jews were killed.

dag: Dama lala ni chɛ ka yi bihi maa chɛ ma dolibu ka jɛmdi binnana, di saha Yawɛ suhu ni ti yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka o kun ya yomyom.
en: because they will turn your child away from following me so that they end up serving other gods. That will make the LORDs anger burn against you, and he will quickly annihilate you.

dag: Biɛɣukam niriba daa yi kul kanila Dauda sanna ti pahir o zuɣu hal ka o tɔbbihi ti galisi kaman Naawuni tɔbbihi la.
en: Reinforcements came to David daily until there was an army as mighty as Gods army.

dag: So yi bɔr ni o yo pia kam puuni yim maa zuɣu ka dee li, o ni yo di daa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi.
en: If you want to buy back this part of your harvest, you may do so by paying what it is worth plus an additional percent.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita yɛli ba, Man ni chaŋ kulipaligu. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti gba ni dol a chaŋ. Ka bɛ daa yi nti kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ, amaa dindali maa yuŋ maa bɛ daa bi gbaai shɛli.
en: Simon Peter said, I am going out to fish. The other followers said, We will go with you. So all of them went out and got into the boat. They fished that night but caught nothing.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun tum alahichi ŋuna n-yɛn kpi. Bia ku di wahala o ba daalahichi zuɣu. Ka bialan ku di wahala o bia daalahichi zuɣu. Wuntizɔra wuntia tuma yɛn nyɛla omaŋmaŋ ko dini, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu mi ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma nyɛ omaŋmaŋ ko dini.
en: Only the one who sins will die. A child wont bear a parents guilt, and a parent wont bear a childs guilt. Those who do right will be declared innocent, and the wicked will be declared guilty.

dag: Ka n daa ŋmahiŋmahi m mam maa jilajila n-zaŋ tari Izraɛlnim ni su luɣ shɛlikam zaa, dama bɛna n-tum din chihiri ŋɔ mini biŋkɔb tuuni ŋɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni maa.
en: So I took her and cut her into pieces. Then I sent one piece to each of the tribes of Israel. I sent the pieces to the lands we have received. I did that because the people of Benjamin have done this terrible thing in Israel.

dag: Naawuni gbaɣisi n tɔbu ka filim ma, lala zuɣu ka bɛ liri ma ka binshɛli bi gu ba soli.
en: God has taken the string from my bow and made me weak, so they feel free to do whatever they want to me.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani; ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa Jɛrɔbɔam Nɛbat bia la ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la.
en: He sinned against the Lord , following the wicked example of King Jeroboam son of Nebat, who led Israel into sin.

dag: Nimaani ka Izraɛl Naawuni jilima daa yi wulimpuhili polo kanna, di vuri daa ŋmanila kom din mali yaa vuri, ka o jilima daa neei tiŋgban ni.
en: where the glory of Israels God was coming in from the east. Its sound was like the sound of a mighty flood, and the earth was lit up with his glory.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Gomna Pailɛt maŋmaŋ daa yina ti bɔhi ba, Yi ni tahi do so ŋɔ na taali lee nyɛla dini.
en: So Pilate went out to them and asked, What charge do you bring against this man.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Ahimɛlɛk, A ka takɔbi bee kpani kpe n-zaŋ ti ma? Dama naa tuma maa ni bɔri yomyom shɛm zuɣu chɛ ka m bi tooi zaŋ n takɔbi bee m bidibbin shɛli.
en: David asked Ahimelech, Do you have a spear or sword here? The kings business is very important. I had to leave quickly, and I didnt bring my sword or any other weapon.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Bokim. Ka bɛ daa mali sara ti Yawɛ nimaani.
en: and they offered sacrifices to the Lord . From then on, they called that place Crying.

dag: Itiɔpianim mini Ijiptinima n-daa yi nyɛ o yaa, ka di mi daa ka tariga. Putinim mini Libianim n-daa nyɛ bɛn sɔŋd o.
en: She ruled Ethiopia and Egypt, there was no limit to her power; Libya was her ally.

dag: Nandan gbansɔɣu ni tooi niŋ bindirigu pam, amaa ka bɛn doli soli din bi tuhi fa li.
en: A poor persons land might produce much food, but it is unjustly swept away.

dag: Lala ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti Izraɛlnima kaman o ni daa pun lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛm la. Bɛ ni daa deei li naai, bɛ daa ʒinila di ni.
en: The LORD gave to Israel all the land he had pledged to give to their ancestors. They took it over and settled there.

dag: O daa yihi ba bumbɔni mini zibisim ni, ka kabi bɛ bandi.
en: God brought them out from the darkness and deep gloom; he shattered their chains.

dag: A nyina piɛlimi kaman bɛ ni su piɛ nyaan shɛb kom ka bɛ zaɣ yino kam mali jaa, ka bɛ ni so bi kɔŋ o bala.
en: Your teeth are whiter than sheep freshly washed; they match perfectly, not one is missing.

dag: Naawuni yɛm puuni o bi chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ nim tooi zaŋ bɛ yɛm baŋ ŋun Naawuni; dina n-chɛ ka di tiɣi Naawuni nini ni o zaŋ ti ni yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu shɛli din ŋmani jɛrilim ŋɔ n-tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ yɛda.
en: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.

dag: A mi di bi puhi ma ka mɔɣisi n kpariŋ kaman ti kali ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa n ni kpe a yili ŋɔ na hal ni wayo, paɣ ŋɔ na bi chɛ n naba bɔbilibu.
en: You did not greet me with a kiss, but she has been kissing my feet since I came in.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti kul kpe Samaria puuni, ka Ilaisha suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Neem niriba ŋɔ nina n-chɛ ka bɛ nya. Ka Yawɛ daa neei bɛ nina maa, ka bɛ lihi nya ka bɛ bela Samaria puuni.
en: As soon as they had entered the city, Elisha prayed, Open their eyes, Lord , and let them see. The Lord answered his prayer; he restored their sight, and they saw that they were inside Samaria.
