dag: Ʒiri shɛhiralan maanila zaligu ansarisi, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu noli vaani zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.

dag: Ka bia maa daa ti zooi, ka bɛ ŋmaag o bihili, ka Ibrahimma daa puhi chuɣu dahin shɛli Yisahaku ni daa ŋmaai bihili maa.
en: The child grew, and on the day that he was weaned, Abraham gave a great feast.

dag: Di saha ka bɛn daa yɛn vih o maa dii yiɣis o sani yi; ka dabiɛm daa kpe sapashin kpɛm maa gba o ni daa baŋ ni Pool nyɛla Rom tiŋbia ka o lo o zoligɔnim lala maa zuɣu.
en: The men who were preparing to question Paul moved away from him immediately. The commander was afraid because he had already put Paul in chains, and he was a Roman citizen.

dag: A zaŋ pɔhim leeg a tuumba, ka zaŋ buɣim mini buɣim niɛm leeg a tumtumdiba.
en: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.

dag: Bɛ yi di daa tɛhirila bɛ ni daa pun yi tin shɛl na la yɛla, bɛ daa naan nya soli n-lan lab nimaani.
en: If they had been thinking about the country that they had left, they would have had the opportunity to return to it.

dag: Ka Baanabas daa bɔri ni bɛ ʒi Jɔn ŋun yuli daa lan booni Maak la pahi.
en: Barnabas wanted to bring John Mark with them too.

dag: Bɛ ni daa vihi ma bɛ daa loya ni bɛ bahi ma, dama bɛ daa bi nya ka n tum taal shɛli din simdi kum.
en: They looked into the charges against me and wanted to release me. They found that I had not done anything deserving death.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maligumaaniba kpamba daa yɛli Gomna Pailɛt, Di sabi ni Yɛhudianim Naa la m-bɔŋɔ, amaa sabimila, Doo ŋɔ yɛliya ni o nyɛla Yɛhudianim Naa. .
en: The chief priests said to Pilate, Do not write The King of the Jews, but rather, This man said, I am the King of the Jews.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni tɛhi shɛm ka yɛl lala maa ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Yinim bɛn yɛda bi yaɣi lala ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋdi tab saawara yi ni ka bɔrɔbɔro maa zuɣu?.
en: Jesus knew what they were thinking and said: You surely don't have much faith! Why are you talking about not having any bread?.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, nyin kul nyɛla naa sahakam; ka a yuli kul ni be ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Our Lord , you are King forever and will always be famous.

dag: Alizanda ni nim mini dunia ni nim zaŋ tabili teeku mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni, paɣimiy o.
en: Praise him, heaven and earth! Sea and everything in it, praise him!.

dag: Ka yimaŋmaŋ gba mi Timoti ni pun kpaŋd omaŋ shɛm m min o ni laɣim kaman ba min o bia n-tumdi lahibal suŋ tuma la yɛla.
en: You know his character, how he labors with me for the gospel like a son works with his father.

dag: Nyini n-chɛ ka o yiɣiri kaman toli la? O nyeeni firisibu din mali jilima la mali dabiɛm.
en: Did you make them leap like locusts and frighten people with their snorting?.

dag: Yulimiya paɣiviɛligakushihikom ni zoori shɛm: Di bi tumda; di mi bi miri gumdi. Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni hal Sulemaana min o jilima zaa ha, o daa bi ye situra ka di viɛli kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom zaɣ yini gba viɛlim.
en: Look how the wild flowers grow: they don't work or make clothes for themselves. But I tell you that not even King Solomon with all his wealth had clothes as beautiful as one of these flowers.

dag: Di di bi simdi ni a gba zo a kpee maa nambɔɣu kaman n ni daa zo a nambɔɣu shɛm maa.
en: Shouldnt you also have mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had mercy on you.

dag: Yi mi di ŋmariya tab ʒiri, dama yi pun yihi biɛr kurili la mini di miligu yɛla bahi.
en: Do not lie to one another, for you have put off the old self with its habits.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi kpi, bɛ tahima naaya; ka bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni ku nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: When the wicked die, their hopes die with them.

dag: Yawɛ, amaŋmaŋ nini nyaya, di zaŋ li shini! N Duuma, di be katiŋ ka chɛ ma!.
en: You see everything, Lord ! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.

dag: n-zaŋ hal ni Bɛrɔta ni Sibiraim . N-zaŋ hal ni Hazɛrihatikɔn fɔntiŋ din be Hauran tintariga la.
en: Berothah, Sibraim and Hazer Hatticon, which is on the border of Hauran.

dag: Ka o daa kab dari pa bimbin maa zuɣu, ka ŋmahiŋmahi naɣilaa maa nimdi pa dari maa zuɣu, ka yɛli ba, Niŋmiya kom pali koyuya anahi n-kpaai li tɛli sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ŋɔ mini dari maa.
en: He put the wood in order, butchered the bull, and placed the bull on the wood. Fill four jars with water and pour it on the sacrifice and on the wood, he commanded.

dag: Ka gbib yɛlimaŋ shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi ŋun be ti ni ni zaŋ niŋ a nuu ni la.
en: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.

dag: N nia lɔbu nyɛla ni n yihi lahibal suŋ waazu ŋɔ luɣ shɛli niriba ni na bi wum Masia yuli yɛla, ka di chɛ ka n ku me n-tam so mɛbu zuɣu.
en: In this way, I have a goal to preach the gospel where they havent heard of Christ yet, so that I wont be building on someone elses foundation.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun bi ʒe n nyaaŋa pala ŋun bɔri n zaɣ viɛlli; ka ŋunkam mi bi sɔŋdi ma naɣ wurindila m bini bahira.
en: Whoever is not with me is against me. And anyone who does not work with me is working against me.

dag: Ka Tomas kuhi yɛli, N Duuma ni n Naawuni.
en: Thomas responded to Jesus, My Lord and my God.

dag: ka tim ti mabia Timoti yi sanna. O nyɛla Naawuni tumtumdi so ti min o ni laɣindi tumdi Masia lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu tuma la. Ti daa tim o mi na ni o ti kpaŋsi ya yi yɛda niŋbu puuni, ka kpam ya jaande.
en: and we sent you Timothy, who is our brother and Gods coworker in the good news about Christ. We sent him to strengthen and encourage you in your faithfulness.

dag: ka niŋ tipawumli n-gbibi nyɔtaɣirisi din tibisa n-zɔri na ni bɛ ti tuh o.
en: They are proud and rebellious; they stubbornly hold up their shields and rush to fight against God.

dag: Bɛ piɛma diri pam, bɛ tɔbiri gba guri viɛla. Bɛ yuri takarifiɛma ŋmanila pilima, ka bɛ chɛchɛbunsi kalima zɔri gindi yomyom kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga la.
en: Their arrows are sharp. Their bows are strung and ready to shoot. The horses hooves are as hard as flint. Clouds of dust rise from behind their chariots.

dag: Amaa Lɛvinim maa bɛn tim bɛ suɣa gili alikauli suɣili maa n-gul li, ka Naawuni suhu ti ku yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: The Levites will set up their tents so that they surround the Tent of the Agreement. They will serve as guards and keep the people away from the Tent. This will protect the Israelites from the Lords anger.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli niriba maa, Miligimiya ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔ suɣa shee, ka di shihiya bɛ binshɛɣu, di yi pa lala bɛ daalahichi maa zaa ni ʒin ya chaŋ.
en: Moses warned the people, Move away from the tents of these evil men. Dont touch anything that belongs to them! If you do, you will be destroyed because of their sins.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, daboya mini zoya zuɣu buɣa jɛmbu nyɛla yɔhiŋ. Yɛlimaŋli, Izraɛlnim tiliginsim bela Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Surely what happens on the hills is a waste, as is the uproar on the mountains. Only in the LORD our God is the salvation of Israel.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yihi binshɛli din ka daɣiri binshɛli din mali daɣiri ni na? So ku tooi.
en: There's no way a human can be completely pure.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa kpamba maa zaŋ doo maa ti darig o tibili.
en: The town leaders will beat the man with a whip.

dag: ka o lu tiŋa, ka wum ka kukol shɛli boon o na yɛra, Sool, Sool, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋdi ma alaka.
en: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to him, Saul, Saul! Why are you persecuting me.

dag: Ka yi mali gɔpiɛliga dapuhi, ka niŋ daanya pa di zuɣu.
en: Cover two acacia wood poles with bronze and put them through the rings for carrying the altar.

dag: Zaŋm a nuu chaŋ katiŋ ka chɛ ma, ka di lan chɛ ka a yɛla mali ma dabiɛm.
en: stop punishing me, and don't crush me with terror.

dag: Dan zuliya ni, Ammishadai bia Ahiɛza n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from Dan, Ahiezer, Ammishaddais son.

dag: Dinzuɣu mmaŋmaŋ bee m mabihi bee n sɔŋdiba bee ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ guliba bɛn doli ma la ni so daa bi yeei ti situra. Ti zaɣ yino kam daa kul gbibila o bidibbini o nudirigu ni.
en: I didn't take off my clothes even at night, neither did any of my companions nor my servants nor my bodyguards. And we all kept our weapons at hand.

dag: ka wurim nam ʒiishɛhi ka chɛ ka di yiko zan tariga. N ni lɛb chɛchɛbunsi mini bɛn mal li chani pili; ka daai wɔribariba mini bɛ yuri luhi; ka bɛ ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku taba.
en: and overthrow kingdoms and end their power. I will overturn chariots and their drivers; the horses will die, and their riders will kill one another.

dag: N daa kuhi boli Yawɛ n nandahima puuni. N Naawuni ka n daa boli maa. Ka o daa be o jɛmbu duu puuni ka wum n kukoli; ka n kuhigu maa daa lu o tiba ni.
en: In my trouble I called to the Lord ; I called to my God for help. In his temple he heard my voice; he listened to my cry for help.

dag: Zabimi n zuɣu n-tiligi ma. Dolimi n nyɛvili kaman a ni lo ma alikauli shɛm.
en: Defend my cause, and set me free; save me, as you have promised.

dag: Dama o pala ninsala kaman n ni nyɛ ninsal shɛm ŋɔ, ka n ni tooi garigi yɛl o shɛli, bee ka m min o ni ti chaŋ ʒiishee.
en: God isn't a mere human like me. I can't put him on trial.

dag: Gbibiya Vuhim Dabisili ka chɛ ka di be kasi kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya shɛm.
en: Observe the Sabbath and keep it holy, as I, the Lord your God, have commanded you.

dag: Bɛ yi daai bɛ zuɣulaannim tampima zuɣu luhina, di saha ka bɛ ni baŋ ni n yɛrila yɛlimaŋli.
en: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff.

dag: Dina n-yɛn nyɛ yi gba zaka, ka di be kaman kabɔɣili ni chi bee wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili ni wain zaka la.
en: Just as the Israelites give me part of their grain and wine, you must set aside part of what you receive.

dag: ka baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli, ka yɛlimaŋli maa yihi ya dabitim ni.
en: You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.

dag: Dama di ni leei jilima zuɣupiligu a zuɣu ni, ka leei dolibi a nyiŋgol ni.
en: Their teaching will improve your character as a handsome turban or a necklace improves your appearance.

dag: O mali yɛm o suhu ni, ka o kpiɔŋ galisi; ŋuni n-na mi m-mo o ka di nasara?.
en: God is so wise and powerful that no one could oppose him and survive.

dag: Di saha ka Bɔaz daa yɛli tiŋ maa kpamba mini bɛn zaa daa be nimaani maa, Yi zaa di ma shɛhira zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni n da Ɛlimɛlɛk min o bidibis ayi Kiliɔn ni Malɔn ni su binshɛɣukam zaa Naomi sani.
en: Boaz told the town leaders and everyone else: All of you are witnesses that today I have bought from Naomi the property that belonged to Elimelech and his two sons, Chilion and Mahlon.

dag: A daalikauli min a suhu yubu zuɣu, ka a tum tuun kara ŋɔ zaa ni a chɛ ka man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ baŋ li.
en: You have done this wonderful thing, and you have let me know about it, because you wanted to keep your promise.

dag: Nir ni ti zaŋ tɔbu mini piɛma kpe nimaani ni o ti go mɔɣu, dama gɔhi mini suligunyinyaɣu ni ti zooi lim tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa.
en: You will go there to hunt with your bow and arrows, because the whole country will be covered with thornbushes.

dag: ka ti mi yi ye li, di ni chɛ ka ti ku be ti zaɣim.
en: by being clothed with it we shall not be without a body.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bo n-nya li, di ni ti ba nyɛvili, ka ti bɛ niŋgbuna zaa alaafee.
en: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.

dag: Man Pool maŋmaŋa n-sabi ŋɔ: N ni yo a li. Hal n ni tooi yɛli ni n samli dol a zaŋ chaŋ amaŋmaŋ nyɛvili polo.
en: Here, I will write this with my own hand: I, Paul, will pay you back.

dag: ka a niriba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ ni ninvuɣ yino bee bɛ zaa yi mi bɛ wahala mini bɛ suhugarigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka teei bɛ nuhi tiri duu ŋɔ polo na n-fabili niŋ a ka suh a.
en: whatever prayer or petition is made by any individual or by all of your people Israel—because people will recognize their own pain and suffering and spread out their hands toward this temple.

dag: Salo maa ni daa ti wurim naai, ka Yisa nyaandoliba pinaayi la mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim o sani bɔh o yɛtɔɣ ŋaha la yɛla.
en: When Jesus was alone with the twelve apostles and some others, they asked him about these stories.

dag: ni Leedan ni Ammihud ni Ɛlishama.
en: Ladan was Tahans son. Ammihud was Ladans son. Elishama was Ammihuds son.

dag: Bɛ ni dɔɣ ma dahin shɛli zaŋ na hal ni pɔŋɔ, nyini ka n zaŋ mmaŋ dalim, ka m ma ni dɔɣ ma hal ni zuŋɔ, nyini n-kul nyɛ n Naawuni.
en: I was thrown on you from birth; youve been my God since I was in my mothers womb.

dag: Ka Manɔa daa yɛl o paɣa, Ti nini nya Naawuni, dinzuɣu biɛhiŋ kani, ti ni kpi.
en: Manoah said to his wife, We have seen God. Surely we will die because of this.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli Naawuni nyɛla ŋun galisi ka mi bi ʒiɛm so, o yɛm galisiya pam.
en: How strong God is! He despises no one; there is nothing he doesn't understand.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka a dɔni a kabiri ni ni suhudoo, ka n chɛ ka a paag a yaannim tooni pɔi. A nini ku nya n ni ti yɛn chɛ ka zaɣibiɛ shɛli zaa lu Jɛrusalɛm mini di niriba zuɣu maa. Ka bɛ zaa daa zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ labi ti yɛli naa.
en: and the punishment which I am going to bring on Jerusalem will not come until after your death. I will let you die in peace. The men returned to King Josiah with this message.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a ni tooi kpuɣ a zuɣu ka galimi kani, a ni yi barina ni, ka ku lan zɔri dabiɛm.
en: then you will lift up your face without blemish; you will be secure and not fear.

dag: Ka di bintira kɔtomsi maa mini di jaba maa ni firilatamdigu maa ti nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ matarika kuri salin shɛli din nyɛ alali.
en: The buds, the branches, and the lampstand are to be a single piece of pure hammered gold.

dag: Amaa yɛl yini n naɣ beni ka ti ni bɔri ni yi niŋ li pɔi ka ti naanyi saɣi, dina n-nyɛ: yi chɛ ka yi dɔbba zaa guni m-be kaman tinima.
en: But we will allow you to marry her if you do this one thing: Every man in your town must be circumcised like us.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim ni bɛ pɔri Naawuni sani mal alibarika, dama alizanda nam nyɛla bɛ dini.
en: God blesses those people who depend only on him. They belong to the kingdom of heaven!.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku wum Yawɛ yɛligu, ka zaɣis o zaligu dolibu, dindina ŋun Yawɛ ni darigi yi tibili.
en: But if you dont listen to the Lord , if you refuse to do what the Lord says, he will be against you. The Lord will destroy you and your king.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa me Mɔabnim buɣili Chɛmɔshi din nyɛ daɣiri la jɛmbu shee mini Ammɔnnim buɣili Molɛk din nyɛ daɣiri la jɛmbu shee zali Jɛrusalɛm wulimpuhili polo zoli zuɣu.
en: On the hill east of Jerusalem, Solomon built a shrine to Chemosh the detestable god of Moab, and to Molech the detestable god of the Ammonites.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Naawuni nir maa, Ti kulimi n yiŋa ka n ti niŋ bindirigu ti a ka a di, ka n ti a yɔri.
en: Come home with me and eat something, Jeroboam said. I want to give you a gift for what you have done.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Yisa m-bo bimpiɛlli niŋ o.
en: Then Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a new linen cloth.

dag: Gbib a yɛda niŋbu min a suhu ni tɛha ka di ku mali galimi. Ninvuɣ shɛb ni bi doli suhu ni tɛha ŋɔ tatabo ni wuhi shɛm zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ yɛda niŋbu saɣim.
en: because you have faith and a good conscience. Some people have ruined their faith because they refused to listen to their conscience.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi kul zaɣisir o? Yi bɔrila tibidarigibo din galisi? Izraɛlnima, yi zuɣuri zaa malila dansi, ka yi suhuri mini yi tɛha ka alaafee.
en: What good will it do to keep punishing you? You will continue to rebel. Your whole head and heart are already sick and aching.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋdi binshɛŋa din be kasi bahiri bahi bee n-zaŋdi binshɛŋa din mali buchi pam bahiri kuruchunima, dama di pa shɛli ka bɛ no li fi taŋkpaɣu ni, ka ŋmaligina tin ya daŋa.
en: Don't give to dogs what belongs to God. They will only turn and attack you. Don't throw pearls down in front of pigs. They will trample all over them.

dag: dama m mi yi ni pun yu ni yi niŋ shɛm yɛla. Ka n nyuri bara yi zuɣu Masidɔnianim sani, ka yɛri ni Akaianim gba pun malila shili yuuni la ha, ka yi ni yu ni yi niŋ shɛm kpaŋsi bɛ ni shɛb pam suhuri.
en: I know that you are willing to help, and I have boasted of you to the people in Macedonia. The believers in Achaia, I said, have been ready to help since last year. Your eagerness has stirred up most of them.

dag: Di saha ka Ijiptinim zaa ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. A ni daa leei kariŋmaaŋa jaaŋgbee Izraɛlnim sani maa zuɣu.
en: Then everyone in Egypt will know that I am the Lord . You and your nation refused to help the people of Israel and were nothing more than a broken stick.

dag: Yi suhuri yi ye din tuhi tumbu zuɣu, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi niŋ ya shɛli?.
en: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chamiya ti nya o ni be luɣ shɛli ka n tim ka bɛ ti gbaag o na. Ka bɛ daa ti yɛl o, O be Dɔtan.
en: He said, Go and find out where he is. Then I will send men to capture him. They told him, He is in Dothan.

dag: ni Itai ŋun ba daa nyɛ Ribai ŋun daa nyɛ Gibia din daa be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni nir la ni Bɛnaaya ŋun daa nyɛ Piratɔn nir la ni.
en: Ithai, Ribais son from Gibeah of the Benjaminites; Benaiah from Pirathon.

dag: N nintam n-kul nyɛ m bindirigu wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ka niriba kul bɔhiri ma sahakam, A Naawuni maa lee be ya.
en: Day and night I cry, and tears are my only food; all the time my enemies ask me, Where is your God.

dag: Ka n daa labina nti nya chirimbu shɛli Ɛliashib ni chirim chɛ ka Tɔbaya be Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni dundɔŋ ni nɛma duu maa ni maa.
en: So I came back to Jerusalem. There I heard about the sad thing that Eliashib had done. He had given Tobiah a room in the Temple of God!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tibigi Naawuni n zuɣu.
en: And because of me, they praised God.

dag: Nyin Bɛlitishaaza ŋun nyɛ timanim kpɛm ŋɔ, dama m mi ni wun shɛŋa din be kasi la shia be a ni, ka a tooi baŋdi ashiya gbinni. N ni daa zahim zahin shɛli maa m-bɔŋɔ: Wuhim ma di gbinni.
en: Belteshazzar, chief of the dream interpreters, I know the breath of the holy gods is in you, and no mystery is too difficult for you. Tell me the meaning of the visions I had in my dream.

dag: Nachimbil so ŋun nyɛ faralana ka mali yɛm, o so ninvuɣ kurigu ŋun nyɛ naa, ka nyɛ jɛrigu ŋun ku saɣi deei saɣisigu.
en: A poor but wise youth is better than an old and foolish king, who no longer listens to advice.

dag: Ka Hiram tumtumdiba mini Naa Sulemaana tumtumdiba bɛn daa yi chani Ofiri ti ʒiri salima na la daa lan ʒiri aligum dari mini kuɣ viɛla na ti pahi.
en: The sailors of King Hiram and of King Solomon who brought gold from Ophir also brought juniper wood and jewels.

dag: N ni lo ni n tum din viɛli zuɣu, n dimnim zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu n-yo ma din viɛli niŋbu samli.
en: I did nothing but good, and they paid me back with evil. I try to do what is right, but that only makes them turn against me.

dag: Puhimiya tab puhiri suŋ. Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda la zaa puhiri ya.
en: Give each other the special greeting of Gods people. All of Gods holy people here send you their greetings.

dag: ka Pɛdazu bia Gamaliɛl daa nyɛ Manaasa zuliya zuɣulana;.
en: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was the leader of the Manasseh tribe.

dag: Ka ti daa yiɣisi ni n-kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Asɔs ni ti ti zaŋ Pool pahi timaŋ zuɣu; ti min o ni daa pun tɔɣisi zali shɛm m-bala, dama o daa yɛliya ni ŋun yɛn chaŋla tiŋ paai ni.
en: We went on ahead to the ship and sailed off to Assos, where we were going to take Paul aboard. He had told us to do this, because he was going there by land.

dag: Ka chɛrubinim maa daa teei bɛ kpiŋkpama pɔbi Alikauli Adaka maa zaashee maa, ka di daa chɛ ka bɛ kpiŋkpama pɔbi Alikauli Adaka mini di dapuhi.
en: whose wings covered both the chest and the poles used for carrying it.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Ti mi ka biɛhiŋ kani ni Yawɛ be a sani, dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti min a laɣim lo tab alikauli.
en: They answered, Now we know that the Lord is with you, and we think that there should be a solemn agreement between us. We want you to promise.

dag: Dinzuɣu nira daa yi yɛn kpe duri maa nudirigu polo dunoya maa ni, a ni dolila duu maa tariga so shɛli din baɣisiri gooni maa wulimpuhili polo.
en: The door to these rooms was at the east end of the wall that stood in front of them.

dag: Amaa Naawuni yɛm wuhiri dimaŋ la bɛn dee li sani.
en: But wisdom is proved to be right by all her descendants.

dag: nti be nimaani hal ka Naa Hɛrɔd ti kpi. Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka anab so ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O daa yɛlimi ni ti Duuma yɛliya, Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka n yihi m Bia maa na.
en: where they stayed until Herod died. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, I called my son out of Egypt.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bi mi din niŋ kamaata, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ bɛn mi li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: The wicked dont understand justice, but those who love the Lord understand it completely.

dag: Ti ni daa be bɛ sani n-guli ti piɛri ŋɔ saha shɛli maa zaa, bɛna n-daa nyɛ gooni gili ti yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni zaa.
en: In fact, the whole time we were with them, watching our sheep, they were a protective wall around us both night and day.

dag: Amaa o daa chɛ ka Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kom di Ijipti naa min o tɔbbihi. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: but he drowned the king of Egypt and his army; his love is eternal.

dag: Naawuni, di shini; Naawuni, di fo, a mi di kpalim ʒiya!.
en: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!.

dag: Dindali maa, kɔnyuri ni ti wum gbarigi nachimbihi kpɛma mini paɣisaribihi kpɛma, ka bɛ tarigi.
en: At that time the beautiful young men and women will become weak from thirst.

dag: ni teebul la mini di zuɣu lahi zaa ni bɔrɔbɔro din be kasi la.
en: the table and all its equipment, and the bread offered to God;.

dag: Amaa ka Gɛshurinim mini Sirianim daa fa Havɔtijairi mini Kɛnat ni di tiŋkpansi bɛ sani, di daa nyɛla tinsi pihiyɔbu. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Makiri ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad ba la bihi.
en: but Geshur and Aram took Havvoth-jair from them, as well as Kenath and its villages, sixty towns. All these were descendants of Machir, Gileads father.

dag: Izraɛlnim maa nyarila o ninni ni nyaɣisira, ka o zaŋ sariga pili lir li, naɣila o ti lan chaŋ ni o mini Yawɛ ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa yaha.
en: the Israelites would see that the skin of Moses face was shining brightly. So Moses would put the veil on his face again until the next time he went in to speak with the LORD.

dag: Yɛlimiy o ni n wumya ni o chɛrila o piɛri kɔbiri ni o piɛguliba maa mi yi kul bela ti sani, ka ti bi niŋ ba zaɣ biɛ shɛli, bɛ mi binshɛli daa bi bɔrigi bɛ ni daa be ti sani Kamɛl saha shɛli maa.
en: I've heard that you are cutting the wool from your sheep. When your shepherds were with us in Carmel, we didn't harm them, and nothing was ever stolen from them.

dag: Mɛmiya duɣuri n-zaŋdi tampiligim niŋdi di puuni, ka mali soobuya mini taha ni dirijaba ni lahi din ni niŋdi buɣim. Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ daanya mali di lahi mini duɣuri zaa.
en: Make pans for the greasy ashes, and make shovels, bowls, hooks, and fire pans. All this equipment is to be made of bronze.

dag: N ku saɣim n ni lo o alikauli shɛli, bee n-taɣi n ni yaai n noli yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: I wont break my covenant. I wont renege on what crossed my lips.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ ni, n lan nya shɛli zaŋ chaŋ yɛm polo, ka di nyɛ yɛlikpeeni n sani.
en: There is something else I saw, a good example of how wisdom is regarded in this world.

dag: Turi maa nyɛla din saɣim n suhu; ka n lan ka tahima. N daa lihi bo nambɔzɔbo, amaa ka bi nya li; ka lihi bo bɛn ni maai n suhu, ka bi nya so.
en: Insults have broken my heart, and I am in despair. I had hoped for sympathy, but there was none; for comfort, but I found none.

dag: Pagɔrili noli ŋmanila bɔɣ zilinli; Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi bahi ninvuɣ so zuɣu n-yɛn lu di puuni.
en: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.

dag: ni Shɛfatia daŋ ni Hatil daŋ ni Pokɛrɛt Hazɛbaim daŋ ni Ami daŋ.
en: Shephatiah, Hattil, Pochereth-hazzebaim, and Ami.

dag: Lɛvinim shɛb bɛn kpalim puuni, bɛ daa pii fɔntins anahi Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti Mɛrari daŋ niriba. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ: Jokiniam mini Karita.
en: The rest of the Levites, the clan of Merari, received from the territory of Zebulun four cities: Jokneam, Kartah.

dag: Ka bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee muɣis a? Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, Paɣ ŋɔ n-daa yɛli ma, Zaŋm a bidibiga ŋɔ ka ti duɣi ŋubi zuŋɔ; ka sa zaŋ m mi bidibiga duɣi ŋubi biɛɣuni.
en: What's your trouble? She answered, The other day this woman here suggested that we eat my child, and then eat her child the next day.

dag: Amaa a yi saɣisi ninvuɣ biɛri ni bɛ zo n-yi bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali maa ni, ka ninvuɣ biɛri maa bi chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri maa, bɛ ni kpi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ni, amaa ka nyini lee tiligi a nyɛvili.
en: But suppose you do warn the wicked of their ways so that they might turn from them. If they dont turn from their ways, they will die in their guilt, but you will save your life.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti mali sariakaribo nyolɔrigu viɛnyɛliŋga kaman yi ni yɛn she binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la shɛm, di simdi ka a ti zaŋ salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli mal li.
en: From the same costly material make a breastpiece for the high priest to use in finding out what I want my people to do.

dag: Karimbaani niŋbu nyaaŋa nyɛla vi dibu, amaa bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋa nyɛla bɛn mali yɛm.
en: People who are proud will soon be disgraced. It is wiser to be modest.

dag: Juda zuliya niriba mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba dimnim ni daa wum ni bɛn labina maa mɛrila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ duu la.
en: The enemies of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin heard that the people had come back to rebuild the temple of the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Hal di nyaɣa yi kul kurigi tiŋgban ni, ka di mundili kuui do tiŋa.
en: Even though its roots grow old, and its stump dies in the ground.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa garigi yɛl o, Di gbinni m-bɔŋɔ: Piɛr ata maa nyɛla daba ata.
en: Joseph answered, I will tell you what the dream means. The three baskets mean three days.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Wuhim ti ŋahili la gbinni.
en: Then Peter spoke up, Explain this riddle to us.

dag: N sɔŋsim yirila Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ sanna.
en: My help will come from the Lord , the Creator of heaven and earth.

dag: Ɛdom naa ni daa zaɣisi ni Izraɛlnim di tim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gari maa, ka Izraɛlnim maa daa taɣi doli shɛli polo gari.
en: The king of Edom refused to let the Israelites travel through his country, so the Israelites turned around and went another way.

dag: ka doli soli din tuhi ka di chɛ ka napɔn barinim naba ku ŋmirigi, amaa ka lee ni malila alaafee.
en: Keep walking on straight paths, so that the lame foot may not be disabled, but instead be healed.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka a niriba maa lur a sizuura, ka gbib a zaligunim saha shɛlikam bɛ ni yɛn be a ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti bɛ yaannim ŋɔ ni.
en: Then your people will worship you and obey you for as long as they live in the land you gave their ancestors.

dag: Cham gili bɛ ni saɣim luɣ shɛli zaa kahikahi maa; ti dimnim maa saɣim binshɛɣukam din be Naawuni jɛmbu duu la.
en: Walk over these total ruins; our enemies have destroyed everything in the Temple.

dag: bɛ yi bi niŋdi niriba din tuhi Zallakudura Naa tooni.
en: denying someone justice before the Most High.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa sabi zaligu shɛli Musa ni daa pun sab zal la pa kuɣa maa zuɣu Izraɛlnim ninni.
en: There, in the presence of the Israelites, Joshua wrote on the stones a copy of the Instruction from Moses, which Moses had written earlier.

dag: Shɛbuɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Musa bia Gɛrishom mi bia la n-daa nyɛ kpɛm ŋun su azichinim fukumsi.
en: Shebuel, of the clan of Moses' son Gershom, was the chief official responsible for the Temple treasury.

dag: Hal n yi nyɛla ŋun ʒi yɛtɔɣa, amaa n lee bi kɔŋ baŋsim dina; binshɛɣukam puuni ti pun kahigiri dimbɔŋɔ yɛla n-wuhiri ya palɔni sahakam.
en: It is true that I am not a trained speaker, but I do have knowledge. We have shown this to you clearly in every way.

dag: O ni ti taɣi bihi laamba suhuri ti bɛ bihi, ka taɣi bihi suhuri ti bɛ laamba din ni chɛ ka n ku kana ti yɛli noli niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Elijah will help the parents become close to their children, and he will help the children become close to their parents. This must happen, or I will come and completely destroy your country.

dag: Kom ni binneen shɛba yi ni yɛn diri n-nyɛ: Binshɛɣukam din be kom ni ka mali gɔhi mini paɣiri teekunim puuni bee kulibɔna ni, yin ŋubimiya ba.
en: You may eat anything that lives in water and has fins and scales. But it would be disgusting for you to eat anything else that lives in water, and you must not even touch their dead bodies.

dag: Bɔ n-daa chɛ ka bɛ bi nya li? Bɛ daa bi bo li la yɛda niŋbu puuni, amaa ka daa bo li la bɛmaŋmaŋ tuma puuni. Bɛ daa tuui kuɣ tuurili shɛli.
en: And why not? Because they did not depend on faith but on what they did. And so they stumbled over the stumbling stone.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa niŋ ba nirilim. Musa daa nyɛla ninvuɣ titali Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni Firawuna min o kpamba ni o niriba sani.
en: The LORD made sure that the Egyptians were kind to the Hebrew people. In addition, Pharaohs officials and the Egyptian people even came to honor Moses as a great and important man in the land.

dag: ni zaŋdi ya tahiri maa, ka yi ti di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bindirigu, yin zaŋmiya di shɛli ti Yawɛ.
en: whenever you eat the lands food you will present a gift offering to the LORD.

dag: Noli ŋɔ zaa ni ti doli ya n-din ya hal ti kun ya, yi ni zaɣisi ni yi ku doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la zuɣu.
en: Thats how all these curses will come over you, pursuing you, reaching you until you are completely wiped out, because you didnt obey the LORD your Gods voice by keeping his commandments and his regulations that he gave you.

dag: Di pala o ni daa saɣi ti ni daa kpam o jaande shɛm la kɔŋko, amaa omaŋmaŋ suhu yubu zuɣu ka o gba suhu daa ye yi sani kandina zuɣu.
en: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.

dag: ka o daa niŋ omaŋmaŋ ni pun lo shɛm, ka kahigi ashili nia shɛli o ni pun lo ni o pal li Masia zuɣu la wuhi ti.
en: he let us know his secret plan. This was what God wanted, and he planned to do it through Christ.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni yi mali yurilim yi bebu ni kaman Masia ni daa yu ti ka zaŋ omaŋ pa talima ti zuɣu, ka di tiɣi Naawuni nini kaman sara shɛli din nyom viɛl ŋun Naawuni san la.
en: Live your life with love, following the example of Christ, who loved us and gave himself for us. He was a sacrificial offering that smelled sweet to God.

dag: Di ŋubiya kuruchu dama o mali takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, amaa o bi gbuɣiri ŋubira. O nyɛla daɣiri bini yi sani.
en: Do not eat pigs. They must be considered unclean; they have divided hoofs, but do not chew the cud.

dag: N ni chɛ ka mɔɣa dɔni zoya sunsuuni tiŋgban kuŋ ni, ka chɛ ka kɔbil nina yooi vinvama ni. N ni chɛ ka kom puhigi mɔɣu ni zɔra, ka chɛ ka kom yi tiŋgban kuŋ ni na zɔra.
en: I will make rivers flow on mountain peaks. I will send streams to fill the valleys. Dry and barren land will flow with springs and become a lake.

dag: Yawɛ, dimbɔŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa, a ni lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ti, ka chɛ ka ti di wahala shɛŋa di ni bi simdi ni ti di?.
en: After all this, will you hold back, LORD? Will you keep silent and torment us so terribly?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan bɔhi Sintani, A tɛhi n dabili Ayuba yɛla? So bi ŋman o dunia ni. O nyɛla ŋun ka galimi ka o biɛhigu be tibi zaa, ka o nyɛ ŋun zɔri Naawuni, ka bi tumdi zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Did you notice my servant Job? the Lord asked. There is no one on earth as faithful and good as he is. He worships me and is careful not to do anything evil.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a ni tooi kpuɣ a zuɣu ka galimi kani, a ni yi barina ni, ka ku lan zɔri dabiɛm.
en: Then you won't be ashamed; you will be confident and fearless.

dag: Yɛlim o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa. Nyin nyɛbiga ŋun bahibahi amaŋ be ko sunsuuni ka yɛra, Nail nyɛla n ni su shɛli. Mani n-daa gbi li.
en: that I am saying: King of Egypt, you were like a giant crocodile lying in a river. You acted as though you owned the Nile and made it for yourself. But now I, the Lord God, am your enemy!.

dag: ka o suhu ti maai ka o tam a ni niŋ o shɛm maa yɛla. Di nyaaŋa ka n naan yi tim na ka bɛ ti zaŋ a na. Bɔzuɣu ka n yɛn kɔŋ m bidibis ayi zaa dahin yini.
en: until your brothers anger at you goes away and he forgets what you did to him. Then I will send for you and bring you back from there. Why should I suffer the loss of both of you on one day.

dag: nti zaŋ li kpɛhi bɛ buɣili Dagɔn duu ti zali baɣili buɣili Dagɔn.
en: Then the Philistines took Gods chest and brought it into Dagons temple and set it next to Dagon.

dag: Ka sandira maa daa damd o tooni m-balind o yɛra, N dana, na dim ma suɣilo, n ni yo a di zaa.
en: But the servant fell down, kneeled before him, and said, Please, be patient with me, and Ill pay you back.

dag: Izraɛlnima, di maliya suhupiɛlli. Miriya ka yi chɛ ka yi suhu paligi kaman zuliya shɛb la. Dama yi zaɣisi yi Naawuni ka tumdila yolimyolim. Yi yuya ni yi tum yolimyolim maa ka deei yi sanyoo kabɔɣili kam ni.
en: Israel, dont celebrate like the nations do. Dont be happy. You acted like a prostitute and left your God. You committed your sexual sin on every threshing floor.

dag: So yi bi yuri ka tum alahichi, ŋun bom yuun yini bunyaŋ mali alahichi tumbu sara.
en: If an individual sins unintentionally, that person must present a one-year-old female goat for a purification offering.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Hɛman ŋun daa nyɛ naa daanab maa bidibisi, ka di daa doli Naawuni ni daa lo o alikauli ni o ni tibig o la. Dama Naawuni daa ti o la bidibisi pinaanahi ni bipuɣins ata.
en: All these were the family of Heman the kings seer, according to Gods promise to honor him. God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

dag: N suhir a, ni a di chaŋ, ka m bo pin na ti ti a. Ka o yɛl o, N ni guh a hal ka a ti labina.
en: Please wait here. Dont go away until I come back to you. Let me bring my offering and set it down in front of you. And the Lord said, I will wait until you come back.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ nina ni sabigimi gari sala. So bi lan baŋdi ba soya zuɣu. Bɛ niŋgbuŋgbana kuumi pa bɛ kɔba zuɣu; di kuumi kaman dari la.
en: But now their faces are blacker than soot. No one even recognizes them in the streets. Their skin is wrinkled over their bones. Their skin is like wood.

dag: Ka Keenannim tintariga daa yi Sidɔn Gɛra polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai Gaza zaŋ lab Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni Adima ni Zɛbɔiim zaŋ hal ti paai Lasha.
en: until the Canaanite borders reached from Sidon southward to Gerar near Gaza, and eastward to Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim near Lasha.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, N nam pala dunia ŋɔ nam. N nam yi di nyɛla dunia ŋɔ nam, n niriba naan zabi n zuɣu ka so ku tooi zaŋ ma niŋ Yɛhudianim nuu ni. Amaa n nam pala dunia ŋɔ nam.
en: Jesus said, My kingdom does not belong to this world; if my kingdom belonged to this world, my followers would fight to keep me from being handed over to the Jewish authorities. No, my kingdom does not belong here.

dag: Dama Naawuni nir maa ni daa yɛli naa, Biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha bɛ sa ni kɔhi zim balli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ata anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini, ka kɔhi chi din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayɔbu mi anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini Samaria dunɔdal ni la.
en: Elisha had told the king that by that time the following day ten pounds of the best wheat or twenty pounds of barley would be sold in Samaria for one piece of silver.

dag: Ŋun wuhiri shɛli omaŋmaŋ yiko ni bɔrila omaŋmaŋ jilima nyabu, amaa ŋun bɔri ŋun tim o na jilima nyabu nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana, ka ʒiri ka o nol ni.
en: Those who speak on their own seek glory for themselves. Those who seek the glory of him who sent me are people of truth; theres no falsehood in them.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka yi ni ti yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Kuhimiya bol o yuli ka o sɔŋ ya! Yɛlimiya zuliya kam zaa o ni tum tuun shɛŋa! Yɛlimiya ba ni o galisiya pam!.
en: A day is coming when people will sing, Give thanks to the Lord ! Call for him to help you! Tell all the nations what he has done! Tell them how great he is!.

dag: Bɛ gba daa zaŋla bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi bahi tiŋa, ka di leei waɣiri. Amaa ka Aduna jaaŋgbee maa daa zaŋ bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi maa vali.
en: Each one threw down his rod, and they turned into cobras. But then Aarons rod swallowed up each of their rods.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, a chɛ ka o takɔbi noli gbilim; ka bi zan o nyaaŋa tɔbu ni.
en: You have made his weapons useless and let him be defeated in battle.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni labisi o ni ʒiɛm m pɔri shɛl la min o ni saɣim alikauli shɛli la ʒil o.
en: The Sovereign Lord says, As surely as I am the living God, I will punish him for breaking the treaty which he swore in my name to keep.

dag: Ka Naa Amɔn kpambalib daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo n-ku o o yiŋa.
en: Amons officials plotted against him and assassinated the king in his palace.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Timmi niriba ka bɛ chaŋ ti puɣisi nya Keenan tiŋgbɔn.
en: The Lord said to Moses.

dag: Ka salo maa zaa daa saɣi ni bɛ niŋmi lala, dama di daa nyɛla din tiɣi niriba maa zaa nini.
en: The people were pleased with the suggestion and agreed to it.

dag: Dindali maa yi ni ti boli tab na ka yi ti ʒini yi wain tihi mini yi fiig tihi gbini. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, At that time people will sit and talk with their friends and neighbors. They will invite each other to sit under the fig trees and grapevines.

dag: Mikimasinim daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pisinaayi.
en: from the town of Micmash:.

dag: So yi tɛhi ni o nyɛla anabi bee ŋun mi Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛla, di simdi ni o saɣi ni n ni sabiri shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ nyɛla ti Duuma zaligu.
en: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.

dag: Ka yi yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin daŋmi yili maa nim puhibu ŋ-ŋɔ: Naawuni niŋmi alibarika niŋ yili ŋɔ nim ni.
en: Before you go into a house, say, Peace be with this home.

dag: Ka pateesa shɛŋa din daa yili dunoli maa yaɣ yini wɔɣilim daa pooi mita ayopɔin biɛla, ka di mali daantalis ata mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ata.
en: There were twenty-two and a half feet of drapes on one side with three posts and three bases for them.

dag: Ka naa daa tim ti yih o na. Tiŋ maa niriba maa naa n-daa yih o.
en: Then the king of Egypt set Joseph free.

dag: Niriba turi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋdi bindira sɔɣira, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kɔhir li mali alibarika.
en: People curse a greedy man who refuses to sell his grain, but they bless a man who sells his grain to feed others.

dag: M ba Dauda daa lo o suhu ni ni o ni me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ yuli jilima.
en: My father David wanted to build a temple for the name of the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi maani Ijipti tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni yi ni kana ti ʒini ŋɔ wuna n-chɛ ka yi nuhi tuma chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu? Yi bɔri ni yi kpi ka leei dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa ni yɛn maani shɛba ansarisi ka turi shɛba?.
en: Why do you anger me by what you do: by burning incense to other gods in the land of Egypt where you have come to live? You will be eliminated and become an object of cursing and disgrace among all the nations of the earth.

dag: Ka dunianim suhuri ni paligi bɛ kum maa zuɣu, ka bɛ ni mali suhupiɛlli ka tiri tab pina, anabinima ayi maa ni daa yi nahindi dunianim shɛm la zuɣu.
en: Those who live on earth will rejoice over them. They will celebrate and give each other gifts, because these two prophets had brought such pain to those who live on earth.

dag: Ka Dauda daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zal o shɛm maa, ka daa ku Filistianim maa Gɛba hal ti paai Gɛza.
en: David followed Gods orders exactly, and they defeated the Philistine army from Gibeon all the way to Gezer.

dag: Ka Ɛsta garigi yɛl o, Ti dim maa n-nyɛ Haman ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ. Di saha maa ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Haman naa mini Ɛsta tooni.
en: Esther said, The man against us, our enemy, is this wicked Haman. Then Haman was filled with terror before the king and queen.

dag: Yimiya luɣilikam na ti liri ba. Yɔhimiya bɛ kambɔna. Laɣimmiya ba duhi kaman bɛ ni kpaai kawana duhi shɛm la n ku bɛ zaa. Di chɛliya ka binshɛli lan kpalim nimaani.
en: Come against her from every side; throw open her granaries; pile her up like stalks of grain; totally destroy her; leave nothing intact.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa kul bɔrila tin shɛli din so. Tin shɛli din be alizanda ni ka bɛ daa bɔra. Dinzuɣu vi bi mali Naawuni ni bɛ bol o bɛ Naawuni, dama o pun me tiŋ zali ba.
en: But at this point in time, they are longing for a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore, God isnt ashamed to be called their God—he has prepared a city for them.

dag: Bɛ daa mɛla gooni gili Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaa. Doo maa ni daa gbibi bimbuɣisirigu shɛli o nuu ni maa wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita ata. Ka o daa zaŋ li buɣisi gooni maa barilim mini di dubu. Di dubu daa nyɛla mita ata, ka di barilim gba nyɛ mita ata.
en: The first thing I saw was an outer wall that completely surrounded the temple area. The man took his measuring stick, which was three meters long, and measured the wall; it was three meters high and three meters thick.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ piɛguliba ŋɔ, kummiya, kummiya pampam, ka lunya bilim tampiligim ni, dama yi kubu biɛɣu neeya, ka yi wurim kpe yɔɣu biɛɣu neei, ka yi ni ti lu kaman duɣu viɛlli la.
en: Shepherds, you should be leading the sheep. Start crying, you great leaders! Roll around on the ground in pain, you leaders of the sheep. It is now time for your slaughter. You will be scattered everywhere, like pieces flying from a broken jar.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ binʒim maa kpaai vie Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini din be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni la, ka zaŋ biŋkpam nyo buɣim ka di nyɛ din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: The priest shall throw the blood against the sides of the altar at the entrance of the Tent and burn the fat to produce an odor that is pleasing to the Lord .

dag: Ka Naawuni ni ti Yisa jilima yu shɛli maa zuɣu la ni chɛ ka sokam bɛn be alizanda ni mini bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni ni bɛn be tiŋgbani puuni ha ni ti gbani o tooni.
en: so that at the name of Jesus everyone in heaven, on earth, and under the earth might bow.

dag: Ka o ba Yisahaku bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee bala? Ka o yɛl o, Mani a bituuli Iso.
en: Who are you? Isaac asked. Your older son Esau, he answered.

dag: Di saha ka Babilɔn naa Baladan bia Mɛrɔdakibaladan daa wum ni Hɛzɛkia daa biɛra, amaa ka nya alaafee, ka o daa sab gbaŋ m-bo pini pahi tim tuumba ni bɛ zaŋ li na ti ti Hɛzɛkia.
en: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah was well, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.

dag: Lala n-nyɛn ya. Yi ŋmanila wuntizɔriba niriba sani, amaa ka bilikɔnsi mini tuumbiɛri lee pali yi suhuri ni.
en: That's what you are like. Outside you look good, but inside you are evil and only pretend to be good.

dag: Ka Asa mini tɔbbihi bɛn daa be o sani maa daa kari doli ba ni Gɛra n-daa ku Itiɔpianim maa zaa ka so bi kpalim, dama Yawɛ min o tɔbbihi daa ku ba. Ka Judanim maa daa di nɛma pam chaŋ.
en: Asa and his troops chased them as far as Gerar. The Cushites fell until there were no survivors. They were completely crushed by the LORD and his army, who carried off a huge amount of loot.

dag: O daa lan nyo tindaannim kɔba buɣim bɛ bimbina zuɣu, ka daa yihi Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm daɣiri ni.
en: Josiah even burned the bones of the priests who had served the Baal gods on their own altars. This is how he destroyed idols and idol worship from Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛl o, Miri ka a zaŋ a nuu shihi bia maa bee n-niŋ o shɛli; dama pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni a shiri zɔri Naawuni hal ka bi mɔŋ o a bigaŋ ŋɔ.
en: The messenger said, Dont stretch out your hand against the young man, and dont do anything to him. I now know that you revere God and didnt hold back your son, your only son, from me.

dag: Yi kul yɛra, Ti nyee nyɔniya, ka naɣiri yi nyɛhi niŋdi ma. Yi zaŋdi yi ni fa biŋkɔb shɛb bee biŋkɔb gbariti bee biŋkɔb barinim na ti maani sara tiri ma, yi tɛhiya ni n ni dee li yi sani? Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You get so disgusted that you even make vulgar signs at me. And for an offering, you bring stolen animals or those that are lame or sick. Should I accept these?.

dag: Ka Naa Asa daa chɛ ka bɛ moli molo Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, o mi daa bi yihi so nuu. Ka bɛ daa va Baasha ni daa mali kuɣ shɛŋa mini da shɛŋa mɛri Rama maa na, ka ŋun Naa Asa daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li me Gɛba din be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni la mini Mizipa.
en: Asa ordered everyone in Judah to carry away the stones and wood Baasha had used to strengthen the town of Ramah. Then he used these same stones and wood to fortify the town of Geba in the territory of Benjamin and the town of Mizpah.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kuhi yɛli, Ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda, pa mani ka o niŋ yɛda, amaa ŋun tim ma na maa ka o niŋ yɛda maa.
en: Then Jesus said loudly, Everyone who believes in me is really believing in the one who sent me.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni nir niŋ siɣa dimbɔŋɔ puuni. Ŋunkam mali kookali ni tooi baŋ biŋkɔbigu maa namba maa, dama di nyɛla ninsal namba. O namba maa nyɛla kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: This calls for wisdom. Whoever is intelligent can figure out the meaning of the number of the beast, because the number stands for the name of someone. Its number is .

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a mini bɛn vari ma la va; ka chɛ ka a mini bɛn tuhiri ma la tuhi!.
en: LORD, argue with those who argue with me; fight with those who fight against me!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛli ba, Chamiya Bɛtilihɛm nti bo bia maa viɛnyɛliŋga; yi yi ti nya o ni be shɛli, yin labimiyana ti yɛli ma, ka n gba chaŋ ti jɛm o.
en: He sent them to Bethlehem, saying, Go and search carefully for the child. When youve found him, report to me so that I too may go and honor him.

dag: Bɛ yɛri yɛtɔɣ biɛri zaŋ chaŋ a polo, ka ŋmari ʒiri zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.

dag: N ni siɣina ti tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa nimaani; ka zaŋ shi so ŋun be a zuɣu maa yiko shɛli niŋ bɛ ni, ka bɛ ʒi niriba maa ʒili maa sɔŋ a, ka a kɔŋko ku lan ʒi li.
en: While I am talking with you there, I will give them some of your authority, so they can share responsibility for my people. You will no longer have to care for them by yourself.

dag: Bɛ ni di nasara bɛ tuma ni, ka alɔbo ku di bɛ bihi. N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ mini bɛ bihi ni sahakam.
en: They wont labor in vain, nor bear children to a world of horrors, because they will be people blessed by the LORD, they along with their descendants.

dag: Di saha maa ka Zaliguzaɣisira maa ni ti yi zahira, ka ti Duuma Yisa ni ti zaŋ o vuhim pɔhim din yir o nol ni na ku o ka bah o yoli, ŋun Yisa palo yibu dali o labbuna saha.
en: Then the person who is lawless will be revealed. The Lord Jesus will destroy him with the breath from his mouth. When the Lord comes, his appearance will put an end to him.

dag: A dim yi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ viɛla, nyin di niŋ li yɛda, dama din chihira ayopɔin sɔɣi be di ni.
en: Though they speak graciously, dont believe them, for seven horrible things are in their heart.

dag: Bɛn gbilisi tibili wum yɛlli ni tɔŋ. Ka bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani ni mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Pay attention to what you are taught, and you will be successful; trust in the Lord and you will be happy.

dag: Naa Amazia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that Amaziah did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Di tamya zaɣ viɛlli niŋbu yɛla, ka zaŋmiya yi ni mali shɛli sɔŋdi taba, dama dina n-nyɛ sara shɛŋa din tiɣiri Naawuni nini.
en: Dont forget to do good and to share what you have because God is pleased with these kinds of sacrifices.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ nyini ŋun yuri nyaɣisim pam ni nyini ŋun tɛhi ni shɛli ku niŋ a la, wumma! A tɛhiya ni a galisimi m-be kaman Naawuni la, ka so kani ŋ-ŋman a. A bi tɛhi ni a ni leei pakoli bee n-kɔŋ bihi.
en: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.

dag: dindina yin niŋmiya ʒiri shɛhiralan maa kaman o ni di lo ni o niŋ o kpee maa shɛm maa, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni.
en: then you must do to him what he had planned to do to his fellow Israelite. Remove such evil from your community!.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi nyaŋ yi dimnim bɛn yiɣisi ni bɛ tuhi ya. Bɛ ni ti doli so yini kana ni be ti tuhi ya, ka ni ti ŋmaligi guui doli soya ayopɔin zo ka chɛn ya.
en: The Lord will help you defeat your enemies and make them scatter in all directions.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Yinim bɛn kalinli pɔri ŋɔ, di zɔriya dabiɛm, dama di nyɛla yi Ba Naawuni yubu ni o tin ya nam.
en: My little group of disciples, don't be afraid! Your Father wants to give you the kingdom.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai luɣ shɛli bɛ ni yɛn gbe, ka bɛ ni yino lɔrig o kpalaŋa ni o niŋ bindirigu ti o buŋa ka nya ka liɣiri be o kpalaŋ maa nol ni;.
en: At the place where they spent the night, one of them opened his sack to feed his donkey and found his money at the top of the sack.

dag: Ŋun di nasara, n ni chɛ ka m min o laɣim ʒini n nam ʒiishee kaman n gba ni daa di nasara ka m mini m Ba Naawuni laɣim ʒi o nam ʒiishee shɛm la.
en: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Ijiptinim niŋ ya nirilim din ni chɛ ka yi ku yi nimaani chaŋ ni nu zaŋa.
en: I will make the Egyptians respect you so that when my people leave, they will not go empty-handed.

dag: ni n ku zaŋ a gali bee a namdili mia bee a ni su binshɛlikam, ka a ti yɛli, Mani n-chɛ ka Ibram leei bundana.
en: I promise that I will not keep anything that is yours—not even a thread or a sandal strap! I dont want you to say, I made Abram rich.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa yɛli Yisifu, N yi kpi pumpɔŋɔ, m paɣiya, n ni nya a ni n nini ka baŋ ni a na be a nyɛvil ni maa zuɣu.
en: Then Israel said to Joseph, Now I can die in peace. I have seen your face, and I know that you are still alive.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim maa daa tooi niŋ bɛ dimnim maa bɛ ni bɔri shɛm. Bɛ daa zaŋla takɔbiri ku bɛ dimnim maa.
en: The Jews defeated all their enemies. They used swords to kill and destroy them. They did what they wanted to the people who hated them.

dag: Chamiya chuɣu maa ni. Man na ku chaŋ di ni, dama n saha na bi paai.
en: You go up to the festival. Im not going to this one because my time hasnt yet come.

dag: Ka Abishai Zɛruya bia la daa yɛli, Di simdi ni ti ku Shimɛi o ni daa tu Yawɛ ninvuɣ gahindili ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Abishai son of Zeruiah said, Lets kill him for all the bad things he said about the Lord s chosen king. .

dag: Ka a daa yɛli tinim a daba ŋɔ, Ʒimiy o ka n sanna ka n ti nya o.
en: You told your servants, Bring him down to me so I can see him.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la n-ti Yawɛ o ni daa me Yawɛ sara maligu bimbin shɛli zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa varanda tooni la zuɣu.
en: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to the Lord on the Lord s altar. He built that altar in front of the Temple porch.

dag: Di simdi ka o zaŋ kawana lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili pahi naɣilaa kam zuɣu, ka lan zaŋ kawana lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili pahi piɛlaa kam zuɣu m-mali sara din nyɛ o chi min o kawana sara, ka bo kpam lita ata pahi kawaan tahili kam zuɣu.
en: The ruler will give an ephah of barley as a grain offering with each bull, and an ephah of barley with each ram. He must give a hin of oil for each ephah of grain.

dag: Yawɛ bela zuɣusaa o luɣ kasi shee ka lihirina. O bela alizanda ni ka lihiri dunia ŋɔ na.
en: From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.

dag: Yi yi yɛli Ti ni nahim o pam, dama yɛlli maa mi yila o kɔbili ni na.
en: You say, How will we pursue him so that the root of the matter can be found in him.

dag: Di yi pa lala bɛ ni nyuli kuli, ka tam zaligu yɛla, ka mɔŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be muɣisigu ni zaa yɛlimaŋli.
en: Drinking makes you forget your responsibilities, and you mistreat the poor.

dag: Yawɛ mali yɛlimaŋli, dama n zaɣis o yɛligu. Amaa zuliya kam zaa, wummiya, nyamiya n ni diri wahala shɛm. Bɛ gbahi m paɣisara mini n nachimba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: Now Jerusalem says, I refused to listen to the Lord , so he is right for doing these things. So listen, all you people! Look at my pain! My young women and men have gone into captivity.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, sabimi yilli ŋɔ n-zaŋ li wuhi Izraɛlnima, zaŋm li niŋ bɛ noya ni din ni chɛ ka yilli ŋɔ leei shɛhira n sani n-jɛndi Izraɛlnima.
en: So in light of all that, you must write down this poem and teach it to the Israelites. Put it in their mouths so that the poem becomes a witness for me against them.

dag: Jaande, ŋmaligimiya, ka di tumiya taali. Ŋmaligimiya pumpɔŋɔ, yi zilisi n nimmaŋtali.
en: You need to start over and stop being so unfair! Think again, because I am innocent.

dag: Timiya sokam zaa jilima. Yumiya mabihili. Lumiya Naawuni sizuura. Timiya Nazuɣu jilima.
en: Respect everyone, love other believers, honor God, and respect the Emperor.

dag: Ka do so ŋun yuli daa booni Ananias min o paɣ Safira bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ ni su shɛli kɔhi.
en: Ananias and his wife Sapphira also sold a piece of property.

dag: Bee n yi chɛ ka alɔbo lu di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka n suhu yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu ni n ku ba, ka n kuri ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri bɛn be di ni.
en: And suppose I am so angry that I send a deadly disease to wipe out the people and livestock of a sinful nation.

dag: N Naawuni, n ni ŋme mɔɣilo paɣ a a ʒiɛyimtali zuɣu; N ni ŋme mɔɣilo n-yili yila paɣi nyin Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ.
en: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ nirilim min o yurilim ni daa ti yi palo ninsalinim san la.
en: But when the kindness and love of God our Savior was revealed.

dag: Amaa nyini zanim baɣili ma kpe, ka n yɛl a fukumsi zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, ka a zaŋ wuhi ba ka bɛ ti dol li n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba ni bɛ su maa ni.
en: but you stand here near me. I will tell you all the commands, laws, and rules that you must teach them. They must do these things in the land that I am giving them to live in.

dag: Di saha maa Dauda daa ʒila tiŋ maa dunoya ayi sunsuuni, ka tiŋgula daa ti du n-tam dunɔdali dufahirili zuɣusaa n-lihi ha nya do so ni zɔrina o kɔŋko.
en: Now David was sitting between the two gates. The watchman on duty went up on the roof of the gate by the wall. He looked out and saw a man running alone.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa sabi yilli ŋɔ dindali maa n-zaŋ li wuhi Izraɛlnim maa.
en: That same day Moses wrote down the song and taught it to the people of Israel.

dag: Ka o daa kpɛri bɛ jɛmbu duri ni ti wuhiri ba, ka sokam zaa daa tibigir o pam.
en: He taught in the Jewish synagogues, and everyone praised him.

dag: ka chɛ a niriba bɛn tum alahichi a sani maa mini biriginsim shɛli bɛ ni birig a sani maa zaa taali, ka zo ba nambɔɣu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbahi ba leei daba maa sani, ka lala chɛ ka bɛ gba zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: Forgive your people no matter how much they have sinned against you. Make the enemies who defeated them be kind to them.

dag: Ti mabihi, di kpala talahi ni ti kul paɣiri Naawuni yi zuɣu sahakam. Di tuhiya ni ti niŋ lala, dama yi yɛda kul zoorimi, ka yi yurilim zaŋ chaŋ yi tab sani gba kul zoori pahira.
en: Brothers and sisters, we must always thank God for you. This is only right because your faithfulness is growing by leaps and bounds, and the love that all of you have for each other is increasing.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan boli do so ŋun daa nyɛ zom maa na m-pahi buyi nti yɛl o, Paɣimi Naawuni; amaa ti lee mi ni doo ŋɔ nyɛla alahichilana.
en: The leaders called the man back and said, Swear by God to tell the truth! We know that Jesus is a sinner.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kali bɛ bidibisi bɛn nyɛ goli yini bihi zaŋ tabili ninkura, ka bɛ kalinli nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaata; dama bɛ daa bi zaŋ Lɛvinim pahi Izraɛlnim kalinli ni, bɛ ni daa bi pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa pal shɛli ti ba la zuɣu.
en: Their enrollment was . consisting of every male one month old and above. They werent enrolled with the Israelites because no inheritance of land was given to them among the Israelites.

dag: Birimiya wuntitali ti yimaŋa, ka ti kpuɣi atam din nyɛ yurilim din ka ŋmali. Komiya yi tiŋgbani din doya ka bi ko la, dama saha paaya ni yi bo Yawɛ ka o kana ti tiligi ya.
en: Sow for yourselves righteousness; reap faithful love; break up your unplanted ground, for it is time to seek the LORD, that he may come and rain righteousness upon you.

dag: dama nyɛvili gari bindirigu, ka niŋgbuŋ mi gari situra.
en: Life is more than food or clothing.

dag: A zaŋ ma bahila bɔɣ zilinli ni, luɣ shɛli din zibisi ka zilima.
en: You placed me down in the deepest pit, in places dark and deep.

dag: Pita ni daa ti ka Antiɔk na, n daa galim o o ninni, dama o ni daa niŋ shɛm nyɛla din simdi galimbu.
en: When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong.

dag: Yisifu ŋmanila ti shɛli din wandi wala, ka nyɛ din ʒe n-tab kulibɔŋ, ka di wula zooi yaɣi kuligbiriŋ zuɣu.
en: Joseph is a young bull, a young bull by a spring, who strides with oxen.

dag: Amaa ka Ibram bɔhi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ baŋ ni n ni ti su li.
en: But Abram said, LORD God, how do I know that I will actually possess it.

dag: Bɔ saha ka yi yɛn chɛ ma nahimbu, ka chɛ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa yi ni mali dariti tɔhiri ma ŋɔ?.
en: How long will you torture me with your words?.

dag: Sulemaana daa di nam m-be Jɛrusalɛm n-su Izraɛlnim zaa la yuun pihinahi.
en: Solomon ruled in Jerusalem over all Israel for years.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yiɣisi dol o lab kul o yiŋa nti di bindirigu ka nyu kom.
en: so he went home with him and ate and drank.

dag: Wumm a ba ŋun dɔɣ a yɛligu. Miri ka a ʒiɛm a ma o yi ti kurigi.
en: Listen to your father. Without him, you would never have been born. Respect your mother, even when she is old.

dag: Kɔbil shɛli nabihi ni daa gbi. Kolibil shɛli niriba toondaannim ni daa gbi. Nam jaaŋgbɛhi ka bɛ daa zaŋ gbi li. Bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi ka bɛ daa zaŋ gbi li. Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi yɔɣu maa ni chaŋ Matana.
en: The well that the officials dug, that the officials of the people hollowed out with the rulers scepter and their staffs. They marched from the desert to Mattanah.

dag: Faralan bi tuuli ni di, ka nandan dɔni ni alaafee, amaa n ni chɛ ka kum ku yi bihi, ka ku yi puuni bɛn kpalim.
en: But even the poorest of my people will be able to eat safely. And their children will be able to lie down and feel safe. But I will make your family die from hunger, and your enemy will kill anyone who survives.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl tuma kpamba maa daa baŋ ni yɛlli ka bɛ nya maa, bɛ ni daa yɛli ba ni bɛ kul ŋmam bilichiisi maa kaman bɛ ni yi pun ŋmari li shɛm tariga dabisili kam la zuɣu.
en: The Israelite supervisors saw how impossible their situation was when they were commanded, Dont reduce your daily quota of bricks.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa ti lan tuhi nyaŋ Filistianima, ka fa Gaat mini di tiŋkpansi zaa Filistianim maa sani.
en: Later, David attacked the Philistines and defeated them. He took the town of Gath and the other small towns around it from the Philistines.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb suhuri daa kpɛm pam ka bɛ zaɣisi yɛda niŋbu, ka tari Yisa soli maa daɣiri salo maa ni. Di saha ka Pool daa chɛ ba, ka woligi Yisa nyaandoliba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ Tairanus kariŋ duu nti tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛla dabisili kam.
en: but some of them were stubborn and refused to believe. In front of everyone they said terrible things about God's Way. Paul left and took the followers with him to the lecture hall of Tyrannus. He spoke there every day.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani tariga daa nyɛla Jaza zaŋ tabili Giliad tin kara zaa ni Amɔrinim tiŋgbani pirigili zaŋ hal ti paai Aroa din be Raba wulimpuhili polo la.
en: Their territory included Jazer and all the cities of Gilead, half the land of Ammon as far as Aroer, which is east of Rabbah;.

dag: Jɔsia bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɔhanan ŋun daa nyɛ o bikpɛma, ŋun pah ayi n-daa nyɛ Jɛhoyakim, ka ŋun pah ata nyɛ Zɛdɛkia, ka ŋun pah anahi nyɛ Shallum.
en: Josiah had four sons: Johanan, Jehoiakim, Zedekiah, and Joahaz.

dag: amaa di zuliya maa nim yi tumdi zaɣ biɛɣu n sani, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum n yɛligu, dindina n ni taɣi n tɛha zaŋ chaŋ zaɣ viɛl shɛli n ni di yɛn niŋ ba maa polo.
en: But if I see that nation doing evil things and not obeying me, I will think again about the good I had planned to do for them.

dag: amaa jɛmmiyala man Yawɛ ŋun daa teeg n nuu n-zaŋ n yiko din galisi pam yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la; damdimiya n tooni ka maani yi sara maligu tiri ma.
en: Worship only me! I am the one who rescued you from Egypt with my mighty power. Bow down to me and offer sacrifices.

dag: Maliya biɛrisuŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani, ka di chɛ ka bɛ yi tɔɣisiri n-dalindi ya ni yi nyɛla tuumbiɛtumdiba, bɛ ni bahi nya yi tuun suma ka ti Naawuni jilima o kandina dali.
en: Your conduct among the heathen should be so good that when they accuse you of being evildoers, they will have to recognize your good deeds and so praise God on the Day of his coming.

dag: Dunɔdali zɔntua maa ni, teebuya ayi daa ʒiɛla yaɣ yini polo ka teebuya ayi ʒe yaɣ din la polo. Di zuɣu ka bɛ daa yɛn kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi maani sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la min alahichi sara ni alahichi sanyoo sara la.
en: There were two tables on each side of the door of this porch. The animals for the burnt offerings, the sin offerings, and the guilt offerings were killed on these tables.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm maa zuɣu chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai niriba maa pam ka bɛ yɛl o, Ka tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ŋɔ? Bɛ daa baŋya ni o yila Yawɛ sani zɔra, dama omaŋmaŋa n-daa pun yɛli ba lala.
en: When the sailors heard this, they were frightened, because Jonah had already told them he was running from the Lord . Then they said, Do you know what you have done.

dag: Di yɛla daa naɣ ti yila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pa ti mabi maŋa la sanna. Bɛ daa kamina nti kpe ti ni ni bɛ puɣisi baŋ ti ni mali yolisim shɛli Yisa Masia ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpɛhi ti dabitim ni.
en: although some wanted it done. Pretending to be believers, these men slipped into our group as spies, in order to find out about the freedom we have through our union with Christ Jesus. They wanted to make slaves of us.

dag: Ka Judanim maa zaa daa garigi yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Naa ni nyɛ ti daŋ ni nir zuɣu. Ka wula ka yi suhuri yiɣisi yɛlli ŋɔ zuɣu? Yi nya ka ti dila naa binshɛli? Bee o ti ti la pini.
en: The people of Judah answered, Why are you so angry? We are the king's relatives. He didn't give us any food, and we didn't take anything for ourselves.

dag: Yi yi ti daai yi dimnim pihi luhi ka ku ba dahin shɛli, kom ni ti zɔri yiri zoya din du pam mini kuŋkuna din du pam zaa ni na.
en: Every mountain and hill will have streams filled with water. These things will happen after many people are killed and the enemys towers are pulled down.

dag: Yawɛ yi bahi li noli, wula ka di lee yɛn tooi fo? O zal li mi ni di liri Ashikɛlɔnnim mini bɛn be teeku noli.
en: But how can the sword of the Lord rest? The Lord gave it a command. He commanded it to attack the city of Ashkelon and the seacoast.

dag: N ni zaŋ a niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka bɛ wurim a ni ko pin shɛli la min a ni daa me binshɛŋa din dundu zali luɣ shɛŋa zaa la. Bɛ ni ti pirig a situra zaa, ka yeeg a yɛ viɛla zaa, ka chɛ a zal a zaɣim.
en: I will let those lovers have you. They will destroy your mounds. They will burn your places for worship. They will tear off your clothes and take your beautiful jewelry. They will leave you bare and naked as you were when I found you .

dag: Bɛ nyɛla Hiburunima? N gba nyɛla Hiburu. Bɛ nyɛla Izraɛl zuliya? N gba nyɛla Izraɛl zuliya. Bɛ nyɛla Ibrahimma yaansi? N gba nyɛla o yaaŋa.
en: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they Abraham's descendants? So am I.

dag: Ŋuna n-zali ba ni bɛ kul beni sahakam. O zali ba la zaligu, ka di mi ku yiɣisi.
en: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa kpah o zuɣu ni di zuɣu, ka chɛ ka buŋ ŋun bi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa kaman ninsal la n-kari anabi maa o yinyari tuma ni.
en: and was rebuked for his sin. His donkey spoke with a human voice and stopped the prophet's insane action.

dag: Ka Judanim daa kana ti booi kpam bahi Dauda zuɣu ni nimaani n-zaŋ o leei Judanim naa. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda ni Jabɛshigiliadnima n-daa sɔɣi Sool.
en: Then the men of Judah came to Hebron and anointed David as king of Judah. When David heard that the people of Jabesh in Gilead had buried Saul.

dag: Naa Dauda daa yɛliya: N Duuma Naawuni, chɛ ka bɛ bindiriyubo leei zana mini tɔŋ gbahi ba; ka chɛ ka bɛ lu ka nya tibidarigibo.
en: Then David said, Turn their meals into bait for a trap, so that they will stumble and be given what they deserve.

dag: Gɛrishɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Libini mini Shimɛi ni bɛ malibu.
en: Gershon had two sons, Libni and Shimei.

dag: Yi yi di niŋ Anabi Musa yɛda, yi naan niŋ n gba yɛda, dama o daa sabi n yɛla zali.
en: If you believed Moses, you would believe me, because Moses wrote about me.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka Piɛbil maa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah ayɔbu, ka tiŋgbani damda, ka wuntaŋ sabigi kaman bɛ ni zaŋ chinchin shɛli n-tim shim ni la, ka goli mi mooi kaman ʒim la.
en: Then I watched while the Lamb opened the sixth seal. There was a great earthquake, and the sun became as black as sackcloth. The full moon became red like blood.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti ŋmaligi bɔhi yimaŋa, Ka ŋuni n-lee dɔɣi bihi ŋɔ zaa ti ti? N daa kɔŋ m bihi. Bɛ daa zaŋ ma kulila tinzun tiŋa, ka ŋuni n-lee wumsi bihi ŋɔ zaa? N daa kpalimla n ko, ka ya ka bihi ŋɔ zaa lee yina? .
en: and Jerusalem will ask, Am I really their mother? How could I have given birth when I was still mourning in a foreign land? Who raised these children? Where have they come from.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ɛhab daa yɛl o paɣ Jɛzibɛl Ilaija ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa min o ni zaŋ takɔbi ku Baal daanabinim zaa shɛm yɛla.
en: King Ahab told Jezebel everything that Elijah did and how Elijah had killed all the prophets of Baal with a sword.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, To, n kana! Ka m malila yiko din ni tooi yɛli shɛli? Naawuni ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli niŋ n nol ni, dina ka n yɛn tɔɣisi.
en: Balaam answered, Well, I am here now. I came, but I might not be able to do what you asked. I can only say the words God tells me to say.

dag: M mabia Jɔnatan, n suhu saɣimya pam a zuɣu. M min a biɛhigu daa lu n-taɣili tab pam. A yurilim zaŋ chaŋ n sani daa mali alahiziba, ka galisi pam gari paɣ ni mali yurilim shɛm.
en: I grieve for you, my brother Jonathan! You were so dear to me! Your love was more amazing to me than the love of women.

dag: Ka Musa daa me sara maligu bimbini nimaani, ka boli di yuli, Yawɛ n-nyɛ n nasara tuuta.
en: Moses built an altar there and called it, The LORD is my banner.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Hɔr Zoli maa zuɣu n-chaŋ ti dɔni Zalimɔna.
en: The people left Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.

dag: Yɛlim ba ni a nyɛla n tizɔpaɣa, ka bɛ niŋ ma nirilim a zuɣu, ka tiligi n nyɛvili a zuɣu.
en: So tell them you are my sister so that they will treat me well for your sake, and I will survive because of you.

dag: Yinim bɛn je din viɛla ka bɔrila zaɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ, yinim bɛn dariti tɔhiri n niriba niŋgbuŋ gbana, ka dariti tɔhiri bɛ nimdi ka chɛri bɛ kɔba ŋɔ.
en: you who hate good and love evil, who tear the skin off them, and the flesh off their bones.

dag: Ifriim zuliya bɛn daa gbibi tɔbiri daa ŋmaligi guui tɔbu tuhibu dali.
en: The men from Ephraim had their weapons, but they ran from the battle.

dag: Fɔntin shɛli ni niriba ni daa kul palila n-leei dabari maa! Tin shɛli din daa nyɛ tin titali niriba sani la nti be kaman pakoli maa. Tin shɛli din daa nyɛ nabipuɣiŋga fɔntinsi ni la leela dabili.
en: Oh, no! She sits alone, the city that was once full of people. Once great among nations, she has become like a widow. Once a queen over provinces, she has become a slave.

dag: Ka so yi zaɣisi kandina zaŋ chaŋ daba ata sunsuuni, zuɣulaannim mini kpamba bɛn bahim noli ka bɛ fa o binshɛɣukam zaa, ka dilan ku lan mali soli ni o be bɛn yi Babilɔn n-lab kulina maa kalinli ni.
en: All those who failed to appear within three days, as mandated by the officials and elders, would have all their property taken away. They would be separated from the congregation of the exiles.

dag: Yawɛ malaika maa daa lan yɛli Haga yaha, Nyama, a mali pua, a mi ti yɛn dɔɣila bidibiga, ka bol o yuli Ishimail, dama Yawɛ wum a nandahima kuhigu maa.
en: Then the angel of the Lord said, Hagar, you are now pregnant, and you will have a son. You will name him Ishmael, because the Lord has heard that you were treated badly.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa niŋ lala. Shɛb daa pihi pampam, ka shɛb mi pihi biɛlabiɛla.
en: The Israelites did as Moses said, some collecting more, some less.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ n tampiŋ ni n tiliginsim ni m birini, ka so ku tooi nyaŋ ma.
en: He is my Rock, the only one who can save me. He is my high place of safety, where no army can defeat me.

dag: Ŋuna n-deeri dunia ŋɔ zuɣulaannim yɛm ka chɛ ka bɛ dari gindi mɔɣu.
en: He makes their leaders foolish and lets them wander confused and lost;.

dag: Ti ni mali maligumaaniba zuɣulan titali so ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Bia Yisa ŋun daa chaŋ ti be Naawuni san la zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti gbibi ti daadiini ŋɔ kirikiri.
en: We have a great high priest who has gone to live with God in heaven. He is Jesus the Son of God. So let us continue to express our faith in him.

dag: N ni ŋmaligi lu yi zuɣu; n ni nyahi ya ka yi yi daɣiri ni kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi buɣim maani anzinfa ka di yiri shɛm la.
en: I will take action against you. I will purify you the way metal is refined, and will remove all your impurity.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi maani Ijipti tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni yi ni kana ti ʒini ŋɔ wuna n-chɛ ka yi nuhi tuma chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu? Yi bɔri ni yi kpi ka leei dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa ni yɛn maani shɛba ansarisi ka turi shɛba?.
en: Why do you make me angry by worshiping idols and by sacrificing to other gods here in Egypt, where you have come to live? Are you doing this just to destroy yourselves, so that every nation on earth will make fun of you and use your name as a curse?.

dag: Ka nyuli zabbu mini diribarilim tɛha ni be shɛli, nimaani ka chirachira mini tuumbiɛri balibu kam tumbu be.
en: Where there is jealousy and selfishness, there will be confusion and every kind of evil.

dag: Nyin Naa n-zali zaligu ni biŋkumda la yi ti piligi kumsi, sokam ŋun damdim tiŋa n-jɛm salima binnan la.
en: Your Majesty, you gave a command that everyone who hears the sound of the horn, pipe, zither, lyre, harp, flute, and every kind of instrument should bow down and worship the gold statue.

dag: O daa tɛhimi ni Pool ni ti o liɣiri, dinzuɣu ka o daa kul timdi ti boon o na waawaayili ka o min o ti diri alizama.
en: At the same time he was hoping that Paul would give him some money; and for this reason he would call for him often and talk with him.

dag: Ka a ŋariŋduhiriba kuhigu vuri daa chɛ ka teeku duli sɔhigi.
en: At your helmsmens cries for help, the troubled waters seethe.

dag: bɛn chɛ yɛlimaŋli soli bahi, ka yɛri ni kpiimba kum ni neebu la pun niŋ la. Lala ka bɛ niŋdi n-gbarigiri ninvuɣ shɛb yɛda.
en: They have left the way of truth and are upsetting the faith of some believers by saying that our resurrection has already taken place.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la di vi, ka birim. Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni wahala paai ma la ŋmaligi labi ni vi.
en: Let those who seek my life, who want me dead, be disgraced and put to shame. Let those who want to do me harm be thoroughly frustrated and humiliated.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-yihi n shia kpiimba biɛhigu shee, a lan ti ma nyɛvili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun do gbala ni la kalinli ni.
en: LORD, you brought me up from the grave, brought me back to life from among those going down to the pit.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa n-lihiri bɔri paɣisar viɛlli, ka daa ti nya Abishag ŋun daa nyɛ Shunɛm paɣisarili n-zaŋ o na ti ti naa.
en: So the kings servants began looking everywhere in the country of Israel for a beautiful young woman to keep the king warm. They found a young woman named Abishag, from the town of Shunem, and brought her to the king.

dag: Tikub ku tooi gbibi ashili, dinzuɣu miri ka a zaŋ amaŋ tabili yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋlana.
en: A gossip can never keep a secret. Stay away from people who talk too much.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni lo ti alikauli shɛl la zuɣu, tinim kul guhirila zuɣusaa mini dunia tiŋgbani din nyɛ zaɣ pala, ka wuntitali be di ni la.
en: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!.

dag: Nazari nir zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: saha shɛl o ni zaŋ wolig omaŋ maa tariga yi ti paai, bɛn zaŋm o na ti zali Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni.
en: When you have completed your promised time of being a Nazirite, go to the sacred tent.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk daa zaŋ piɛri mini naɣilahi ni dabidɔbba ni paɣiba ti Ibrahimma, ka zaŋ o paɣ Zara gba labisi ti o.
en: So Abimelech gave Sarah back to Abraham. Abimelech also gave Abraham some sheep, cattle, and slaves.

dag: Ka buŋ maa daa nya Yawɛ malaika maa ka o ŋooi takɔbi gbib o nuu ni ʒe sol ni; ka buŋ maa daa birigi kpe mɔɣu, ka Balaam fiɛb o ni o ŋmalig o lu soli.
en: When Balaam's donkey saw the angel standing there with a sword, it walked off the road and into an open field. Balaam had to beat the donkey to get it back on the road.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abiata, N ni daa kul nya Doɛg Ɛdom nir la dindali maa, n daa pun baŋ ni o ni yɛli Sool di yɛla. Mani n-nyɛ ŋun bo kum ti a ba daŋ ŋɔ zaa maa.
en: David answered, That day when I saw Doeg, I knew he would tell Saul! Your family died because of me.

dag: O daa fa ma n dim ŋun nyɛ yaalan nuu ni bahi, ka tiligi ma bɛn je ma nuu ni, dama bɛ daa gari ma yaa.
en: God saved me from my powerful enemy, saved me from my foes, who were too much for me.

dag: Di zɔriya ba dabiɛm, kul teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa niŋ Firawuna mini Ijiptinim zaa shɛm la yɛla.
en: Do not be afraid of them; remember what the Lord your God did to the king of Egypt and to all his people.

dag: Ti bɔri ni ti lan lab yi sanna. Hal man Pool maŋmaŋ kpaŋ mmaŋ gari yimyim bushɛm ni n kana, amaa ka Sintani kul guri ti soli.
en: We wanted to return to you. I myself tried to go back more than once, but Satan would not let us.

dag: Lɛvinim maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Gɛrishɔn mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari.
en: Levi had three sons. Their names were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim yi ti nya a, bɛ ni yɛli, O paɣa m-bala, ka ku ma ka chɛ a.
en: When the Egyptians see you, they will assume that you are my wife, and so they will kill me and let you live.

dag: Bɛ zaɣisi ma, ka kaɣi ʒe kpaŋa ka chɛ ma. Bɛ bi zɔri dabiɛm ni bɛ tuhi nintɔri n tooni.
en: They detest me, keep their distance, dont withhold spit from my face.

dag: Bɛ naɣ zaŋdi li mi maani buɣim. Ka di zuɣu polo mini di nyoya polo yi di buɣim ka chɛ di sunsuuni ka di leei sala doya, di ni tooi lan ku buchi yaha?.
en: If not, can it be used as firewood? Fire would consume its two ends, but its middle part would only get charred. So is it useful for anything?.

dag: Juda nabihi ni daa wum din niŋ maa, ka bɛ daa yi nayili n-kabi chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni nti ʒini bɛ ʒiishɛhi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa Dunɔdal Palli la shee.
en: When the officials of Judah heard these things, they went up from the royal palace to the LORDs temple and took their places at the entrance of the New Gate of the LORDs temple.

dag: Ninsalinim ni yi bɛ manim puya ni na ni nuzaŋa shɛm, lala ka bɛ ti lan yɛn yi dunia ŋɔ ni ni nuzaŋa. Bɛ ti ku ʒi bɛ tuma binshɛli bɛ nuu ni yi.
en: We leave this world just as we entered it—with nothing. In spite of all our work there is nothing we can take with us.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ kul larila ninvuɣ biɛri maa, dama o mi ni bɛ biɛɣu kanna.
en: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.

dag: Ka paɣiba maa daa booni Izraɛlnim maa chani bɛ buɣa maligunim ni, ka bɛ ti jɛmdi buɣa maa ka diri di maligu bindira.
en: The Moabite women invited the people to the sacrifices for their god. So the people ate a meal, and they worshipped their god.

dag: M pun kahig a yuli wuhi ba, ka ni lan kahigi li wuhi ba pahi, ka di chɛ ka yurilim shɛli a ni yuri ma la be bɛ ni, ka n gba be bɛ ni.
en: I made you known to them, and I will continue to do so, in order that the love you have for me may be in them, and so that I also may be in them.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ zuliya la luya, ka ku lan yiɣisi yaha! Bɛ chɛ ba sɔŋ tiŋa, ka so kani n-ni yiɣisi ba zali.
en: Virgin Israel has fallen, Never to rise again! She lies abandoned on the ground, And no one helps her up.

dag: Ka bɛ daa va bɛ kɔba ti sɔɣi Jabɛshi tiŋ puuni tamarisik tia gbini, ka lo noli daba ayopɔin.
en: Then they took the bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in town, and fasted for seven days.

dag: N niŋgbunzabili ŋɔ, n niŋgbunzabili ŋɔ! Biɛrim mali ma, ka n lɛbiri ginda. Mbaye, n suhu ni, n suhu kul tɔrila pampam. N ku tooi shini, dama n wumla kikahi kumsi, di nyɛla tɔbuchiriga.
en: Oh, my suffering, my suffering! My pain is unbearable; my heart is in turmoil; it throbs nonstop. I cant be silent, because I hear the blast of the trumpet and the roar of the battle cry!.

dag: Ka niriba maa yi ti tum alahichi a sani, ka a darigi bɛ tibili ka chɛ ka saa bi mira, ka bɛ niŋ tuuba, ka zaŋ bɛ nina kpa duu ŋɔ polo na n-kuhi bol a yuli ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi maa ka suh a.
en: When you hold back the rain because your people have sinned against you, and then when they repent and face this Temple, humbly praying to you.

dag: Ka Yisifu yɛli, Naawuni di saɣi ka n niŋ lala! Kulla n ni nya pipia maa so sani maa kɔŋko n-ni leei n dabili; amaa yinim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ, kulimiya yi ba sani ni alaafee.
en: But Joseph said, I will not make you all slaves! Only the man who stole the cup will be my slave. You others can go in peace to your father.

dag: Tiŋgban ni ka bɛ gbiri yihiri kuriti, ka nyɛligiri tahiʒiɛɣu mi kuɣa ni.
en: the same is done with iron and copper.

dag: A ni lari saɣiŋgu mini kum, ka ti ku zɔri dunia ŋɔ ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri dabiɛm.
en: You will laugh at violence and hunger and not be afraid of wild animals.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa, dɔɣim bihi ka yi nabi; ka zuliya pam yi a ni na; ka nanim pam gba ti yi a zuliya ni na.
en: God said to him, I am El Shaddai. Be fertile and multiply. A nation, even a large group of nations, will come from you; kings will descend from your own children.

dag: Uziɛl bidibisi ni, Aminadab n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbiga ni pinaayi pah o zuɣu.
en: and Amminadab, the leader of Uzziels family, and of his relatives.

dag: Nir lala di tɛhiri ni o ni deei shɛli ti Duuma sani.
en: If you are like that, unable to make up your mind and undecided in all you do, you must not think that you will receive anything from the Lord.

dag: ka niriba daa ti gbihi maai ka o dim chaŋ ti zaŋ piriŋkpana biɛlim biri gari di ni ka chaŋ o chandi.
en: One night, when everyone was asleep, an enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat and went away.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Bokim. Ka bɛ daa mali sara ti Yawɛ nimaani.
