en: and that is why the place is called Bochim. There they offered sacrifices to the Lord .

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Hɛman ŋun daa nyɛ naa daanab maa bidibisi, ka di daa doli Naawuni ni daa lo o alikauli ni o ni tibig o la. Dama Naawuni daa ti o la bidibisi pinaanahi ni bipuɣins ata.
en: Heman was one of the king's prophets, and God honored Heman by giving him sons and daughters.

dag: Di ni lan chɛ ka tarimba nya fahim, ka wuhi bipola baŋsim mini yɛm.
en: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.

dag: Ka so daa yɛl o, A tizɔbihi min a ma be samban ni m-bɔri ni bɛ nya a n-tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: So one of the people there said to him, Look, your mother and brothers are standing outside, and they want to speak with you.

dag: Ka Shiiba daa chaŋ yaɣi Izraɛl tinsi zaa zuɣu n-chaŋ ti kpe Ɛbɛl fɔŋ din be Bɛtimaaka la ni. Ka Bikiri daŋ ni niriba zaa daa laɣim dol o kpe tiŋ maa ni.
en: Sheba passed through the territory of all the tribes of Israel and came to the city of Abel Beth Maacah, and all the members of the clan of Bikri assembled and followed him into the city.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa deei tɔrokɔnim maa mini naɣilahi maa n-zaŋ ba ti Lɛvinim maa.
en: So Moses accepted the wagons and the oxen and gave them to the Levites.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni tim anabinim mini yɛnnima ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba yi sanna, ka yi ti ku bɛ shɛba, ka kpahi bɛ shɛb tabili dapula zuɣu, ka fiɛb bɛ shɛb mi yi jɛmbu duri ni, ka niŋ ba alaka tiŋ ni zaŋ ti kpa tiŋ ni.
en: Therefore, look, Im sending you prophets, wise people, and legal experts. Some of them you will kill and crucify. And some you will beat in your synagogues and chase from city to city.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka dimbɔŋɔ kul yɛn beni? A kul yɛn sɔɣimi sahakam? A yɛn chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili be kaman buɣim la hal ni bɔ saha?.
en: How long will it last, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? How long will your wrath burn like fire?.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ni lu ka ku lan beni, amaa wuntizɔriba yiŋ ni zani.
en: The wicked meet their downfall and leave no descendants, but the families of the righteous live on.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a? A nyɛla Anabi Ilaija? Ka o yɛli ba, M pa o. Ka bɛ lan bɔh o, Bɛ ni daa yɛli anab so yɛla la n-nyɛ a? Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Aai.
en: Who are you, then? they asked. Are you Elijah? No, I am not, John answered. Are you the Prophet? they asked. No, he replied.

dag: Ka tizɔra bi deeri tizɔbo laara naɣila o dolila tizɔbo zaligunim ni wuhi shɛm.
en: An athlete who runs in a race cannot win the prize unless he obeys the rules.

dag: Shimɛi bidibisi daa nyɛla bɛba ata, Shɛlomɔt mini Haziɛl ni Haran. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Leedan daŋ niriba kpamba.
en: Jehiels family: Shelomith, Haziel, and Haran—three in all. These were the heads of the households of Ladan.

dag: Naawuni ni niŋ din tuhi. O ni ti chɛ ka bɛn niŋdi ya wahala la gba di wahala.
en: God will do what is right. He will punish those who are causing you trouble.

dag: Ka Kalɛb daa yɛli, Ninvuɣ so ŋun ŋme n-nyaŋ Kiriatisɛfanim ka deei bɛ tiŋ maa, n ni zaŋ m bipuɣiŋga Akisa ti o paɣipini.
en: Caleb said, I will give my daughter Achsah in marriage to the man who succeeds in capturing Kiriath Sepher.

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni ti yaannim zaa daa bela sagbani tiŋli, ka bɛ zaa daa lan doli soli kpe teeku ni gari.
en: Brothers and sisters, I want you to be sure of the fact that our ancestors were all under the cloud and they all went through the sea.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ li gari taba kaman tulaale duɣira ni niŋdi shɛm la, ka di leei din be kasi, ka nyɛ kpa shɛli bɛ ni yɛn mali boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni.
en: Mix all these things to make a special sweet-smelling anointing oil.

dag: Naawuni, darigim bɛ tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu; nyaŋmi lala zuliyanim maa a suhuyiɣisili puuni!.
en: Punish them, O God, for their evil; defeat those people in your anger!.

dag: Maligim daa yi ti luri bɛ biɛhigu maa shee yuŋ saha shɛli, ka manna maa gba dol li luri na.
en: When the dew fell on the camp during the night, the manna would fall with it.

dag: Chɛ ka o niŋgbuŋ leei zaɣ palli kaman bipolli niŋgbuŋ la; ka chɛ ka o lan mali yaa kaman o ni daa nyɛ bipolli la.
en: Their bodies will grow young and strong again;.

dag: Di kpari biɛla ka dunianim ku lan nya ma yaha; amaa yinim ni nyari ma. N ni mali nyɛvili be zuɣu, yi gba ni mali nyɛvili m-be.
en: In a little while the world will see me no more, but you will see me; and because I live, you also will live.

dag: Ka Maika daa bɔh o, Tiŋkani ka a yina? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N nyɛla Lɛvi zuliya nira, ka yi Bɛtilihɛm Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. N chani bɔrila luɣ shɛli ni n ʒini.
en: Where are you from? Micah asked. I am a Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, the man answered, and I'm on my way to find a new place to live.

dag: O ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Lɛvi zuliya polo m-bɔŋɔ; Zaŋm a Tumim ti Lɛvi zuliya ka zaŋ a Urim ti ŋun ʒe a yim a ni daa zahim so Masa la, a mini ŋun daa mo Mɛriba kom ni la.
en: At Massah and Meribah Spring, the Lord tested you, tribe of Levi. You were faithful, and so the priesthood belongs to the Levi tribe.

dag: Nyama, ti vihi dimbɔŋɔ nya, di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Wummi li, ka baŋ li amaŋmaŋa.
en: Look, weve searched this out, and so it is; listen and find out for yourself.

dag: M mabihi, n kpamdi ya jaande ni yi kpahimmi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tahiri naŋgbankpeeni mini woligibu din chihiri wuhibu shɛli yi ni daa pun dee la nol la. Kaɣimiya ba!.
en: I urge you, my friends: watch out for those who cause divisions and upset people's faith and go against the teaching which you have received. Keep away from them!.

dag: ka Jɛfune bia Kalɛb daa yi Juda zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb, Jephunnehs son.

dag: Shammai bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Maɔn, ka Maɔn daa nyɛ Bɛtizur ba.
en: Shammais son: Maon; Maon was Beth-zurs father.

dag: Bɛ ni daa pii dunɔguliba ŋɔ ka di doli bɛ zuɣulaannim ni nyɛ shɛm maa, bɛ gba daa malila bɛ tuma Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni kaman bɛ dɔɣiriba maa ni daa tumdi shɛm maa.
en: These were the leaders of the groups of the gatekeepers. The gatekeepers had a special way to serve in the Lord s Temple, just as their relatives did.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali, Firawuna ni chɛ ka bɛ kana ti yih a ti ŋma a zuɣu, ka zaŋ a yili tia ka noonsi di a nimdi.
en: In three days the king will release you—and have your head cut off! Then he will hang your body on a pole, and the birds will eat your flesh.

dag: O chɛ ka di niŋda, di yi nyɛla tibidarigibo zuɣu bee o yurilim zuɣu.
en: He causes the clouds to punish people with floods or to water his earth and show his love.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ nina ni sabigimi gari sala. So bi lan baŋdi ba soya zuɣu. Bɛ niŋgbuŋgbana kuumi pa bɛ kɔba zuɣu; di kuumi kaman dari la.
en: Now they are blacker than tar, and no one recognizes them; their skin clings to their bones and is drier than firewood.

dag: Di daba ata dali, niriba maa gunibu maa yuma ni daa na biɛri saha shɛli maa, ka Yaakubu bidibis ayi, Simiɔn mini Lɛvi bɛn daa nyɛ Daina tizɔdɔbba la daa zaŋ takɔbiri chaŋ ti liri tiŋ maa nima n-libigi ba ku bɛ dɔbba zaa.
en: Three days later, when the men were still sore from their circumcision, two of Jacob's sons, Simeon and Levi, the brothers of Dinah, took their swords, went into the city without arousing suspicion, and killed all the men.

dag: Dinzuɣu di yi nyɛla n dan ni yɛli ma chi mini alikama ni wain ni kpa shɛli yɛla la dina, zaŋmi li ti tinim bɛn nyɛ n dan tumtumdiba ŋɔ na.
en: So now send us the wheat, barley, wine, and olive oil that you promised.

dag: A mini zuɣulaan shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ni tooi mali jina? A mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ din pa yɛlimaŋli leei din tuhi ni tooi mali jina?.
en: You dont help crooked judges. They use the law to make life hard for the people.

dag: Yi yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Naawuni guli ya o yiko puuni n-gu tiliginsim shɛli din mali shili gu ni di ti kahigi wuhi palo ni ʒiɛmana din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni la.
en: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.

dag: Alikizanda ŋun nyɛ daanya doora la daa tum ma zaɣ biɛɣu pam; ti Duuma ni bɔh o biɛri labisi o ni tum shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Alexander the metalworker did me great harm; the Lord will reward him according to what he has done.

dag: Di simdi ka bansi maa miri naŋgbaŋkuɣila din ti yɛn gbibi dapu shɛŋa yi ni ti yɛn zaŋ buɣiri teebuli maa la.
en: Put the rings close to the frame around the top of the table. These rings will hold the poles used to carry the table.

dag: Hiram ni daa wum Sulemaana ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka di niŋ o nyaɣisim pam, ka o yɛli, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ m paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun ti Dauda bi yɛndana ni o su ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn galisi pam ŋɔ.
en: Hiram was extremely pleased when he received Solomon's message, and he said, Praise the Lord today for giving David such a wise son to succeed him as king of that great nation.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa gbaai Jɔn Baptaizira kpɛhi duu saha shɛl la nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa ka Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni na nti yihiri Naawuni lahibal suŋ waazu.
en: After John had been put in prison, Jesus went to Galilee and preached the Good News from God.

dag: Tiŋgbani, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, amaa chɛ ka a suhu piɛla, ka mali suhupiɛlli; dama Yawɛ tum tuun kara.
en: Fields, don't be afraid, but be joyful and glad because of all the Lord has done for you.

dag: Ka o kɔre daa kul be o mamanim bɛn yoya be kaman bunsi yoya, ka bɛ bɔri paɣiba kaman yuri la ni.
en: She eagerly wanted to go to bed with Egyptian men, who were famous for their sexual powers.

dag: Di tamya zaɣ viɛlli niŋbu yɛla, ka zaŋmiya yi ni mali shɛli sɔŋdi taba, dama dina n-nyɛ sara shɛŋa din tiɣiri Naawuni nini.
en: And dont forget to do good and to share what you have with others, because sacrifices like these are very pleasing to God.

dag: Ka o daa kpe duu maa ni, ka vooi dunoli yo bɛ niriba ayi maa niŋ, ka suhi Yawɛ.
en: He closed the door and prayed to the Lord .

dag: ka mol ti Duuma faako tibu saha molo.
en: and to say, This is the year the Lord has chosen. .

dag: Ti yi zaŋ Naawuni Shia yɛla biri yi suhuri ni, dindina di zooya ni ti deei dunia ŋɔ ni binyara yi sani?.
en: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.

dag: Saha shɛli niriba yi ti yɛri ni suhudoo mini gom beni, di saha maa ka bahi yoli dii yɛn paai ba, ka bɛ ku tiligi. Di ni ti bemi kaman paɣ ni yi wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la.
en: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.

dag: Ka a yɛli niriba maa, Yi yɛn kpɛla yi dɔɣiriba bɛn nyɛ Iso zuliya ka be Ɛdom la tiŋgban ni gari, bɛ ni zɔri ya dabiɛm. Dinzuɣu gbibiya yimaŋa.
en: He told me to give you the following instructions: You are about to go through the hill country of Edom, the territory of your distant relatives, the descendants of Esau. They will be afraid of you.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋunkam yɛn nyu bara, ŋun nyum li la ti Duuma zuɣu.
en: But, the one who brags should brag in the Lord. .

dag: Ka n chaŋ hal ti paai teeku maa puuni zolɔna ni m-mal hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din dunoya nyɛ din yo n-kpari ʒiɛya hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Amaa, yaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, ka a yihi ma bɔɣ zilinli maa ni na ni nyɛvili.
en: I went down to the very roots of the mountains, into the land whose gates lock shut forever. But you, O Lord my God, brought me back from the depths alive.

dag: Ŋunkam gariti ʒiɛrila o nɛma; ka o leeg o ʒiʒiinitab ni maani so ansarisi.
en: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.

dag: Di saha ka Ribɛka daa yɛli Yisahaku, Hiti paɣiba ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka n suhu bi doya. Yaakubu yi kpuɣi Hiti paɣa ka o be kaman bɛmbɔŋɔ, bebu bukaata lan yɛn nyɛ bɔ n sani.
en: Rebecca said to Isaac, I am sick and tired of Esau's foreign wives. If Jacob also marries one of these Hittites, I might as well die.

dag: Ka Daadam Bia ti kana, ka o mini niriba laɣindi diri ka nyura ka yi yɛra, Nyama, ŋun kpiri kum pam, ka lan nyɛ danyura mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim zo.
en: The Son of Man came, and he ate and drank, and you said, Look at this man! He is a glutton and wine drinker, a friend of tax collectors and other outcasts.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa kuhi yɛli, N Duuma, n kul ʒiɛla n zaashee wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa.
en: Then the seer called out: Upon a watchtower, Lord, Im standing all day; and upon my observation post Im stationed throughout the night.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa ti yiɣisi asibaasi n-yi Akasia chaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni nti dɔn nimaani ni bɛ gbaai li du.
en: Joshua took down the camp early in the morning. He and all the Israelites marched out of Shittim and came to the Jordan, where they stayed overnight before crossing.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa bɔh o, Ŋuni ka a lee bɔri ni n chɛ ka o yina? Ka o yɛl o, M bɔri ni a chɛ ka Samuɛl n-yina.
en: So the woman said, Who do you want me to bring up for you? Bring up Samuel, he said.

dag: Naawuni ŋun ni tooi gbibi ya ka yi ku lu, ka ni zaŋ ya tah omaŋmaŋ tooni din mali jilima shee ni suhupiɛlli, ka yi ku mali taali la.
en: To the one who is able to protect you from falling, and to present you blameless and rejoicing before his glorious presence.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa zani Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini tooni Izraɛlnim zaa ninni n-teeg o nuhi.
en: Then in the presence of the people Solomon went and stood in front of the altar and raised his arms in prayer. .

dag: Niŋm ba kaman a ni daa niŋ Midiannim mini Sisɛra ni Jabin shɛm Kishɔn Mɔɣili ni la.
en: Do to them what you did to the Midianites, and to Sisera and Jabin at the Kishon River.

dag: Yil yidan yi ti yiɣisi kpari dunoli maa ka yi kana ti ʒiɛya niŋdi gaafara yɛra, Ti Duuma, yoom ti ka ti gari, o ni ti garigi yɛli ya, N ʒi yi ni yi shɛl na.
en: Once the owner of the house gets up and shuts the door, then you will stand outside and knock on the door, saying, Lord, open the door for us. He will reply, I dont know you or where you are from.

dag: Bɛ baɣa ka fɔŋ ni vuri ni, so mi bi mali ba tumdi tuma ka bɛ wumd o tahigu.
en: He laughs at the clamor of the town, doesnt hear the drivers shout.

dag: Miriya ka yi pahi ninvuɣ bɔbigu zuɣu tum tuumbiɛɣu bee m-pahi bɛ zuɣu bɛ ʒiri shɛhira dibu ni.
en: Do not follow the majority when they do wrong or when they give testimony that perverts justice.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa paai yili maa ni nti nya ka bia maa kpi n-dola o garo zuɣu.
en: Elisha arrived at the woman's house and went straight to his room, where he saw the boy's body on his bed.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei zaa ka bɛ bi tooi baŋ tiŋgban shɛli din bala, amaa ka bɛ lee nya kulinol shɛli ka di duli viɛla, ka bɛ daa lɔri nia ni di yi ni nani bɛ ni zaŋ ŋariŋ maa du ni.
en: When daylight came, the sailors saw land, but they did not know what land it was. They saw a bay with a beach and wanted to sail the ship to the beach if they could.

dag: Ka m mali suhupiɛlli pumpɔŋɔ, ka di pala yi suhuri ni daa saɣim maa zuɣu, amaa yi suhuri ni daa saɣim ka yi niŋ tuuba la zuɣu, dama Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun saɣi ka yi suhuri daa saɣim maa, dinzuɣu yi bi kɔŋ shɛli ti ni niŋ shɛm maa puuni.
en: But now I am happy—not because I made you sad, but because your sadness made you change your ways. That sadness was used by God, and so we caused you no harm.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Hiram daa ti Sulemaana sida mini Sipirɛs dakuɣ shɛŋa zaa o ni daa bɔra.
en: So Hiram gave Solomon all the cedar and fir logs that he wanted.

dag: ni bindir viɛla din niŋdi kurimbuni ha zoya zuɣu ni bindira din niŋdi pam dabo kura zuɣu.
en: with the best fruit from ancient mountains, with the gifts of eternal hills.

dag: Yɛmiya Naawuni gbaɣino mini di nɛma zaa, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi nyaŋ Sintani yɛŋkiŋkabina soya zaa.
en: Put on all the armor that God gives you, so that you will be able to stand up against the Devil's evil tricks.

dag: N ni daa wum bɛ fabila maa mini bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka n suhu daa yiɣisi pam.
en: When I heard their complaints, I was very angry.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pirigi bɛ ni yɛn kpa tiŋgbani maa yaɣ shɛŋa polo ti taba. Ɛhab kɔŋko daa kpala yaɣ yini polo; ka Obadia mi kɔŋko kpa yaɣ din la polo.
en: To search, they divided the land between themselves. Ahab went one way by himself, while Obadiah went a different way by himself.

dag: Malimiya nyɔtaɣirisi zaɣ bihi mini zaɣ kara n-chaŋ tɔb tuhibu.
en: It's time to go into battle! So grab your shields.

dag: Dindali maa Ijiptinim ni ti ŋmanila paɣiba, dabiɛm ni ti kpe ba ka bɛ ni sɔhira, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni ti yɛn doli so shɛli liri ba zuɣu.
en: At that time the Egyptians will be like frightened women. They will be afraid of the Lord All-Powerful, because he will raise his arm to punish the people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tim ti boli Pool na ka Tɛɛtulus gbaag o fiɣisibu yɛra, N dan Filiksi, a zuɣu ka ti ʒiya ni alaafee, ka a tumdi tuun suma tiri ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa.
en: So Paul was called in, and Tertullus stated the case against him: Honorable Felix, you have brought our people a long period of peace, and because of your concern our nation is much better off.

dag: Yuuni kam Yisa ba min o ma daa yi chanila Jɛrusalɛm ti puhiri Yaɣigari Chuɣu.
en: Every year Jesus parents went to Jerusalem for the Passover festival.

dag: ka wurim nam ʒiishɛhi ka chɛ ka di yiko zan tariga. N ni lɛb chɛchɛbunsi mini bɛn mal li chani pili; ka daai wɔribariba mini bɛ yuri luhi; ka bɛ ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku taba.
en: I will overthrow the thrones of the kingdoms; I will destroy the strength of the nations. I will overthrow chariot and rider; horses and riders will fall. Each one will fall by the sword of his companion.

dag: ka o puhirina m-be kaman aŋgo ŋun yi amiliya sampaa ni na bee kaman kpiɔŋlana ni yi yina n-zɔr o tia ni suhupiɛlli shɛm la.
en: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.

dag: Doo maa ni daa na kul ʒe n sani maa, ka n daa wum ka so tɔɣisiri ma yɛtɔɣa Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni na.
en: The man was standing beside me, and I heard the Lord say from inside the temple:.

dag: Amaa ka n daa bi saɣi ti Balaam, ka o daa naɣ niŋla alibarika niŋ yi ni; ka n daa tiligi ya Balak nuu ni.
en: but I refused to listen to Balaams prayer. So he asked me to bless you, and I saved you from the enemy.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋ maa nim daa yɛli Jɔash, Yihim a bia maa na ka ti ku o. O ni wurim Baal bimbini, ka ŋmaai Ashɛra ŋmahinli binwɔɣinli din ʒe m-baɣ li la luhi la zuɣu.
en: The men of the town went to Joash and said, Your son Gideon knocked over Baal's altar and cut down the sacred pole next to it. Hand him over, so we can kill him.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka yihi ya dabitim bandi ni.
en: I am the Lord your God. I am the one who freed you from the land of Egypt, where you were slaves.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka a zilinli tabili a noli puuni, ka a leei birigu, ka ku lan kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni, dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: Ill make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth and take away your ability to speak. You wont be able to correct them, because they are a household of rebels.

dag: Di di dii bi simdi ni n lan sabi gbaŋ tin ya zaŋ chaŋ tɔto tɔhi ti Yisa nyaandoliba la yɛla polo;.
en: There is really no need for me to write you about the help being sent to God's people in Judea.

dag: Pa Naawuni yino maa n-nam paɣ maa? Niŋgbina mini shia maa zaa nyɛla o dini. Ka bɔ ka o lee bɔra? O bɔri ni Naawuni biɛhigu be ti bihi ni. Dinzuɣu gbibiya yimaŋa, ka di chɛn ya ka so bi ʒe o ni daa kpuɣi paɣ so o bipolitali ni yim.
en: God wants husbands and wives to become one body and one spirit. Why? So that they would have holy children and protect that spiritual unity. Dont cheat on your wife. She has been your wife from the time you were young.

dag: O yi vihi ya, di ni viɛl yi zuɣu? Bee yi ni tooi yɔhim o kaman niriba ni yɔhindi tab shɛm la?.
en: If God checked you very closely, would he see that you are right? Do you really think you can fool God the same as you fool people?.

dag: Wuhim ti a yurilim maŋli la asiba, din ni chɛ ka ti yili suhupiɛlli yila, ka ti suhuri piɛli ti dabisa zaa ni.
en: Fill us each morning with your constant love, so that we may sing and be glad all our life.

dag: N ni daa nya binneen shɛba ka bɛ be Izraɛl Naawuni naba tiŋli Kɛba Mɔɣili dul la m-bala. Ka n daa baŋ ni bɛ nyɛla chɛrubinima.
en: These were the living beings under the Glory of the God of Israel in the vision at the Kebar Canal, and now I realized that they were Cherub angels.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi bebu be kaman dunia ŋɔ nim bebu, amaa chɛliya ka yi bebu zaa taɣi, yi tɛha ni leei tɛhi pala la zuɣu, ka lala chɛ ka yi tooi baŋ Naawuni yubu din nyɛ din viɛli mini din tiɣir o nini ni din be tibi la.
en: Do not conform yourselves to the standards of this world, but let God transform you inwardly by a complete change of your mind. Then you will be able to know the will of God—what is good and is pleasing to him and is perfect.

dag: Kaɣili ni tooi zooi luɣ shɛli ka pa ni baa ni? Kaɣili ni tooi zooi viɛnyɛliŋga ka pa ni kom ni be luɣ shɛli?.
en: Does papyrus grow apart from a marsh? Does a reed flourish without water?.

dag: Yi nini yi nya tayiɣ kam, yi laɣir o la zɔri, ka lan chɛ ka yi mini zinaniŋdiba be.
en: You make friends with thieves whenever you see one; you spend your time with adulterers.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka di kul yɛn be lala? A suhuyiɣisili kul yɛn beni la sahakam? A nyuli zabbu suhuyiɣisili maa yɛn dirimi kaman buɣim la?.
en: Lord , will you be angry with us forever? Will your anger continue to burn like fire?.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn daa bi deei Naawuni yɛligu saha shɛl o ni daa di suɣilo guhiri ba Anabi Nuhu ʒiɛman ni la. Di saha ka Anabi Nuhu daa kpahiri ŋariŋ shɛli niriba biɛla bɛn nyɛ niriba anii kɔŋko ni daa kpe n-tiligi kom dibu ni la.
en: Those were the spirits who refused to obey God long ago in the time of Noah. God was waiting patiently for people while Noah was building the big boat. And only a few—eight in all—were saved in the boat through the floodwater.

dag: Mahili bidibisi ni Ɛliɛza ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bidibiga la n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: from Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

dag: A daag o tiŋ gooni luhi, ka wurim o birininima.
en: You pulled down the walls of his city. You destroyed all his fortresses.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti mali sara maligu shɛli ti Duuma zaligu ni daa wuhi la; di daa nyɛla ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambih ayi.
en: They also went to offer a sacrifice of a pair of doves or two young pigeons, as required by the law of the Lord.

dag: Ka Bɛtuɛl mi daa dɔɣi Ribɛka. Bih anii ŋɔ ka Milika daa dɔɣi ti Nahɔr ŋun daa nyɛ Ibrahimma mabia maa.
en: Rebecca's father. Milcah bore these eight sons to Nahor, Abraham's brother.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ tɛha maa ka yɛli bɔɣukpiŋlan maa, Mirimina ti zani kpe. Ka o dii yiɣisi zani niriba maa ni.
en: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he told the man to stand up where everyone could see him. And the man stood up.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ daa leeg alahichi Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ ni; ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka di simdi ni bɛ yaag o daŋ maa n-kpihim di birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: This sin on his part brought about the ruin and total destruction of his dynasty.

dag: Sida tihi din daa be Naawuni tihi puu la ni daa bi paai li. Gɔhi tihi bi paai di wulikpana. Nira ku tooi zaŋ ti shɛŋa din be polipoli buɣisi di wula. Tia daa ka Naawuni tihi puu la ni din viɛl paai li.
en: None of the cedar trees in my garden of Eden were as beautiful as this tree; no tree of any kind had such long branches.

dag: Ka bɛ daa silim zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa ka yɛli, Yaa Naawuni, nyin ŋun su vuhirigu kam zaa nyɛvili ŋɔ, wula ka ninvuɣ yino tum alahichi, ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi niriba ŋɔ zaa zuɣu.
en: But the two men bowed down and prayed, Our God, you gave these people life. Why would you punish everyone here when only one man has sinned.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ o nyaandoliba m-pa omaŋ zuɣu dol o.
en: So Jesus and his followers went with the man.

dag: Ka Ɛhab ŋun daa nyɛ Omri bia la daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani n-gari na shɛb bɛn zaa daa daŋ o tooni la.
en: Ahab did more things to disobey the Lord than any king before him.

dag: Doo kam ŋun suhiri Naawuni bee n-tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu ʒiɛmdila o zuɣu;.
en: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered shames his head.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ suhuri ni tɛha maa ka boli bibil na nti zaŋ o zali baɣil omaŋa.
en: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he took a child, stood him by his side.

dag: Na so ŋun doli zaligu soli, o tiŋ ni mali suhudoo, amaa na so ŋun yu liɣiri pam ni wurim o tiŋa.
en: A king gives stability to the land by justice, but one who imposes heavy taxes tears it down.

dag: Zaŋmiya bɔrɔbɔro din nyɛ yi wumpaɣibo sara maligu na, ka moliya yi ni tiri pin shɛŋa pahiri la molo, dama yinim Izraɛlnim ni yu ni yi niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: Go on and offer your bread in thanksgiving to God, and brag about the extra offerings you bring! This is the kind of thing you love to do.

dag: Teem a ni daa yɛli mani a dabili ŋɔ shɛm, ka m mali tahima di zuɣu la yɛla.
en: Remember your promise to me, your servant; it has given me hope.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa kpe nayili maa nti yɛli naa, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, a dihi a tɔbbihi bɛn zaa tilig a nyɛvili ka tilig a bidibisi min a bipuɣinsi ni a paɣiba ni a mamanim zaa nyɛviya ŋɔ vi.
en: Joab went to the house where David was staying and told him: You've made your soldiers ashamed! Not only did they save your life, they saved your sons and daughters and wives as well.

dag: Ifriimnim yɛliya, Aa, ti mali buni, ti bo buni zali timaŋa! Amaa bɛ buni maa zaa ku tooi yo bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa samli.
en: Ephraim said, I am rich! I have found true riches! No one will learn about my crimes. No one will learn about my sins.

dag: Ka bia maa dɔɣim dali naba daa ti tuui, ka bɛ laɣimna ni bɛ ti gun o. Bɛ daa bɔri ni bɛ zaŋla o ba yuli Zakaria la ti o.
en: When the baby was a week old, they came to circumcise him, and they were going to name him Zechariah, after his father.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa naɣilahi maa zuɣuri ni, ka yi zaŋ zaɣ yino mali sara alahichi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ Lɛvinim maa daalahichi zuɣu.
en: Then the Levites will lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and Aaron will offer one as a purification offering and the other as an entirely burned offering to the LORD in order to seek reconciliation for the Levites.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa kana ti lu n-dɔni ninkurigu maa yiŋ dunol ni Lɛvi zuliya doo maa ni daa kpe shɛl la biɛkaali saha n-do nimaani hal ka di ti neei.
en: At daybreak, the woman came and collapsed at the door of the mans house where her husband was staying, where she lay until it was daylight.

dag: Bɛ nini nyabu yim ka tiŋgbani ti dam pam hal ka duu maa gbinni ti sɔhira, ka sarika duu maa dunoya zaa dii yooi, ka sokam bandi baai.
en: Suddenly there was a violent earthquake, which shook the prison to its foundations. At once all the doors opened, and the chains fell off all the prisoners.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti lab ti Dauda suɣili din daa lu la zali. N ni ti mali di luɣ shɛŋa din daa saɣim la zaa, ka ti li zali ka di be kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm la;.
en: Davids tent has fallen, but at that time I will set it up again. I will fix its holes and repair its ruined parts. I will set it up as it was before.

dag: O tim o yiŋ bipuɣinsi ni bɛ chaŋ tiŋ puuni luɣ shɛŋa din du pam shee ti boli niriba.
en: She has sent her servant girls to announce from the highest hill in the city.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord gave Moses.

dag: Mbusim be piɛgul so ŋun chɛ piɛri bahi maa zuɣu! Bɛ ni zaŋ sua n-chɛ o bɔɣu tabil o nudirigu nini. Ka o bɔɣu maa kpi, ka o nudirigu nini maa gba zom zaa.
en: That worthless shepherd is doomed! He has abandoned his flock. War will totally destroy his power. His arm will wither, and his right eye will go blind.

dag: ni jɛra ni bɛn bi ʒe yim ni ninkuunsinima ni bɛn bi zɔri nambɔɣu.
en: they have no conscience; they do not keep their promises, and they show no kindness or pity for others.

dag: M mali niɣi mini bunsi ni biŋkɔbbaligu ni daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba; ka tim na ni n ti yɛli nyini n dana din ni chɛ ka a suhu maai ni mani. .
en: I own cattle, donkeys, sheep, goats, and slaves. I am sending you word, sir, in the hope of gaining your favor.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam dindali maa, ka o po n-yɛli.
en: The LORD became angry on that day and promised.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti zaŋ ya ti niŋ o ni daa lo yi yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu alikauli ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la ni, tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali fɔntin kara din viɛla, ka pa yi ni me shɛŋa.
en: Now once the LORD your God has brought you into the land that he swore to your ancestors, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give to you—a land that will be full of large and wonderful towns that you didnt build.

dag: Yawɛ, n guhirila saha shɛli a ni yɛn tiligi ma.
en: I wait for your deliverance, Lord .

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, ka bi mali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu, amaa ka lee tumdi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm, dindina hal bɛ ni bi mali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa zaa yoli, bɛ kul mali fukumsi zaligu bɛ suhuri ni m-bala.
en: The Gentiles do not have the Law; but whenever they do by instinct what the Law commands, they are their own law, even though they do not have the Law.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa ŋmaligi yɛli ba, Yinim suhutunanim bɛn bi niŋdi anabinim yɛligu yɛda ŋɔ!.
en: Then Jesus said to them, You foolish people! Your dull minds keep you from believing all that the prophets talked about.

dag: Kamiyana ti di m bindira ŋɔ, ka nyu n ni zaŋ wain shɛli gabi tab ŋɔ.
en: Come, eat my food and drink the wine I have prepared.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa bɔh o, Ti Duuma, ya polo ka dimbɔŋɔnim ti yɛn niŋ maa? Ka o yɛli ba, Bin kpiŋ ni be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka juri laana.
en: The disciples asked, Where, Lord? Jesus said, The vultures gather wherever theres a dead body.

dag: yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Izraɛlnima wummiya, yi vu m-miri ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnim zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira bee n-zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi ni sɔhira bee n-zɔri ba dabiɛm.
en: and say, Soldiers of Israel, listen to me! Today when you go into battle, don't be afraid of the enemy, and when you see them, don't panic.

dag: Wumma, n ni wuh a n ni yɛli n ni nya shɛli.
en: Listen to me; I will argue with you; what Ive seen, I will declare to you.

dag: Ka Naa Uzia daa lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Filistianima, ka daai Gaat mini Jamnia ni Ashidɔd goondahi zaa luhi, ka me fɔntinsi miri Ashidɔd mini Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣ shɛŋa polo.
en: While Uzziah was king, he started a war against the Philistines. He smashed the walls of the cities of Gath, Jabneh, and Ashdod, then rebuilt towns around Ashdod and in other parts of Philistia.

dag: ka di pɔri gari tibiɛlinli kam la, amaa di yi ti zooi, di galisirimi gari tutuɣ kam m-mal ti leei tia, hal ka noonsi kanna nti tɛri bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu.
en: It is the smallest of all seeds. But when it grows, it is the largest of all garden plants. It becomes a tree big enough for the birds to come and make nests in its branches.

dag: Dama di nyɛla talahi ni sokam ʒi omaŋmaŋ ʒili.
en: For each of you have to carry your own load.

dag: Ka bɛ chɛchɛbunsi daa firi bayaɣiti ni n-kɔŋ chandi. Di saha ka Ijiptinim maa daa yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti zo ka chɛ Izraɛlnim maa, dama Yawɛ tuhirila Ijiptinim pahiri bɛ zuɣu.
en: He made the wheels of their chariots get stuck, so that they moved with great difficulty. The Egyptians said, The Lord is fighting for the Israelites against us. Let's get out of here.

dag: Dinzuɣu kpuɣimiya yi bɔɣiri din zali ŋɔ zuɣusaa, ka kpaŋsi yi dun gbarima ŋɔ.
en: So strengthen your drooping hands and weak knees!.

dag: Di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisiri yomyom, dama jɛra suhuri ni ka suhuyiɣisili be.
en: Only fools get angry quickly and hold a grudge.

dag: Naawuni, a tɛha nyɛla din viɛli pam n sani, di galisiya.
en: Your thoughts are beyond my understanding. They cannot be measured!.

dag: Yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn bi zɔri vi ŋɔ, laɣimmiya taba.
en: Shameless nation, come to your senses.

dag: Ti wum Mɔabnim karimbaani yɛla. Bɛ mali karimbaani pam. Ti lan wum bɛ duhimaŋtali mini bɛ karimbaani ni bɛ barinyubo ni bɛ nyarimaŋtali yɛla.
en: We have heard of Moabs pride: arrogant, puffed up, exalted, high and mighty, boastful!.

dag: Ka so yi yɛn zaŋ noombihi nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ, ŋun zaŋmila ŋmanʒiɛhi bee yiŋ ŋmambihi.
en: If the offering for the LORD is an entirely burned offering from the birds, you can present your offering from the doves or pigeons.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti teei yi tuumbiɛri mini yi biɛhigu din daa bi viɛl la yɛla, ka ku lan bɔri yi ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa mini din chihiri shɛŋa la.
en: You will remember your evil ways and hate yourselves for what you've done.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Amaa m bɔrimi ni yi baŋ ni Daadam Bia mali yiko din chɛri niriba daalahichi paŋdi ba dunia ŋɔ ni. Di saha ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛli gbalikpimalan maa.
en: I will prove to you, then, that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins. So he said to the paralyzed man.

dag: n-yɛri niriba maa, Yi yi ti kul nya ka maligumaaniba kpuɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daalikauli Adaka la ʒi n-chana, yin yiɣisimiya yi dooshee ŋɔ doli ba;.
en: They gave orders to the people: When you see the Levite priests carrying the Box of the Agreement of the Lord your God, follow them.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Di karitiya tab saria, ka Naawuni ti ku kari yi gba saria; di zaŋdiya tab taali, ka Naawuni ti ku zaŋ yi gba taali; chɛliya yi tab taali paŋmi ba, ka Naawuni ti chɛ m-paŋ yi gba.
en: Jesus said: Don't judge others, and God won't judge you. Don't be hard on others, and God won't be hard on you. Forgive others, and God will forgive you.

dag: Naawuni daa bi ku Izraɛl ninvuɣ zuɣuri maa, ka bɛ daa nya o, ka di ka nyu.
en: Even though these leaders of Israel saw God, he did not punish them. So they ate and drank.

dag: Bɛ bi mali noli ni yɛtɔɣa kɔŋko saɣisiri tumtumdiba, dama hal bɛ yi kul baŋ a ni yɛli shɛm, bɛ baɣa ku bɛ di ni.
en: Even when servants are smart, it takes more than words to make them obey.

dag: Yisa ni daa niŋ li Vuhim Dabisili dali maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim maa muɣisi Yisa pam.
en: As a result, the Jewish leaders were harassing Jesus, since he had done these things on the Sabbath.

dag: Ninsal niŋgbuŋ ni nyɛ zaɣ yini, amaa ka mali yaɣ bɔbili ka di zaa tuma bi nyɛ yim la.
en: We have many parts in the one body, and all these parts have different functions.

dag: Man Yawɛ lan yɛli, So na ʒi n-zaŋ wain tiwal viɛla labi, amaa o naɣ zaŋdi li mi dooi wain. Dinzuɣu n gba ku bahi n niriba zaa yoli, n ni tiligi bɛ puuni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi ma.
en: The LORD proclaims: As new wine is found in the grape cluster, and someone says, Dont destroy it, for there is a blessing in it, so I will do for the sake of my servants and not destroy everything.

dag: O ni ŋma ba luhi kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi kpaŋa ŋ-ŋmari tibɔŋ ni tihi luhiri shɛm la, ka di lu kaman Lɛbanɔn ti suma ni luri shɛm la.
en: With an ax, the glorious Lord will destroy every tree in the forests of Lebanon.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ li lee kali ni zaligu Izraɛlnim zaa sani, ka bɛ dol li hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: David made this a rule, and it has been followed in Israel ever since.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa yi Judia n-ka Antiɔk na n-daa ti gbaai Yisa nyaandoliba wuhibu yɛri ni shee bɛ guniya kaman Anabi Musa ni daa zali shɛm la ni di yi pa lala bɛ ku tiligi.
en: Some people came from Judea and started teaching the Lord's followers that they could not be saved, unless they were circumcised as Moses had taught.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari alaka Naawuni yubu tumbu zuɣu mal alibarika, dama alizanda nam nyɛla bɛ dini.
en: Great blessings belong to those who suffer persecution for doing what is right. Gods kingdom belongs to them.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Ilaisha daa bol anab bil so na nti yɛl o, Malim shili n-zaŋ kpa luɣuluɣu ŋɔ gbib a nuu ni chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.
en: The prophet Elisha called to a member of the group of prophets, Get ready, take this jug of oil with you, and go to Ramoth-gilead.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o chaŋ Zɔfim mɔɣu ni Pisiga Zoli zuɣu nti me sara maligu bimbina ayopɔin zali, ka kɔrigi naɣila yinoyino mini piɛla yinoyino m-mali sara pa di zaɣ yini kam zuɣu.
en: So Balak led Balaam to Watchmen Hills. This was on top of Mount Pisgah. There Balak built seven altars and killed a bull and a ram on each altar as a sacrifice.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka sanzali zani, ka siɣili saa bi lan mira. Amaa ka yi nini kul moola zina niŋbu zuɣu, ka vi bi mali ya.
en: That is why the rains were held back, and the spring showers did not come. You even look like a prostitute; you have no shame.

dag: Di simdi ka yi zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ leei zaligu yi sani, ka yi mini yi bihi doli li sahakam.
en: After you have entered the country promised to you by the Lord , you and your children must continue to celebrate Passover each year.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku yi dɔbba, ka ku yi tɔbutuhiriba tɔbu ni.
en: Your men will fall by the sword, your warriors in battle!.

dag: Ka nanim daa kana Taanak Mɛgido kulibɔŋ la ni ti tuhi tɔbu. Ka Keenan nanim daa tuhi, amaa ka bi di nɛma din nyɛ anzinfa.
en: Kings came and made war; the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by Megiddos waters, but they captured no spoils of silver.

dag: Yinim Galɛshianim bɛn tum jɛrilim ŋɔ, timalaan ŋuni n-lee birim ya? Yisa Masia dapulli zuɣu kum yɛla daa kahigi wuhi palɔni yimaŋmaŋ ninni.
en: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti do tin tital shɛl ni bɛ ni daa kpahi bɛ Duuma tabili dapulli zuɣu la solɔɣu zuɣu. Tiŋ maa yupaa n-nyɛ Sɔdom bee Ijipti.
en: Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.

dag: Amaa Giliad min o paɣ gba daa dɔɣi bidib shɛba. Ka o paɣ bidibisi maa ni daa ti zooi, bɛ daa karila Jɛfita ka yɛl o, Ti min a ku laɣim di ti ba fali, dama a nyɛla paɣ so bia.
en: Gileads wife gave birth to other sons for him, and when his wifes sons grew up, they drove Jephthah away. They told him, You wont get an inheritance in our fathers household because youre a different womans son.

dag: Yisa daa ti be luɣ shɛli o kɔŋko suhiri Naawuni ka o nyaandoliba chaŋ o sani ka o ti bɔhi ba, Niriba lee yɛri ni n nyɛla ŋuni.
en: Once when Jesus was praying by himself, the disciples joined him, and he asked them, Who do the crowds say that I am.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ daa bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, amaa ka so daa lee bi zaŋ o nuu shih o, dama o saha daa na bi paai.
en: When Jesus said this, the people tried to grab him. But no one was able even to touch him, because the right time for him had not yet come.

dag: Dama di nyɛla Naawuni yubu ni yi tum din tuhi, ka di chɛ ka yi mum jɛra bɛn tɔɣisiri ʒilinsi yɛtɔɣa la noya.
en: God wants you to silence stupid and ignorant people by doing right.

dag: ni suhuyiɣisili, Yisa nyaandoliba ayi maa ni daa wuhiri niriba n-yɛri ni Yisa ni neei kum ni maa zuɣu kum ni neebu beni la zuɣu.
en: These men were angry because the apostles were teaching the people that the dead would be raised from death, just as Jesus had been raised from death.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n kul zɔri kpari booli polo ni di chɛ ka n nya Naawuni ni boli ti boligu shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni la.
en: I keep running hard toward the finish line to get the prize that is mine because God has called me through Christ Jesus to life up there in heaven.

dag: Ka karimbanim bɛn nyɛ diribarilimnim ŋɔ ni zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ ni nam yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa tɔɣisi ya ni bɛ zaŋ ya bo liɣiri. Amaa bɛ Sariakarita ŋun ni bahi ba yoli pun mali shili ka di wɔɣa; ka mi bi gbihira.
en: In their greed they will take advantage of you with lies. The judgment pronounced against them long ago hasnt fallen idle, nor is their destruction sleeping.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zaɣisi kpamba maa ni yɛl o shɛm maa, ka lan mal o bipalitab bɛn min o daa laɣim zooi, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn ʒiin o tooni la saawara.
en: But Rehoboam ignored the advice the elders gave him and instead sought the counsel of the young advisors who had grown up with him and now served him.

dag: Ŋunkam ti mo Yawɛ, o yi nyɛla Izraɛl tiŋbia bee sana, bɛn kum o, Izraɛlnim maa zaa bɛn labim o kuɣa.
en: and be put to death. Any Israelite or any foreigner living in Israel who curses the Lord shall be stoned to death by the whole community.

dag: Ka naa maa ni ti zaŋ yɔhiŋgu n-saɣim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun zaɣisi adiini soli maa, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli Naawuni bɛn ni ti zani dɛde, ka chɛ ka bɛ min o tuhi.
en: By deceitful means he will corrupt those who violate a covenant, but the people who acknowledge their God will stand strong and will act.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ o paɣ Zara nti sɔɣi sil shɛli din daa be Makipɛla palo din be Mamri wulimpuhili polo la ni Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: After this, Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave in the field of Machpelah near Mamre, that is, Hebron, in the land of Canaan.

dag: Lubu din mali dabiɛm pam mini chirachira be Ʒii Nyabu Vinvamli ni, ka bɛ daai ti tiŋ goma luhi, ka ŋme sɔŋsim bɔbu kuŋ bahi zoya ni nima. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-niŋ lala maa.
en: The Lord All-Powerful had chosen a time for noisy shouts and confusion to fill Vision Valley, and for everyone to beg the mountains for help.

dag: Dinzuɣu kpahimmiya yi ni be shɛm viɛnyɛliŋga, ka di benya kaman bɛn be ʒilinsi ni, amaa ka lee bemi kaman yɛnnima.
en: So be very careful how you live. Live wisely, not like fools.

dag: M mabihi, n suhiri ya, di tumiya tuumbiɛɣu ŋɔ.
en: He said to them, Friends, I beg you, don't do such a wicked thing!.

dag: Shɛm ŋun daa nyɛ Jafɛt biɛlikpɛma ka nyɛ Ɛbanim zaa yab la gba daa dɔɣi bihi.
en: Shem, the older brother of Japheth, was the ancestor of all the Hebrews.

dag: O zahindila puu pɔi ka naanyi da li. O zaŋdila o ni tum tuma nya laɣ shɛli n-ko wain tihi puu.
en: She knows how to buy land and how to plant a vineyard.

dag: N yi di daa bi kana ti wuhi ba, bɛ naan ku mali taali, amaa pumpɔŋɔ bɛ ku tooi lan chihi yi bɛ taali maa ni.
en: They would not have been guilty of sin if I had not come and spoken to them; as it is, they no longer have any excuse for their sin.

dag: Yawɛ alibarika ni yi Ziɔn na paag a. Naawuni chɛ ka a nya Jɛrusalɛm tɔŋbu a dunia yili bebu ni zaa.
en: May the LORD bless you from Zion. May you experience Jerusalems goodness your whole life long.

dag: Ka Musa daa bɔhi Yawɛ, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ lala? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ niriba ŋɔ zaa ʒi tibisili ʒili ma ka bi sɔŋ ma?.
en: and he said to the Lord , Why have you treated me so badly? Why are you displeased with me? Why have you given me the responsibility for all these people?.

dag: Asirianim ku tooi tiligi ti, ti ku lan ba yuri yaha, ti mi ku lan boli ti ni zaŋ ti nuhi mali binshɛŋa la ti Naawuni. Yɛlimaŋli, kpibiga nya nambɔzɔbo.
en: Assyria can't save us, and chariots can't help. So we will no longer worship the idols we have made. Our Lord , you show mercy to orphans.

dag: dindina n ni tin ya sakom saa mibu saha, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani maa bindira niŋ pam, ka yi puri ni tihi wali wala.
en: and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun yɛli Sairus; A nyɛla m piɛgula, ka ni niŋ n ni yɛl a ni a niŋ shɛli. A ni yɛli ka bɛ lan me Jɛrusalɛm zali; ka chɛ ka bɛ sɔŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tampuɣili. .
en: He says to Cyrus, You are my shepherd. You will do what I want. You will say to Jerusalem, You will be rebuilt! You will tell the Temple, Your foundations will be put in place.

dag: Ka n yi saɣim yi suhuri n ni daa sab gban shɛli tin ya la puuni, n suhu bi miligi di zuɣu, hal n suhu ni daa pun miligi di zuɣu la zaa yoli, dama n nyaya ka gbaŋ maa daa shiri saɣim yi suhuri, amaa ka yi suhusaɣiŋgu maa daa lee bi yuui.
en: For even if that letter of mine made you sad, I am not sorry I wrote it. I could have been sorry when I saw that it made you sad for a while.

dag: Ka ŋun Yisahaku daa ti yi nti be samban ni zaawuni n-tɛhir o suhu ni, ka daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya ka laakumnim kanna.
en: One evening, Isaac went out to inspect the pasture, and while staring he saw camels approaching.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abishai, Pumpɔŋɔ Shiiba Bikiri bia ŋɔ ni niŋ ti barina pam n-gari Absalom ni daa niŋ ti shɛm la, dinzuɣu zaŋm a dan tɔbbihi ŋɔ m-biɛh o naba, di yi pa lala o ni ti kpe tiŋ shɛŋa bɛ ni me goondahi gili ni, ka muɣisi ti.
en: David said to Abishai, Sheba son of Bicri is more dangerous to us than Absalom was. So take my officers and chase Sheba. Hurry before he gets into cities with walls. If he gets into the well-protected cities, we will not be able to get him.

dag: Bɛ daa ku Ɛvi mini Rɛkɛm ni Zur ni Hur ni Rɛba bɛn daa nyɛ Midian nanim la m-pahi bɛ ni daa ku bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa zuɣu. Bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbi ku Bɛɔr bia Balaam gba.
en: They killed the kings of Midian: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian, along with others slain. They also killed Balaam, Beors son, with the sword.

dag: ni Hiburɔnnima ni ŋun Dauda min o niriba maa ni daa gɔri chani tiŋ shɛŋa zaa la nima.
en: and Hebron, and to all the other places where David and his men had stayed.

dag: M bia, gbaam amaŋa ka chɛ bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm maa.
en: My son, dont go on the path with them; keep your feet from their way.

dag: Yisa Masia dapulli zuɣu kum yɛla nyɛla jɛrilim bɛn be bahi yoli sol ni sani, amaa tinim bɛn tiligi ŋɔ sani, di nyɛla Naawuni yiko.
en: The message of the cross is foolishness to those who are being destroyed. But it is the power of God for those of us who are being saved.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun yuri ka tum alahichi, o yi nyɛla tiŋbia bee tinzun nira, o mola Yawɛ maa, di simdi ni bɛ ku dilana.
en: If someone sins and knows they are doing wrong, they are rebelling against the Lord . They must be separated from their people. The same law applies to citizens of Israel and to foreigners living among you.

dag: Di saha Sool daa pun zaŋla o bipuɣiŋga Mikal ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda paɣ la n-ti do so ŋun yuli booni Paliti ka o nyɛ Laishi Gallim nir bia la.
en: Meanwhile, Saul had given his daughter Michal, who had been David's wife, to Palti son of Laish, who was from the town of Gallim.

dag: Dabo shɛŋa zaa zuɣu bɛ ni daa kɔri bindira, gɔhi mini suligunyinyaɣu ni ti zooi lim nimaani ka so ku tooi kpe di ni, amaa nimaani ni ti leela niɣi mini piɛri gɔrim shee.
en: All the hills where crops were once planted will be so overgrown with thorns that no one will go there. It will be a place where cattle and sheep graze.

dag: Yɛlimiya zuliya kam zaa ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ naa! Dunia ŋɔ kpɛmmi ʒiɛya, ka kul ku vuui. O ni doli zaligu soli kari niriba saria.
en: Say to all the nations, The Lord is king! The earth is set firmly in place and cannot be moved; he will judge the peoples with justice.

dag: Hal bɛ ku tooi kahigi yɛl shɛŋa zuɣu bɛ ni fiɣisi ma ŋɔ wuh a.
en: Nor can they prove to you the allegations they are now bringing against me.

dag: Isaka zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tola daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Tolanima; ka Puva daŋ niriba nyɛ Puvanima.
en: There were , men from the tribe of Issachar; they were from the clans of Tola, Puvah, Jashub, and Shimron.

dag: Amaa chɛ ka a nuu pa ŋun be a nudirigu polo la zuɣu, ŋun nyɛ a ni ti so kpiɔŋ ti amaŋ la.
en: Let your hand be with the one on your right side— with the one whom you secured as your own.

dag: Zaŋmiya adiini yila mini Naawuni paɣibu yila ni Yila litaafi ni yila kpaŋsiri taba, ka yilimiya yila paɣimi ti Duuma ni yi suhuri zaa.
en: Encourage each other with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord.

dag: ti yɛli ma, Pool, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a. A ni bahi paai Naa Siiza tooni. Nyama, Naawuni ni tilig a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa bɛ ŋariŋ ŋɔ ni nyɛviya a zuɣu.
en: and said, Don't be afraid, Paul! You must stand before the Emperor. And God in his goodness to you has spared the lives of all those who are sailing with you.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka o daa zaŋ ti yab Ibrahimma zali wuntia zaani o yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: So God accepted him.

dag: di yi niŋ ka a nya paɣ viɛlli yi ni gbahi shɛb daba maa ni, ka bɔri ni a zaŋ o leeg a paɣa.
en: You might see a beautiful woman among the captives who you want to be your wife.

dag: A wuntitali nyɛla wuntitali din bi naara, ka a zaligunim nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: Your righteousness will last forever, and your law is always true.

dag: Mbusim din daŋ tooni pun gari; amaa ka mbusim diba ayi na doli di nyaaŋa na.
en: The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.

dag: Ka di daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb suli pam ka bɛ yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, Bɔzuɣu ka paɣ ŋɔ saɣim tulaale ŋɔ lala?.
en: Some grew angry. They said to each other, Why waste the perfume?.

dag: Amaa o niŋgbuŋ din nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu ŋmahinli la yɛla ka o daa yɛri maa.
en: But Jesus was talking about his body as a temple.

dag: ka zaŋ o nuu pa o biŋkɔbigu maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig o Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni, ka Aduna bidibisi maa zaŋ o ʒim maa kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Naawuni la.
en: Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Amazia ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa maa daa mali o kpamba saawara, ka tim ti yɛli Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa, ka nyɛ Jɛhɔahaz bia, ka nyɛ Jɛhu yaaŋa la ni o kana ti chɛ ka bɛ nina pali taba.
en: King Amaziah of Judah and his advisers plotted against Israel. He then sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel, who was the son of Jehoahaz and grandson of Jehu, challenging him to fight.

dag: Naawuni duya nti ʒini o nam ʒiishee ni tahigu. Yawɛ duya ni kikaa kumsi.
en: God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.

dag: Wummiya, yinim Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim dɔɣirikpamba mini bɛ nanim bɛn zaɣisi zaligu, ka tiri nimmira yɛlimaŋli ŋɔ.
en: Hear this, leaders of the house of Jacob, rulers of the house of Israel, you who reject justice and make crooked all that is straight.

dag: N ni lan bɔhi bɔhigu ŋɔ yaha: Naawuni zaɣisila o niriba? Naawuni di wuhi gba! Mmaŋmaŋ nyɛla Izraɛl zuliya ŋun nyɛ ti yab Ibrahimma yaaŋa, ka nyɛ ŋun yi Bɛnjamin zuliya ni na.
en: Am I saying that God has turned his back on his people? Certainly not! I am one of the people of Israel, and I myself am a descendant of Abraham from the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: Zuɣusaa nyɛla din wuhiri Naawuni jilima! Ka sagbana wuhir o nuhi tuma!.
en: How clearly the sky reveals God's glory! How plainly it shows what he has done!.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi mini yi ni chani ninvuɣ shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa lo tab alikauli. Yi yi niŋ lala, di ni leei tɔŋ yi sani.
en: Be careful! Dont make any agreement with the people who live in the land where you are going. If you make an agreement with them, it will bring you trouble.

dag: Sagbani maa daa yi kpalim ʒiɛya daba ayi bee goli bee di daa yi kpalim ʒe Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa zuɣusaa yuui, Izraɛlnim maa kul kpalindimi doya ka bi chana; amaa di daa yi ti vuui saha shɛli, bɛ gba yiɣisirimi gbaai chandi.
en: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a long time, the Israelites would camp so long as the cloud lingered on the dwelling and settled on it. They wouldnt march. But when it ascended, they would march.

dag: Yaakubu daa niŋla yuun pinaayopɔin Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni; ka o yuma kalinli daa yiɣisi yuun kɔbiga ni pihinahi ni ayopɔin.
en: After Jacob had lived in the land of Egypt for seventeen years, and after he had lived a total of years.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka liɣiri yɔhim a, a mi di chɛ ka birapu pam dibu kpɛh a yɔɣu.
en: don't let your anger and the pain you endured make you sneer at God.

dag: Ka o yidan Ɛlikana daa bɔh o Hanna, bɔ n-niŋ ka a mali suhugarigu, ka kumdi hal ti zaɣisi bindirigu? M bi gari bihi pia a sani.
en: So Elkanah asked, Hannah, why are you crying? Why won't you eat? Why do you feel so bad? Don't I mean more to you than ten sons.

dag: Yawɛ, a nyɛla ŋun wumdi nandaamba suhigu; ka lan nyɛ ŋun kpaŋsiri bɛ suhuri, ka ni gbilis a tibili wum.
en: LORD, you listen to the desires of those who suffer. You steady their hearts; you listen closely to them.

dag: Di yi pa lala, yi ni kɔŋ yi jilima yi tab sani, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi zɔri nambɔɣu kun ya ŋmaai yi yuma jia.
en: Otherwise, you will give your strength to others, your years to a cruel person.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yɛl bɔ? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Nazarɛt do so ŋun yuli booni Yisa, ka o daa nyɛ anab titali o tumtumsa min o yɛtɔɣa ni zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni mini salinim zaa san la yɛla.
en: What do you mean? Jesus asked. They answered: Those things that happened to Jesus from Nazareth. By what he did and said he showed that he was a powerful prophet, who pleased God and all the people.

dag: Ti daa fa bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ n-zaŋ li ti Rubin zuliya niriba mini Gaad zuliya niriba ni Manaasa zuliya niriba pirigili.
en: Then we took their land and gave it to the people in the tribes of Reuben and Gad and to half the tribe of Manasseh.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim maa nim kpillikpilli mini zuɣu ti o, ka o nyo di zaa buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Aarons sons gave the pieces and head of the burnt offering to Aaron, and he burned them on the altar.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o, N yi yu ni o kul kpalim beni hal ka n ti labina, di lee nya a ya? Nyin dee doli ma.
en: Jesus answered him, If I want him to live until I come, what is that to you? Follow me.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa bɔh o mabihi maa, Ti yi ku ti tizo ŋɔ ka wuhi ni pa tinima n-ku o, nyɔ bɔ ka ti lee yɛn nya di ni?.
en: Judah said to his brothers, What will we gain by killing our brother and covering up the murder?.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya: Alizanda nyɛla n nam ʒiishee, ka dunia ŋɔ nyɛ n naba zaashee. Ka yili bɔ ka yi yɛn me n-ti ma? Ka bee luɣ dini n-lee yɛn nyɛ n vuhibu shee?.
en: The LORD says: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool. So where could you build a house for me, and where could my resting place be?.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔram daa zaŋ sapashin kpamba min o chɛchɛbunsi zaa chaŋ yuŋ ti tuhi Ɛdomnim bɛn daa gil o min o chɛchɛbunsi sapashinnim niŋ sunsuuni la.
en: So Jehoram and his officers set out with chariots and invaded Edom. There the Edomite army surrounded them, but during the night they managed to break out and escape.

dag: bee bin bɔ ka sal lee yɛn zaŋ o nyɛvili taɣi?.
en: There is nothing you can give to regain your life.

dag: Ti Duuma pala ŋun bi niŋdi yomyom zaŋ chaŋ o daalikauli palibu polo kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni tɛhiri shɛm la, amaa o lee nyɛla ŋun mali suɣilo zaŋ chaŋ yi polo, dama o bi yu ni so ti bahi yoli, amaa o bɔri ni sokam zaa lee niŋla tuuba.
en: The Lord isnt slow to keep his promise, as some think of slowness, but he is patient toward you, not wanting anyone to perish but all to change their hearts and lives.

dag: Di saha ka Pita daa yiɣisi zan o nyaandolitab maa sunsuuni. Bɛ daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pisi laasabu ka o yɛli ba.
en: After a few days there was a meeting of the believers. There were about of them. Peter stood up and said.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikahi mini binyila n-yili suhupiɛlli yila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naa ŋɔ tooni.
en: Blow trumpets and horns, and shout for joy to the Lord , our king.

dag: Ashaaranim kul yɛn tuɣila taba, ka bɛ kul wumdi ŋumaŋuma luɣilikam. Bɛ ti kul yɛn bɔrila ʒii nyabu anabinim sani. Maligumaaniba wuhibu ni ti naai, ka ninkura kpamli yɛtɔɣa ti naai.
en: One disaster will follow another, and a steady stream of bad news will pour in. You will beg the prophets to reveal what they foresee. The priests will have nothing to teach the people, and the elders will have no advice to give.

dag: Amaa bɛn zo n-tiligi ni ti be Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu, ka di be kasi. Ka Yaakubu zuliya ni ti lan deei bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ la su yaha.
en: But there will be survivors on Mount Zion. They will be my special people. The nation of Jacob will take back what belongs to it.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Nyin ŋun nyɛ suhukpeendana ni kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ, Yawɛ be a sani.
en: The angel appeared and spoke to Gideon, The Lord is helping you, and you are a strong warrior.

dag: Ka n ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ zaa din nyɛ yi ni be tiŋgban shɛli puuni n-nyɛ saamba ŋɔ n-ti a min a zuliya maa, ka yi su li sahakam, ka n nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: I will give to you and to your descendants this land in which you are now a foreigner. The whole land of Canaan will belong to your descendants forever, and I will be their God.

dag: Buni ku tooi tiligi nir Naawuni suhuyiɣisili dali, amaa wuntitali tiligiri nir kum ni.
en: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.

dag: Amaa ti yi niŋ tahima ti nini ni na bi nya shɛli zuɣu, dindina ti ni di suɣilo guhiri li.
en: But we are hoping for something we dont have yet, and we are waiting for it patiently.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni ŋun be, ka nyɛ ŋun zaŋ ma ʒili m ba Dauda nam ʒiishee, ka me yili ti ma kaman o ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛm la zuɣu, n ni chɛ ka bɛ ku Adɔnija zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The Lord made me king in my father's place and promised that the kings of Israel would come from my family. Yes, I swear by the living Lord that Adonijah will die today.

dag: Bakɔi piligu dabisili dali kam, sokam zaa yihim kaman Naawuni ni lɔrig o shɛm tariga na ti zali, ka di chɛ ka n ti kana ka laɣ tɔhibu yɛla ku lan beni yaha.
en: On the first day of the week, each of you should set aside whatever you can afford from what you earn so that the collection wont be delayed until I come.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa kuhiri yɛra, Naawuni kukoli m-bɔŋɔ, pa ninsal dini.
en: It isn't a man speaking, but a god! they shouted.

dag: Yawɛ, a vihi ma m-baŋ ma zaa.
en: Lord , you have examined me and you know me.

dag: O daa zaŋla daanya mali sara maligu bimbini maa kurupooti n-zaŋ li zali di naŋgbaŋkuɣila lɔŋni, ka di du m-paai di pirigili tariga zaŋ siɣi tiŋ polo.
en: He made a bronze grating and put it under the rim of the altar, so that it reached halfway up the altar.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bi nya shɛli di ka di yuui zuɣu ka Pool daa ti yiɣisi zani bɛ sunsuuni yɛli, N yilikpɛrilaannima, yi yi di daa wum n yɛligu la ka chɛ ka ti kpalim Kriit, ti naan ku nya gamu shɛli mini ashaara shɛli ti ni nya ŋɔ.
en: For a long time no one had eaten. Paul stood up among them and said, Men, you should have complied with my instructions not to sail from Crete. Then we would have avoided this damage and loss.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ taaya n-yɔri vuri, ka di vuri kaman teeku vubu la. Aa, niriba maa yɔrila vuri, ka di vuri kaman kom pam vubu la.
en: Doom to the raging of many peoples; like the thundering seas they thunder. Doom to the roar of nations, like the roaring of mighty waters.

dag: Yi ni deei Yisa Masia n-leei yi Duuma la zuɣu, chɛliya ka yi min o laɣim be.
en: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ yɛliya ni bɛ daa na bi dɔɣi ma, ka o pii ma leeg o dabili ni n zaŋ Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnima, ka yam yɔɣu la labis o sanna. Yawɛ ti ma jilima. N kpiɔŋ yirila n Naawuni sanna.
en: And now the LORD has decided— the one who formed me from the womb as his servant— to restore Jacob to God, so that Israel might return to him. Moreover, Im honored in the LORDs eyes; my God has become my strength.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga bol o yuli Samuɛl, dama Hanna daa yɛlimi, N suh o la Yawɛ sani.
en: with a son. She named him Samuel because she had asked the Lord for him.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa, ka bi ʒe a kɔsoya maa nyaaŋa, n ni chɛ ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa bahi yoli n-leei dabari, zaŋ Migidol hal ni Sine n-zaŋ hal ti paai Itiɔpia tintariga.
en: Now I am turning against you and your river. Your nation will be nothing but an empty wasteland all the way from the town of Migdol in the north to Aswan in the south, and as far as the border of Ethiopia.

dag: Ŋuna n-su dunia tiŋgbani puuni ziliŋ; ka su zo kara la gba.
en: The earths depths are in his hands; the mountain heights belong to him.

dag: ka ŋunkam zaɣisi ni o ku jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni maa, dilan yi nyɛla ninkurigu bee bia bee doo bee paɣa, bɛn kum o.
en: Anyone who refused to serve the Lord God was to be killed. It did not matter if that person was important or not or if that person was a man or woman.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti yi mali dahima, yin chɛliya ka ti tum sokam zaa tuun suma, di bahi bamdi bɛn nyɛ mabi yinsi yɛda niŋbu puuni la.
en: We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord.

dag: O ti zaŋm o nuu pa bua maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig o luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim Yawɛ san la, ka di leei alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: He shall put his hand on its head and kill it on the north side of the altar, where the animals for the burnt offerings are killed. This is an offering to take away sin.

dag: N wuhiya ni a yurilim maŋli maa kul yɛn benimi sahakam; a ʒiɛyimtali mi kul bami ʒiɛya kaman zuɣusaa la.
en: Thats why I say, Your loyal love is rightly built—forever! You establish your faithfulness in heaven.

dag: Dama chɛrubinim maa daa yirigila bɛ kpiŋkpama n-lim Alikauli Adaka maa ni daa ʒe luɣ shɛli maa, dinzuɣu chɛrubinim maa n-daa nyɛ bimpindigu din pili Adaka maa mini di dapuhi la.
en: Their outstretched wings covered the box and the poles it was carried by.

dag: Di simdi ka o ti zaŋ firilanim maa tamtam salima firilatamdigu maa zuɣu ka di doli soli Yawɛ tooni sahakam.
en: Aaron must continually tend the lights on the pure lampstand before the LORD.

dag: Yi gba nyɛla n shɛhiranima, yi ni pun be n sani piligu ni hal ni pɔŋɔ la zuɣu.
en: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni yi taali ni Naawuni sani Masia ʒim zuɣu maa, din gari lala nyɛla, o zuɣu ka ti ni tiligi Naawuni suhuyiɣisili puuni yaha.
en: We have been made right with God by the blood sacrifice of Christ. So through Christ we will surely be saved from Gods anger.

dag: Gol tuuli biɛɣ pinaanahi dali zaawuni nyɛla yi ni yɛn zaŋdi Yaɣigari chuɣu pina tiri Yawɛ saha shɛli.
en: The Lord s Passover is on the th day of the first month just before dark.

dag: Wuntia puuni ka yi ni niŋ yaa. So ku lan nahim ya, ka dabiɛm ku lan mali ya. So ku lan kpɛhi ya dabiɛm, di ni ti niŋ ya katiŋa.
en: You will be built on fairness with no fears of injustice; every one of your worries will be taken far from you.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni daa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni di binshɛɣukam zaa naai.
en: So the earth, the sky, and everything in them were finished.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ me luɣ kasi shee ti ma din ni chɛ ka m be bɛ sani.
en: The people will build a holy place for me. Then I can live among them.

dag: Niŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ pahi asiba sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di nyɛ yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la zuɣu.
en: All of these are to be offered each day of the festival in additional to the regular sacrifices, and the smoke from them will please me.

dag: Amaa ka Mikaya yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, ŋun Yawɛ ni yɛli ma shɛm, lala ka n yɛn yɛli.
en: But Micaiah answered, By the living Lord I promise that I will say what he tells me to.

dag: Dindali maa ti Duuma ni ti lan zaŋ o niriba bɛn kpalim be tinduya ni la labisi yiŋ na yaha. O ni ti yihi ba Asiria mini Ijipti ni Patrɔs ni Itiɔpia ni Ɛlam ni Babilɔn ni Hamat ni teeku duli tinsi ni teeku noli tinsi ni na.
en: At that time the Lord will again reach out and take his people who are left in countries like Assyria, North Egypt, South Egypt, Ethiopia, Elam, Babylonia, Hamath, and other faraway countries around the world.

dag: Kalim Lɛvinima kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya mini bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm dɔbba bɛn nyɛ kaman gol yini zaŋ chana.
en: Now I want you to count the men and boys in the Levi tribe by families and by clans. Include every one at least a month old.

dag: Zaŋmiya zuliya kam na, ka chɛ ka niriba laɣimna. Bɛ ni ŋuni m-pun yɛl ti dimbɔŋɔ yɛla, ka yɛl ti kurimbuni ha yɛla zali? Bɛ zaŋm bɛ shɛhiranim na ka bɛ ti zani bɛ nyaaŋa, ka chɛ ka bɛ wum ka yɛli ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Summon the nations to come to the trial. Which of their gods can predict the future? Which of them foretold what is happening now? Let these gods bring in their witnesses to prove that they are right, to testify to the truth of their words.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Yi yi ti nya ka Sirianim maa yɛn nyaŋ ma, yin zomiya n kuŋa, m mi yi ti nya ka Ammɔnnim maa yɛn nyaŋ ya, n ni zo yi kuŋa.
en: Joab told his brother, If the Syrians are too much for me to handle, come and help me. And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, I'll come and help you.

dag: ka o lan labi kpe saria karibu shee maa ti bɔhi Yisa, Tiŋkani ka a yina? Ka Yisa bi garig o shɛli.
en: He went back into the palace and asked Jesus, Where do you come from? But Jesus did not answer.

dag: Bɔ ka yɛnnim lee zaŋ so jɛra? Ka nyɔ bɔ ka tarimba lee nya bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm ni bɛ gbib bɛmaŋa niriba ni?.
en: How are the wise better off than fools? What good does it do the poor to know how to face life?.

dag: ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmaligi ka chɛ Yawɛ dolibu ka bi lan jɛmd o bee m-bɔhir o binshɛli yɛla la birili.
en: Nothing will remain of anyone who has turned away and rejected me.

dag: ka daa lo o mihi n-zaŋ o tahi Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: They put him in chains, led him off, and handed him over to Pilate, the Roman governor.

dag: Dauda ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb Hiburɔn m-bɔŋɔ: o bituuli n-daa nyɛ Amnɔn ŋun ma daa nyɛ Ahinɔam ka o yi Jɛziriil na la, ŋun pa o zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Daniɛl ŋun ma daa nyɛ Abigeel ŋun daa yi Kamɛl na la.
en: Some of Davids sons were born in the town of Hebron. This is a list of Davids sons: Davids first son was Amnon. Amnons mother was Ahinoam. She was from the town of Jezreel. The second son was Daniel. His mother was Abigail from Carmel in Judah.

dag: Di yi nyɛla nir min o kpee chaŋla mɔɣu ni ni bɛ ti ŋma dari, ka o ti yaai kpaŋ ni o ŋmaai tia luhi, ka kpan zuɣu ŋooi n-ŋme o kpee maa ka o kpi, ŋun ku o maa ni tooi zo n-kuli fɔntinsi ŋɔ tin yin ni tiligi.
en: For example, suppose you and a friend go into the forest to cut wood. You are chopping down a tree with an ax, when the ax head slips off the handle, hits your friend, and kills him. You can run to one of the Safe Towns and save your life.

dag: Kaman saa pɔhim ni tahiri sakom na shɛm, lala ka nyaanzum tahiri suhuyiɣisili na.
en: Just as wind blowing from the north brings rain, telling secrets brings anger.

dag: Chɛ ka a neesim min a yɛlimaŋli kana; ka chɛ ka di wuhi ma soli n-zaŋ ma tahi a zoli din be kasi ka nyɛ a ni be luɣ shɛl la zuɣu.
en: Send your light and your truth; may they lead me and bring me back to Zion, your sacred hill, and to your Temple, where you live.

dag: Ŋun di nasara ni ti ye binyɛr piɛla ŋɔ tatabo, ka n ku kpihim o yuli nyɛvili litaafi ni; amaa ka ni ti zan o nyaaŋa m-bol o yuli m Ba Naawuni min o malaikanim sani.
en: Those who emerge victorious will wear white clothing like this. I wont scratch out their names from the scroll of life, but will declare their names in the presence of my Father and his angels.

dag: Nir yi mali biɛla ka wuntitali be di ni, di so ni nir mali pam ka di bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: It is better to have a little, honestly earned, than to have a large income, dishonestly gained.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, dim n ni zaŋ binshɛli ti a maa, ŋubimi gbaŋ maa ka chaŋ ti tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim yɛtɔɣa.
en: God said, Mortal man, eat this scroll; then go and speak to the people of Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be nimaani maa ka ninkur so ti yi o puuni na zaawuni. Doo maa daa yila Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoya ni tiŋ ni na ti be Gibia maa. Amaa nimaaninim daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba.
en: Then in the evening, an old man was coming home from his daily work in the fields. This man was from the Ephraim highlands and was an immigrant in Gibeah, the people of that place being Benjaminites.

dag: Ka Pita kpuɣ o nuhi gahi wuhi ni bɛ foma, ka o daa kahigi Naawuni ni niŋ shɛm yih o duu maa ni wuhi ba; ka yɛli ba ni bɛ yɛlim Jeemsi mini yɛdaniŋdiba zaa di yɛla. Ka daa yi nimaani chaŋ luɣ shɛli.
en: Peter motioned for them to keep quiet. Then he told how the Lord had led him out of jail. He also said, Tell James and the others what has happened. After that, he left and went somewhere else.

dag: Wuntizɔriba nyɔri nyɛla nyɛvili tia, amaa duŋtaabo dirila nyɛvili.
en: What good people produce is like a life-giving tree. Those who are wise give new life to others.

dag: Ʒiɛmana din kanna niriba ni ti jɛm o; bɛ ni ti yɛli ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna niriba ti Duuma yɛla.
en: Future generations will serve him; they will speak of the Lord to the coming generation.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa yi mir o ni o damd o tiŋa n-lu o sizuura, o teerila o nuu gbaai dilana m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: And if anyone came to Absalom and started to bow down to him, Absalom would treat him like a close friend—he would reach out and touch him and kiss him.

dag: Jaadai bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Rɛgɛm mini Jɔtam ni Gɛshan ni Pɛlɛt ni Ɛfa ni Shaaf.
en: A man named Jahdai had six sons: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

dag: Di saha ka Sool suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Jɔnatan zuɣu, ka o yɛl o, Nyin ŋun nyɛ paɣ yoli ŋun bi zani tuhi bia ŋɔ. A tɛhi ni m bi mi ni a zaŋ Jɛsi dapala maa kpɛh a kɔbili ni ni a dihila amaŋ vi, ka lan dih a ma gba vi?.
en: Saul became furious with Jonathan and said to him, How rebellious and faithless your mother was! Now I know you are taking sides with David and are disgracing yourself and that mother of yours!.

dag: dama Naawuni bi zaŋla shia ŋun ni chɛ ka ti zɔri dabiɛm ti ti, amaa shi so ŋun ni chɛ ka ti mali yiko mini yurilim ni maŋgbibbu ka o zaŋ ti ti.
en: God's Spirit doesn't make cowards out of us. The Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.

dag: Amaa so ni bɔhi, Ka wula ka kpiimba lee yɛn tooi neei kum ni? Ka niŋgbun bɔ ka bɛ lee yɛn mali.
en: Someone will ask, How can the dead be raised to life? What kind of body will they have.

dag: Saha shɛlikam bɛ daa yi ti kpuɣi Alikauli Adaka maa chana, Musa yɛrimi, Yawɛ, yiɣisim chɛ ka a dimnim wurim, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je a ŋmalig a tooni guui.
en: Each day as the Israelites began their journey, Moses would pray, Our Lord , defeat your enemies and make them run.

dag: ni o deei Judas ni daa tum birigi n-chaŋ o chandi shee ka chɛ tinim tuumba ŋɔ tuun shɛl la.
en: to serve as an apostle in the place of Judas, who left to go to the place where he belongs.

dag: Taainim ni zaŋ pina na ti ti a m-bɔri ni a niŋ ba nirilim, ka bundaannim gba ni zaŋ pina balibu kam na ti ti a.
en: People from Tyre will bring you gifts. Their richest people will try to win your friendship.

dag: Hal o ni daa bi tum tuumbiɛ shɛli, ka ʒiri daa ka o nol ni maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa gbi o gballi garila tuumbiɛrinim gbala ni; ka daa sɔɣ o pahi bundan zuɣu.
en: He was placed in a grave with those who are evil, he was buried with the rich, even though he had never committed a crime or ever told a lie.

dag: So yi bɔr ni o ŋme o naŋgbankpeeni, o ni bɔh o bɔhigunim tuhili, ka o ku tooi garigi bɔhigu yini gba.
en: How can anyone argue with him? He can ask a thousand questions that no one could ever answer.

dag: Naawuni ni niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ n ni zuɣu, n kpamdi yi zaa jaande ni yi ni so di tɛhi ni omaŋmaŋ bebu gari o bebu ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa lee tɛhimiyala nimmoo tɛha, ka zahimmiya yimaŋa viɛnyɛliŋga kaman Naawuni ni ti sokam yɛda shɛm.
en: And because of God's gracious gift to me I say to every one of you: Do not think of yourself more highly than you should. Instead, be modest in your thinking, and judge yourself according to the amount of faith that God has given you.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni bɔri ni niriba niŋdi ya shɛm, yi gba niŋmiya ba lala, dama Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim min anabinim yɛligu ni wuhiri shɛm m-bala.
en: Do for others what you would want them to do for you. This is the meaning of the Law of Moses and the teaching of the prophets.

dag: Ka o gba ŋmaligi bɔhi ma, A bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛli? Ka n garigi yɛli, N dana, m bi mi.
en: Don't you know? he asked me. No, I don't, sir, I replied.

dag: Ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ garig o, bee n nya yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis o?.
en: How, then, could I possibly argue my case with God?.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi nachimbil so ŋun daa yɛl o li maa, Tiŋ kani ka a lee yina? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N nyɛla Amalɛk saan so ŋun be a tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni bia.
en: Where are you from? David asked the young man who brought him the news. Im the son of an immigrant, he answered. An Amalekite.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la kul bela n tooni, ka n dol a ni ʒiɛyimtali.
en: Because your faithful love is right in front of me— I walk in your truth!.

dag: Obadia daa nyɛla Shɛmaya bia, ka Shɛmaya nyɛ Galal bia, ka Galal nyɛ Jɛdutun bia, ka Jɛdutun nyɛ Bɛrɛkia bia, ka Bɛrɛkia nyɛ Asa bia, ka Asa nyɛ Ɛlikana ŋun daa ʒi Nɛtɔfanim tiŋkpaŋ la bia.
en: Obadiah son of Shemaiah son of Galal son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah son of Asa son of Elkanah, who lived in the settlements of the Netophathites.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ mani m-pii duu ŋɔ m-mal li ka di be kasi ni di chɛ ka yi jɛmdi ma di puuni ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka n ni chɛ ka n zaɣa be di ni ka lan yuuni li sahakam.
en: because it belongs to me, and this is where I will be worshiped forever. I will never stop watching over it.

dag: Dinzuɣu wuhim ti ka ti kaani ti dabisa, din ni chɛ ka ti niŋ yɛm ti suhuri ni.
en: Teach us how short our life is, so that we may become wise.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ shɛhira maa zaa daa kul bi bahi doli taba.
en: But also what these people said did not agree.

dag: Jɛramiil ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛzirɔn bituuli san la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ram ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli san la mini Buna ni Orɛn ni Ozɛm ni Ahija.
en: Jerahmeel, Hezron's oldest son, was the father of Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, dabisa kanna, ka n ni ti zaŋ daadamnim mini biŋkɔbiri niŋ Izraɛl mini Juda tiŋgbana ni.
en: The days are coming, says the Lord , when I will help the family of Israel and Judah to grow. I will help their children and animals to grow too. It will be like planting and caring for a plant.

dag: ni bɛn be Aroa mini bɛn be Sifimɔt ni bɛn be Ɛshitɛmɔa.
en: Aroer, Siphmoth, Eshtemoa.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun pah ata la ŋun daa zaŋ o yiŋlan maa ni ti o laɣ shɛli maa ti gaai bɔɣili zaŋ li pi.
en: But the servant who got one bag of money went away and dug a hole in the ground. Then he hid his masters money in the hole.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla Avimnim bɛn daa be tiŋkpansi zaŋ hal ni Gaza la, Kafitɔrimnim bɛn daa yi Kafitɔr na la daa ku ba ka ʒini bɛ ʒiishee maa.
en: A group called the Avvim used to live in villages as far south as Gaza, but the Philistines killed them and settled on their land.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni chɛ ka bɛ gbaai Sintani ŋun yɔhindi ba maa n-zaŋ o bahi buɣim teeku din nyɛ chilibi buɣim ni, luɣ shɛli biŋkɔbigu la min o daanabi ʒirilan la ni pun be, ka bɛ ni nyari nahiŋgu yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: And he was thrown into the lake of burning sulfur with the beast and the false prophet. There they would be tortured day and night forever and ever.

dag: O ni wolig omaŋ ti Yawɛ dabisa shɛŋa maa zaa puuni, o di miri kpima.
en: The period of dedication to the LORD also requires that the person not go near a corpse.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa baŋ nɛma maa ka yɛli, Paɣ maa nyɛla wuntizɔra n-gari ma, n ni bi zaŋ o ti m bia Shɛla la zuɣu. Ka o daa bi saɣi ka o mini paɣ maa lan dɔni yaha.
en: Judah recognized these things and said, She is right. I was wrong. I did not give her my son Shelah like I promised. And Judah did not sleep with her again.

dag: Naa, ti gba ni nyar a nam daanfaani la zuɣu n-chɛ ka ti bi bɔri ni ti nya a filiŋ, dinzuɣu ka ti timna ti yɛl a.
en: Since we receive our salary from the palace, and since it is not fitting for us to witness the kings dishonor, we now send this letter and inform the king.

dag: Pool mini Baanabas ni daa be Aikɔnium maa ka bɛ daa ti doli taba chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu ti yihi waazu, ka Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim pam daa niŋ yɛda.
en: Paul and Barnabas spoke in the synagogue in Iconium, just as they had done at Antioch, and many Jews and Gentiles put their faith in the Lord.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli kɔbiliga maa yuli Bɛrilahairoi; ka di do Kadɛshi mini Bɛrɛd sunsuuni.
en: That is why people call the well between Kadesh and Bered The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me.

dag: Reechɛl ni daa nya ka o bi dɔɣi bihi ti Yaakubu maa zuɣu ka o daa zabir o biɛli nyuli, ka yɛli Yaakubu, Tim ma bihi, di yi pa lala, n ni kpi.
en: When Rachel realized that she could bear Jacob no children, Rachel became jealous of her sister and said to Jacob, Give me children! If you dont, I may as well be dead.

dag: Izraɛl bihi min o yaansi bɛn daa dol o kuli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihiyɔbunaayɔbu. O bidibisi paɣiba daa ka bɛ kalinli maa ni.
en: The total number of Jacobs direct descendants who went with him to Egypt was people.

dag: Ka shi so daa tɔhi zani Yawɛ tooni yɛl o, Man ni niŋ o naŋgban malisim. Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, So dini ka a lee yɛn doli.
en: until one particular spirit approached the LORD and said, I will persuade him. How? the LORD asked.

dag: Di daba ata dali, niriba maa gunibu maa yuma ni daa na biɛri saha shɛli maa, ka Yaakubu bidibis ayi, Simiɔn mini Lɛvi bɛn daa nyɛ Daina tizɔdɔbba la daa zaŋ takɔbiri chaŋ ti liri tiŋ maa nima n-libigi ba ku bɛ dɔbba zaa.
en: On the third day, when they were still in pain, two of Jacobs sons and Dinahs brothers Simeon and Levi took their swords, came into the city, which suspected nothing, and killed every male.

dag: Ka yi gba be biɛr yoli n-gari yi yaannim maa ni daa be shɛm maa. Yinim m-bɔŋɔ: yi zaɣ yino kam niŋla tipawumli n-doli zaɣ biɛɣu soli, ka zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu.
en: But you people have sinned more than your ancestors. You are very stubborn, and you are doing only what you want to do. You are not obeying me. Because you do only what you want to do.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ninsalinim zɔr o; o bi lihi nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lihi bɛmaŋ yɛnnim la.
en: Therefore, people fear him; none of the wise can see him.

dag: Ka n daa bu n-nuɣisi ba kaman pɔhim ni ʒiɛri taŋkpa zim shɛli chana, ka n daa zaŋ ba labi kaman soli zuɣu baɣiri la.
en: I crush them, so that they become like dust which the wind blows away. I trample on them like mud in the streets.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba daa ti ka Yisa sanna nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka ti mini Farisiinim lɔri noli, ka nyin nyaandoliba bi lɔra.
en: Then the followers of John the Baptist came to Jesus, asking, Why is it that we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don't fast at all.

dag: Amaa o bihi yi ti zaɣisi n zaligu, ka bi doli n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi.
en: But if his descendants disobey my law and do not live according to my commands.

dag: Lala zuɣu ti suhuri saɣimmi; dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ti nina fulimmi.
en: We are sick at our very hearts and can hardly see through our tears.

dag: Yi sɔŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun ka yiko pam; yi tiligi bɔɣu din ka yaa ŋɔ.
en: How well you have helped the weak, saved those with frail arms.
